Translation: In the event of any disagreement regarding the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the designated airlines or the relevant competent authorities of the Contracting Parties shall resolve the issue through direct consultations in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding.

Query_Text_cn: 如不能达成协议,缔约双方应通过外交途径解决。
Translation: If an agreement cannot be reached, the contracting parties shall resolve the matter through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条缔约一方如认为需要修改或补充本协定或其附件的任何条款,可随时向缔约另一方提出协商,此项协商应在缔约另一方接到建议之日起六十天内进行。
Translation: Article 14: If either Contracting Party deems it necessary to amend or supplement any provision of this Agreement or its annexes, it may at any time propose consultations to the other Contracting Party. Such consultations shall take place within sixty days from the date the other Contracting Party receives the proposal.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定或其附件的任何修改或补充,应经缔约双方换文确认后生效。
Translation: Any amendment or supplement to this Agreement or its annexes shall become effective upon confirmation by exchange of letters between the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条本协定自签字之日起生效。
Translation: Article 15 This Agreement shall enter into force upon the date of signature.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方可随时将终止本协定的愿望通知缔约另一方。
Translation: Either contracting party may notify the other contracting party at any time of its desire to terminate this agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约另一方接到通知之日起十二个月后终止，如在期满前，缔约一方提出撤销上述通知，并取得缔约另一方同意后，则本协定继续有效。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate twelve months after one contracting party receives notice from the other. However, if the party that gave such notice withdraws it before the expiration of the twelve-month period and obtains the consent of the other contracting party, this Agreement shall remain in force.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七九年七月八日在北京签订，共两份，每份都用中文、菲律宾文和英文写成，叁种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Beijing on July 8, 1979, in two originals, each in the Chinese, Filipino, and English languages, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 所得税（以下简称“乌干达税收”）。
Translation: Income tax (hereinafter referred to as "Uganda Tax").

Query_Text_cn: 一、在本协定中，“缔约国一方居民”一语是指按照该缔约国法律，由于住所、居所、成立地、管理机构所在地，或者其他类似的标准，在该缔约国负有纳税义务的人，并且包括该缔约国和其地方当局。
Translation: 1. In this Agreement, the term "resident of a Contracting State" refers to any person who, under the laws of that Contracting State, is liable to tax therein by reason of domicile, residence, place of incorporation, place of management, or any other similar criterion, and includes that Contracting State and its local authorities.

Query_Text_cn: （七）矿场、油井或气井、采石场或者其他开采自然资源的场所。
Translation: (7) A mine, oil or gas well, quarry, or any other place for the extraction of natural resources.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约国一方企业通过雇员或者其他人员在缔约国另一方提供劳务，包括咨询劳务，但仅以该性质的活动（为同一项目或相关联的项目）在任何十二个月中连续或累计超过183天的为限。
Translation: (b) An enterprise of one Contracting State provides services, including consultancy services, in the other Contracting State through its employees or other personnel, but only if such activities (for the same or a connected project) continue for a period or periods aggregating more than 183 days within any twelve-month period.

Query_Text_cn: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人（除适用第六款规定的独立地位代理人以外）在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权以该企业的名义签订合同并经常行使这种权力，这个人为该企业进行的任何活动，应认为该企业在该缔约国一方设有常设机构，除非这个人通过固定营业场所进行的活动限于第四款的规定。按照该款规定，不应认为该固定营业场所是常设机构。
Translation: 5. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2, where a person—other than an agent of independent status to whom paragraph 6 applies—is acting on behalf of an enterprise of one Contracting State and has, and habitually exercises, in a Contracting State the authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise, that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in that State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise, unless the activities of such person are limited to those referred to in paragraph 4 which, if exercised through a fixed place of business, would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 六、在执行上述各款时，除有适当的和充分的理由需要变动外，每年应采用相同的方法确定归属于常设机构的利润。
Translation: 6. In applying the provisions of the preceding paragraphs, unless there are appropriate and sufficient reasons for variation, the method used to determine the profits attributable to a permanent establishment shall be applied consistently from year to year.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方企业以船舶或飞机经营国际运输业务取得的利润，应仅在该国征税。
Translation: Profits derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在下列任何一种情况下：（一）缔约国一方企业直接或者间接参与缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本，或者（二）相同的人直接或者间接参与缔约国一方企业和缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本，两个企业之间商业或财务关系的构成条件不同于独立企业之间商业或财务关系的构成条件，并且由于这些条件的存在，导致其中一个企业没有取得其本应取得的利润，则可以将这部分利润计入该企业的所得，并据以征税。
Translation: 1. In any of the following circumstances: (i) where an enterprise of one Contracting State participates directly or indirectly in the management, control, or capital of an enterprise of the other Contracting State; or (ii) where the same person participates directly or indirectly in the management, control, or capital of an enterprise of one Contracting State and an enterprise of the other Contracting State, and in either case, the commercial or financial relations between the two enterprises are made or imposed under conditions different from those that would be made between independent enterprises, then any profits which would, but for those conditions, have accrued to one of the enterprises but, by reason of those conditions, have not so accrued, may be included in the profits of that enterprise and taxed accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些股息也可以在支付股息的公司是其居民的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果股息受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过股息总额的7.5%。
Translation: 2. However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, in accordance with the laws of that Contracting State. Nevertheless, if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 7.5% of the gross amount of the dividends.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“股息”一语是指从股份或者非债权关系分享利润的其他权利取得的所得，以及按照分配利润的公司是其居民的缔约国法律，视同股份所得同样征税的其他公司权利取得的所得。
Translation: 3. The term "dividends" as used in this Article refers to income derived from shares or other rights, not being debt-claims, that entitle the holder to participate in profits, as well as income from other corporate rights which, under the laws of the Contracting State of which the company making the distribution is a resident, is subject to the same taxation treatment as income from shares.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些利息也可以在其发生的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果利息受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过利息总额的10%。
Translation: 2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, in accordance with the laws of that State. Nevertheless, if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10% of the gross amount of the interest.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第二款的规定，发生于缔约国一方而由缔约国另一方政府、其地方当局或中央银行或者完全为缔约国另一方政府所拥有的金融机构取得的利息；或者由该缔约国另一方任何其他居民取得的利息，但其债权是由该缔约国另一方政府、其地方当局或中央银行或者完全为缔约国另一方政府所拥有的金融机构保险、担保或间接提供资金的，应在首先提及的缔约国一方免税。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2, interest arising in one Contracting State and received by the government, local authorities, or central bank of the other Contracting State, or by a financial institution wholly owned by the government of the other Contracting State, or by any other resident of the other Contracting State whose debt claim is insured, guaranteed, or indirectly financed by the government, local authorities, or central bank of the other Contracting State, or by a financial institution wholly owned by the government of the other Contracting State, shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，对该支付款项的超出部分，仍应按各缔约国的法律征税，但应对本协定其他规定予以适当注意。
Translation: In such cases, the excess portion of the payment shall remain subject to taxation in accordance with the laws of the respective Contracting States, with due regard to the other provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些特许权使用费也可以在其发生的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果特许权使用费受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过特许权使用费总额的10%。
Translation: 2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, in accordance with the laws of that State. Nevertheless, if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10% of the gross amount of the royalties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“特许权使用费”一语是指为使用或有权使用任何文学、艺术或科学着作，包括电影影片、无线电或电视广播使用的胶片、磁带的版权，任何专利、商标、设计或模型、图纸、秘密配方或秘密程序，或任何工业、商业、科学设备所支付的作为报酬的各种款项；或者为有关工业、商业、科学经验的信息所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。
Translation: 3. The term "royalties" as used in this Article refers to payments of any kind received as consideration for the use of, or the right to use, any copyright of literary, artistic, or scientific works, including cinematograph films, tapes used for radio or television broadcasting, any patent, trademark, design or model, plan, secret formula or process, or for the use of, or the right to use, any industrial, commercial, or scientific equipment; or for information concerning industrial, commercial, or scientific experience.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果支付特许权使用费的人--不论是否为缔约国一方居民--在缔约国一方设有常设机构或者固定基地，支付该特许权使用费的义务与该常设机构或者固定基地有联系，并由其负担该特许权使用费，上述特许权使用费应认为发生于该常设机构或者固定基地所在的缔约国。
Translation: However, if the person paying the royalties—regardless of whether they are a resident of a Contracting State—has a permanent establishment or fixed base in a Contracting State, and the obligation to pay such royalties is connected with that permanent establishment or fixed base and is borne by it, then such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the Contracting State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国一方企业转让从事国际运输的船舶或飞机，或者转让属于经营上述船舶、飞机的动产取得的收益，应仅在该缔约国征税。
Translation: 3. Gains derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from the alienation of ships or aircraft operated in international traffic, or movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships or aircraft, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 五、转让第一款至第四款所述财产以外的其他财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 5. Gains derived from the alienation of property other than those referred to in paragraphs 1 to 4 shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the transferor is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在有关纳税年度开始或结束的任何12个月内在缔约国另一方停留连续或累计达到或超过183天。
Translation: (b) Staying in the other Contracting State for a continuous or cumulative period of 183 days or more within any 12-month period beginning or ending in the relevant tax year.

Query_Text_cn: （三）该项报酬不是由雇主设在缔约国另一方的常设机构或固定基地所负担。
Translation: (3) The remuneration is not borne by a permanent establishment or fixed base which the employer has in the other contracting state.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条上述规定，在缔约国一方企业经营国际运输的船舶或飞机上从事受雇活动取得的报酬，可以在该缔约国征税。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the provisions of this Article, remuneration derived from employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic by an enterprise of a Contracting State may be taxed in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条董事费缔约国一方居民作为缔约国另一方居民公司的董事会成员取得的董事费和其他类似款项，可以在缔约国另一方征税。
Translation:
Article 16: Directors' Fees

Directors' fees and other similar payments received by a resident of one Contracting State in their capacity as a member of the board of directors of a company that is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条上述规定，作为缔约国一方居民的表演家或运动员在缔约国另一方按照缔约国双方政府的文化交流计划进行活动取得的所得，在该缔约国另一方应予免税。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the provisions of this Article, income derived by entertainers or athletes who are residents of one Contracting State from activities performed in the other Contracting State under a cultural exchange program agreed upon by the governments of both Contracting States shall be exempt from tax in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用第十九条第二款的规定外，因以前的雇佣关系支付给缔约国一方居民的退休金和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 1. Except as provided in paragraph 2 of Article 19, pensions and other similar remuneration paid to a resident of one Contracting State in respect of past employment shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、（一）缔约国一方政府或其地方当局对履行政府职责向其提供服务的个人支付退休金以外的报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 1. (a) Remuneration, other than a pension, paid by a Contracting State or its local authorities to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or authorities in the discharge of governmental functions shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、（一）缔约国一方政府或其地方当局支付或者从其建立的基金中支付给向其提供服务的个人的退休金，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 2. (1) Pensions paid by the government of one Contracting Party or its local authorities, or from funds established by them, to individuals in respect of services rendered to that government or local authorities shall be taxable only in that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如果任何个人是缔约国一方居民，或者在紧接前往缔约国另一方之前曾是缔约国一方居民，主要为了在该缔约国另一方政府认可的大学、学院、学校或教育机构或科研机构从事教学、讲学或研究的目的而停留在该缔约国另一方，对其由于教学、讲学或研究取得的报酬，该缔约国另一方应自其第一次到达之日起，两年内免予征税。
Translation: 1. If any individual is a resident of one Contracting State, or was a resident of one Contracting State immediately prior to visiting the other Contracting State, and stays in the other Contracting State primarily for the purpose of teaching, lecturing, or conducting research at a university, college, school, educational institution, or research institution recognized by the government of that other Contracting State, the remuneration received by such individual for teaching, lecturing, or research shall be exempt from tax in that other Contracting State for a period of two years from the date of their first arrival.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款的规定仅适用于个人按照缔约国双方的技术协议为公共利益而进行的讲学、教学和研究活动取得的收入。
Translation: 2. The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall apply only to income derived by an individual from lecturing, teaching, and research activities carried out in the public interest in accordance with a technical agreement between the Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第一款所述学生、企业学徒或实习生取得的未包括在第一款中的赠款、奖学金和受雇所得，在接受教育或培训期间，应与其所停留国居民享受同样的免税、优惠或减税。
Translation: 2. Grants, scholarships, and employment income received by students, company apprentices, or interns as mentioned in Paragraph 1, which are not included in Paragraph 1, shall, during their period of education or training, enjoy the same exemptions, allowances, or reductions in taxation as are accorded to residents of the country in which they are staying.

Query_Text_cn: （一）中国居民从乌干达取得的所得，按照本协定规定在乌干达缴纳的税额，可以在对该居民征收的中国税收中抵免。
Translation: (1) For income derived by Chinese residents from Uganda, the amount of tax paid in Uganda in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement may be credited against the Chinese tax levied on such residents.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，抵免额不应超过对该项所得按照中国税法和规章计算的中国税收数额。
Translation: However, the amount of the credit shall not exceed the amount of Chinese tax calculated on such income in accordance with Chinese laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: （二）从乌干达取得的所得是乌干达居民公司支付给中国居民公司的股息，并且该中国居民公司拥有支付股息公司股份不少于20%的，该项抵免应考虑支付该股息公司就该项所得缴纳的乌干达税收。
Translation: (2) Where the income derived from Uganda is dividends paid by a resident company of Uganda to a resident company of China, and the Chinese resident company holds at least 20% of the shares of the company paying the dividends, the credit shall take into account the Ugandan tax paid by the company paying the dividends in respect of such income.

Query_Text_cn: 乌干达居民取得的所得，按照本协定规定可以在中国征税的，乌干达应允许从对该居民的所得征收的税额中扣除等于在中国缴纳的所得税的数额。
Translation: Where income derived by a resident of Uganda may be taxed in China in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement, Uganda shall allow a deduction from the tax payable on such income by that resident an amount equal to the income tax paid in China.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，该项扣除应不超过可以在中国征税的所得在扣除前计算的那部分乌干达所得税数额。
Translation: However, such deduction shall not exceed the portion of Ugandan income tax attributable to the income taxable in China, calculated before the deduction.

Query_Text_cn: 三、除适用第九条第一款、第十一条第七款或第十二条第六款的规定外，缔约国一方企业支付给缔约国另一方居民的利息、特许权使用费和其他款项，在确定该企业应纳税利润时，应像支付给该缔约国一方居民的一样，在相同情况下予以扣除。
Translation: 3. Except as provided in paragraph 1 of Article 9, paragraph 7 of Article 11, or paragraph 6 of Article 12, interest, royalties, and other payments made by an enterprise of one Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall, for the purpose of determining the taxable profits of such enterprise, be deductible under the same conditions as if they had been paid to a resident of the first-mentioned State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国双方主管当局应通过相互协商设法解决在解释或实施本协定时所发生的困难或疑义，也可以对本协定未作规定的消除双重征税问题进行协商。
Translation: 3. The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall endeavor to resolve by mutual consultation any difficulties or doubts arising in the interpretation or application of this Agreement, and may also consult each other on the elimination of double taxation in cases not provided for in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 为有助于达成协议，双方主管当局的代表可以进行会谈，口头交换意见。
Translation: To facilitate the conclusion of an agreement, representatives of the competent authorities of both parties may hold meetings and exchange views orally.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方主管当局应交换可以预见的与执行本协定的规定相关的信息，或与执行缔约国双方或其地方当局征收的各种税收的国内法律相关的信息，以根据这些法律征税与本协定不相抵触为限。
Translation: 1. The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall exchange information that is foreseeably relevant to the implementation of the provisions of this Agreement, or to the domestic laws concerning the imposition of various taxes by either Contracting State or its local authorities, insofar as such taxation is not contrary to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条外交代表和领事官员本协定应不影响按国际法一般原则或特别协定规定的外交代表或领事官员的税收特权。
Translation:
Article 27: Diplomatic Representatives and Consular Officers

This Agreement shall not affect the tax privileges of diplomatic representatives or consular officers as provided under the general principles of international law or specific agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条生效缔约国双方应通过外交途径相互通知已完成本协定生效所必需的国内法律程序。
Translation: Article 28: The Contracting Parties shall notify each other through diplomatic channels upon completion of the domestic legal procedures necessary for the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 协定自后一方通知收到之日起第30天生效。
Translation: The agreement shall enter into force on the 30th day following the date of receipt of notification by one party.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定将适用于在协定生效年度的次年1月1日或以后开始的纳税年度中取得的所得。
Translation: This Agreement shall apply to income derived in taxable years beginning on or after January 1 of the year following the year in which the Agreement enters into force.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条终止本协定应长期有效。但缔约国任何一方可以在本协定生效之日起满5年后任何历年的6月30日或以前，通过外交途径书面通知对方终止本协定。
Translation:
Article 29 Termination

This Agreement shall remain in force for a long period. However, either Contracting Party may terminate this Agreement by giving written notice to the other Party through diplomatic channels on or before June 30 of any calendar year after the expiration of five years from the date of entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，本协定对终止通知发出年度的次年1月1日或以后开始的纳税年度中取得的所得停止有效。
Translation: In such cases, this Agreement shall cease to have effect in respect of income derived in any tax year beginning on or after January 1 of the year following the year in which the notice of termination is given.

Query_Text_cn: 本议定书于2012年1月11日在坎帕拉签订，一式两份，每份均用中文和英文写成，两种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Protocol was signed in Kampala on January 11, 2012, in duplicate, each in Chinese and English, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 常设机构因使用专利或者其他权利而支付给企业总机构或该企业其他办事处的特许权使用费、报酬或其他类似款项，因具体服务或管理而支付的佣金，或者因借款而支付的利息（银行企业除外），都不作任何扣除（属于偿还代垫实际发生的费用除外）。
Translation: Royalties, remuneration, or other similar payments paid by a permanent establishment for the use of patents or other rights to the head office of the enterprise or to other offices of the same enterprise, commissions paid for specific services or management, or interest paid on borrowings (except for banking enterprises), shall not be deducted in any form (except for the reimbursement of actual expenses advanced).

Query_Text_cn: 同样，在确定常设机构的利润时，对于常设机构从企业总机构或该企业其他办事处取得的专利或其他权利的特许权使用费、报酬或其他类似款项，因具体服务或管理而取得的佣金，或者因借款给该企业总机构或该企业其他办事处而取得的利息（银行企业除外），都不应考虑在内（属于偿还代垫实际发生的费用除外）。
Translation: Similarly, in determining the profits of a permanent establishment, royalties, fees, or other similar payments received by the permanent establishment from the enterprise's head office or other branches for patents or other rights, commissions earned for specific services or management, or interest received for loans made to the enterprise's head office or other branches (except in the case of banking enterprises), should not be taken into account (except for reimbursement of actual expenses incurred).

Query_Text_cn: 五、作为缔约国一方居民的公司从缔约国另一方取得利润或所得，该缔约国另一方不得对该公司支付的股息征税，也不得对该公司的未分配利润征税，即使支付的股息或未分配利润全部或部分是发生于缔约国另一方的利润或所得。但是，支付给缔约国另一方居民的股息或者据以支付股息的股份与设在缔约国另一方的常设机构有实际联系的除外。
Translation: 5. However, this shall not apply where the dividends are paid to a resident of that other Contracting State, or where the shares in respect of which the dividends are paid are effectively connected with a permanent establishment situated in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第二款的规定，发生于缔约国一方，而支付给缔约国另一方的政府或地方当局、中央银行或任何完全由政府拥有的金融机构的利息，或者由缔约国另一方的政府或地方当局、中央银行或任何完全由政府拥有的金融机构担保或保险的贷款而支付的利息，应在首先提及的缔约国一方免税。
Translation: 3. Query_Text_cn: 五、如果利息受益所有人作为缔约国一方居民，在利息发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业，据以支付该利息的债权与该常设机构有实际联系的，不适用第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: 5. If the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of one Contracting State and carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the interest arises through a permanent establishment situated therein, and the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment, the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果支付利息的人--不论是否为缔约国一方居民--在缔约国一方设有常设机构，支付该利息的债务与该常设机构有联系，并由其负担该利息，上述利息应认为发生于该常设机构所在的缔约国。
Translation: However, if the person paying the interest—regardless of whether they are a resident of a Contracting State—has a permanent establishment in a Contracting State, and the debt on which the interest is paid is connected with that permanent establishment and the interest is borne by it, such interest shall be deemed to arise in the Contracting State in which the permanent establishment is situated.

Translation: 3. Translation: 4. Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果支付特许权使用费的人--不论是否为缔约国一方居民--在缔约国一方设有常设机构，支付该特许权使用费的义务与该常设机构有联系，并由其负担该特许权使用费，上述特许权使用费应认为发生于该常设机构所在的缔约国。
Translation: However, if the person paying the royalties—regardless of whether they are a resident of a Contracting State—has a permanent establishment in a Contracting State, and the obligation to pay the royalties is connected with that permanent establishment and borne by it, such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the Contracting State in which the permanent establishment is situated.

Query_Text_cn: (三)在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点经停,以上下国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: (3) To designate points on the routes within the territory of the other contracting party for stops, for the purpose of embarking and disembarking international passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的一点与该领土内另一点间,无权装载旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: 3. The designated airline of one Contracting Party shall not have the right to embark passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail between two points within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方应将其指定空运企业开航协议航班的日期,提前六十天通知缔约另一方。
Translation: 4. Each contracting party shall notify the other contracting party at least sixty days in advance of the date on which its designated airline intends to commence scheduled flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条一、缔约一方有权向缔约另一方通过外交照会指定一家空运企业,以便在本协定附件规定航线上经营协议航班。
Translation: Article 3(1): Either Contracting Party shall have the right to designate, by diplomatic note to the other Contracting Party, an airline to operate the agreed services on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 或(三)如该空运企业没有按照本协定规定的条件经营。
Translation: or (c) if the said air transport enterprise fails to operate in accordance with the conditions stipulated in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非本条第一款所述的取消、暂停或规定条件必须立即执行,以防止进一步违反法律和规定,否则这种权利只能在与缔约另一方协商方可行使。
Translation: 2. Unless the cancellation, suspension, or imposition of conditions described in paragraph 1 of this Article must be implemented immediately to prevent further violations of laws and regulations, such rights may only be exercised after consultation with the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留、航行的法律和规定,以及关于旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件进出其国境和在其领土内停留的法律和规定,均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、空勤组和所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: Article 5 The laws and regulations of one contracting party concerning the entry into, stay in, and navigation within its territory by aircraft engaged in international flights, as well as those concerning the entry, stay, and departure of passengers, crew, baggage, cargo, and mail, shall apply to the aircraft, crew, passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail of the designated air transport enterprises of the other contracting party while they are within the territory of the first contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方应及时向缔约另一方提供上述有关的法律和规定的资料。
Translation: Either Contracting Party shall promptly provide the other Contracting Party with information on the relevant laws and regulations mentioned above.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机及其留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品,在进出缔约另一方领土时,缔约另一方应在互惠基础上豁免任何关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation: Article 6(1): Aircraft operated by the designated airlines of one Contracting Party on the specified routes, along with their normal equipment, spare parts, fuel, oil, lubricants, and onboard supplies retained on the aircraft, shall be exempt, on a reciprocal basis, from any customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes and charges upon entry into or exit from the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 上述物品,经缔约另一方海关当局同意后方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: The aforementioned items may only be unloaded within the territory of the other Contracting Party with the consent of the customs authorities of that Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业根据缔约另一方的规定,在缔约另一方领土内为其飞机加注和配备供飞行规定航线使用的燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品,缔约另一方应在互惠基础上豁免关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation: 2. Each Contracting Party shall, on a reciprocal basis, exempt from customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes the fuel, lubricating oils, and onboard supplies loaded onto aircraft of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party within its territory, in accordance with the regulations of the latter, for use on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业运入缔约另一方领土纯供在规定航线上飞行的飞机使用的机上正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品,缔约另一方亦应在互惠基础上豁免关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation: 3. Each Contracting Party shall, on a reciprocal basis, exempt from customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes and charges the normal aircraft equipment, spare parts, fuel, oil, lubricants, and aircraft stores imported by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party into its territory, provided that such items are used solely for the operation of flights on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条第一款所述在缔约另一方领土内卸下的物品以及本条第三款所述运入缔约另一方领土的物品,应由缔约另一方海关当局监管,按该海关当局的规定缴纳保管费用,并不得在缔约另一方领土内转售或移作他用,直至重新运回或根据上述海关当局规定另作处理。
Translation: 4. The goods unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party as referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, as well as the goods brought into the territory of the other Contracting Party as referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article, shall be subject to the supervision of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party, and storage fees shall be paid in accordance with the regulations of those customs authorities. Such goods shall not be resold or used for other purposes within the territory of the other Contracting Party until they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the regulations of the aforementioned customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条对缔约一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的飞机所载的、直接过境缔约另一方领土的旅客、行李、货物,缔约另一方至多采取非常简化的控制措施。
Translation: Article 7 stipulates that, for passengers, baggage, and cargo carried by aircraft operating scheduled flights designated by one contracting party and directly transiting the territory of the other contracting party, the latter shall apply at most extremely simplified control measures.

Query_Text_cn: 上述直接过境的行李和货物,应豁免关税和其他类似税收。
Translation: Baggage and goods in direct transit as mentioned above shall be exempt from customs duties and other similar taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条一、缔约一方应在其领土内,为缔约另一方指定空运企业指定供经营规定航线所使用的机场和备降机场,并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation: Article 8(1): Each Contracting Party shall, within its territory, designate airports and alternate airports for use by the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party operating the specified routes, and shall provide the communication, navigation, meteorological, and other ancillary services required for the operation of the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场、设备和技术服务,应按照缔约另一方有关当局规定的公平合理的费率付费。
Translation: 2. When an airline designated by one Contracting Party uses the airports, equipment, and technical services of the other Contracting Party, it shall pay fair and reasonable charges as prescribed by the relevant authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班时,应享有公平合理的机会。
Translation: Article 9 (1): When the designated airlines of both contracting parties operate agreed services on the specified routes, they shall enjoy fair and equal opportunities.

Query_Text_cn: (三)联程航班经营的需要。
Translation: (3) The need for operating connecting flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条一、缔约一方指定空运企业对前往或来自缔约另一方领土的运输所收取的运价,应在合理的上制定,适当照顾到一切有关因素,包括经营成本、合理的利润和其他空运企业的运价。
Translation: Article 10 (1) The fares charged by the designated airlines of one Contracting Party for transportation to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be established on a reasonable basis, taking due account of all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profit, and the fares of other airlines.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述运价,应先由缔约双方指定空运企业协议。
Translation: 2. The tariffs referred to in Paragraph 1 of this Article shall first be agreed upon by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、按此协议的运价至少应在其拟议实行前六十天提交缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: 3. The fares under this agreement shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of both contracting parties for approval at least sixty days prior to their proposed implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 在特殊情况下,经上述当局协议,这一时限可予缩短。
Translation: In exceptional circumstances, this time limit may be shortened by agreement of the aforementioned authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如缔约双方指定空运企业未能根据本条第二款规定就运价达成协议,或缔约一方航空当局对根据第二款规定所协议的运价,向缔约另一方航空当局发出异议通知,缔约双方航空当局应设法相互商议,确定运价。
Translation: 4. If the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on tariffs in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article, or if the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party notify the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party of their objection to the tariffs agreed upon pursuant to paragraph 2, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to consult each other in order to determine the tariffs.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如缔约双方航空当局未能就根据本条第三款规定向其提交的任何运价,或根据本条第四款就运价的确定达成协议,此项分歧应按照本协定第十七条规定予以解决。
Translation: 5. If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on any tariff submitted to them pursuant to paragraph 3 of this Article, or on the determination of any tariff pursuant to paragraph 4 of this Article, the dispute shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article 17 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内经营国际运输所得收入,缔约另一方应在互惠的基础上豁免所得税和其他一切税收,并应准予结汇。
Translation: Article 11 Income derived from the operation of international transportation by an air transport enterprise designated by one Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall, on a reciprocal basis, be exempt from income tax and all other taxes by the other Contracting Party, and the remittance of such income shall be permitted.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条缔约一方航空当局应按缔约另一方航空当局的要求,向后者提供缔约另一方指定空运企业在协议航班上所载来自或前往缔约另一方领土的业务统计。
Translation: Article 12 The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party shall, at the request of the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party, provide the latter with statistical data relating to the traffic carried on the agreed services by the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人员应为中华人民共和国和阿拉伯叙利亚共和国公民,其人数由缔约双方指定空运企业商定,并经缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: The personnel of the representative offices shall be citizens of the People's Republic of China and the Syrian Arab Republic. Their number shall be determined by mutual agreement between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and approved by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条缔约一方指定空运企业的空勤组成员在飞行协议航班时,缔约另一方应允其凭有效护照人境,无需办理签证,但在机场停留时间不得超过二十四小时,并应搭乘同一飞机离境。
Translation: Article 14 When crew members of an air transport enterprise designated by one Contracting Party are operating scheduled flights, the other Contracting Party shall permit their entry with valid passports without requiring a visa, provided that their stay at the airport does not exceed twenty-four hours and they depart on the same aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方每年应向缔约另一方提供一次上述空勤组成员的名单,但可随时提交上述名单的更改。
Translation: Each contracting party shall provide the other contracting party with the list of the aforementioned crew members once a year, but may submit changes to the list at any time.

Query_Text_cn: (八)总申报单。
Translation: (viii) Master Declaration Form.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方颁发的证件和执照,缔约另一方应承认其有效。
Translation: Certificates and licenses issued by one contracting party shall be recognized as valid by the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条一、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约另一方领土内发生事故时,缔约另一方应指示其有关当局立即将事故详细情况通知缔约一方航空当局,并应对上述飞机上的空勤组和旅客提供必要的援助。
Translation:
Article 16

1. In the event of an accident involving an aircraft of an air transport enterprise designated by one Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall instruct its relevant authorities to immediately notify the aviation authorities of the former in detail about the accident and shall provide necessary assistance to the crew and passengers on board the said aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: (六)将调查结果书面通知缔约一方航空当局。
Translation: (vi) The results of the investigation shall be communicated in writing to the aeronautical authorities of the contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 有关上述调查活动的费用由境内发生事故的缔约方负担。
Translation: The costs related to the aforementioned investigation activities shall be borne by the contracting party where the accident occurred.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条缔约双方应密切合作,互相支持,保证本协定正确实施。
Translation: Article 17 The contracting parties shall cooperate closely and support each other to ensure the proper implementation of this agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 如对本协定的解释或实施发生分歧,缔约双方指定空运企业应本着友好合作、互相谅解的精神直接协商解决,如不能达成协议,应由缔约双方航空当局协商解决,如仍不能达成协议,缔约双方应通过外交途径解决。
Translation: In the event of any divergence regarding the interpretation or implementation of this agreement, the designated airlines of both contracting parties shall resolve the issue through direct consultations in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding. If no agreement can be reached, the matter shall be resolved through consultations between the aeronautical authorities of both contracting parties. If an agreement still cannot be reached, the issue shall be settled through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条缔约一方如认为需要修改或补充本协定的任何条款或其附件,可随时要求与另一方进行协商,此项协商应于缔约另一方接到要求之日起六十天内进行。
Translation: Article 18: If either Contracting Party deems it necessary to amend or supplement any provision of this Agreement or its annexes, it may at any time request consultations with the other Party. Such consultations shall take place within sixty days from the date the other Party receives the request.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定或其附件的任何修改或补充,经缔约双方以外交换文确认后生效。
Translation: Any amendment or supplement to this Agreement or its annexes shall become effective upon confirmation by exchange of letters between the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条本协定的附件和有关换文是本协定的组成部分。
Translation: Article 19 The annexes and relevant exchange of letters to this Agreement constitute integral parts of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条缔约一方可随时将终止本协定的意愿通知缔约另一方。
Translation: Article 20: Either Contracting Party may, at any time, notify the other Contracting Party of its intention to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约另一方接到通知之日起十二个月后终止,如在期满前,缔约一方提出撤销上述通知,并取得缔约另一方同意后,则本协定继续有效。
Translation: This agreement shall terminate twelve months after one contracting party receives notice from the other. However, if the notifying party withdraws the notice before the expiration date and obtains the consent of the other party, this agreement shall remain in effect.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条本协定自外交换文中规定之日起生效。在外交换文中应声明已履行缔约各方的法律所要求的手续。
Translation: Article 21 This Agreement shall enter into force on the date specified in the exchange of notes. The exchange of notes shall state that the procedures required by the laws of the contracting parties have been completed.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七五年十一月十日在大马士革签订，共两份，每份都用中文、阿拉伯文和英文写成。叁种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Damascus on November 10, 1975, in two originals, each in Chinese, Arabic, and English, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定第一条（一）中的“国防部”改为“运输部”。
Translation: In Article 1(a) of this Agreement, "Ministry of National Defense" shall be replaced with "Ministry of Transport."

Query_Text_cn: 缔约任何一方指定空运企业在规定航线上提供的协议航班，应在其领土内的一点始发。
Translation: The scheduled flights operated by the designated airlines of either contracting party on the specified routes shall originate from a point within its own territory.

Query_Text_cn: 二、不经停的权利缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机，可以不降停规定航线上的任何中间经停点和延伸点，但应尽早相互通知。
Translation: 2. The designated airlines of the contracting parties shall have the right to operate agreed flights on the specified routes without landing at any intermediate or extension points on those routes. However, both parties shall notify each other as early as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 三、专包机和加班飞行（一）缔约一方指定空运企业如欲飞行前往或来自缔约另一方领土的专机和包机，缔约一方航空当局应向缔约另一方航空当局提出申请，由其向本国有关当局办理许可和答复。
Translation:
III. Charter and Extra Flights

(1) If an airline designated by one Contracting Party wishes to operate charter or extra flights to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party, the aviation authorities of the former shall submit an application to the aviation authorities of the latter, who shall process the permit and provide a response through their relevant national authorities.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约一方指定空运企业如在规定航线上作加班飞行，在通常情况下，应在飞机起飞四十八小时前向缔约另一方航空当局提出申请，并在获得许可后方可飞行。
Translation: If an airline designated by one Contracting Party intends to operate extra flights on the specified routes, it shall normally submit an application to the aviation authorities of the other Contracting Party at least forty-eight hours before departure, and may only operate such flights after obtaining approval.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国政府和缅甸联邦政府关于两国边界问题的协定*（注*：1960年1月28日签订于北京并于1960年5月14日生效。
Translation: Agreement Between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Union of Burma on the Boundary Question Between the Two Countries* (*Note: Signed in Beijing on January 28, 1960, and entered into force on May 14, 1960.)

Query_Text_cn: 第一条缔约双方同意立即成立由双方同等人数的代表所组成的联合委员会，并且责成该委员会根据本协定的规定，商谈解决本协定第二条所列的有关中缅边界的各项具体问题，进行勘察边界和树立界桩的工作，起草中缅边界条约。联合委员会定期地在中缅两国的首都或者中缅两国的其他地点举行会议。
Translation: Article 1: The contracting parties agree to immediately establish a joint commission composed of an equal number of representatives from both sides. The commission is tasked with negotiating and resolving the specific issues concerning the China-Myanmar border listed in Article 2 of this agreement, conducting border surveys and the erection of boundary markers, and drafting the China-Myanmar Boundary Treaty in accordance with the provisions of this agreement. The joint commission shall hold regular meetings in the capitals of China and Myanmar or at other locations in the two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 一、自尖高山起到中缅边界西端终点的全部未定界，除片马、古浪、岗房地区以外，遵照传统的习惯线定界，也就是说，从尖高山起沿着以太平江、瑞丽江、怒江、独龙江为一方和恩梅开江为另一方的分水岭向北，直到在靖丹和木刻戛之间跨越独龙江的地方，然后继续沿着以独龙江和察隅河为一方和除独龙江以外的全部伊洛瓦底江上游支系为另一方的分水岭，直到中缅边界西端的终点为止。
Translation: All the undemarcated sections from Jiangaoshan to the western terminus of the China-Myanmar border, except for the areas of Pianma, Gulang, and Gangfang, shall be demarcated in accordance with the traditional customary line. That is to say, starting from Jiangaoshan, the boundary shall follow the watershed between the Taiping River, Ruili River, Nujiang River, and Dulong River on one side, and the Enmei River on the other side, heading north until it crosses the Dulong River between Jingdan and Mukega. Thereafter, it shall continue along the watershed between the Dulong River and Chayu River on one side, and all the upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River except the Dulong River on the other side, until reaching the western terminus of the China-Myanmar border.

Query_Text_cn: 联合委员会将派出由双方同等人数的人员组成的联合勘察队，沿着上述分水岭进行勘察，以确定这一段边界线的具体位置，并且树立界桩。
Translation: The Joint Commission will dispatch a joint survey team composed of an equal number of personnel from both sides to conduct a survey along the aforementioned watershed in order to determine the precise location of this section of the boundary line and to erect boundary markers.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缅甸政府同意将属于中国的片马、古浪、岗房地区归还中国。
Translation: 2. The Myanmar government agreed to return the Pianma, Gulang, and Gangfang areas, which belong to China, to China.

Query_Text_cn: 至于归还给中国的这个地区的面积，由联合委员会根据缅甸政府和中国政府分别在1957年2月4日和1957年7月26日提出的并且用地图标明的建议，商谈确定。
Translation: As for the area of the region to be returned to China, it shall be negotiated and determined by the Joint Commission based on the proposals submitted by the Burmese government and the Chinese government on February 4, 1957, and July 26, 1957, respectively, which are indicated on maps.

Query_Text_cn: 联合委员会在确定归还给中国的这个地区的面积以后，将派出由双方同等人数的人员组成的联合勘察队，实地勘察这一段边界线的具体位置，并且树立界桩。
Translation: After determining the area of the region to be returned to China, the Joint Commission shall dispatch a joint survey team composed of an equal number of personnel from both sides to conduct an on-site survey of the specific location of this section of the boundary line and to erect boundary markers.

Query_Text_cn: 三、为了废除缅甸对南碗河和瑞丽江汇合处的、属于中国的猛卯三角地区（即南碗指定区）所保持的“永租”关系，中国政府同意把这个地区移交给缅甸，成为缅甸联邦领土的一部分。
Translation: 3. In order to abolish Myanmar's "perpetual lease" over the Mengmao Triangle area (i.e., the designated Namwan area), which is located at the confluence of the Namwan River and the Ruili River and belongs to China, the Chinese government agrees to transfer this area to Myanmar, making it part of the territory of the Union of Myanmar.

Query_Text_cn: 作为交换，缅甸政府同意，把班洪部落和班老部落在1941年6月18日中英两国政府换文划定的、从南定河和南帕河汇合处到南段已定界第一号界桩为止的边界线以西的辖区划归中国，成为中国领土的一部分。
Translation: In exchange, the Burmese government agreed to transfer the territories of the Ban Hong and Ban Lao tribes, located west of the boundary line defined by the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British governments on June 18, 1941—from the confluence of the Nan Ding River and the Nan Pa River to the first boundary marker on the southern section of the established border—to China, thereby making them part of Chinese territory.

Query_Text_cn: 至于划归中国的这些地区的面积，中国政府和缅甸政府分别在1957年7月26日和1959年6月4日提出了用地图标明的建议。
Translation: As for the area of these regions incorporated into China, the Chinese government and the Burmese government respectively proposed suggestions marked on maps on July 26, 1957, and June 4, 1959.

Query_Text_cn: 两国政府的建议中互相一致的地区，肯定划归中国。
Translation: The areas where the proposals of the two governments are consistent shall be unquestionably assigned to China.

Query_Text_cn: 两国政府的建议中关于班洪部落的辖区有出入的地区，由联合委员会派出双方同等人数的人员组成的小组实地查明该地区是否属于班洪部落管辖，以便确定该地区是否移交中国。
Translation: For areas where the two governments have differing proposals regarding the jurisdiction of the Banhong tribe, a joint team composed of an equal number of representatives from both sides, dispatched by the Joint Committee, shall conduct on-site investigations to determine whether these areas fall under the jurisdiction of the Banhong tribe, so as to decide whether the areas should be transferred to China.

Query_Text_cn: 划归中国的班洪部落和班老部落辖区的面积这样确定以后，联合委员会将派出由双方同等人数的人员组成的联合勘察队，实地勘察这一段边界线的具体位置，并且树立界桩。
Translation: After the areas under the jurisdiction of the Banhong and Banlao tribes, which have been incorporated into China, are thus determined, the Joint Commission shall dispatch a joint survey team composed of an equal number of personnel from both sides to conduct an on-site survey of the specific location of this section of the boundary line and to erect boundary markers.

Query_Text_cn: 四、从南定河和南帕河汇合处到南段已定界第一号界桩为止的一段边界，除本条第三款所规定的调整以外，按照1941年6月18日中英两国政府的换文定界，联合委员会将派出由双方同等人数的人员组成的联合勘察队，沿着这一段边界线进行定界、标界和树立界桩的工作。
Translation: 4. For the section of the boundary from the confluence of the Nam Ting River and the Nam Paw River to Boundary Marker No. 1, which has already been demarcated in the southern section, except for the adjustments stipulated in Paragraph 3 of this Article, the boundary shall be determined in accordance with the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British governments dated June 18, 1941. The Joint Commission shall dispatch a joint survey team composed of an equal number of personnel from both sides to carry out demarcation, boundary marking, and the erection of boundary markers along this section of the boundary line.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条缔约双方同意，联合委员会在解决本协定第二条中所列的有关中缅边界的现存问题以后，将负责起草中缅边界条约，其中不仅将包括本协定第二条所提到的各段边界，而且将包括过去已经划定、无需加以更改的各段边界。
Translation:
Article 3

The Contracting Parties agree that, after the Joint Commission has resolved the existing issues concerning the China-Myanmar border listed in Article 2 of this Agreement, it shall be responsible for drafting the China-Myanmar Boundary Treaty. This treaty will include not only the sections of the boundary mentioned in Article 2 of this Agreement, but also those sections of the boundary that have already been demarcated in the past and require no further modification.

Query_Text_cn: 新的边界条约经两国政府签订和生效后，将代替一切旧的有关两国边界的条约和换文。
Translation: After being signed and coming into effect by the governments of both countries, the new boundary treaty will replace all previous treaties and exchanges of notes concerning the boundary between the two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 中国政府根据一贯反对外国特权和尊重其他国家主权的政策，声明放弃1941年6月18日中英两国政府换文所规定的、中国参加经营缅甸炉房矿产企业的权利。
Translation: In accordance with its consistent policy of opposing foreign privileges and respecting the sovereignty of other countries, the Chinese government hereby declares its renunciation of the right to participate in the operation of the Burma smelting and mining enterprise, as stipulated in the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British governments dated June 18, 1941.

Query_Text_cn: （一）本协定须经批准，批准书应尽速在仰光交换。
Translation: (1) This Agreement shall be subject to ratification, and the instruments of ratification shall be exchanged in Yangon as soon as possible.

Query_Text_cn: （二）本协定在互换批准书以后立即生效，到两国政府将签订的中缅边界条约生效时自动失效。
Translation: (2) This agreement shall enter into force immediately upon the exchange of instruments of ratification and shall automatically cease to be effective upon the entry into force of the Sino-Burmese Boundary Treaty to be concluded by the two governments.

Query_Text_cn: 1960年1月28日订于北京，共两份，每份都用中文和英文写成，中、英两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: Signed in Beijing on January 28, 1960, in two copies, each in Chinese and English, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: ３．外国企业所得税（包括地方所得税）。
Translation: 3. Foreign enterprise income tax (including local income tax).

Query_Text_cn: ３．财产收益税。
Translation: 3. Property Income Tax.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本协定也适用于本协定签订之日后缔约国任何一方增加或者代替本条第一款所列税种的相同或者实质相似的税收。
Translation: II. This Agreement shall also apply to any identical or substantially similar taxes that are imposed in addition to, or in place of, the taxes listed in paragraph 1 of this Article by either Contracting State after the date of signature of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国双方主管当局应将各自税法所作的变动通知对方。
Translation: The competent authorities of both Contracting Parties shall notify each other of any changes made to their respective tax laws.

Query_Text_cn: （九）“主管当局”一语，在中国方面是指财政部税务总局或其授权的代表；在联合王国方面是指国内收入局或其授权的代表。
Translation: (9) The term "competent authority" refers, in the case of China, to the State Administration of Taxation of the Ministry of Finance or its authorized representative; and in the case of the United Kingdom, to the Inland Revenue or its authorized representative.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国一方在实施本协定时，对于未明确定义的用语，除上下文另有规定的以外，应当具有该缔约国关于适用本协定税种的法律所规定的含义。
Translation: 2. In implementing this Agreement, any term not otherwise defined shall, unless the context requires otherwise, have the meaning which it has under the laws of that Contracting State concerning the taxes to which this Agreement applies.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在本协定中，“缔约国一方居民”一语是指按照该国法律，由于住所、居所、总机构、实际管理机构所在地，或者其它类似的标准，在该国负有纳税义务的人。
Translation: 1. For the purposes of this Agreement, the term "resident of a Contracting State" means any person who, under the laws of that State, is liable to tax therein by reason of his domicile, residence, place of incorporation, place of effective management, or any other criterion of a similar nature.

Query_Text_cn: （四）如果其同时是两个国家的国民，或者不是任何一国的国民，缔约国双方主管当局应通过协商解决。
Translation: (4) If a person is a national of both countries or is not a national of either country, the competent authorities of both contracting parties shall resolve the matter through consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 三、由于本条第一款的规定，除个人外，同时为缔约国双方居民的人，应认为是其经营的实际管理机构所在国的居民。
Translation: 3. Pursuant to the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article, except for individuals, a person who is a resident of both Contracting States shall be deemed to be a resident of the State in which its place of effective management is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果这些人在缔约国一方设有其经营的实际管理机构，在缔约国另一方设有其总机构，缔约国双方主管当局应协商确定该公司为本协定中缔约国一方的居民。
Translation: However, if such persons have their place of effective management in one Contracting State and their head office in the other Contracting State, the competent authorities of the Contracting States shall consult each other to determine which State the company shall be deemed to be a resident of for the purposes of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （七）勘探或开发自然资源所使用的装置或设施。
Translation: (vii) Equipment or facilities used for the exploration or development of natural resources.

Query_Text_cn: 三、建筑工地，建筑、装配或安装工程，仅以连续六个月以上的为常设机构。
Translation: 3. A building site, or a construction, assembly, or installation project, shall constitute a permanent establishment only if it lasts for more than six consecutive months.

Query_Text_cn: （六）专为本款第（一）项至第（五）项活动的结合所设的固定营业场所，如果由于这种结合使该固定营业场所全部活动属于准备性质或辅助性质。
Translation: (vi) A fixed place of business established solely for the combination of activities listed in items (i) to (v) of this paragraph, provided that, as a result of such combination, the overall activities of the fixed place of business are of a preparatory or auxiliary nature.

Query_Text_cn: 五、虽有本条第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权并经常行使这种权力代表该企业签订合同，除适用本条第六款的独立代理人以外，这个人为该企业进行的任何活动，应认为该企业在缔约国一方设有常设机构。除非这个人的活动仅限于本条第四款的规定，即使是通过固定营业场所进行活动，按照该款规定，不应认为该固定营业场所是常设机构。
Translation: 5. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, where a person in one Contracting State acts on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State and has, and habitually exercises, the authority to conclude contracts on behalf of that enterprise, that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the first-mentioned State in respect of any activities carried out by that person, except where such person is an independent agent to whom paragraph 6 of this Article applies. Unless the activities of such person are limited to those specified in paragraph 4 of this Article, even if carried out through a fixed place of business, such fixed place of business shall not be deemed a permanent establishment in accordance with the provisions of that paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约国一方企业仅通过按常规经营本身业务的经纪人、一般佣金代理人或者任何其他独立代理人在缔约国另一方进行营业，不应认为在该缔约国另一方设有常设机构。
Translation: 6. A company of one Contracting State shall not be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State merely because it carries on business in that other State through a broker, general commission agent, or any other independent agent acting in the ordinary course of their business.

Query_Text_cn: 但如果这个代理人的活动全部或几乎全部代表该企业，不应认为是本款所指的独立代理人。
Translation: However, if the agent's activities are wholly or almost wholly conducted on behalf of the enterprise, the agent should not be regarded as an independent agent as referred to in this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条第一款的规定适用于从直接使用、出租或者任何其它形式使用不动产取得的所得。
Translation: 3. The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall apply to income derived from the direct use, leasing, or any other form of use of immovable property.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条第一款和第三款的规定也适用于企业的不动产所得和用于进行独立个人劳务的不动产所得。
Translation: 4. The provisions of Paragraphs 1 and 3 of this Article shall also apply to income derived by enterprises from immovable property and to income derived from immovable property used for the performance of independent personal services.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该企业通过设在该另一国的常设机构在该另一国进行营业，其利润可以在该另一国征税，但应仅以属于该常设机构的利润为限。
Translation: If the enterprise carries on business in the other country through a permanent establishment situated therein, the profits of the enterprise may be taxed in that other country, but only so much of them as is attributable to that permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: 二、从属于本条第三款的规定，缔约国一方企业通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构在该另一国进行营业，如果该常设机构是一个独立和分设的企业，在相同和相似的情况下从事相同或相似活动，并完全独立地同其所隶属的企业进行交易，该常设机构在缔约国各方可能得到的利润应属于该常设机构。
Translation: 2. Subject to the provisions of paragraph 3 of this Article, where an enterprise of one Contracting State carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein, and if such permanent establishment is a separate and independent enterprise engaged in the same or similar activities under the same or similar conditions, and conducts transactions with the enterprise to which it belongs entirely independently, the profits that may be attributed to the permanent establishment in each Contracting State shall belong to that permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: 三、确定常设机构的利润时，应允许扣除其进行营业发生的各项费用，包括行政和一般管理费用，不论其发生于该常设机构所在国或者其它任何地方。
Translation: 3. In determining the profits of a permanent establishment, all expenses incurred for the purposes of the business, including administrative and general management expenses, shall be allowed as deductions, whether incurred in the country where the permanent establishment is situated or elsewhere.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，常设机构使用专利或者其它权利支付给企业总机构或该企业其它办事处的特许权使用费、报酬或其它类似款项，具体服务或管理的佣金，技术服务的报酬，或者借款给该常设机构的利息（银行企业除外），都不作任何扣除（属于偿还代垫实际发生的费用除外）。
Translation: However, royalties, fees, or other similar payments paid by a permanent establishment for the use of patents or other rights to the head office or other offices of the same enterprise, commissions for specific services or management, remuneration for technical services, or interest on loans provided to the permanent establishment (except for banking enterprises), shall not be deducted in any form, except for reimbursement of actual expenses advanced.

Query_Text_cn: 同样，在确定常设机构的利润时，对于该常设机构从企业总机构或该企业其它办事处取得的专利或其它权利的特许权使用费、报酬或其它类似款项，具体服务或管理的佣金，技术服务的报酬，或者借款给该企业总机构或该企业其它办事处的利息（银行企业的除外），也不考虑（属于偿还代实际发生的费用除外）。
Translation: Similarly, in determining the profits of a permanent establishment, royalties, remuneration, or other similar payments for patents or other rights obtained by the permanent establishment from the enterprise's head office or other branches, commissions for specific services or management, remuneration for technical services, or interest on loans provided to the enterprise's head office or other branches (except for banking enterprises) shall not be taken into account, except for reimbursement of actual expenses incurred.

Query_Text_cn: 五、不应仅由于常设机构为企业采购货物或商品，将利润归属于该常设机构。
Translation: 5. Profits should not be attributed to a permanent establishment merely because it purchases goods or merchandise for the enterprise.

Query_Text_cn: 一、以船舶或飞机经营国际运输的利润，应仅在企业实际经营管理机构所在缔约国征税。
Translation: 1. Profits from the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the enterprise is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果船运企业的实际经营管理机构设在船上，应以船舶母港所在缔约国为所在国；或者如果没有母港，应以船舶经营者为居民的缔约国为所在国。
Translation: 2. If the actual place of management of a shipping enterprise is located on board a ship, the country of residence shall be the Contracting State in which the ship's home port is situated; or, if there is no home port, the country of residence shall be the Contracting State of which the operator of the ship is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条规定也适用于参加合伙经营、联合经营或者参加国际经营机构的利润。
Translation: 3. This article also applies to profits derived from participation in partnerships, joint ventures, or international business organizations.

Query_Text_cn: （二）同一人直接或间接参与缔约国一方企业和缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本。
Translation: (b) The same person directly or indirectly participates in the management, control, or capital of an enterprise of one Contracting State and an enterprise of the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 在上述任何一种情况下，两个企业之间的商业或财务关系不同于独立企业之间的关系。因此，由于这些情况而没有取得的任何利润，可以计入该企业的利润内，并据以征税。
Translation: In any of the above cases, the commercial or financial relations between the two enterprises differ from those between independent enterprises. Therefore, any profits that would have accrued to one of the enterprises but, due to these circumstances, have not so accrued, may be included in the profits of that enterprise and taxed accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国另一方居民从缔约国一方居民公司取得的股息，可以在该另一国征税。
Translation: Dividends paid by a company resident in one Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些股息也可以在支付股息的公司是其居民的缔约国，按照该国的法律征税。但是，如果该项股息的受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过该股息总额的百分之十。
Translation: 2. However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, in accordance with the laws of that State. Nevertheless, if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the dividends.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“股息”一语应具有按照支付股息公司是其居民的缔约国的税法含义，并应包括按该税法视同股息或分配的任何项目。
Translation: 3. The term "dividends" as used in this Article shall have the meaning assigned to it under the tax laws of the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, and shall include any item that is treated as a dividend or distribution under such tax laws.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条第二款的规定，不应影响对公司支付股息前的利润所征收的公司利润税。
Translation: 4. The provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article shall not affect the collection of corporate profit tax on profits from which dividends are paid by the company.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如股息受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在支付股息的公司是其居民的缔约国另一方，通过设在该另一国的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该另一国的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付股息的股份与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，不适用本条第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: 5. Where the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of one Contracting State and the company paying the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, and the company carries on business in that other State through a permanent establishment situated therein or performs independent personal services through a fixed base situated therein, and the shares in respect of which the dividends are paid are effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base, the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，应视具体情况适用第七条或第十五条的规定。
Translation: In such cases, the provisions of Article 7 or Article 15 shall be applied as appropriate, depending on the specific circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约国一方居民公司从缔约国另一方取得利润或所得，该另一国不得对该公司支付的股息征收任何税收。但支付给该另一国居民的股息或者据以支付股息的股份与设在该另一国的常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的除外。对于该公司的未分配的利润，即使支付的股息或未分配的利润全部或部分是发生于该另一国的利润或所得，该另一国也不得征税。
Translation: 6. Where a company that is a resident of one Contracting State derives profits or income from the other Contracting State, that other State shall not impose any tax on the dividends paid by the company, except where such dividends are paid to a resident of that other State or where the shares in respect of which the dividends are paid are effectively connected with a permanent establishment or a fixed base situated in that other State. Furthermore, that other State shall not impose any tax on the undistributed profits of the company, even if such profits or income, out of which the dividends are paid or the undistributed profits arise, consist wholly or partly of profits or income arising in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国另一方居民取得的发生于缔约国一方的利息，可以在该另一国征税。
Translation: Interest arising in one Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些利息也可以在该利息发生的缔约国，按照该国的法律征税。
Translation: 2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, in accordance with the laws of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果该项利息的受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过利息总额的百分之十。
Translation: However, if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the interest.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条第二条的规定，发生在缔约国一方而为缔约国另一方政府、行政区、地方当局、该缔约国另一方中央银行或该政府的任何机构取得的利息；或者为该缔约国另一方的其他居民取得的利息；其债权是由该缔约国另一方政府、行政区、地方当局、该缔约国另一方中央银行或该政府的任何机构提供资金、担保或保险的，应在该缔约国一方免税。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article, interest arising in one Contracting State and derived by the government, an administrative subdivision, a local authority, the central bank, or any agency of the government of the other Contracting State, or by any other resident of the other Contracting State, shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned Contracting State if the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid is financed, guaranteed, or insured by the government, an administrative subdivision, a local authority, the central bank, or any agency of the government of the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条“利息”一语是指从各种债权取得的所得，不论其有无抵押担保或者是否有权分享债务人的利润；特别是从公债、债券或者信用债券取得的所得，包括其溢价和奖金。但不包括按照本协定第十条的规定视为分配的任何项目。
Translation: 4. The term "interest" in this Article refers to income derived from various types of debt claims, regardless of whether they are secured by mortgage or whether there is a right to participate in the debtor's profits; in particular, it includes income from government securities, bonds, or debentures, including premiums and prizes attached thereto. However, it does not include any items that are treated as distributions under the provisions of Article 10 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果利息受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在该利息发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该另一国的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该另一国的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付该利息的债权与该常设机构或者固定基地有实际联系的，不适用本条第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: 5. If the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of one Contracting State and carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein, or performs independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein, and the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base, the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 六、如果支付利息的人为缔约国一方政府、行政区、地方当局和该国居民，应认为该利息发生在该国。
Translation: 6. If the person paying the interest is the government, an administrative subdivision, a local authority of a Contracting State, or a resident of that State, such interest shall be deemed to arise in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，当支付利息的人不论是否为缔约国一方居民，在缔约国一方设有常设机构或者固定基地，支付该利息的债务与该常设机构或者固定基地有联系，并由其负担这种利息，上述利息应认为发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在国。
Translation: However, where the person paying the interest, whether a resident of a Contracting State or not, has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the indebtedness on which the interest is paid was incurred, and such interest is borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base, such interest shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 七、由于支付利息的人与受益所有人之间或者他们与其他人之间的特殊关系，支付的利息数额，不论什么原因，超出支付人与受益所有人没有上述关系所能同意的数额时，本条规定应仅适用于后来提及的数额。
Translation: 7. Where, due to a special relationship between the payer of the interest and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person, the amount of interest paid exceeds, for whatever reason, the amount that would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship, the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the last-mentioned amount.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，对该支付款项的超出部分，仍应按各缔约国的法律征税，但应适当考虑本协定的其它规定。
Translation: In such cases, the excess portion of the payment shall remain subject to taxation in accordance with the laws of the respective Contracting States, with due regard to the other provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国另一方居民取得的发生于缔约国一方的特许权使用费，可以在该另一国征税。
Translation: Royalties arising in one Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些特许权使用费也可以在其发生的缔约国，按照该国的法律征税。
Translation: 2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, in accordance with the laws of that State.

Query_Text_cn: （一）在本条第三款第（一）项所述的特许权使用费的情况下，该项特许权使用费总额的百分之十。
Translation: (a) In the case of royalties referred to in subparagraph (a) of paragraph 3 of this Article, ten percent of the total amount of such royalties.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在本条第三款第（二）项所述的特许权使用费的情况下，该项特许权使用费调整数额的百分之十。
Translation: (ii) In the case of royalties referred to in item (ii) of paragraph 3 of this Article, ten percent of the adjusted amount of such royalties.

Query_Text_cn: 在该项中，“调整数额”是指特许权使用费总额的百分之七十。
Translation: In this item, "adjusted amount" refers to seventy percent of the total amount of royalties.

Query_Text_cn: （二）使用、有权使用工业、商业、科学设备所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。
Translation: (2) Payments made as remuneration for the use of, or the right to use, industrial, commercial, or scientific equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果特许权使用费受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在该特许权使用费发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该另一国的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该另一国的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付该特许权使用费的权利或财产与该常设机构和固定基地有实际联系的，不适用本条第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: 4. If the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of one Contracting State and carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the royalties arise through a permanent establishment situated therein, or performs independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein, and the right or property in respect of which the royalties are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base, then the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果支付特许权使用费的人是缔约国一方政府、行政区、地方当局和该国居民，应认为该特许权使用费发生在该缔约国。
Translation: 5. If the person paying the royalties is the government, an administrative subdivision, a local authority of a Contracting State, or a resident of that State, the royalties shall be deemed to arise in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，当支付特许权使用费的人不论是否为缔约国一方居民，在缔约国一方设有常设机构或者固定基地，支付该特许权使用费的义务与该常设机构或者固定基地有联系，并由其负担这种特许权使用费，上述特许权使用费应认为发生于该常设机构或者固定基地所在国。
Translation: However, where the person paying the royalties, whether or not a resident of a Contracting State, has a permanent establishment or fixed base in a Contracting State, and the obligation to pay the royalties is connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base and the royalties are borne by it, such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 六、由于支付特许权使用费的人与受益所有人之间或他们与其他人之间的特殊关系，支付的特许权使用费数额，不论什么原因，超出支付人与受益所有人没有上述关系所能同意的数额时，本条规定应仅适用于后来提及的数额。
Translation: 6. Where, due to a special relationship between the payer of royalties and the beneficial owner, or between either of them and any other person, the amount of royalties paid exceeds, for whatever reason, the amount that would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship, the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the latter amount.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国另一方居民取得的发生于缔约国一方的技术费，可以在该另一国征税。
Translation: Royalties arising in one Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些技术费也可以在其发生的缔约国，按照该国的法律征税。
Translation: 2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, in accordance with the laws of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果该项技术费的受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过技术费调整数额的百分之十。
Translation: However, if the beneficial owner of the technical fees is a resident of the other contracting state, the tax charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the adjusted amount of the technical fees.

Query_Text_cn: 在本款中，“调整数额”是指技术费总额的百分之七十。
Translation: In this clause, "adjusted amount" refers to seventy percent of the total technical fee.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“技术费”一语是指技术、监督管理、咨询服务，包括使用或有权使用有关工业、商业、科学经验的情报，作为报酬支付给任何人的款项。但不包括支付给第十六款提及的从事非独立个人劳务的雇用人员的款项。
Translation: III. The term "technical fees" in this article refers to payments made to any person as remuneration for technology, supervision and management, and consulting services, including the use of or the right to use information concerning industrial, commercial, or scientific experience. However, it does not include payments made to employees engaged in non-independent personal services as mentioned in Article 16.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果技术费受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在技术费发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该另一国的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该另一国的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，该项技术费与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，不适用本条第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: 4. If the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of one Contracting State and the royalties arise in the other Contracting State, and the business is carried on in that other State through a permanent establishment situated therein or independent personal services are performed through a fixed base situated therein, and the royalties are effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base, then the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果支付技术费的人是缔约国一方政府、行政区、地方当局或该国居民，应认为该技术费发生在该国。
Translation: 5. If the person paying the technical fees is the government, an administrative region, a local authority of a contracting state, or a resident of that state, the technical fees shall be deemed to arise in that state.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，当支付技术费的人不论是否为缔约国一方居民，在缔约国一方设有常设机构或者固定基地，支付技术费的义务与该常设机构或固定基地有联系，并由其负担这种技术费，上述技术费应认为发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在国。
Translation: However, when the person paying the technical fees, regardless of whether they are a resident of a Contracting State, has a permanent establishment or fixed base in one of the Contracting States, and the obligation to pay the technical fees is connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base and borne by it, the aforementioned technical fees shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is located.

Query_Text_cn: 六、由于支付技术费的人与受益所有人之间或他们与其他人之间的特殊关系，支付的技术费数额，不论什么原因，超出支付人与受益所有人没有上述关系所能同意的数额时，本条规定应仅适用于后来提及的数额。
Translation: 6. Where, due to a special relationship between the person paying the royalties and the beneficial owner, or between both of them and any other person, the amount of royalties paid exceeds, for whatever reason, the amount that would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship, the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the latter amount.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用本条第二款规定外，发生于缔约国一方的财产收益，该国根据其国内法律的规定，可以征税。
Translation: 1. Except as provided in paragraph 2 of this Article, income from property arising in a Contracting State may be taxed by that State in accordance with its domestic laws.

Query_Text_cn: 二、转让从事国际运输的船舶或飞机，以及属于经营上述船舶、飞机的不动产以外的财产取得的收益，应仅在该企业实际经营管理机构所在的缔约国征税。
Translation: 2. Gains derived from the alienation of ships or aircraft operated in international traffic, or of property other than immovable property pertaining to the operation of such ships or aircraft, shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the enterprise is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用第十三条的规定外，缔约国一方居民由于专业性劳务或者其它独立性活动取得的所得，应仅在该国征税。
Translation: 1. Except as provided in Article 13, income derived by a resident of one Contracting State from professional services or other independent activities shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在有关会计年度中，在缔约国另一方停留连续或累计超过一百八十三天。
Translation: (b) During the relevant fiscal year, the individual stays in the other Contracting State for a period or periods exceeding in the aggregate 183 days.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，该另一国可以对其在该国进行活动取得的所得征税。
Translation: In this case, the other country may tax the income derived from activities carried out within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用第十七条、第十九条、第二十条、第二十一条和第二十二条的规定以外，缔约国一方居民因受雇取得的薪金、工资和其它类似报酬，除在缔约国另一方受雇的以外，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 1. Except as provided in Articles 17, 19, 20, 21, and 22, salaries, wages, and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of one Contracting State in respect of employment shall be taxable only in that State, unless the employment is exercised in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条第一款和第二款的规定，受雇于经营国际运输的船舶或飞机而取得的报酬，可以在企业实际经营管理机构所在缔约国征税。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, remuneration derived from employment aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic may be taxed in the Contracting State in which the enterprise's place of effective management is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 四、虽有本条第一款和第二款的规定，缔约国一方国民由于为从事国际航空运输飞机经营的该缔约国企业提供服务，作为派驻在缔约国另一方的官员或者职员取得的薪金、工资和其它类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: 4. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, salaries, wages and other similar remuneration derived by a national of a Contracting State in respect of an employment exercised as an official or employee of an enterprise of that Contracting State engaged in the operation of aircraft in international traffic, for services rendered in the other Contracting State, shall be taxable only in that first-mentioned Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、虽有第十五条和第十六条的规定，缔约国一方居民，作为表演家，如戏剧、电影、广播或电视艺术家、音乐家或者作为运动员，在缔约国另一方从事其个人活动取得的所得，可以在该另一国征税。
Translation: 1. Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 15 and 16, income derived by a resident of one Contracting State as an entertainer, such as a theatre, motion picture, radio or television artist, musician, or as an athlete, from their personal activities exercised in the other Contracting State, may be taxed in that other State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、虽有第七条、第十五条和第十六条的规定，表演家或运动员从事其个人活动取得的所得，并非归属表演家或者运动员本人，而是归属于其他人，可以在这些表演家或运动员从事上述活动的缔约国征税。
Translation: 2. Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 7, 15, and 16, income derived by entertainers or athletes from their personal activities, which does not accrue to the entertainers or athletes themselves but to another person, may be taxed in the Contracting State in which such entertainers or athletes perform those activities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条第一款和第二款的规定，按照缔约国双方的文化协定或安排，从事第一款所提及的上述活动取得的所得，如果完全或实质上由缔约国任何一方公共资金或者政府资金资助的对该国的访问，在从事上述活动的缔约国，应予免税。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, income derived from the activities referred to in paragraph 1, carried out under a cultural agreement or arrangement between the Contracting States, shall be exempt from tax in the Contracting State in which such activities are performed, provided that the visit to that State is wholly or substantially supported by public funds or government funds of either Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 除适用第二十条第二款的规定以外，因以前的雇佣关系支付给缔约国一方居民的退休金和其它类似报酬，应仅在该国征税。
Translation: Except as provided in paragraph 2 of Article 20, pensions and other similar remuneration paid to a resident of one Contracting State in respect of past employment shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、（一）缔约国一方政府、行政区或地方当局对向其提供服务的个人支付的退休金以外的报酬，应仅在该国征税。
Translation: 1. (a) Remuneration, other than pensions, paid by the government, administrative region, or local authorities of one Contracting State to individuals for services rendered to them shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: ２．不是仅由于提供该项服务，而成为该国的居民，该项报酬，应仅在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: 2. The mere provision of such services does not render the individual a resident of that country; therefore, the remuneration shall be taxable only in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、（一）缔约国一方政府、行政区或地方当局支付的或者从其建立的基金中对向其提供服务的个人支付的退休金，应仅在该国征税。
Translation: 2. (1) Pensions paid by, or out of funds established by, the government, an administrative subdivision, or a local authority of one Contracting State to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第十六条、第十七条、第十八条和第十九条的规定，应适用于为缔约国一方政府、行政区和地方当局进行营业提供服务所取得的报酬和退休金。
Translation: 3. The provisions of Articles 16, 17, 18, and 19 shall apply to remuneration and pensions received for services rendered in the course of business to the government, administrative regions, or local authorities of a Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 任何个人在直接前往缔约国一方之前曾是缔约国另一方居民，为在该缔约国一方的大学、学院、学校或其它公认的教育或者科研机构从事教学、讲学或研究的目的，停留在该缔约国一方，从其第一次到达该国之日起不超过三年的，该缔约国一方应对其由于教学、讲学或研究取得的报酬，免予征税。
Translation: Any individual who was a resident of one Contracting State prior to directly visiting the other Contracting State for the purpose of teaching, lecturing, or conducting research at a university, college, school, or other recognized educational or research institution in that other Contracting State, and who stays in that other Contracting State for a period not exceeding three years from the date of first arrival, shall be exempt from taxation by that other Contracting State on any remuneration received for such teaching, lecturing, or research.

Query_Text_cn: （三）在该缔约国从事个人劳务的所得（企业学徒提供给其跟之学艺的人或合伙企业的劳务，或者实习生提供给其提供培训的人的劳务除外），在任何征税年度不超过一千镑英国货币或等值的中国货币。
Translation: (3) Income derived from personal services performed in the contracting state (excluding services rendered by apprentices to their masters or by partners to the partnership, or by interns to those providing their training) shall be exempt from tax in any fiscal year if it does not exceed one thousand pounds sterling or the equivalent amount in Chinese currency.

Query_Text_cn: 二、根据本条第一款，上述免税应仅在持续到完成接受教育或培训所需的合理或通常的时间内。任何人从该项接受教育或培训开始起超过五年的，不应享受第一款的优惠。
