Translation: 2.(a) Determining the owner of copyright in cinematographic works falls within the scope of national legal provisions that are required to be protected.

Query_Text_cn: （b）然而，在其法律承认参加电影作品制作的作者应属于版权所有者的本同盟成员国内，这些作者，如果应允许参加此项工作，除非有相反或特别的规定，不能反对对电影作品的复制、发行、公开表演、演奏、向公众有线传播、广播、公开传播、配制字幕和配音。
Translation: (b) However, in those member countries of the Union where the law recognizes the authors who participate in the creation of cinematographic works as copyright holders, these authors, if permitted to participate in such work, may not object to the reproduction, distribution, public performance, presentation, communication to the public by cable, broadcasting, public transmission, subtitling, and dubbing of the cinematographic work, unless otherwise stipulated or specifically provided.

Query_Text_cn: （c）为适用本款b项，上面提到的应允形式是否应是一项书面合同或一项相当的文书，这一问题应由电影制片人总部或惯常住所所在的本同盟成员国的法律加以规定。然而被要求给予保护的本同盟成员国的法律得规定这一应允应以书面合同或相当得文书的形式。法律作出此种规定的国家应以书面声明通知总干事，并由后者将这一声明立即通知本同盟所有其他成员国。
Translation: (c) For the purposes of subparagraph (b) of this Article, whether the aforementioned consent must take the form of a written contract or an equivalent document shall be determined by the law of the country of the Union in which the producer of the cinematographic work has his headquarters or habitual residence. However, the law of the country of the Union where protection is sought may require that such consent be in the form of a written contract or an equivalent document. Any country whose law makes such a requirement shall notify the Director General in writing, and the Director General shall immediately communicate such notification to all other countries of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: （d）"相反或特别的规定”指与上述应允有关的任何限制性条件。
Translation: (d) "Contrary or special provisions" refers to any restrictive conditions related to the aforementioned undertakings.

Query_Text_cn: 3.除非本国法律另有规定，本条第二款b项之规定不适用于为电影作品创作的剧本、台词和音乐作品的作者，也不适用于电影作品的主要导演。但本同盟成员国中其法律并未规定对电影导演适用本条第二款b项者，应以书面声明通知总干事，总干事应将此声明立即转达本同盟所有其他成员国。
Translation: 3. Unless otherwise provided by national law, the provisions of paragraph 2(b) of this Article shall not apply to authors of scripts, dialogue, and musical works created for cinematographic works, nor to the principal director of a cinematographic work. However, any member country of the Union whose law does not provide for the application of paragraph 2(b) of this Article to film directors shall notify the Director General by means of a written declaration, and the Director General shall immediately communicate such declaration to all other member countries of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 1.对于艺术作品原作和作家与作曲家的手稿，作者或作者死后由国家法律所授权的人或机构享有不可剥夺的权利，在作者第一次转让作品之后对作品进行的任何出售中分享利益。
Translation: 1. For original works of art and manuscripts by writers and composers, the author or the person or institution authorized by national law after the author's death shall enjoy an inalienable right to share in the proceeds from any subsequent sale of the work following its first transfer.

Query_Text_cn: 2.只有在作者本国法律承认这种保护的情况下，才可在本同盟的成员国内要求上款所规定的保护，而且保护的程度应限于被要求给予保护的国家的法律所允许的程度。
Translation: 2. The protection specified in the preceding paragraph may be claimed in the member countries of this Union only if such protection is recognized by the laws of the country of origin of the author, and the extent of such protection shall be limited to that permitted by the laws of the country where protection is sought.

Query_Text_cn: 3.分享利益之方式和比例由各国法律确定。
Translation: The methods and proportions for sharing benefits shall be determined by the laws of each country.

Query_Text_cn: 1.受本公约保护的文学艺术作品的作者，只要其名字以通常方式出现在该作品上，在没有相反证据的情况下，即视为该作品的作者并有权在本同盟成员国中对侵犯其权利的人提起诉讼。即使作者采用的是假名，只要根据作者的假名可以毫无疑问地确定作者的身份，本款也同样适用。
Translation: 1. The author of a literary or artistic work protected under this Convention shall, in the absence of evidence to the contrary, be regarded as the author and entitled to institute legal proceedings against any person infringing their rights in the member countries of the Union, provided that their name appears on the work in the usual manner. This provision shall also apply where the author uses a pseudonym, as long as the identity of the author can be unequivocally established from the pseudonym.

Query_Text_cn: 2.以通常方式在电影作品上署名的自然人或法人，除非有相反的证据，即推定为该作品的制片人。
Translation: 2. A natural person or legal entity whose name appears in the usual manner on a cinematographic work shall, in the absence of evidence to the contrary, be presumed to be the producer of that work.

Query_Text_cn: 3.对于不具备作品和以上第一款所述情况以外的假名作品，如果出版者的名字出现在作品上，在没有相反证据的情况下，该出版者即视为作者的代表，并以此资格有权维护和行使作者的权利。当作者公开其身份并证实其为作者时，本款的规定即停止适用。
Translation: 3. For pseudonymous works that do not qualify as works and are not covered by the circumstances described in Paragraph 1 above, if the publisher's name appears on the work, the publisher shall, in the absence of evidence to the contrary, be deemed the representative of the author and, in this capacity, shall have the right to protect and exercise the author's rights. This provision shall cease to apply when the author discloses their identity and proves authorship.

Query_Text_cn: 4.（a）对作者的身份不明但有充分理由推定该作者是本同盟某一成员国国民的未出版的作品，该国法律得指定主管当局代表该作者并有权维护和行使作者在本同盟成员国内之权利。
Translation: 4.(a) In the case of unpublished works whose author is unknown but for which there is good reason to presume that the author is a national of a member country of this Union, the legislation of that country may designate a competent authority to represent the author and to protect and enforce the rights of the author within the territories of the member countries of this Union.

Query_Text_cn: （b）根据本规定而指定主管当局的本同盟成员国应以书面声明将此事通知总干事，声明中写明被指定的当局全部有关情况。总干事应将此声明立即通知本同盟所有其他成员国。
Translation: (b) Any member country of this Union that designates a competent authority pursuant to these provisions shall notify the Director General in writing, specifying all relevant details concerning the designated authority. The Director General shall immediately inform all other member countries of the Union of such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 1.对作品的侵权复制品，在作品受法律保护的本同盟成员国应予扣押。
Translation: Infringing copies of works shall be seized in any member country of the Union where the work is protected by law.

Query_Text_cn: 2.上款规定同样适用于来自对某作品不予保护或停止保护的国家的复制品。
Translation: 2. The provisions of the preceding paragraph shall also apply to copies originating from countries where a particular work is not protected or where protection has ceased.

Query_Text_cn: 3.扣押应按各国法律实行。
Translation: 3. Seizure shall be carried out in accordance with the laws of each country.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条如果本同盟任何成员国的主管当局认为有必要对于任何作品或制品的发行、演出、展出，通过法律或条例行使许可、监督或禁止的权力，本公约的条款绝不应妨碍本同盟各成员国政府的这种权力。
Translation: Article 17: If the competent authorities of any member country of this Union deem it necessary to exercise, by means of laws or regulations, the power to authorize, supervise, or prohibit the distribution, performance, or exhibition of any work or production, the provisions of this Convention shall in no way restrict the governments of the member countries of this Union in the exercise of such powers.

Query_Text_cn: 1.本公约适用于所有在本公约开始生效时尚未因保护期满而在其起源国进入公有领域的作品。
Translation: 1. This Convention applies to all works which, at the time it comes into force, have not yet entered the public domain in their country of origin due to the expiration of the term of protection.

Query_Text_cn: 2.但是，如果作品因原来规定的保护期已满而在被要求给予保护的国家已进入公有领域，则该作品不再重新受保护。
Translation: 2. However, if a work has entered the public domain in the country where protection is sought due to the expiration of the originally stipulated term of protection, it shall not be granted renewed protection.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本原则应按照本同盟成员国之间现有的或将要缔结的有关特别公约所规定的条款实行。在没有这种条款的情况下，各国分别规定实行上述原则的条件。
Translation: 3. This principle shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions stipulated in existing or future special conventions between the member states of the alliance. In the absence of such provisions, each country shall separately determine the conditions for implementing the above principle.

Query_Text_cn: 4.新加入本同盟时以及因实行第七条或放弃保留而扩大保护范围时，以上规定也同样适用。
Translation: 4. The above provisions shall also apply when a new member joins this Union, as well as when the scope of protection is expanded due to the implementation of Article 7 or the relinquishment of reservations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条如果本同盟成员国的本国法律提供更广泛的保护，本公约条款不妨碍要求适用这种规定。
Translation: Article 19: If the national laws of a member country of this Union provide broader protection, the provisions of this Convention shall not preclude the application of such regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条本同盟各成员国政府保留在它们之间签订给予作者比本公约所规定的更多的权利，或者包括不违反本公约的其他条款的特别协议的权力。凡符合上述条件的现有协议的条款仍然适用。
Translation: Article 20: The governments of the member countries of this Union reserve the right to conclude among themselves special agreements granting authors more extensive rights than those provided for in this Convention, or including other provisions not contrary to this Convention. The provisions of existing agreements that meet these conditions shall remain applicable.

Query_Text_cn: 1.有关发展中国家的特别条款载于附件。
Translation: 1. Special provisions concerning developing countries are set out in the annex.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在符合第二十八条第一款b项规定的前提下，附件构成本文本的组成部分。
Translation: 2. Subject to the provisions of Article 28, paragraph 1(b), the annexes form an integral part of this text.

Query_Text_cn: 1.（a）本同盟设一大会，由受第二十二至二十六条约束的本同盟成员国组成。
Translation: 1.(a) The League shall establish an Assembly, composed of representatives of the Members of the League subject to Articles 22 to 26.

Query_Text_cn: （b）每一国家的政府由一名代表作为其代表，并可由若干名副代表、顾问及专家协助之。
Translation: (b) The government of each country shall be represented by one representative, who may be assisted by several deputy representatives, advisers, and experts.

Query_Text_cn: （c）每个代表团的费用由指派它的政府负担。
Translation: (c) The expenses of each delegation shall be borne by the government that appoints it.

Query_Text_cn: （13）行使成立产权组织的公约所赋予它的并为它所接受的权利。
Translation: (13) Exercise the rights conferred upon it by the convention establishing the property rights organization and accepted by it.

Query_Text_cn: （b）对于还涉及产权组织管理的其他同盟的问题，大会在了解到产权组织协调委员会的意见后作出决定。
Translation: (b) For other matters concerning the management of unions that involve the Organization, the General Assembly shall make decisions after considering the views of the Coordination Committee of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 3.（a）大会每一成员国有一票。
Translation: 3.(a) Each Member State of the Assembly shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: （b）大会成员国的半数构成法定人数。
Translation: (b) A quorum shall consist of half of the Member States of the Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: （c）尽管有b项的规定，如开会时出席国家不足半数，但相当或多于大会成员国三分之一，则可作出决定；除有关大会程序之决定外，大会的决定须具备下列条件方可执行：国际局将上述决定通知未出席大会的成员国，请它们在上述通知之日起三个月内用书面投票或弃权。如果在期满时，用这样方式投票或弃权的国家的数目达到开会时法定人数的欠缺数目，同时已获得必要的多数，上述决定即可执行。
Translation: (c) Notwithstanding the provisions of item (b), if less than half of the member states are present at the meeting but the number present is equal to or more than one-third of the total member states, decisions may still be made. Except for decisions concerning the procedures of the Assembly, the following conditions must be met for such decisions to take effect: The International Bureau shall notify the member states not present at the Assembly of the said decisions and request them to cast a written vote or abstain within three months from the date of notification. If, by the end of this period, the number of member states voting or abstaining in this manner equals the number required to reach a quorum at the meeting, and the necessary majority has been obtained, the said decisions shall become effective.

Query_Text_cn: （d）除第二十六条第二款规定的情况外，大会的决定以投票数三分之二的多数通过。
Translation: (d) Except as provided in paragraph 2 of Article 26, decisions of the General Assembly shall be made by a two-thirds majority of the votes cast.

Query_Text_cn: （e）弃权不视为投票。
Translation: (e) Abstentions shall not be considered as votes.

Query_Text_cn: （f）一名代表只能代表一国，也只能以该国名义投票。
Translation: (f) A representative may represent only one country and may vote only in the name of that country.

Query_Text_cn: （g）非大会成员国的本同盟成员国以观察员身份参加会议。
Translation: (g) Member States of this Union that are not members of the Assembly may participate in the meetings as observers.

Query_Text_cn: 4.（a）大会每二年举行一届常会，由总干事召集，除特殊情况外，与产权组织的全体大会在同时同地举行。
Translation: 4.(a) The General Assembly shall hold one ordinary session every two years, convened by the Director General, and, except in special circumstances, shall meet at the same time and place as the General Assembly of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: （b）大会在执行委员会的要求下或大会成员国四分之一的国家的要求下，由总干事召集应举行特别会议。
Translation: (b) Special sessions of the General Conference shall be convened by the Director-General at the request of the Executive Board or at the request of one quarter of the Member States of the Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 5.大会通过其议事规则。
Translation: 5. The Assembly shall adopt its rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 1.大会设执行委员会。
Translation: 1. The conference shall establish an Executive Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 2.（a）执委会由大会在其成员国中选出的国家组成。此外，产权组织所在地的国家除第二十五条第七款b项的情况外，在执委会中有一当然席位。
Translation: 2.(a) The Executive Committee shall be composed of countries elected by the Assembly from among its member states. In addition, except in the case provided for in Article 25, paragraph 7(b), the country in which the Organization has its headquarters shall have an ex officio seat on the Executive Committee.

Query_Text_cn: （b）执委会每一成员国政府有一名代表作为其代表，可由若干名副代表、顾问及专家协助之。
Translation: (b) Each member government of the Executive Committee shall be represented by one representative, who may be assisted by several deputy representatives, advisers, and experts.

Query_Text_cn: 3.执委会成员国数目为大会成员国数目的四分之一。在计算席位时，以四相除剩下的余数不计算。
Translation: 3. The number of Executive Committee member states shall be one-fourth of the number of General Assembly member states. When calculating the seats, any remainder resulting from the division by four shall not be counted.

Query_Text_cn: 4.在选派执委会成员国时，大会要适当考虑按地区公平分配和保证使可能签订有关本同盟的特别协议的国家参加执委会的必要性。
Translation: 4. When appointing members of the Executive Committee, the Assembly shall give due consideration to equitable geographical distribution and to the necessity of including countries that may conclude special agreements related to this Union.

Query_Text_cn: 5.（a）执委会成员国的任期自它们当选的该届大会闭会时起至大会下届常会闭会时止。
Translation: 5.(a) The term of office for members of the Executive Committee shall commence at the close of the session of the Assembly at which they are elected and shall end at the close of the next regular session of the Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: （b）执委会的成员国重新当选的数目最多不得超过三分之二。
Translation: (b) The number of member states re-elected to the Executive Committee shall not exceed two-thirds.

Query_Text_cn: （c）大会制定执委会成员国选举和可能重新当选的程序。
Translation: (c) The Assembly shall establish procedures for the election of Executive Committee member states and their possible re-election.

Query_Text_cn: （2）向大会提交有关总干事草拟的本同盟的计划草案和二年期预算草案的建议。
Translation: (2) To submit to the Assembly recommendations concerning the draft program and draft biennial budget of the Organization prepared by the Director General.

Query_Text_cn: （6）履行在本公约范围内赋予它的其他一切任务。
Translation: (6) To perform all other tasks assigned to it within the scope of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (b)对于还涉及产权组织管理的其他同盟的问题，执行委员会在了解到产权组织协调委员会的意见后作出决定。
Translation: (b)With regard to other matters concerning unions whose administration involves the Organization, the Executive Committee shall make decisions after taking into account the views of the Coordination Committee of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 7.（a）执委会在总干事的召集下，每年举行一届常会，尽可能与产权组织协调委员会同时同地举行。
Translation: 7.(a) The Executive Committee shall hold one regular session each year, convened by the Director General, and, as far as possible, at the same time and place as the session of the Coordination Committee of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: (b)执委会在总干事倡议下，或是应执委会主席或四分之一成员国的要求，由总干事召集举行特别会议。
Translation: (b) The Executive Board may hold special sessions convened by the Director-General on his or her own initiative, or at the request of the Chairperson of the Executive Board or one quarter of the Member States, with the Director-General responsible for convening such sessions.

Query_Text_cn: 8.(a)执委会每一成员国有一票。
Translation: 8.(a) Each member country of the Executive Committee shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: (b)执委会成员国的半数构成法定人数。
Translation: (b) A quorum shall consist of half of the member states of the Executive Committee

Query_Text_cn: (c)决议以投票数中简单多数票作出。
Translation: (c) Resolutions shall be adopted by a simple majority of the votes cast.

Query_Text_cn: (d)弃权不视为投票。
Translation: (d) Abstentions shall not be considered as votes.

Query_Text_cn: (e)一名代表只能代表一国，也只能以该国名义投票。
Translation: (e) A representative may represent only one country and may vote only in the name of that country.

Query_Text_cn: 9.非执委会成员国的本同盟成员国以观察员身份参加其会议。
Translation: 9. Member states of the Alliance that are not part of the Executive Committee shall participate in its meetings as observers.

Query_Text_cn: 10.执行委员会通过其议事规则。
Translation: 10. The Executive Committee shall adopt its rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 1.(a)本同盟的行政工作由国际局负责，该局接替与保护工业产权国际公约设立的同盟局合并的本同盟局的工作。
Translation: 1.(a)The administrative work of the Union shall be carried out by the International Bureau, which shall take over the functions of the Union Bureau established under the International Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property, merged with the Bureau of this Union.

Query_Text_cn: (b)国际局负担本同盟各机构的秘书处的工作。
Translation: (b) The International Bureau shall be responsible for the secretariat work of the various organs of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: (c)产权组织总干事是本同盟最高官员并代表本同盟。
Translation: (c) The Director General of the Organization is the highest official of the Union and represents the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 2.国际局汇集并出版有关保护版权的资料，本同盟每一成员国应尽快将有关保护版权的所有新法律及官方文件通知国际局。
Translation: 2. The International Bureau shall collect and publish information concerning the protection of copyright. Each member country of the Union shall promptly communicate to the International Bureau all new laws and official texts concerning the protection of copyright.

Query_Text_cn: 3.国际局出版一种月刊。
Translation: 3. The International Bureau publishes a monthly journal.

Query_Text_cn: 4.国际局应本同盟各成员国之请求，向它们提供有关保护版权问题的资料。
Translation: 4. Upon request from any member country of the Union, the International Bureau shall provide information concerning copyright protection.

Query_Text_cn: 5.国际局从事各项研究并提供有利于保护版权的服务。
Translation: 5. The International Bureau conducts various studies and provides services conducive to the protection of copyright.

Query_Text_cn: 6.总干事及由他指派的任何工作人员均可出席大会、执委会、其他各种专家委员会或工作组的会议，但无表决权。总干事或由他指派的一名工作人员为这些机构的当然秘书。
Translation: 6. The Director-General and any staff members designated by him may attend meetings of the General Assembly, the Executive Committee, and other expert committees or working groups, but shall have no voting rights. The Director-General or a staff member designated by him shall serve as the ex officio secretary of these bodies.

Query_Text_cn: 7.(a)国际局根据大会指示和与执委会合作，筹备修订除第二十二至二十六条外的公约条款的会议。
Translation: 7.(a)The International Bureau, in accordance with the instructions of the General Assembly and in cooperation with the Executive Committee, shall prepare a conference for the revision of the provisions of the Convention, except for Articles 22 to 26.

Query_Text_cn: (b)国际局可就筹备修订会议征询政府间组织和非政府间国际性组织的意见。
Translation: (b) The International Bureau may seek the opinions of intergovernmental organizations and international non-governmental organizations regarding the preparation of revision conferences.

Query_Text_cn: (c)总干事和由他指派的人员可参加这些会议的审议，但无表决权。
Translation: (c)The Director-General and any persons designated by him may participate in the deliberations of these meetings, but without the right to vote.

Query_Text_cn: 8.国际局执行交付给它的所有其他工作。
Translation: 8. The International Bureau shall carry out all other tasks assigned to it.

Query_Text_cn: 1.(a)本同盟有自己的预算。
Translation: 1.(a) The Alliance has its own budget.

Query_Text_cn: (b)本同盟的预算包括本同盟本身的收入及支出，它对各同盟共同开支预算的缴款，以及在情况需要时，交给产权组织会议预算支配的款项。
Translation: (b) The budget of the Union includes the income and expenditure of the Union itself, its contribution to the budget of common expenses of the Unions, and, when necessary, funds allocated to the budget under the control of the Assembly of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: (c)不专属本同盟而同样属于产权组织管理的其他一个或几个同盟的开支，视为各同盟的共同开支。本同盟在共同开支中所占份额视这些开支与它的关系而定。
Translation: (c) Expenditures that are not exclusive to this Union but are also attributable to one or several other Unions administered by the Organization shall be regarded as joint expenditures of the Unions. The share of this Union in such joint expenditures shall be determined in relation to its connection with those expenditures.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本同盟预算的确定须考虑到与其他由产权组织管理的同盟的预算相协调的要求。
Translation: 2. The determination of the budget of this Union must take into account the requirements for coordination with the budgets of other Unions administered by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ⑸租金、利息及其他杂项收入。
Translation: (5) Rental income, interest, and other miscellaneous income.

Query_Text_cn: (b)除以前已经指明者外，每个国家在交存其批准书或加入书时，须说明它希望被列入哪一级。也可以改变级别。如果某一成员国希望降低其级别，它应在某一届常会期间将此事通知大会。这一变动自该届会议后的那一日历年开始时生效。
Translation: (b) Except as previously indicated, each country shall specify the category it wishes to be listed in when depositing its instrument of ratification or accession. Changes in category are also permitted. If a member country wishes to downgrade its category, it shall notify the General Assembly during a regular session. Such a change shall take effect at the beginning of the calendar year following that session.

Query_Text_cn: (c)每个国家每年会费数额在所有国家每年向本同盟交付的会费总数中所占比例，同它所在的那一级的单位数在全部国家的单位总数中所占比例相同。
Translation: (c)The proportion of each country's annual contribution to the total annual contributions paid by all countries to the Union shall be the same as the proportion of the number of units of its class to the total number of units of all countries.

Query_Text_cn: (d)会费应于每年1月1日支付。
Translation: (d) Membership fees shall be paid on January 1st of each year.

Query_Text_cn: (e)逾期未缴纳会费的国家，如拖欠总数达到或超过过去整整两年内它应缴纳的会费数，则不得行使它在本同盟任何机构中的表决权。但如该机构认为这种拖欠系由于非常及不可避免之情况，则可允许该国保留行使其表决权。
Translation: (e) Any country that is in arrears in the payment of its dues, if the amount owed equals or exceeds the total amount of dues payable for the preceding two full years, shall not be entitled to vote in any organ of the Union. However, if the organ considers that the failure to pay is due to exceptional and unavoidable circumstances, it may permit the country to retain its voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: (f)如在新的会计年度开始前还未通过预算，则可按照财务条例规定的手续将前一年的预算延期实行。
Translation: (f) If the budget has not been approved before the start of the new fiscal year, the previous year's budget may be extended in accordance with the procedures stipulated in the financial regulations.

Query_Text_cn: ⒌国际局代表本同盟提供的服务应得收入的数额由总干事确定，总干事向大会和执委会就此提出报告。
Translation: The amount of income to which the International Bureau is entitled for the services provided by the Union shall be determined by the Director General, who shall report thereon to the Assembly and the Executive Committee.

Query_Text_cn: ⒍(a)本同盟拥有一笔由每一成员国一次付款组成的周转基金。如基金不足，由大会决定增加。
Translation: ⒍(a) The Alliance shall have a revolving fund composed of a one-time payment from each member country. If the fund is insufficient, the General Assembly shall decide on an increase.

Query_Text_cn: (b)每个国家对上述基金的首次付款数以及追加数应按基金成立或决定增加当年该国缴纳会费数的比例。
Translation: (b) Each country's initial and additional payments to the above-mentioned fund shall be made in proportion to the amount of membership dues paid by that country in the year the fund is established or the decision to increase is made.

Query_Text_cn: (c)付款的比例及方式由大会根据总干事的提议并征求产权协调委员会意见后决定。
Translation: (c)The proportion and method of payment shall be determined by the General Assembly upon the proposal of the Director General and after consulting the Coordination Committee on Property Rights.

Query_Text_cn: ⒎(a)与产权组织所在地的国家签订的会址协定规定，如周转基金不足，可由该国垫款。垫款数和垫款条件由该国和产权组织每次分别签订协定。在该国承诺垫付款项期间，该国在执委会中占有一席当然席位。
Translation: ⒎(a) According to the headquarters agreement signed with the country where the property rights organization is located, if the revolving fund is insufficient, the country may provide advances. The amount and conditions of such advances shall be stipulated in separate agreements between the country and the property rights organization each time. During the period in which the country commits to providing advances, it shall hold an ex officio seat on the Executive Committee.

Query_Text_cn: (b)a项所指国家和产权组织均有权以书面通知方式废止提供垫款的保证。这种废止自通知提出那一年底起三年后生效。
Translation: Both the country and the property organization referred to in item (a) shall have the right to terminate the guarantee for the provision of advances by written notice. Such termination shall take effect three years after the end of the year in which the notice is given.

Query_Text_cn: ⒏根据财务条例规定的方式，帐目审计由大会同意指派的一个或几个本同盟成员国或外聘审计员担任。
Translation: In accordance with the provisions of the financial regulations, the audit of accounts shall be conducted by one or more member states of the Union or external auditors appointed with the approval of the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: ⒈所有大会成员国，执委会或总干事均可提出修改第二十二、二十三、二十四、二十五条及本条的建议。这些建议由总干事在提交大会审查前至少六个月通知大会成员国。
Translation: All Member States of the General Conference, the Executive Board, or the Director-General may propose amendments to Articles 22, 23, 24, 25, and this Article. The Director-General shall notify Member States of the General Conference of such proposals at least six months before submitting them for the Conference's consideration.

Query_Text_cn: ⒉第一款所指的各条的修改应由大会通过，通过需要投票数的四分之三；但对第二十二条及本款的任何修改需经投票数的五分之四通过。
Translation: Amendments to the articles referred to in paragraph 1 shall be adopted by the Assembly with a three-fourths majority of votes; however, any amendment to Article 22 or to this paragraph shall require a five-fourths majority of votes for adoption.

Query_Text_cn: ⒊第一款所提各条的任何修改，至少要在总干事收到在修改通过时为大会成员国的四分之三国家根据它们各自的宪法批准修改的书面通知一个月后才能生效。以这种方式接受的这些条款的修改对修改生效时为大会成员国的所有国家或其后成为成员国的国家具有约束力；但任何增加本同盟成员国财务义务的修改只对那些已通知表示接受这类修改的国家有约束力。
Translation: Any amendment to the articles referred to in paragraph 1 shall enter into force only one month after the Director General has received written notifications of approval of the amendment, in accordance with their respective constitutions, from three-fourths of the countries that were member states of the Assembly at the time the amendment was adopted. Amendments thus accepted shall be binding on all countries that are member states of the Assembly at the time the amendment enters into force, or that become member states thereafter; however, any amendment that increases the financial obligations of the member countries of the Union shall be binding only on those countries that have notified their acceptance of such an amendment.

Query_Text_cn: ⒈本公约可进行修订，以便使之得到改善，从而使本同盟体制臻于完善。
Translation: This Convention may be revised in order to improve it and thereby perfect the system of the Alliance.

Query_Text_cn: ⒉为此目的，可相继在本同盟一个成员国内举行同盟成员国代表的会议。
Translation: For this purpose, meetings of representatives of the member states of the Alliance may be held successively in the territory of any member state of the Alliance.

Query_Text_cn: ⒊除第二十六条有关修改第二十二至二十六条的规定外，所有对本文本的修订，包括附件的修订，均需投票数全体一致通过。
Translation: Except for the provisions of Article 26 regarding amendments to Articles 22 to 26, all other amendments to this text, including amendments to the annexes, require unanimous approval by all votes.

Query_Text_cn: ⒈(a)凡签署此公约文本的任何本同盟成员国均可批准此公约文本，如尚未签署，则可加入本公约。批准书或加入书交存总干事处。
Translation: 1.(a) Any member country of the Union that has signed this Convention may ratify it; if it has not signed, it may accede to the Convention. Instruments of ratification or accession shall be deposited with the Director General.

Query_Text_cn: (b)本同盟任何成员国在其批准书或加入书中均可声明其批准或加入不适用第一至二十一条及附件；但如该国已根据附件第六条第一款作出声明，则它在上述文件中可只声明其批准或加入不适用于第一至二十条。
Translation: (b) Any member country of this alliance may declare in its instrument of ratification or accession that its ratification or accession does not apply to Articles 1 to 21 and the Annex. However, if the country has made a declaration pursuant to Article 6, paragraph 1 of the Annex, it may declare in the aforementioned document that its ratification or accession does not apply to Articles 1 to 20.

Query_Text_cn: (c)凡根据b项已声明其批准或加入对该项所提到的条款不发生效力的本同盟任何成员国可在其后任何时候声明将其批准或加入的效力扩大到这些条款。这一声明交存总干事处。
Translation: (c) Any member country of the Union that has declared, pursuant to item (b), that its ratification or accession does not apply to the provisions referred to therein may at any time thereafter declare that its ratification or accession shall extend to those provisions. Such declaration shall be deposited with the Director General.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵法国、西班牙、大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国、美利坚合众国已受到1971年7月24日在巴黎修订过的世界版权公约的约束。
Translation: France, Spain, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, and the United States of America are bound by the Universal Copyright Convention as revised at Paris on July 24, 1971.

Query_Text_cn: (b)a项提到的生效，对于至少在生效前三个月交存批准书或加入书但未按第一款b项作过声明的本同盟成员国具有效力。
Translation: The entry into force referred to in paragraph (a) shall apply to any member country of the Union that has deposited its instrument of ratification or accession at least three months prior to the entry into force, but has not made a declaration under item (b) of the first paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: (c)就b项对之不适用的已批准或加入此公约文本而未按照第一款b项作过声明的所有本同盟成员国而言，第一至二十一条及附件在总干事通知该批准书或加入书交存之日后三个月生效，除非交存文件中注明有更晚的日期。在后一情况下，第一至二十一条及附件则在注明的日期对该国生效。
Translation: (c) For all member countries of this Union that have ratified or acceded to this Convention text to which item (b) does not apply and have not made a declaration pursuant to paragraph 1(b), Articles 1 to 21 and the Annex shall enter into force three months after the date on which the Director General notifies the deposit of the instrument of ratification or accession, unless a later date is specified in the deposited instrument. In the latter case, Articles 1 to 21 and the Annex shall enter into force for that country on the specified date.

Query_Text_cn: (d)a至c项的规定不影响附件第六条的适用。
Translation: The provisions of items (a) to (c) do not affect the application of Article 6 of the Annex.

Query_Text_cn: ⒊对不管是否按照第一款b项作过声明而批准或加入此公约文本的任何本同盟成员国，第二十二至三十八条在总干事通知已交存批准书或加入书之日后三个月生效，除非交存文件中注明有更晚的日期。在后一情况下，第二十二至三十八条则在注明的日期对该国生效。
Translation: For any member country of the Union that ratifies or accedes to this Act of the Convention, regardless of whether it has made a declaration under paragraph (1)(b), Articles 22 to 38 shall enter into force three months after the date on which the Director General notifies that the instrument of ratification or accession has been deposited, unless a later date is specified in the deposited instrument. In the latter case, Articles 22 to 38 shall enter into force for that country on the date so specified.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国和缅甸联邦边界条约*（注*：1960年10月1日签订于北京并于1961年1月4日生效。
Translation: Treaty on the Boundary Between the People's Republic of China and the Union of Burma* (*Note: Signed in Beijing on October 1, 1960, and entered into force on January 4, 1961.)

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国主席特派国务院总理周恩来；缅甸联邦总统特派总理吴努。
Translation: The President of the People's Republic of China appointed Premier Zhou Enlai of the State Council as his special representative; the President of the Union of Burma appointed Prime Minister U Nu as his special representative.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国同意按照一九四一年六月十八日中英两国政府换文来划定从南帕河和南定河汇合处到南卡江和南永河汇合处的一段边界，但是本条约第二条和第三条规定的调整除外。
Translation: The People's Republic of China agrees to delimit the section of the boundary from the confluence of the Nanpa River and the Nanding River to the confluence of the Nanka River and the Nanyong River in accordance with the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British governments dated June 18, 1941, except for the adjustments stipulated in Articles II and III of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条鉴于中缅两国的平等友好关系，双方决定废除缅甸对属于中国的猛卯三角地（南碗指定区）所保持的“永租”关系。
Translation: Article 2: In view of the equal and friendly relations between China and Myanmar, both parties have agreed to abolish Myanmar's "perpetual lease" over the Mengmao Triangle (designated area of Nanwan), which belongs to China.

Query_Text_cn: 考虑到缅甸方面的实际需要，中国方面同意把这个地区（面积约为220平方公里，85平方英里，如附图所标明）移交给缅甸，成为缅甸联邦领土的一部分。
Translation: In consideration of Myanmar's actual needs, the Chinese side agrees to transfer this area (approximately 220 square kilometers, or 85 square miles, as indicated in the attached map) to Myanmar, making it part of the territory of the Union of Myanmar.

Query_Text_cn: 作为交换，同时为了照顾历史关系和部落的完整，缅甸方面同意把按照一九四一年六月十八日中英两国政府换文的规定属于缅甸的班洪、班老部落辖区（面积约为189平方公里，73平方英里，如附图所标明）划归中国，成为中国领土的一部分。
Translation: As an exchange, and in consideration of historical ties and the integrity of the tribes, the Burmese side agreed to transfer the territories of the Banhong and Banlao tribes (with an area of approximately 189 square kilometers, or 73 square miles, as indicated in the attached map), which, according to the provisions of the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British governments on June 18, 1941, belonged to Burma, to China, thereby making them part of Chinese territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条为了便于双方各自的行政管理，照顾当地居民的部落关系和生产、生活上的需要，双方同意对一九四一年六月十八日中英两国政府换文划定的界线中的一小段，做一些公平合理的调整，把永和寨和龙乃寨划归中国，把羊柏寨、班孔寨、班弄寨和班歪寨划归缅甸，使这些骑线村寨不再被边界线所分割。
Translation: Article 3: In order to facilitate the respective administrative management of both parties and to accommodate the tribal relations and production and living needs of local residents, both sides agree to make fair and reasonable adjustments to a small section of the boundary delineated in the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British governments on June 18, 1941. Yonghezai and Longnaizai will be assigned to China, while Yangbaizai, Bankongzai, Bannongzai, and Banwaizai will be assigned to Myanmar, so that these villages straddling the boundary will no longer be divided by the border.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条中国政府根据一贯反对外国特权和尊重其他国家主权的政策，声明放弃一九四一年六月十八日中英两国政府换文规定的、中国参加经营缅甸炉房矿产企业的权利。
Translation: Article 4: In accordance with its consistent policy of opposing foreign privileges and respecting the sovereignty of other countries, the Chinese government declares its renunciation of the right to participate in the operation of the Burma Bawdwin Mines enterprise, as stipulated in the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British governments dated June 18, 1941.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条缔约双方同意，从尖高山到中缅边界西端终点的一段边界，除片马、古浪、岗房地区以外，按照传统的习惯线定界，也就是从尖高山起，沿着以太平江、瑞丽江、怒江、西靖丹以上的独龙江为一方、恩梅开江为另一方的分水岭向北，直到在西靖丹以西独龙江南岸的一点，由此跨过独龙江，然后继续沿着以西靖丹以上的独龙江和察隅河为一方和除西靖丹以上的独龙江以外的全部伊洛瓦底江上游支系为另一方的分水岭，直到中缅边界西端终点为止。
Translation: Article 5: Both contracting parties agree that, except for the areas of Pianma, Gulang, and Gangfang, the section of the boundary from Jiangaoshan to the western terminus of the China-Myanmar border shall be delimited according to the traditional customary line. Specifically, starting from Jiangaoshan, the boundary shall follow the watershed northward, with Taiping River, Ruili River, Nujiang River, and the upper reaches of the Dulong River above Xijingdan on one side, and the Enmei River on the other side, until reaching a point on the southern bank of the Dulong River west of Xijingdan. From there, the boundary shall cross the Dulong River and continue along the watershed, with the upper reaches of the Dulong River above Xijingdan and the Chayu River on one side, and all tributaries of the upper Irrawaddy River except the upper Dulong River above Xijingdan on the other side, until reaching the western terminus of the China-Myanmar border.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条缔约双方确认，从尖高山到南帕河和南定河汇合处以及从南卡江和南永河汇合处到中缅边界东南端终点南腊河和澜沧江（湄公河）汇合处的两段边界，过去已经划定，无需加以更改，界线如本条约附图所标明。
Translation: Article 6 The contracting parties confirm that the two sections of the boundary—from Jiangaoshan to the confluence of the Nanpa River and the Nanding River, and from the confluence of the Nanka River and the Nanyong River to the southeastern terminus of the China-Myanmar border at the confluence of the Nanla River and the Lancang River (Mekong River)—have already been demarcated in the past and require no further modification. The boundary lines are indicated in the map attached to this treaty.

Query_Text_cn: （1）从尖高山（木浪凸）起，界线沿着以太平江（大盈江）、龙川江（瑞丽江）、怒江（萨尔温江）为一方，恩梅开江为另一方的分水岭向北转东南再向东北行，经过水城山口（马赤伊车特山口）、班瓦山口、大沙明山、派赖山口（耶冒隆古基特山口）、茨竹山口（拉桂山口），到楚衣大河（楚衣和大河）源头。
Translation: Starting from Jiangaoshan (Mulangtu), the boundary follows the watershed separating the Taiping River (Daying River), Longchuan River (Ruili River), and Nu River (Salween River) on one side, and the Enmei River on the other. It turns north, then southeast, and then northeast, passing through Shuicheng Pass (Machiyichet Pass), Banwa Pass, Dashaming Mountain, Pailai Pass (Yemaolongguket Pass), Cizhu Pass (Laguishan Pass), and reaches the source of the Chuyi River (Chuyihe River).

Query_Text_cn: （2）从楚衣大河源头起，界线沿楚衣大河西北行，到该河和从北面流来的该河一支流的汇合处，即沿该支流北行，到以片马河（唐恰因河）的支流为一方、王克河（莫库河）及其支流楚衣大河为另一方的分水岭上的一点，转沿该分水岭西行，经马赤洛瓦底（2423公尺，7950英尺），再转北到片马寨以西穿过片马河，沿山脊北行，经鲁克桑坂山并穿过干河（康好河）到吴中河（瓦索考河），然后沿吴中河西行到该河和小江（瑙漳卡河）汇合处，再溯小江北上，到该江和大巴底河（保德河）汇合处。
Translation: (2) Starting from the source of the Chuyi River, the boundary runs northwest along the Chuyi River to the confluence where a tributary flows into it from the north. It then follows this tributary northward to a point on the watershed, where a tributary of the Pianma River (Tangqiayin River) lies on one side and the Wangke River (Moku River) and its tributary, the Chuyi River, lie on the other. From there, the boundary turns west along the watershed, passing through Machiluowadi (2,423 meters, 7,950 feet), then turns north, crossing the Pianma River to the west of Pianma Village. It continues north along the mountain ridge, passing through the Luksangban Mountains and crossing the Gan River (Kanghao River) to reach the Wuzhong River (Wasokao River). The boundary then follows the Wuzhong River westward to its confluence with the Xiaojiang River (Nauzhangka River), and then traces the Xiaojiang River northward to its confluence with the Dabadih River (Baode River).

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线经过岗房寨以北，大体向东再向东南，沿着以小巴底河（泡西河）、吴中河为一方、大巴底河为另一方的分水岭，直到怒江和恩梅开江分水岭上的一点。
Translation: From there, the boundary passes north of Gangfangzhai, generally heading east and then southeast, following the watershed with Xia Badi River (Paoxi River) and Wuzhong River on one side, and Da Badi River on the other, until it reaches a point on the watershed between the Nujiang River and the Enmei Kai River.

Query_Text_cn: （3）从怒江和恩梅开江分水岭上的上述一点起，界线沿着以怒江、西靖丹以上的独龙江为一方、恩梅开江为另一方的分水岭大体向北，经过加俄都山口（沙燕山口）、沙拉山口、鸣克山口（纳开山口）、泥自谷山口（吉吉萨拉山口）、考赤萨拉山口、琼吉山口、麻古赤山口后，再向北大体转西行，经阿弄山口、麦瓦山口、邦唐山（邦唐拉孜）、容朗山口、阿拉拉孜到土色邦拉孜。
Translation: (3) Starting from the aforementioned point on the watershed between the Nujiang River and the Irrawaddy River, the boundary generally runs northward along the watershed, with the Nujiang River and the Dulong River above Xijingdan on one side and the Irrawaddy River on the other. It passes through Jiaodu Pass (Shayan Pass), Shala Pass, Mingke Pass (Nakay Pass), Nizigu Pass (Jijisala Pass), Kaochisala Pass, Qiongjishan Pass, Maguchi Pass, then turns generally westward to the north, passing through Anong Pass, Maiwa Pass, Bangtang Mountain (Bangtang Lazi), Ronglang Pass, Alalazi, and finally reaches Tusebang Lazi.

Query_Text_cn: （4）从土色邦拉孜起，界线沿山脊大体西北行，经2892公尺高地和2140．3公尺高地，到西靖丹以西独龙江南岸的一点，由此跨过独龙江，到独龙江和它的北边一支流的汇合处，然后沿山脊向西北，到扛丹拉孜（龙戛旁）。
Translation: (4) Starting from Tusebang Laz, the boundary generally follows the mountain ridge northwestward, passing through the elevations of 2,892 meters and 2,140.3 meters, to a point on the southern bank of the Dulong River west of Xijingdan. From there, it crosses the Dulong River to the confluence of the Dulong River and its northern tributary, then continues along the mountain ridge northwestward to Kangdan Laz (Longjiabang).

Query_Text_cn: （5）从扛丹拉孜起，界线沿着以西靖丹以上的独龙江为一方和伊洛瓦底江上游支系（不包括西靖丹以上的独龙江）为另一方的分水岭大体向北再西北行，经过萨拉山口、聪惹山口（阿曼三山口）到宇朗山口。
Translation: (5) Starting from Kangdanlazi, the boundary generally runs north and then northwest along the watershed that separates the upper Dulong River above Xijingdan on one side from the tributaries of the upper Irrawaddy River (excluding the Dulong River above Xijingdan) on the other, passing through the Sala Pass, Congre Pass (Aman San Pass), and reaching the Yulang Pass.

Query_Text_cn: （6）从宇朗山口起，界线沿着以察隅河为一方和伊洛瓦底江上游支系为另一方的分水岭大体向西南行，经过贡拉山口到中缅边界西端终点。
Translation: (6) Starting from the Yulang Pass, the boundary generally runs southwest along the watershed, with the Chayu River on one side and the upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River on the other, passing through the Gongla Pass to the western terminus of the China-Myanmar border.

Query_Text_cn: （1）从尖高山起，界线沿着以太平江上游支系、勐戛河、大巴江上游支系为一方、恩梅开江下游支系为另一方的分水岭大体向西南，经大丫口（陇牵克特），转西北到小雀丫口（大巴枯克特）。
Translation: (1) Starting from Jiangaoshan, the boundary generally runs southwest along the watershed separating the upper tributaries of the Taiping River, Mengjia River, and upper tributaries of the Daba River on one side, from the lower tributaries of the Enmei River on the other side, passing through Dayakou (Longqian Kete), then turns northwest to Xiaoque Yakou (Daba Kuke Te).

Query_Text_cn: （2）从小雀丫口起，界线顺大巴江、勐戛河，再溯石竹河（巴乃卡，上游名卡同卡），到石竹河源头。
Translation: (2) Starting from Xiaoque Yakou, the boundary follows the Daba River and Mengjia River, then traces upstream along the Shizhu River (Banai Ka, known as Katongka in its upper reaches) to the source of the Shizhu River.

Query_Text_cn: （3）从石竹河源头起，界线沿着以勐来河为一方、巴窑卡河、玛琍卡河、南山河为另一方的分水岭向西南转西，到拉沙河源头。
Translation: (3) Starting from the source of the Shizhu River, the boundary follows the watershed, with the Menglai River on one side and the Bayao Ka River, Mali Ka River, and Nanshan River on the other, turning southwest and then west, until it reaches the source of the Lasha River.

Query_Text_cn: （4）从拉沙河源头起，界线顺拉沙河、溯穆雷江和羯羊河（既阳江），经马脖子（阿路克特），顺南奔江南下，到南奔江和太平江汇合处，再溯太平江东行，到太平江和枯利河汇合处以西的小山梁和太平江相遇处。
Translation: (4) Starting from the source of the Lasha River, the boundary follows the Lasha River, ascends the Murei River and the Jieyang River (also known as the Yang River), passes through Mabozhi (Alukete), follows the Nanben River southward to the confluence of the Nanben River and the Taiping River, then ascends the Taiping River eastward to the point where the small ridge west of the confluence of the Taiping River and the Kuli River meets the Taiping River.

Query_Text_cn: （5）从太平江和上述小山梁相遇处起，界线沿着以枯利河、户撒河（南撒河）、南碗河的支流为一方、枯利河以西的太平江支流为另一方的分水岭到邦千山（板凳山）。
Translation: (5) Starting from the point where the Taiping River meets the aforementioned small ridge, the boundary follows the watershed, with the tributaries of the Kuli River, Husa River (Nansha River), and Nanwan River on one side, and the tributaries of the Taiping River west of the Kuli River on the other, until it reaches Bangqian Mountain (Banteng Mountain).

Query_Text_cn: （6）从邦千山起，界线向南接金跌河，然后顺该河和南洼河（乓岭河），到曼允海寨东南、弄沙寨以北南洼河南岸一点，然后以直线向西南，转南行，到南洒河（曼丁河），从此顺过去划定界线时南洒河的河道到该河和南碗河汇合处，再顺当时南碗河的河道到该河道和当时瑞丽江的河道汇合处。
Translation: (6) Starting from Bangqianshan, the boundary extends south to connect with the Jindie River, then follows the course of this river and the Nanwa River (Pangling River) to a point on the southern bank of the Nanwa River, southeast of Manyun Haizhai and north of Nongsha Zhai. From there, it proceeds in a straight line southwestward, then turns south to reach the Nansai River (Manding River). From this point, the boundary follows the course of the Nansai River as it was at the time the boundary was demarcated, to the confluence of the Nansai River and the Nanwan River. It then follows the course of the Nanwan River as it was at that time to the confluence of the Nanwan River and the Ruili River as they existed at that time.

Query_Text_cn: （7）从过去划定界线时南碗河和瑞丽江的河道汇合处到瑞丽江和畹町河（南阳河）汇合处，界线的位置如本条约附图所示。
Translation: (7) From the confluence of the Nanwan River and the Ruili River, where the boundary was previously demarcated, to the confluence of the Ruili River and the Wanting River (Nanyang River), the location of the boundary shall be as shown in the map attached to this treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线溯过去划定界线时畹町河的河道和卫上河，然后转西北沿南遮河（南色河）一支流到和南遮河汇合处，从此溯南遮河东行，经青树丫口，再沿勐龙河和过去划定界线时勐古河（南戈河）的河道，溯南开河和南邦瓦河，经一丫口，然后沿曼辛河[南棒河，上游名南跌河（南勒普河）]，到和怒江汇合处，从此溯怒江东行直到和地界沟（南扪河）相遇处。
Translation: From this point, the boundary follows the course of the Wanting River and Weishang River as delineated in previous boundary demarcations, then turns northwest along a tributary of the Nanzhe River (Nanse River) to its confluence with the main Nanzhe River. From there, it follows the Nanzhe River eastward, passes through Qingshu Yakou, then follows the Menglong River and the course of the Menggu River (Nange River) as previously demarcated, continues along the Nankai River and Nanbangwa River, passes through a mountain pass, then follows the Manxin River [Nanbang River, known upstream as Nandie River (Nanelepu River)] to its confluence with the Nujiang River. From this point, it follows the Nujiang River eastward until it meets the Dijiegou (Namen River).

Query_Text_cn: （8）从怒江和地界沟相遇处起，界线向南沿地界沟而行，然后沿以勐棒河（南朋河上游）为一方、怒江的支流为另一方的分水岭向西南转南到炮楼山。
Translation: (8) Starting from the point where the Nujiang River meets the Dijie Gully, the boundary runs south along the Dijie Gully, then turns southwest and south along the watershed, with the Mengbang River (the upper reaches of the Nanpeng River) on one side and a tributary of the Nujiang River on the other, until it reaches Paolou Mountain.

Query_Text_cn: （9）从炮楼山起，界线向东南沿瓦窑沟、麦地河南面的坡岭、板桥河和小鹿场河（新寨沟）而行，直到小鹿场河的源头。
Translation: (9) Starting from Paolou Mountain, the boundary runs southeast along the slopes south of Wayaogou and Maidie River, then follows Banqiao River and Xiaoluchang River (Xinzhaigou), until it reaches the source of Xiaoluchang River.

Query_Text_cn: 从该河的源头直到南帕河和南定河汇合处，界线的位置如本条约附图所示。
Translation: From the source of the river to the confluence of the Nam Pa and Nam Ting rivers, the boundary shall be as shown on the map annexed to this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 然后，界线溯南定河东行约四公里（约三英里）后，即向东南沿公母大山（来兴山）西北山坡到公母大山山顶。
Translation: Then, the boundary follows the Nan Ding River eastward for approximately four kilometers (about three miles), and then turns southeast along the northwestern slope of Gongmu Dashan (Laixing Mountain) to the summit of Gongmu Dashan.

Query_Text_cn: （10）从公母大山山顶起，界线向东南沿恭勐河（南涝沙河）一支流，到和从东南流来的另一支流汇合处，再溯后一支流到马落寨西北的一点。
Translation: (10) Starting from the summit of Gongmu Dashan, the boundary runs southeast along a tributary of the Gongmeng River (Nanlaosha River) to the confluence with another tributary flowing from the southeast, then follows this latter tributary upstream to a point northwest of Maluo Village.

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线以直线到马落寨西南一点，再以直线穿过云兴河（南大河）的一条支流，到上述支流和云兴河另一支流汇合处以东的仙人山，然后再沿云兴河上述两条支流的分水岭而行，到其中西面支流的源头，再沿勐林山脊向西转西南，到勐林山山顶。
Translation: From this point, the boundary runs in a straight line to a point southwest of Maluo Village, then proceeds in a straight line across a tributary of the Yunxing River (also known as the South Dajiang), reaching Xianren Mountain, which lies east of the confluence of this tributary and another tributary of the Yunxing River. It then follows the watershed between these two tributaries of the Yunxing River to the source of the western tributary, and continues along the Menglin Mountain ridge, turning west and then southwest, until it reaches the summit of Menglin Mountain.

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线沿南板河向东转东南行，到该河和从西南流来的在垭口寨东北面的一支流汇合处，溯该支流西南行，到垭口寨东北一点，从此转南，经过垭口寨以东的一点，穿过垭口寨南面的南板河一支流，即折向西行，到招保寨（达克莱诺）稍东的南衣河源头。
Translation: From there, the boundary follows the Nanban River eastward and then southeastward to the confluence of this river and a tributary flowing from the southwest, located northeast of Yakouzhai. It then traces this tributary southwestward to a point northeast of Yakouzhai, from which it turns south, passes a point east of Yakouzhai, crosses a tributary of the Nanban River south of Yakouzhai, and then turns westward to the headwaters of the Nanyi River, slightly east of Zhaobaozhai (Dakleino).

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线沿南衣河、南模河南行，再转东沿南滚河、巧克河而行，到巧克河的东北源头。
Translation: From there, the boundary runs south along the Nanyi River and the Nanmo River, then turns east along the Nangun River and the Qiaoke River, reaching the northeastern source of the Qiaoke River.

Query_Text_cn: （11）从巧克河的东北源头起，界线沿着以南滚河上游支系为一方、巧克河的南面支流和南丁河（南屯河）为另一方的分水岭向南转东而行，到羊柏寨西侧一点，向东经过羊柏寨以北100公尺处，再向东直到一小河在上述分水岭上的源头，然后沿山脊东行到勐董河（南董河，上游名大董河）一支流的源头，再沿该支流向东转东北行到和勐董河另一从东南流来的支流的汇合处，从此沿该支流到勐董河和龙达小河（南浪河）之间的分水岭上的该支流源头。
Translation: (11) Starting from the northeastern source of the Qiaoke River, the boundary follows the watershed, with the upper tributaries of the Nan Gun River on one side and the southern tributaries of the Qiaoke River and the Nanting River (Nantun River) on the other, turning south and then east, reaching a point west of Yangbaizhai. It then proceeds east, passing 100 meters north of Yangbaizhai, and continues east to the source of a small river on the aforementioned watershed. From there, it follows the mountain ridge eastward to the source of a tributary of the Mengdong River (Nandong River, known as Dadong River in its upper reaches), then follows this tributary east and northeast to the confluence with another tributary flowing from the southeast into the Mengdong River. From this point, it follows the latter tributary to its source on the watershed between the Mengdong River and the Longda River (Nanlang River).

Query_Text_cn: 然后界线向东穿过分水岭到龙达小河的源头，再沿该河而行，到该河和从北面流来的支流汇合处，再沿该支流向北，然后穿过岗宾脑山脊上的一点，沿一河谷大体东行，穿过龙达小河一支流的两个分支流的汇合处，转向东北，到以勐董河为一方，南马河为另一方的分水岭，直到1941．8公尺（6370英尺）高地。
Translation: The boundary then extends eastward across the watershed to the source of the Longda River, follows the river to the confluence with a tributary flowing from the north, then proceeds northward along this tributary, crosses a point on the ridge of Gangbinniao Mountain, follows a valley generally eastward, passes the confluence of two branches of a tributary of the Longda River, turns northeast to the watershed between the Mengdong River on one side and the Nanma River on the other, and continues to the 1,941.8-meter (6,370-foot) elevation point.

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线沿着以勐董河、腊勐河（南勐河）、黑河、库杏河（南卡蓝河）、南卡镐河（南项河）为一方，南马河为另一方的分水岭，向东转南再转西北，直到来劳寨西北该分水岭上的一点。
Translation: From this point, the boundary follows the watershed formed by the Mengdong River, Lameng River (Nan Meng River), Hei River, Kuxing River (Nankalan River), and Nankahao River (Nanxiang River) on one side, and the Nanma River on the other side, turning east, then south, and then northwest, until it reaches a point on this watershed northwest of Lailaozhai.

Query_Text_cn: （12）从来劳寨西北上述分水岭上的一点起，界线顺最近的南卡镐河支流而下，然后顺南卡镐河到其和从西南流来的支流的汇合处，再溯该支流大体向西南，到该支流在2180公尺（7152英尺）高地东北、离该高地最近的源头，然后在上述高地东南150公尺（492英尺）处穿过山脊，转南到发源于上述高地最近的南弄河（南洒克河）一支流的源头，然后沿该支流到和南弄河汇合处，再沿南弄河、南锡河、南卡江，到南卡江和南永河汇合处，再溯南永河而上，到其源头。
Translation: (12) Starting from a point on the aforementioned watershed northwest of Laozhai, the boundary follows the nearest tributary of the Nankahao River downstream, then follows the Nankahao River to its confluence with a tributary flowing from the southwest. It then traces this tributary generally southwestward to its source, which is northeast of the 2,180-meter (7,152-foot) elevation and closest to this high ground. The boundary then crosses the ridge 150 meters (492 feet) southeast of the aforementioned high ground, turns south to the source of a tributary of the Nannong River (Nansake River) originating near this high ground, follows this tributary to its confluence with the Nannong River, then follows the Nannong River, Nanxi River, and Nanka River to the confluence of the Nanka River and the Nanyong River, and finally traces the Nanyong River upstream to its source.

Query_Text_cn: （13）从南永河源头起，界线向东南到纳乌河和南配河（南亚河）的分水岭，再沿该分水岭大体向东，继沿纳乌河，到和南来河的汇合处，再沿纳乌河和南来河的分水岭而行，到昂朗山（洛昂朗）山脊，向北沿山脊到昂朗山山顶，再大体向东沿山脊穿过南洞基克河，然后沿着以拉定河（会缺台河）以北的南垒河西岸的支流和南腊河（南马河的支流）为一方、拉定河以南的南垒河西岸的支流为另一方的分水岭而行，到邦顺山（洛邦顺）山顶。
Translation: (13) Starting from the source of the Nanyong River, the boundary runs southeast to the watershed between the Nawu River and the Nanpei River (Nanya River), then generally east along this watershed, continuing along the Nawu River to its confluence with the Nanlai River. It then follows the watershed between the Nawu River and the Nanlai River to the ridge of Anglang Mountain (Luolanglang), proceeds north along the ridge to the summit of Anglang Mountain, and then generally east along the ridge, crossing the Nandongjik River. The boundary then follows the watershed, with the tributaries on the west bank of the Nanlei River north of the Lading River (Huiquetai River) and the tributaries of the Nanla River (a tributary of the Nanma River) on one side, and the tributaries on the west bank of the Nanlei River south of the Lading River on the other side, until it reaches the summit of Bangshun Mountain (Luobangshun).

Query_Text_cn: （14）从邦顺山山顶起，界线大体向东沿着拉定河、南垒河、过去划定界线时南乐河的河道、南卧河（南卜河），到南卧改乃山（洛外南）上的南卧河源头。
Translation: Starting from the summit of Bangshun Mountain, the boundary generally runs eastward along the Lading River, Nanlei River, the riverbed of Nanle River as previously demarcated, Nanwo River (Nanbu River), to the source of Nanwo River on Nanwo Gainai Mountain (Luowai Nan).

Query_Text_cn: （15）从南卧改乃山上的南卧河源头起，界线大体向东沿着以南腊河（南垒河的支流）、南派河、南西河（南霍河）为一方、南品河、南卯河、南西板河为另一方的分水岭而行，到三面坡（洛三勐）。
Translation: (15) Starting from the source of the Nanwo River on Mount Nanguogainai, the boundary generally runs eastward along the watershed, with the Nanla River (a tributary of the Nanlei River), Nanpai River, and Nanxi River (Nanhuo River) on one side, and the Nanpin River, Nanmao River, and Nanxiban River on the other, until it reaches Sanmianpo (Luosanmeng).

Query_Text_cn: （16）从三面坡起，界线大体向东北，到南览河西岸的一点，然后顺该河而下，到南览河南岸的鸠那山脚，再大体东南行，经过灰令亮（灰莫秋）、拉地、南孟号到麦牛栋，再大体向东北行，穿过龙曼当，到灰腊小河，再沿该河向北行，到该河和南览河汇合处。
Translation: (16) Starting from Sanmianpo, the boundary generally runs northeast to a point on the west bank of the Nanlan River, then follows the river downstream to the foot of Jiuna Mountain on the south bank of the Nanlan River. It then generally heads southeast, passing through Huilingliang (Huimoqiu), Ladi, Nanmenghao to Mainiudong, and then generally runs northeast, crossing Longmandang to the Huila Stream. From there, it follows the stream northward to the confluence of this stream and the Nanlan River.

Query_Text_cn: 然后，界线向东转南沿南览河、南桔河（南舍河）、南甲河（回洒河），到垒连底法山。
Translation: Then, the boundary turns east and then south, following the Nanlan River, Nanjie River (Nanshe River), and Nanjia River (Huisha River), reaching Leilian Difa Mountain.

Query_Text_cn: 然后界线沿南摩特河（南麦河）、南洞河、南达河，到悻岗垒山（马行拱山）。
Translation: Then the boundary follows the Nam Mot River (Nam Mai River), the Nam Dong River, and the Nam Da River to Xingganglei Mountain (Maxinggong Mountain).

Query_Text_cn: （17）从悻岗垒山起，界线向东沿着以南阿河及其上游支系为一方、南洛河（包括其支流南黑河）为另一方的分水岭而行，直到广变乃山顶。
Translation: (17) Starting from Xingganglei Mountain, the boundary runs east along the watershed, with the Nan'a River and its upstream tributaries on one side and the Nanluo River (including its tributary, the Nanhei River) on the other, until it reaches the summit of Guangbiannai Mountain.

Query_Text_cn: （18）从广变乃山顶起，界线大体向东北沿回勒河（南勒河）、过去划定界线时南阿河的河道而行，到南阿河和澜沧江（湄公河）汇合处，即顺澜沧江而下，直到中缅边界东南端终点南腊河和澜沧江汇合处止。
Translation: (18) Starting from Guangbian at the mountain summit, the boundary generally runs northeast along the Huile River (Nanle River) and follows the river course of the Nan'a River as previously delineated, reaching the confluence of the Nan'a River and the Lancang River (Mekong River). From there, it follows the Lancang River downstream until it reaches the southeastern terminus of the China-Myanmar border at the confluence of the Nanla River and the Lancang River.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条所述的两国全部边界线以及双方在联合勘察时所树立的临时分界标志的位置，标明在本条约所附的二十五万分之一的全线图和某些地区的五万分之一的地图上。
Translation: 3. All boundary lines between the two countries described in this Article, as well as the locations of the temporary boundary markers erected by both parties during the joint survey, are indicated on the 1:250,000-scale map of the entire boundary and on the 1:50,000-scale maps of certain areas attached to this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条缔约双方同意，凡是以河流为界的地段，不能通航的河流以河道中心线为界，能够通航的河流以主要航道（水流最深处）的中心线为界，如果界河改道，除双方另有协议外，两国的边界线维持不变。
Translation: Article 8: The contracting parties agree that, for sections where the boundary is defined by a river, the centerline of the river channel shall serve as the boundary for non-navigable rivers, while the centerline of the main navigable channel (the deepest part of the river) shall serve as the boundary for navigable rivers. If a boundary river changes its course, unless otherwise agreed by both parties, the boundary between the two countries shall remain unchanged.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本条约第二条所规定应该移交给缅甸的猛卯三角地，在本条约生效后，即成为缅甸联邦的领土。
Translation: 1. The Namwan Triangle, which is to be transferred to Burma as stipulated in Article II of this Treaty, shall become the territory of the Union of Burma upon the entry into force of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条约第一条所规定应该归还中国的片马、古浪、岗房地区和第二条所规定应该划归中国的班洪、班老辖区，在本条约生效后四个月内，由缅甸政府移交给中国政府。
Translation: 2. The Pianma, Gulang, and Gangfang areas, which should be returned to China as stipulated in Article 1 of this Treaty, and the Banhong and Banlao jurisdictions, which should be assigned to China as stipulated in Article 2, shall be handed over by the Government of Burma to the Government of China within four months after the entry into force of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条约第三条所规定的调整地区，在本条约生效后四个月内，分别由缔约一方政府移交给另一方政府。
Translation: 3. The areas subject to adjustment as stipulated in Article 3 of this Treaty shall be handed over by the government of one contracting party to the government of the other contracting party within four months after the entry into force of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条在本条约签订后，根据一九六○年一月二十八日双方关于两国边界问题的协定成立的中缅边界联合委员会，将继续对两国的边界线进行必要的勘察，树立新界桩和订修、改造旧界桩，然后草拟一项议定书，详细载明整个边界线的走向和全部界桩的位置，并且附入标明界线和界桩位置的详图。
Translation: Article 10: After the signing of this treaty, the China-Myanmar Joint Boundary Commission, established in accordance with the Agreement between the two parties on the boundary issue dated January 28, 1960, shall continue to conduct necessary surveys of the boundary line between the two countries, erect new boundary markers, and repair or modify existing boundary markers. Subsequently, the Commission shall draft a protocol detailing the course of the entire boundary line and the locations of all boundary markers, accompanied by detailed maps indicating the boundary line and the positions of the markers.

Query_Text_cn: 上述议定书经两国政府签订后，即成为本条约的附件，该项详图将代替本条约的附图。
Translation: Once the above protocol is signed by the governments of both countries, it shall become an annex to this treaty, and the detailed map therein shall replace the map attached to this treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 在上述议定书签订后，中缅边界联合委员会的任务即告终止，一九六○年一月二十八日双方关于两国边界问题的协定即行失效。
Translation: After the signing of the above protocol, the mandate of the Sino-Burmese Joint Boundary Commission was terminated, and the agreement between both parties regarding the boundary issues between the two countries, dated January 28, 1960, was rendered invalid.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条缔约双方同意，在两国边界正式划定后，如果发生任何边界争议，应由双方友好协商解决。
Translation: Article 11: Both contracting parties agree that, after the official demarcation of the boundary between the two countries, any border disputes that may arise shall be resolved through friendly consultations between the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条本条约须经批准，批准书应尽速在仰光互换。
Translation: Article 12 This Treaty shall be subject to ratification, and the instruments of ratification shall be exchanged at Yangon as soon as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 本条约自互换批准书之日起生效。
Translation: This treaty shall enter into force on the date of the exchange of instruments of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 在本条约生效后，除一九六○年一月二十八日双方关于两国边界问题的协定在本条约第十条中另有规定外，过去一切有关两国边界的条约、换文和有关文件即行失效。
Translation: After the entry into force of this Treaty, all previous treaties, exchanges of notes, and related documents concerning the boundary between the two countries shall become null and void, except as otherwise provided in Article 10 of this Treaty regarding the Agreement on the Boundary Issue between the two countries dated January 28, 1960.

Query_Text_cn: 本条约于一九六○年十月一日在北京签订，共两份，每份都用中文、缅文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This treaty was signed in Beijing on October 1, 1960, in two copies, each written in Chinese, Burmese, and English, all three texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条本联盟的建立参加本条约的国家（以下称为"缔约国”）组成国际承认用于专利程序的微生物保存联盟。
Translation: Article 1: The Union established by this Treaty shall be composed of the States party to this Treaty (hereinafter referred to as "Contracting States") and shall constitute the International Union for the Recognition of the Deposit of Microorganisms for the Purposes of Patent Procedure.

Query_Text_cn: （ｘｖ）"施行细则”，指第十二条所述的施行细则。
Translation: (xv) "Implementing Rules" refers to the Implementing Rules mentioned in Article 12.

Query_Text_cn: （１）（ａ）缔约国允许或要求保存用于专利程序的微生物的，应承认为此种目的而在任一国际保存单位所做的微生物保存。这种承认由该国际保存单位说明的保存事实和交存日期，以及承认提供的样品是所保存的微生物样品。
Translation: (1)(a) Where a Contracting Party permits or requires the deposit of microorganisms for the purposes of patent procedures, it shall recognize the deposit of a microorganism made for such purposes at any international depositary authority. Such recognition shall be based on the statements by the international depositary authority regarding the fact and date of the deposit, and on the assurance that the samples provided are samples of the deposited microorganism.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）任一缔约国均可索取由国际保存单位发出的（ａ）项所述保存的存单副本。
Translation: (b) Any Contracting Party may request a copy of the certificate of deposit issued by the international depository referred to in item (a).

Query_Text_cn: （２）就本条约和施行细则所规定的事务而言，任何缔约国均无需遵守和本条约及施行细则的规定不同的或另外的要求。
Translation: (2) With respect to matters governed by this Treaty and its Regulations, no Contracting State shall be required to comply with requirements that are different from or additional to those provided in this Treaty and its Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: （ｉ）这种微生物不能存活时，或（ｉｉ）提供的样品需要送出国外，而因出境或入境限制向国外送出或在国外接受该样品有阻碍时，该单位在注意到它不可能提供样品后，应立即将这种不可能情况通知交存人，并说明其原因，除第（２）款另有规定应适用该规定外，根据本款规定，交存人享有将原来保存的微生物重新提交保存的权力。
Translation: (i) When such microorganism cannot survive, or (ii) when the provided sample needs to be sent abroad but there are obstacles to sending or receiving the sample abroad due to export or import restrictions, the institution shall, upon becoming aware that it is unable to provide the sample, immediately notify the depositor of this impossibility and state the reasons. Except as otherwise provided in paragraph (2), which shall prevail, the depositor shall have the right to make a new deposit of the originally preserved microorganism in accordance with the provisions of this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: （ｉｉ）在（ａ）项第（ｉｉ）目所述情况下，可同另一国际保存单位保存。
Translation: (ii) In the case referred to in subparagraph (a)(ii), it may be deposited with another international depository authority.

Query_Text_cn: （ｃ）任一重新保存均应附具有交存人签字的文件，声明重新提交保存的微生物与原来保存的微生物相同。如果对交存人的声明有争议时，应根据适用的法律确定举证责任。
Translation: (c) Any resubmission must be accompanied by a document signed by the depositor, declaring that the resubmitted microorganism is identical to the originally deposited microorganism. In the event of a dispute regarding the depositor's declaration, the burden of proof shall be determined in accordance with applicable law.

Query_Text_cn: （ｄ）除（ａ）项至（ｃ）项和（ｅ）项另有规定应适用各该规定外，如果涉及原保存微生物存活能力的所有文件都表明该微生物是能存活的，而且交存人是在收到（ａ）项所述通知之日起三个月内重新保存的，该重新保存的微生物应视为在原保存日提出。
Translation: (d) Except as otherwise provided in items (a) to (c) and (e), if all documents relating to the viability of the originally deposited microorganism indicate that the microorganism is viable, and the depositor makes a new deposit within three months from the date of receipt of the notification referred to in item (a), the new deposit shall be deemed to have been made on the date of the original deposit.

Query_Text_cn: （ｅ）如果属于（ｂ）项第（ｉ）目所述情况，但在国际局将（ｂ）项第（ｉ）目所述丧失或限制国际保存单位资格或停止保存公告之日起六个月内，交存人仍未收到（ａ）项所述通知时，则（ｄ）项所述的三个月期限应自上述公告之日起算。
Translation: (e) If the situation described in item (i) of paragraph (b) applies, but the depositor has not received the notice referred to in paragraph (a) within six months from the date on which the International Bureau announces the loss or limitation of the status of international depository authority or the cessation of acceptance as described in item (i) of paragraph (b), the three-month period referred to in paragraph (d) shall be counted from the date of the aforementioned announcement.

Query_Text_cn: （２）如果保存的微生物已经移交另一国际保存单位，只要另一国际保存单位能够提供这种微生物样品，第（１）款（ａ）项所述的权利即不存在。
Translation: (2) If the deposited microorganism has already been transferred to another international depositary authority, the right referred to in paragraph (1)(a) shall cease to exist, provided that the other international depositary authority is able to supply samples of the microorganism.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条输出入限制各缔约国公认以下规定是十分合乎需要的，即如某些种类微生物自其领土输出或向其领土输入受到限制时，只有在对国家安全或对健康或环境有危险而需要进行限制的情况下，这样的限制才适用于根据本条约保存或将要保存的微生物。
Translation:
Article 5: Export and Import Restrictions

The Contracting Parties recognize that it is highly necessary that, if the export from or import into their territories of certain types of microorganisms is subject to restrictions, such restrictions shall apply to microorganisms preserved or to be preserved under this Treaty only when such restrictions are required for reasons of national security or to prevent risks to health or the environment.

Query_Text_cn: （１）任何保存机构如要具备国际保存单位的资格，必须是设在缔约国领土上的，而且必须由该国做出该保存机构符合并将继续符合第（２）款所列各项要求条件的保证。
Translation: (1) For any depository institution to qualify as an international depository authority, it must be located within the territory of a contracting state, and that state must provide assurances that the institution meets, and will continue to meet, all the requirements set forth in paragraph (2).

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，该保存机构必须设在该组织的成员国领土上。
Translation: In this case, the depository must be established within the territory of a member state of the organization.

Query_Text_cn: （ｖｉｉｉ）按照施行细则规定的条件和手续提供所保存的任何微生物的样品。
Translation: (viii) Provide samples of any preserved microorganisms in accordance with the conditions and procedures stipulated in the implementing rules.

Query_Text_cn: （ｉｉ）当终止或限制一个国际保存单位的国际保存单位资格时。
Translation: (ii) When terminating or restricting the status of an international conservation unit as an international conservation unit.

Query_Text_cn: （１）（ａ）通过保存机构所在的缔约国递交总干事的书面通知，包括一件声明保证该机构符合并将继续符合第六条第（２）款规定的各项要求，该保存机构即可取得国际保存单位资格。也可通过政府间工业产权组织递交总干事的书面通知，其中包括上述声明，取得上述资格。
Translation: (1)(a) An international depository authority status may be acquired by submitting to the Director General a written notification from the Contracting State in which the institution is located, including a declaration assuring that the institution complies with and will continue to comply with all the requirements set forth in Article 6(2). Such status may also be acquired by submitting to the Director General a written notification from an intergovernmental industrial property organization, which includes the aforementioned declaration.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）上述通知还应包括按照施行细则规定需提供的关于该保存机构的情报，并可写明自何日起国际保存单位资格开始生效。
Translation: (b) The above notification shall also include information regarding the depository institution as required by the implementing regulations, and may specify the date from which the status of international depository authority becomes effective.

Query_Text_cn: （２）（ａ）如果总干事确认该通知包括了所要求的声明，并且收到了所要求的全部情报，国际局应将该通知立即予以公布。
Translation: (2)(a) If the Director General confirms that the notification includes the required declaration and has received all the requested information, the International Bureau shall immediately publish the notification.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）国际保存单位资格自该通知公布之日起取得，或者，如果根据第（１）款（ｂ）项表明了某一日期，而此日期迟于该通知的公布日，则自此日期起取得资格。
Translation: (b) The qualification as an international conservation unit shall be obtained from the date of publication of the notice, or, if a date is specified pursuant to subparagraph (1)(b) and such date is later than the date of publication of the notice, the qualification shall be obtained from that specified date.

Query_Text_cn: （３）第（１）款和第（２）款规定的手续细节应在施行细则中规定。
Translation: (3) The detailed procedures stipulated in paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be specified in the implementing rules.

Query_Text_cn: （１）（ａ）任何缔约国或任何政府间工业产权组织均可以按第六条规定的各项要求没有得到或不再得到满足为理由，请求大会终止任何保存单位的国际保存单位资格，或将其资格限制在某些微生物种类之内。但是一个缔约国或政府间工业产权组织曾为一国际保存单位做出第七条第（１）款（ａ）项所述保证的，该缔约国或政府间工业产权组织不得就该国际保存单位提出这种请求。
Translation: (1)(a) Any Contracting Party or any intergovernmental industrial property organization may request the Assembly to terminate the status of any depository institution as an international depository authority, or to restrict its status to certain kinds of microorganisms, on the grounds that the requirements specified in Article 6 are not or are no longer being fulfilled. However, if a Contracting Party or intergovernmental industrial property organization has given the assurance referred to in Article 7(1)(a) for an international depository authority, such Contracting Party or intergovernmental industrial property organization may not make such a request with respect to that international depository authority.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）在按照（ａ）项提出请求之前，该缔约国或政府间工业产权组织应通过总干事把即将提出请求的理由告知递交了第七条第（１）款所述通知的缔约国或政府间工业产权组织，以便该国或该组织自接到通知之日起六个月内采取适当行动排除提出该请求的需要。
Translation: (b) Before making a request under item (a), the Contracting Party or intergovernmental industrial property organization shall, through the Director General, inform the Contracting Party or intergovernmental industrial property organization that has submitted the notification referred to in Article 7(1) of the reasons for the impending request, so that the said Party or organization may take appropriate action within six months from the date of receipt of the notification to eliminate the need for making such a request.

Query_Text_cn: （ｃ）如果大会确认该请求有充分的依据时，则应决定终止（ａ）项中所述单位的国际保存单位资格，或限制其保存的微生物种类。大会的这种决定需要以三分之二多数的赞成票通过。
Translation: (c) If the General Assembly confirms that the request is well-founded, it shall decide to terminate the status of the international depository authority of the entity referred to in item (a), or to restrict the types of microorganisms it is authorized to preserve. Such a decision by the General Assembly shall require a two-thirds majority vote in favor.

Query_Text_cn: （２）（ａ）曾做出第七条第（１）款（ａ）项所述声明的缔约国或政府间工业产权组织可以向总干事发出通知，全部地或只就某些种类微生物撤回其声明，而当其做出的保证不再适用时，无论如何都应就其不适用的范围撤回其声明。
Translation: (2)(a) A Contracting State or an intergovernmental industrial property organization that has made the declaration referred to in Article 7(1)(a) may notify the Director General to withdraw its declaration, either in whole or with respect to certain kinds of microorganisms only, and in any event shall withdraw its declaration to the extent that the assurances it has given are no longer applicable.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）自施行细则规定的日期起，如果该通知关系到整个声明，则使该国际保存单位资格停止，或者，如果只关系到某些种类微生物，则使这种资格受到相应限制。
Translation: (b) From the date specified in the implementing rules, if the notice concerns the entire declaration, the status of the international depository authority shall be terminated; or, if it concerns only certain kinds of microorganisms, such status shall be correspondingly restricted.

Query_Text_cn: （３）第（１）款和第（２）款规定的手续细节应在施行细则中规定。
Translation: (3) The detailed procedures stipulated in paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be specified in the implementing rules.

Query_Text_cn: （１）（ａ）受若干国家委托以批准地区专利而其成员国都是保护工业产权国际（巴黎）联盟成员国的任何政府间组织，均可以向总干事递交一份声明，表明其承担第三条第（１）款（ａ）项所规定的承认义务，承担第三条第（２）款所述要求的义务，并接受本条约和施行细则适用于政府间工业产权组织的各种规定的全部效力。如果是在本条约根据第十六条第（１）款生效之前递交的，则前一句中所述声明，自条约生效之日起生效。如果是在条约生效之后递交的，所述声明应自递交三个月之后生效，除非在声明中指定了较迟的日期。在后一种情况下，该声明应自该指定日期生效。
Translation: (1)(a) Any intergovernmental organization, entrusted by several countries with the authority to grant regional patents and whose member states are all members of the International Union for the Protection of Industrial Property (Paris Union), may submit a declaration to the Director General, indicating that it undertakes the obligation of recognition as stipulated in Article 3(1)(a), undertakes the obligations required under Article 3(2), and accepts the full effect of all provisions of this Treaty and the Regulations applicable to intergovernmental organizations concerned with industrial property. If such a declaration is submitted before the entry into force of this Treaty pursuant to Article 16(1), it shall take effect from the date of entry into force of the Treaty. If the declaration is submitted after the entry into force of the Treaty, it shall take effect three months after its submission, unless a later date is specified in the declaration. In the latter case, the declaration shall take effect from the specified date.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）所述组织应享有第三条第（１）款（ｂ）项所规定的权利。
Translation: The organization referred to in (b) shall enjoy the rights specified in Article 3, paragraph (1)(b).

Query_Text_cn: （２）如果本条约或施行细则有关政府间工业产权组织的任何规定经修订或修正时，任何政府间工业产权组织均可以向总干事发出通知撤回其按第（１）款中所述的声明。
Translation: (2) If any provision of this Treaty or the Regulations concerning intergovernmental organizations for industrial property is amended or revised, any such intergovernmental organization may notify the Director General of its withdrawal of the declaration referred to in paragraph (1).

Query_Text_cn: （ｉｉ）如果通知是在第（ｉ）目所述日期以后收到的，自通知指定日期起，或者没有做出这种指定时，自收到通知之日后三个月起。
Translation: (ii) If the notice is received after the date specified in item (i), the period shall commence from the date specified in the notice, or, if no such date is specified, three months after the date of receipt of the notice.

Query_Text_cn: （３）除第（２）款所述情况外，任何政府间工业产权组织还可以向总干事发出通知撤回其按第（１）款（ａ）项所述声明。撤回应自总干事收到该通知之日两年后生效。在该声明生效之日起五年期间不接受根据本款提出的撤回通知。
Translation: (3) Except as provided in paragraph (2), any intergovernmental organization for industrial property may notify the Director General of its withdrawal of the declaration made under item (a) of paragraph (1). Such withdrawal shall take effect two years after the date on which the Director General receives the notification. No notification of withdrawal under this paragraph shall be accepted within five years from the date on which the declaration takes effect.

Query_Text_cn: （４）一个政府间工业产权组织根据第七条第（１）款发出的通知使得一个保存机构取得国际保存单位资格的，该政府间工业产权组织所发的按第（２）款或第（３）款所述撤回，应在总干事收到该撤回通知之日起一年后终止这种资格。
Translation: (4) If an intergovernmental industrial property organization issues a notification under Article 7(1) that enables a depository institution to acquire the status of an international depository authority, the withdrawal issued by that intergovernmental industrial property organization as described in paragraph (2) or (3) shall terminate such status one year after the date on which the Director General receives the withdrawal notification.

Query_Text_cn: （５）第（１）款（ａ）项所述声明，第（２）款或第（３）款所述撤回通知，根据第七条第（１）款（ａ）项发出的声明，包括根据第六条第（１）款第２句做出的保证，根据第八条第（１）款提出的请求，以及第八条第（２）款所述撤回通知，均应要求得到该政府间工业产权组织的上级机关明确认可，该上级机关成员国应全部是该组织成员国，并且决定是由这些国家政府的正式代表做出的。
Translation: (5) The declaration referred to in Article (1)(a), the notice of withdrawal referred to in Article (2) or (3), the declaration made under Article 7(1)(a), including the assurance given pursuant to the second sentence of Article 6(1), the request made under Article 8(1), and the notice of withdrawal referred to in Article 8(2), shall all require the explicit approval of the superior body of the said intergovernmental organization for industrial property. All member states of this superior body must be member states of the organization, and decisions shall be made by the official representatives of the governments of these states.

Query_Text_cn: （１）（ａ）大会应由缔约国组成。
Translation: (1)(a) The Conference shall be composed of the States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）每一缔约国应有一名代表，可辅以副代表、顾问和专家。
Translation: (b) Each Contracting Party shall have one representative, who may be accompanied by deputy representatives, advisers, and experts.

Query_Text_cn: （ｃ）各政府间工业产权组织在大会以及由大会建立的各委员会和工作组的会议上应由特别观察员代表。
Translation: (c) Intergovernmental industrial property organizations shall be represented by special observers at the meetings of the Assembly and at meetings of committees and working groups established by the Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: （ｄ）任何本组织成员或保护工业产权国际（巴黎）联盟成员而非本联盟成员的国家以及除第二条第（ｖ）项定义的政府间工业产权组织之外的专门从事专利方面事务的任何政府间组织，在大会的会议上，如经大会决定，在大会建立的各委员会和工作组的会议上，都可由观察员出席。
Translation: (d) Any member of this Organization or any country that is a member of the International (Paris) Union for the Protection of Industrial Property but not a member of this Union, as well as any intergovernmental organization specializing in patent matters other than the intergovernmental industrial property organizations defined in Article 2(v), may attend meetings of the Assembly as observers, and, if so decided by the Assembly, may also attend meetings of committees and working groups established by the Assembly as observers.

Query_Text_cn: （ｖｉｉｉ）履行按照本条约是适当的其他职责。
Translation: (viii) To perform such other duties as are appropriate in accordance with this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: （３）一个代表只可以代表一个国家，并以该国的名义投票。
Translation: (3) Each representative may represent only one country and vote in the name of that country.

Query_Text_cn: （４）每一缔约国应有一票表决权。
Translation: (4) Each contracting party shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: （５）（ａ）缔约国的半数构成开会的法定人数。
Translation: (5)(a) A quorum for a meeting shall consist of half of the States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）不足法定人数时，大会可以做出决议，但除有关其本身程序的决议外，所有这类决议都应按照施行细则规定以通信投票方式取得法定人数及所需的多数票之后才生效。
Translation: (b) When a quorum is not present, the General Assembly may adopt resolutions, but except for resolutions concerning its own procedures, all such resolutions shall become effective only after a quorum and the required majority have been obtained through a postal vote in accordance with the rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: （６）（ａ）除第八条第（１）款（ｃ）项、第十二条第（４）款和第十四条第（２）款（ｂ）项另有规定应适用该规定外，大会的决定需有所投票数的多数票。
Translation: (6)(a) Except as otherwise provided in Article 8(1)(c), Article 12(4), and Article 14(2)(b), decisions of the General Assembly shall require a majority of the votes cast.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）弃权不应认为是投票。
Translation: (b) Abstention shall not be considered as a vote.

Query_Text_cn: （７）（ａ）大会每三历年由总干事召集一次通常会议，最好与本组织的大会在同时同地举行。
Translation: (7)(a) The General Conference shall be convened in ordinary session by the Director-General once every three calendar years, preferably at the same time and place as the General Conference of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）经总干事主动发起或应四分之一缔约国要求，应由总干事召集大会临时会议。
Translation: (b) The Director-General shall convene a special session of the Assembly either on his own initiative or at the request of one-quarter of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: （８）大会应通过其自身的议事规程。
Translation: (8) The General Assembly shall adopt its own rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: （ｉｉ）为修订会议、大会、大会建立的委员会和工作组以及由总干事召集的处理本联盟有关事务的任何其它会议设立秘书处。
Translation: (ii) To establish a secretariat for revision conferences, assemblies, committees and working groups established by the assembly, as well as any other meetings convened by the Director General to address matters concerning the Union.

Query_Text_cn: （２）总干事为本联盟的最高行政官员，并代表本联盟。
