Translation: (2) The Director-General is the chief administrative officer of the Alliance and represents the Alliance.

Query_Text_cn: （３）总干事应召集有关处理本联盟事务的一切会议。
Translation: (3) The Director-General shall convene all meetings related to the handling of the affairs of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: （４）（ａ）总干事及其指定的职员应参加大会和由大会建立的委员会和工作组的所有会议，以及由总干事召集的有关处理本联盟事务的任何其它会议，但无表决权。
Translation: (4)(a) The Director General and staff designated by him shall participate in all meetings of the General Assembly, committees, and working groups established by the General Assembly, as well as any other meetings convened by the Director General concerning the affairs of the Union, but shall have no voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）总干事，或由其指定的职员，应作为大会、各委员会、各工作组以及（ａ）项所述其它会议的当然秘书。
Translation: (b) The Director-General, or a staff member designated by him, shall serve ex officio as the Secretary of the General Conference, its committees, its working groups, and other meetings referred to in paragraph (a).

Query_Text_cn: （５）（ａ）总干事应遵照大会的指示为修订会议进行筹备。
Translation: (5)(a) The Director-General shall make preparations for the revision conference in accordance with the instructions of the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）总干事可以就修订会议的筹备工作与政府间组织和非政府间国际组织进行磋商。
Translation: (b) The Director-General may consult with intergovernmental organizations and international non-governmental organizations regarding the preparations for the revision conference.

Query_Text_cn: （ｃ）总干事及其指定人员应参加修订会议的讨论，但无表决权。
Translation: (c) The Director-General and his designated personnel shall participate in the discussions of the revision meetings, but shall have no voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: （ｄ）总干事，或其指定的职员，应作为任何修订会议的当然秘书。
Translation: (d) The Director-General, or a staff member designated by him, shall serve as the ex officio secretary of any revision meeting.

Query_Text_cn: （ｉｉｉ）对执行本条约有用的任何细节。
Translation: (iii) Any details useful for the implementation of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: （２）与本条约同时通过的施行细则作为附件附在本条约之后。
Translation: (2) The implementing rules adopted concurrently with this treaty are attached as an annex to this treaty.

Query_Text_cn: （３）大会可以修订施行细则。
Translation: (3) The General Assembly may amend the implementing rules.

Query_Text_cn: （４）（ａ）除（ｂ）项另有规定应适用该规定外，对本施行细则的任何修正需有所投票数的三分之二票。
Translation: (4)(a) Except as otherwise provided in item (b), any amendment to these implementing rules shall require a two-thirds majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）有关由国际保存单位提供所保存的微生物样品规定的任何修正，在没有任何缔约国投票反对该修正提案的情况下才能通过。
Translation: (b) Any amendment to the provisions concerning the preservation of microbial samples provided by the International Depositary Authority shall only be adopted if no Contracting Party votes against the proposed amendment.

Query_Text_cn: （５）在本条约与施行细则的规定发生抵触时，以本条约的规定为准。
Translation: (5) In the event of any conflict between the provisions of this Treaty and its implementing rules, the provisions of this Treaty shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: （１）本条约可以由缔约国参加的会议随时修订。
Translation: This treaty may be amended at any time by a meeting of the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: （２）修订会议的召集均应由大会决定。
Translation: (2) The convening of revision conferences shall be decided by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: （３）第十条和第十一条可以由修订会议或按照第十四条的规定进行修正。
Translation: (3) Articles 10 and 11 may be amended by a revision conference or in accordance with the provisions of Article 14.

Query_Text_cn: （１）（ａ）根据本条约提出修正第十条和第十一条的提案，可以由任何缔约国或由总干事提出。
Translation: (1)(a) Proposals to amend Articles 10 and 11 under this Treaty may be submitted by any Contracting Party or by the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）这些提案应在提供大会对其审议之前至少六个月，由总干事预先通知各缔约国。
Translation: (b) These proposals shall be communicated by the Director-General to all Contracting Parties at least six months in advance before being submitted to the Conference for its consideration.

Query_Text_cn: （２）（ａ）对第（１）款所述各条的修正应由大会通过。
Translation: (2)(a) Amendments to the articles referred to in paragraph (1) shall be adopted by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 对第十一条的任何修正需有所投票数的四分之三票。
Translation: Any amendment to Article 11 requires a three-fourths majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: （３）（ａ）对第（１）款所述各条的修正，应在总干事收到大会通过该修正时四分之三的成员国依照各自的宪法程序表示接受该修正的书面通知起一个月后生效。
Translation: (3)(a) Amendments to the articles referred to in paragraph (1) shall enter into force one month after the Director-General receives written notifications from three-fourths of the Member States, indicating their acceptance of the amendment in accordance with their respective constitutional procedures, following the adoption of the amendment by the General Conference.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）对上述各条的任何修正，一经接受后，对于在该修正案经大会通过时是缔约国的所有缔约国都有约束力，但对上述缔约国产生财政义务或增加这种义务的任何修正仅对通知接受这种修正的国家有约束力。
Translation: (b) Any amendment to the above articles, once accepted, shall be binding upon all Contracting Parties that are Parties at the time the amendment is adopted by the Conference. However, any amendment that imposes or increases financial obligations on the aforementioned Contracting Parties shall be binding only upon those countries that have notified their acceptance of such amendment.

Query_Text_cn: （ｃ）根据（ａ）项规定接受并生效的任何修正对在大会通过该修正案后成为缔约国的所有国家均有约束力。
Translation: (c) Any amendment accepted and entered into force in accordance with paragraph (a) shall be binding on all States that become Parties after the adoption of the amendment by the Conference.

Query_Text_cn: （ｉ）签字后递交批准书。（ｉｉ）递交加入书。
Translation:
(i) Submit the instrument of ratification after signing.  
(ii) Submit the instrument of accession.

Query_Text_cn: （２）批准书或加入书应交总干事保存。
Translation: (2) Instruments of ratification or accession shall be deposited with the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: （１）对于最早递交批准书或加入书的五个国家，本条约应自递交第五份批准书或加入书之日后三个月开始生效。
Translation: (1) For the first five countries that submit their instruments of ratification or accession, this treaty shall enter into force three months after the date of deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification or accession.

Query_Text_cn: （２）对于任何其它国家，除非在其批准书或加入书中指定以后的日期，本条约应自该国递交其批准书或加入书之日三个月后开始生效。在指定日期的情况下，本条约应在该国指定的日期开始生效。
Translation: (2) For any other country, unless a later date is specified in its instrument of ratification or accession, this Treaty shall enter into force for that country three months after the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification or accession. In the case where a date is specified, the Treaty shall enter into force for that country on the specified date.

Query_Text_cn: （１）任何缔约国均可通知总干事退出本条约。
Translation: (1) Any Contracting Party may notify the Director-General of its withdrawal from this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: （２）自总干事收到退出通知之日起两年后，退出发生效力。
Translation: (2) Withdrawal shall take effect two years after the date on which the Director-General receives the notice of withdrawal.

Query_Text_cn: （３）任何缔约国在其成为本条约缔约国之日起五年届满以前，不得行使第（１）款规定的退约权利。
Translation: (3) No State Party may exercise the right of withdrawal provided for in paragraph (1) of this Article before the expiration of five years from the date on which it became a Party to this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: （４）一个缔约国曾对于一保存机构发出第七条第（１）款（ａ）项所述声明因而使该保存机构取得国际保存单位资格的，该国退出本条约应使这种资格在总干事收到第（１）款所述通知之日起一年后终止。
Translation: (4) If a Contracting State has issued a declaration to a depositary institution as referred to in Article 7(1)(a), thereby conferring upon that institution the status of an international depositary authority, the withdrawal of that State from this Treaty shall result in the termination of such status one year after the Director General receives the notification referred to in paragraph (1).

Query_Text_cn: （１）（ａ）本条约应在一份用英语和法语两种语言写成的条约原本上签字，两种文本均为同等的正本。
Translation: (1)(a) This treaty shall be signed on a single original in both the English and French languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: （ｂ）总干事在与有关政府协商后，并在本条约签字日起两个月内用建立世界知识产权组织公约签字时所用的其它语言制定本条约的正式文本。
Translation: (b) After consulting with the relevant governments, the Director General shall, within two months from the date of signature of this Treaty, establish official texts of this Treaty in the other languages used for the signing of the Convention Establishing the World Intellectual Property Organization.

Query_Text_cn: （ｃ）总干事在与有关政府协商后，应用阿拉伯语、德语、意大利语、日语和葡萄牙语以及大会指定的其他语言制定本条约的正式文本。
Translation: (c) After consultation with the relevant governments, the Director-General shall prepare official texts of this Treaty in Arabic, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, and such other languages as may be designated by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: （２）本条约在布达佩斯开放签字至一九七七年十二月三十一日截止。
Translation: (2) This Treaty shall be open for signature in Budapest until December 31, 1977.

Query_Text_cn: （１）本条约签字截止后，其原本应由总干事保存。
Translation: After the deadline for signing this treaty, the original document shall be kept by the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: （２）总干事应将经其证明的本条约和施行细则文本二份送交第十五条第（１）款所述所有国家的政府，送交可能按照第九条第（１）款（ａ）项递交声明的政府间组织，并根据请求，送交任何其他国家政府。
Translation: (2) The Director General shall transmit two copies of the texts of this Treaty and the Regulations, as certified by him, to the governments of all countries referred to in Article 15(1), to any intergovernmental organization that may submit a declaration pursuant to Article 9(1)(a), and, upon request, to the government of any other country.

Query_Text_cn: （３）总干事应将本条约向联合国秘书处登记。
Translation: The Director-General shall register this Convention with the Secretariat of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: （４）总干事应将经其证明的对本条约和施行细则的修正条款文本二份送交所有缔约国、所有政府间工业产权组织，并根据请求送交任何其它国家政府和按照第九条第（１）款（ａ）项递交声明的任何其它政府间组织。
Translation: (4) The Director General shall transmit two copies of the text of any amendment to this Treaty and the Regulations, certified by him, to all Contracting States, all intergovernmental organizations concerned with industrial property, and, upon request, to any other national government and any other intergovernmental organization which has submitted a declaration under Article 9(1)(a).

Query_Text_cn: （ｉｘ）按照第十七条收到的退约通知。
Translation: (ix) Notice of withdrawal received in accordance with Article 17.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条宗旨本公约的宗旨是促进、保护和确保所有残疾人充分和平等地享有一切人权和基本自由，并促进对残疾人固有尊严的尊重。
Translation:
Article 1 - Purpose

The purpose of this Convention is to promote, protect and ensure the full and equal enjoyment of all human rights and fundamental freedoms by all persons with disabilities, and to promote respect for their inherent dignity.

Query_Text_cn: 残疾人包括肢体、精神、智力或感官有长期损伤的人，这些损伤与各种障碍相互作用，可能阻碍残疾人在与他人平等的基础上充分和切实地参与社会。
Translation: Persons with disabilities include those who have long-term physical, mental, intellectual, or sensory impairments which, in interaction with various barriers, may hinder their full and effective participation in society on an equal basis with others.

Query_Text_cn: “基于残疾的歧视”是指基于残疾而作出的任何区别、排斥或限制，其目的或效果是在政治、经济、社会、文化、公民或任何其他领域，损害或取消在与其他人平等的基础上，对一切人权和基本自由的认可、享有或行使。
Translation: "Discrimination on the basis of disability" refers to any distinction, exclusion, or restriction based on disability, the purpose or effect of which is to impair or nullify the recognition, enjoyment, or exercise, on an equal basis with others, of all human rights and fundamental freedoms in political, economic, social, cultural, civil, or any other field.

Query_Text_cn: “通用设计”是指尽最大可能让所有人可以使用，无需作出调整或特别设计的产品、环境、方案和服务设计。
Translation: "Universal design" refers to the design of products, environments, programs, and services to be usable by all people to the greatest extent possible, without the need for adaptation or specialized design.

Query_Text_cn: “通用设计”不排除在必要时为某些残疾人群体提供辅助用具。
Translation: "Universal design" does not preclude the provision of assistive devices for certain groups of persons with disabilities when necessary.

Query_Text_cn: （八）尊重残疾儿童逐渐发展的能力并尊重残疾儿童保持其身份特性的权利。
Translation: (viii) Respect the evolving capacities of children with disabilities and their right to preserve their identity.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国承诺确保并促进充分实现所有残疾人的一切人权和基本自由，使其不受任何基于残疾的歧视。
Translation: 1. The States Parties undertake to ensure and promote the full realization of all human rights and fundamental freedoms for all persons with disabilities, without discrimination of any kind on the basis of disability.

Query_Text_cn: （九）促进培训协助残疾人的专业人员和工作人员，使他们了解本公约确认的权利，以便更好地提供这些权利所保障的协助和服务。
Translation: (ix) Promote the training of professionals and staff who assist persons with disabilities, enabling them to understand the rights recognized in this Convention so as to better provide the assistance and services guaranteed by these rights.

Query_Text_cn: 二、关于经济、社会和文化权利，各缔约国承诺尽量利用现有资源并于必要时在国际合作框架内采取措施，以期逐步充分实现这些权利，但不妨碍本公约中依国际法立即适用的义务。
Translation: 2. With regard to economic, social, and cultural rights, each State Party undertakes to take steps, to the maximum of its available resources and, where necessary, within the framework of international cooperation, with a view to achieving progressively the full realization of these rights, but without prejudice to those obligations under the present Covenant that are immediately applicable according to international law.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国应当在为实施本公约而拟订和施行立法和政策时以及在涉及残疾人问题的其他决策过程中，通过代表残疾人的组织，与残疾人，包括残疾儿童，密切协商，使他们积极参与。
Translation: 3. In preparing and implementing legislation and policies to give effect to this Convention, as well as in other decision-making processes concerning issues related to persons with disabilities, States Parties shall closely consult with and actively involve persons with disabilities, including children with disabilities, through organizations representing them.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本公约的规定不影响任何缔约国法律或对该缔约国生效的国际法中任何更有利于实现残疾人权利的规定。
Translation: 4. The provisions of this Convention shall not affect any provisions in the laws of a State Party or in international law applicable to that State Party that are more conducive to the realization of the rights of persons with disabilities.

Query_Text_cn: 对于根据法律、公约、法规或习惯而在本公约任何缔约国内获得承认或存在的任何人权和基本自由，不得以本公约未予承认或未予充分承认这些权利或自由为借口而加以限制或减损。
Translation: No restriction or derogation of any human rights and fundamental freedoms recognized or existing in any Contracting State pursuant to law, conventions, regulations, or custom shall be permitted on the pretext that such rights or freedoms are not recognized or are not sufficiently recognized in this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 五、本公约的规定应当无任何限制或例外地适用于联邦制国家各组成部分。
Translation: 5. The provisions of this Convention shall apply without any limitation or exception to all constituent parts of federal states.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国确认，在法律面前，人人平等，有权不受任何歧视地享有法律给予的平等保护和平等权益。
Translation: 1. The States Parties affirm that all persons are equal before the law and are entitled, without any discrimination, to equal protection and equal rights under the law.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国应当禁止一切基于残疾的歧视，保证残疾人获得平等和有效的法律保护，使其不受基于任何原因的歧视。
Translation: 2. States Parties shall prohibit all discrimination on the basis of disability and ensure that persons with disabilities receive equal and effective legal protection against discrimination on any ground.

Query_Text_cn: 三、为促进平等和消除歧视，缔约国应当采取一切适当步骤，确保提供合理便利。
Translation: 3. In order to promote equality and eliminate discrimination, States Parties shall take all appropriate measures to ensure the provision of reasonable accommodation.

Query_Text_cn: 四、为加速或实现残疾人事实上的平等而必须采取的具体措施，不得视为本公约所指的歧视。
Translation: 4. Specific measures that must be taken to accelerate or achieve de facto equality for persons with disabilities shall not be considered discrimination as defined by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国确认残疾妇女和残疾女孩受到多重歧视，在这方面，应当采取措施，确保她们充分和平等地享有一切人权和基本自由。
Translation: 1. States Parties recognize that women and girls with disabilities are subject to multiple forms of discrimination and shall take measures to ensure that they fully and equally enjoy all human rights and fundamental freedoms.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国应当采取一切适当措施，确保妇女充分发展，地位得到提高，能力得到增强，目的是保证妇女能行使和享有本公约所规定的人权和基本自由。
Translation: 2. States Parties shall take all appropriate measures to ensure the full development, advancement, and empowerment of women, with the aim of guaranteeing that women can exercise and enjoy the human rights and fundamental freedoms set forth in this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国应当采取一切必要措施，确保残疾儿童在与其他儿童平等的基础上，充分享有一切人权和基本自由。
Translation: 1. States Parties shall take all necessary measures to ensure that children with disabilities fully enjoy all human rights and fundamental freedoms on an equal basis with other children.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在一切关于残疾儿童的行动中，应当以儿童的最佳利益为一项首要考虑。
Translation: 2. In all actions concerning children with disabilities, the best interests of the child shall be a primary consideration.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国应当确保，残疾儿童有权在与其他儿童平等的基础上，就一切影响本人的事项自由表达意见，并获得适合其残疾状况和年龄的辅助手段以实现这项权利，残疾儿童的意见应当按其年龄和成熟程度适当予以考虑。
Translation: 3. States Parties shall ensure that children with disabilities have the right to freely express their views on all matters affecting them on an equal basis with other children, and are provided with assistance appropriate to their disability and age to realize this right. The views of children with disabilities shall be given due weight in accordance with their age and maturity.

Query_Text_cn: （三）提高对残疾人的能力和贡献的认识。
Translation: (3) Enhance awareness of the abilities and contributions of persons with disabilities.

Query_Text_cn: （四）推行了解残疾人和残疾人权利的培训方案。
Translation: (iv) Implement training programs to raise awareness about persons with disabilities and their rights.

Query_Text_cn: 一、为了使残疾人能够独立生活和充分参与生活的各个方面，缔约国应当采取适当措施，确保残疾人在与其他人平等的基础上，无障碍地进出物质环境，使用交通工具，利用信息和通信，包括信息和通信技术和系统，以及享用在城市和农村地区向公众开放或提供的其他设施和服务。
Translation: 1. In order to enable persons with disabilities to live independently and participate fully in all aspects of life, States Parties shall take appropriate measures to ensure that persons with disabilities have access, on an equal basis with others, to the physical environment, transportation, information and communications, including information and communications technologies and systems, and other facilities and services open or provided to the public, both in urban and rural areas.

Query_Text_cn: （二）信息、通信和其他服务，包括电子服务和应急服务。
Translation: (2) Information, communication, and other services, including electronic services and emergency services.

Query_Text_cn: （八）促进在早期阶段设计、开发、生产、推行无障碍信息和通信技术和系统，以便能以最低成本使这些技术和系统无障碍。
Translation: (viii) Promote the design, development, production, and implementation of accessible information and communication technologies and systems at an early stage, so that accessibility can be achieved at minimal cost.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条生命权缔约国重申人人享有固有的生命权，并应当采取一切必要措施，确保残疾人在与其他人平等的基础上切实享有这一权利。
Translation:
Article 10 Right to Life

States Parties reaffirm that every human being has the inherent right to life and shall take all necessary measures to ensure that persons with disabilities are effectively able to enjoy this right on an equal basis with others.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条危难情况和人道主义紧急情况缔约国应当依照国际法包括国际人道主义法和国际人权法规定的义务，采取一切必要措施，确保在危难情况下，包括在发生武装冲突、人道主义紧急情况和自然灾害时，残疾人获得保护和安全。
Translation:
Article 11 Situations of Risk and Humanitarian Emergencies

States Parties shall take, in accordance with their obligations under international law, including international humanitarian law and international human rights law, all necessary measures to ensure the protection and safety of persons with disabilities in situations of risk, including situations of armed conflict, humanitarian emergencies, and the occurrence of natural disasters.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国重申残疾人享有在法律面前的人格在任何地方均获得承认的权利。
Translation: 1. The States Parties reaffirm that persons with disabilities have the right to recognition as persons before the law everywhere.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国应当确认残疾人在生活的各方面在与其他人平等的基础上享有法律权利能力。
Translation: 2. States Parties shall recognize that persons with disabilities enjoy legal capacity on an equal basis with others in all aspects of life.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国应当采取适当措施，便利残疾人获得他们在行使其法律权利能力时可能需要的协助。
Translation: 3. States Parties shall take appropriate measures to facilitate access by persons with disabilities to the support they may require in exercising their legal capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约国应当确保，与行使法律权利能力有关的一切措施，均依照国际人权法提供适当和有效的防止滥用保障。
Translation: 4. States Parties shall ensure that all measures relating to the exercise of legal capacity are accompanied by appropriate and effective safeguards against abuse, in accordance with international human rights law.

Query_Text_cn: 这些保障应当确保与行使法律权利能力有关的措施尊重本人的权利、意愿和选择，无利益冲突和不当影响，适应本人情况，适用时间尽可能短，并定期由一个有资格、独立、公正的当局或司法机构复核。
Translation: These safeguards should ensure that measures relating to the exercise of legal capacity respect the individual's rights, will, and preferences, are free from conflicts of interest and undue influence, are tailored to the person's circumstances, are applied for the shortest possible duration, and are subject to regular review by a competent, independent, and impartial authority or judicial body.

Query_Text_cn: 提供的保障应当与这些措施影响个人权益的程度相称。
Translation: The safeguards provided should be commensurate with the extent to which these measures affect individual rights.

Query_Text_cn: 五、在符合本条的规定的情况下，缔约国应当采取一切适当和有效的措施，确保残疾人享有平等权利拥有或继承财产，掌管自己的财务，有平等机会获得银行贷款、抵押贷款和其他形式的金融信贷，并应当确保残疾人的财产不被任意剥夺。
Translation: 5. In accordance with the provisions of this article, States Parties shall take all appropriate and effective measures to ensure that persons with disabilities have equal rights to own or inherit property, to control their own financial affairs, and to have equal opportunities to obtain bank loans, mortgages, and other forms of financial credit. States Parties shall also ensure that persons with disabilities are not arbitrarily deprived of their property.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国应当确保残疾人在与其他人平等的基础上有效获得司法保护，包括通过提供程序便利和适龄措施，以便利他们在所有法律诉讼程序中，包括在调查和其他初步阶段中，切实发挥其作为直接和间接参与方，包括其作为证人的作用。
Translation: 1. States Parties shall ensure that persons with disabilities have effective access to justice on an equal basis with others, including through the provision of procedural accommodations and age-appropriate measures, to facilitate their effective participation in all legal proceedings, including at investigative and other preliminary stages, as direct and indirect participants, including as witnesses.

Query_Text_cn: 二、为了协助确保残疾人有效获得司法保护，缔约国应当促进对司法领域工作人员，包括警察和监狱工作人员进行适当的培训。
Translation: 2. In order to help ensure that persons with disabilities have effective access to justice, States Parties shall promote appropriate training for those working in the field of justice, including police and prison staff.

Query_Text_cn: （二）不被非法或任意剥夺自由，任何对自由的剥夺均须符合法律规定，而且在任何情况下均不得以残疾作为剥夺自由的理由。
Translation: (b) Not to be subjected to unlawful or arbitrary deprivation of liberty; any deprivation of liberty must comply with legal provisions, and under no circumstances shall disability be used as a reason for deprivation of liberty.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国应当确保，在任何程序中被剥夺自由的残疾人，在与其他人平等的基础上，有权获得国际人权法规定的保障，并应当享有符合本公约宗旨和原则的待遇，包括提供合理便利的待遇。
Translation: 2. States Parties shall ensure that persons with disabilities who are deprived of their liberty in any proceedings are, on an equal basis with others, entitled to the safeguards provided by international human rights law, and shall be treated in accordance with the purpose and principles of this Convention, including the provision of reasonable accommodation.

Query_Text_cn: 一、不得对任何人实施酷刑或残忍、不人道或有辱人格的待遇或处罚。
Translation: 1. No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment or punishment.

Query_Text_cn: 特别是不得在未经本人自由同意的情况下，对任何人进行医学或科学试验。
Translation: In particular, no one shall be subjected to medical or scientific experimentation without their free consent.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国应当采取一切有效的立法、行政、司法或其他措施，在与其他人平等的基础上，防止残疾人遭受酷刑或残忍、不人道或有辱人格的待遇或处罚。
Translation: 2. States Parties shall take all effective legislative, administrative, judicial, or other measures to prevent persons with disabilities, on an equal basis with others, from being subjected to torture or cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment or punishment.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国应当采取一切适当的立法、行政、社会、教育和其他措施，保护残疾人在家庭内外免遭一切形式的剥削、暴力和凌虐，包括基于性别的剥削、暴力和凌虐。
Translation: 1. States Parties shall take all appropriate legislative, administrative, social, educational, and other measures to protect persons with disabilities, both within and outside the family, from all forms of exploitation, violence, and abuse, including gender-based exploitation, violence, and abuse.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国还应当采取一切适当措施防止一切形式的剥削、暴力和凌虐，除其他外，确保向残疾人及其家属和照护人提供考虑到性别和年龄的适当协助和支助，包括提供信息和教育，说明如何避免、识别和报告剥削、暴力和凌虐事件。
Translation: 2. States Parties shall also take all appropriate measures to prevent all forms of exploitation, violence, and abuse, including, inter alia, ensuring that persons with disabilities, their families, and caregivers are provided with appropriate assistance and support, taking into account gender and age, including the provision of information and education on how to avoid, recognize, and report instances of exploitation, violence, and abuse.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国应当确保保护服务考虑到年龄、性别和残疾因素。
Translation: States Parties shall ensure that protection services take into account age, gender, and disability factors.

Query_Text_cn: 三、为了防止发生任何形式的剥削、暴力和凌虐，缔约国应当确保所有用于为残疾人服务的设施和方案受到独立当局的有效监测。
Translation: 3. In order to prevent any form of exploitation, violence, and abuse, States Parties shall ensure that all facilities and programs serving persons with disabilities are effectively monitored by independent authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 四、残疾人受到任何形式的剥削、暴力或凌虐时，缔约国应当采取一切适当措施，包括提供保护服务，促进被害人的身体、认知功能和心理的恢复、康复及回归社会。
Translation: 4. When persons with disabilities are subjected to any form of exploitation, violence, or abuse, States Parties shall take all appropriate measures, including the provision of protective services, to promote the physical, cognitive, and psychological recovery, rehabilitation, and social reintegration of the victims.

Query_Text_cn: 上述恢复措施和回归社会措施应当在有利于本人的健康、福祉、自尊、尊严和自主的环境中进行，并应当考虑到因性别和年龄而异的具体需要。
Translation: The above rehabilitation and social reintegration measures should be carried out in an environment conducive to the individual's health, well-being, self-esteem, dignity, and autonomy, and should take into account the specific needs arising from differences in gender and age.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约国应当制定有效的立法和政策，包括以妇女和儿童为重点的立法和政策，确保查明、调查和酌情起诉对残疾人的剥削、暴力和凌虐事件。
Translation: 5. States Parties shall enact effective legislation and policies, including those focused on women and children, to ensure the identification, investigation, and, where appropriate, prosecution of incidents of exploitation, violence, and abuse against persons with disabilities.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条保护人身完整性每个残疾人的身心完整性有权在与其他人平等的基础上获得尊重。
Translation:
Article 17 Protection of Personal Integrity

Every person with a disability has the right to respect for his or her physical and mental integrity on an equal basis with others.

Query_Text_cn: （四）不被任意剥夺或因残疾而被剥夺进入本国的权利。
Translation: (iv) The right not to be arbitrarily deprived, or deprived due to disability, of the right to enter one's own country.

Query_Text_cn: 二、残疾儿童出生后应当立即予以登记，从出生起即应当享有姓名权利，享有获得国籍的权利，并尽可能享有知悉父母并得到父母照顾的权利。
Translation: II. Children with disabilities shall be registered immediately after birth and, from birth, shall have the right to a name, the right to acquire a nationality, and, as far as possible, the right to know and be cared for by their parents.

Query_Text_cn: （三）残疾人可以在平等基础上享用为公众提供的社区服务和设施，并确保这些服务和设施符合他们的需要。
Translation: (3) Persons with disabilities shall have equal access to community services and facilities available to the public, and it shall be ensured that these services and facilities meet their needs.

Query_Text_cn: （四）鼓励生产助行器具、用品和辅助技术的实体考虑残疾人行动能力的各个方面。
Translation: 4. Encourage manufacturers of mobility aids, devices, and assistive technologies to take into account all aspects of persons with disabilities' mobility.

Query_Text_cn: （五）承认和推动手语的使用。
Translation: (v) Recognize and promote the use of sign language.

Query_Text_cn: 一、残疾人，不论其居所地或居住安排为何，其隐私、家庭、家居和通信以及其他形式的交流，不得受到任意或非法的干预，其荣誉和名誉也不得受到非法攻击。
Translation: 1. Persons with disabilities, regardless of their place of residence or living arrangements, shall not be subjected to arbitrary or unlawful interference with their privacy, family, home, or correspondence, as well as other forms of communication, nor to unlawful attacks on their honor and reputation.

Query_Text_cn: 残疾人有权获得法律的保护，不受这种干预或攻击。
Translation: Persons with disabilities have the right to legal protection against such interference or attacks.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国应当在与其他人平等的基础上保护残疾人的个人、健康和康复资料的隐私。
Translation: 2. States Parties shall protect the privacy of personal, health, and rehabilitation information of persons with disabilities on an equal basis with others.

Query_Text_cn: （三）残疾人，包括残疾儿童，在与其他人平等的基础上，保留其生育力。
Translation: (3) Persons with disabilities, including children with disabilities, retain their reproductive capacity on an equal basis with others.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下均应当以儿童的最佳利益为重。
Translation: In all circumstances, the best interests of the child should be given primary consideration.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国应当适当协助残疾人履行其养育子女的责任。
Translation: States Parties shall provide appropriate assistance to persons with disabilities in fulfilling their responsibilities as parents.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国应当确保残疾儿童在家庭生活方面享有平等权利。
Translation: 3. States Parties shall ensure that children with disabilities enjoy equal rights in family life.

Query_Text_cn: 为了实现这些权利，并为了防止隐藏、遗弃、忽视和隔离残疾儿童，缔约国应当承诺及早向残疾儿童及其家属提供全面的信息、服务和支助。
Translation: In order to realize these rights and to prevent the concealment, abandonment, neglect, and isolation of children with disabilities, States Parties shall undertake to provide comprehensive information, services, and support to children with disabilities and their families at an early stage.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约国应当确保不违背儿童父母的意愿使子女与父母分离，除非主管当局依照适用的法律和程序，经司法复核断定这种分离确有必要，符合儿童本人的最佳利益。
Translation: 4. States Parties shall ensure that children are not separated from their parents against the will of the parents, except when competent authorities, subject to applicable law and procedures and judicial review, determine that such separation is necessary and in the best interests of the child.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下均不得以子女残疾或父母一方或双方残疾为理由，使子女与父母分离。
Translation: Under no circumstances shall children be separated from their parents on the grounds of the disability of the children themselves or of one or both parents.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约国应当在近亲属不能照顾残疾儿童的情况下，尽一切努力在大家庭范围内提供替代性照顾，并在无法提供这种照顾时，在社区内提供家庭式照顾。
Translation: 5. States Parties shall make every effort to provide alternative care within the extended family when close relatives are unable to care for children with disabilities, and, when such care cannot be provided, to offer family-based care within the community.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国确认残疾人享有受教育的权利。
Translation: 1. States Parties recognize the right of persons with disabilities to education.

Query_Text_cn: （三）使所有残疾人能切实参与一个自由的社会。
Translation: (3) Enable all persons with disabilities to genuinely participate in a free society.

Query_Text_cn: （五）按照有教无类的包容性目标，在最有利于发展学习和社交能力的环境中，提供适合个人情况的有效支助措施。
Translation: 5. In line with the inclusive goal of providing education for all, effective support measures tailored to individual circumstances shall be provided in environments most conducive to the development of learning and social skills.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国应当使残疾人能够学习生活和社交技能，便利他们充分和平等地参与教育和融入社区。
Translation: 3. States Parties shall enable persons with disabilities to learn life and social skills, facilitating their full and equal participation in education and integration into the community.

Query_Text_cn: （三）确保以最适合个人情况的语文及交流方式和手段，在最有利于发展学习和社交能力的环境中，向盲、聋或聋盲人，特别是盲、聋或聋盲儿童提供教育。
Translation: (3) Ensure that education is provided to blind, deaf, or deaf-blind persons, especially blind, deaf, or deaf-blind children, in the language and communication mode and means most suitable to their individual circumstances, and in an environment that maximizes the development of learning and social abilities.

Query_Text_cn: 四、为了帮助确保实现这项权利，缔约国应当采取适当措施，聘用有资格以手语和（或）盲文教学的教师，包括残疾教师，并对各级教育的专业人员和工作人员进行培训。
Translation: 4. In order to help ensure the realization of this right, States Parties shall take appropriate measures to employ teachers, including teachers with disabilities, who are qualified in sign language and/or Braille, and to train professionals and staff at all levels of education.

Query_Text_cn: 这种培训应当包括对残疾的了解和学习使用适当的辅助和替代性交流方式、手段和模式、教育技巧和材料以协助残疾人。
Translation: Such training should include understanding disability and learning to use appropriate augmentative and alternative communication methods, means and modes, educational techniques, and materials to assist persons with disabilities.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约国应当确保，残疾人能够在不受歧视和与其他人平等的基础上，获得普通高等教育、职业培训、成人教育和终生学习。
Translation: 5. States Parties shall ensure that persons with disabilities are able to access general higher education, vocational training, adult education, and lifelong learning without discrimination and on an equal basis with others.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，缔约国应当确保向残疾人提供合理便利。
Translation: For this purpose, States Parties shall ensure the provision of reasonable accommodation to persons with disabilities.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条健康缔约国确认，残疾人有权享有可达到的最高健康标准，不受基于残疾的歧视。
Translation: Article 25: States Parties recognize that persons with disabilities have the right to the enjoyment of the highest attainable standard of health without discrimination on the basis of disability.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国应当采取一切适当措施，确保残疾人获得考虑到性别因素的医疗卫生服务，包括与健康有关的康复服务。
Translation: States Parties shall take all appropriate measures to ensure that persons with disabilities have access to healthcare services, including health-related rehabilitation services, that take into account gender considerations.

Query_Text_cn: （六）防止基于残疾而歧视性地拒绝提供医疗保健或医疗卫生服务，或拒绝提供食物和液体。
Translation: (vi) Prevent discriminatory denial of healthcare or medical services, or denial of food and water, on the basis of disability.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国应当采取有效和适当的措施，包括通过残疾人相互支持，使残疾人能够实现和保持最大程度的自立，充分发挥和维持体能、智能、社会和职业能力，充分融入和参与生活的各个方面。
Translation: 1. States Parties shall take effective and appropriate measures, including through mutual support among persons with disabilities, to enable persons with disabilities to achieve and maintain the highest possible level of independence, fully develop and sustain their physical, intellectual, social, and vocational abilities, and fully integrate and participate in all aspects of life.

Query_Text_cn: （二）有助于残疾人参与和融入社区和社会的各个方面，属自愿性质，并尽量在残疾人所在社区，包括农村地区就近安排。
Translation: (b) It facilitates the participation and integration of persons with disabilities in all aspects of community and society, is voluntary in nature, and should be arranged as close as possible to the communities where persons with disabilities reside, including rural areas.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国应当促进为从事适应训练和康复服务的专业人员和工作人员制订基础培训和进修培训计划。
Translation: 2. States Parties shall promote the establishment of basic and in-service training programs for professionals and staff engaged in adaptation training and rehabilitation services.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在适应训练和康复方面，缔约国应当促进提供为残疾人设计的辅助用具和技术以及对这些用具和技术的了解和使用。
Translation: 3. In terms of adaptive training and rehabilitation, States Parties shall promote the provision of assistive devices and technologies designed for persons with disabilities, as well as the awareness and use of such devices and technologies.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国确认残疾人在与其他人平等的基础上享有工作权，包括有机会在开放、具有包容性和对残疾人不构成障碍的劳动力市场和工作环境中，为谋生自由选择或接受工作的权利。
Translation: 1. States Parties recognize the right of persons with disabilities to work, on an equal basis with others, including the opportunity to gain a living by work freely chosen or accepted in a labor market and work environment that is open, inclusive, and accessible to persons with disabilities.

Query_Text_cn: （十一）促进残疾人的职业和专业康复服务、保留工作和恢复工作方案。
Translation: (11) Promote vocational and professional rehabilitation services for persons with disabilities, as well as job retention and return-to-work programs.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国应当确保残疾人不被奴役或驱役，并在与其他人平等的基础上受到保护，不被强迫或强制劳动。
Translation: 2. States Parties shall ensure that persons with disabilities are not subjected to slavery or servitude, and are protected, on an equal basis with others, from forced or compulsory labor.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国确认残疾人有权为自己及其家属获得适足的生活水平，包括适足的食物、衣物、住房，以及不断改善生活条件；__UNDEF__缔约国应当采取适当步骤，保障和促进在不受基于残疾的歧视的情况下实现这项权利。
Translation: 1. States Parties recognize the right of persons with disabilities to an adequate standard of living for themselves and their families, including adequate food, clothing and housing, and to the continuous improvement of living conditions; States Parties shall take appropriate steps to safeguard and promote the realization of this right without discrimination on the basis of disability.

Query_Text_cn: （五）确保残疾人可以平等享受退休福利和参加退休方案。
Translation: (v) Ensure that persons with disabilities can equally enjoy retirement benefits and participate in retirement schemes.

Query_Text_cn: 2、建立和加入残疾人组织，在国际、全国、地区和地方各级代表残疾人。
Translation: 2. To establish and join organizations of persons with disabilities, representing persons with disabilities at international, national, regional, and local levels.

Query_Text_cn: （三）进出文化表演或文化服务场所，例如剧院、博物馆、电影院、图书馆、旅游服务场所，并尽可能地可以进出在本国文化中具有重要意义的纪念物和纪念地。
Translation: (3) Entering and exiting cultural performance or service venues, such as theaters, museums, cinemas, libraries, and tourism service sites, and, as much as possible, accessing monuments and memorial sites of significant importance in the national culture.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国应当采取适当措施，使残疾人能够有机会为自身利益并为充实社会，发展和利用自己的创造、艺术和智力潜力。
Translation: 2. States Parties shall take appropriate measures to enable persons with disabilities to have the opportunity to develop and utilize their creative, artistic, and intellectual potential, not only for their own benefit but also for the enrichment of society.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国应当采取一切适当步骤，依照国际法的规定，确保保护知识产权的法律不构成不合理或歧视性障碍，阻碍残疾人获得文化材料。
Translation: 3. States Parties shall take all appropriate steps, in accordance with the provisions of international law, to ensure that laws protecting intellectual property rights do not constitute an unreasonable or discriminatory barrier to access to cultural materials by persons with disabilities.

Query_Text_cn: 四、残疾人特有的文化和语言特性，包括手语和聋文化，应当有权在与其他人平等的基础上获得承认和支持。
Translation: The unique cultural and linguistic characteristics of persons with disabilities, including sign language and Deaf culture, should be recognized and supported on an equal basis with others.

Query_Text_cn: （五）确保残疾人可以获得娱乐、旅游、休闲和体育活动的组织人提供的服务。
Translation: (v) Ensure that persons with disabilities have access to services provided by organizations offering entertainment, tourism, leisure, and sports activities.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国承诺收集适当的信息，包括统计和研究数据，以便制定和实施政策，落实本公约。
Translation: 1. The States Parties undertake to collect appropriate information, including statistical and research data, in order to formulate and implement policies for the purpose of fulfilling this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （二）遵行保护人权和基本自由的国际公认规范以及收集和使用统计数据的道德原则。
Translation: (2) Adhering to internationally recognized norms for the protection of human rights and fundamental freedoms, as well as ethical principles in the collection and use of statistical data.

Query_Text_cn: 二、依照本条规定收集的信息应当酌情分组，用于协助评估本公约规定的缔约国义务的履行情况，查明和清除残疾人在行使其权利时遇到的障碍。
Translation: 2. The information collected in accordance with this article shall be appropriately categorized and used to assist in assessing the implementation of the obligations of States Parties under this Convention, as well as in identifying and eliminating obstacles encountered by persons with disabilities in exercising their rights.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国应当负责传播这些统计数据，确保残疾人和其他人可以使用这些统计数据。
Translation: 3. States Parties shall be responsible for disseminating these statistical data and ensuring that persons with disabilities and others have access to them.

Query_Text_cn: 我联合国人民同决心欲免后世再遭今代人类两度身历惨不堪言之战祸，重申基本人权，人格尊严与价值，以及男女与大小各国平等权利之信念，创造适当环境，俾克维持正义，尊重由条约与国际法其他渊源而起之义务，久而弗懈，促成大自由中之社会进步及较善之民生，并为达此目的力行容恕，彼此以善邻之道，和睦相处，集中力量，以维持国际和平及安全，接受原则，确立力法，以保证非为公共利益，不得使用武力，运用国际机构，以促成全球人民经济及社会之进展，用是发愤立志，务当同心协力，以竟厥功。爰由我各本国政府，经齐集金山市之代表各将所奉全权证书，互相校阅，均属妥善，议定本联合国宪章，并设立国际组织，定名联合国。
Translation:
We, the peoples of the United Nations, determined to save succeeding generations from the scourge of war, which twice in our lifetime has brought untold sorrow to mankind, and to reaffirm faith in fundamental human rights, in the dignity and worth of the human person, in the equal rights of men and women and of nations large and small, and to establish conditions under which justice and respect for the obligations arising from treaties and other sources of international law can be maintained, and to promote social progress and better standards of life in larger freedom, and for these ends to practice tolerance and live together in peace with one another as good neighbors, and to unite our strength to maintain international peace and security, and to ensure, by the acceptance of principles and the institution of methods, that armed force shall not be used, save in the common interest, and to employ international machinery for the promotion of the economic and social advancement of all peoples, have resolved to combine our efforts to accomplish these aims.

Accordingly, our respective Governments, through representatives assembled in the city of San Francisco, who have exhibited their full powers found to be in good and due form, have agreed to the present Charter of the United Nations and do hereby establish an international organization to be known as the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、维持国际和平及安全；并为此目的：采取有效集体办法、以防止且消除对于和平之威胁，制止侵略行为或其他和平之破坏；并以和平方法且依正义及国际法之原则，调整或解决足以破坏和平之国际争端或情势。
Translation: 1. To maintain international peace and security; and to that end: to take effective collective measures for the prevention and removal of threats to the peace, for the suppression of acts of aggression or other breaches of the peace, and to bring about by peaceful means, and in conformity with the principles of justice and international law, adjustment or settlement of international disputes or situations which might lead to a breach of the peace.

Query_Text_cn: 二、发展国际间以尊重人民平等权利及自决原则为根据之友好关系，并采取其他适当办法，以增强普遍和平。
Translation: 2. To develop friendly relations among nations based on respect for the equal rights of peoples and the principle of self-determination, and to take other appropriate measures to strengthen universal peace.

Query_Text_cn: 三、促成国际合作，以解决国际间属于经济、社会、文化、及人类福利性质之国际问题，且不分种族、性别、语言、或宗教、增进并激励对于全体人类之人权及基本自由之尊重。
Translation: 3. To promote international cooperation in solving international problems of an economic, social, cultural, or humanitarian nature, and to advance and encourage respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms for all, without distinction as to race, gender, language, or religion.

Query_Text_cn: 四、构成一协调各国行动之中心，以达成上述共同目的。
Translation: 4. To constitute a center for harmonizing the actions of nations in the attainment of these common objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本组织系基于各会员国主权平等之原则。
Translation: 1. This organization is based on the principle of the sovereign equality of all its member states.

Query_Text_cn: 二、各会员国应一秉善意，履行其依本宪章所担负之义务，以保证全体会员国由加入本组织而发生之权益。
Translation: 2. Each Member State shall act in good faith and fulfill its obligations under this Charter to ensure that all Member States enjoy the rights arising from their accession to this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 三、各会员国应以和平方法解决其国际争端，俾免危及国际和平、安全、及正义。
Translation: 3. All Member States shall settle their international disputes by peaceful means so as not to endanger international peace, security, and justice.

Query_Text_cn: 四、各会员国在其国际关系上不得使用威胁或武力，或以与联合国宗旨不符之任何其他方法，侵害任何会员国或国家之领土完整或政治独立。
Translation: 4. Each Member State shall refrain in its international relations from the threat or use of force, or from any other methods inconsistent with the purposes of the United Nations, to violate the territorial integrity or political independence of any Member State or country.

Query_Text_cn: 五、各会员国对于联合国依本宪章规定而采取之行动，应尽力予以协助，联合国对于任何国家正在采取防止或执行行动时，各会员国对该国不得给予协助。
Translation: 5. All Member States shall give every assistance to the United Nations in any action it takes in accordance with the present Charter, and shall refrain from giving assistance to any state against which the United Nations is taking preventive or enforcement action.

Query_Text_cn: 六、本组织在维持国际和平及安全之必要范围内，应保证非联合国会员国遵行上述原则。
Translation: 6. Within the scope necessary for maintaining international peace and security, the Organization shall ensure that non-member states of the United Nations comply with the aforementioned principles.

Query_Text_cn: 但此项原则不妨碍第七章内执行办法之适用。
Translation: However, this principle does not preclude the application of the implementation measures set forth in Chapter VII.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条凡曾经参加金山联合国国际组织会议或前此曾签字于１９４２年１月１日联合国宣言之国家，签订本宪章，且依宪章第一百一十条规定而予以批准者，均为联合国之创始会员国。
Translation: Article 3: Any state which has participated in the San Francisco United Nations International Organization Conference or has previously signed the Declaration by United Nations of January 1, 1942, and which signs this Charter and ratifies it in accordance with Article 110 of the Charter, shall be deemed an original Member of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、凡其他爱好和平之国家，接受本宪章所载之义务，经本组织认为确能并愿意履行该项义务者，得为联合国会员国。
Translation: 1. Membership in the United Nations is open to all other peace-loving states which accept the obligations contained in the present Charter and, in the judgment of the Organization, are able and willing to carry out these obligations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、准许上述国家为联合国会员国，将由大会经安全理事会之推荐以决议行之。
Translation: 2. The admission of the aforementioned states as Members of the United Nations shall be effected by a resolution of the General Assembly upon the recommendation of the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条联合国会员国，业经安全理事会对其采取防止或执行行动者，大会经安全理事会之建议，得停止其会员权利及特权之行使。此项权利及特权之行使，得由安全理事会恢复之。
Translation:
Article 5  
A Member of the United Nations against which preventive or enforcement action has been taken by the Security Council may be suspended from the exercise of the rights and privileges of membership by the General Assembly upon the recommendation of the Security Council. The exercise of these rights and privileges may be restored by the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条联合国之会员国中，有屡次违犯本宪章所载之原则者，大会经安全理事会之建议，得将其由本组织除名。
Translation: A Member of the United Nations which has persistently violated the principles contained in the present Charter may be expelled from the Organization by the General Assembly upon the recommendation of the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 大会、安全理事会、经济暨社会理事会、托管理事会、国际法院、及秘书处。
Translation: The General Assembly, the Security Council, the Economic and Social Council, the Trusteeship Council, the International Court of Justice, and the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 二、联合国得依本宪章设立认为必需之辅助机关。
Translation: 2. The United Nations shall establish such subsidiary organs as it deems necessary in accordance with the present Charter.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条联合国对于男女均得在其主要及辅助机关在平等条件之下，充任任何职务，不得加以限制。
Translation: Article 8: The United Nations shall not restrict the eligibility of men and women, on equal terms, to participate in any position within its principal and subsidiary organs.

Query_Text_cn: 一、大会由联合国所有会员国组织之。
Translation: 1. The conference is organized by all member states of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、每一会员国在大会之代表，不得超过五人。
Translation: 2. The number of representatives of each Member State at the General Assembly shall not exceed five.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条大会得讨论本宪章范围内之任何问题或事项，或关于本宪章所规定任何机关之职权；并除第十二条所规定外，得向联合国会员国或安全理事会或兼向两者，提出对各该问题或事项之建议。
Translation:
Article 10

The General Assembly may discuss any questions or matters within the scope of this Charter, or relating to the powers of any organs provided for in this Charter, and, except as provided in Article 12, may make recommendations to the Members of the United Nations, to the Security Council, or to both, on any such questions or matters.

Query_Text_cn: 一、大会得考虑关于维持国际和平及安全之合作之普通原则，包括军缩及军备管制之原则；并得向会员国或安全理事会或兼向两者提出对于该项原则之建议。
Translation: 1. The General Assembly shall consider the general principles of cooperation for the maintenance of international peace and security, including the principles governing disarmament and the regulation of armaments, and may make recommendations to the Members of the United Nations or to the Security Council or to both regarding such principles.

Query_Text_cn: 二、大会得讨论联合国任何会员国或安全理事会或非联合国会员国依第三十五条第二项之规定向大会所提关于维持国际和平及安全之任何问题；除第十二条所规定外，并得向会员国或安全理事会或兼向两者提出对于各该项问题之建议。凡对于需要行动之各该项问题，应由大会于讨论前或讨论后提交安全理事会。
Translation: 2. The General Assembly may discuss any questions relating to the maintenance of international peace and security submitted to it by any Member of the United Nations, by the Security Council, or by any non-member state in accordance with Article 35, paragraph 2. Except as provided in Article 12, it may make recommendations on any such questions to the Member States, to the Security Council, or to both. Any such questions requiring action shall be referred by the General Assembly to the Security Council either before or after discussion.

Query_Text_cn: 三、大会对于足以危及国际和平与安全之情势，得提请安全理事会注意。
Translation: The General Assembly may call the attention of the Security Council to situations which are likely to endanger international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条所载之大会权力并不限制第十条之概括范围。
Translation: 4. The powers conferred upon the General Assembly in this article shall not limit the general scope of Article 10.

Query_Text_cn: 一、当安全理事会对于任何争端或情势，正在执行本宪章所授予该会之职务时，大会非经安全理事会请求，对于该项争端或情势，不得提出任何建议。
Translation: 1. While the Security Council is exercising the functions assigned to it by this Charter in relation to any dispute or situation, the General Assembly shall not make any recommendation regarding that dispute or situation unless requested by the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、秘书长经安全理事会之同意，应于大会每次会议时，将安全理事会正在处理中关于维持国际和平及安全之任何事件，通知大会；于安全理事会停止处理该项事件时，亦应立即通知大会，或在大会闭会期内通知联合国会员国。
Translation: 2. With the consent of the Security Council, the Secretary-General shall, at each session of the General Assembly, notify the Assembly of any matters relating to the maintenance of international peace and security that are being dealt with by the Security Council; when the Security Council ceases to deal with such matters, the Secretary-General shall also immediately notify the Assembly, or, during the recess of the Assembly, notify the Member States of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: （子）以促进政治上之国际合作，并提倡国际法之逐渐发展与编纂。
Translation: To promote international cooperation in the political sphere and to advocate the progressive development and codification of international law.

Query_Text_cn: （丑）以促进经济、社会、文化、教育、及卫生各部门之国际合作，且不分种族、性别、语言、或宗教，助成全体人类之人权及基本自由之实现。
Translation: (b) To promote international cooperation in the economic, social, cultural, educational, and health fields, and to assist in the realization of human rights and fundamental freedoms for all people, without distinction as to race, gender, language, or religion.

Query_Text_cn: 二、大会关于本条第一项（丑）款所列事项之其他责任及职权，于第九章及第十章中规定之。
Translation: 2. Other responsibilities and powers of the Assembly concerning the matters listed in item (c) of paragraph 1 of this Article are stipulated in Chapters IX and X.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条大会对于其所认为足以妨害国际间公共福利或友好关系之任何情势，不论其起原如何，包括由违反本宪章所载联合国之宗旨及原则而起之情势，得建议和平调整办法，但以不违背第十二条之规定为限。
Translation: The General Assembly may recommend measures for the peaceful adjustment of any situation which it deems likely to impair the general welfare or friendly relations among nations, regardless of the origin of such situation, including situations resulting from a violation of the purposes and principles of the United Nations as set forth in the present Charter, provided that such recommendations do not contravene the provisions of Article 12.

Query_Text_cn: 该项报告应载有安全理事会对于维持国际和平及安全所已决定或施行之办法之陈述。
Translation: The report shall contain a statement of the measures which the Security Council has decided upon or implemented for the maintenance of international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: 二、大会应收受并审查联合国其他机关所送之报告。
Translation: 2. The General Assembly shall receive and examine reports submitted by other organs of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条大会应执行第十二章及第十三章所授予关于国际托管制度之职务，包括关于非战略防区托管协定之核准。
Translation: Article 16 The General Assembly shall carry out the functions assigned to it under Chapters XII and XIII with respect to the international trusteeship system, including the approval of trusteeship agreements for territories not designated as strategic areas.

Query_Text_cn: 一、大会应审核本组织之预算。
Translation: The General Assembly shall review the budget of the organization.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本组织之经费应由各会员国依照大会分配限额担负之。
Translation: 2. The expenses of this organization shall be borne by the member states in accordance with the quotas allocated by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 三、大会应审核经与第五十七条所指各种专门机关订定之任何财政及预算办法，并应审查该项专门机关之行政预算，以便向关系机关提出建议。
Translation: 3. The General Assembly shall review any financial and budgetary arrangements made with the various specialized agencies referred to in Article 57, and shall examine the administrative budgets of such specialized agencies in order to make recommendations to the relevant agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 一、大会之每一会员国，应有一个投票权。
Translation: Each member state of the Assembly shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: 二、大会对于重要问题之决议应以到会及投票之会员国三分之二多数决定之。
Translation: 2. Resolutions on important issues at the General Assembly shall be decided by a two-thirds majority of the member states present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 关于维持国际和平及安全之建议，安全理事会非常任理事国之选举，经济暨社会理事会理事国之选举，依第八十六条第一项（）款所规定托管理事会理事国之选举，对于新会员国加入联合国之准许，会员国权利及特权之停止，会员国之除名，关于施行托管制度之问题，以及预算问题。
Translation: Recommendations regarding the maintenance of international peace and security, the election of non-permanent members of the Security Council, the election of members of the Economic and Social Council, the election of members of the Trusteeship Council as stipulated in Article 86, paragraph 1 (), the admission of new Member States to the United Nations, the suspension of rights and privileges of Member States, the expulsion of Member States, matters concerning the implementation of the trusteeship system, and budgetary issues.

Query_Text_cn: 三、关于其他问题之决议，包括另有何种事项应以三分之二多数决定之问题，应以到会及投票之会员国过半数决定之。
Translation: 3. Resolutions on other issues, including matters that require a two-thirds majority for decision, shall be adopted by a majority of the member states present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条凡拖欠本组织财政款项之会员国，其拖欠数目如等于或超过前两年所应缴纳之数目时，即丧失其在大会投票权。大会如认拖欠原因，确由于该会员国无法控制之情形者，得准许该会员国投票。
Translation: Article 19: Any Member State that is in arrears of its financial contributions to the organization shall have no voting rights in the General Assembly if the amount of its arrears equals or exceeds the amount due for the preceding two years. The General Assembly may permit such a Member State to vote if it is satisfied that the failure to pay is due to circumstances beyond the Member State's control.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条大会每年应举行常会，并于必要时，举行特别会议。特别会议应由秘书长经安全理事会或联合国会员国过半数之请求召集之。
Translation: Article 20: The General Assembly shall hold regular annual sessions and, as necessary, special sessions. Special sessions shall be convened by the Secretary-General at the request of the Security Council or of a majority of the Members of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条大会应自行制定其议事规则。大会应选举每次会议之主席。
Translation: Article 21 The Assembly shall adopt its own rules of procedure. The Assembly shall elect a President for each session.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条大会得设立其认为于行使职务所必需之辅助机关。
Translation: Article 22 The General Assembly may establish such subsidiary organs as it deems necessary for the performance of its functions.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条(注：１９６３年１２月１７日经大会通过修正，１９６５年８月３１日生效。二十三条的修正案将安全理事会理事国自十一国增至十五国。
Translation: Article 23 (Note: Amended by the General Assembly on December 17, 1963, effective August 31, 1965. The amendment to Article 23 increased the number of members of the Security Council from eleven to fifteen.)

Query_Text_cn: 一、安全理事会以联合国十五会员国组织之。中华民国、法兰西、苏维埃社会主义共和国联邦、大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国及美利坚合众国应为安全理事会常任理事国。大会应选举联合国其他十会员国为安全理事会非常任理事国，选举时首宜充分斟酌联合国各会员国于维持国际和平与安全及本组织其余各宗旨上之贡献，并宜充分斟酌地域上之公匀分配。
Translation: 1. The Security Council shall consist of fifteen Members of the United Nations. The Republic of China, the French Republic, the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, and the United States of America shall be permanent members of the Security Council. The General Assembly shall elect ten other Members of the United Nations to be non-permanent members of the Security Council, due regard being specially paid, in the first instance, to the contribution of Members of the United Nations to the maintenance of international peace and security and to the other purposes of the Organization, as well as to equitable geographical distribution.

Query_Text_cn: 二、安全理事会非常任理事国任期定为二年。安全理事会理事国自十一国增至十五国后第一次选举非常任理事国时，所增四国中两国之任期应为一年。任满之理事国不得即行连选。
Translation: 2. The term of office for non-permanent members of the Security Council shall be two years. At the first election of non-permanent members following the increase in the number of Security Council members from eleven to fifteen, the terms of office for two of the four additional members shall be one year. A retiring member shall not be eligible for immediate re-election.

Query_Text_cn: 三、安全理事会每一理事国应有代表一人。
Translation: 3. Each member of the Security Council shall be represented by one representative.

Query_Text_cn: 一、为保证联合国行动迅速有效起见，各会员国将维持国际和平及安全之主要责任，授予安全理事会，并同意安全理事会于履行此项责任下之职务时，即系代表各会员国。
Translation: 1. In order to ensure that United Nations actions are swift and effective, the primary responsibility for maintaining international peace and security is conferred upon the Security Council by the Member States, who agree that, in carrying out its duties under this responsibility, the Security Council acts on their behalf.

Query_Text_cn: 二、安全理事会于履行此项职务时，应遵照联合国之宗旨及原则。为履行此项职务而授予安全理事会之特定权力，于本宪章第六章、第七章、第八章、及第十二章内规定之。
Translation: 2. In carrying out this responsibility, the Security Council shall act in accordance with the purposes and principles of the United Nations. The specific powers granted to the Security Council for the discharge of this responsibility are set forth in Chapters VI, VII, VIII, and XII of this Charter.

Query_Text_cn: 三、安全理事会应将常年报告、并于必要时将特别报告、提送大会审查。
Translation: 3. The Security Council shall submit its annual report, and special reports when necessary, to the General Assembly for review.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条为促进国际和平及安全之建立及维持，以尽量减少世界人力及经济资源之消耗于军备起见，安全理事会借第四十七条所指之军事参谋团之协助，应负责拟具方案，提交联合国会员国，以建立军备管制制度。
Translation: Article 26 In order to promote the establishment and maintenance of international peace and security, with the least diversion for armaments of the world's human and economic resources, the Security Council shall be responsible for formulating plans to be submitted to the Members of the United Nations for the establishment of a system for the regulation of armaments, with the assistance of the Military Staff Committee referred to in Article 47.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条(注：１９６３年１２月１７日经大会修正，１９６５年８月３１日生效。修正后的第二十七条规定安全理事会关于程序事项之决议，应以九理事国（前为七理事国）之可决票表决之，对于其他一切事项之决议，应以九理事国（前为七理事国）之可决票包括安全理事会五常任理事国之同意票表决之。
Translation: Article 27 (Note: Amended by the General Assembly on December 17, 1963, effective August 31, 1965. The amended Article 27 stipulates that decisions of the Security Council on procedural matters shall be made by an affirmative vote of nine members (formerly seven members). Decisions on all other matters shall be made by an affirmative vote of nine members (formerly seven members), including the concurring votes of the five permanent members of the Security Council.)

Query_Text_cn: 一、安全理事会每一理事国应有一个投票权。
Translation: Each member of the Security Council shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: 二、安全理事会关于程序事项之决议，应以九理事国之可决票表决之。
Translation: 2. Decisions of the Security Council on procedural matters shall be made by an affirmative vote of nine members.

Query_Text_cn: 但对于第六章及第五十二条第三项内各事项之决议，争端当事国不得投票。
Translation: However, with regard to decisions on matters covered in Chapter VI and Article 52, paragraph 3, parties to a dispute shall abstain from voting.

Query_Text_cn: 一、安全理事会之组织，应以使其能继续不断行使职务为要件。为此目的，安全理事会之各理事国应有常驻本组织会所之代表。
Translation: 1. The organization of the Security Council shall be such as to enable it to function continuously. For this purpose, each member of the Security Council shall have a representative at the headquarters of the Organization at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 二、安全理事会应举行定期会议，每一理事国认为合宜时得派政府大员或其他特别指定之代表出席。
Translation: 2. The Security Council shall hold regular meetings, and each member of the Council may, whenever it deems appropriate, be represented at such meetings by a senior government official or other specially designated representative.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在本组织会所以外，安全理事会得在认为最能便利其工作之其他地点举行会议。
Translation: 3. The Security Council may hold meetings at places other than the seat of the Organization if it deems this would best facilitate its work.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条安全理事会得设立其认为于行使职务所必需之辅助机关。
Translation: Article 29: The Security Council may establish such subsidiary organs as it deems necessary for the performance of its functions.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条安全理事会应自行制定其议事规则，包括其推选主席之方法。
Translation: Article 30 The Security Council shall adopt its own rules of procedure, including the method of selecting its President.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条在安全理事会提出之任何问题，经其认为对于非安全理事会理事国之联合国任何会员国之利益有特别关系时，该会员国得参加讨论，但无投票权。
Translation: Article 31: Any Member of the United Nations which is not a member of the Security Council may participate, without vote, in the discussion of any question brought before the Security Council whenever the latter considers that the interests of that Member are specially affected.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条联合国会员国而非为安全理事会之理事国，或非联合国会员国之国家，如于安全理事会考虑中之争端为当事国者，应被邀参加关于该项争端之讨论，但无投票权。安全理事会应规定其所认为公平之条件，以便非联合国会员国之国家参加。
Translation:
Article 32  
Any Member of the United Nations which is not a member of the Security Council, or any state which is not a Member of the United Nations, if it is a party to a dispute under consideration by the Security Council, shall be invited to participate in the discussion relating to the dispute, but without a vote. The Security Council shall lay down such conditions as it deems just for the participation of a state which is not a Member of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、任何争端之当事国，于争端之继续存在足以危及国际和平与安全之维持时，应尽先以谈判、调查、调停、和解、公断、司法解决、区域机关或区域办法之利用、或各该国自行选择之其他和平方法，求得解决。
Translation: 1. When the continuation of any dispute between parties is likely to endanger the maintenance of international peace and security, the parties concerned shall first seek a solution by negotiation, inquiry, mediation, conciliation, arbitration, judicial settlement, resort to regional agencies or arrangements, or other peaceful means of their own choice.

Query_Text_cn: 二、安全理事会认为必要时，应促请各当事国以此项方法，解决其争端。
Translation: 2. The Security Council shall, when it deems necessary, urge the parties concerned to resolve their disputes by this method.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条安全理事会得调查任何争端或可能引起国际磨擦或惹起争端之任何情势，以断定该项争端或情势之继续存在是否足以危及国际和平与安全之维持。
Translation: Article 34: The Security Council may investigate any dispute or situation which may lead to international friction or give rise to a dispute, in order to determine whether the continued existence of such dispute or situation is likely to endanger the maintenance of international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国任何会员国得将属于第三十四条所指之性质之任何争端或情势，提请安全理事会或大会注意。
Translation: 1. Any member of the United Nations may bring to the attention of the Security Council or the General Assembly any dispute or situation of the nature referred to in Article 34.

Query_Text_cn: 二、非联合国会员国之国家如为任何争端之当事国时，经预先声明就该争端而言接受本宪章所规定和平解决之义务后，得将该项争端，提请大会或安全理事会注意。
Translation: 2. If a state which is not a Member of the United Nations is a party to a dispute, it may bring the dispute to the attention of the General Assembly or the Security Council, provided that it accepts in advance, for the purposes of that dispute, the obligations of peaceful settlement as set forth in the present Charter.

Query_Text_cn: 三、大会关于按照本条所提请注意事项之进行步骤，应遵守第十一条及第十二条之规定。
Translation: 3. The procedures to be followed by the Assembly regarding matters brought to its attention under this Article shall be in accordance with the provisions of Articles 11 and 12.

Query_Text_cn: 一、属于第三十三条所指之性质之争端或相似之情势，安全理事会在任何阶段，得建议适当程序或调整方法。
Translation: 1. In the case of any dispute of the nature referred to in Article 33, or any situation of a similar nature, the Security Council may, at any stage, recommend appropriate procedures or methods of adjustment.

Query_Text_cn: 二、安全理事会对于当事国为解决争端业经采取之任何程序，理应予以考虑。
Translation: 2. The Security Council should take into consideration any procedures already undertaken by the parties concerned to resolve the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 三、安全理事会按照本条作成建议时，同时理应注意凡具有法律性质之争端，在原则上，理应由当事国依国际法院规约之规定提交国际法院。
Translation: 3. When making recommendations under this Article, the Security Council should also bear in mind that, in principle, any disputes of a legal nature should be submitted by the parties to the International Court of Justice in accordance with the provisions of the Statute of the Court.

Query_Text_cn: 一、属于第三十三条所指之性质之争端，当事国如未能依该条所示方法解决时，应将该项争端提交安全理事会。
Translation: 1. If the parties to a dispute of the nature referred to in Article 33 fail to resolve it by the means indicated in that Article, they shall refer the dispute to the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、安全理事会如认为该项争端之继续存在，在事实上足以危及国际和平与安全之维持时，应决定是否当依第三十六条采取行动或建议其所认为适当之解决条件。
Translation: 2. If the Security Council considers that the continued existence of the dispute is, in fact, likely to endanger the maintenance of international peace and security, it shall decide whether to take action under Article 36 or to recommend such terms of settlement as it deems appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条安全理事会如经所有争端当事国之请求，得向各当事国作成建议，以求争端之和平解决，但以不妨碍第三十三条至第三十七条之规定为限。
Translation: Article 38: The Security Council, at the request of all parties to a dispute, may make recommendations to the parties with a view to the peaceful settlement of the dispute, provided that such recommendations do not prejudice the provisions of Articles 33 to 37.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条安全理事会应断定任何和平之威胁、和平之破坏、或侵略行为之是否存在，并应作成建议或抉择依第四十一条及第四十二条规定之办法，以维持或恢复国际和平及安全。
Translation: Article 39: The Security Council shall determine the existence of any threat to the peace, breach of the peace, or act of aggression, and shall make recommendations, or decide what measures shall be taken in accordance with Articles 41 and 42, to maintain or restore international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条为防止情势之恶化，安全理事会在依第三十九条规定作成建议或决定办法以前，得促请关系当事国遵行安全理事会所认为必要或合宜之临时办法，此项临时办法并不妨碍关系当事国之权利、要求、或立场。
Translation: Article 40 In order to prevent an aggravation of the situation, the Security Council may, before making the recommendations or deciding upon the measures provided for in Article 39, call upon the parties concerned to comply with such provisional measures as it deems necessary or desirable. Such provisional measures shall be without prejudice to the rights, claims, or position of the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 安全理事会对于不遵行此项临时办法之情形，应予适当注意。第四十一条安全理事会得决定所应采武力以外之办法，以实施其决议，并得促请联合国会员国执行此项办法。此项办法得包括经济关系、铁路、海运、航空、邮、电、无线电、及其他交通工具、之局部或全部停止，以及外交关系之断绝。
Translation: The Security Council should give appropriate attention to situations where this provisional measure is not complied with. Article 41: The Security Council may decide on measures not involving the use of armed force to implement its decisions and may call upon United Nations Member States to carry out such measures. These measures may include the partial or complete interruption of economic relations, rail, sea, air, postal, telegraphic, radio, and other means of communication, as well as the severance of diplomatic relations.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条安全理事会如认第四十一条所规定之办法为不足或已经证明为不足时，得采取必要之空海陆军行动，以维持或恢复国际和平及安全。此项行动得包括联合国会员国之空海陆军示威、封锁、及其他军事举动。
Translation: Article 42: Should the Security Council consider that the measures provided for in Article 41 are inadequate or have proved to be inadequate, it may take such action by air, sea, or land forces as may be necessary to maintain or restore international peace and security. Such action may include demonstrations, blockades, and other military operations by air, sea, or land forces of Member States of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国各会员国为求对于维持国际和平及安全有所贡献起见，担任于安全理事会发令时，并依特别协定，供给为维持国际和平及安全所必需之军队、协助、及便利，包括过境权。
Translation: 1. In order to contribute to the maintenance of international peace and security, all Members of the United Nations undertake to make available to the Security Council, upon its call and in accordance with a special agreement, armed forces, assistance, and facilities necessary for the maintenance of international peace and security, including rights of passage.

Query_Text_cn: 二、此项特别协定应规定军队之数目及种类，其准备程度及一般驻扎地点，以及所供便利及协助之性质。
Translation: II. This special agreement shall specify the number and types of troops, their level of readiness, general stationing locations, as well as the nature of facilities and assistance provided.

Query_Text_cn: 三、此项特别协定应以安全理事会之主动，尽速议订。此项协定应由安全理事会与会员国或由安全理事会与若干会员国之集团缔结之，并由签字国各依其宪法程序批准之。
Translation: 3. This special agreement shall be negotiated as soon as possible at the initiative of the Security Council. It shall be concluded between the Security Council and member states, or between the Security Council and groups of member states, and shall be ratified by the signatory states in accordance with their respective constitutional procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条安全理事会决定使用武力时，于要求非安全理事会会员国依第四十三条供给军队以履行其义务之前，如经该会员国请求，应请其派遣代表，参加安全理事会关于使用其军事部队之决议。
Translation: Article 44: When the Security Council has decided to use force, it shall, before calling upon a Member of the United Nations not represented on the Council to provide armed forces in fulfillment of the obligations assumed under Article 43, invite such Member, if the Member so requests, to participate in the decisions of the Security Council concerning the employment of contingents of that Member's armed forces.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条为使联合国能采取紧急军事办法起见，会员国应将其本国空军部队为国际共同执行行动随时供给调遣。此项部队之实力与准备之程度，及其共同行动之计划，应由安全理事会以军事参谋团之协助，在第四十三条所指之特别协定范围内决定之。
Translation: Article 45 In order to enable the United Nations to take urgent military measures, Members shall hold immediately available national air-force contingents for combined international enforcement action. The strength and degree of readiness of these contingents, and plans for their combined action, shall be determined, within the limits laid down by the special agreements referred to in Article 43, by the Security Council with the assistance of the Military Staff Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条武力使用之计划应由安全理事会以军事参谋团之协助决定之。
Translation: Article 46: Plans for the use of armed force shall be made by the Security Council with the assistance of the Military Staff Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 一、设立军事参谋团，以便对于安全理事会维持国际和平及安全之军事需要问题，对于受该会所支配军队之使用及统率问题，对于军备之管制及可能之军缩问题，向该会贡献意见并予以协助。
Translation: 1. Establish a Military Staff Committee to provide advice and assistance to the Security Council on matters concerning the military requirements for maintaining international peace and security, the use and command of forces under the Council's control, and issues related to the regulation of armaments and possible disarmament.

Query_Text_cn: 二、军事参谋团应由安全理事会各常任理事国之参谋总长或其代表组织之。联合国任何会员国在该团未有常任代表者，如于该团责任之履行在效率上必需该国参加其工作时，应由该团邀请参加。
Translation: 2. The Military Staff Committee shall be composed of the Chiefs of Staff of the permanent members of the Security Council or their representatives. Any Member State of the United Nations not permanently represented on the Committee shall be invited by the Committee to participate in its work when the efficient discharge of the Committee’s responsibilities requires the participation of that Member.

Query_Text_cn: 三、军事参谋团在安全理事会权力之下，对于受该会所支配之任何军队，负战略上之指挥责任；关于该项军队之统率问题，应待以后处理。
Translation: 3. The Military Staff Committee, under the authority of the Security Council, shall be responsible for the strategic direction of any armed forces placed at the disposal of the Council; the question of the command of such forces shall be dealt with at a later stage.

Query_Text_cn: 四、军事参谋团，经安全理事会之授权，并与区域内有关机关商议后，得设立区域分团。
Translation: 4. The Military Staff Committee, upon authorization by the Security Council and after consultation with relevant agencies in the region, may establish regional subcommittees.

Query_Text_cn: 一、执行安全理事会为维持国际和平及安全之决议所必要之行动，应由联合国全体会员国或由若干会员国担任之，一依安全理事会之决定。
Translation: 1. The actions required to implement the Security Council's decisions for the maintenance of international peace and security shall be undertaken by all Members of the United Nations or by certain Members, as determined by the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、此项决议应由联合国会员国以其直接行动、及经其加入为会员之有关国际机关之行动履行之。
Translation: 2. This resolution shall be implemented by the Member States of the United Nations through their direct actions, as well as through actions taken by relevant international agencies to which they belong as members.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条联合国会员国应通力合作，彼此协助，以执行安全理事会所决定之办法。
Translation: Article 49: The Members of the United Nations shall join in affording mutual assistance in carrying out the measures decided upon by the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十条安全理事会对于任何国家采取防止或执行办法时，其他国家，不论其是否为联合国会员国，遇有因此项办法之执行而引起之特殊经济问题者，应有权与安全理事会会商解决此项问题。
Translation: Article 50: If preventive or enforcement action is taken by the Security Council against any state, any other state, whether a Member of the United Nations or not, which finds itself confronted with special economic problems arising from the carrying out of those measures shall have the right to consult the Security Council with regard to a solution of those problems.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十一条联合国任何会员国受武力攻击时，在安全理事会采取必要办法，以维持国际和平及安全以前，本宪章不得认为禁止行使单独或集体自卫之自然权利。会员国因行使此项自卫权而采取之办法，应立即向安全理事会报告，此项办法于任何方面不得影响该会按照本宪章随时采取其所认为必要行动之权责，以维持或恢复国际和平及安全。
Translation: Article 51: Nothing in the present Charter shall impair the inherent right of individual or collective self-defense if an armed attack occurs against a Member of the United Nations, until the Security Council has taken measures necessary to maintain international peace and security. Measures taken by Members in the exercise of this right of self-defense shall be immediately reported to the Security Council and shall not in any way affect the authority and responsibility of the Security Council under the present Charter to take at any time such action as it deems necessary in order to maintain or restore international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本宪章不得认为排除区域办法或区域机关、用以应付关于维持国际和平及安全而宜于区域行动之事件者；但以此项办法或机关及其工作与联合国之宗旨及原则符合者为限。
Translation: 1. Nothing in this Charter shall be construed as excluding regional arrangements or agencies for dealing with matters that are appropriate for regional action concerning the maintenance of international peace and security; provided, however, that such arrangements or agencies and their activities are consistent with the purposes and principles of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔结此项办法或设立此项机关之联合国会员国，将地方争端提交安全理事会以前，应依该项区域办法，或由该项区域机关，力求和平解决。
Translation: 2. Before submitting local disputes to the Security Council, United Nations member states that are parties to such arrangements or have established such agencies shall seek peaceful settlement through those regional arrangements or by those regional agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 三、安全理事会对于依区域办法或由区域机关而求地方争端之和平解决，不论其系由关系国主动，或由安全理事会提交者，应鼓励其发展。
Translation: 3. The Security Council shall encourage the development of regional arrangements or agencies for the peaceful settlement of local disputes, whether such initiatives are taken by the parties concerned or referred to the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条绝不妨碍第三十四条及第三十五条之适用。
Translation: 4. This article shall in no way prejudice the application of Articles 34 and 35.

Query_Text_cn: 一、安全理事会对于职权内之执行行动，在适当情形下，应利用此项区域办法或区域机关。如无安全理事会之授权，不得依区域办法或由区域机关采取任何执行行动；但关于依第一百零七条之规定对付本条第二项所指之任何敌国之步骤，或在区域办法内所取防备此等国家再施其侵略政策之步骤，截至本组织经各关系政府之请求，对于此等国家之再次侵略，能担负防止责任时为止，不在此限。
Translation: The Security Council shall, where appropriate, utilize regional arrangements or agencies for enforcement action within its authority. No enforcement action shall be taken under regional arrangements or by regional agencies without the authorization of the Security Council; however, measures taken pursuant to Article 107 against any enemy state referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article, or preventive measures within regional arrangements against the recurrence of aggressive policies by such states, shall not be subject to this restriction until the Organization, upon the request of the governments concerned, is able to assume responsibility for preventing further aggression by such states.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一项所称敌国系指第二次世界大战中为本宪章任何签字国之敌国而言。
Translation: 2. The term "enemy state" as used in paragraph 1 of this Article refers to any state which, during the Second World War, was an enemy of any signatory to the present Charter.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十四条关于为维持国际和平及安全起见，依区域办法或由区域机关所已采取或正在考虑之行动，不论何时应向安全理事会充分报告之。
Translation: Article 54: The Security Council shall at all times be fully informed of any actions taken or contemplated under regional arrangements or by regional agencies for the maintenance of international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: （子）较高之生活程度，全民就业，及经济与社会进展。
Translation: A higher standard of living, full employment, and economic and social progress.

Query_Text_cn: 国际间文化及教育合作。
Translation: International cultural and educational cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: （）全体人类之人权及基本自由之普遍尊重与遵守，不分种族、性别、语言、或宗教。
Translation: Universal respect for and observance of human rights and fundamental freedoms for all, regardless of race, gender, language, or religion.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十六条各会员国担允采取共同及个别行动与本组织合作，以达成第五十五条所载之宗旨。
Translation: Article 56: All Members pledge themselves to take joint and separate action in cooperation with the Organization for the achievement of the purposes set forth in Article 55.

Query_Text_cn: 一、由各国政府间协定所成立之各种专门机关，依其组织约章之规定，于经济、社会、文化、教育、卫生、及其他有关部门负有广大国际责任者，应依第六十三条之规定使与联合国发生关系。
Translation: 1. Various specialized agencies established by intergovernmental agreements of different countries, which, in accordance with their constitutions, bear broad international responsibilities in the fields of economic, social, cultural, educational, health, and other related sectors, shall, pursuant to the provisions of Article 63, establish relationships with the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述与联合国发生关系之各专门机关，以下简称专门机关。
Translation: II. The specialized agencies referred to above that have established relations with the United Nations shall hereinafter be referred to as "specialized agencies."

Query_Text_cn: 第五十八条本组织应作成建议，以调整各专门机关之政策及工作。
Translation: Article 58 The Organization shall make recommendations for the coordination of the policies and activities of the specialized agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十九条本组织应于适当情形下，发动各关系国间之谈判，以创设为达成第五十五条规定宗旨所必要之新专门机关。
Translation: Article 59: The Organization shall, where appropriate, initiate negotiations among the relevant states for the creation of new specialized agencies as may be necessary for the accomplishment of the purposes set forth in Article 55.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十条履行本章所载本组织职务之责任，属于大会及大会权力下之经济暨社会理事会。为此目的，该理事会应有第十章所载之权力。
Translation: Article 60 The responsibility for the discharge of the functions of the Organization set forth in this Chapter shall be vested in the General Assembly and, under the authority of the General Assembly, in the Economic and Social Council, which shall have for this purpose the powers set forth in Chapter X.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十一条(注：１９６３年１２月１７日经大会通过修正，１９６５年８月３１日生效。六十一条的修正案将经济及社会理事会理事国自十八国增至二十七国。
