Translation: Article 61 (Note: Amended by the General Assembly on December 17, 1963, effective August 31, 1965. The amendment to Article 61 increased the number of members of the Economic and Social Council from eighteen to twenty-seven.)

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会由大会选举联合国二十七会员国组织之。
Translation: 1. The Economic and Social Council shall be composed of twenty-seven Member States of the United Nations elected by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除第三款所规定外，经济暨社会理事会每年选举理事九国，任期三年。任满之理事国得即行连选。
Translation: 2. Except as provided in paragraph 3, the Economic and Social Council shall elect nine members each year for a term of three years. A retiring member shall be eligible for immediate re-election.

Query_Text_cn: 三、经济暨社会理事会理事国自十八国增至二十七国后第一次选举时，除选举理事六国接替任期在该年年终届满之理事国外，应另增选理事九国。增选之理事九国中，三国任期一年，另三国任期二年，依大会所定办法。
Translation: 3. At the first election following the increase in the number of members of the Economic and Social Council from eighteen to twenty-seven, in addition to electing six members to replace those whose terms expire at the end of that year, nine additional members shall be elected. Of these nine additional members, three shall serve for one year and another three for two years, in accordance with the procedure established by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 四、经济暨社会理事会之每一理事国应有代表一人。
Translation: Each member of the Economic and Social Council shall be represented by one representative.

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会得作成或发动关于国际经济、社会、文化、教育、卫生、及其他有关事项之研究及报告；并得向大会、联合国会员国、及关系专门机关、提出关于此种事项之建议案。
Translation: 1. The Economic and Social Council may initiate or conduct studies and reports on international economic, social, cultural, educational, health, and other related matters; it may also submit recommendations on such matters to the General Assembly, United Nations Member States, and relevant specialized agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本理事会为增进全体人类之人权及基本自由之尊重及维护起见，得作成建议案。
Translation: 2. For the purpose of promoting and encouraging respect for and observance of human rights and fundamental freedoms for all, this Council may make recommendations.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本理事会得拟具关于其职权范围内事项之协约草案，提交大会。
Translation: III. The Council may draft agreements concerning matters within its scope of authority and submit them to the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本理事会得依联合国所定之规则召集本理事会职务范围以内事项之国际会议。
Translation: 4. The Council may convene international conferences on matters within its scope of duties in accordance with the rules established by the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会得与第五十七条所指之任何专门机关订立协定，订明关系专门机关与联合国发生关系之条件。该项协定须经大会之核准。
Translation: 1. The Economic and Social Council may enter into agreements with any of the specialized agencies referred to in Article 57, specifying the conditions under which such agencies shall be brought into relationship with the United Nations. Such agreements shall be subject to approval by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本理事会，为调整各种专门机关之工作，得与此种机关会商并得向其提出建议，并得向大会及联合国会员国建议。
Translation: II. This Council, in order to coordinate the activities of various specialized agencies, may consult with such agencies and make recommendations to them, as well as to the General Assembly and the Member States of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会得取适当步骤，以取得专门机关之经常报告。本理事会得与联合国会员国及专门机关，商定办法俾就实施本理事会之建议及大会对于本理事会职权范围内事项之建议所采之步骤，取得报告。
Translation: 1. The Economic and Social Council may take appropriate steps to obtain regular reports from specialized agencies. The Council may agree with United Nations Member States and specialized agencies on arrangements for obtaining reports regarding the steps taken to implement the Council's recommendations and those of the General Assembly on matters within the Council's competence.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本理事会得将对于此项报告之意见提送大会。
Translation: II. The Council may submit its opinions on this report to the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十五条经济暨社会理事会得向安全理事会供给情报，并因安全理事会之邀请，予以协助。
Translation: Article 65: The Economic and Social Council may furnish information to the Security Council and shall assist the Security Council upon its request.

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会应履行其职权范围内关于执行大会建议之职务。
Translation: 1. The Economic and Social Council shall perform its duties regarding the implementation of the recommendations of the General Assembly within the scope of its authority.

Query_Text_cn: 二、经大会之许可，本理事会得应联合国会员国或专门机关之请求，供其服务。
Translation: With the permission of the General Assembly, the Council may, at the request of any Member State of the United Nations or any specialized agency, render services to them.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本理事会应履行本宪章他章所特定之其他职务，以及大会所授予之职务。
Translation: III. The Council shall perform such other functions as are specified in other chapters of this Charter, as well as those assigned by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会每一理事国应有一个投票权。
Translation: Each member of the Economic and Social Council shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本理事会之决议，应以到会及投票之理事国过半数表决之。
Translation: Resolutions of this Council shall be adopted by a majority vote of the member states present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十八条经济暨社会理事会应设立经济与社会部门及以提倡人权为目的之各种委员会，并得设立于行使职务所必需之其他委员会。
Translation: Article 68: The Economic and Social Council shall establish commissions in the economic and social fields, as well as commissions for the promotion of human rights, and may establish such other commissions as may be required for the performance of its functions.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十九条经济暨社会理事会应请联合国会员国参加讨论本理事会对于该国有特别关系之任何事件，但无投票权。
Translation: Article 69: The Economic and Social Council may invite any Member of the United Nations to participate, without vote, in its discussions on any matter of particular concern to that Member.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十条经济暨社会理事会得商定办法使专门机关之代表无投票权而参加本理事会及本理事会所设各委员会之讨论，或使本理事会之代表参加此项专门机关之讨论。
Translation: Article 70: The Economic and Social Council may make arrangements for representatives of the specialized agencies to participate, without the right to vote, in the discussions of the Council and of its committees, and for representatives of the Council to participate in the discussions of those specialized agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十一条经济暨社会理事会得采取适当办法，俾与各种非政府组织会商有关于本理事会职权范围内之事件。此项办法得与国际组织商定之，并于适当情形下，经与关系联合国会员国会商后，得与该国国内组织商定之。
Translation: Article 71: The Economic and Social Council may make suitable arrangements for consultation with non-governmental organizations which are concerned with matters within its competence. Such arrangements may be made with international organizations and, where appropriate, with national organizations after consultation with the Member of the United Nations concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会应自行制定其议事规则，包括其推选主席之方法。
Translation: 1. The Economic and Social Council shall establish its own rules of procedure, including the method for electing its President.

Query_Text_cn: 二、经济暨社会理事会应依其规则举行必要之会议。此项规则应包括因理事国过半数之请求而召集会议之条款。
Translation: 2. The Economic and Social Council shall hold such meetings as may be required in accordance with its rules. These rules shall include provisions for convening meetings at the request of a majority of the members of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: （子）于充分尊重关系人民之文化下，保证其政治、经济、社会、及教育之进展，予以公平待遇，且保障其不受虐待。
Translation: (1) With full respect for the culture of the peoples concerned, ensure their political, economic, social, and educational advancement, provide fair treatment, and protect them from abuse.

Query_Text_cn: （丑）按各领土及其人民特殊之环境、及其进化之阶段，发展自治；对各该人民之政治愿望，予以适当之注意；并助其自由政治制度之逐渐发展。
Translation: (B) To develop self-government according to the particular circumstances of each territory and its people, as well as the stage of their advancement; to give due consideration to the political aspirations of these peoples; and to assist in the progressive development of their free political institutions.

Query_Text_cn: （）促进国际和平及安全。
Translation: () promotes international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: （卯）提倡建设计划，以求进步；奖励研究；各国彼此合作，并于适当之时间及场合与专门国际团体合作，以求本条所载社会、经济、及科学目的之实现。
Translation: (d) To promote the adoption of measures for advancement; to encourage research; to cooperate with one another and, when appropriate, with specialized international organizations, in order to achieve the social, economic, and scientific objectives set forth in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: （）在不违背安全及宪法之限制下，按时将关于各会员国分别负责管理领土内之经济、社会、及教育情形之统计及具有专门性质之情报，递送秘书长，以供参考。本宪章第十二章及第十三章所规定之领土，不在此限。
Translation: ( ) shall, subject to the limitations imposed by security and constitutional requirements, regularly transmit to the Secretary-General, for information purposes, statistical and other specialized reports regarding the economic, social, and educational conditions in the territories for the administration of which they are respectively responsible. The territories to which Chapters XII and XIII of this Charter apply are excepted from the foregoing provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十四条联合国各会员国公同承诺对于本章规定之领土，一如对于本国区域，其政策必须以善邻之道奉为圭臬；并于社会、经济、及商业上，对世界各国之利益及幸福，予以充分之注意。
Translation: Article 74: The Members of the United Nations also agree that their policy in respect of the territories to which this Chapter applies, no less than in respect of their own territories, must be based on the general principle of good-neighborliness, and due account must be taken of the interests and well-being of the rest of the world, in social, economic, and commercial matters.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十五条联合国在其权力下，应设立国际托管制度，以管理并监督凭此后个别协定而置于该制度下之领土。此项领土以下简称托管领土。
Translation: Article 75: The United Nations shall establish an international trusteeship system under its authority to administer and supervise territories placed under this system by subsequent individual agreements. These territories shall hereinafter be referred to as trust territories.

Query_Text_cn: （子）促进国际和平及安全。
Translation: (Sub-item) Promote international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: （丑）增进托管领土居民之政治、经济、社会、及教育之进展；并以适合各领土及其人民之特殊情形及关系人民自由表示之愿望为原则，且按照各托管协定之条款，增进其趋向自治或独立之逐渐发展。
Translation: (b) To promote the political, economic, social, and educational advancement of the inhabitants of the Trust Territories, taking into account the particular circumstances and needs of each territory and its peoples, as well as their freely expressed wishes, and in accordance with the terms of the respective trusteeship agreements, to further their progressive development towards self-government or independence.

Query_Text_cn: （）不分种族、性别、语言、或宗教，提倡全体人类之人权及基本自由之尊重，并激发世界人民互相维系之意识。
Translation: It promotes respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms for all people, regardless of race, gender, language, or religion, and fosters a sense of mutual connection among peoples around the world.

Query_Text_cn: （卯）于社会、经济、及商业事件上，保证联合国全体会员国及其国民之平等待遇，及各该国民于司法裁判上之平等待遇，但以不妨碍上述目的之达成，且不违背第八十条之规定为限。
Translation: (d) In social, economic, and commercial matters, ensure equal treatment for all United Nations member states and their nationals, as well as equal treatment for the nationals of each state in judicial proceedings, provided that such measures do not impede the achievement of the aforementioned objectives and are not contrary to the provisions of Article 80.

Query_Text_cn: （子）现在委任统治下之领土。
Translation: (Sub) Territories currently under appointed rule.

Query_Text_cn: （丑）因第二次世界大战结果或将自敌国割离之领土。
Translation: (Territory) Territory separated from enemy states as a result of World War II.

Query_Text_cn: （）负管理责任之国家自愿置于该制度下之领土。
Translation: The territory voluntarily placed under the system by a state bearing administrative responsibility.

Query_Text_cn: 二、关于上列种类中之何种领土将置于托管制度之下，及其条件，为此后协定所当规定之事项。
Translation: 2. The specific territories among the aforementioned categories to be placed under the trusteeship system, as well as the terms and conditions thereof, shall be determined by subsequent agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十八条凡领土已成为联合国之会员国者，不适用托管制度；联合国会员国间之关系，应基于尊重主权平等之原则。
Translation: Article 78 The trusteeship system shall not apply to territories which have become members of the United Nations; relations among United Nations member states shall be based on the principle of respect for sovereign equality.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十九条置于托管制度下之每一领土之托管条款，及其更改或修正，应由直接关系各国、包括联合国之会员国而为委任统治地之受托国者，予以议定，其核准应依第八十三条及第八十五条之规定。
Translation: The terms of trusteeship for each territory placed under the trusteeship system, including any alteration or amendment thereof, shall be agreed upon by the States directly concerned, including the mandatory power if it is a Member of the United Nations, and shall be approved in accordance with the provisions of Articles 83 and 85.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除依第七十七条、第七十九条，及第八十一条所订置各领土于托管制度下之个别托管协定另有议定外，并在该项协定未经缔结以前，本章任何规定绝对不得解释为以任何方式变更任何国家或人民之权利、或联合国会员国个别签订之现有国际约章之条款。
Translation: 1. Except as provided in Articles 77, 79, and 81, and unless otherwise agreed in specific trusteeship agreements concluded for each territory under the trusteeship system, and prior to the conclusion of such agreements, nothing in this Chapter shall be construed as in any way altering the rights of any state or people, or the terms of existing international instruments to which Members of the United Nations may be parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一项不得解释为对于依第七十七条之规定而订置委任统治地或其他领土于托管制度下之协定，授以延展商订之理由。
Translation: 2. The first paragraph of this Article shall not be interpreted as providing grounds for extending the right to negotiate agreements placing trust territories or other territories under the trusteeship system in accordance with the provisions of Article 77.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十一条凡托管协定均应载有管理领土之条款，并指定管理托管领土之当局。该项当局，以下简称管理当局，得为一个或数个国家，或为联合国本身。
Translation: Article 81: All trusteeship agreements shall include provisions for the administration of the territory and designate the authority responsible for administering the trust territory. This authority, hereinafter referred to as the administering authority, may be one or more countries, or the United Nations itself.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十二条于任何托管协定内，得指定一个或数个战略防区，包括该项协定下之托管领土之一部或全部，但该项协定并不妨碍依第四十三条而订立之任何特别协定。
Translation: Article 82: Any trusteeship agreement may designate one or more strategic areas, including all or part of the trust territory to which the agreement applies, but such agreement shall not prejudice any special agreements concluded pursuant to Article 43.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国关于战略防区之各项职务，包括此项托管协定条款之核准、及其更改或修正，应由安全理事会行使之。
Translation: 1. All functions of the United Nations relating to strategic areas, including the approval of the terms of this trusteeship agreement and any amendments or modifications thereto, shall be exercised by the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第七十六条所规定之基本目的，适用于每一战略防区之人民。
Translation: 2. The fundamental objectives stipulated in Article 76 apply to the people of every strategic defense zone.

Query_Text_cn: 三、安全理事会以不违背托管协定之规定且不妨碍安全之考虑为限，应利用托管理事会之协助，以履行联合国托管制度下关于战略防区内之政治、经济、社会、及教育事件之职务。
Translation: 3. The Security Council shall, to the extent that it does not contravene the provisions of the trusteeship agreements and does not impede considerations of security, utilize the assistance of the Trusteeship Council in carrying out its functions under the United Nations trusteeship system with respect to political, economic, social, and educational matters in strategic areas.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十四条管理当局有保证托管领土对于维持国际和平及安全尽其本分之义务。该当局为此目的得到用托管领土之志愿军、便利、及协助，以履行该当局对于安全理事会所负关于此点之义务，并以实行地方自卫，且在托管领土内维持法律与秩序。
Translation: Article 84: The administering authority is obligated to ensure that the trust territory fulfills its responsibilities in maintaining international peace and security. For this purpose, the authority may utilize volunteer forces, facilities, and assistance from the trust territory to discharge its obligations to the Security Council in this regard, to implement local self-defense, and to maintain law and order within the trust territory.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国关于一切非战略防区托管协定之职务，包括此项托管协定条款之核准及其更改或修正，应由大会行使之。
Translation: 1. The functions of the United Nations with respect to trusteeship agreements for all non-strategic areas, including the approval of the terms of such trusteeship agreements and their alteration or amendment, shall be exercised by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 二、托管理事会于大会权力下，应协助大会履行上述之职务。
Translation: 2. The Trusteeship Council, under the authority of the General Assembly, shall assist the Assembly in carrying out the aforementioned functions.

Query_Text_cn: （子）管理托管领土之会员国。
Translation: (Member) States administering trust territories.

Query_Text_cn: （丑）第二十三条所列名之国家而现非管理托管领土者。
Translation: The countries listed in Article 23(b) that are not currently administering trust territories.

Query_Text_cn: （）大会选举必要数额之其他会员国，任期三年，俾使托管理事会理事国之总数，于联合国会员国中之管理托管领土者及不管理者之间，得以平均分配。
Translation: ...the General Assembly shall elect as many other members as may be necessary for a term of three years, so that the total number of members of the Trusteeship Council shall be distributed as evenly as possible among the United Nations Members administering trust territories and those which do not.

Query_Text_cn: 二、托管理事会之每一理事国应指定一特别合格之人员，以代表之。
Translation: Each member state of the Trusteeship Council shall designate a specially qualified individual to represent it.

Query_Text_cn: （子）审查管理当局所送之报告。
Translation: (Sub-item) Review the reports submitted by the supervisory authorities.

Query_Text_cn: （丑）会同管理当局接受并审查请愿书。
Translation: (Ugly) Jointly with the management authorities, accept and review petitions.

Query_Text_cn: （）与管理当局商定时间，按期视察各托管领土。
Translation: ( ) agrees on a schedule with the administering authorities and inspects the trust territories as scheduled.

Query_Text_cn: （卯）依托管协定之条款，采取上述其他行动。
Translation: (d) Take the aforementioned other actions in accordance with the provisions of the custodial agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十八条托管理事会应拟定关于各托管领土居民之政治、经济、社会、及教育进展之问题单；就大会职权范围内，各托管领土之管理当局应根据该项问题单向大会提出常年报告。
Translation: Article 88: The Trusteeship Council shall formulate a questionnaire concerning the political, economic, social, and educational advancement of the inhabitants of each trust territory. Within the scope of the powers of the General Assembly, the administering authorities of each trust territory shall submit annual reports to the General Assembly based on this questionnaire.

Query_Text_cn: 一、托管理事会之每一理事国应有一个投票权。
Translation: Each member of the Trusteeship Council shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: 二、托管理事会之决议应以到会及投票之理事国过半数表决之。
Translation: 2. Decisions of the Trusteeship Council shall be made by a majority vote of the member states present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 一、托管理事会应自行制定其议事规则，包括其推选主席之方法。
Translation: 1. The Trusteeship Council shall establish its own rules of procedure, including the method for selecting its chairman.

Query_Text_cn: 二、托管理事会应依其所定规则，举行必要之会议。此项规则应包括关于经该会理事国过半数之请求而召集会议之规定。
Translation: 2. The Trusteeship Council shall hold such meetings as may be necessary in accordance with its rules. These rules shall include provisions for convening meetings at the request of a majority of the member states of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十一条托管理事会于适当时，应利用经济暨社会理事会之协助，并对于各关系事项，利用专门机关之协助。
Translation: Article 91: The Trusteeship Council shall, at appropriate times, utilize the assistance of the Economic and Social Council and, with respect to all relevant matters, the assistance of specialized agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十二条国际法院为联合国之主要司法机关，应依所附规约执行其职务。该项规约系以国际常设法院之规约为根据，并为本宪章之构成部分。
Translation: Article 92: The International Court of Justice shall be the principal judicial organ of the United Nations. It shall perform its functions in accordance with the annexed Statute, which is based on the Statute of the Permanent Court of International Justice and forms an integral part of this Charter.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国各会员国为国际法院规约之当然当事国。
Translation: 1. All members of the United Nations are ipso facto parties to the Statute of the International Court of Justice.

Query_Text_cn: 二、非联合国会员国之国家得为国际法院规约当事国之条件，应由大会经安全理事会之建议就各别情形决定之。
Translation: 2. The conditions under which states that are not members of the United Nations may become parties to the Statute of the International Court of Justice shall, in each case, be determined by the General Assembly upon the recommendation of the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国每一会员国为任何案件之当事国者，承诺遵行国际法院之判决。
Translation: 1. Each member of the United Nations, as a party to any case, undertakes to comply with the judgment of the International Court of Justice.

Query_Text_cn: 二、遇有一造不履行依法院判决应负之义务时，他造得向于安全理事会申诉。安全理事会如认为必要时，得作成建议或决定应采办法，以执行判决。
Translation: 2. If one party fails to fulfill the obligations imposed by a judgment of the court, the other party may appeal to the Security Council. If the Security Council deems it necessary, it may make recommendations or decide upon measures to be taken to enforce the judgment.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十五条本宪章不得认为禁止联合国会员国依据现有或以后缔结之协定，将其争端托付其他法院解决。
Translation: Article 95 Nothing in the present Charter shall prevent Members of the United Nations from entrusting the settlement of their disputes to other tribunals by virtue of agreements already in force or which may be concluded in the future.

Query_Text_cn: 一、大会或安全理事会对于任何法律问题得请国际法院发表咨询意见。
Translation: The General Assembly or the Security Council may request the International Court of Justice to give an advisory opinion on any legal question.

Query_Text_cn: 二、联合国其他机关、及各种专门机关，对于其工作范围内之任何法律问题，得随时以大会之授权，请求国际法院发表咨询意见。
Translation: II. Other organs of the United Nations and various specialized agencies may, at any time and within the scope of their work, request the International Court of Justice to give an advisory opinion on any legal question, subject to authorization by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十七条秘书处置秘书长一人及本组织所需之办事人员若干人。秘书长应由大会经安全理事会之推荐委派之。秘书长为本组织之行政首长。
Translation: Article 97: The Secretariat shall comprise a Secretary-General and such staff as the Organization may require. The Secretary-General shall be appointed by the General Assembly upon the recommendation of the Security Council. The Secretary-General shall be the chief administrative officer of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十八条秘书长在大会、安全理事会、经济暨社会理事会、及托管理事会之一切会议，应以秘书长资格行使职务，并应执行各该机关所托付之其他职务。秘书长应向大会提送关于本组织工作之常年报告。
Translation:
Article 98

The Secretary-General shall act in that capacity in all meetings of the General Assembly, the Security Council, the Economic and Social Council, and the Trusteeship Council, and shall perform such other functions as are entrusted to him by these organs. The Secretary-General shall make an annual report to the General Assembly on the work of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十九条秘书长得将其所认为可能威胁国际和平及安全之任何事件，提请安全理事会注意。
Translation: Article 99: The Secretary-General may bring to the attention of the Security Council any matter which, in his opinion, may threaten the maintenance of international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: 一、秘书长及办事人员于执行职务时，不得请求或接受本组织以外任何政府或其他当局之训示，并应避免足以妨碍其国际官员地位之行动。秘书长及办事人员专对本组织负责。
Translation: 1. In the performance of their duties, the Secretary-General and the staff shall not seek or receive instructions from any government or other authority external to the Organization, and shall refrain from any action which might reflect on their status as international officials. The Secretary-General and the staff shall be responsible only to the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 二、联合国各会员国承诺尊重秘书长及办事人员责任之专属国际性，决不设法影响其责任之履行。
Translation: 2. The Member States of the United Nations pledge to respect the exclusively international character of the responsibilities of the Secretary-General and the staff, and to refrain from attempting to influence the discharge of their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 一、办事人员由秘书长依大会所定章程委派之。
Translation: 1. Staff members shall be appointed by the Secretary-General in accordance with the rules established by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 二、适当之办事人员应长期分配于经济暨社会理事会、托管理事会、并于必要时，分配于联合国其他之机关。此项办事人员构成秘书处之一部。
Translation: 2. Appropriate staff members shall be assigned on a long-term basis to the Economic and Social Council and the Trusteeship Council, and, when necessary, to other organs of the United Nations. These staff members shall constitute a part of the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 三、办事人员之雇用及其服务条件之决定，应以求达效率、才干、及忠诚之最高标准为首要考虑。征聘办事人员时，于可能范围内，应充分注意地域上之普及。
Translation: 3. The employment of staff and the determination of their conditions of service shall be primarily guided by the highest standards of efficiency, competence, and integrity. In recruiting staff, due regard shall be paid, as far as possible, to the principle of geographical distribution.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本宪章发生效力后，联合国任何会员国所缔结之一切条约及国际协定应尽速在秘书处登记，并由秘书处公布之。
Translation: 1. After the entry into force of this Charter, every treaty and international agreement entered into by any Member of the United Nations shall be registered with the Secretariat as soon as possible and published by it.

Query_Text_cn: 二、当事国对于未经依本条第一项规定登记之条约或国际协定，不得向联合国任何机关援引之。
Translation: 2. A party may not invoke any treaty or international agreement before any organ of the United Nations if it has not been registered in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: （一）“航空当局”，中华人民共和国方面指中国民用航空总局，丹麦王国方面指公共工程部，或双方均指被授权执行与本协定有关的职能的任何个人或机构。
Translation: (a) "Aeronautical authorities" means, in the case of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Aviation Administration of China, and in the case of the Kingdom of Denmark, the Ministry of Public Works, or, in both cases, any person or agency authorized to perform any functions related to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （二）“指定空运企业”，指根据本协定第三条规定经指定和获许的空运企业。
Translation: (ii) "Designated airline" refers to an airline that has been designated and authorized in accordance with the provisions of Article 3 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （三）“航班”，指以飞机从事旅客、行李、货物和邮件的公共运输的任何定期航班。
Translation: (3) "Flight" refers to any scheduled flight operated by aircraft for the public transportation of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail.

Query_Text_cn: （四）“国际航班”，指飞越一个以上国家领土的航班。
Translation: (iv) "International flight" refers to a flight that traverses the territory of more than one country.

Query_Text_cn: （五）“空运企业”，指经营国际航班的任何航空运输企业。
Translation: (v) "Air transport enterprise" refers to any airline operating international flights.

Query_Text_cn: （六）“非运输业务性经停”，指目的不在于装上或卸下旅客、行李、货物或邮件的降停。
Translation: (vi) "Non-traffic stop" refers to a landing where the purpose is not to embark or disembark passengers, baggage, cargo, or mail.

Query_Text_cn: （七）“运价规章”，指为运输旅客、行李和货物所支付的价格以及采用这些价格的条件，包括代理和提供其他附属服务的价格和条件，但不包括运输邮件的报酬和条件。
Translation: (7) "Tariff regulations" refer to the prices paid for the transportation of passengers, baggage, and cargo, as well as the conditions under which these prices are applied, including the prices and conditions for agency and the provision of other ancillary services, but excluding the remuneration and conditions for mail transportation.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条业务权利一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件所规定的航线（以下称“规定航线”）上建立和经营定期航班（以下称为“协议航班”）的权利。
Translation:
Article 2 Business Rights

1. Each contracting party grants the other contracting party the right to establish and operate scheduled flights (hereinafter referred to as "agreed flights") on the routes specified in the annex to this agreement (hereinafter referred to as "specified routes").

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业在其季节飞行时刻表经缔约另一方航空当局同意后，有权沿该当局规定的航路，不降停飞越缔约另一方领土。
Translation: 2. Once the designated air carrier of one Contracting Party has obtained approval from the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party for its seasonal flight schedule, it shall have the right to overfly the territory of the other Contracting Party without landing, along routes prescribed by the said authorities.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点经停，以便上下国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: (b) To designate points on the specified routes within the territory of the other contracting party for the purpose of embarking and disembarking international passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的一点与该领土内另一点间，除该空运企业的人员及其家属和行李外，无权装载旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: 4. The designated airline of one contracting party shall not have the right to embark passengers, baggage, cargo, or mail, except for its own personnel and their families and baggage, between any point within the territory of the other contracting party and another point within that territory.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方应将其指定空运企业开航协议航班的日期，至少提前六十天通知缔约另一方。
Translation: 5. Either Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party of the date on which its designated airline intends to commence scheduled flights at least sixty days in advance.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条空运企业的指定和经营许可一、缔约一方有权通过向缔约另一方提交外交照会,指定一家空运企业,经营本协定附件规定航线上的协议航班。
Translation:
Article 3 Designation and Operating Permit of Air Transport Enterprises

1. Either Contracting Party shall have the right to designate an air transport enterprise, by submitting a diplomatic note to the other Contracting Party, to operate the agreed services on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业的主要所有权和有效管理权应属于该缔约方或其公民。
Translation: 2. The designated airline of either contracting party shall be substantially owned and effectively controlled by that contracting party or its nationals.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在不违反本条第二款规定的情况下，缔约另一方在收到上述指定后，应立即将合适的经营许可发给缔约一方指定空运企业。
Translation: 3. Without prejudice to the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article, upon receipt of the above designation, the other Contracting Party shall, without delay, grant the appropriate operating authorization to the air transport enterprise designated by the Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非本条第一款所述的取消、暂停或规定条件必须立即执行，以防止进一步违反法律和规定，否则只能在与缔约另一方协商后方可行使这种权利。
Translation: 2. Unless the cancellation, suspension, or imposition of conditions described in Paragraph 1 of this Article must be implemented immediately to prevent further violations of laws and regulations, such rights may only be exercised after consultation with the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条法律和规定的遵守一、缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留、航行的法律和规定，以及关于旅客、机组、行李、货物和邮件进出其领土和在其领土内停留的法律和规定，均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、机组和所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation:
Article 5 Compliance with Laws and Regulations

1. The laws and regulations of one contracting party concerning the entry, stay, and navigation of aircraft engaged in international flights within its territory, as well as those relating to the entry, stay, and departure of passengers, crew, baggage, cargo, and mail within its territory, shall apply to the aircraft, crew, passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail of the designated air carrier of the other contracting party while they are within the territory of the first contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方应及时向缔约另一方提供有关法律和规定的资料。
Translation: Each contracting party shall promptly provide the other contracting party with information regarding relevant laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方应尽力避免对缔约另一方指定空运企业的飞机，造成不必要的延误。
Translation: 2. Each Contracting Party shall make every effort to avoid causing unnecessary delays to the aircraft of the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条关税和其他税捐的豁免一、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机及留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品，在进出缔约另一方领土时，缔约另一方应在互惠基础上豁免任何关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation:
Article 6 Exemption from Customs Duties and Other Taxes

1. Aircraft operated by the designated airlines of one Contracting Party on the specified routes, as well as the normal equipment, spare parts, fuel, oils, lubricants, and onboard supplies retained on such aircraft, shall, on entry into or exit from the territory of the other Contracting Party, be exempt from all customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes on a reciprocal basis by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （三）为缔约另一方指定空运企业飞行国际航班的飞机加注的燃料和润滑油，即使这些燃料和润滑油系供在加注的缔约方境内的航段上使用。
Translation: (3) Fuel and lubricants supplied to aircraft operated by an airline designated by the other contracting party for international flights shall be exempt, even if such fuel and lubricants are intended for use on the domestic segment of the route within the territory of the contracting party where they are supplied.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条机上设备和物资的储存留置在缔约一方指定空运企业飞机上的机上正常设备、物资和供应品，经缔约另一方海关当局同意后，方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation:
Article 7 Storage and Retention of Onboard Equipment and Supplies

Normal onboard equipment, materials, and supplies stored on aircraft operated by designated airlines of one Contracting Party may only be unloaded within the territory of the other Contracting Party with the consent of the customs authorities of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条技术服务的提供和费率一、缔约一方应在其领土内，为缔约另一方指定空运企业指定供经营规定航线使用的主用机场和备降机场，并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation:
Article 8 Provision of Technical Services and Rates

1. Each Contracting Party shall, within its territory, designate the primary and alternate airports for use by the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party operating the specified routes, and shall provide the communication, navigation, meteorological, and other ancillary services required for the operation of the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 具体办法由缔约双方航空当局协议。
Translation: The specific measures shall be agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场、设备和技术服务所付的费率，不应高于其他国家空运企业所付的费率。
Translation: 2. The rates charged by one Contracting Party for the use of its airports, equipment, and technical services by the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party shall not be higher than those paid by airlines of any other country.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条运力规定一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班方面，应享有合理平等的机会。
Translation:
Article 9 Capacity Provisions

1. The designated airlines of both contracting parties shall enjoy reasonable and equal opportunities to operate agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在经营协议航班时,缔约一方指定空运企业应考虑到缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益,以免不适当地影响后者在相同航线上或其航段上所提供的航班。
Translation: 2. In operating the agreed services, the designated airline of one Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party so as not to unduly affect the services provided by the latter on the same route or any section thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方指定空运企业应就各自航班的形式相互协商。
Translation: The designated airlines of both contracting parties shall mutually consult on the modalities of their respective flights.

Query_Text_cn: 有关缔约一方指定空运企业的飞行时刻表（包括机型和班次）的任何事项，应经缔约另一方航空当局同意。
Translation: Any matters concerning the flight schedules (including aircraft types and frequencies) of the designated airlines of one Contracting Party shall be subject to the approval of the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班，应与公众对规定航线上的运输需要保持密切的关系，并以提供足够的运力为其主要目的，以满足当前和合理地预计到的、由指定该空运企业的缔约方领土内始发或以该领土为终点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输要求。
Translation: 3. The scheduled services operated by the designated airlines of both contracting parties shall be closely related to the public's demand for transportation on the specified routes, with the primary objective of providing adequate capacity to meet the current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the contracting party designating the airline.

Query_Text_cn: （一）来自和前往指定该空运企业的缔约方领土的业务需要；（二）在考虑到协议航班所经地区国家的空运企业所建立的其他航班后，该地区的业务需要；（三）联程航班经营的需要。
Translation: (1) The business needs arising from and destined for the territory of the contracting party designating the airline; (2) The business needs of the region, taking into account other flights established by airlines of countries in the region traversed by the agreed flights; (3) The requirements for operating connecting flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条运价规章的制定一、缔约一方指定空运企业对前往或来自缔约另一方领土的运输所收取的运价，应在合理的水平上制定，适当照顾到一切有关因素，包括经营成本、合理的利润和其他空运企业的运价。
Translation:
Article 10 Formulation of Tariff Regulations

1. The tariffs charged by the designated airlines of one Contracting Party for transportation to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be established at reasonable levels, taking due account of all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profit, and the tariffs of other airlines.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述运价，应由缔约双方指定空运企业协议，如有必要和可能，可与经营相同航线或航段的其他空运企业进行协商。
Translation: 2. The tariffs referred to in Paragraph 1 of this Article shall be agreed upon by the designated airlines of both contracting parties and, where necessary and possible, may be established through consultation with other airlines operating on the same routes or segments.

Query_Text_cn: 三、按此协议的运价至少应在其拟议实行日期前九十天，提交缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: 3. The fares under this agreement shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of both contracting parties for approval at least ninety days prior to their proposed effective date.

Query_Text_cn: 在特殊情况下，经上述当局协议，这一时限可予缩短。
Translation: In special circumstances, this time limit may be shortened by agreement of the aforementioned authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如缔约双方指定空运企业未能根据本条第二款规定就运价达成协议，或缔约一方航空当局对根据第二款规定所协议的运价，向缔约另一方航空当局发出异议通知，缔约双方航空当局应在与其他有关国家的航空当局协商后设法确定运价。
Translation: 4. If the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on fares in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article, or if the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party notify the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party of their objection to the fares agreed upon pursuant to paragraph 2, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall, after consultation with the aeronautical authorities of other relevant countries, endeavor to determine the fares.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如缔约双方航空当局未能就根据本条第三款规定向其提交的任何运价，或根据本条第四款就运价的确定达成协议，此项分歧应通过外交途径予以解决。
Translation: 5. If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach agreement on any tariff submitted to them in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 3 of this Article, or on the determination of any tariff pursuant to paragraph 4 of this Article, such disagreement shall be settled through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 六、在新运价制定以前，根据本条各项规定制定的运价仍应有效。
Translation: 6. Prior to the establishment of new tariffs, the tariffs formulated in accordance with the provisions of this article shall remain in effect.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条财务规定缔约一方指定空运企业因运输旅客、行李、货物和邮件而在缔约另一方领土内所得的收支余额，缔约另一方应同意缔约一方按正式汇率自由结汇。
Translation:
Article 11 Financial Provisions

The balance of income and expenditure obtained by the designated airline of one contracting party within the territory of the other contracting party from the transportation of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail shall be freely convertible and remitted at the official exchange rate, subject to the agreement of the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约双方间的支付按一项特别协定进行，这项协定应适用。
Translation: If payments between the contracting parties are governed by a special agreement, that agreement shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条统计资料的提供缔约一方航空当局应按缔约另一方航空当局的要求，向后者提供缔约一方指定空运企业在协议航班上所载来自或前往缔约另一方领土的业务统计。
Translation:
Article 12 Provision of Statistical Data

Upon request by the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party, the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party shall provide statistical data regarding the traffic carried on the agreed services by the designated airlines of the former, originating from or destined for the territory of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条代表机构一、缔约一方指定空运企业为了经营规定航线，有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线的通航地点设立代表机构。
Translation:
Article 13 Representative Offices

1. For the purpose of operating the designated routes, the designated airlines of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish representative offices at the points of operation on the designated routes within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人员应为中华人民共和国和丹麦王国公民，其人数由缔约双方指定空运企业商定，并经缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: The personnel of the representative offices shall be citizens of the People's Republic of China and the Kingdom of Denmark. Their number shall be determined by mutual agreement between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and approved by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构人员必须遵守驻在国的现行法律和规定。
Translation: Personnel of representative agencies must comply with the current laws and regulations of the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方应为缔约另一方指定空运企业的代表机构和工作人员提供协助和便利。
Translation: 2. Each Contracting Party shall provide assistance and facilitation to the representative offices and personnel of the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条空运企业的经营安全缔约一方应在可能范围内，保护在其领土内的空运企业的经营安全。
Translation: Article 14 The contracting party responsible for the operational safety of air transport enterprises shall, to the extent possible, protect the operational safety of air transport enterprises within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条证件一、缔约一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的飞机，应具有该缔约方国籍标志和登记标志。
Translation:
Article 15 Certificates

1. Aircraft operated by the designated airline of one Contracting Party on scheduled flights under this Agreement shall bear the nationality and registration marks of that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约一方指定空运企业提出申请，并经缔约另一方航空当局的同意，可使用其他国籍的飞机。
Translation: If an airline designated by one Contracting Party submits an application and obtains the consent of the aviation authorities of the other Contracting Party, aircraft of other nationalities may be used.

Query_Text_cn: （一）登记证；（二）适航证；（三）航行记录表；（四）机上无线电台执照；（五）每一空勤组成员的执照或证件；（六）如载有旅客，携带注明起讫地点的旅客名单；（七）如载有货物和邮件，携带货物和邮件舱单；（八）如缔约任何一方需要，携带与国际标准一致的总申报单；（九）如飞机载有根据缔约另一方规定应受限制的货物，携带必要的许可。
三、缔约一方颁发的上述有效证件和执照，缔约另一方应予承认。
Translation: 3. The valid certificates and licenses issued by one contracting party shall be recognized by the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条机组国籍缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的机组成员，应分别为本国公民。
Translation: Article 16 The crew members of the designated airlines of each Contracting Party operating on the specified routes shall be citizens of their respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 经缔约另一方航空当局同意，可雇佣其他国籍的机组成员飞行协议航班。
Translation: With the consent of the other contracting party's aviation authorities, crew members of other nationalities may be employed to operate the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条事故和紧急情况一、如缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约另一方领土内发生事故或紧急情况，缔约另一方应立即对上述飞机及其机组和旅客提供必要的寻找、营救和协助。
Translation:
Article 17: Accidents and Emergencies

1. If an aircraft operated by an airline designated by one Contracting Party encounters an accident or emergency within the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall immediately provide necessary search, rescue, and assistance to the aircraft, its crew, and passengers.

Query_Text_cn: （一）尽快通知缔约一方；（二）保护证据并确保该飞机及其装载物的安全；（三）调查事故情况；（四）允许缔约一方的代表接近飞机，并作为观察员参加对事故的调查；（五）如调查中不再需要该飞机及其装载物，应立即予以放行；（六）将调查结果书面通知缔约一方航空当局。
三、有关上述调查活动的正常费用由境内发生事故的缔约方负担。
Translation: 3. The normal expenses related to the above-mentioned investigation activities shall be borne by the contracting party within whose territory the accident occurred.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条协商和分歧的解决一、缔约双方航空当局应本着密切合作的精神，经常相互协商，以保证实施和满意地遵守本协定及其附件的各项规定。
Translation:
Article 18 Consultation and Settlement of Differences

1. The aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall, in a spirit of close cooperation, consult each other regularly to ensure the implementation of and satisfactory compliance with the provisions of this Agreement and its Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如对本协定的解释或实施发生分歧，缔约双方航空当局应本着友好合作和互相谅解的精神尽力直接协商解决，如航空当局不能达成协议，应将此事提交缔约双方，由其尽力通过外交途径解决。
Translation: 2. In the event of any disagreement regarding the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to resolve the matter through direct consultations in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding. If the aeronautical authorities are unable to reach an agreement, the matter shall be referred to the Contracting Parties, who shall make every effort to resolve it through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条修改如缔约任何一方认为需要修改本协定或其附件的任何规定，可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商，此项协商可在航空当局之间进行，可采取讨论或通信方式进行，并应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起六十天内开始。
Translation:
Article 19 Amendment

If either Contracting Party considers it necessary to amend any provision of this Agreement or its annexes, it may at any time request consultations with the other Contracting Party. Such consultations may be conducted between the aeronautical authorities, either through discussions or correspondence, and shall commence within sixty days from the date the request is received by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 对本协定及其附件的任何修改，经缔约双方以外交换文证实后生效。
Translation: Any amendment to this Agreement and its annexes shall enter into force after being confirmed by an exchange of documents between the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条附件本协定的附件和有关本协定的换文是本协定的组成部分。
Translation:
Article 20 Annexes

The annexes to this Agreement and the exchange of letters related to this Agreement constitute integral parts of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条终止缔约一方可随时将其终止本协定的意愿通知缔约另一方。
Translation:
Article 21 Termination

Either contracting party may at any time notify the other contracting party of its intention to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条生效本协定自签字之日起生效。
Translation:
Article 22 Effectiveness

This Agreement shall enter into force from the date of signature.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表，经其各自政府正式授权，已在本协定上签字为证。
Translation: The undersigned, being duly authorized by their respective governments, have signed this Agreement in witness thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七三年五月十八在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文和英文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Beijing on May 18, 1973, in two originals, each in Chinese and English, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 丹麦境内的地点——莫斯科和/或伊尔库茨克——北京和/或上海——东京和/或经缔约双方航空当局协议的其他延伸点二、不经停的权利缔约双方指定空运企业在各自规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机，可以不降停规定航线上的任何中间经停点和延伸点。
Translation:
Points within Denmark—Moscow and/or Irkutsk—Beijing and/or Shanghai—Tokyo and/or other beyond points as agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties.

2. Right of Non-Stop Operation  
The designated airlines of the Contracting Parties, when operating agreed services on the specified routes, may, at their option, omit any intermediate or beyond points on the specified routes without loss of any rights.

Query_Text_cn: 三、加班飞行缔约一方指定空运企业如在规定航线上作加班飞行，在通常情况下，应在飞机起飞四十八小时前向缔约另一方航空当局提出申请，并在获得许可后方可飞行。
Translation: 3. Charter Flights: If the designated air transport enterprise of one contracting party operates charter flights on the specified routes, it shall, under normal circumstances, submit an application to the aviation authorities of the other contracting party at least forty-eight hours prior to departure, and may only operate the flight after obtaining approval.

Query_Text_cn: (一)“航空当局”,中华人民共和国方面指中国民用航空总局,挪威王国方面指民用航空局,或双方均指被授权执行与本协定有关的职能的任何个人或机构。
Translation: (a) "Aeronautical authorities" means, in the case of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Aviation Administration of China, and in the case of the Kingdom of Norway, the Civil Aviation Authority, or, in both cases, any person or agency authorized to perform any functions related to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: (四)“国际航班”,指飞越一个以上国家领土上空的航班。
Translation: (iv) "International flight" refers to a flight that passes over the territory of more than one country.

Query_Text_cn: (六)“非运输业务性经停”,指目的不在于装上或卸下旅客、行李、货物和邮件的降停。
Translation: (6) "Non-traffic stop" refers to a landing where the purpose is not to embark or disembark passengers, baggage, cargo, or mail.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条业务权利一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件所规定的航线(以下称为“规定航线”)上建立和经营定期航班(以下称为“协议航班”)的权利。
Translation:
Article 2 Business Rights

1. Each contracting party grants the other contracting party the right to establish and operate scheduled flights (hereinafter referred to as "agreed flights") on the routes specified in the annex to this agreement (hereinafter referred to as "specified routes").

Query_Text_cn: 三、在不违反本条第二款规定的情况下,缔约另一方在收到上述指定后,应立即将合适的经营许可发给缔约一方指定空运企业。
Translation: 3. Without prejudice to the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article, upon receipt of the above designation, the other Contracting Party shall, without delay, grant the appropriate operating authorization to the air transport enterprise designated by the Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方应及时向缔约另一方提供有关法律和规定的资料。
Translation: Each contracting party shall promptly provide the other contracting party with information regarding relevant laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条关税和其他税捐的豁免一、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机及留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品,在进出缔约另一方领土时,缔约另一方应在互惠基础上豁免任何关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation:
Article 6 Exemption from Customs Duties and Other Taxes

1. Aircraft operated by the designated airlines of one Contracting Party on the specified routes, as well as the normal equipment, spare parts, fuel, oils, lubricants, and supplies retained on board such aircraft, shall, upon arrival in or departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party, be exempt on a reciprocal basis from any customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes.

Query_Text_cn: (三)为缔约另一方指定空运企业飞行国际航班的飞机加注的燃料和润滑油,即使这些燃料和润滑油系供在加注的缔约方境内的航段上使用。
Translation: (iii) Fuel and lubricants supplied to aircraft operated by the designated airlines of the other contracting party for international flights, even if such fuel and lubricants are intended for use on the domestic segment within the territory of the contracting party where they are supplied.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条机上设备和物资的储存留置在缔约一方指定空运企业飞机上的正常设备、物资和供应品,经缔约另一方海关当局同意后,方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation:
Article 7 Storage of Onboard Equipment and Supplies

The normal equipment, materials, and supplies stored on aircraft operated by an airline designated by one Contracting Party may only be unloaded within the territory of the other Contracting Party with the consent of the customs authorities of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条技术服务的提供和费率一、缔约一方应在其领土内,为缔约另一方指定空运企业指定供经营规定航线使用的主用机场和备降机场,并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation:
Article 8 Provision of Technical Services and Rates

1. Each Contracting Party shall, within its territory, designate the primary and alternate airports to be used by the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified routes, and shall provide the communication, navigation, meteorological, and other ancillary services required for the operation of the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方指定空运企业应就各自航班的形式相互协商。
Translation: The designated airlines of both contracting parties shall consult with each other regarding the form of their respective flights.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班,应与公众对规定航线上的运输需要保持密切的关系,并以提供足够的运力为其主要目的,以满足当前和合理地预计到的、由指定该空运企业的缔约方领土内始发或以该领土为终点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输要求。
Translation: 3. The scheduled services operated by the designated airlines of both contracting parties shall maintain a close relationship with the public demand for transportation on the specified routes, with the primary objective of providing adequate capacity to meet the current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the contracting party designating the airline.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如缔约双方航空当局未能就根据本条第三款规定向其提交的任何运价,或根据本条第四款就运价的确定达成协议,此项分歧应通过外交途径予以解决。
Translation: 5. If the aeronautical authorities of the contracting parties fail to reach agreement on any tariff submitted to them pursuant to paragraph 3 of this Article, or on the determination of a tariff pursuant to paragraph 4 of this Article, such disagreement shall be resolved through diplomatic channels.

Translation: However, this provision shall not be construed to allow the continued application of such a rate beyond twelve months after the date on which it should have expired.

Article 18 Consultation and Settlement of Differences

1. The aeronautical authorities of both contracting parties shall, in a spirit of close cooperation, consult each other regularly to ensure the implementation of and satisfactory compliance with the provisions of this Agreement and its Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如对本协定的解释或实施发生分歧,缔约双方航空当局应本着友好合作和互相谅解的精神尽力直接协商解决,如航空当局不能达成协议,应将此事提交缔约双方,由其尽力通过外交途径解决。
Translation: 2. In the event of any disagreement regarding the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to resolve the matter through direct consultations in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding. If the aeronautical authorities are unable to reach an agreement, the matter shall be referred to the Contracting Parties themselves, who shall make every effort to resolve it through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条修改如缔约任何一方认为需要修改本协定或其附件的任何规定,可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商,此项协商可在航空当局之间进行,可采取讨论或通信方式进行,并应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起六十天内开始。
Translation:
Article 19 Amendment

If either Contracting Party considers it necessary to amend any provision of this Agreement or its annexes, it may at any time request consultations with the other Contracting Party. Such consultations may be conducted between the aeronautical authorities, either through discussion or correspondence, and shall commence within sixty days from the date the request is received by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条附件本协定的附件和有关本协定的换文是本协定的组成部分。
Translation: Article 20 The annexes to this Agreement and the exchanges of letters relating to this Agreement shall form an integral part of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条终止缔约一方可随时将其终止本协定的意愿通知缔约另一方。
Translation: Article 21 Either Contracting Party may, at any time, notify the other Contracting Party of its intention to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约另一方接到通知之日起十二个月后终止,如在期满前撤回上述通知,在取得缔约另一方同意后,本协定继续有效。
Translation: This agreement shall terminate twelve months after one contracting party receives notification from the other, unless the notification is withdrawn before the expiration of this period. With the consent of the other contracting party, the agreement shall remain in force.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七三年五月十二日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文和英文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Beijing on May 12, 1973, in two originals, each in the Chinese and English languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 二、不经停的权利缔约双方指定空运企业在各自规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机，可以不降停规定航线上的任何中间经停点和延伸点。
Translation:
2. Non-stop Rights

The designated airlines of both contracting parties may operate agreed services with their aircraft on the specified routes without landing at any intermediate points or beyond points on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 三、加班飞行缔约一方指定空运企业如在规定航线上作加班飞行，在通常情况下，应在飞机起飞四十八小时前向缔约另一方航空当局提出申请，并在获得许可后方可飞行。
Translation: 3. Charter Flights: If the designated air transport enterprise of one contracting party operates charter flights on the specified routes, it shall, under normal circumstances, submit an application to the aviation authorities of the other contracting party at least forty-eight hours prior to departure, and may only operate the flight after obtaining approval.

Query_Text_cn: (一)“航空当局”,中华人民共和国方面指中国民用航空总局,瑞典王国方面指民用航空委员会,或双方均指被授权执行与本协定有关的职能的任何个人或机构。
Translation: (a) "Aeronautical authorities" means, in the case of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Aviation Administration of China, and in the case of the Kingdom of Sweden, the Civil Aviation Board, or, in both cases, any person or agency authorized to perform any functions related to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条业务权利一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件所规定的航线(以下称为“规定航线”)上建立和经营定期航班(以下称为“协议航班”)的权利。
Translation:
Article 2 Business Rights

1. Each contracting party grants the other contracting party the right to establish and operate scheduled flights (hereinafter referred to as "agreed flights") on the routes specified in the annex to this agreement (hereinafter referred to as "specified routes").

Query_Text_cn: 第三条空运企业的指定和经营许可一、缔约一方有权通过向缔约另一方提交外交照会,指定一家空运企业,经营本协定附件规定航线上的协议航班。
Translation:
Article 3 Designation and Operating Authorization of Air Carriers

1. Either Contracting Party shall have the right, by means of a diplomatic note to the other Contracting Party, to designate one air carrier to operate the agreed services on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条法律和规定的遵守一、缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留、航行的法律和规定,以及关于旅客、机组、行李、货物和邮件进出其领土和在其领土内停留的法律和规定,均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、机组和所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation:
Article 5 Compliance with Laws and Regulations

1. The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party governing the entry into, stay in, and departure from its territory of aircraft engaged in international air navigation, as well as the laws and regulations relating to the entry, stay, and departure of passengers, crew, baggage, cargo, and mail, shall apply to the aircraft, crew, passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail of the designated airline(s) of the other Contracting Party while they are within the territory of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条关税和其他税捐的豁免一、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机及留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品,在进出缔约另一方领土时,缔约另一方应在互惠基础上豁免任何关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation:
Article 6 Exemption from Customs Duties and Other Taxes

1. Aircraft operated by the designated airlines of one Contracting Party on the specified routes, as well as the normal equipment, spare parts, fuel, oils, lubricants, and onboard supplies retained on such aircraft, shall, upon entry into or exit from the territory of the other Contracting Party, be exempt from any customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes on a reciprocal basis by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (三)为缔约另一方指定空运企业飞行国际航班的飞机加注的燃料和润滑油,即使这些燃料和润滑油系供在加注的缔约方境内的航段上使用。
Translation: (iii) Fuel and lubricants supplied to aircraft operated by an airline designated by the other contracting party for international flights, even if such fuel and lubricants are intended for use on the segment of the flight within the territory of the contracting party where they are supplied.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条机上设备和物资的储存留置在缔约一方指定空运飞机上的机上正常设备、物资和供应品,经缔约另一方海关当局同意后,方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: Article 7 The storage and retention of onboard equipment and supplies on an aircraft designated by one Contracting Party shall only be unloaded within the territory of the other Contracting Party with the consent of the customs authorities of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条技术服务的提供和费率一、缔约一方应在其领土内,为缔约另一方指定空运企业指定供经营规定航线使用的主用机场和备降机场,并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation:
Article 8 Provision of Technical Services and Rates

1. Each Contracting Party shall, within its territory, designate the primary and alternate airports to be used by the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified routes, and shall provide the communication, navigation, meteorological, and other ancillary services required for the operation of the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条运力规定一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班方面,应享有合理平等的机会。
Translation:
Article 9 Capacity Provisions

1. The designated airlines of both contracting parties shall enjoy reasonable and equal opportunities to operate agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条运价规章的制定一、缔约一方指定空运企业对前往或来自缔约另一方领土的运输所收取的运价,应在合理的水平上制定,适当照顾到一切有关因素,包括经营成本、合理的利润和其他空运企业的运价。
Translation:
Article 10 Formulation of Tariff Regulations

1. The tariffs charged by the designated airlines of one Contracting Party for transportation to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be established at reasonable levels, taking due account of all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profit, and the tariffs of other airlines.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条财务规定缔约一方指定空运企业因运输旅客、行李、货物和邮件而在缔约另一方领土内所得的收支余额,缔约另一方应同意缔约一方按正式汇率自由结汇。
Translation:
Article 11 Financial Provisions

The balance of receipts and expenditures obtained by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party from the transportation of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be freely convertible and remittable at the official exchange rate, as agreed by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条统计资料的提供缔约一方航空当局应按缔约另一方航空当局的要求,向后者提供缔约一方指定空运企业在协议航班上所载来自或前往缔约另一方领土的业务统计。
Translation:
Article 12 Provision of Statistical Data

Upon request by the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party, the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party shall provide statistical data regarding the traffic carried on the agreed services by the designated airlines of the former, to or from the territory of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条代表机构一、缔约一方指定空运企业为了经营规定航线,有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线的通航地点设立代表机构。
Translation:
Article 13 Representative Offices

1. The designated airlines of one Contracting Party, for the purpose of operating the specified routes, shall have the right to establish representative offices at the points of call on the specified routes within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人员应为中华人民共和国和瑞典王国公民,其人数由缔约双方指定空运企业商定,并经缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: The personnel of the representative offices shall be citizens of the People's Republic of China and the Kingdom of Sweden. Their number shall be determined by agreement between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and approved by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条空运企业的经营安全缔约一方应在可能范围内,保护在其领土内的空运企业的经营安全。
Translation: Article 14: Each contracting party shall, to the extent possible, protect the operational safety of air transport enterprises within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条证件一、缔约一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的飞机,应具有该缔约方国籍标志和登记标志。
Translation: Article 15, Certificate 1: Aircraft operated by an air transport enterprise designated by one Contracting Party for scheduled flights shall bear the nationality and registration marks of that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (一)登记证；(二)适航证；(三)航行记录表；(四)机上无线电台执照；(五)每一空勤组成员的执照或证件；(六)如载有旅客,携带注明起讫地点的旅客名单；(七)如载有货物和邮件,携带货物和邮件舱单；(八)如缔约任何一方需要,携带与国际标准一致的总申报单；(九)如飞机载有根据缔约另一方规定应受限制的货物,携带必要的许可。
第十六条机组国籍缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的机组成员,应分别为本国公民。
Translation: Article 16 Crew members of the designated airlines of each Contracting Party operating on the specified routes shall be citizens of their respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条事故和紧急情况一、如缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约另一方领土内发生事故或紧急情况,缔约另一方应立即对上述飞机及其机组和旅客提供必要的寻找、营救和协助。
Translation:
Article 17 Accidents and Emergencies

1. If an aircraft operated by an airline designated by one Contracting Party encounters an accident or emergency within the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall immediately provide necessary search, rescue, and assistance to the aircraft, its crew, and passengers.

Query_Text_cn: (一)尽快通知缔约一方；(二)保护证据并确保该飞机及其装载物的安全；(三)调查事故情况；(四)允许缔约一方的代表接近飞机,并作为观察员参加对事故的调查；(五)如调查中不再需要该飞机及其装载物,应立即予以放行；(六)将调查结果书面通知缔约一方航空当局。
Translation: (1) Notify the contracting party as soon as possible; (2) Protect the evidence and ensure the safety of the aircraft and its cargo; (3) Investigate the circumstances of the accident; (4) Allow representatives of the contracting party to access the aircraft and participate as observers in the investigation of the accident; (5) If the aircraft and its cargo are no longer needed for the investigation, release them immediately; (6) Notify the aviation authorities of the contracting party in writing of the investigation results.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条协商和分歧的解决一、缔约双方航空当局应本着密切合作的精神,经常相互协商,以保证实施和满意地遵守本协定及其附件的各项规定。
Translation:
Article 18: Consultation and Settlement of Differences

1. The aeronautical authorities of both contracting parties shall, in the spirit of close cooperation, consult with each other regularly to ensure the implementation and satisfactory compliance with the provisions of this Agreement and its Annexes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条修改如缔约任何一方认为需要修改本协定或其附件的任何规定,可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商,此项协商可在航空当局之间进行,可采取讨论或通信方式进行,并应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起六十天内开始。
Translation:
Article 19 Amendment

If either Contracting Party considers it necessary to amend any provision of this Agreement or its Annex, it may at any time request consultations with the other Contracting Party. Such consultations may be held between the aeronautical authorities of the Parties and may take place through discussion or correspondence, and shall commence within sixty days from the date of receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条附件本协定的附件和有关本协定的换文是本协定的组成部分。
Translation:
Article 20 Annexes

The annexes to this Agreement and the exchange of letters related to this Agreement constitute integral parts of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条终止缔约一方可随时将其终止本协定的意愿通知缔约另一方。
Translation:
Article 21 Termination

Either contracting party may at any time notify the other contracting party of its intention to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条生效本协定自签字之日起生效。
Translation:
Article 22 Entry into Force

This Agreement shall enter into force from the date of signature.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七三个六月一日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文和英文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Beijing on June 1, 1973, in two originals, each in Chinese and English, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 二、不经停的权利缔约双方指定空运企业在各自规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机，可以不降停规定航线上的任何中间经停点和延伸点。
Translation: 2. The designated airlines of both contracting parties shall have the right to operate agreed flights on their respective specified routes without landing at any intermediate or extension points on the designated routes.

Query_Text_cn: 三、加班飞行缔约一方指定空运企业如在规定航线上加班飞行，在通常情况下，应在飞机起飞四十八小时前向缔约另一方航空当局提出申请，并在获得许可后方可飞行。
Translation:
3. Charter Flights

If the designated airline of one contracting party operates charter flights on the specified routes, it shall, under normal circumstances, submit an application to the aeronautical authorities of the other contracting party at least forty-eight hours before departure, and may only operate the flight after obtaining approval.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在缔约双方商定并以外交换文确认的航线(该外交换文和航线以下分别称为“关于航线的换文”和“规定航线”)上经营定期航班(以下称为“协议航班”)的权利。
Translation:
Article 1

1. Each Contracting Party grants the other Contracting Party the right to operate scheduled air services (hereinafter referred to as "agreed services") on the routes agreed upon by both Contracting Parties and confirmed by an exchange of notes (hereinafter referred to as the "Exchange of Notes on Routes" and the "specified routes," respectively).

Query_Text_cn: 二、在遵守本协定规定的情况下,经缔约一方指定的空运企业(以下称为“指定空运企业”)在规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机,有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点降停,上下前往或来自缔约一方领土和前往或来自缔约双方领土之间的经停点的国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: 2. Subject to the provisions of this Agreement, aircraft operated by the designated airlines of one Contracting Party (hereinafter referred to as "designated airlines") shall have the right, while operating scheduled flights on the specified routes, to land at points on the specified routes within the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of taking on and discharging international passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail destined for or originating from the territory of either Contracting Party or from intermediate points between the territories of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应将其指定空运企业开始经营协议航班的日期,至迟在开航前六十天通知缔约另一方。
Translation: 3. Each contracting party shall notify the other contracting party of the date on which its designated airline intends to commence scheduled air services under the agreement no later than sixty days prior to the commencement of such services.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条一、缔约一方有权指定一家空运企业,在关于航线的换文中的规定航线上经营协议航班,并经由外交途径将这一指定通知缔约另一方。
Translation: Article 2 (1) Each contracting party shall have the right to designate one airline to operate scheduled services on the specified routes set forth in the exchange of letters concerning the routes, and shall notify the other contracting party of such designation through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在遵守本条第二款规定的情况下,缔约另一方在收到上述通知后,应即将经营许可给予缔约一方指定空运企业。
Translation: 3. Subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article, upon receipt of the aforementioned notification, the other Contracting Party shall, without delay, grant the operating authorization to the designated airline(s) of the Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如按照本协定第八条的规定为协议航班制定的运价业已生效,根据本条第一、第二和第三款的规定被指定和获许的空运企业方可开始经营协议航班。
Translation: 4. If the fares established for the agreed services in accordance with Article 8 of this Agreement have come into effect, the designated and authorized airlines may commence operating the agreed services only in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 1, 2, and 3 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非为了防止进一步违反法律和规定,必要立即执行本条第一款所述的取消、暂停或规定条件,这种权利只能在与缔约另一方协商后方可行使。
Translation: 2. Except where it is necessary to immediately implement the cancellation, suspension, or imposition of conditions described in paragraph 1 of this Article in order to prevent further violations of laws and regulations, such rights may only be exercised after consultation with the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留、运行的法律和规定,以及关于旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件进出其领土和在其领土内停留的法律和规定,均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、空勤组和所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: Article 4 The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the entry into, stay in, and departure from its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services, as well as the laws and regulations relating to the entry, stay, and departure of passengers, crew, baggage, cargo, and mail, shall apply to the aircraft, crew, passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party while they are within the territory of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条一、缔约一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的飞机及留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、润滑油和机上供应品(包括食品、饮料和烟草),如这些设备和物品留置在飞机上直至再次运出或在缔约另一方领土内航段上使用,在进出缔约另一方领土时,应豁免对物品进口、出口或过境所征收的任何关税、检验费和其他类似费用。
Translation: Article 5 (1): Aircraft operated on scheduled services by the designated airline(s) of one Contracting Party, as well as the normal equipment, spare parts, fuel, lubricants, and aircraft stores (including food, beverages, and tobacco) retained on board such aircraft, shall, upon entry into, departure from, or transit through the territory of the other Contracting Party, be exempt from all customs duties, inspection fees, and other similar charges on import, export, or transit, provided that such equipment and items remain on board the aircraft until they are re-exported or used on the segment of the journey within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (三)为缔约另一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的出境飞机供应的燃料和润滑油,即使这些燃料和润滑油系供在加注的缔约一方境内的航段上使用。
Translation: (iii) The fuel and lubricants supplied to outbound aircraft operating scheduled flights designated by the other contracting party's airlines, even if such fuel and lubricants are intended for use on the segment within the territory of the contracting party where they are supplied.

Query_Text_cn: 三、留置在缔约一方指定空运企业飞机上和临时运入缔约另一方领土的机上正常设备、物资和供应品,只有在缔约另一方海关当局同意后,方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: 3. The normal equipment, materials, and supplies retained on the aircraft of an airline designated by one Contracting Party, as well as those temporarily brought into the territory of the other Contracting Party, may only be unloaded within the territory of the other Contracting Party with the consent of its customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 遇此情况,上述物品应交上述当局监管,并不得在缔约另一方领土内转售或移作他用,直至再次运出,或根据海关规定另作处理。
Translation: In such cases, the aforementioned items shall be placed under the supervision of the aforementioned authorities and shall not be resold or used for other purposes within the territory of the other Contracting Party until they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with customs regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一、缔约一方应在其领土内为缔约另一方指定空运企业提供经营规定航线所用的机场和备降机场,并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation: Article 6 (1): Each Contracting Party shall, within its territory, provide the airports and alternate airports required for the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party to operate the agreed routes, as well as the communication, navigation, meteorological, and other ancillary services necessary for the operation of the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 具体办法由缔约双方航空当局协议(在本协定中,“航空当局”一词,中国方面指中国民用航空当局,德意志联邦共和国方面指联邦交通部长)。
Translation: The specific measures shall be agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both contracting parties (in this Agreement, the term "aeronautical authorities" refers to the Civil Aviation Authority of China on the Chinese side and the Federal Minister of Transport on the side of the Federal Republic of Germany).

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场、设备、技术服务和导航设备,应按照缔约另一方有关当局规定的公平合理的费率付费。
Translation: 2. When the designated airline of one Contracting Party uses the airports, facilities, technical services, and navigation equipment of the other Contracting Party, it shall pay fair and reasonable charges as prescribed by the relevant authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 此项费率不应高于其他国家空运企业通常所付的费率。
Translation: This rate should not exceed the rates typically paid by air transport enterprises in other countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班时,应享有公平合理的机会。
Translation: Article 7(1) When the designated airlines of both contracting parties operate agreed services on the specified routes, they shall enjoy fair and reasonable opportunities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、经营规定航线有关的班次、机型、班期时刻以及业务代理和地面服务事项,应由缔约双方指定空运企业讨论确定。
Translation: 3. Matters related to the frequency, aircraft type, schedule, and timing of flights on the agreed routes, as well as business agency and ground services, shall be discussed and determined by the designated airlines of both contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 按此协议的班次、机型和班期时刻应经各自的航空当局同意。
Translation: The frequency, aircraft type, and schedule of services under this agreement shall be subject to the approval of the respective aeronautical authorities.

Query_Text_cn: (三)直达航班经营的需要。
Translation: (3) The need for operating direct flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条一、在以下各款中,“运价”指为运输旅客、行李和货物所支付的价格以及采用这些价格的条件,包括代理和提供其他附属服务的价格和条件,但不包括运输邮件的报酬或条件。
Translation: Article 8 (1) In the following paragraphs, "tariff" refers to the price paid for the transportation of passengers, baggage, and cargo, as well as the conditions under which these prices apply, including the prices and conditions for agency and the provision of other ancillary services, but excluding the remuneration or conditions for the transportation of mail.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方指定空运企业应就规定航线上缔约一方领土和缔约另一方领土间所采用的运价进行协议。
Translation: 2. The designated airlines of both contracting parties shall reach an agreement on the fares to be applied by the designated airlines between the territories of the contracting parties on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 此种运价,应在合理的水平上制定,适当考虑到一切有关因素,包括经营成本、合理的利润和其他空运企业的运价。
Translation: Such rates should be established at a reasonable level, taking into proper account all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profit, and the rates of other air transport enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 三、按此协议的运价至少应在其预计实行之日六十天以前,提交各自航空当局同意。
Translation: 3. The fares under this agreement shall be submitted to the respective aeronautical authorities for approval at least sixty days prior to their proposed implementation date.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如未能根据本条第二款规定就运价达成协议,或如在本条第三款规定适用的期限内,缔约一方航空当局对根据第二款规定所商定的运价,向缔约另一方航空当局发出异议通知,缔约双方航空当局应设法相互协议,确定运价。
Translation: 4. If no agreement on the tariffs can be reached in accordance with paragraph 2 of this Article, or if, within the period specified in paragraph 3 of this Article, the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party notify the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party of their objection to the tariffs agreed upon under paragraph 2, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to reach a mutual agreement to determine the tariffs.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如缔约双方航空当局未能就根据本条第三款规定向其提交的任何运价,或根据本条第四款就运价的确定达成协议,此项分歧应根据本协定第十三条规定予以解决。
Translation: 5. If the aeronautical authorities of the contracting parties fail to reach agreement on any tariff submitted to them pursuant to paragraph 3 of this Article, or on the determination of any tariff pursuant to paragraph 4 of this Article, such disagreement shall be resolved in accordance with the provisions of Article 13 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 七、在规定航线上缔约一方和第三国之间的运价应为该缔约一方与各该第三国政府同意的运价。
Translation: 7. The fares between one Contracting Party and a third country on the specified routes shall be those agreed upon by the Contracting Party and the governments of the respective third countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内经营国际运输所得的收入,缔约另一方应允许按正式比价结汇。
Translation: Article 9: The income earned by the designated airlines of one contracting party from operating international transportation within the territory of the other contracting party shall be allowed by the latter to be converted and remitted at the official exchange rate.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条一、缔约一方指定空运企业为了经营规定航线,有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线的通航地点设立代表机构。
Translation:
Article 10

1. For the purpose of operating the specified routes, the designated airline of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish representative offices at the points of call on the specified routes within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人员应经缔约另一方同意,其人数由缔约双方指定空运企业商定,并经缔约双方航空当局同意。
Translation: The personnel of the representative office shall be subject to the consent of the other Contracting Party, and their number shall be determined by mutual agreement between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and approved by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构人员必须遵守驻在国的现行法律和规定。
Translation: Personnel of representative offices must comply with the current laws and regulations of the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应设法保证在其领土内的缔约另一方指定空运企业的协议航班所用的飞机、器材和其他财产的安全。
Translation: 3. Each contracting party shall endeavor to ensure the safety of the aircraft, equipment, and other property used by the designated air carriers of the other contracting party for scheduled flights within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约一方指定空运企业愿雇佣其他国籍的空勤组成员飞行规定航线,应经缔约另一方同意。
Translation: If a contracting party designates an airline that intends to employ crew members of other nationalities to operate specified routes, it must obtain the consent of the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条一、如缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约另一方领土内发生事故或遇险,缔约另一方应指示其有关当局立即通知缔约一方航空当局,并应对上述飞机上的空勤组和旅客提供必要的援助。
Translation:
Article 11

1. In the event that an aircraft operated by an air transport enterprise designated by one Contracting Party meets with an accident or distress within the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall instruct its relevant authorities to immediately notify the aviation authorities of the former and shall provide necessary assistance to the crew and passengers on board the aforementioned aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条缔约双方应本着密切合作的精神,经常交换意见,以保证实施和满意地遵守本协定及关于航线的换文中的各项规定。
Translation: Article 12 The contracting parties shall, in the spirit of close cooperation, regularly exchange views to ensure the implementation and satisfactory compliance with this agreement and the provisions set forth in the correspondence regarding air routes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条缔约双方如对本协定的解释或实施发生争端,应首先指示其各自的航空当局通过谈判予以解决。
Translation: Article 13 In the event of any dispute between the Contracting Parties regarding the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the Parties shall first instruct their respective aeronautical authorities to resolve the dispute through negotiation.

Query_Text_cn: 如上述当局不能达成协议,缔约一方可要求同缔约另一方协商。
Translation: If the competent authorities are unable to reach an agreement as mentioned above, either Contracting Party may request consultations with the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 此项协商应在提出要求之日起六十天内开始。
Translation: Such consultations shall commence within sixty days from the date of the request.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条缔约一方如欲修改或补充本协定的任何规定,可要求同缔约另一方协商。
Translation: Article 14: If either Contracting Party wishes to amend or supplement any provision of this Agreement, it may request consultations with the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 此项协商应在提出要求之日起六十天内开始。
Translation: Such consultations shall commence within sixty days from the date of the request.

Query_Text_cn: 经协商所作的修改或补充,在缔约双方相互通知已各自履行了使其生效的内部手续后开始生效。
