Translation: Any amendments or supplements made through consultation shall enter into force after both contracting parties have notified each other that they have completed the necessary internal procedures for their entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条一、本协定在缔约双方履行了各自的法律或宪法手续并以外交换文相互通知后生效。
Translation: Article 15(1) This Agreement shall enter into force after both contracting parties have completed their respective legal or constitutional procedures and have mutually notified each other in writing.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方可随时将终止本协定的决定通知缔约另一方。
Translation: 2. Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its decision to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约另一方接到通知之日起十二个月后终止。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date on which either Contracting Party receives notice from the other Party.

Query_Text_cn: 如在期满前,上述通知已经撤销,并取得缔约另一方同意后,则本协定继续生效。
Translation: If, prior to the expiration of the term, the above-mentioned notice has been withdrawn with the consent of the other contracting party, this Agreement shall remain in force.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七五年十月三十一日在北京签订,共两份,每份都用中文、德文和英文写成,三种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This agreement was signed in Beijing on October 31, 1975, in two copies, each in Chinese, German, and English, all three texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 在解释上遇有分歧时,以英文文本为准。
Translation: In the event of any discrepancies in interpretation, the English text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: (九)“航线表”,指本协定所附的航线表或根据本协定第十六条的规定所修改过的航线表。
Translation: (ix) "Schedule of Routes" refers to the schedule of routes attached to this Agreement or as amended in accordance with Article 16 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条授权一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方以本协定规定的权利,以使其指定空运企业能在航线表规定的航线上建立和经营国际航班(以下分别称为“规定航线”和“协议航班”)。
Translation:
Article 2 Authorization

1. Each Contracting Party shall grant to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement, so that the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party may establish and operate international air services on the routes specified in the Route Schedule (hereinafter referred to as the "specified routes" and the "agreed services," respectively).

Query_Text_cn: (一)不降停飞越缔约另一方领土；(二)在上述领土内缔约双方航空当局协议的地点作非运输业务性经停；(三)在航线表中规定的上述领土内的地点经停,以便上下国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: (1) To fly across the territory of the other contracting party without landing; (2) To make non-traffic stops at points within the said territory agreed upon by the aeronautical authorities of both contracting parties; (3) To stop at points within the said territory specified in the route schedule for the purpose of taking on and discharging international passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条指定和许可一、缔约一方有权书面向缔约另一方指定一家空运企业,在航线表规定的航线上经营协议航班。
Translation:
Article 3 Designation and Authorization

1. Either Contracting Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Contracting Party one airline to operate the agreed services on the specified routes in the Route Schedule.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约各方指定空运企业的主要所有权和有效管理权应属于该缔约方或其国民。
Translation: 2. The designated airlines of each contracting party shall be substantially owned and effectively controlled by that contracting party or its nationals.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在不违反本条第二款规定的情况下,缔约另一方在收到上述指定后,应不延误地给予该空运企业以合适的经营许可。
Translation: 3. Without prejudice to the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article, upon receipt of the above designation, the other Contracting Party shall, without delay, grant the designated airline the appropriate operating authorization.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约另一方航空当局可要求缔约一方指定空运企业向它证明,该空运企业有资格履行根据法律和规章所制定的条件,这些法律和规章是上述当局在经营国际航班方面所通常和合理地予以实施的。
Translation: 4. The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party may require the designated airline of one Contracting Party to satisfy them that it is qualified to fulfill the conditions prescribed under the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied by those authorities to the operation of international air services.

Query_Text_cn: 五、空运企业按照上述一经指定和获准,即可在任何时候开始经营协议航班。
Translation: 5. Once designated and approved as mentioned above, airlines may commence operating scheduled flights under the agreement at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非本条第一款所述的暂停或规定条件必须立即执行,以防止进一步违反法律和规章,这种权利只能在与缔约另一方协商后方可行使。
Translation: 2. Except where the suspension or prescribed conditions referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article must be implemented immediately to prevent further violations of laws and regulations, such rights may only be exercised after consultation with the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如缔约一方根据本条采取行动,缔约双方的权利都不应受到影响。
Translation: 3. If either contracting party takes action pursuant to this article, the rights of both contracting parties shall remain unaffected.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条提供技术服务和费率一、缔约一方应在其领土内指定供缔约另一方指定空运企业经营规定航线所使用的主用机场和备降机场,并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation:
Article 5 Provision of Technical Services and Rates

1. Each contracting party shall designate, within its territory, the primary and alternate airports to be used by the designated airlines of the other contracting party for the operation of the specified routes, and shall provide the communication, navigation, meteorological, and other ancillary services required for the operation of the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场,应按缔约另一方有关当局所规定的公平合理的费率付费。
Translation: 2. When a designated airline of one Contracting Party uses the airports of the other Contracting Party, it shall pay fair and reasonable charges as prescribed by the relevant authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 这些费率不应高于从事国际航班飞行的缔约另一方本国空运企业使用类似设施和服务所付的费率。
Translation: These charges shall not be higher than those paid by the designated airlines of the other contracting party for similar facilities and services when operating international flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条豁免关税、其他税收和费用一、缔约一方指定空运企业飞行国际航班的飞机,以及留置在机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、润滑油和机上供应品(包括食品、饮料和烟草),如这些设备和物品留置在飞机上直至再次运出,在进入缔约另一方领土时,应豁免一切关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation:
Article 6 Exemption from Customs Duties, Other Taxes, and Charges

1. Aircraft operated on international flights by an airline designated by one Contracting Party, as well as the normal equipment, spare parts, fuel, lubricants, and onboard supplies (including food, beverages, and tobacco) retained on board such aircraft, shall, upon entry into the territory of the other Contracting Party, be exempt from all customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes and charges, provided that such equipment and supplies remain on board until re-exported.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业运入或代表该企业运入缔约另一方领土的只供飞行国际航班使用的燃料、润滑油、零备件、正常设备和机上供应品,或装上该企业的飞机的上述物资,即使在装机的缔约方领土内的航段上使用,也应豁免所有税收和费用,包括缔约另一方领土内所征收的关税和检验费。
Translation: 2. Fuel, lubricants, spare parts, regular equipment, and onboard supplies imported by or on behalf of an airline designated by one Contracting Party into the territory of the other Contracting Party, solely for use on international flights, or loaded onto the aircraft of such airline, shall be exempt from all taxes and charges, including customs duties and inspection fees levied within the territory of the other Contracting Party, even if such materials are used on the domestic segment within the territory of the Contracting Party where they are loaded.

Query_Text_cn: 三、留置在缔约任何一方飞机上的机上正常设备、零备件、机上供应品、燃料和润滑油,只能在缔约另一方海关当局同意后,方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。该当局可要求这些物品置于他们监督之下,直至再次运出,或按海关规定另作处理。
Translation: 3. The regular equipment, spare parts, onboard supplies, fuel, and lubricating oil retained on the aircraft of either Contracting Party may only be unloaded within the territory of the other Contracting Party with the consent of the customs authorities of the latter. Such authorities may require these items to be placed under their supervision until they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with customs regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约任何一方指定空运企业运入缔约另一方领土的机票、货运单以及空运企业的宣传品和小纪念品,应豁免一切关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation: 4. Tickets, air waybills, promotional materials, and small souvenirs designated by any contracting party's airline for transport into the territory of the other contracting party shall be exempt from all customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条财务规定缔约任何一方允许缔约另一方按正式比价,自由结汇缔约另一方指定空运企业因运输旅客、行李、货物和邮件在其领土内所得的收支余额。
Translation:
Article 7 Financial Provisions

Each contracting party shall permit the other contracting party to freely convert, at the official exchange rate, the net balance of receipts and expenditures earned within its territory by the designated airlines of the other contracting party from the transportation of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条豁免所得税和其他税捐一、缔约一方指定空运企业经营协议航班所得的收入或利润,在缔约另一方领土内应豁免所得税或其他类似税收。
Translation:
Article 8 Exemption from Income Tax and Other Taxes

1. Income or profits derived by an airline designated by one Contracting Party from operating agreed services shall be exempt from income tax or other similar taxes within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业为经营协议航班而在缔约另一方领土内雇佣的雇员,如系缔约任何一方的国民,其因受雇而取得薪金、津贴或其他收入,在该领土内应豁免所得税或其他类似税捐。
Translation: 2. Employees employed by an air transport enterprise designated by one Contracting Party to operate scheduled services in the territory of the other Contracting Party, if they are nationals of either Contracting Party, shall be exempt from income tax or any other similar taxes in that territory on salaries, allowances, or other income derived from such employment.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约各方应采取根据其法律可能必要的措施,以使本条规定生效。
Translation: 3. The contracting parties shall take such measures as may be necessary under their respective laws to give effect to the provisions of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条入境和放行规章一、缔约任一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留、航行的法律和规章,以及关于旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件进出其领土和在其领土内停留的法律和规章,均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、空勤组和该机所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation:
Article 9: Entry and Clearance Regulations

1. The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party concerning the entry, stay, and navigation of aircraft engaged in international flights within its territory, as well as the laws and regulations regarding the entry, stay, and departure of passengers, crew, baggage, cargo, and mail within its territory, shall apply to the aircraft, crew, passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail transported by the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party while within the territory of the first Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、对直接过境缔约任一方领土的旅客,至多只采取非常简化的控制措施。
Translation: 2. For passengers who are merely transiting directly through the territory of either contracting party, only the most simplified control measures shall be applied.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条运力规定一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班方面,应有公平均等的机会。
Translation:
Article 10 Capacity Provisions

1. The designated airlines of both contracting parties shall have fair and equal opportunities to operate agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、有关班次、机型、飞行时刻表、地面服务和关于经营协议航班的其他事项,应由缔约双方指定空运企业协商确定,并应经缔约双方航空当局同意。
Translation: 2. Matters concerning flight frequency, aircraft type, flight schedules, ground services, and other issues related to the operation of scheduled flights shall be determined through consultation between the designated airlines of both contracting parties and shall be subject to the approval of the aviation authorities of both parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班时,应考虑缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益,以免不适当地影响后者在整条航线或其航段上经营的航班。
Translation: 3. When a designated airline of one contracting party operates scheduled flights on the specified routes, it shall take into account the interests of the designated airline of the other contracting party so as to avoid unduly affecting the latter's operations on the entire route or any segment thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 四、指定空运企业提供的协议航班,其主要目的应是以合理的载运比率提供足够的运力,以满足当前和合理地预料到的、来自或前往指定该空运企业的、缔约方领土的旅客、邮件和货物的运输的需要。
Translation: 4. The primary purpose of the scheduled flights operated by the designated airline shall be to provide adequate capacity, at a reasonable load factor, to meet the current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the transportation of passengers, mail, and cargo to and from the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在考虑该空运企业协议航班所经过的地区内各国空运企业建立的其他航班后,该地区的运输要求；(三)联程航班经营的需要。
Translation:
(2) The transportation requirements of the region, taking into account other flights established by airlines of the countries within the region traversed by the scheduled flights of the air transport enterprise under consideration;  
(3) The need for the operation of through services.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条资料和统计数据缔约任何一方航空当局应根据缔约另一方航空当局的要求,向其提供审议缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上提供的运力时可能合理地需要的定期资料或其他统计资料。
Translation:
Article 11: Data and Statistics

The aeronautical authorities of either Contracting Party shall, upon request by the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party, provide relevant data or other statistical information that may reasonably be required for the purpose of reviewing the capacity provided by the designated air transport enterprises of one Contracting Party on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条班期时刻表的批准一、缔约任一方指定空运企业应不晚于在规定航线上开始飞行协议航班三十天前,将航班类别、机型和班期时刻表通知缔约另一方航空当局。
Translation:
Article 12 Approval of Flight Schedules

1. Either Contracting Party shall require its designated airline to notify the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party of the type of service, aircraft type, and proposed flight schedules no later than thirty days prior to the commencement of the agreed services on the specified routes.

Query_Text_cn: 这一规定同样适用于此后更改以及每一夏季和冬季时刻表。
Translation: This regulation also applies to subsequent changes as well as to each summer and winter timetable.

Query_Text_cn: 二、收到该班期时刻表的航空当局对该时刻表通常应予批准或提出修改意见。
Translation: 2. Upon receiving the schedule for the relevant flight, the aviation authorities should generally approve the schedule or provide suggestions for modification.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下,上述指定空运企业不得在上述航空当局批准该时刻表前开始经营航班。
Translation: In no case shall the designated airlines mentioned above commence operations on the specified routes before the schedule has been approved by the aforementioned aeronautical authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 这一规定同样适用于此后的更改。
Translation: This provision also applies to subsequent amendments.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条运价的制定一、任何协议航班的运价应在合理的水平上制定,适当考虑到一切有关因素,包括经营成本、合理的利润、航班特点(如速度和舒适水平),以及其他空运企业在规定航线任何航段上所收取的运价。
Translation:
Article 13 Formulation of Tariffs

1. The tariffs for any agreed services shall be established at reasonable levels, due regard being paid to all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profit, the characteristics of the service (such as speed and comfort), and the tariffs charged by other air carriers for any segment of the specified route.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述运价,应由缔约双方指定空运企业达成协议,在有必要和可能时,应与在该航线或其航段上经营的其他空运企业进行磋商。
Translation: 2. The fares referred to in Paragraph 1 of this Article shall be agreed upon by the designated airlines of both contracting parties and, where necessary and possible, shall be consulted with other airlines operating on the route or its segments.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如指定空运企业不能就这些运价中的任何一项达成协议,缔约双方航空当局应设法达成协议,确定运价。
Translation: 3. If the designated airlines are unable to reach an agreement on any of these fares, the aeronautical authorities of the contracting parties shall endeavor to reach an agreement to determine the fares.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如双方航空当局未能就批准根据本条第二款向其提交的任何运价达成协议,或未能根据第三款就运价的确定达成协议,这一问题应根据本协定第十七条规定提交缔约双方解决。
Translation: 4. If the aeronautical authorities of the two parties fail to reach an agreement on the approval of any tariff submitted to them in accordance with paragraph 2 of this Article, or fail to reach an agreement on the determination of tariffs in accordance with paragraph 3, the matter shall be referred to the Contracting Parties for resolution in accordance with the provisions of Article 17 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 五、在根据本条规定决定新运价前,已生效的运价应继续有效。
Translation: 5. Prior to the determination of new freight rates in accordance with this Article, the existing effective rates shall remain in force.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方的上述有效证件,缔约另一方应予承认。
Translation: The above-mentioned valid documents of one contracting party shall be recognized by the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条协商一、为了在与实施本协定有关的所有问题上进行紧密的合作和取得一致意见,缔约双方航空当局在必要时应交换意见。
Translation:
Article 16 Consultation

1. In order to maintain close cooperation and reach consensus on all matters related to the implementation of this Agreement, the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall, when necessary, exchange views.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方为了修改本协定或航线表,可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商。
Translation: 2. Either Contracting Party may at any time request consultations with the other Contracting Party for the purpose of amending this Agreement or the Route Schedule.

Query_Text_cn: 经协商达成的对本协定的任何修改,应在根据各自国家法律履行了法律程序并换文陈明之日起生效。
Translation: Any amendments to this Agreement reached through consultation shall enter into force from the date of exchange of notes confirming the completion of legal procedures in accordance with the respective national laws.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如修改只涉及航线表,则应在缔约双方航空当局间进行协商。
Translation: 3. If the modifications involve only the route schedule, consultations shall be held between the aeronautical authorities of the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条争端的解决缔约双方应密切合作,互相支持,保证本协定的正确实施。
Translation:
Article 17: Settlement of Disputes

The contracting parties shall cooperate closely and support each other to ensure the proper implementation of this agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 如对本协定的解释和实施发生分歧,缔约双方主管当局应本着友好合作、互相谅解的精神直接协商解决。
Translation: In the event of any divergence in the interpretation or implementation of this agreement, the competent authorities of both contracting parties shall resolve the issue through direct consultations in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条终止缔约任何一方可随时将其终止本协定的决定通知缔约另一方。
Translation:
Article 18 Termination

Either contracting party may, at any time, notify the other contracting party of its decision to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 通知发出后,本协定在缔约另一方收到终止通知之日起二十个月后即告终止,除非缔约双方在期满前同意撒销该通知。
Translation: After the notice has been issued, this Agreement shall terminate twenty months after the date on which the other Contracting Party receives the notice of termination, unless both Contracting Parties agree to withdraw the notice before the expiration of that period.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条标题本协定每条均冠以标题,只是为了查阅方便,而决非对本协定的范围或意图予以解释、限制或说明。
Translation:
Article 19 Titles

The titles of each article of this Agreement are inserted for convenience of reference only and shall in no way be used to interpret, limit, or define the scope or intent of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九八○年一月二十日在科威特签字，共两份正本，每份都用中文、阿拉伯文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Kuwait on January 20, 1980, in two original copies, each in Chinese, Arabic, and English, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国政府代表陈瑞光（签字）中国民用航空总局顾问科威特国政府代表谢。贾。阿。
Translation: Chen Ruiguang, Representative of the Government of the People's Republic of China (signature), Advisor of the Civil Aviation Administration of China; Sha. Ja. A., Representative of the Government of the State of Kuwait.

Query_Text_cn: 中国境内一点——任何两个中间经停点——科威特——任何两个以远点。
Translation: Any point in China—any two intermediate points—Kuwait—any two beyond points.

Query_Text_cn: 航班可以经停规定航线上的中间经停点和以远点，但在这些地点和科威特之间不行使业务权。
Translation: Flights may make stops at intermediate points and beyond points on the specified routes, but shall not exercise traffic rights between these points and Kuwait.

Query_Text_cn: 科威特——任何两个中间经停点——北京——任何两个以远点。
Translation: Kuwait—any two intermediate points—Beijing—any two beyond points.

Query_Text_cn: 航班可以经停规定航线上的中间经停点和以远点，但在这些地点和北京之间不行使业务权。
Translation: Flights may make stops at designated intermediate points and beyond points along the specified route, but shall not exercise traffic rights between these points and Beijing.

Query_Text_cn: （1）任何或所有航班可以不经停规定航线上的任何地点，但这些航班应从指定该空运企业的缔约方领土始发并在该领土内终止。
Translation: (1) Any or all flights may bypass any point on the specified routes, but such flights must originate from and terminate within the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline.

Query_Text_cn: （2）缔约国一方指定空运企业在开始飞行协议航班前和在以后改变时刻表前，应向缔约另一方航空当局提出中间经停点和以远点，并经该当局批准。
Translation: The designated airline of one Contracting Party shall submit the intermediate points and beyond points to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party for approval before commencing scheduled flights under the agreement and prior to any subsequent changes to the timetable.

Query_Text_cn: 每一航班所经停的地点无须相同。
Translation: The stopover locations for each flight do not need to be the same.

Query_Text_cn: 近年来，对于消除阻碍流向发展中国家外国投资增长的障碍的需要受到了相当程度的关注。
Translation: In recent years, considerable attention has been paid to the need to eliminate obstacles hindering the growth of foreign investment flows to developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 许多国家业已制定新的法律，以促进外国投资，并为此目的，与资本输出国缔结双边投资条约。
Translation: Many countries have enacted new laws to promote foreign investment and, for this purpose, have concluded bilateral investment treaties with capital-exporting nations.

Query_Text_cn: 为了改善发展中国家的投资气候，促进投资流入这些国家，出现了为外国投资者在发展中国家的非商业性风险提供资金上担保的构想.几乎所有的发达国家和两个发展中国家已建立了官方机构，以担保其国民向发展中国家投资的非商业性风险。
Translation: In order to improve the investment climate in developing countries and promote investment inflows into these countries, the concept of providing financial guarantees for non-commercial risks faced by foreign investors in developing countries has emerged. Almost all developed countries and two developing countries have established official agencies to guarantee non-commercial risks for their nationals investing in developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，阿拉伯投资保证公司也提供区域性的担保.十几年来，私人政治风险市场也一直进行国际性的营运.这些实体的活动都受到若干限制，对政治风险的担忧仍然是向发展中国家投资的重要障碍.这就需要一多边投资担保机构来弥补这些机构的不足，并通过提供担保和从事其他投资促进活动来改善投资气候。
Translation: In addition, the Arab Investment Guarantee Corporation also provides regional guarantees. For more than a decade, the private political risk market has been operating internationally. However, the activities of these entities are subject to certain limitations, and concerns over political risk remain a major obstacle to investment in developing countries. This highlights the need for a multilateral investment guarantee agency to address the shortcomings of these institutions and to improve the investment climate by offering guarantees and engaging in other investment promotion activities.

Query_Text_cn: 建立一多边投资担保机构的设想最初出现于50年代。
Translation: The idea of establishing a multilateral investment guarantee agency first emerged in the 1950s.

Query_Text_cn: 1962年至1972年期间，在国际复兴开发银行（在本解说中，后简称为世界银行）曾数次讨论这一构想，但均未形成创立此类机构的决议.克劳森行长在1981年世界银行年会上的第一次讲话中重提这一设想.世界银行职员经过详细研究并与世界银行执行董事们进行几次非正式讨论之后，1984年5月向执行董事们分发了一份题为（多边投资担保机构建议案的主要特征）的报告.该报告提出了一些关键特征，使其区别于以前在世界银行讨论的方案.该建议案在与执行董事会讨论后，作了修改，后被纳入1984年10月分发的《关于建立多边投资担保机构的纲要草案）之中。
Translation: Between 1962 and 1972, the idea was discussed several times within the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (hereinafter referred to as the World Bank in this commentary), but no resolution was adopted to establish such an institution. President Clausen revived this concept in his first address at the 1981 World Bank Annual Meeting. After detailed research by World Bank staff and several informal discussions with the Executive Directors, a report entitled "Main Features of a Proposal for a Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency" was distributed to the Executive Directors in May 1984. This report proposed several key features that distinguished it from previous proposals discussed at the World Bank. After discussions with the Board of Executive Directors, the proposal was revised and subsequently incorporated into the "Outline Draft on the Establishment of a Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency" distributed in October 1984.

Query_Text_cn: 以这一文件为基础，与世界银行成员国政府进行了磋商。
Translation: Based on this document, consultations were held with the governments of World Bank member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 数次磋商后形成了本公约的修改草案并于1985年3月分发给成员国政府。
Translation: After several rounds of consultations, a draft amendment to this Convention was formulated and distributed to the governments of member states in March 1985.

Query_Text_cn: 1985年6月至9月间，执行董事们在来自成员国政府的专家的协助下。
Translation: Between June and September 1985, the Executive Directors, with the assistance of experts from member governments.

Query_Text_cn: 召开了全体委员会讨论本公约草案，1985年9月，执行董事会形成本公约的最后草案并推荐给理事会，以便理事会通过决议，开放该公约以供签署。
Translation: A plenary committee was convened to discuss the draft of this Convention. In September 1985, the Executive Board finalized the draft of the Convention and recommended it to the Council, so that the Council could adopt a resolution to open the Convention for signature.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约的条款绝大部分是不言而喻的，本解说说明其中的一些主要特征，以帮助解释其条款。
Translation: The provisions of this Convention are largely self-explanatory. This commentary highlights some of its main features to assist in the interpretation of its articles.

Query_Text_cn: 1．本公约建立多边投资担保机构（在本解说中称机构），作为自主的国际组织，根据国际法和其成员回国内法具有"完全的法人资格”（第7条），其主要目的是鼓励生产性投资在成员国之间，尤其是向发展中国家成员国流动（第二条）。
Translation: 1. This Convention establishes the Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency (hereinafter referred to as "the Agency") as an autonomous international organization, which, under international law and the domestic laws of its member countries, possesses "full legal personality" (Article 7). Its primary purpose is to encourage the flow of productive investment among member countries, particularly into developing member countries (Article 2).

Query_Text_cn: 所谓的"生产性投资”是强调机构的重点在于一切经济部门的具体项目和方案。
Translation: The so-called "productive investment" emphasizes that the institution's focus is on specific projects and programs in all sectors of the economy.

Query_Text_cn: 这并不意味着将其业务限制于制造业部门．除对在这些成员国中的投资提供非商业性风险担保外，机构还将开展辅助活动，以促进投资流动C第二条（b）款）。
Translation: This does not mean limiting its operations to the manufacturing sector. In addition to providing guarantees against non-commercial risks for investments in these member countries, the institution will also carry out ancillary activities to promote the flow of investments (Article 2(b)).

Query_Text_cn: 2．机构的成员国资格应向世界银行一切成员国和瑞士开放（第四条（a）款）。
Translation: 2. Membership in the institution shall be open to all member countries of the World Bank and Switzerland (Article IV, Section (a)).

Query_Text_cn: 但是世界银行成员国没有加入机构的义务。
Translation: However, member states of the World Bank are not obligated to join the institution.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约认识到资本辅出国成员国和资本输入国成员国一并加入的重要性，在其生效的条款（第六十一条（b）款）和表决条款（第三十九条）方面，尤为如此。
Translation: This Convention recognizes the importance of the joint accession of both capital-exporting and capital-importing member countries, particularly with regard to its entry-into-force provisions (Article 61(b)) and voting provisions (Article 39).

Query_Text_cn: 3．按世界银行早期方案的设计，机构没有股份资本，仅代表通过机构提供赞助投资担保的成员国开展业务。
Translation: According to the initial design of the World Bank's early scheme, the institution had no share capital and operated solely on behalf of member countries that provided sponsorship for investment guarantees through the institution.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本公约，机构将拥有股份资本（第五条），并以自己的能力发放担保，同时可为成员国赞助的投资提供担保作为补充，在后一种情况下，机构只充当管理者的角色（第二十四条和本公约附件I）。
Translation: Under this Convention, the Agency shall have share capital (Article V) and shall issue guarantees in its own capacity. It may also provide guarantees for investments sponsored by member countries as a supplement; in the latter case, the Agency acts solely in an administrative capacity (Article XXIV and Annex I of this Convention).

Query_Text_cn: 认缴资本可被扩大使用，允许担保数倍于其规模（第二十二条）。
Translation: Subscribed capital can be leveraged, allowing guarantees to be issued for amounts several times its size (Article 22).

Query_Text_cn: 4．公约规定的法定资本为10亿特别提款权，分为10万股，每股票面价值为l万特别提款权．但是，成员国对于股奉的支付义务将根据1981年1月1日至1985年6月30日期间以美元标价的特别提款权的平均值计算，即1特别提款权等于1．082美元，前一日期是特别提款权采用目前一揽于货币的日期（第五条（a）款）．一旦首期法定数额被完全认缴，法定资本将自动增加到加入国所必需认缴的程度（第五条（b）款）．理事会经代表股份55％以上且不少于2／3总投票权的特别多数票通过，也可随时增加法定资本（第五条（c）款和第3条（d）款）。
Translation: The Convention stipulates a statutory capital of SDR 1 billion, divided into 100,000 shares with a par value of SDR 10,000 each. However, member states’ payment obligations for shares are calculated based on the average value of the SDR in US dollars during the period from January 1, 1981 to June 30, 1985, namely, 1 SDR equals 1.082 US dollars. The former date marks the adoption of the current basket of currencies for the SDR (Article 5(a)). Once the initial statutory amount is fully subscribed, the statutory capital will automatically increase to the level required for new member subscriptions (Article 5(b)). The Board of Governors may also increase the statutory capital at any time by a special majority vote representing more than 55% of the shares and no less than two-thirds of the total voting power (Articles 5(c) and 3(d)).

Query_Text_cn: 5.认缴资本的数额将决定机构的承保容量（第二十二条）．可以预计，在机构开始营运后的一段合理时间内，法定资本将被认缴，并在此基础上，机构将成功地经营。
Translation: 5. The amount of subscribed capital will determine the institution's underwriting capacity (Article 22). It can be expected that within a reasonable period after the institution begins operations, the statutory capital will be fully subscribed, and on this basis, the institution will operate successfully.

Query_Text_cn: 6．每一成员国都应认缴机构的资本．第六条规定最低认股数为50股（50万特别提款权）．这将使所有成员国在机构中都有份额．创始成员国的认缴将按公约附表A的规定决定．加入成员国的认缴将由机构的理事会决定．股份将技票面价格由创始成员国认缴，理事会被授权决定加入成员国的认缴条件，但发行价格不得低于票面价格．如果机构在增加股份时业已积累了储备，那么，高于票面的发行价格可能是适当的（第六条）。
Translation: 6. Each member country shall subscribe to the capital of the institution. Article 6 stipulates a minimum subscription of 50 shares (500,000 Special Drawing Rights), ensuring that all member countries hold a stake in the institution. The subscriptions of founding members shall be determined in accordance with Schedule A of the Convention. The subscriptions of acceding members shall be determined by the Board of Governors of the institution. Shares shall be issued to founding members at par value, and the Board of Governors is authorized to determine the terms of subscription for acceding members, provided that the issue price shall not be less than par value. If the institution has accumulated reserves at the time of a capital increase, it may be appropriate to issue shares at a price above par value (Article 6).

Query_Text_cn: 7．公约规定，认缴股份股金的lO％将用现金支付，另外的lO％将用不可转让的无患本票或类似债券缴付，并根据董事会的决定予以兑现．支付的现金被指定用于开办费用、行政开支和产生于机构担保的可能的索赔．以不可转让的证券形式所作的另一部分支付的安排允许资金仍留在成员目的中央银行系统之内，并在机构开始营业的数年内发生大宗索赔时，提供缓冲的付赔资金．这一条款的目的在于一开始就加强机构作为财政健全的保险人的地位．认缴资本剩余的80％待机构催缴．以清偿其债务（第七条）．应该强调的是实际动用不可转让的证券和催缴资本的情况，预计是不会发生的，因为机构将在稳妥的商业基础上开展活动，并在任何情况下都保持其履行其财务的能力（第二十五条）．第八款（c）敢规定，在一成员国延迟支付催缴的股金，机构被援权对未支付的认缴股份连续进行催缴。
Translation: The Convention stipulates that 10% of the subscribed share capital shall be paid in cash, and another 10% shall be paid in the form of non-transferable promissory notes or similar bonds, to be redeemed as determined by the Board of Directors. The cash paid is designated for start-up expenses, administrative costs, and potential claims arising from the institution's guarantees. The arrangement for payment in the form of non-transferable securities allows the funds to remain within the central banking system of the member countries and provides a buffer for claim payments in the event of substantial claims during the initial years of the institution's operations. The purpose of this provision is to strengthen the institution's position as a financially sound insurer from the outset. The remaining 80% of the subscribed capital is subject to call by the institution for the settlement of its liabilities (Article VII). It should be emphasized that the actual use of non-transferable securities and the calling of capital are not expected to occur, as the institution will operate on a sound commercial basis and will, under all circumstances, maintain its ability to meet its financial obligations (Article XXV). Paragraph 8(c) further provides that, in the event a member country delays payment of called share capital, the institution is authorized to make successive calls on the unpaid subscribed shares.

Query_Text_cn: 8．除了以下所述的有限的例外，对于认缴股份的实收部分和催缴部分必须用公约所指的可自由使用的货币支付（第三条（c）软和第八条）．这是确保机构的财政生机和被认为是可信任的保险人所必需的．在与国际货币基金组织磋商之后，董事会有权指定国际货币基金组织所指定的司自由使用以外的货币为"可自由使用”的货币．如果确认有关货币能为机构的目的而使用，且得到该所涉货币发行国的同意，那么董事会就可作出这一决定（第三条（c）款）．为了减轻发展中国家成员国的负担，公约允许发晨中国家用当地货币支付其认缴股份的实收现金部分的25％，由于可能涉及的数额小，预计时机构的财政不会产生不利的影响。
Translation: 8. Except for the limited exceptions described below, both the paid-in and callable portions of the subscribed shares must be paid in freely usable currencies as referred to in the Agreement (Article III(c) and Article VIII). This is necessary to ensure the financial viability of the institution and to be regarded as a reliable insurer. After consultation with the International Monetary Fund, the Board of Directors has the authority to designate as “freely usable” a currency other than those specified by the International Monetary Fund as freely usable currencies. The Board may make such a decision if it is confirmed that the currency in question can be used for the purposes of the institution and with the consent of the issuing country of that currency (Article III(c)). In order to ease the burden on developing member countries, the Agreement allows developing countries to pay up to 25% of the paid-in cash portion of their subscribed shares in local currency. Since the amounts involved are likely to be small, this is not expected to have an adverse effect on the institution’s finances.

Query_Text_cn: 9．为了减少一切成员国的财政负担，公约规定，在某些情况下，机构将把催缴股份的缴数额退还给成员国．这些退款应按各成员国在退款之前所作的催缴支付的比例，用可自由使用的货币支付（第十条（b）款）。
Translation: 9. In order to reduce the financial burden on all member states, the convention stipulates that, under certain circumstances, the institution shall refund the amounts of called-up shares to member states. These refunds shall be paid in freely usable currencies in proportion to each member state's payments of called-up shares prior to the refund (Article 10(b)).

Query_Text_cn: 如果从东道国那里取得的补偿是不可自由使用的货币，那么机构只在将这些货币兑换成可自由使用的货币之后，才向各成员国退款．在退款数额的范围内，成员国的催缴资本的义务将重新恢复，恢复到各自在催缴前的状况（第十条（c）款）。
Translation: If the compensation obtained from the host country is in a currency that is not freely usable, the institution shall refund the member countries only after converting such currency into freely usable currency. Within the scope of the refunded amount, the obligation of member countries to pay callable capital shall be reinstated, restoring each to its status prior to the call (Article 10(c)).

Query_Text_cn: 10．本公约为机构的担保业务建立了一个基本框架，并使董事会通过制定随时可修改的政策、规则和细则更为细致地规定这些业务的范围。
Translation: 10. This Convention establishes a basic framework for the guarantee operations of the institution and enables the Board of Directors to further specify the scope of these operations through the formulation of policies, rules, and regulations that may be amended at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 这就赋予机构在这一框架内，具有必要的灵活性，以适应不断变化的情势，保持其财政生机．例如，机构可在开始其业务时限制其担保范围，并在积累经验和建立财政储备时扩大其担保范围。
Translation: This grants the institution the necessary flexibility within this framework to adapt to changing circumstances and maintain its financial vitality. For example, the institution may limit the scope of its guarantees when commencing operations and expand the scope as it gains experience and builds financial reserves.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，担保业务的细节和机构与投资者之间所达成的特定安排，都将订入机构与投资者签订的担保合同．第十六条规定，机构不能根据担保合同担保投资者所道受的全部损失．这一条款旨在制止因其全部损失可获得担保的投资者可能采取的不负责任的行为（通常称为"道德风险”）．在确定可能给予赔偿的适当百分比时，机构可在各国国家性投资保证机构的规则中找到一些指导，这些机构典型的规定是赔偿7O％至95％的损失。
Translation: In addition, the details of the guarantee business and the specific arrangements reached between the agency and the investor will be incorporated into the guarantee contract signed by the agency and the investor. Article 16 stipulates that the agency cannot guarantee compensation for all losses suffered by the investor under the guarantee contract. This provision is intended to prevent irresponsible behavior (commonly referred to as "moral hazard") that may be taken by investors who know that all their losses are guaranteed. When determining the appropriate percentage of compensation to be provided, the agency can find some guidance in the rules of national investment guarantee agencies in various countries, which typically stipulate compensation for 70% to 95% of the losses.

Query_Text_cn: 11．如上所述，适用于担保业务的政策、规则和细则将由董事会决定．根据这些原则所缔结的担保合同将由机构的总裁在董事会的指导之下批准。
Translation: 11. As stated above, the policies, rules, and regulations applicable to guarantee operations shall be determined by the Board of Directors. Guarantee agreements entered into under these principles shall be approved by the President of the institution under the guidance of the Board.

Query_Text_cn: 因东道国限制和延迟兑换和转移投资者所赚取的当地货币而产生的货币汇兑险，征收险、以及战争和内乱险．在这些传统的担保风险之外，本公约增加了东道国政府在以下第十五条所指的特定情况下违反或不履行对投资者的契约义务的风险（第十一条（a）款）。
Translation: In addition to traditional covered risks such as currency transfer risk arising from restrictions and delays imposed by the host country on the conversion and transfer of local currency earned by investors, expropriation risk, and risks of war and civil disturbance, this Convention adds the risk of the host government breaching or failing to fulfill its contractual obligations to investors under specific circumstances as referred to in Article 15 (Article 11(a)).

Query_Text_cn: 13．第十一条（a）款（I）项广泛地规定了货币汇兑险．它旨在包罗一切形式的新的直接限制措施（包括在现存的限制措施之上增加的限制），以及间接或隐蔽的限制措施，无论这些限制措施是法律上规定的，还是事实上存在的．这些限制措施必须"可归因于东道国政府”，这一措辞也包含了东道国公共机构或其他公共机关所施加的限制．这一条款没有规定特定的期限，这一期限将在董事会制定的规则和细则中，尤其是在担保合同中加以规定．在确定何为"合理期限’时，机构需在迅速汇兑对投资者的利益与东道国政府在处理申请时被认为可能是正当的某些迟延之间求得平衡。
Translation: Article 11(a)(I) broadly stipulates coverage for currency exchange risks. Its purpose is to encompass all forms of new direct restrictive measures (including additional restrictions imposed on top of existing ones), as well as indirect or covert restrictions, regardless of whether such measures are legally prescribed or exist in practice. These restrictions must be "attributable to the host government," a wording that also includes restrictions imposed by public institutions or other public authorities of the host country. This provision does not specify a particular time limit; such a period will be stipulated in the rules and regulations established by the Board, and especially in the guarantee contract. In determining what constitutes a "reasonable period," the Agency must strike a balance between the investor's interest in prompt transfer and any delays that may be considered justifiable for the host government in processing the application.

Query_Text_cn: 14.第十一条（a）款（II）项规定的是征收险。
Translation: Article 11(a)(II) stipulates expropriation insurance.

Query_Text_cn: 它将包括可归因于东道国政府的措施，如国有化、没收、查封、剥夺、扣押和冻结资产等．条款中"任何立法上的作为或行政上的作为”的措施包括行政机关采取的措施，但不包括司法机关在行使其职能时所采取的措施．政府通常采取的管理其经济活动的措施，如税收、环境、劳动方面的立法，以及保护公共安全所采取的措施，都小包括在这一条款中，除非这些措施是歧视投保人的。
Translation: It will include measures attributable to the host government, such as nationalization, expropriation, confiscation, deprivation, seizure, and freezing of assets. The term "any legislative or administrative measures" in the clause refers to actions taken by administrative authorities, but does not include measures taken by judicial authorities in the exercise of their functions. Measures commonly adopted by governments to manage their economic activities, such as legislation on taxation, environment, and labor, as well as measures taken to protect public safety, are not included in this clause unless such measures are discriminatory against the insured party.

Query_Text_cn: 在认定这些措施时，机构在实践中不得损害成员国或投资者基于双边投资条约、其他条约和国际法的权利。
Translation: When determining these measures, institutions must not, in practice, undermine the rights of Member States or investors under bilateral investment treaties, other treaties, and international law.

Query_Text_cn: 15．违约险包括在第十一条（a）款（III）项之中．只有当投保人没有诉诸法庭向东道国政府提起违约诉讼时，或者当求诸这样的法庭但受到按担保合同规定属不合理的迟延的阻碍时，或者当投资者不能执行其所得到的与已有利的最终判决时，才得予以补偿。
Translation: 15. Breach of contract insurance is included under Article 11(a)(III). Compensation shall only be provided if the insured has not resorted to legal proceedings against the host government, or if such proceedings have been pursued but have been subject to delays deemed unreasonable under the terms of the guarantee contract, or if the investor is unable to enforce a favorable final judgment obtained.

Query_Text_cn: 16．第十一条（a）款（iV）项包括了战争和内乱险．它旨在包括典型的在东道国政府控制之外的革命、动乱、政变和类似的政治事件．然而，具体针对投保人的恐怖主义行为和类似活动不包括在这一条款之中，但可包括在以下所述的第十一条（b）款之中。
Translation: Section 11(a)(iv) covers risks of war and civil unrest. It is intended to include typical political events such as revolutions, disturbances, coups, and similar incidents that occur beyond the control of the host government. However, acts of terrorism and similar activities specifically targeting the insured are not included under this clause, but may be covered under Section 11(b) as described below.

Query_Text_cn: 17．公约规定了特殊的灵活性，允许担保其他特定的非商业性风险，但只有经投资者和东道国联合申请，并经董事会特别多数票批准，方可进行（第十一条（b）款）．这类批准可以逐个作出，也可由细则规定按本条款可以获得担保的各种情况。
Translation: 17. The Convention provides for special flexibility, allowing the coverage of other specific non-commercial risks, but only upon joint application by the investor and the host country and with the approval of the Board of Directors by special majority (Article 11(b)). Such approval may be granted on a case-by-case basis or, as stipulated in the regulations, for various situations eligible for coverage under this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 18．公约第十一条（b）软和（c）款排除了发生在担保合同缔结之前的事件，投保人认可或负有责任的东道国政府的行为，以及由货币贬值或降低定值所造成的损失。
Translation: Article 11(b) and (c) of the Convention exclude events that occurred prior to the conclusion of the guarantee contract, actions by the host country government that are acknowledged or for which the insured bears responsibility, as well as losses caused by currency devaluation or depreciation.

Query_Text_cn: 19．第十二条规定了机构担保的适格投资的形式。
Translation: Article 12 stipulates the forms of eligible investments for institutional guarantees.

Query_Text_cn: 机构即需要保持其珍贵的资本以促进直接投资魔动，又需要通过允许董事会决定扩大担保其他类型的投资，确保将来的灵活性，这一条款努力寻求上述两种需要之间的平衡．根据设计，机构将集中担保符合第十二条（a）款的投资，即产权投资、不同类型的直接投资、以及股权所有者对所涉企业发放或担保的中、长期贷款（所谓的股权类型贷款或赞助贷款）．"直接投资”是一个统称，其明确的范围必须由董事会决定．董事会将受国际货币基金组织对外国直接投资所下定义的指导，即"为了获得在独立于投资者之外的财产上经营的一个企业的持久利益，并且投资者的目的是为了取得该企业管理中的有效发言权而进行的投资．”服务和管理合同等新形式的投资和投资者的收入取决于企业经营的特许协议、许可证协议、租赁协议以及产品分享协议，均可被董事会认为是直接投资．在任何情况下，无论是用货币形式进行投资，还是以机器、设备、服务、技术工艺和技术等实物形式进行投资，都无关紧要。
Translation: Institutions need to preserve their valuable capital to promote direct investment, while also ensuring future flexibility by allowing the board of directors to decide whether to extend guarantees to other types of investments. This provision seeks to strike a balance between these two needs. By design, the institution will focus on guaranteeing investments that meet the requirements of Article 12(a), namely equity investments, various forms of direct investments, and medium- and long-term loans (so-called equity-type or sponsor loans) made or guaranteed by equity holders to the enterprises involved. “Direct investment” is a general term, the precise scope of which must be determined by the board of directors. The board will be guided by the definition of foreign direct investment provided by the International Monetary Fund, namely, “an investment made to acquire a lasting interest in an enterprise operating in a property independent of the investor, with the investor’s objective being to obtain an effective voice in the management of that enterprise.” New forms of investment such as service and management contracts, and cases where the investor’s income depends on concession agreements, license agreements, lease agreements, or production sharing agreements related to the operation of the enterprise, may all be considered direct investment by the board. In any case, it does not matter whether the investment is made in the form of currency or in kind, such as machinery, equipment, services, technology, or know-how.

Query_Text_cn: 20．第十二条（b）款赋予董事会将来把机构的担保扩大到其他类型的投资的灵活性．它授权董事会经特别多数票同意将担保扩大到任何中、长期形式的投资，但与机构已担保或拟担保的投资无关的贷款除外．为了节省机构宝贵的资源，机构将不担保或分保政府或官方出口信贷机构所提供、担保或分保的出口信贷，不论其形式如何．因为机构的担保对象仅限于投资，只有当出口物表现为对特定投资的出资时，它们才能被担保（在前一句子的范围之内）．如一项代理或分销安捧主要旨在促进出口，且在其中投资者拥有的只是不重要的产权利益的话，则机构将不予担保．机构将作为一个投资担保机构起作用，而不能作为一个与官方出口信贷机构竞争的出口信贷机构起作用。
Translation: Article 12(b) grants the Board of Directors the flexibility to extend the institution’s guarantees to other types of investments in the future. It authorizes the Board, with the approval of a special majority, to expand guarantees to any medium- or long-term form of investment, except for loans unrelated to investments already guaranteed or proposed to be guaranteed by the institution. To conserve the institution’s valuable resources, it will not guarantee or reinsure export credits provided, guaranteed, or reinsured by governments or official export credit agencies, regardless of their form. Since the institution’s guarantees are limited to investments, export credits can only be guaranteed when they constitute contributions to specific investments (within the scope of the preceding sentence). If an agency or distribution arrangement is primarily intended to promote exports and the investor’s ownership interest is insignificant, the institution will not provide guarantees. The institution will function as an investment guarantee agency and not as an export credit agency competing with official export credit institutions.

Query_Text_cn: 21．为贯彻其宗旨而不损害其财政生机，机构的担保对象仅限于良好的投资．机构应认定有关投资对东道国的经济和社会发展有所贡献、符合该东道国的法律和条例、以及与该东道国所宣布的发展目标相一致．它也应该认定适当的投资条件（包括可得到的公正平等的待遇和法律保护）适用于所涉的投资（第十二条（d）款）．如果这类保护在东道国法律或双边投资条约中得不到保证，那么，只有在机构根据第二十三条（b）款（II）项，或者就机构所担保的投资的待遇与东道国达成协议之后，才能作出担保．机构所担保的投资应该是新的投资，即在要求机构担保的申请登记之后才实施的投资[第十二条（c）款），排除先已存在的投资并不禁止机构担保用以发展现存投资的投资或本可转移出东道国之外的收益的再投资．第十二条（c）款（II）项中的"收益”一词旨在包括提成费和许可证费。
Translation: 21. In order to fulfill its objectives without compromising its financial viability, the institution shall limit its guarantees to sound investments. The institution must determine that the relevant investment contributes to the economic and social development of the host country, complies with the laws and regulations of the host country, and is consistent with the development objectives declared by the host country. It should also ascertain that appropriate investment conditions (including the availability of fair and equitable treatment and legal protection) apply to the investment in question (Article 12(d)). If such protection is not guaranteed under the laws of the host country or in a bilateral investment treaty, then a guarantee may only be provided after the institution has reached an agreement with the host country regarding the treatment of the investment guaranteed by the institution, in accordance with Article 23(b)(II). The investments guaranteed by the institution should be new investments, that is, investments made after the registration of the application for the institution’s guarantee [Article 12(c)], and the exclusion of pre-existing investments does not preclude the institution from guaranteeing investments made to develop existing investments or the reinvestment of earnings that could otherwise be transferred out of the host country. The term “earnings” in Article 12(c)(II) is intended to include royalties and license fees.

Query_Text_cn: 22．作为适格的投保人，是自然人的投资者必须为东道国以外的成员国的国民．如果投资者是法人，那么它必须是在东道国以外的成员国登记并有其主要业务地，或者其资本主要由东道国以外的成员国或其国民所拥有．私人和公共所有的投资只有在商业基础上经营，才是适格的投资（第十三条（a）款（II）项）．但是，希望被担保投资的大部分将为私人所拥有。
Translation: 22. To qualify as an eligible investor, an individual investor must be a national of a member country other than the host country. If the investor is a legal entity, it must be incorporated and have its principal place of business in a member country other than the host country, or its capital must be predominantly owned by member countries other than the host country or their nationals. Both private and public investments are eligible only if they are operated on a commercial basis (Article 13(a)(II)). However, it is expected that the majority of investments seeking guarantees will be privately owned.

Query_Text_cn: 23．对于投资者不能与东道国有联系这一要件，第十三条（c）款规定了一项例外，即东道国国民或在东道国登记或为东道国国民所拥有的法人从国外移入资产的情形，但投资者和东道国应该联合申请并经董事会特别多数票批准．这一例外与机构将投资引入发展中国家的中心宗旨是一致的．现在一些发展中国家有国民侨居国外，并拥有大量的离岸资金，这一例外有助于资本流回发展中国家。
Translation: Article 13(c) provides an exception to the requirement that investors must not have any connection with the host country. Specifically, it allows for situations where nationals of the host country, or legal entities registered in the host country or owned by its nationals, transfer assets from abroad. However, in such cases, the investor and the host country must jointly apply, and approval must be obtained by a special majority vote of the Board of Directors. This exception aligns with the institution's central objective of channeling investment into developing countries. Currently, some developing countries have nationals residing abroad who possess substantial offshore funds, and this exception facilitates the return of capital to developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 24．第十四条将机构本身的担保业务限于发屉中国家成员国境内的投资．按第三条（c）款的规定，发展中国家成员国为列入本公约附表A的成员国．在执行董事会讨论期间，达成共识，机构将发展有关担保适格性方面的政策，优先对欠发达国家开展业务．就第十四条而言，一致认为，经非发展中国家成员国请求，其国际关系由此类成员国负责的附属领土应该被当作发展中国家成员国对待．但是．该成员国在其附属领土内的投资被排除在担保之外。
Translation: Article 14 limits the Agency’s guarantee operations to investments within the territories of developing member countries. According to Article 3(c), developing member countries are those listed in Annex A of this Convention. During the discussions of the Board of Directors, it was agreed by consensus that the Agency shall formulate policies regarding eligibility for guarantees, giving priority to operations in less developed countries. For the purposes of Article 14, it is unanimously agreed that, at the request of a non-developing member country, its dependent territories for whose international relations it is responsible shall be treated as developing member countries. However, investments by such member countries in their own dependent territories shall be excluded from coverage by guarantees.

Query_Text_cn: 25．第十五条规定，在"在东道国政府同意奉机构就指定的承保风险发放担保之前”，机构不得缔结任何担保合同，任何东道国都可以拒绝同意．这会促使东道国在同意之前评估拟议中的投资．机构将根据这一条款建立取得同意的程序．这些程序可能包括如果不反对即视为同意的规定（第三十八条（b）款）．尽管不需要投资者母国的同意，但是，如果投资者母国政府通知机构，该投资的资金是违反该国法律转移出境的，那么机构应拒绝提供担保。
Translation: Article 15 stipulates that “before the Agency issues guarantees for designated covered risks, the consent of the host government must be obtained”; the Agency shall not enter into any guarantee contract before such consent is given, and any host country may refuse to grant consent. This will prompt the host country to assess the proposed investment before giving its approval. The Agency will establish procedures for obtaining such consent in accordance with this provision. These procedures may include provisions whereby consent is deemed to have been given if no objection is raised (Article 38(b)). Although the consent of the investor’s home country is not required, if the government of the investor’s home country notifies the Agency that the funds for the investment were transferred abroad in violation of its laws, the Agency shall refuse to provide a guarantee.

Query_Text_cn: 26．第十八条规定，如果机构根据担保合同赔偿或同意赔偿投资者，那么它将取得投资者对东道国的权利，该权利是因导致向机构索赔的事件而取得的．代位权是一项公认的保险法原则．它规定的是，被担保的投资者向机构转让现存的索赔权，机构作为代位人，将取得投资者所拥有的同样权利．担保合同将规定代位权的条软和条件．由于机构将仅仅赔偿投资者的部分损失（第十六条），这些条款和条件对于投资者有特别重要的意义．第十八条（b）款规定，全体成员国应承认机构代位的权利。
Translation: Article 18 stipulates that if the Agency compensates or agrees to compensate an investor under a guarantee contract, it shall acquire the investor's rights against the host country arising from the event that gave rise to the claim against the Agency. Subrogation is a well-established principle in insurance law. It provides that the guaranteed investor transfers existing claims to the Agency, which, as the subrogee, acquires the same rights as those held by the investor. The guarantee contract will specify the terms and conditions of subrogation. Since the Agency will only compensate the investor for part of the loss (Article 16), these terms and conditions are of particular importance to the investor. Article 18(b) provides that all member states shall recognize the Agency’s right of subrogation.

Query_Text_cn: 27．根据第十八条（c）款的规定．机构作为代位权人所获得的当地货币，在使用和转移方面，有权得到所给予投保人的同样优惠待遇．此外，如果这些货币不是可自由使用的货币，那么机构有权用这些货币支付其行政开支或其他费用，并就这些货币的其他用途直接寻求与东道国达成协议．这类其他用途可能包括将当地货币卖给其他机构（例如国际信贷机构）、在这些国家的外国投资者或从这些国家进口商品的进口商．在万一机构取得大量当地货币的情况之下，机构有效地使用或处分这种货币的能力，显得十分重要。
Translation: 27. In accordance with Article 18(c), the local currency obtained by the Agency as a subrogated party shall, in terms of use and transfer, be entitled to the same preferential treatment as that granted to the insured. Furthermore, if such currency is not freely usable, the Agency shall have the right to use it to pay its administrative or other expenses, and may directly seek to reach an agreement with the host country regarding other uses of such currency. These other uses may include selling the local currency to other institutions (such as international credit institutions), to foreign investors in those countries, or to importers of goods from those countries. In the event that the Agency acquires a large amount of local currency, its ability to effectively use or dispose of such currency becomes particularly important.

Query_Text_cn: 28．为了确保迅速付赔，将由总裁根据担保合同和董事会可能通过的政策作出有关决定，在发生争端的情况下，最终的决定将依赖机构和所涉投资者之间的仲裁结果（第五十八条）．根据设计，这些政策将要求投保人寻求在当时条件下适当的行政救济，如果这些救济根据的法律可随时利用的话，并且可以规定合理的期限，以便最大限度地促成友好解决投资者和东道国之间的争端（第十七条）。
Translation: 28. To ensure prompt payment of compensation, decisions will be made by the President in accordance with the guarantee contract and any policies adopted by the Board of Directors. In the event of a dispute, the final decision will depend on the outcome of arbitration between the institution and the investor involved (Article 58). By design, these policies will require the insured party to seek appropriate administrative remedies available under the prevailing conditions, provided such remedies are accessible under applicable law, and may stipulate reasonable time limits to maximize the likelihood of amicable settlement of disputes between investors and host countries (Article 17).

Query_Text_cn: 在担保合同中订入具体的时间期限，将与其他政治风险保险人的惯例相一致．这一条款反映了各国国家性投资保证机构公认的惯例，不应该加给投资者过分的负担，因为投资者没有要求用尽一切当地救济之后，才能从机构那里得到赔偿，时间限制将取决于所涉及的风险类型和特殊情况的复杂性．以上时间限制与提出索赔到机构就索赔作出决定之间的最长期限，是两个不同的概念．这些时间限制没有具体规定于本公约之中，因为难以确定在所有情况下都合适的具体期限，但是，机构可以在其规则和细则中规定这些时间限制，并可以在担保合同中订入这些时间限制，以增加其所提供服务的吸引力。
Translation: Including specific time limits in the guarantee contract will be consistent with the practices of other political risk insurers. This clause reflects the recognized practice of national investment guarantee agencies in various countries and should not impose an excessive burden on investors, as investors are not required to exhaust all local remedies before seeking compensation from the agency. The time limits will depend on the type of risk involved and the complexity of the particular circumstances. The above-mentioned time limits and the maximum period between the submission of a claim and the agency's decision on the claim are two distinct concepts. These time limits are not specifically stipulated in this Convention, as it is difficult to determine a period suitable for all situations. However, the agency may specify such time limits in its rules and regulations and may include them in the guarantee contract to enhance the attractiveness of its services.

Query_Text_cn: 29．机构将弥补国家性和区域性机构的不足，而不是与它们竞争（第十九条）．因此，机构将注重担保来自设有国家性机构的成员国（主要是那些输出资本的发展中国家成员国）的投资，与国家性和区域性机构共保投资．为国家性和区域性机构提供分保，担保具有合理性和发展性但又不符合国家性和区域性机构适格标准的投资，担保不同成员国投资者共同参加的投资．为了节省费用，提高效率，机构可以利用国家性和区域性实体的行政支持，并可以与它们签订适当的合作协议（第十九条）．例如，国家性管理机构可以帮助处理当地投资者要求多边担保的申请和正在形成的索赔．这就减少了机构在其总部之外设立办事处的必要性．然而，需要明确的是，机构必须依靠自己对风险的评估，并由自己对发放担保和支付索赔作出决定。
Translation: 29. The Agency will complement, rather than compete with, national and regional institutions (Article XIX). Therefore, the Agency will focus on guaranteeing investments from member countries with national institutions—primarily those developing member countries that are capital exporters—and will co-insure investments with national and regional institutions. It will provide reinsurance to national and regional institutions, guarantee investments that are reasonable and developmental in nature but do not meet the eligibility criteria of national and regional institutions, and guarantee investments involving investors from different member countries. To reduce costs and improve efficiency, the Agency may utilize the administrative support of national and regional entities and may enter into appropriate cooperation agreements with them (Article XIX). For example, national management institutions may assist in processing applications from local investors seeking multilateral guarantees and in handling emerging claims. This reduces the need for the Agency to establish offices outside its headquarters. However, it must be clearly stated that the Agency must rely on its own risk assessment and make independent decisions regarding the issuance of guarantees and the payment of claims.

Query_Text_cn: 30，第十九条将机构在这方面可以合作的机构定义为"成员国的国家性实体和多数资本为成员国拥有的区域性实体，且其开展的业务活动与本机构相似．”这包括担保投资非商业性风险或促进私人投资流入发展中国家的任何机构．因此，机构可能与同一国家内的一个以上的机构合作．应该注意，国家性实体与机构之间的合作并不导致该实体自动成为第三十八条之下成员国和机构之间的通讯渠道．这一条款要求每一成员国指定一适当机关就本公约所产生的一切事项进行联系。
Translation: Article 19 defines the institutions with which the Agency may cooperate in this regard as "national entities of member states and regional entities majority-owned by member states, whose business activities are similar to those of the Agency." This includes any institution that provides guarantees against non-commercial risks of investments or promotes the flow of private investment into developing countries. Therefore, the Agency may cooperate with more than one institution within the same country. It should be noted that cooperation between a national entity and the Agency does not automatically make that entity the channel of communication between the member state and the Agency under Article 38. This provision requires each member state to designate an appropriate authority to communicate on all matters arising under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 31．机构可以与政治风险私人保险人合作，以加强其本身的业务能力，并鼓励那些保险人在机构的发展中国家成员国，以与机构相似的条件，提供担保（第二十一条（a）款）．例如，关于前一目的，私人保险公司可能协助机构开展其保险服务的营销活动，例如，关于后一目的，机构将在推动私人保险能力方面发挥催化作用．例如，与私人承保人缔结共保协议．机构尤其应设法担保私人保险人按合理的条件下不能担保的投资。
Translation: 31. The institution may cooperate with private political risk insurers to enhance its own operational capabilities and encourage those insurers to provide guarantees in the institution's developing member countries under conditions similar to those offered by the institution (Article 21(a)). For example, regarding the former objective, private insurance companies may assist the institution in marketing its insurance services; regarding the latter objective, the institution will play a catalytic role in promoting private insurance capacity, such as by entering into co-insurance agreements with private underwriters. The institution should particularly seek to guarantee investments that private insurers are unable to cover under reasonable conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 经成员国政府请求，机构应与其就第十九条至第二十一条所规定的事项进行磋商．这些包括机构在设计其本身的担保业务、共保、分保、赞助担保业务和行政合作方面的补充作用．如果适当的话，机构可以与成员国政府签订"伞形协议”，为机构与该成员国的官方和私人保险人的合作提供一个框架。
Translation: At the request of a member government, the Agency shall consult with it on the matters specified in Articles 19 to 21. These include the Agency’s complementary role in designing its own guarantee operations, coinsurance, reinsurance, sponsored guarantee operations, and administrative cooperation. Where appropriate, the Agency may enter into an "umbrella agreement" with the member government to provide a framework for cooperation between the Agency and the official and private insurers of that member.

Query_Text_cn: 33．根据第二十条和第二十一条（a）款的规定，机构被授权向成员国投资保证机构、区域性投资保证机构（目前唯一的例子是阿拉伯投资保证公司）和成员国的私人保险人提供分保．正如本解说第三十一条所述的那样，机构与私人保险人的安排，包括分保安排，都旨在蛀励它们按与机构发放担保相类似的条件向投资者提供担保．分保的目的在于分散机构本身和分保实体的风险，也应该允许分保出实体扩大其业务。
Translation: 33. Pursuant to the provisions of Articles 20 and 21(a), the Agency is authorized to provide reinsurance to national investment guarantee agencies of member countries, regional investment guarantee agencies (currently, the only example being the Arab Investment Guarantee Corporation), and private insurers of member countries. As stated in the commentary on Article 31, arrangements between the Agency and private insurers, including reinsurance arrangements, are intended to encourage them to offer guarantees to investors on terms similar to those provided by the Agency. The purpose of reinsurance is to diversify the risks borne by both the Agency itself and the reinsured entities, and it should also enable the reinsured entities to expand their operations.

Query_Text_cn: 34．应该注意，机构所提供的分保必须总是与一项"特定的投资”相联．这里的意图是排除按比例承担初始承保人分出的那部分风险（通常称为合约分保）．也应该注意，分保业务特只占用机构全部业务中预先确定的郡部分．因此，第二十条（a）款（规定，最大数额应由董事会经特别多数票不时加以确定．如果投资在机构收到分保申请前一年以上就已完成，那么本公约规定的景初限度是机构以自己的名义（不能包括赞助担保）可以提供的担保总额为lO％．这个限度既适用于官方实体的分保，也适用于私人保险人的分保．一旦合适的话，这些限度可以由董事会经特别多数票加以改变。
Translation: It should be noted that the reinsurance provided by the institution must always be linked to a “specific investment.” The intention here is to exclude the proportional assumption of the portion of risk ceded by the original insurer (commonly referred to as treaty reinsurance). It should also be noted that reinsurance business only occupies a predetermined portion of the institution’s total business. Therefore, Article 20(a) stipulates that the maximum amount shall be determined from time to time by the Board of Directors by special majority vote. If the investment was completed more than one year before the institution received the reinsurance application, the initial limit prescribed by this Convention is that the total amount of guarantees the institution may provide in its own name (excluding sponsored guarantees) shall not exceed 10%. This limit applies both to reinsurance by official entities and to reinsurance by private insurers. Where appropriate, these limits may be changed by the Board of Directors by special majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 35．适用于机构担保的决定风险、投资、投资者和东道国适格性的条件，将适用于分保由于技术上的原因，分保投资不必在提出分保申请之后才实施（第二十条（a）款）。
Translation: 35. The conditions determining risk, investment, investor, and host country eligibility applicable to institutional guarantees shall also apply to reinsurance. For technical reasons, reinsurance investments do not have to be implemented only after the submission of a reinsurance application (Article 20(a)).

Query_Text_cn: 36．第二十条（c）款规定，应尽可能对分保安排作出这样的设计，以便机构或分保分出实体拥有机构作为初始担保人所拥有的相等的代位和仲裁的权利．然而，如果设有东道国对机构分保的事先同意，那么机构作为代位权人的权利将不会有效（第二十条（c）款）．在一些情况下，机构代位取得分保分出实体的权利可能不切实际．在另一些情况下，机构让分保分出实体代表其行使机构所取得的代位权可能更为便捷．第二十条（c）款要求担保合同规定，分保分出实体将审慎地采取求偿救济措施。
Translation: Article 20(c) stipulates that, to the extent possible, reinsurance arrangements should be structured so that the Agency or the reinsured entity possesses rights of subrogation and arbitration equal to those held by the Agency as the original guarantor. However, if the host country’s prior consent to the Agency’s reinsurance is required, the Agency’s rights as subrogee will not be effective (Article 20(c)). In some cases, it may be impractical for the Agency to acquire the rights of the reinsured entity through subrogation. In other cases, it may be more convenient for the Agency to have the reinsured entity exercise, on its behalf, the subrogation rights acquired by the Agency. Article 20(c) requires that the guarantee contract stipulate that the reinsured entity will prudently pursue remedies for recovery.

Query_Text_cn: 37．根据第二十一条（b）款的规定，机构发放的担保可由官方的或私人保险人分保保将使机构进一步分散其风险．只有当机构根据适当的条件、以合理的费用取得分保时使用这一权力。
Translation: According to Article 21(b), guarantees issued by the institution may be reinsured by official or private insurers, which will further diversify the institution's risk. This authority shall be exercised only when reinsurance is obtained under appropriate conditions and at reasonable cost.

Query_Text_cn: 38．按照保险业和银行业公认的原则，允许负债总额超过保险人和银行的股权资本．这一原则存在的依据是，可以合理地推论，不可能所有被担保或被保险的风险都会变成损失．根据本公约，该原则也适用于机构．第二十二条（a）款规定，机构可承担的或有负债总额的上限不能超过认缴资本与储备之和的150％，加上一定比例的分保额，除非理事会经特别多数票另有决定．由于机构在一段时间后才能建立起风险分布状况，因此要求董事会不时地检查风险的实际分布和潜在的损失，以决定是否应该向理事会推荐采用更高的风险资产比例．但是，如上所述．增加比例的任何决定都需经董事会的特别多数票通过，且风险资产比例不能超过1；5这一上限。
Translation: According to the generally accepted principles in the insurance and banking industries, it is permissible for total liabilities to exceed the equity capital of insurers and banks. The rationale behind this principle is the reasonable assumption that not all insured or guaranteed risks will result in losses. Under this Convention, the same principle applies to the institution. Article 22(a) stipulates that the maximum amount of contingent liabilities the institution may assume shall not exceed 150% of the sum of subscribed capital and reserves, plus a certain proportion of reinsurance, unless the Board of Governors decides otherwise by a special majority. Since the institution can only establish its risk distribution profile over time, the Board of Directors is required to periodically review the actual distribution of risks and potential losses to determine whether to recommend to the Board of Governors the adoption of a higher ratio of risk assets. However, as stated above, any decision to increase the ratio must be approved by a special majority of the Board of Directors, and the ratio of risk assets may not exceed the upper limit of 1.5.

Query_Text_cn: 39．第二十二条（b）款（I）项规定，董事会可以规定对单个成员国的投资者所发放的一切担保的或有负债的上限．这一条款的目的是在一成员国对机构的相应出资与该成员国的投资者从机构那里得益两者之间求得平衡．董事会在确定限度时，被要求"适当考虑”一成员国认缴的资本．但是，当发展中国家成员国或其国民投资于其他发展中国家成员国，也要求董事会"适当考虑”放宽对它们适用这些限度的必要性。
Translation: Article 22(b)(I) provides that the Board of Directors may establish a ceiling on the contingent liabilities arising from all guarantees issued to investors from a single member country. The purpose of this provision is to maintain a balance between the contributions made by a member country to the institution and the benefits its investors derive from the institution. In determining the ceiling, the Board is required to “give due consideration” to the capital subscribed by a member country. However, when investors from developing member countries, or the countries themselves, invest in other developing member countries, the Board is also required to “give due consideration” to the need to relax the application of these ceilings to them.

Query_Text_cn: 40．董事会可以确立第三类限度，以便使风险适当地全面分布，避免风险过分集中．因此，对于机构在单个项目的规模、在单个东道国内的全部投资，投资的类型或其他因素等方面所承担的风险，可以规定限度（第二十二条（b）款（B）款）．因为这些限度主要用来分散风险．因此，对单个东道国中的投资的任何限度不得受这类国家相应认缴资本数额的影响。
Translation: 40. The Board of Directors may establish a third category of limits to ensure that risks are appropriately and broadly distributed, thereby avoiding excessive concentration of risk. Accordingly, limits may be set on the risks assumed by the institution in terms of the size of individual projects, the total investment in a single host country, the types of investments, or other factors (Article 22(b)(B)). Since these limits are primarily intended to diversify risk, any limits on investments in a single host country shall not be affected by the corresponding amount of subscribed capital from that country.

Query_Text_cn: 41．机构区别于以往方案的特征之一就是，它有义务开展对发放担保有辅助作用的活动，以促进投资向成员国和在成员国之间流动（第二条（b）款）．根据第二十三条（a）款的规定，机构有责任进行研究，传播有关发展中国家成员国的投资机会的信息，以及开展其他活动，以促进外国投资。
Translation: One of the distinguishing features of the institution compared to previous schemes is its obligation to carry out activities that assist in providing guarantees, in order to promote the flow of investment to and among member countries (Article 2(b)). According to Article 23(a), the institution is responsible for conducting research, disseminating information on investment opportunities in developing member countries, and undertaking other activities to promote foreign investment.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，经成员国请求，机构可以提供旨在改善投资条件的技术援助和咨询，包括对草拟投资法典和审查投资鼓励规划等诸如此类事项提供咨询．提供这类辅助性服务可以收取适当的费用，或在必要的情况下，可以无代价的给予受益国。
Translation: In addition, upon the request of member countries, the institution may provide technical assistance and advisory services aimed at improving investment conditions, including advice on drafting investment codes and reviewing investment incentive programs, among other related matters. Appropriate fees may be charged for such auxiliary services, or, where necessary, they may be provided to beneficiary countries free of charge.

Query_Text_cn: 42．机构在开展其促进活动时，将受成员国之间有关投资协定的指导，并设法消除存在于成员国之间阻碍投资流动的障碍．此外，机构有义务与促进外国投资的其他机构协作，尤其与国际金融公司协作（第二十三条（a）款）．这将有助于避免机构进行重复的活动。
Translation: 42. In carrying out its promotional activities, the Agency shall be guided by investment agreements between member countries and seek to eliminate obstacles to the flow of investments among them. Furthermore, the Agency is obligated to cooperate with other institutions that promote foreign investment, particularly with the International Finance Corporation (Article 23(a)). This will help avoid duplication of activities by the Agency.

Query_Text_cn: 43．第二十三条（b）款（I）款赋予机构一项职责，鼓励友好解决投资者与东道国之间的争端．机构也可以提供有关可供利用的争端解决和调停机构的信息．机构也受命促进和推动在成员国之间缔结投资保护条约．例如，机构可承担对现有协定的研究工作，并协助成员国政府分析这类协定的含义和有益之处。
Translation: Article 23(b)(I) assigns the institution the responsibility to encourage the amicable settlement of disputes between investors and host countries. The institution may also provide information on available dispute resolution and conciliation bodies. Furthermore, the institution is mandated to promote and facilitate the conclusion of investment protection treaties among member countries. For example, the institution may undertake research on existing agreements and assist member governments in analyzing the implications and benefits of such agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 44．根据第二十三条（b）款（II）项的规定，机构应努力与其成员国缔结双边和多边协定，以便确保机构在担保投资方面，所享受的待遇至少不低于所涉成员国向最优惠投资担保机构或国家提供的待遇．在确定最优惠机构或国家时，机构应从整体上而不是从个别条款来考虑协定．根据第二十三条（b）款（II）项所订的协议要求经董事会特别多数票同意．据估计，在机构所担保的投资不能从现有的双边条约受益的情况下，或者在这类条约中所规定的标准被机构认为不充分的情况下，才会缔结这些协定。
Translation: 44. Pursuant to Article 23(b)(II), the Agency shall endeavor to conclude bilateral and multilateral agreements with its member countries to ensure that, with respect to investment guarantees, the treatment accorded to the Agency is at least no less favorable than that accorded by the member country concerned to the most favored investment guarantee agency or country. In determining the most favored agency or country, the Agency shall consider the agreement as a whole rather than individual provisions. Agreements concluded under Article 23(b)(II) require the special majority approval of the Board of Directors. It is estimated that such agreements will only be concluded in cases where investments guaranteed by the Agency cannot benefit from existing bilateral treaties, or where the standards set forth in such treaties are deemed insufficient by the Agency.

Query_Text_cn: 45.银行建立国际投资保险机构的早期方案认为，机构仅代表赞助成员国开展其担保业务．根据公约，赞助担保投资对于机构以其自己名义所开展的业务，将发挥重要的补充作用．除了后一项业务之外，如果一个成员国或数个成员国同意赞助担保这些投资，那么，机构可以根据第二十四条规定对其他投资提供担保，并可提供另外的分保．有关赞助担保业务的具体条款规定在附件I，附件Ⅱ是奉公约的不可缺少的组成部分．必须强调的是，根据附件I第二条（c）款的规定，机构在如下所述的赞助信托基金中所持有和管理的资产必须与机构的资产分开，且机构不得以其本身的资产对赞助担保业务承担债务。
Translation: The early proposals for the establishment of an international investment insurance agency by banks suggested that the agency would conduct its guarantee operations solely on behalf of sponsoring member countries. According to the Convention, sponsored guarantees for investments will play an important supplementary role to the operations conducted by the agency in its own name. In addition to the latter operations, if one or more member countries agree to sponsor guarantees for these investments, the agency may, in accordance with Article 24, provide guarantees for other investments and may also offer additional reinsurance. The specific provisions regarding sponsored guarantee operations are set forth in Annex I, and Annex II constitutes an indispensable part of the Convention. It must be emphasized that, pursuant to Article 2(c) of Annex I, the assets held and managed by the agency in the sponsored trust funds described below must be kept separate from the agency’s own assets, and the agency shall not be liable for the obligations of sponsored guarantee operations with its own assets.

Query_Text_cn: 向机构提议担保一项投资的成员国将按其所赞助担保的数额承担分担损失的或有负债．保险费和其他因赞助担保而获得的收入将积存于一项独立的基金即所称的"赞助信托基金”之中．与赞助担保有关的行政开支和对索赔的支付，都将从这一基金中支出．在这一基金耗尽之后，赞助担保所导致的任何损失，都将由各成员国按各自所赞助担保的总额占所有成员国赞助担保总额的比例，由全体成员国进行分扭．但是，每一赞助担保成员国的最高责任将限于该成员国不时赞助的所有担保项下的最高或有负债总额．附件I第一条至第三条规定了一成员国赞助担保安排项下分担损失义务的限额。
Translation: The member country proposing to guarantee an investment to the Agency shall assume a contingent liability for sharing losses in proportion to the amount of the guarantee it sponsors. Premiums and other income derived from sponsored guarantees shall be accumulated in a separate fund, referred to as the "Sponsorship Trust Fund." Administrative expenses related to sponsored guarantees and payments of claims shall be paid out of this fund. After this fund is exhausted, any losses resulting from sponsored guarantees shall be shared among all member countries in proportion to the total amount of guarantees each has sponsored relative to the total amount sponsored by all member countries. However, the maximum liability of each sponsoring member country shall be limited to the highest aggregate contingent liability under all guarantees sponsored by that country from time to time. The limits of the obligation of a member country to share losses under a sponsored guarantee arrangement are set forth in Articles 1 to 3 of Annex I.

Query_Text_cn: 47．赞助担保会促使成员国在几种情况下提供投资保险保护．没有国家性机构的成员国可以利用这一制度为其投资者提供担保．对于其他成员国，赞助担保可能被用作分散风险的方法，因为赞助担保使成员国用按比例分担赞助信托基金项下全部或有负债来替代其国家性机构担保的投资的全部或有负债。
Translation: 47. Sponsorship guarantees will prompt member countries to provide investment insurance protection in several situations. Member countries without national agencies can use this system to offer guarantees to their investors. For other member countries, sponsorship guarantees may serve as a means of risk diversification, as they allow member countries to replace the full contingent liabilities of investments guaranteed by their national agencies with proportionate sharing of all contingent liabilities under the Sponsorship Trust Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 48．一般来说，适用于机构本身业务的本公约有关担保业务和财务管理的条款，将也适用于赞助担保（附件I第六条）．特别是本公约第十一条和第十二条项下的适格要件也适用于被赞助担保的投资．但是有关赞助担保投资的对象不限于成员国国民．附件I第一条（a）款规定，这类投资可以"由任何国籍的一个投资者或任何一个或几个国籍的投资者进行”。
Translation: Generally, the provisions of this Convention concerning guarantee operations and financial management that apply to the institution’s own operations shall also apply to sponsored guarantees (Article VI of Annex I). In particular, the eligibility requirements under Articles 11 and 12 of this Convention shall also apply to investments covered by sponsored guarantees. However, the scope of sponsored guarantee investments is not limited to nationals of member countries. Article I(a) of Annex I stipulates that such investments may be made “by an investor or investors of any nationality.”

Query_Text_cn: 东道国可以共同赞助担保一项投资．共同赞助担保表明东道国在投资中有扳大的发展利益和改善风险状况的愿望．附件I第一条（c）款规定机构有义务优先对待担保东道国共同赞助担保的投资。
Translation: The host country may co-sponsor the guarantee of an investment. Co-sponsoring a guarantee indicates that the host country has significant development interests in the investment and a desire to improve the risk profile. Article I(c) of Annex I stipulates that the Agency is obliged to give priority to guaranteeing investments co-sponsored by the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 49．本公约第十四条的规定将担保限制于在发展中国家的投资，这一限制适用于机构本身的业务，但并不扩大到赞助担保业务．成员国可以赞助担保在任何成员国的投资，但应特别注重在发晨中国家成员国的业务．允许在发达国家进行赞助担保业务的基本理由是，赞助担保在发达国家的投资对一些输出资本的发展中国家有特殊的利益，而又不会浪费机构宝贵的担保容量，因此，不会减少机构担保在发晨中国家的投资的能力．在一些情况下，投资于一个发达国家的公司．可能会促进在发展中国家的该公司的合营企业或其于公司．投资于发达国家也有这样的优点，能改善赞助信托基金业务中的风险状况，以及能促使其采取更大的风险分散措施。
Translation: Article 14 of this Convention limits guarantees to investments in developing countries; this restriction applies to the operations of the Agency itself but does not extend to sponsored guarantee operations. Member countries may sponsor guarantees for investments in any member country, but special attention should be given to operations in developing member countries. The fundamental reason for permitting sponsored guarantee operations in developed countries is that such guarantees for investments in developed countries offer particular benefits to some capital-exporting developing countries, while not wasting the Agency’s valuable guarantee capacity and, therefore, not diminishing the Agency’s ability to guarantee investments in developing countries. In certain cases, investment in a company in a developed country may facilitate joint ventures or subsidiaries of that company in developing countries. Investment in developed countries also has the advantage of improving the risk profile of sponsored trust fund operations and encouraging greater risk diversification.

Query_Text_cn: 50．附件I第五条（a）教授权机构在赞助担保的基础上向各成员国及其机构、成员国的区域性机构和成员国的私人保险人提供分保．这些分保业务应适用机构自身开展分保业务的同样条件。
Translation: 50. Article 5(a) of Annex I authorizes the Agency, on the basis of sponsorship and guarantee, to provide reinsurance to Member States and their agencies, regional agencies of Member States, and private insurers of Member States. Such reinsurance operations shall be subject to the same conditions as those applicable to the Agency's own reinsurance operations.

Query_Text_cn: 51．附件l第六条规定，机构以其自身资本和储备为基础开展担保业务所依的稳妥的商业和财务惯例也适用于赞助担保业务．像以自己的名义承保的那样，机构将不赞助担保具有不可接受的高风险的投资或将恶化其风险状况的投资．赞助成员国的信任也将有助于赞助担保业务的开展，这种信任的程度就像存在于最可信任的成员国之间的信任那样．附件I第一条（c）款特别规定机构应"适当注意赞助成员国是否能够履行本附件所规定的义务”而且，可指望赞助担保业务在财务上将像机构开展本身担保业务一样的稳妥。
Translation: Article 6 of Annex I stipulates that the sound commercial and financial practices on which the institution relies when conducting guarantee business based on its own capital and reserves shall also apply to sponsored guarantee business. Just as when underwriting in its own name, the institution will not sponsor guarantees for investments that carry unacceptably high risks or that would worsen its risk profile. The trust placed by sponsoring member countries will also facilitate the conduct of sponsored guarantee business, and the degree of such trust should be akin to the trust that exists among the most reliable member countries. Article 1(c) of Annex I specifically provides that the institution shall “give due consideration to the ability of the sponsoring member country to fulfill the obligations set forth in this Annex,” and it can be expected that sponsored guarantee business will be conducted with the same prudence, from a financial perspective, as the institution’s own guarantee business.

Query_Text_cn: 52．附件I第一条（d）款要求机构与赞助成员国就有关赞助担保业务的事项进行定期磋商．而且，投票权的分配将为决定赞助担保投资而修改，每一赞助担保成员国和赞助担保投资的东道国每赞助担保或接受1万特别提款权的投资，将分配到1张追加票（附件I第七条）．因此，从理论上说，有这样的可能性，董事会为赞助担保业务所通过的条款和条件可能与机构以自己名义开展业务的条款和条件不一致。
Translation: 52. Article I, Section (d) of Annex I requires the institution to hold regular consultations with sponsoring member countries on matters related to sponsored guarantee operations. Furthermore, the allocation of voting rights will be adjusted to determine sponsored guarantee investments: for each sponsored guarantee or investment of SDR 10,000 accepted, one additional vote will be allocated to both the sponsoring guarantee member country and the host country of the sponsored guarantee investment (Annex I, Article VII).
