Translation: Military authorities, even in areas that have been invaded or occupied, shall permit residents or relief organizations to independently collect and care for the wounded and sick of any nationality.

Query_Text_cn: 一般平民应尊重此种伤者、病者；尤不得施以暴行。
Translation: Ordinary civilians should respect such wounded or sick individuals and must not subject them to acts of violence.

Query_Text_cn: 任何人不得因看护伤者、病者而被侵扰或定罪。
Translation: No one shall be disturbed or prosecuted for caring for the wounded or sick.

Query_Text_cn: 本条规定并不免除占领国对于伤者、病者给予身体上及精神上照顾之义务。
Translation: This provision does not exempt the occupying power from its obligation to provide physical and mental care to the wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条医务部门之固定医疗所，及流动医疗队，在任何情况下不得被攻击，而应随时受冲突各方之尊重及保护。
Translation: Article 19: Fixed medical establishments and mobile medical units of medical departments shall under no circumstances be attacked and must be respected and protected at all times by all parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 倘落于敌方之手，在俘获国自身对于发现在该医疗所及医疗队之伤者、病者未能保证必需之照顾期中，其人员仍应有执行其任务之自由。
Translation: If captured by the enemy, during the period when the Detaining Power is unable to ensure the necessary care for the wounded and sick found at the medical establishment or with the medical unit, its personnel shall nevertheless be free to carry out their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 负责当局应保护上述医疗所及医疗队尽可能如此设置，以期不致因对军事目标之攻击而危及其安全。
Translation: The responsible authorities shall ensure, to the extent possible, that the aforementioned medical establishments and medical units are so situated that attacks against military objectives do not imperil their safety.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条1949年8月12日改善海上武装部队伤者病者及遇船难者境遇之日内瓦公约所保护之医院船，不得自陆上加以攻击。
Translation: Hospital ships protected by the Geneva Convention of August 12, 1949, for the Amelioration of the Condition of Wounded, Sick and Shipwrecked Members of Armed Forces at Sea shall not be attacked from the land.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条医务部门之固定医疗所及流动医疗队应得之保护不得停止，除非此等组织越出其人道主义任务之外，用以从事有害于敌方之行为。
Translation: Article 21: The protection to which fixed medical establishments and mobile medical units of medical departments are entitled shall not cease, except in cases where such organizations exceed their humanitarian functions and engage in activities harmful to the enemy.

Query_Text_cn: 惟如经给予相当警告，并依各个情形，指定合理之时限而警告仍被忽视时，始得停止保护。
Translation: Protection may only be suspended after appropriate warnings have been given, reasonable time limits have been specified according to each circumstance, and such warnings have been disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: (五)医疗所或医疗队或其人员扩展其人道主义的活动及于伤病平民之照顾。
Translation: 5. Medical establishments or medical teams, or their personnel, may extend their humanitarian activities to the care of wounded and sick civilians.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条平时各缔约国及战事开始后冲突各方，均得在其领土内，于必要时在占领地内，设立医院地带及处所，加以适当的组织以便保护伤者、病者，及在该地带处所负责组织与管理工作以及照顾集中于该处人们之人员，俾免受战争影响。
Translation: Article 23: At all times, each Contracting Party, as well as the parties to a conflict after the outbreak of hostilities, may establish hospital zones and localities within their own territory and, when necessary, in occupied areas. These zones and localities shall be properly organized to protect the wounded and sick, as well as the personnel responsible for organizing, administering, and caring for those gathered in such zones, so that they may be sheltered from the effects of war.

Query_Text_cn: 在战事开始时，及其进行中，有关各方得缔结协定互相承认其所设立之医院地带及处所。
Translation: At the outset of hostilities and during their course, the parties concerned may conclude agreements mutually recognizing the hospital zones and localities established by each of them.

Query_Text_cn: 各该国得为此目的实施本公约所附协定草案之规定，连同其所认为必要之修改。
Translation: Each of the said countries shall implement the provisions of the draft agreement annexed to this Convention for this purpose, together with any modifications it deems necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 为便利此等医院地带及处所之设立与承认，保护国及红十字国际委员会当被邀从事斡旋。
Translation: To facilitate the establishment and recognition of such hospital zones and localities, the Protecting Powers and the International Committee of the Red Cross shall be invited to undertake mediation.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条专门从事寻觅、收集、运送、医治伤者、病者及预防疾病之医务人员，专门从事管理医疗队及医疗所之职员以及随军牧师，在一切情况下应受尊重与保护。
Translation: Article 24: Medical personnel exclusively engaged in searching for, collecting, transporting, or treating the wounded and sick, as well as in disease prevention, staff exclusively responsible for managing medical units and establishments, and chaplains attached to the armed forces shall be respected and protected in all circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条武装部队中曾受特别训练以备于需要时充当医院勤务员、护士或辅助担架员，从事寻觅、收集、运送或诊疗伤者及病者之人员，如其执行任务时与敌人接触，或落于敌方之手，应同样受尊重与保护。
Translation: Article 25 Personnel in the armed forces who have received special training to serve, when necessary, as hospital orderlies, nurses, or auxiliary stretcher-bearers, and who are engaged in searching for, collecting, transporting, or treating the wounded and sick, shall, if they come into contact with the enemy or fall into enemy hands while performing their duties, be accorded the same respect and protection.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条凡经本国政府正式认可并核准之各国红十字会及其他志愿救济团体之员，如担任第二十四条所述人员同样之任务，则应与该条所述人员处于同样地位，但此类团体之人员应受军事法规之约束。
Translation: Article 26: Members of national Red Cross societies and other voluntary relief organizations officially recognized and approved by their respective governments, when performing the same duties as those described in Article 24, shall be accorded the same status as the personnel mentioned in that article. However, such members shall be subject to military regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 每一缔约国应将在其责任下准许从事协助其武装部队的正规医疗工作之各团体之名称，通知其他一方。此项通知，应于平时，或战事开始时，或战事进行中，但无论如何，在实际使用各该名称以前为之。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall notify the other Parties of the names of all organizations authorized under its responsibility to undertake regular medical activities in support of its armed forces. Such notification shall be made in peacetime, at the outbreak of hostilities, or during the course of hostilities, but in any case, prior to the actual use of any such names.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条凡中立国认可之团体，必需经其本国政府之事先同意及有关冲突一方之核准，始得以其医疗人员及医疗队协助该冲突之一方。
Translation: Article 27: Any organization recognized by a neutral country must obtain prior consent from its own government and approval from the party to the conflict concerned before its medical personnel and units may assist one of the parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 此项人员及此等医疗队应受该冲突一方之管制。
Translation: Such personnel and medical units shall be subject to the control of the Party to the conflict in whose hands they are.

Query_Text_cn: 该中立国应将此项同意通知接受协助国家之敌方。
Translation: The neutral country shall notify the enemy of the assisted state of its consent.

Query_Text_cn: 接受此项协助之冲突一方在利用之前，必须通知敌方。
Translation: The party to the conflict receiving such assistance must notify the enemy before making use of it.

Query_Text_cn: 此种协助在任何情况下不得视为对于冲突之干预。
Translation: Such assistance shall not, under any circumstances, be regarded as intervention in the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 对于第一款所指之人员于离开其所属之中立国前，应发给第四十条所规定之身份证。
Translation: Before leaving the neutral country to which they belong, the persons referred to in paragraph one shall be issued the identity card prescribed in Article 40.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条第二十四及二十六各条所指人员之落于敌方手中者，仅在战俘之健康状况精神需要以及人数上均有此要求时，方得留用之。
Translation: Persons referred to in Articles 24 and 26 of Article 28 who fall into enemy hands may be retained only when required by the health conditions, mental needs, and number of prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 因上述情形而留用之人员不得视为战俘。
Translation: Personnel retained under the above circumstances shall not be regarded as prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 但至少应享受1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约所规定之利益。
Translation: But at the very least, they should enjoy the benefits stipulated by the Geneva Convention of August 12, 1949, concerning the treatment of prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 上项人员应在拘留国军事法规范围内，并在该国主管部门管辖下，本其职业之道义，继续为战俘，尤其属于其本国武装部队者，执行其医疗及精神任务。
Translation: The above-mentioned personnel shall remain within the scope of the detaining power's military regulations and under the jurisdiction of its competent authorities, and, in accordance with the ethical standards of their profession, continue to perform their medical and spiritual duties for prisoners of war, especially those belonging to their own armed forces.

Query_Text_cn: ()彼等应许其定期访问战俘营外之劳动队或医院中之战俘。
Translation: They shall be permitted to visit prisoners of war working in labor detachments or held in hospitals outside the prisoner-of-war camps at regular intervals.

Query_Text_cn: 拘留国应供给所需之交通工具。
Translation: The Detaining Power shall provide the necessary means of transportation.

Query_Text_cn: ()关于每一战俘营中留用医务人员之职务上活动，由该营最高级医官对该营军事当局负责。
Translation: The activities related to the duties of retained medical personnel in each prisoner-of-war camp shall be supervised by the senior medical officer of the camp, who is responsible to the camp's military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，在战事开始时，冲突各方应就医务人员相当等级之事取得协议，其中包括第二十六条所列团体之医务人员之等级。
Translation: To this end, at the outset of hostilities, the parties to the conflict shall reach an agreement on the equivalence of medical personnel ranks, including the ranks of medical personnel belonging to the organizations listed in Article 26.

Query_Text_cn: 上述医官及随军牧师有权直接与该营之军事及医务当局接洽有关职务之一切问题，该军事及医务当局应予彼等以有关此项问题之通讯所必需之便利。
Translation: The aforementioned medical officers and chaplains accompanying the armed forces shall have the right to communicate directly with the military and medical authorities of the camp on all matters pertaining to their duties. The said military and medical authorities shall provide them with all facilities necessary for such communications.

Query_Text_cn: ()营中留用人员虽应服从内部纪律，但不得令其从事医疗或宗教任务以外之任何工作。
Translation: Retained personnel in the camp shall be subject to internal discipline, but shall not be required to perform any work other than medical or religious duties.

Query_Text_cn: 在战事中，冲突各方应制定关于可能时遣返留用人员之办法，并决定遣返之程序。
Translation: During hostilities, all parties to the conflict shall establish procedures for the repatriation of retained personnel whenever possible and determine the process for repatriation.

Query_Text_cn: 上述各规定并不解除拘留国对于战俘医疗及精神上之福利所应尽之义务。
Translation: The above provisions do not relieve the Detaining Power of its obligations regarding the medical and mental welfare of prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条第二十五条所指人员落于敌方手中者，应为战俘，但于需要时应令其担任医务工作。
Translation: Persons referred to in Article 25 who fall into enemy hands shall be considered prisoners of war, but may be required to carry out medical duties when necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条非系第二十八条所规定之必需留用人员，一俟归路可通及军情许可，应将其送回其所属之冲突一方。
Translation: Article 30 Personnel other than those required to be retained as specified in Article 28 shall be sent back to the party to the conflict to which they belong as soon as communication routes are open and military considerations permit.

Query_Text_cn: 上述人员在等候回国期间，不应视为战俘，但至少应享受1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约所规定之利益。
Translation: The above-mentioned personnel, while awaiting repatriation, shall not be regarded as prisoners of war, but shall at least enjoy the benefits provided by the Geneva Convention of August 12, 1949, concerning the treatment of prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 彼等并应在敌方指挥下，继续执行其任务，尤以派其照顾其所同属冲突一方之伤者、病者为宜。
Translation: They shall also continue to carry out their duties under the direction of the enemy, particularly by attending to the wounded and sick belonging to the same party to the conflict as themselves.

Query_Text_cn: 彼等出发时，应携带其所有行李、个人用品、贵重品及工具等。
Translation: They should take all their luggage, personal belongings, valuables, and tools with them when departing.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条依第三十条规定，送回人员之选择，应不拘种族、宗教或政治意见之任何考虑，但宜按照其被俘日期之次序及身体健康之状况为之。
Translation: Article 31: In accordance with the provisions of Article 30, the selection of persons to be repatriated shall not be influenced by considerations of race, religion, or political opinions. However, preference should be given based on the order of their capture and their state of health.

Query_Text_cn: 自战事开始时起，冲突各方得以特别协定，按照战俘之人数之比例及战俘营中此等人员之分配，决定留用人员之百分比。
Translation: Since the outbreak of hostilities, the parties to the conflict may, by special agreement and in proportion to the number of prisoners of war and their distribution among the camps, determine the percentage of retained personnel.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条第二十七条所指之人员落于敌方之手者，不得拘留。
Translation: Article 32: Persons referred to in Article 27 who fall into enemy hands shall not be detained.

Query_Text_cn: 除另有协议外，应许其返回本国，如其不可能，则一俟归路可通及军情许可，应准予返回其所服役之冲突一方的领土。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed, they shall be permitted to return to their own country; if this is not possible, they shall be allowed to return to the territory of the party to the conflict in whose service they were employed as soon as the route is open and military considerations permit.

Query_Text_cn: 等候释放期间，彼等应在敌方指导下，继续其工作，尤以担任看护其所服役之冲突一方之伤者、病者为宜。
Translation: While awaiting release, they shall continue their duties under the direction of the enemy, particularly by caring for the wounded and sick of the party to the conflict they serve.

Query_Text_cn: 彼等出发时，应携带其行李、个人用品、贵重品、工具、武器，并于可能时，其所有之交通工具。
Translation: When they depart, they should bring their luggage, personal belongings, valuables, tools, weapons, and, when possible, any means of transportation they own.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方对于在其权力下之此种人员，应予以与本国武装部队相等人员同样之食物、居所、津贴及薪给。
Translation: Each party to the conflict shall provide such persons under its authority with the same food, accommodation, allowances, and pay as those given to members of its own armed forces of equivalent rank.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情形下，食物之质，量及种类均应足以维持上述人员之正常健康状况。
Translation: In all circumstances, the quality, quantity, and variety of food shall be sufficient to maintain the normal health of the aforementioned persons.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条武装部队之流动医疗队落于敌方之手者，其器材应留作照顾伤者及病者之用。
Translation: Article 33: If mobile medical units of the armed forces fall into enemy hands, their equipment shall be retained for the care of the wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 武装部队之固定医疗所的建筑物、器材及物资，应仍受战争法规之拘束，但在其为照顾伤者、病者所必需之期间，不得移作别用。
Translation: The buildings, equipment, and supplies of fixed medical establishments of the armed forces shall remain subject to the laws of war, but during the period when they are necessary for the care of the wounded and sick, they shall not be diverted to other uses.

Query_Text_cn: 惟战地司令遇紧急军事需要时得使用之，但须彼等预订关于在该所疗养之伤者、病者的福利之办法。
Translation: They may be used only by the commander of the battlefield in cases of urgent military necessity, but such use must be subject to arrangements made in advance for the welfare of the wounded and sick being cared for there.

Query_Text_cn: 本条所指之器材与物资不得故意摧毁。
Translation: The equipment and materials referred to in this article must not be intentionally destroyed.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条凡许予本公约的特权之各救济团体，其不动产与动产应视为私有财产。
Translation: Article 34 All relief organizations granted the privileges of this Convention shall have their real and personal property regarded as private property.

Query_Text_cn: 战争法规及惯例所承认之交战国征用权，仅在紧急需要的场合，并在对伤者、病者之福利已有保证后，始得行使。
Translation: The right of requisition recognized by the laws and customs of war may only be exercised in cases of urgent necessity, and only after ensuring the welfare of the wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条伤者及病者或医疗设备之运输队，应与流动医疗队受同样之尊重及保护。
Translation: Article 35: Convoys transporting the wounded, sick, or medical equipment shall be accorded the same respect and protection as mobile medical units.

Query_Text_cn: 此项运输队或车辆如落于敌方手中时，应受战争法规之拘束；但以俘获该项运输或车辆之冲突一方在一切情形下，应保证照顾其所载运之伤者、病者为条件。
Translation: If such convoys or vehicles fall into enemy hands, they shall be subject to the laws of war; however, the party capturing these convoys or vehicles must, under all circumstances, ensure the care of the wounded and sick being transported therein.

Query_Text_cn: 文职人员及由征用所得之一切运输工具应受国际法一般规则之拘束。
Translation: Civilian personnel and all means of transportation requisitioned shall be subject to the general rules of international law.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条对于医务飞机，即专用以搬移伤者、病者，及运送医务人员及设备之飞机，不得袭击，而在各有关交战国间所特别约定之高度、时间及航线飞行时，应受各交战国之尊重。
Translation: Article 36: Medical aircraft, namely aircraft exclusively employed for the removal of wounded and sick persons and for the transport of medical personnel and equipment, shall not be attacked. When flying at altitudes, times, and on routes specifically agreed upon by the parties to the conflict concerned, such aircraft shall be respected by those parties.

Query_Text_cn: 此项飞机在其上下及两侧面应显明标以第三十八条所规定之特殊标志，以及其本国国旗。
Translation: The aircraft shall bear the distinctive emblem prescribed in Article 38, prominently displayed on its upper, lower, and lateral surfaces, as well as the national flag of its country.

Query_Text_cn: 并应备有战事开始时或战事进行中经各交战国间同意之任何其他标志或识别方法。
Translation: And any other signs or means of identification agreed upon by the belligerent parties at the outbreak of hostilities or during the course of the conflict shall also be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 除另有协议外，在敌人领土或敌人占领地上空之飞行应予禁止。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed, flights over enemy territory or enemy-occupied areas shall be prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 医务飞机应服从一切降落命令。
Translation: Medical aircraft must comply with all landing orders.

Query_Text_cn: 如被令降落，而需要检查时，则经过检查后，该机载其乘员得继续航行。
Translation: If the aircraft is ordered to land and an inspection is required, the aircraft and its crew may continue their flight after the inspection is completed.

Query_Text_cn: 非自愿降落于敌人领土或敌人占领地时，机内之伤者、病者及飞行人员应为战俘。
Translation: In the event of an involuntary landing on enemy territory or areas occupied by the enemy, the wounded, sick, and flight crew aboard the aircraft shall be considered prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 医务人员应按第二十四条及以下各条待遇之。
Translation: Medical personnel shall be treated in accordance with Article 24 and the following articles.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条冲突各方之医务飞机，在本条第二款规定之拘束下，得在中立国之领土上空飞行，必要时，得在该国领土降落，或用以为停留站。
Translation: Medical aircraft of the parties to the conflict may, subject to the restrictions laid down in the second paragraph of this Article, fly over the territory of neutral States and, in case of necessity, land or use it as a stopover.

Query_Text_cn: 该项飞机之飞越上述领土，应预先通知各中立国，并服从一切水陆降落之命令。
Translation: The flight of such aircraft over the aforementioned territories shall be subject to prior notification to all neutral countries and compliance with any orders to land on land or water.

Query_Text_cn: 仅在冲突各方与有关中立国特别约定之航线、高度及时间飞行时，始免受袭击。
Translation: Exemption from attack is granted only when flying along routes, at altitudes, and during times specifically agreed upon by all parties to the conflict and the relevant neutral countries.

Query_Text_cn: 但中立国对于医疗飞机之飞越其领土或在其领土降落，得规定条件或限制。
Translation: However, neutral countries may stipulate conditions or restrictions regarding the passage of medical aircraft over their territory or their landing within it.

Query_Text_cn: 此项可能的条件与限制对于冲突各方应一律适用。
Translation: These possible conditions and restrictions should apply equally to all parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 除中立国与冲突各方另有协议外，凡经地方当局之同意由医务飞机运至中立国领土之伤者、病者，如国际法有此要求，应由中立国以适当方式予以拘留，俾彼等不能再行参加战斗。
Translation: Except where otherwise agreed between the neutral Power and the parties to the conflict, wounded and sick persons who are conveyed by medical aircraft to the territory of a neutral Power with the consent of the local authorities shall, if so required by international law, be detained by the neutral Power in such a manner that they cannot take part in hostilities again.

Query_Text_cn: 医院收容与拘禁之费用应由其所依附之国负担。
Translation: The expenses for hospitalization and detention shall be borne by the country to which the individual is affiliated.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条为对瑞士表示敬意，白底红十字之旗样，系将其联邦国旗翻转而形成者，留作武装部队医务部门之标志与特殊记号。
Translation: Article 38: As a mark of respect to Switzerland, the flag featuring a red cross on a white background, which is formed by reversing the Swiss federal flag, shall be reserved as the emblem and distinctive sign of the medical services of the armed forces.

Query_Text_cn: 但各国如已采用白底红新月或白底红狮与日以代替红十字之标志者，此等标志亦为本公约规定所承认。
Translation: However, if any countries have already adopted the red crescent on a white background or the red lion and sun on a white background in place of the red cross as their emblem, these emblems shall also be recognized by the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条在军事主管当局之指导下，上项标志应标明于旗帜、臂章，及医务部门所使用之一切设备上。
Translation: Article 39: Under the guidance of the military authorities, the aforementioned emblem shall be displayed on flags, armbands, and all equipment used by medical units.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条第二十四、二十六、二十七各条所指之人员，应在左臂佩带由军事机关发给并盖印而具有特殊标志之防水臂章。
Translation: Personnel referred to in Articles 24, 26, and 27 of Article 40 shall wear a waterproof armband with a special insignia on their left arm, issued and stamped by the military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 此种人员除应携带第十六条所述之身份牌外，应另携带具有此项特殊标志之特种身份证。
Translation: In addition to carrying the identification badge specified in Article 16, such personnel shall also carry a special identity card bearing this distinctive emblem.

Query_Text_cn: 此证应有防水之效能，并具有适当的尺寸以便携带于衣袋内。
Translation: This certificate should be waterproof and of an appropriate size to be conveniently carried in a pocket.

Query_Text_cn: 其上应用本国文字，至少载明持用者之姓名、出生日期、等级、番号，并应注明其以何种身份享受本公约之保护。
Translation: The document shall bear inscriptions in the national language and at least indicate the holder's name, date of birth, rank, and number, as well as specify the capacity in which the holder is entitled to the protection of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 该证应附有本人像片，及其签字或指纹，或二者俱备。
Translation: The certificate should be accompanied by the holder's photograph and either their signature or fingerprint, or both.

Query_Text_cn: 该证并应加盖军事当局之钢印。
Translation: The certificate shall also bear the official seal of the military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 同一武装部队所使用之身份证应式样一致，并尽可能使各缔约国之武装部队使用类似的式样。
Translation: The identification cards used by the same armed forces shall be of a uniform design, and, as far as possible, the armed forces of the Contracting Parties shall use similar designs.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方可参照本公约所附之示范格式。
Translation: The parties to the conflict may refer to the model format attached to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 在战事开始时，冲突各方应互相通知其所采用之式样。
Translation: At the outset of hostilities, all parties to the conflict shall notify each other of the designs they have adopted.

Query_Text_cn: 在可能范围内，身份证至少应制备两份，其中一份存于本国。
Translation: Where possible, at least two copies of the identity card should be prepared, with one copy kept in the home country.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下对上述人员不得剥夺其符号或身份证，或佩带臂章之权利。
Translation: Under no circumstances shall the aforementioned personnel be deprived of their right to carry symbols or identification cards, or to wear armbands.

Query_Text_cn: 如遇遗失时得领取身份证副本或补领符号。
Translation: In case of loss, a duplicate or replacement of the identification card may be issued.

Query_Text_cn: 此项臂章由军事当局盖印发给。
Translation: This armband is issued and stamped by the military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 此种人员所佩带之军事证明文件，应注明其所受之特别训练，其所担任任务之临时性以及佩带臂章之权利。
Translation: The military identification documents carried by such personnel should specify the special training they have received, the temporary nature of their assigned tasks, and their right to wear armbands.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条本公约特殊旗帜之悬挂仅限于依本公约应受尊重之医疗队及医疗所，并须经军事当局同意。
Translation: Article 42 The display of the distinctive emblem of this Convention is restricted to medical units and establishments entitled to respect under this Convention, and is subject to the approval of the military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 流动医疗队与固定医疗所，均得加悬其所属冲突一方之国旗。
Translation: Both mobile medical units and fixed medical facilities shall display the national flag of the party to the conflict to which they belong.

Query_Text_cn: 但落于敌方手中之医疗队，除本公约之旗帜外，不得悬挂其他任何旗帜。
Translation: Medical units that fall into enemy hands shall not display any flag other than that of the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方，于军情许可下，应采取必要之步骤，使标明医疗队所之特殊标志易为敌方海陆空军所辨识，以避免任何敌对行动之可能。
Translation: All parties to the conflict, as permitted by military circumstances, shall take the necessary steps to ensure that the distinctive emblems indicating the presence of medical units are easily recognizable by enemy land, sea, and air forces, so as to avoid any possible hostile actions.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十三条属于中立国之医疗队经获准依照第二十七条所规定之条件协助一交战国者，在该交战国欲利用第四十二条所给予之特许时，除悬挂本公约之旗帜外，应加悬该交战国之国旗。
Translation: Medical units of a neutral country that are authorized, under the conditions set forth in Article 27, to assist a belligerent party, shall, when that belligerent wishes to avail itself of the privileges granted by Article 42, display not only the flag of the present Convention but also the national flag of that belligerent.

Query_Text_cn: 除受负责军事当局相反的命令之拘束外，此等医疗队得于一切情况下悬挂其本国国旗，即使其落于敌方手中。
Translation: Except when subject to contrary orders from the responsible military authorities, such medical units may display their national flag in all circumstances, even if they fall into enemy hands.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条除本条下列各款所列情形外，白底红十字标志及"红十字”字样，或"日内瓦十字”字样，不论在平时或战时，只能用以标明或保护本公约及规定类似事项之其他公约所保护之医疗队及医疗所，以及其人员与器材。
Translation: Article 44 Except for the circumstances listed in the following paragraphs of this Article, the emblem of the red cross on a white ground and the words "Red Cross" or "Geneva Cross," whether in peacetime or in wartime, may be used only to indicate or protect the medical units and establishments, as well as their personnel and equipment, protected by this Convention and by other conventions providing similar protection.

Query_Text_cn: 对于使用第三十八条第二款提及之标志之国家，本规定应适用于该项标志。
Translation: For countries using the emblem referred to in Article 38, Paragraph 2, these provisions shall apply to that emblem.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条所指之各国红十字会及其他救济团体仅在本款所指范围内有权使用给予本公约之保护之特别标志。
Translation: The national Red Cross societies and other relief organizations referred to in Article 26 shall be entitled to use the special emblem granted protection under this Convention only within the scope specified in this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，各国红十字会（红新月、红狮与日）在平时依照其本国法律，得使用红十字名义及标志，以从事其他符合国际红十字大会所定之原则之活动。
Translation: In addition, national Red Cross societies (Red Crescent, Red Lion and Sun) may, in accordance with their national laws, use the name and emblem of the Red Cross in peacetime to carry out other activities consistent with the principles established by the International Conference of the Red Cross.

Query_Text_cn: 此项标志应用比较小的尺寸，并不得置于臂章或屋顶上。
Translation: This emblem shall be used in relatively small sizes and must not be placed on armbands or rooftops.

Query_Text_cn: 国际红十字组织及其正式委派之人员，不论何时均得使用白底红十字之标志。
Translation: The International Red Cross and its duly authorized personnel may use the emblem of a red cross on a white background at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 作为一种例外措施，本公约之标志，得依照本国内法律并经本国红十字会（红新月、红狮与日）之一的明白许可，于平时得用以辨别用作救护车之车辆及标明专为免费治疗伤者、病者之救护站所在地。
Translation: As an exceptional measure, the emblem of this Convention may, in accordance with national laws and with the explicit permission of the national Red Cross (Red Crescent, Red Lion and Sun), be used in peacetime to identify vehicles serving as ambulances and to mark locations of aid stations dedicated exclusively to the free treatment of the wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条冲突各方应通过其总司令保证以上条款之详细执行，并依照本公约之一般原则规定预料不到之事件。
Translation: Article 45: The parties to the conflict shall ensure the detailed implementation of the above provisions through their respective commanders-in-chief, and address unforeseen events in accordance with the general principles stipulated by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条对于本公约所保护之伤者、病者、工作人员、建筑物或设备之报复行为，均予禁止。
Translation: Article 46 Acts of reprisal against the wounded, the sick, personnel, buildings, or equipment protected by this Convention are strictly prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十七条各缔约国在平时及战时应在各该国尽量广泛传播本公约之约文，尤应在其军事，并如可能时在公民教育计划中，包括本公约之学习，俾本公约之原则为全体人民，尤其武装战斗部队、医务人员及随军牧师所周知。
Translation: Article 47: Each Contracting Party shall, both in peacetime and in wartime, disseminate the text of this Convention as widely as possible within its country. In particular, the study of this Convention shall be included in military and, where possible, civilian educational programs, so that the principles of the Convention may be known to the entire population, especially to the armed fighting forces, medical personnel, and chaplains accompanying the troops.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十八条条缔约国应通过瑞士联邦委员会，在战时则通过保护国，互相通知本公约之正式译文，及其所采用以保证实施本公约之法律与规则。
Translation: Article 48: The Contracting Parties shall communicate to each other, through the Swiss Federal Council and, in wartime, through the Protecting Powers, the official translations of the present Convention, as well as the laws and regulations adopted to ensure its implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条各缔约国担任制定必要之立法，俾对于本身犯有或令人犯有下条所列之严重破坏本公约之行为之人，处以有效之刑事制裁。
Translation: Article 49: Each Contracting Party shall undertake to enact the necessary legislation to impose effective criminal sanctions on persons who commit, or cause others to commit, any of the serious violations of this Convention listed in the following article.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国有义务搜捕被控为曾犯或曾令人犯此种严重破坏本公约行为之人，并应将此种人，不分国籍，送交各该国法庭。
Translation: Each contracting party is obligated to search for persons accused of having committed or ordered the commission of such grave breaches of this Convention, and shall bring such persons, regardless of their nationality, before its courts.

Query_Text_cn: 该国亦得于自愿时，并依其立法之规定，将此种人送交另一有关之缔约国审判，但以该缔约国能指出案情显然者为限。
Translation: The country may also, at its discretion and in accordance with its legislation, surrender such persons to another concerned contracting party for trial, provided that the requesting contracting party can clearly specify the facts of the case.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国应采取必要之措施，以制止下条所列严重破坏本公约之行为以外之一切违反本公约之规定之行为。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall take necessary measures to prevent all acts in violation of the provisions of this Convention, other than the serious breaches listed in the following article.

Query_Text_cn: 在一切情况下，被告人应享有适当的审讯及辩护之保障。此种保障，不得次于1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约第一百零五条及其以下各条所规定者。
Translation: In all circumstances, the accused shall enjoy adequate safeguards for trial and defense. Such safeguards shall not be less than those provided in Article 105 and subsequent articles of the Geneva Convention of August 12, 1949, concerning the treatment of prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 故意杀害，酷刑或不人道待遇，包括生物学实验，故意使身体及健康遭受重大痛苦或严重伤害，以及无军事上之必要，而以非法与暴乱之方式，对财产之大规模的破坏与征收。
Translation: Deliberate killing, torture or inhuman treatment, including biological experiments, the intentional infliction of severe pain or serious injury to body or health, as well as large-scale destruction and seizure of property not justified by military necessity and carried out unlawfully and wantonly.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十一条任何缔约国不得自行推卸，或允许任何其他缔约国推卸，其本身或其他缔约国所负之关于上条所述之破坏公约行为之责任。
Translation: Article 51: No Contracting Party shall absolve itself, or permit any other Contracting Party to absolve itself, from the responsibility for acts of breach of the Convention as described in the preceding article, whether such responsibility pertains to itself or to any other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十二条经冲突之一方之请求，应依有关各方所决定之方式，进行关于任何被控违犯本公约的行为之调查。
Translation: Article 52: Upon the request of one of the parties to the conflict, an investigation shall be conducted, in the manner determined by the relevant parties, into any act alleged to be in violation of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如关于调查程序不能获致协议，则各方应同意选定一公断人，由其决定应遵行之程序。
Translation: If no agreement can be reached regarding the investigation procedures, all parties shall agree to appoint an arbitrator, who shall determine the procedures to be followed.

Query_Text_cn: 违约行为一经确定，冲突各方应使之终止，并应迅速加以取缔。
Translation: Once a breach of contract is established, all parties involved in the conflict shall ensure its termination and promptly suppress it.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十三条除按本公约有权使用者之外，一切个人、公私团体、商号或公司，不论其使用之目的及采用之日期为何，使用"红十字”或"日内瓦十字”之标志或名称以及其他仿冒之标志或名称，无论何时均应禁止。
Translation: Article 53: Except for those entitled to use it under this Convention, the use of the emblem or designation "Red Cross" or "Geneva Cross," as well as any imitation emblem or designation, by any individual, public or private organization, firm, or company, regardless of the purpose of use or the date of adoption, shall be prohibited at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 因为依采用翻转的联邦国旗而对瑞士表示之敬意，及瑞士国徽与本公约之特殊标志之间可以发生之混淆，任何私人、团体或商号，不论系作为厂标或商标，或此种厂标商标之一部分，或出于违反商业信义的目的，或在可以伤害瑞士国家情感之情况下，使用瑞士国徽，或仿冒此项国徽标志，无论何时，均应予禁止。
Translation: Out of respect for Switzerland, which has adopted the inverted federal flag, and due to the potential confusion between the Swiss national emblem and the distinctive emblem of this Convention, any private individual, group, or commercial entity is prohibited at all times from using the Swiss national emblem, or any imitation thereof, whether as a factory or trademark, or as part of such a mark, or for purposes contrary to commercial integrity, or in circumstances that may offend Swiss national sentiment.

Query_Text_cn: 但未参加1929年7月27日日内瓦公约之各缔约国对于早已使用前款规定之各种符号标志者，得限期令其停止使用。此项期限自本公约生效之日起，不得超过三年。但此种使用，在战时，不得视为系受本公约之保护。
Translation: However, the High Contracting Parties to the Geneva Convention of July 27, 1929, may set a deadline for those who have long used the emblems specified in the preceding paragraph but are not parties to the Convention, requiring them to cease such use. This deadline shall not exceed three years from the date this Convention enters into force. However, such use during wartime shall not be considered as protected under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 本条第一款所规定之禁止事项，亦适用于第三十八条第二款所指之标志及符号，但不影响其过去使用所获得之权利。
Translation: The prohibitions stipulated in Paragraph 1 of this Article shall also apply to the signs and symbols referred to in Paragraph 2 of Article 38, but shall not affect rights acquired through their prior use.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十四条各缔约国，若其立法尚未完备，应采取必要之措施，以便随时防止及取缔第五十三条所规定之各种滥用行为。
Translation: Article 54: Each Contracting Party, if its legislation is not yet complete, shall take the necessary measures to prevent and suppress at all times the various abuses specified in Article 53.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十五条本公约以英文及法文订立。
Translation: Article 55: This Convention is drawn up in English and French.

Query_Text_cn: 两种文字之约文具有同等效力。
Translation: The two language versions of the agreement shall have equal legal effect.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应准备本公约之俄文及西班牙文之正式译文。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall prepare official Russian and Spanish translations of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十六条本公约以本日为订立之日期，至1950年2月12日为止，凡参加1949年4月21日日内瓦会议各国，以及未参加该次会议，但系1864年、1906年或1929年救济战地军队伤者病者之日内瓦公约之缔约国，均可签字。
Translation: Article 56 This Convention, dated as of today, shall be open for signature until February 12, 1950, by any of the countries participating in the Geneva Conference of April 21, 1949, as well as by any country which did not participate in that Conference but is a party to the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armies in the Field of 1864, 1906, or 1929.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十七条本公约应尽速批准，其批准书应交存于伯尔尼。
Translation: Article 57 This Convention shall be ratified as soon as possible, and the instruments of ratification shall be deposited at Berne.

Query_Text_cn: 每一批准书交存时，应予登记，并由瑞士联邦委员会将该项登记之证明的抄本分送业经签字或通知加入本公约之各国。
Translation: Each instrument of ratification shall be registered upon deposit, and the Swiss Federal Council shall send a certified copy of the registration to each country that has signed or notified its accession to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十八条本公约在至少两国批准书交存后六个月发生效力。
Translation: Article 58: This Convention shall enter into force six months after the deposit of instruments of ratification by at least two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 嗣后，本公约对于每一缔约国自其批准书交存后六个月发生效力。
Translation: Thereafter, this Convention shall enter into force for each contracting party six months after the deposit of its instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十九条在各缔约国间之关系上，本公约代替1864年8月22日、1906年7月6日及1929年7月27日之各公约。
Translation: Article 59: In relations between the Contracting Parties, this Convention replaces the Conventions of August 22, 1864, July 6, 1906, and July 27, 1929.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十条本公约自生效之日起，任何未签字本公约之国家均得加入。
Translation: Article 60: From the date of entry into force of this Convention, any State that has not signed the Convention may accede to it.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十一条本公约之加入应以书面通知瑞士联邦委员会，自加入之通知收到之日起六个月后发生效力。
Translation: Article 61: Accession to this Convention shall be effected by written notification to the Swiss Federal Council and shall take effect six months after the date of receipt of such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应将此项加入通知所有业经签字或加入本公约之国家。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall communicate this to all States which have signed or acceded to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十二条第二条及第三条所载之情况应使在战事开始或占领之前或后，冲突各方所交存之批准书及加入之通知立即生效。
Translation: The situations described in Articles 2 and 3 of Article 62 shall cause the instruments of ratification and notifications of accession deposited by the parties to the conflict, whether before or after the outbreak of hostilities or occupation, to take immediate effect.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应将其从冲突各方收到之任何批准书或加入之通知，以最迅速方法通告之。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall communicate any instruments of ratification or accession received from the parties to the conflict by the most expeditious means.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十三条每一缔约国得自由退出本公约。
Translation: Article 63: Each contracting party is free to withdraw from this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 退约须用书面通知瑞士联邦委员会，并由该委员会转告所有缔约国政府。
Translation: Withdrawal shall be effected by written notification to the Swiss Federal Council, which shall communicate it to the governments of all the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 退约须于通知瑞士联邦委员会后一年发生效力。
Translation: Withdrawal shall take effect one year after notification to the Swiss Federal Council.

Query_Text_cn: 但如缔约国于作退约通知时已卷入冲突，则其退约须待至和议成立后，并在有关本公约所保护之人员之释放及遣返之工作完毕后，始能生效。
Translation: However, if the Contracting Party is involved in a conflict at the time of giving notice of withdrawal, the withdrawal shall not take effect until peace has been concluded and the release and repatriation of persons protected by the present Convention have been completed.

Query_Text_cn: 退约仅对该退约国有效，但并不减轻冲突各方依国际法原则仍应履行之义务，此等原则系产自文明人民间树立之惯例，人道法则与公众良心之要求。
Translation: Withdrawal is only effective for the withdrawing state and does not relieve the parties to a conflict of their obligations under the principles of international law, which are derived from the established customs among civilized nations, the laws of humanity, and the dictates of public conscience.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十四条瑞士联邦委员会应将本公约在联合国秘书处登记，并应将其所接获之所有关于本公约之批准、加入及退约通知联合国秘书处。
Translation: Article 64 The Swiss Federal Council shall register this Convention with the Secretariat of the United Nations and shall notify the Secretariat of all ratifications, accessions, and denunciations received in respect of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，下列签署人于交存全权证书后，签署本公约，以昭信守。
Translation: In witness whereof, the undersigned, having deposited their full powers, have signed this Convention to signify their adherence thereto.

Query_Text_cn: 1949年8月12日以英文法文订于日内瓦。
Translation: Done at Geneva on August 12, 1949, in English and French.

Query_Text_cn: 正本应交存于瑞士联邦委员会之档案中。
Translation: The original shall be deposited in the archives of the Swiss Federal Council.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应将证明之抄本送交每一签字及加入之国家。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall transmit a copy of the certificate to each signatory and acceding state.

Query_Text_cn: （德、美、阿根廷、奥匈、比、玻利维亚、巴西、保加利亚、智利、中国、哥伦比亚、古巴、丹麦、多米尼加、厄瓜多尔、西班牙、法国、英国、希腊、危地马拉、海地、意大利、日本、卢森堡、墨西哥、门的内哥罗、挪威、巴拿马、巴拉圭、荷兰、秘鲁、波斯、葡萄牙、罗马尼亚、俄国、萨尔瓦多、塞尔维亚、暹罗、瑞典、瑞士、土耳其、乌拉圭、委内瑞拉等各缔约国元首称呼略。
Translation: (Titles of the heads of state of the contracting parties, including Germany, the United States, Argentina, Austria-Hungary, Belgium, Bolivia, Brazil, Bulgaria, Chile, China, Colombia, Cuba, Denmark, the Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Spain, France, the United Kingdom, Greece, Guatemala, Haiti, Italy, Japan, Luxembourg, Mexico, Montenegro, Norway, Panama, Paraguay, the Netherlands, Peru, Persia, Portugal, Romania, Russia, El Salvador, Serbia, Siam, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, Uruguay, Venezuela, etc., are omitted.)

Query_Text_cn: 1993年7月15日，钱其琛外长致函该法院秘书长，通知我恢复在该法院的活动；该法院秘书长于1993年11月22日复函认可，其复函日期视为我加入该两公约之日期。
Translation: On July 15, 1993, Foreign Minister Qian Qichen sent a letter to the Registrar of the Court, notifying the resumption of China's activities at the Court. The Registrar replied on November 22, 1993, acknowledging this notification, and the date of the Registrar's reply is regarded as the date of China's accession to the two Conventions.

Query_Text_cn: （各全权代表名单略。
Translation: (The list of plenipotentiary representatives is omitted.)

Query_Text_cn: 第一条为了在各国关系中尽可能防止诉诸武力，各缔约国同意竭尽全力以保证和平解决国际争端。
Translation: Article 1: In order to prevent the resort to force in relations between countries as much as possible, the contracting parties agree to make every effort to ensure the peaceful settlement of international disputes.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条各缔约国同意,遇有严重分歧或争端,如情势允许,在诉诸武力之前应请求一个或几个友好国家进行斡旋或调停。
Translation: Article 2: The contracting parties agree that, in the event of serious disagreements or disputes, and if circumstances permit, they shall seek the mediation or conciliation of one or more friendly nations before resorting to the use of force.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条不论有无此项请求,各缔约国认为,由一个或几个与争端无关的国家在情势许可的情况下,主动向争端当事国家提供斡旋或调停,是有益的和可取的。
Translation: Article 3: Regardless of whether such a request is made, the contracting parties consider it beneficial and desirable for one or several countries not involved in the dispute to voluntarily offer mediation or conciliation to the parties concerned, whenever circumstances permit.

Query_Text_cn: 与争端无关的国家,即使在敌对过程中,也有权提供斡旋或调停。
Translation: Countries not involved in the dispute have the right to offer mediation or conciliation, even during the course of hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 争端的任一方绝对不能将此项权利的行使视为不友好的行为。
Translation: Neither party to the dispute shall regard the exercise of this right as an unfriendly act.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条调停者的作用在于协调对立的要求并平息争端各国之间可能发生的不满情绪。
Translation: Article 4: The role of the mediator is to reconcile conflicting demands and resolve disputes, as well as to alleviate any dissatisfaction that may arise among the countries involved.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条一俟争端的一方或调停者本身宣布他所建议的和解办法未被接受时,调停者的职能即告终止。
Translation: Article 5: The functions of the mediator shall terminate as soon as one of the parties to the dispute or the mediator himself declares that the proposed settlement has not been accepted.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条斡旋和调停,无论出自争端国的请求,或出自与争端无关的国家的主动,都只具有建议的性质,绝无拘束力。
Translation: Article 6: Mediation and conciliation, whether initiated at the request of the disputing parties or proposed by states not involved in the dispute, are purely advisory in nature and carry no binding force whatsoever.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条接受调停,除非有相反的协议,并不具有中止、推迟或阻碍动员或其他战争准备措施的作用。
Translation: Article 7 Acceptance of mediation, unless otherwise agreed, shall not have the effect of suspending, delaying, or impeding mobilization or other preparations for war.

Query_Text_cn: 如调停发生在敌对行为开始后,除非有相反的协议,进行中的军事行动无须停止。
Translation: If mediation takes place after the commencement of hostilities, ongoing military operations are not required to cease unless otherwise agreed.

Query_Text_cn: 遇有足以危及和平的严重纠纷时，争端各国各自选择一国并赋予与另一方所选择的国家进行直接联系的使命，以防止和平关系的破裂。
Translation: In the event of a serious dispute that could endanger peace, each party to the conflict shall select a country and entrust it with the mission of establishing direct contact with the country chosen by the other party, in order to prevent the breakdown of peaceful relations.

Query_Text_cn: 此项使命的期限，除有相反的协议，不得超过三十天。
Translation: The duration of this mission shall not exceed thirty days unless otherwise agreed.

Query_Text_cn: 在此期限内，争端各国停止有关争端问题的任何直接联系，此项争端应视为已全部移交各调停国。调停国必须尽一切努力以解决纠纷。遇有和平关系确已破裂时，这些国家均负有利用一切机会以恢复和平的共同任务。
Translation: During this period, all parties to the dispute shall cease any direct contact regarding the disputed issues, and the dispute shall be considered as having been fully referred to the mediating countries. The mediating countries must make every effort to resolve the dispute. In the event that peaceful relations have indeed been broken, these countries share the common responsibility of seizing every opportunity to restore peace.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条凡属既不涉及荣誉,也不影响基本利益,而仅属对于事实问题意见分歧的国际性争端,各缔约国认为,由未能通过外交途径达成协议的各方在情势许可的情况下,成立一国际调查委员会,通过公正和认真的调查,以澄清事实,从而促进此项争端的解决,将是有益的和可取的。
Translation: Article 9: For international disputes that neither involve honor nor affect fundamental interests, but are merely disagreements over factual matters, the contracting parties consider it beneficial and desirable, when circumstances permit and when agreement cannot be reached through diplomatic means, for the parties concerned to establish an international commission of inquiry. Through impartial and thorough investigation to clarify the facts, such a commission would facilitate the resolution of these disputes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条国际调查委员会由争端各方通过一项专约组成。
Translation: Article 10: The International Commission of Inquiry shall be established by a special agreement between the parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 调查专约规定需要审查的事实,并规定委员会组成的方式和时间以及委员的权限。
Translation: The special agreement for the inquiry shall specify the facts to be examined, determine the composition and timing of the commission, and define the powers of its members.

Query_Text_cn: 在需要时,专约也规定委员会的会址以及可否迁移到另一地方,委员会使用的语言和委员会准许对它使用的语言,以及各方应提交关于陈述事实的日期,总之,各方同意的一切条件。
Translation: When necessary, the special agreement also stipulates the location of the committee and whether it may be relocated to another place, the languages used by the committee and those permitted for use before it, as well as the dates by which the parties must submit statements of facts—in short, all conditions agreed upon by the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如各方认为有必要任命助理员,则调查专约应规定任命的方式及其职权的范围。
Translation: If all parties deem it necessary to appoint assistants, the special investigation agreement shall specify the method of appointment and the scope of their authority.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条如调查专约没有规定委员会的会址,委员会应设在海牙。
Translation: Article 11 If the special agreement for the inquiry does not specify the location of the Commission, the Commission shall be established in The Hague.

Query_Text_cn: 会址一经确定,除非当事各方同意,委员会不得变更。
Translation: Once the venue has been determined, the committee shall not change it unless all parties concerned agree.

Query_Text_cn: 如调查专约未规定使用的语言,则由委员会予以规定。
Translation: If the language to be used is not specified in the special agreement for the investigation, it shall be determined by the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条调查委员会的组成,除另有规定外,应遵照本公约第四十五条和第五十七条的规定。
Translation: Article 12 Unless otherwise provided, the composition of the Commission of Inquiry shall be in accordance with the provisions of Articles 45 and 57 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条委员或助理员因死亡、退休或因故出缺,应按照其任命的方式予以补缺。
Translation: Article 13: In the event of the death, retirement, or vacancy of a member or assistant, the position shall be filled in accordance with the original method of appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条当事各方有权任命特派人员出席调查委员会,其任务是代表本方并作为各方和委员会之间的中间人。
Translation: Article 14 Each party shall have the right to appoint special representatives to attend the Commission of Inquiry, whose task is to represent their respective parties and act as intermediaries between the parties and the Commission.

Query_Text_cn: 此外,各方有权聘请由它们指派的顾问或律师向委员会陈述它们的理由和维护它们的利益。
Translation: In addition, all parties have the right to engage advisors or lawyers appointed by them to present their arguments and defend their interests before the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条常设仲裁法院国际事务局应作为设在海牙的各调查委员会的秘书处,并将其办公处所和工作人员供缔约各方使用,以便于调查委员会进行工作。
Translation: Article 15 The International Bureau of the Permanent Court of Arbitration shall serve as the secretariat for the Commissions of Inquiry established in The Hague and shall provide its offices and staff for the use of the Contracting Parties, so as to facilitate the work of the Commissions of Inquiry.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条如委员会设在海牙以外的地点,它应任命一秘书长,并以其办公处作为其秘书处。
Translation: Article 16 If the Commission is established at a location other than The Hague, it shall appoint a Secretary-General and designate its office as the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书处受主席领导,其职责是为委员会会议作好必要的安排,作出记录,并在调查期间保管档案。此项档案随后将移交给海牙国际事务局。
Translation: The Secretariat operates under the leadership of the Chairperson and is responsible for making necessary arrangements for committee meetings, keeping records, and maintaining files during the investigation period. These files will subsequently be transferred to the International Bureau of Affairs in The Hague.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条为了促进调查委员会的组成和工作,各缔约国建议在各方未采纳其他规则前,下列规则将适用于调查的程序。
Translation: Article 17 In order to facilitate the establishment and functioning of the Commission of Inquiry, the Contracting Parties recommend that, unless other rules are adopted by the parties concerned, the following rules shall apply to the procedure of the inquiry.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条委员会应规定调查专约或本公约中未曾规定的程序的细节,并安排有关处理证据的一切手续。
Translation: Article 18: The Committee shall prescribe the details of procedures for investigations not specified in the special agreements or in this Convention, and shall make arrangements for all matters related to the handling of evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条调查应听取双方意见。
Translation: Article 19: The investigation shall hear the opinions of both parties.

Query_Text_cn: 在规定的日期,当事每一方应向委员会和另一方送达事实的说明书,如果有的话。在一切情况下,应送达它认为对判定真相有用的文件、证件和资料,以及它希望出庭作证的证人和鉴定人的名单。
Translation: On the specified date, each party shall submit to the committee and the other party a statement of facts, if any. In all cases, it shall provide any documents, evidence, and materials it deems useful for establishing the truth, as well as a list of witnesses and experts it wishes to have testify.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条委员会有权在当事国同意下,临时迁移到它认为对此种调查方法有用的地方,或派一位或几位委员到那里。
Translation: Article 20 The Committee shall have the authority, with the consent of the State Party concerned, to temporarily relocate to any place it deems useful for such investigative methods, or to send one or more of its members to that location.

Query_Text_cn: 但必须取得进行此项调查的所在地国家的许可。
Translation: However, permission must be obtained from the country where the investigation is to be conducted.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条每一项调查和对现场的调查应在当事国代理人或律师出席下或在他们已被正式传唤以后进行。
Translation: Article 21: Every investigation and on-site inspection shall be conducted in the presence of the agents or counsel of the parties concerned, or after they have been duly summoned.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条委员会有权要求当事国一方或另一方提供它认为有益的那些解释或资料。
Translation: Article 22: The Committee has the authority to request either party to provide any explanations or information it deems beneficial.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条当事各方应尽可能充分地向调查委员会提供一切必要的手段和便利,以使该委员会对有关事实获得完全的了解和正确的估计。
Translation: Article 23: The parties concerned shall, as far as possible, provide the investigation committee with all necessary means and facilities to enable the committee to gain a complete understanding and accurate assessment of the relevant facts.

Query_Text_cn: 各方承允按照各自国内法掌握的方法以保证经委员会传唤的处于它们领土内的证人和鉴定人出席。
Translation: Each party undertakes to ensure, in accordance with the methods provided by its domestic law, the attendance of witnesses and experts summoned by the Committee who are within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 如上述证人或鉴定人不能出席委员会,各方将安排他们到其所属国家的主管官员面前作出他们的证词。
Translation: If the aforementioned witnesses or experts are unable to attend the committee, each party shall arrange for them to give their testimony before the competent authorities of their respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条委员会如需在第三缔约国领土内办理各项通知书时,应直接向该国政府提出申请。
Translation: Article 24 When the Committee needs to serve any notifications within the territory of a third contracting state, it shall submit the application directly to the government of that state.

Query_Text_cn: 在现场进行采证,也应照此办理。
Translation: On-site evidence collection should also be conducted accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的而提出的申请应按照被申请国的国内法规定的方式办理。
Translation: Applications submitted for this purpose shall be processed in accordance with the procedures prescribed by the domestic laws of the requested country.

Query_Text_cn: 申请书不得予以拒绝,除非被申请国认为此项申请在性质上有损于它的主权或安全。
Translation: An application shall not be refused unless the requested country considers that the nature of the application is detrimental to its sovereignty or security.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会也始终有权通过该会所在地国来办理。
Translation: The committee always retains the right to conduct affairs through the country where it is located.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条证人和鉴定人应依照当事国的申请或委员会自己的动议予以传唤,并且在一切情况下,须通过上述人员所在地国政府传唤。
Translation: Article 25 Witnesses and experts shall be summoned at the request of the parties or on the initiative of the Committee itself, and in all cases, they must be summoned through the government of the country where such persons are located.

Query_Text_cn: 证人应在代理人和律师出席下按照委员会所规定的顺序,循序和分别作证。
Translation: Witnesses shall testify in the order, sequence, and separately as prescribed by the committee, in the presence of agents and lawyers.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条对证人的询问由主席主持。
Translation: Article 26 The questioning of witnesses shall be presided over by the chairperson.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会委员得向各证人提出他们认为适当的问题,以便对证词加以澄清或补充,或在弄清真实真相的必要限度内,了解与证人有关的任何问题。
Translation: Committee members may pose any questions they deem appropriate to witnesses in order to clarify or supplement testimony, or to inquire into any matters related to the witnesses as necessary to ascertain the true facts.

Query_Text_cn: 当事国代理人和律师不得打断证人作证,也不得直接向证人提出任何质询,但可以请求主席向证人提出他们认为有益的补充性质的问题。
Translation: Agents and lawyers of the parties shall not interrupt the testimony of witnesses, nor shall they directly question the witnesses. However, they may request the presiding officer to ask supplementary questions to the witnesses that they believe to be beneficial.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条证人作证不得读书面稿。
Translation: Article 27: Witnesses shall not read from written statements when giving testimony.

Query_Text_cn: 但是,如果所证事实的性质有此必要,可经主席准许参阅笔记或文件。
Translation: However, if the nature of the facts being testified requires it, notes or documents may be consulted with the permission of the chairperson.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条证人供词应当即作成记录并向证人宣读。
Translation: Article 28 The testimony of a witness shall be recorded immediately and read aloud to the witness.

Query_Text_cn: 证人得对记录作出他认为必要的修改和补充,并附录在他的证词之后。
Translation: The witness may make any modifications and additions to the record that he deems necessary, which shall be appended to his testimony.

Query_Text_cn: 证人的全部供词向证人宣读后,应要求证人签字。
Translation: After the entire testimony has been read to the witness, the witness shall be required to sign it.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条代理人有权在调查的过程中或结束时,用书面向委员会和当事另一方递交他们认为对判定真相有用的一切声明、要求或事实的摘要。
Translation: Article 29 Agents shall have the right, during or upon the conclusion of the investigation, to submit in writing to the Commission and the other party any statements, requests, or summaries of facts which they consider useful for determining the truth.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条委员会对决定的讨论不公开并须保守秘密。
Translation: Article 30 The Committee's deliberations on decisions shall not be made public and must be kept confidential.

Query_Text_cn: 一切决定均由委员会以多数作出。
Translation: All decisions shall be made by the committee by a majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 如一委员拒绝参加表决,应在记录中注明。
Translation: If a member refuses to participate in the vote, it should be noted in the record.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条委员会会议不得公开,调查的记录和文件均不予发表,但依据委员会在当事各方的同意下作出的决定在外。
Translation: Article 31: Committee meetings shall not be open to the public, and records and documents related to investigations shall not be published, except as otherwise decided by the Committee with the consent of all parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条在当事各方提出一切解释和证据以及所有证人已提供证据后,主席即宣告调查结束,委员会休会,以便讨论和起草报告。
Translation: Article 32: After all parties have presented their interpretations and evidence, and all witnesses have given their testimony, the Chair shall declare the investigation concluded. The Committee shall then adjourn to discuss and draft the report.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条报告由委员会全体委员签署。
Translation: Article 33 The report shall be signed by all members of the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会如有一人拒绝签字,应在报告上注明,但报告仍然有效。
Translation: If any member of the committee refuses to sign, it shall be noted in the report, but the report shall remain valid.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条委员会的报告应在公开庭上宣读,当事各方代理人和律师应到场或经正式传唤。
Translation: Article 34 The committee's report shall be read out in a public hearing, with the agents and lawyers of the parties concerned present or duly summoned.

Query_Text_cn: 报告副本应送给当事各方。
Translation: Copies of the report should be provided to all parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条委员会的报告限于对事实的确认,绝对没有仲裁裁决的性质。
Translation: Article 35 The committee's report is limited to the confirmation of facts and shall in no way have the nature of an arbitral award.

Query_Text_cn: 对此项确认的效力全由各方自由决定。
Translation: The effectiveness of this confirmation shall be determined solely at the discretion of each party.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条每一方负担它自己的费用，并平均分担委员会的费用。
Translation: Article 36: Each party shall bear its own expenses and share equally the expenses of the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条国际仲裁的目的是由各国自己选择的法官并在尊重法律的基础上,解决各国之间的纠纷。
Translation: Article 37: The purpose of international arbitration is to resolve disputes between countries by judges chosen by the parties themselves, based on respect for the law.

Query_Text_cn: 请求仲裁即意味着承诺对裁决的诚意服从。
Translation: Requesting arbitration implies a commitment to sincerely comply with the award.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条凡属法律性质的问题,特别是有关解释或适用国际公约的问题,各缔约国承认仲裁是解决通过外交途径所未能解决的纠纷的最有效也是最公正的方法。
Translation: Article 38 For all matters of a legal nature, especially those concerning the interpretation or application of international conventions, the Contracting Parties recognize arbitration as the most effective and equitable means of settling disputes that have not been resolved through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 因此,在关于上述问题的纠纷中,各缔约国在情势许可的情况下诉诸仲裁是可取的。
Translation: Therefore, in disputes concerning the aforementioned issues, it is advisable for the contracting parties to resort to arbitration whenever circumstances permit.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条仲裁专约是针对已经产生或最后可能产生的争端而缔结的。
Translation: Article 39: An arbitration agreement is concluded for disputes that have already arisen or may ultimately arise.

Query_Text_cn: 它可以包括任何争端或只包括某一类的争端。
Translation: It may include any disputes or only a specific category of disputes.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条不论一般条约或专门条约已明文规定各缔约国有诉诸仲裁的义务，各缔约国仍保留缔结新的一般的或专门的协定的权利，以便把强制仲裁扩大适用于各缔约国可能认为提交仲裁的一切案件。
Translation: Article 40: Regardless of whether general or special treaties expressly stipulate the obligation of the contracting parties to resort to arbitration, the contracting parties retain the right to conclude new general or special agreements in order to extend compulsory arbitration to all cases which they may consider appropriate for submission to arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十一条为便利将通过外交途径未能解决的国际争端立即诉诸仲裁,各缔约国承允维持第一届和平会议所建立的常设仲裁法院,并按照本公约所载程序规则随时可以投诉和开庭,除非当事国另有相反的规定。
Translation: Article 41 In order to facilitate the immediate submission to arbitration of international disputes that have not been resolved through diplomatic means, the Contracting Powers undertake to maintain the Permanent Court of Arbitration established by the First Peace Conference, and to ensure that it may be approached and may hold sessions at any time in accordance with the procedural rules set forth in this Convention, unless the parties concerned have agreed otherwise.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条常设仲裁法院对一切仲裁案件有管辖权,除非当事国之间另有成立特别法庭的协议。
Translation: Article 42 The Permanent Court of Arbitration shall have jurisdiction over all arbitration cases, unless the parties have agreed to establish a special tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十三条常设仲裁法院设在海牙。
Translation: Article 43 The Permanent Court of Arbitration shall be established at The Hague.

Query_Text_cn: 它保管档案并处理一切行政事务。
Translation: It maintains archives and handles all administrative affairs.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国承允将它们之间达成的任何仲裁条件以及由特别法庭作出的有关裁决,以核证无误的副本尽速送交事务局。
Translation: Each Contracting Party undertakes to promptly transmit to the Bureau certified true copies of any arbitration agreements concluded between them, as well as any decisions rendered by special tribunals.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国还承允将载明执行仲裁法院裁决的法律、规章和文件送交事务局。
Translation: Each contracting party also undertakes to submit to the Secretariat the laws, regulations, and documents specifying the enforcement of the decisions of the Arbitration Court.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条每个缔约国各指定公认的精通国际法问题、享有最高道德声望并愿意接受仲裁人职责的著名人士至多四名。
Translation: Article 44: Each contracting party may designate up to four persons of recognized competence in matters of international law, of the highest moral standing, and willing to accept the duties of arbitrator.

Query_Text_cn: 被选定的人士应列入法院成员名单,由事务局负责通知各缔约国。
Translation: The individuals selected shall be included in the list of court members, and the Secretariat shall be responsible for notifying all Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁人名单的任何变更,应由事务局通知各缔约国。
Translation: Any changes to the list of arbitrators shall be notified to all contracting parties by the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 两个或几个国家可以协商共同选定一个或几个成员。
Translation: Two or more countries may consult and jointly designate one or more members.

Query_Text_cn: 同一人士得由不同国家选定为成员。
Translation: The same individual may be designated as a member by different countries.

Query_Text_cn: 法院成员的任期为六年,期满可以连任。
Translation: The term of office for court members is six years and may be renewed upon expiration.

Query_Text_cn: 遇有法院成员死亡或退休,应按照该人原任命的同样方式予以补缺,新任期为六年。
Translation: In the event of the death or retirement of a member of the court, a replacement shall be appointed in the same manner as the original appointment, and the new term shall be six years.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条当缔约国愿将它们之间发生的一项争端诉诸常设仲裁法院以求解决时,应在法院成员总名单中挑选仲裁人组成法庭以受理此项争端。
Translation: Article 45: When contracting parties wish to submit a dispute arising between them to the Permanent Court of Arbitration for resolution, arbitrators shall be selected from the general list of court members to form a tribunal to hear the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 每一当事国任命两名仲裁人,其中只有一名可由本国国民充任或由该国从常设仲裁法院成员名单中选出一人充任,再由这些仲裁人共同选择一名公断人。
Translation: Each party shall appoint two arbitrators, of whom only one may be a national of that party or selected from the list of members of the Permanent Court of Arbitration by that party. These arbitrators shall then jointly select an umpire.

Query_Text_cn: 如票数相等,则公断人的选择应委托各当事国共同协议选定的第三国为之。
Translation: In the event of a tie in the number of votes, the selection of the umpire shall be entrusted to a third country jointly agreed upon by the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 如对选择第三国问题未能达成协议,则每一当事国各自选定一不同的国家,并由这样选定的国家共同选出公断人。
Translation: If no agreement can be reached on the selection of a third country, each party shall separately choose a different country, and the countries so chosen shall jointly appoint an arbitrator.

Query_Text_cn: 如在两个月内,这两个国家未能达成协议,则每一国各自从常设法院成员名单中提出候选人两名,但他们都不是当事国所任命的成员,并且不是任一当事国的国民。
Translation: If, within two months, the two countries fail to reach an agreement, each country shall nominate two candidates from the list of members of the Permanent Court, provided that none of them are members appointed by the parties concerned, nor nationals of either party.

Query_Text_cn: 公断人应由按上述办法提出的候选人用抽签决定。
Translation: The arbitrator shall be selected by drawing lots from the candidates nominated in accordance with the aforementioned procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条法庭一经组成,当事国应将它们诉诸法院的决定、仲裁协定的文本以及仲裁人的姓名通知事务局。
Translation: Article 46: Once the tribunal has been constituted, the parties shall notify the Secretariat of their submission of the dispute to the court, the text of the arbitration agreement, and the names of the arbitrators.

Query_Text_cn: 事务局应立即将仲裁协定和法庭其他成员的姓名通知每一仲裁人。
Translation: The Bureau shall immediately notify each arbitrator of the arbitration agreement and the names of the other members of the tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁法庭于当事国规定的日期开庭。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal shall hold hearings on the date specified by the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 事务局为法庭开庭作出必要的安排。
Translation: The Secretariat makes the necessary arrangements for court hearings.

Query_Text_cn: 法庭成员在执行职务或在外国期间,享有外交特权和豁免。
Translation: Members of the court, while performing their duties or when abroad, shall enjoy diplomatic privileges and immunities.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十七条事务局被准许将其办公处所和工作人员提供缔约国,以供任何一个特定仲裁庭之用。
Translation: Article 47: The Bureau is authorized to provide its office premises and staff to the Contracting Parties for the use of any specific arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 如果当事国同意诉诸常设仲裁法院,则法庭的管辖范围可以在章程规定的条件内,扩大适用于非缔约国之间或缔约国和非缔约国之间的争端。
Translation: If the parties concerned agree to submit their dispute to the Permanent Court of Arbitration, the jurisdiction of the Court may, under the conditions stipulated in its Statute, be extended to disputes between non-contracting parties or between contracting and non-contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十八条当两个或两个以上国家有可能发生严重争端时,各缔约国认为它们有义务提请这些国家注意常设仲裁法院是对它们敞开的。
Translation: Article 48: When there is a possibility of a serious dispute arising between two or more countries, each contracting party considers it their duty to draw the attention of those countries to the fact that the Permanent Court of Arbitration is open to them.

Query_Text_cn: 为此,各缔约国声明,对争端各国提请注意本公约的规定,和为了和平的崇高利益而建议诉诸常设法院这一事实,只能被视为一种斡旋性质的行动。
Translation: To this end, the contracting parties declare that drawing the attention of the disputing states to the provisions of this Convention and recommending recourse to the Permanent Court for the noble interests of peace shall be regarded solely as an act of mediation.

Query_Text_cn: 在两国之间发生争端时,两国中任何一国始终可以向国际事务局递送照会,声明它愿意把争端付诸仲裁。
Translation: In the event of a dispute between the two countries, either country may at any time submit a note to the Bureau of International Affairs, declaring its willingness to submit the dispute to arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 事务局应立即把该声明通知另一国。
Translation: The Secretariat shall immediately notify the other country of the statement.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条由各缔约国驻海牙的外交代表和荷兰外交大臣作为主席所组成的常设行政理事会负责指导和监督国际事务局。
Translation: Article 49: The Permanent Administrative Council, composed of the diplomatic representatives of the Contracting States in The Hague and presided over by the Dutch Minister of Foreign Affairs, is responsible for directing and supervising the International Bureau.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会决定它的程序规则以及一切其他必要的规则。
Translation: The Council shall determine its rules of procedure and all other necessary rules.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会应就一切可能发生的涉及法院工作的行政问题作出决定。
Translation: The Council shall make decisions on all administrative matters that may arise concerning the work of the Court.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会有全权处理事务局官员和雇员的任命、停职或撤职。
Translation: The Council has full authority over the appointment, suspension, or removal of the officers and employees of the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会规定薪金和工资并控制总的开支。
Translation: The board determines salaries and wages and controls overall expenditures.

Query_Text_cn: 在正式召开的会议中有九个理事的出席即可使理事会的讨论发生效力。
Translation: The presence of nine directors at a duly convened meeting shall constitute a quorum for the Board of Directors, enabling its deliberations to take effect.

Query_Text_cn: 决议案以多数票作出。
Translation: The resolution is adopted by a majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会应把它所通过的各项规章立即通知各缔约国。
Translation: The Council shall immediately notify all Contracting Parties of any regulations it adopts.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会并应把有关法院工作、行政事务和开支的年度报告提交各缔约国。
Translation: The Council shall also submit an annual report on the work, administrative affairs, and expenditures of the court to all contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 该报告也包括各缔约国根据第四十三条第三款和第四款向事务局通知的文件的重要内容的摘要。
Translation: The report also includes a summary of the key contents of documents notified to the Secretariat by the Contracting Parties pursuant to paragraphs 3 and 4 of Article 43.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十条事务局的费用应按照万国邮政联盟国际事务局所制定的比例，由各缔约国负担。
Translation: Article 50: The expenses of the Bureau of Affairs shall be borne by each contracting country in accordance with the scale established by the International Bureau of the Universal Postal Union.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十一条为了促进仲裁的发展,各缔约国已就下列规则达成协议,这些规则将适用于仲裁程序,除非当事国另有协议。
Translation: Article 51 In order to promote the development of arbitration, the Contracting States have agreed upon the following rules, which shall apply to arbitration proceedings unless the parties have agreed otherwise.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十二条诉诸仲裁的国家签订一项仲裁协定,其中规定争端的事由、任命仲裁人的日期、第六十三条所指的通知的次序和日期,以及每一方须预先存交的支付费用的数额。
Translation: Article 52 States resorting to arbitration shall conclude an arbitration agreement specifying the subject matter of the dispute, the date for the appointment of arbitrators, the order and dates of notifications referred to in Article 63, and the amount of costs to be deposited in advance by each party.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁协定也规定任命仲裁人的方式,法庭可能具有的一切特别权力,法庭开庭的地点,法庭应使用的语言和准许在庭上使用的其他语言,总而言之,当事国间商定的一切条件。
Translation: The arbitration agreement also stipulates the method for appointing arbitrators, any special powers the tribunal may possess, the location of the tribunal's hearings, the language to be used by the tribunal, and any other languages permitted in the proceedings—in short, all conditions agreed upon between the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十三条常设仲裁法院有权解决仲裁争端,如果当事国间商定将其提交它处理的话。
Translation: Article 53 The Permanent Court of Arbitration is authorized to resolve arbitration disputes if the parties agree to submit them to the Court.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本公约生效后缔结或续订的一般的仲裁条约所规定的争端。该条约对所有争端须订立一项仲裁协定,既未明示,也未暗示排除常设法院解决仲裁争端的权力。但如另一当事国声明,它认为争端不属于应归强制仲裁的范畴,则不能提交常设仲裁法院,除非仲裁条约赋予仲裁法庭对这一先决问题作出决定之权。
Translation: 1. Disputes stipulated in general arbitration treaties concluded or renewed after the entry into force of this Convention. Such treaties require the conclusion of an arbitration agreement for all disputes and neither expressly nor implicitly exclude the jurisdiction of the Permanent Court to resolve arbitration disputes. However, if another party declares that it considers the dispute not to fall within the scope of compulsory arbitration, the dispute may not be submitted to the Permanent Court of Arbitration unless the arbitration treaty confers upon the arbitral tribunal the authority to decide on this preliminary issue.

Query_Text_cn: 二、一个国家由于另一国拖欠其国民的契约性债务,而向该国索偿所引起的争端,而为了解决争端,已接受仲裁。
Translation: 2. A dispute arising from one country making a claim against another country due to the latter's default on contractual debts owed to the former's nationals, and for the resolution of such dispute, arbitration has already been accepted.

Query_Text_cn: 如接受仲裁必须服从应以其他方式解决仲裁争端这一条件,则此项规定不能适用。
Translation: If acceptance of arbitration is subject to the condition that arbitration disputes must be resolved by other means, this provision shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十四条如出现前条规定的情况,则仲裁争端应由一个按照第四十五条第三至第六段的规定所指派的五个成员组成的委员会予以解决。
Translation: Article 54: In the event of the circumstances specified in the preceding article, the arbitration dispute shall be resolved by a committee composed of five members appointed in accordance with paragraphs 3 to 6 of Article 45.

Query_Text_cn: 第五名委员为委员会的当然主席。
Translation: The fifth member shall serve as the ex officio chairperson of the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十五条仲裁职责可授予由当事各国自行指定的,或由它们在本公约所建立的常设仲裁法院成员中所选择的一个或几个仲裁人。
Translation: Article 55: Arbitration responsibilities may be assigned to arbitrators designated by the parties themselves, or to one or several arbitrators selected by them from among the members of the Permanent Court of Arbitration established under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如当事各方未能通过协议建立法庭,则按照第四十五条第三至第六段所规定的方式办理。
Translation: If the parties concerned fail to establish a tribunal through agreement, the matter shall be handled in accordance with paragraphs 3 to 6 of Article 45.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十六条如一国君主或国家元首被选为仲裁人,则仲裁程序由他决定。
Translation: Article 56: If a monarch or head of state is chosen as an arbitrator, the arbitration proceedings shall be determined by him.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十七条公断人为法庭的当然庭长。
Translation: Article 57: The arbitrator shall be the presiding judge of the court by default.

Query_Text_cn: 如法庭未设公断人,则由法庭自己任命庭长。
Translation: If the court has not appointed an arbitrator, the presiding judge shall be designated by the court itself.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十八条如按照第五十四条的规定,由一委员会解决仲裁争端,如无相反的协议,则由委员会本身组成法庭。
Translation: Article 58: If, in accordance with the provisions of Article 54, an arbitration dispute is to be resolved by a committee, and unless otherwise agreed, the tribunal shall be constituted by the committee itself.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十九条仲裁人中有一人死亡、退休或由于任何原因不能行使职务,则应按照其任命的方式予以补缺。
Translation: Article 59: If an arbitrator dies, retires, or is unable to perform their duties for any reason, a replacement shall be appointed in the manner in which the original arbitrator was appointed.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十条法庭应设在海牙,除非当事国另有选择。
Translation: Article 60: The court shall be seated in The Hague, unless the parties choose otherwise.

Query_Text_cn: 法庭只能在第三国的同意下才能设在第三国。
Translation: The court can only be established in a third country with the consent of that country.

Query_Text_cn: 法庭庭址一经确定,除非经当事国同意,不得变更。
Translation: Once the location of the court has been determined, it shall not be changed except with the consent of the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十一条如仲裁协定没有规定使用的语言,则由法庭决定。
Translation: Article 61: If the arbitration agreement does not specify the language to be used, the tribunal shall decide.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十二条当事国有权任命特别代理人出席法庭,作为当事国和法庭间的中间人。
Translation: Article 62 A party shall have the right to appoint special agents to appear before the Court as intermediaries between the party and the Court.

Query_Text_cn: 当事国还有权委托其聘请的辩护人或律师出庭为自己的权利和利益辩护。
Translation: The parties concerned also have the right to appoint their own defense counsel or lawyer to appear in court and defend their rights and interests.

Query_Text_cn: 常设仲裁法院的成员除代表任命他们为法院成员的国家外,不得行使代理人、辩护人或律师的职务。
Translation: Members of the Permanent Court of Arbitration shall not act as agents, counsel, or advocates except on behalf of the state that appointed them as members of the Court.

Query_Text_cn: 书面辩护和口头辩论。
Translation: Written defense and oral argument.

Query_Text_cn: 当事国还附送该案中引用的一切文件和资料。
Translation: The parties concerned shall also submit all documents and materials cited in the case.

Query_Text_cn: 此项送达应直接地或通过国际事务局,按照仲裁协议所规定的次序和日期进行。
Translation: Such delivery shall be made directly or through the International Bureau, in the order and on the dates specified in the arbitration agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁协定所规定的日期,经当事国同意,或法庭认为对作出正确决定有必要时,予以延长。
Translation: The date specified in the arbitration agreement may be extended with the consent of the parties or if the court deems it necessary for making a proper decision.

Query_Text_cn: 辩论是当事国在法庭上口头阐述其论据。
Translation: Debate refers to the oral presentation of arguments by the parties before the court.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十四条任何一方所提出的一切文件应以经核证无误的副本送达另一方。
Translation: Article 64 All documents submitted by either party shall be delivered to the other party in certified true copies.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十五条如无特殊情况,法庭只能在书面辩护结束后开庭。
Translation: Article 65 Unless there are exceptional circumstances, the court may only hold a hearing after the written defense has been concluded.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十六条辩论由庭长主持。
Translation: Article 66 The debate shall be presided over by the chief judge.

Query_Text_cn: 辩论只有在当事国同意下,按照法庭的决定才能公开进行。
Translation: Debates may be held in public only with the consent of the parties concerned and in accordance with the decision of the court.

Query_Text_cn: 辩论应载入庭长委任的书记所作成的记录内。
Translation: The debate should be included in the record prepared by the clerk appointed by the presiding judge.

Query_Text_cn: 此项记录须由庭长和书记之一签署；唯有此项记录才具有权威性。
Translation: This record must be signed by either the presiding judge or the court clerk; only this record is considered authoritative.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十七条书面辩护结束后,法庭有权拒绝讨论当事国一方未经另一方同意企图向法庭提出的一切新的文件和资料。
Translation: Article 67 After the conclusion of the written pleadings, the Court shall have the authority to refuse to consider any new documents and materials that one party attempts to submit to the Court without the consent of the other party.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十八条法庭可以考虑当事国的代理人或顾问提请法庭注意的新的文件或资料。
Translation: Article 68 The Court may take into consideration any new documents or materials brought to its attention by the agents or counsel of the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 在此情况下,法庭有权要求出示此项文件或资料,但必须通知对方。
Translation: In such circumstances, the court has the authority to require the production of the document or material, but must notify the other party.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十九条此外,法庭可要求当事国代理人出示一切文件并要求作出一切必要解释。
Translation: Article 69: Furthermore, the Court may require the agents of the parties to produce all documents and to provide any necessary explanations.

Query_Text_cn: 如遇拒绝,法庭应予记录在案。
Translation: If a refusal occurs, the court shall record it in the case file.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十条当事国的代理人和辩护人得向法庭口头陈述他们认为对辩护他们的案件有益的一切论据。
Translation: Article 70: Agents and counsel of the parties may present orally before the Court any arguments they consider beneficial to the defense of their case.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十一条他们有权提出异议和问题。
Translation: Article 71: They have the right to raise objections and questions.

Query_Text_cn: 法庭对这些问题的决定是最终的,以后不得进行任何讨论。
Translation: The court's decisions on these matters are final and shall not be subject to any further discussion.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十二条法庭成员有权向当事国代理人和辩护人提出问题,并要求他们对可疑之点作出解释。
Translation: Article 72 Members of the court have the right to put questions to the agents and counsel of the parties and to request them to clarify any points that appear doubtful.

Query_Text_cn: 在辩论过程中,法庭成员所提出的问题或意见均不能被视为整个法庭的意见或法庭成员的意见。
Translation: During the debate, any questions or comments raised by members of the court shall not be regarded as the opinion of the court as a whole or as the opinion of individual court members.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十三条法庭被授权宣布它有权解释在案件中所引用的仲裁协定和其他文件和资料,以及法律原则的适用问题。
Translation: Article 73: The court is authorized to declare its competence to interpret the arbitration agreement cited in the case, as well as other documents and materials, and issues concerning the application of legal principles.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十四条法庭有权作出处理本案的程序规则,确定当事国每一方结束辩论的形式、次序和日期,以及安排处理证据的一切手续。
Translation: Article 74 The Court shall have the power to lay down rules of procedure for the conduct of the case, to determine the manner, order, and date in which each party to the dispute shall conclude its arguments, and to make all arrangements necessary for the handling of evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十五条当事国承允尽可能充分地向法庭提供对裁决争端所必要的一切资料。
Translation: Article 75 The parties undertake to provide the Court, as fully as possible, with all information necessary for the adjudication of the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十六条法庭需要在第三缔约国境内发出任何通知时,应直接向该国政府提出申请。
Translation: Article 76: When the court needs to issue any notification within the territory of a third contracting state, it shall submit the request directly to the government of that state.

Query_Text_cn: 对于到该国现场收集证据而须采取的步骤也适用本条的规定。
Translation: The provisions of this article shall also apply to the steps that need to be taken for collecting evidence on site in that country.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的而提出的申请应由被申请国按照它的国内法所掌握的方式予以执行。
