Translation: (4) A Party to this Convention that is also a member of any other valid treaty, convention, or international agreement in force at the time this Convention enters into effect, and which, under the provisions of such treaties, conventions, or agreements, is required to protect the various marine species listed in Appendix II, shall be exempt from the obligations under this Convention regarding trade in specimens of such species listed in Appendix II, provided that these specimens are caught by vessels registered in that country and in accordance with the provisions of the aforementioned other treaties, conventions, or international agreements.

Query_Text_cn: (五)尽管有第三条、第四条和第五条的规定，凡出口依本条第(四)款捕获的标本，只需要引进国的管理机构出具证明书，说明该标本是依照其他条约、公约或国际协定规定取得的。
Translation: (5) Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles III, IV, and V, the export of specimens taken in accordance with paragraph (4) of this Article shall only require a certificate issued by the management authority of the importing country, stating that the specimen was obtained in accordance with the provisions of other treaties, conventions, or international agreements.

Query_Text_cn: (六)本公约不应妨碍根据联合国大会2750C字(XXV)号决议而召开的联合国海洋法会议从事编篡和发展海洋法，也不应妨碍任何国家在目前或将来就海洋法以及就沿岸国和船旗国的管辖权的性质和范围提出的主张和法律观点。
Translation: 6. This Convention shall not prejudice the codification and progressive development of the law of the sea undertaken by the United Nations Conference on the Law of the Sea convened pursuant to General Assembly resolution 2750 C (XXV), nor shall it prejudice any claims or legal views concerning the law of the sea and the nature and extent of the jurisdiction of coastal States and flag States that any State may make at present or in the future.

Query_Text_cn: 1.任何成员国可就附录一或附录二的修改提出建议，供下次会议审议。
Translation: Any Member State may propose amendments to Annex I or Annex II for consideration at the next meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 所提修正案的文本至少应在会前150天通知秘书处。
Translation: The text of any proposed amendment shall be communicated to the Secretariat at least 150 days prior to the meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 2.修正案应经到会并参加投票的成员国2/3多数通过。
Translation: 2. Amendments shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of the member states present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 此处所谓"到会并参加投票的成员国”系指出席会议，并投了赞成票或反对票的成员国。
Translation: The term "members present and voting" refers to those member states that are present at the meeting and have cast either an affirmative or negative vote.

Query_Text_cn: 3.在一次会议上通过的修正案，应在该次会议90天后对所有成员国开始生效，但依据本条第(三)款提出保留的成员国除外。
Translation: 3. An amendment adopted at a meeting shall enter into force for all Member States 90 days after the meeting, except for those Member States that have made reservations in accordance with paragraph (3) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对各种海洋物种，秘书处在收到建议修正案文本后，应立即将修正案文本通知成员国。
Translation: 2. For various marine species, upon receiving the proposed amendment text, the Secretariat shall immediately notify the Member States of the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书处还应与业务上和该物种有关的政府间机构进行磋商，以便取得这些机构有可能提供的科学资料，并使与这些机构实施的保护措施协调一致。
Translation: The Secretariat should also consult with intergovernmental bodies that are functionally related to the species in question, in order to obtain any scientific information these bodies may be able to provide and to ensure that conservation measures implemented by these bodies are coordinated.

Query_Text_cn: 12.如修正案获得通过，则自秘书处发出修正案被接受的通知之日起后90天，对各成员国开始生效。但按本条之第(三)款规定提出保留之成员国除外。
Translation: 12. If the amendment is adopted, it shall enter into force for all Member States 90 days after the date on which the Secretariat notifies them of its acceptance, except for those Member States that have made reservations in accordance with paragraph (3) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (三)在本条第(一)款第3项，或第(二)款第12项规定的90天期间，任何成员国均可向公约保存国政府以书面通知形式，对修正案通知提出保留。
Translation: (3) During the 90-day period specified in subparagraph (1)(3) or subparagraph (2)(12) of this Article, any Member State may submit a reservation to the depositary government of the Convention regarding the notification of the amendment, in the form of a written notice.

Query_Text_cn: 在此保留撤销以前，进行有关该物种的贸易时，即不作为本公约的成员国对待。
Translation: Before the reservation is withdrawn, the Party concerned shall not be treated as a Party to this Convention with respect to trade in the species in question.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条附录三及其修改(一)按第二条第(三)款所述，任何成员国可随时向秘书处提出它认为属其管辖范围内，并由其管理的物种的名单。
Translation:
Article 16, Appendix III and Its Amendments

(1) In accordance with paragraph (3) of Article 2, any member country may at any time submit to the Secretariat a list of species which it considers to be within its jurisdiction and under its management.

Query_Text_cn: 附录三应包括：提出将某些物种包括在内的成员国的名称、提出的物种的学名，以及按第一条第2项所述，与该物种相联系的有关动物或植物的任何部分或衍生物。
Translation: Appendix III shall include: the names of the member countries proposing the inclusion of certain species, the scientific names of the proposed species, and, in accordance with Article 1, paragraph 2, any parts or derivatives of animals or plants associated with those species.

Query_Text_cn: (二)根据本条第(一)款规定提出的每一份名单，都应由秘书处在收到该名单后尽快通知成员国。
Translation: (b) Each list submitted in accordance with paragraph (a) of this Article shall be promptly communicated by the Secretariat to the Member States upon receipt.

Query_Text_cn: 该名单作为附录三的一部分，在发出此项通知之日起90天后生效。
Translation: This list, as part of Appendix III, will take effect 90 days after the issuance of this notice.

Query_Text_cn: 在该名单发出后，任何成员国均可随时书面通知公约保存国政府，对任何物种，或其任何部分，或其衍生物持保留意见。在撤销此保留以前，进行有关该物种，或其一部分，或其衍生物的贸易时，该国即不作为本公约的成员国对待。
Translation: After the issuance of the list, any member state may at any time notify the government of the depositary of the Convention in writing of its reservation regarding any species, or any part thereof, or its derivatives. Until such reservation is withdrawn, the state shall not be treated as a party to the Convention with respect to trade involving the species, any part thereof, or its derivatives.

Query_Text_cn: (三)提出应将某一物种列入附录三的成员国，可以随时通知秘书处撤销该物种，秘书处应将此事通知所有成员国，此项撤销应在秘书处发出通知之日起30天后生效。
Translation: A Party that has proposed the inclusion of a species in Appendix III may, at any time, notify the Secretariat of its withdrawal of that species. The Secretariat shall inform all Parties of such withdrawal, which shall take effect 30 days after the date of notification by the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: (四)根据本条第(一)款的规定提出一份名单的任何成员国，应向秘书处提交一份适用于此类物种保护的所有国内法律和规章的抄本，并同时提交成员国对该法律规章的适当解释，或秘书处要求提供的解释。
Translation: (4) Any Party submitting a list pursuant to paragraph (1) of this Article shall provide the Secretariat with copies of all domestic laws and regulations applicable to the protection of such species, together with appropriate explanations of those laws and regulations by the Party, or explanations as requested by the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 该成员国在上述物种被列入在附录三的期间内，应提交对上述法律和规章的任何修改或任何新的解释。
Translation: During the period when the above-mentioned species are listed in Appendix III, the Member State shall submit any amendments to the aforementioned laws and regulations or any new interpretations thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条公约之修改(一)秘书处依至少1/3成员国提出的书面要求，可召开成员国大会特别会议，审议和通过本公约的修正案。
Translation:
Article 17 Amendment of the Convention

(1) The Secretariat may convene a special session of the Conference of Member States to review and adopt amendments to this Convention upon the written request of at least one-third of the Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 此项修正案应经到会并参加投票的成员国2/3多数通过。
Translation: This amendment shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of the member states present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 弃权的成员国将不计入为通过修正案所需2/3的总数内。
Translation: Member states that abstain shall not be counted in the total number required for the adoption of the amendment by a two-thirds majority.

Query_Text_cn: (二)秘书处至少应在会前90天将建议的修正案的案文通知所有成员国。
Translation: (2) The Secretariat shall notify all Member States of the proposed amendments at least 90 days prior to the meeting.

Query_Text_cn: (三)自2/3的成员国向公约保存国政府递交接受该项修正案之日起的60天后，该项修正案即对接受的成员国开始生效。
Translation: (3) Sixty days after two-thirds of the member states have submitted their acceptance of the amendment to the depositary government of the Convention, the amendment shall enter into force for those member states that have accepted it.

Query_Text_cn: 此后，在任何其他成员国递交接受该项修正案之日起的60天后，该项修正案对该成员国开始生效。
Translation: Thereafter, the amendment shall enter into force for any other Member State 60 days after the date on which it submits its instrument of acceptance of the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条争议之解决(一)如两个或两个以上成员国之间就本公约各项规定的解释或适用发生争议，则涉及争议的成员国应进行磋商。
Translation:
Article 18: Settlement of Disputes

(1) If a dispute arises between two or more Member States concerning the interpretation or application of any provision of this Convention, the Member States involved shall consult with each other.

Query_Text_cn: (二)如果争议不能依本条第(一)款获得解决，经成员国相互同意，可将争议提交仲裁，特别是提交设在海牙的常设仲裁法院进行仲裁，提出争议的成员国应受仲裁决定之约束。
Translation: (2) If the dispute cannot be resolved in accordance with paragraph (1) of this Article, it may, with the mutual consent of the member states concerned, be submitted to arbitration, in particular to the Permanent Court of Arbitration at The Hague. The member states submitting the dispute shall be bound by the arbitral decision.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条签署本公约于1973年4月30日以前在华盛顿开放签署，在此以后，则于1974年12月31日以前在伯尔尼开放签署。
Translation: Article 19 This Convention shall be open for signature in Washington until April 30, 1973, and thereafter in Bern until December 31, 1974.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条批准、接受、核准本公约需经批准、接受或核准，批准、接受或核准本公约的文书应交存公约保存国瑞士联邦政府。
Translation: Article 20: Approval, acceptance, and ratification of this Convention require formal approval, acceptance, or ratification. Instruments of approval, acceptance, or ratification of this Convention shall be deposited with the Government of the Swiss Confederation, which is the depositary of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条加入本公约将无限期地开放加入，加入书应交公约保存国保存。
Translation: Article 21: Accession to this Convention shall be open indefinitely. Instruments of accession shall be deposited with the depositary of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条生效(一)本公约自第10份批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的文书交存公约保存国政府90天后开始生效。
Translation:
Article 22 Entry into Force

(1) This Convention shall enter into force 90 days after the date of deposit of the tenth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession with the Government of the Depositary State.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在第十份批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的文书交存以后，批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的国家，自向公约保存国政府交存批准、接受、核准或加入的文书之日起90天后对该国生效。
Translation: (2) After the deposit of the tenth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession to this Convention, the Convention shall enter into force for any State that subsequently deposits its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession ninety days after the date on which such instrument is deposited with the depositary government.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条保留(一)对本公约的各项规定不得提出一般保留。
Translation:
Article 23 Reservations

(1) No general reservations may be made with respect to any provision of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 但根据本条或第十五条和第十六条的规定，可提出特殊保留。
Translation: However, special reservations may be made in accordance with the provisions of this Article or Articles 15 and 16.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何一国在将其批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的文书交托保存的同时，可就下述具体事项提出保留。
Translation: (b) Any State may, at the time of depositing its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession to this Convention, make a reservation with respect to the following specific matters.

Query_Text_cn: 2.附录三中所指的各物种的任何部分或其衍生物。
Translation: 2. Any part or derivative of the species referred to in Appendix III.

Query_Text_cn: (三)成员国在未撤销其根据本条规定提出的保留前，在对该保留物种，或其一部分，或其衍生物进行贸易时，该国即不作为本公约的成员国对待。
Translation: (3) Until a Party withdraws a reservation made under this Article, that Party shall not be treated as a Party to this Convention with respect to trade in the species, or any part or derivative thereof, subject to the reservation.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条废约任何成员国均可随时以书面形式通知公约保存国政府废止本公约。
Translation:
Article 24: Termination of the Convention  
Any member state may terminate this Convention at any time by notifying the depositary government in writing.

Query_Text_cn: 废约自公约保存国政府收到书面通知之日起12个月后生效。
Translation: The denunciation shall take effect 12 months after the date on which the depositary government receives the written notification.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条保存国(一)本公约正本以中、英、法、俄和西班牙文写成，各种文本都具有同等效力。正本应交存公约保存国政府，该政府应将核证无误的副本送致本公约的签字国，或加入本公约的国家。
Translation: Article 25 Depositary State (1) The original text of this Convention shall be drawn up in Chinese, English, French, Russian, and Spanish, all texts being equally authentic. The original shall be deposited with the government of the Depositary State, which shall transmit certified copies thereof to the signatory States of this Convention or to States acceding to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (二)公约保存国政府应将批准、接受、核准或加入、本公约的生效和修改、表示保留和撤销保留以及废止的文书签署交存情况通知本公约所有签字国、加入国和秘书处。
Translation: (2) The government of the depositary state of the Convention shall notify all signatory states, acceding states, and the Secretariat of the signing and deposit of instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, the entry into force and amendment of the Convention, declarations and withdrawals of reservations, as well as the termination of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (三)本公约生效后，公约保存国政府应立即将核证无误的文本根据联合国宪章第一百零二条，转送联合国秘书处登记和公布。
Translation: (3) After the entry into force of this Convention, the government of the depositary state shall immediately transmit a certified true copy of the text to the Secretariat of the United Nations for registration and publication in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 各全权代表受命在本公约上签字，以资证明。
Translation: The plenipotentiaries have been instructed to sign this Convention as evidence thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条有权享受责任限制的人1．下述定义中所指的船舶所有人和救助人，可以根据本公约规定，对第二条所列索赔，限制其责任。
Translation:
Article 1 Persons Entitled to Limit Liability

1. Shipowners and salvors as defined below may, in accordance with the provisions of this Convention, limit their liability for claims listed in Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: 2．“船舶所有人”一词，是指海运船舶的所有人、承租人、经理人和营运人。
Translation: The term "shipowner" refers to the owner, charterer, manager, and operator of a seagoing vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 3．“救助人”是指从事与救助作业直接相关的服务工作的任何人。
Translation: 3. "Rescuer" refers to any person engaged in service work directly related to rescue operations.

Query_Text_cn: 救助作业还包括第二条第1款第（4）、（5）、（6）项所述作业。
Translation: Rescue operations also include the activities described in items (4), (5), and (6) of Article 2, Paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: 4．如果第二条所规定的任何索赔，是向船舶所有人或救助人对其行为、疏忽或过失负有责任的任何人提出的，这种人便有权享受本公约所规定的责任限制。
Translation: 4. If any claim referred to in Article 2 is made against any person for whose act, neglect, or default the shipowner or salvor is responsible, such person shall be entitled to avail himself of the limitation of liability provided for in this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 5．就本公约而言，船舶所有人的责任，应包括对船舶本身提起诉讼案件中的责任。
Translation: For the purposes of this Convention, the liability of the shipowner shall include liability in actions brought against the ship itself.

Query_Text_cn: 6．对于按本公约规定须受责任限制的索赔承担责任的保险人，有权与被保险人本人在同一限度内享受本公约的利益。
Translation: 6. An insurer who is liable for claims subject to limitation of liability under this Convention is entitled to benefit from the provisions of this Convention to the same extent as the insured, within the same limits.

Query_Text_cn: 7．援用责任限制的行为，并不构成对责任的承认。
Translation: Acts invoking limitation of liability do not constitute an admission of liability.

Query_Text_cn: （6）有关责任人以外的任何人，为避免或减少责任人按本公约规定可限制其责任的损失所采取的措施，以及由此措施而引起的进一步损失的索赔。
Translation: (6) Claims in respect of any measures taken by persons other than the person liable, to avoid or minimize loss for which the person liable may limit his liability under this Convention, as well as further loss caused by such measures.

Query_Text_cn: 2．第1款所列各项索赔，即使以追偿请求或者根据契约要求赔偿的方式或其它方式提出，也应受责任限制的制约。
Translation: 2. The claims listed in Paragraph 1 shall be subject to the limitation of liability, even if they are made by way of recourse, indemnity under contract, or in any other manner.

Query_Text_cn: 但第1款第（4）、（5）和（6）项所列索赔，在其涉及与责任人所订契约中所载报酬问题时，应不受责任限制的制约。
Translation: However, claims listed in items (4), (5), and (6) of paragraph 1 shall not be subject to limitation of liability when they involve issues concerning remuneration stipulated in the contract entered into with the liable party.

Query_Text_cn: （5）所任职务与船舶或救助作业有关的船舶所有人或救助人的雇用人员，包括他们的继承人、亲属或有权提出索赔要求的其它人员所提出的索赔，如果按照船舶所有人或救助同雇用人之间的服务合同所适用的法律，船舶所有人或救助人无权在此类索赔方面限制其责任，或者根据此项法律，仅允许将其责任限制在较本公约第六条规定的限额为高时。
Translation: (5) Claims made by employees of the shipowner or salvor, including their heirs, relatives, or other persons entitled to make claims, whose duties are related to the ship or salvage operations, if, under the law applicable to the contract of service between the shipowner or salvor and such employees, the shipowner or salvor is not entitled to limit their liability in respect of such claims, or is permitted to limit their liability only to an amount higher than the limits specified in Article 6 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条不得享受责任限制的行为如经证明，损失是由于责任人本身为蓄意造成这一损失，或者明知可能造成这一损失而轻率地采取的行为或不为所引起，该责任人便无权限制其责任。
Translation:
Article 4: Acts Not Entitled to Limitation of Liability

If it is proven that the loss was caused by the liable party's intentional act or omission, or by reckless conduct with knowledge that such loss would probably result, the liable party shall not be entitled to limit their liability.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条反索赔如果按照本公约规定有权享受责任限制的人，就同一事件向索赔人提出索赔，则双方提出的索赔应相互抵销，而本公约的规定则仅适用于其间的差额（如有差额）。
Translation:
Article 5 Counterclaims

If a person entitled to limitation of liability under this Convention makes a claim against the claimant arising out of the same occurrence, the respective claims shall be set off against each other, and the provisions of this Convention shall apply only to any balance that may remain.

Query_Text_cn: 超过70，000吨，每吨为167计算单位。
Translation: Over 70,000 tons, calculated at 167 units per ton.

Query_Text_cn: 超过70，000吨，每吨为83计算单位。
Translation: Over 70,000 tons, calculated at 83 units per ton.

Query_Text_cn: 2．但是，如果依照第1款第（1）项计算的那部分款额不敷支付全部索赔，则依照第1款第（2）项计算的数额，应用以支付第1款第（1）项下所未支付的差额，而此项未付差额应同第1款第（2）项的索赔按比例取偿。
Translation: 2. However, if the amount calculated under subparagraph (1) of paragraph 1 is insufficient to cover all claims, the amount calculated under subparagraph (2) of paragraph 1 shall be applied to pay the unpaid balance under subparagraph (1) of paragraph 1, and such unpaid balance shall be satisfied on a pro rata basis together with the claims under subparagraph (2) of paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: 3．但是，在无损于按第2款提出的关于人身伤亡的索赔权利的情况下，缔约国可在国内法中规定，对港口工程、港池、航道和助航设施的损害所提出的索赔，应依该法规定而享有较第1款第2项所载其它索赔优先受偿的权利。
Translation: 3. However, without prejudice to claims for personal injury made under paragraph 2, a Contracting State may provide in its national law that claims for damage to port works, basins, waterways, and aids to navigation shall, in accordance with such law, have priority over other claims referred to in item (2) of paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: 4．凡不从任何船舶进行施救工作的救助人，或者只是在对之进行施救工作的船上作业的救助人，其责任限制应按吨位为1，500吨的船舶计算。
Translation: 4. Any salvor who does not carry out salvage operations from any vessel, or who only operates on board a vessel being salvaged, shall have their liability limited as if the vessel had a tonnage of 1,500 tons.

Query_Text_cn: 5．就本公约而言，船舶吨位应为根据《1969年国际船舶吨位丈量公约》附件Ⅰ中所载吨位丈量规则计算的总吨位。
Translation: For the purposes of this Convention, the tonnage of a ship shall be the gross tonnage calculated in accordance with the tonnage measurement rules contained in Annex I of the International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships, 1969.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条旅客索赔的责任限制1．对于在任一具体情况下提出的有关船上旅客人身伤亡的索赔，船舶所有人的责任限制，为46，666计算单位乘以船舶证书上规定的该船载客定额所得的数额，但不得超过25，000，000计算单位。
Translation:
Article 7 Limitation of Liability for Passenger Claims

1. In respect of claims arising from the personal injury or death of passengers onboard in any particular case, the shipowner's liability shall be limited to an amount calculated by multiplying 46,666 units of account by the number of passengers the ship is certified to carry, as specified in the ship's certificate, but shall not exceed 25,000,000 units of account.

Query_Text_cn: （1）根据旅客运输契约而载运者；或（2）经承运人同意，随同照料货物运输契约中所载车辆或活动物者。
Translation: (1) The carrier under a passenger transportation contract; or (2) With the carrier's consent, a person accompanying and taking care of vehicles or live animals specified in a goods transportation contract.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条计算单位1．上述第六条、第七条所述计算单位，是指国际货币基金组织所规定的特别提款权。
Translation:
Article 8 Calculation Unit

1. The calculation unit referred to in Articles 6 and 7 above means the Special Drawing Rights as defined by the International Monetary Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条、第七条所述数额，应按照责任限制基金设立之日、付款之日或根据该国法律与此项付款等值的担保提出之日该国货币的价值，折算成谋求责任限制所有国家的本国货币。
Translation: The amounts referred to in Articles 6 and 7 shall be converted into the national currency of any State seeking to limit liability, based on the value of that currency on the date the limitation fund is constituted, the date of payment, or the date on which a guarantee equivalent to such payment is provided in accordance with the law of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 凡属国际货币基金组织成员国的本公约缔约国，其以特别提款权表示的本国货币的价值，应按国际货币基金组织在上述日期在进行营业和交易中适用的现行定价办法计算。
Translation: For any contracting party to this Convention that is a member of the International Monetary Fund, the value of its currency expressed in Special Drawing Rights shall be calculated in accordance with the current valuation method applied by the International Monetary Fund in its operations and transactions on the aforementioned date.

Query_Text_cn: 非属国际货币基金组织成员国的本公约缔约国，其以特别提款权表示的本国货币的价值，应按该缔约国确定的办法计算。
Translation: For any Contracting State to this Convention that is not a member of the International Monetary Fund, the value of its currency expressed in Special Drawing Rights shall be calculated according to the method determined by that State.

Query_Text_cn: 超过70，000吨，每吨为2，500货币单位。
Translation: Over 70,000 tons, at 2,500 monetary units per ton.

Query_Text_cn: 超过70，000吨，每吨为1，250货币单位。
Translation: Over 70,000 tons, at 1,250 currency units per ton.

Query_Text_cn: （3）有关第七条第1款，为700，000货币单位乘以船舶证书上规定的载客定额所得的数额，但不得超过375，000，000货币单位。
Translation: (3) Regarding Article 7, paragraph 1, the amount shall be 700,000 monetary units multiplied by the passenger capacity specified on the ship's certificate, but shall not exceed 375,000,000 monetary units.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条第2款和第3款的规定，相应地适用于本款第（1）和第（2）项。
Translation: The provisions of paragraphs 2 and 3 of Article 6 shall apply mutatis mutandis to items (1) and (2) of this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 3．上述第2款所指货币单位，相当于纯度为千分之九百的黄金65．5毫克。
Translation: 3. The monetary unit referred to in Paragraph 2 above is equivalent to 65.5 milligrams of gold with a fineness of 900 per thousand.

Query_Text_cn: 将第2款规定的货币单位数额折算成国家货币时，应按有关国家的法律办理。
Translation: When converting the monetary amounts specified in paragraph 2 into the national currency, the relevant laws of the country concerned shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 4．第1款末句所述计算办法和第3款所述折算办法，应能使第六条和第七条所述数额在以缔约国本国货币计算时，尽可能表示出上述条款中按计算单位计算时的同一真实价值。
Translation: 4. The method of calculation referred to at the end of paragraph 1 and the method of conversion referred to in paragraph 3 shall be such as to ensure that the amounts mentioned in Articles 6 and 7, when expressed in the national currency of a Contracting State, represent as closely as possible the same real value as the amounts calculated in terms of the unit of account in those Articles.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国在签字并无保留地批准、接受或认可之时，或在交存第十六条所指文件之时，应视情况向本公约保管人提交第1款所述计算办法，或第3款所述折算结果，并在其变更时作出相应的通知。
Translation: At the time of signature, ratification, acceptance, or approval without reservation, or at the time of depositing the instrument referred to in Article 16, the Contracting Party shall, as appropriate, submit to the depositary of this Convention the calculation method referred to in paragraph 1 or the conversion results referred to in paragraph 3, and shall notify the depositary of any subsequent changes thereto.

Query_Text_cn: （3）对不是从另一艘船舶进行施救工作的救助人，或者只是在对之进行施救工作的船上作业的救助人，以及他或他们对其行为、疏忽或过失负责的任何人提出的索赔。
Translation: (3) Claims made against a salvor who is not engaged in salvage operations from another vessel, or who is merely working on the vessel where the salvage operations are being carried out, as well as any person for whose acts, omissions, or negligence he or they may be responsible.

Query_Text_cn: 2．按第七条规定的责任限制，适用于可能在任何特定情况下，就第一条第2款所述有关第七条所指船舶的负有赔偿责任的任何人，以及他或他们对其行为、疏忽或过失负责的任何人提出的各项索赔的总额。
Translation: 2. The limitation of liability prescribed in Article 7 shall apply to the total amount of all claims that may arise in any particular case against any person who may be held liable for compensation as referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 1 in respect of a ship referred to in Article 7, as well as against any person for whose act, neglect, or default he or they are responsible.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条没有设立责任限制基金的责任限制1．尽管第十一条所述责任限制基金尚未设立，也可以援引责任限制。
Translation:
Article 10 Limitation of Liability Without Establishment of a Limitation Fund

1. Notwithstanding that the limitation fund referred to in Article 11 has not been constituted, limitation of liability may still be invoked.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，缔约国可在其国内法中规定，当在其法院审理须受责任限制的索赔时，只有在责任人已按本公约规定设立责任限制基金，或在援用责任限制权利时设立该项基金，才能援用责任限制的权利。
Translation: However, a Contracting State may provide in its national law that, when claims subject to limitation of liability are brought before its courts, the right to limit liability may only be invoked if the person liable has constituted a limitation fund in accordance with the provisions of this Convention, or constitutes such a fund when invoking the right to limitation of liability.

Query_Text_cn: 2．如在没有设立责任限制基金的情况下援用责任限制，应相应地适用第十二条的规定。
Translation: 2. If the limitation of liability is invoked without the establishment of a limitation fund, the provisions of Article 12 shall apply accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 3．根据本条规定发生的诉讼程序问题，应按受理诉讼的缔约国本国法律决定。
Translation: 3. Procedural issues arising from litigation under this Article shall be determined in accordance with the domestic laws of the Contracting State where the litigation is accepted.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条基金的设立1．被认定负有责任的任何人，可在提出责任限制索赔诉讼的任何缔约国法院或其他主管当局，设立基金。
Translation:
Article 11 Establishment of the Fund  
1. Any person found liable may establish a fund in the court or other competent authority of any Contracting State where a claim for limitation of liability is filed.

Query_Text_cn: 此项基金应为按照第六条和第七条规定适用于对该责任者提出索赔的金额，加上从事故发生引起责任之日起至基金设立之日为止的利息。
Translation: The fund shall consist of the amount applicable to claims against the liable party in accordance with Articles 6 and 7, plus interest accrued from the date the liability arises due to the incident until the date the fund is established.

Query_Text_cn: 此项基金仅可用于支付援用责任限制的索赔。
Translation: This fund may only be used to pay claims arising from the limitation of liability invoked.

Query_Text_cn: 2．设立基金可以储存专款，或提出为设立基金的缔约国法律所允许并经法院或其他主管当局认可的担保。
Translation: 2. The establishment of a fund allows for the storage of earmarked funds or the provision of guarantees permitted by the laws of the Contracting Party establishing the fund and recognized by the court or other competent authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 3．由第九条第1款第（1）、（2）或第（3）项所述当事人之一或其保险人所设立的基金，应被认为是由第1款第（1）、（2）或第（3）项或第2款所述所有当事人所设立。
Translation: 3. A fund established by any of the parties referred to in Article 9, Paragraph 1, Items (1), (2), or (3), or by their insurer, shall be deemed to have been established by all the parties referred to in Paragraph 1, Items (1), (2), or (3), or Paragraph 2.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条基金的分配1．根据第六条第1款、第2款和第3款以及第七条的规定，基金应在索赔人之间，依其对该基金确立的索赔额，按比例分配。
Translation:
Article 12 Distribution of the Fund

1. In accordance with paragraphs 1, 2, and 3 of Article 6 and Article 7, the fund shall be distributed among claimants in proportion to the amounts of their claims established against the fund.

Query_Text_cn: 2．如在基金分配之前，责任人或其保险人已就对该基金的索赔付款结案，则他在已付金额范围内，应依代位权获得此受偿人根据本公约所可享有的权利。
Translation: 2. If, prior to the distribution of the fund, the person liable or his insurer has settled a claim against the fund by making payment, he shall, to the extent of the amount paid, be subrogated to the rights which the compensated person would have enjoyed under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3．本条第2款所规定的代位权，也可由该款所述者之外的人在其已付赠偿金额内行使，但仅以所适用的国内法允许行使此种代位权为限。
Translation: 3. The right of subrogation provided for in paragraph 2 of this Article may also be exercised by persons other than those mentioned in that paragraph, to the extent that they have paid compensation, but only to the extent that such subrogation is permitted under the applicable domestic law.

Query_Text_cn: 4．如果责任人或任何其他人认定，假若赔偿金在基金分配之前即已付出，他便可能在基金分配之后的某日被强制支付赔偿金额的全部或一部，而根据本第第2款及第3款，该人对此项赔偿本可享有代位权，则基金设在国的法院或主管当局可以下令暂时拨出一个足够数额，以便该人在上述日期对此基金行使其索赔权。
Translation: 4. If the person liable or any other individual believes that, should compensation be paid before the distribution of the fund, he may subsequently be compelled to pay all or part of the compensation after the fund has been distributed, and that, pursuant to paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article, he would have been entitled to subrogation in respect of such compensation, the court or competent authority in the State where the fund is established may order that a sufficient amount be temporarily set aside so that the person may exercise his claim against the fund on the aforementioned date.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条其他法律行为的禁止1．如果责任限制基金已按第十一条的规定设立，则已向基金提出索赔的任何人，不得针对该项索赔而对由其设立或以其名义设立基金的人的任何其他财产，行使任何权利。
Translation:
Article 13 Prohibition of Other Legal Actions

1. If a limitation fund has been constituted in accordance with the provisions of Article 11, no claimant who has made a claim against the fund shall be entitled, in respect of such claim, to exercise any right against any other assets of the person by whom the fund has been constituted or on whose behalf it has been constituted.

Query_Text_cn: 2．责任限制基金已按第十一条规定设立之后，则以其名义设立基金之人所属任何船舶或其财产，凡是因向基金提出索赔而已依缔约国管辖权予以扣押或扣留的属于基金设立人名下的任何船舶或其他财产，或是由他提交的抵押品，均可由该国法院或其主管当局下令开释或退还。
Translation: 2. Once a limitation fund has been constituted in accordance with Article 11, any ship or other property belonging to the person by whom the fund has been constituted, which has been arrested or detained within the jurisdiction of a Contracting State in respect of a claim that may be brought against the fund, or any security furnished by him, may be released or returned by order of the court or competent authority of that State.

Query_Text_cn: （4）已在执行扣押的国家设立。
Translation: (4) Established in the country where the seizure is being enforced.

Query_Text_cn: 3．第1款和第2款的规则，仅在索赔人向管理责任限制基金的法院就该基金提出索赔，而且就该项索赔而言，确有基金可用，并可自由划拨时，才可适用。
Translation: 3. The rules in paragraphs 1 and 2 shall apply only when the claimant submits a claim against the limitation fund for management liability to the court, and, with respect to such claim, the fund is indeed available and can be freely allocated.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条法律管辖关于责任限制基金的设立与分配规则，以及与其有关的一切程序规则，除按本章规定办理外，应受基金设在国法律管辖。
Translation: Article 14 The establishment and distribution rules of the limitation of liability fund, as well as all procedural rules related thereto, shall, except as otherwise provided in this chapter, be governed by the law of the State in which the fund is established.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，当本公约的规则在缔约国法院被援用时，如果第一条所指的任何人，在缔约国并无常住地点，或在缔约国并无主要营业处所，或为其谋求责任限制或开释的任何船舶在当时并非悬挂缔约国国旗时，各缔约国可以全部或部分排除其对本公约的适用。
Translation: However, when the provisions of this Convention are invoked before the courts of a Contracting State, if any person referred to in Article 1 does not have a permanent residence or principal place of business in the Contracting State, or if any ship for which limitation or exemption of liability is sought is not flying the flag of the Contracting State at the relevant time, each Contracting State may wholly or partially exclude the application of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国在行使本款规定的任选权时，应将国内法规定的责任限制或者并无此种规定的事实，通知本公约保管人。
Translation: When a Contracting State exercises the option provided for in this paragraph, it shall notify the depositary of this Convention of the limitation of liability prescribed by its domestic law or of the absence of any such limitation.

Query_Text_cn: 或者（2）当该国已成为调节有关这种船舶责任制度的一项国际公约的缔约国时。
Translation: Or (2) when the country has become a party to an international convention governing the liability regime for such vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 在适用本款第1项的情况下，该缔约国应相应地通知本公约的保管人。
Translation: In the case of the application of subparagraph 1 of this paragraph, the Contracting State shall accordingly notify the depositary of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （2）用于勘探或开采海底自然资源或其底土的浮动平台。
Translation: (2) Floating platforms used for the exploration or extraction of seabed natural resources or subsoil.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条签字。
Translation: Article 16 Signing.

Query_Text_cn: 批准和加入1．本公约自1977年2月1日起至1977年12月31日止，在政府海事协商组织（以下简称“海协”）总部向所有国家开放，以供签字，并在其后继续开放，以供加入。
Translation:
Approval and Accession

1. This Convention shall be open for signature by all States at the headquarters of the Intergovernmental Maritime Consultative Organization (hereinafter referred to as "IMCO") from February 1, 1977, to December 31, 1977, and thereafter shall remain open for accession.

Query_Text_cn: 或者（3）加入。
Translation: Or (3) join.

Query_Text_cn: 3．批准、接受、认可或加入本公约，应向“海协”秘书长（以下简称“秘书长”）交存一份载有上述意图的正式文件。
Translation: 3. The approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession to this Convention shall be effected by depositing a formal instrument expressing such intent with the Secretary-General of the "Maritime Association" (hereinafter referred to as the "Secretary-General").

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条生效1．本公约自十二个国家已在本公约签字并无保留地批准，接受或认可，或者已经交存所需批准、接受、认可或加入文件之日一年后次月第一日起生效。
Translation:
Article 17 Entry into Force

1. This Convention shall enter into force on the first day of the month following one year after twelve States have signed and unconditionally ratified, accepted, or approved this Convention, or have deposited the required instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 2．对于在本公约生效条件已得到满足之后但却在生效之日以前交存批准、接受、认可或加入文，或者签字并无保留地批准、接受或认可的国家，其批准、接受、认可或加入或者其签字并无保留地批准、接受、或认可等项，应自本公约生效之日或签字之日，或交存文件之日第九十天后次月第一日起生效，二者之中以较迟者为准。
Translation: 2. For any State that deposits its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, or that signs without reservation as to ratification, acceptance, or approval after the conditions for the entry into force of this Convention have been met but before the date of its entry into force, such ratification, acceptance, approval, accession, or signature without reservation as to ratification, acceptance, or approval shall take effect on the later of: the date of entry into force of this Convention or the first day of the month following the expiration of ninety days after the date of signature or the date of deposit of the instrument.

Query_Text_cn: 3．对于任何一个在本公约生效之后成为本公约缔约国的国家，本公约应自该国交存其文件之日九十天后次月第一日起生效。
Translation: 3. For any country that becomes a party to this Convention after its entry into force, the Convention shall enter into force for that country on the first day of the month following ninety days after the deposit of its instrument.

Query_Text_cn: 4．对于批准、接受、认可或加入本公约的国家之间的关系，本公约应取代并废止1957年10月10日在布鲁塞尔签订的《海上船舶所有人责任限制公约》和1924年8月25日在布鲁塞尔签订的《关于统一海上船舶所有人责任限制某些规则的国际公约》。
Translation: 4. In relations between States that have ratified, accepted, approved, or acceded to this Convention, this Convention shall supersede and abrogate the Convention relating to the Limitation of the Liability of Owners of Sea-going Ships signed at Brussels on 10 October 1957 and the International Convention for the Unification of Certain Rules relating to the Limitation of the Liability of Owners of Sea-going Vessels signed at Brussels on 25 August 1924.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条保留1．任何国家均可在签字、批准、接受、认可或加入本公约时，保留不适用第二条第1款第（4）项和第（5）项的权利。
Translation:
Article 18 Reservations

1. Any State may, at the time of signature, ratification, acceptance, approval or accession to this Convention, reserve the right not to apply subparagraphs (4) and (5) of paragraph 1 of Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: 但对本公约的实质性条款，不得作任何其他保留。
Translation: However, no other reservations may be made to the substantive provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2．在签字时所作的保留，须在批准、接受或认可时予以确认。
Translation: 2. Any reservation made at the time of signature must be confirmed at the time of ratification, acceptance, or approval.

Query_Text_cn: 3．对本公约作出保留的任何国家，均可在任何时日通过寄交秘书长的通知而予以撤销。
Translation: Any State which has made a reservation to this Convention may withdraw it at any time by notifying the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 这种撤销，应自通知收到之日起生效。
Translation: Such revocation shall take effect from the date of receipt of the notification.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该通知声称，对于保留的撤销应自通知中具体规定的日期起生效，而这一日期又较秘书长收到通知之日为迟，则撤销应自这一较迟日期起生效。
Translation: If the notification states that the withdrawal is to take effect from a date specified therein, which is later than the date on which the Secretary-General receives the notification, the withdrawal shall take effect from that later date.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条退出1．缔约国可在本公约对该国生效之日一年后的任何时日，退出本公约。
Translation:
Article 19: Withdrawal

1. A State Party may withdraw from this Convention at any time after one year from the date on which the Convention has entered into force for that State.

Query_Text_cn: 2．退出本公约，应向秘书长交存一份文件。
Translation: 2. To withdraw from this Convention, a document shall be deposited with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 3．退出本公约，应自交存退出通知之日一年后次月第一日起，或自该通知中所载较此为长的期限起生效。
Translation: 3. Withdrawal from this Convention shall take effect on the first day of the month following one year after the date of deposit of the notice of withdrawal, or after such longer period as may be specified in the notice.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条修订和修正1．修订或修正本公约的会议，可由“海协”召开。
Translation:
Article 20 Amendments and Modifications

1. A meeting to amend or modify this Convention may be convened by the "Maritime Association."

Query_Text_cn: 2．经不少于三分之一缔约国要求，“海协”应召开本公约缔约国会议，修订或修正本公约。
Translation: 2. Upon the request of no less than one-third of the contracting parties, the "Maritime Association" shall convene a meeting of the contracting parties to this Convention to revise or amend the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3．凡在本公约的修正案生效之日以后交存的任何批准、接受、认可或加入文件，除非已在文件中表示相反意愿，便应视为适用于修正后的本公约。
Translation: 3. Any instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession deposited after the entry into force of an amendment to this Convention shall, unless the instrument expresses a different intention, be deemed to apply to the Convention as amended.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条对限额和计算单位或货币单位的修改1．尽管有第二十条的规定，“海协”仍可依照本条第2款和第3款的规定，召开专门会议，改变本公约第六条和第七条以及第八条第2款规定的限额，或以其他单位代替第八条第1款和第2款规定的两个单位，或其中之一。
Translation:
Article 21 Amendments of Limits and Units of Account or Monetary Units

1. Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 20, a special meeting may nevertheless be convened by the “Association” in accordance with paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article to amend the limits specified in Articles 6 and 7 and paragraph 2 of Article 8 of this Convention, or to substitute for either or both of the units prescribed in paragraphs 1 and 2 of Article 8 other units.

Query_Text_cn: 2．经不少于四分之一的缔约国要求，“海协”应召开上述会议。
Translation: 2. Upon the request of no less than one quarter of the contracting parties, the "Maritime Association" shall convene the aforementioned meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 3．改变限额或以其他计算单位代替原有单位的决定，应由上述会议到会并投票的缔约国三分之二多数作出。
Translation: Decisions to alter quotas or to substitute other units of calculation for the original units shall be made by a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Parties present and voting at the aforementioned meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 4．凡在修正案生效后交存其批准、接受、认可或加入本公的文件的国家，应适用修正后的本公约。
Translation: 4. For any State that deposits its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession to this Convention after the entry into force of an amendment, the Convention as amended shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条保管1．本公约应由秘书长保管。
Translation:
Article 22 Custody  
1. The present Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: ⑤由本公约任何条文所要求的任何通知事项。
Translation: (v) Any notice required by any provision of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3．本公约一经生效，秘书长便应依照联合国宪章第102条，将一份核证无误的本公约副本，送交联合国秘书长登记并公布。
Translation: 3. Upon the entry into force of this Convention, the Secretary-General shall, in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations, transmit a certified true copy of this Convention to the Secretary-General of the United Nations for registration and publication.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条语言本公约以英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文写成，正本共一份，每种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: Article 23: This Convention is drawn up in a single original in the English, French, Russian, and Spanish languages, each text being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 1976年11月19日订于伦敦。
Translation: Done at London on 19 November 1976.

Query_Text_cn: 为此而被正式授权的下列具名者，特签署本公约，以昭信守。
Translation: The undersigned, duly authorized for this purpose, have signed this Convention to attest their commitment.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条适用范围本公约及其所附各项议定书适用于1949年8月12日关于保护战争受难者的日内瓦四公约共有的第二条所指的场合,包括日内瓦四公约第一号附加议定书第一条第四款所指的场合。
Translation:
Article 1 Scope of Application

This Convention and its attached Protocols shall apply to the situations referred to in Article 2 common to the four Geneva Conventions of August 12, 1949, for the protection of victims of war, including the situations referred to in Article 1, paragraph 4, of Additional Protocol I to the Geneva Conventions.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条同其他国际协定的关系本公约及其所附各项议定书中任何条款均不得被解释为减损缔约国根据适用于武装冲突的国际人道法律所承担的其他义务。
Translation:
Article 2: Relation to Other International Agreements

No provision of this Convention or its annexed protocols shall be interpreted as diminishing the other obligations of States Parties under international humanitarian law applicable to armed conflicts.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条签署本公约将自1981年4月10日起在纽约联合国总部开放给所有国家签署,为期十二个月。
Translation: Article 3: The signing of this Convention shall be open to all States at the United Nations Headquarters in New York from April 10, 1981, for a period of twelve months.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条批准、接受、核准、加入1.本公约须经各签署国的批准、接受或核准。
Translation:
Article 4: Ratification, Acceptance, Approval, Accession

1. This Convention shall be subject to ratification, acceptance, or approval by the signatory States.

Query_Text_cn: 任何未签署本公约的国家亦可加入本公约。
Translation: Any country that has not signed this Convention may also accede to it.

Query_Text_cn: 2.批准、接受、核准或加入书应交存本公约的保存者。
Translation: Instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession shall be deposited with the depositary of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3.愿意受本公约任何一项议定书约束的表示,得由每个国家选择为之,只须该国在交存其批准、接受、核准或加入书时通知保存者该国愿意受任何两项或多项议定书的约束即可。
Translation: 3. The expression of willingness to be bound by any protocol under this Convention may be made by each country at its discretion, provided that the country notifies the depositary, at the time of depositing its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, of its intention to be bound by any two or more protocols.

Query_Text_cn: 4.任何缔约国可在交存其批准、接受、核准或如入书后的任何时候,通知保存者它愿意受对其尚无约束力的任何一项所附议定书的约束。
Translation: 4. Any Contracting Party may, at the time of depositing its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, or at any time thereafter, notify the Depositary that it agrees to be bound by any protocol annexed to which it is not already bound.

Query_Text_cn: 5.缔约国已受其约束的任何议定书,对该缔约国而言,即成为本公约的组成部分。
Translation: Any protocol by which a State Party is bound shall, for that State Party, become an integral part of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条生效1.本公约应在第二十份批准、接受、核准或加入书交存之日后六个月开始生效。
Translation:
Article 5 Entry into Force

1. This Convention shall enter into force six months after the date of deposit of the twentieth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对任何在第二十份批准、接受、核准或加入书交存之日后交存其批准、接受、核准或加入书的国家而言,本公约应在该国批准、接受、核准或加入书交存之日后六个月开始生效。
Translation: 2. For any country that deposits its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession after the date on which the twentieth such instrument has been deposited, this Convention shall enter into force six months after the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本公约所附每项议定书应在二十个国家接本公约第四条第3或第4款的规定通知愿受该议定书约束之日后六个月开始生效。
Translation: Each protocol annexed to this Convention shall enter into force six months after the date on which twenty States have notified, in accordance with paragraph 3 or 4 of Article 4 of this Convention, their consent to be bound by that protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 4.对任何在二十个国家已经通知愿受一项议定书的约束之日后通知愿受该议定书约束的国家而言,该议定书应在该国通知愿受约束之日后六个月开始生效。
Translation: 4. For any country that notifies its acceptance to be bound by a protocol after the date on which twenty countries have already notified their acceptance to be bound by that protocol, the protocol shall enter into force for that country six months after the date of its notification of acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条传播各缔约国承诺无论在和平期间或武装冲突期间,均将尽量在其本国广泛传播本公约及该国受其约束的议定书,特别要在军事训练课程中包括这方面的学习,以便使武装部队均知悉各该文书。
Translation:
Article 6 Dissemination

Each State Party undertakes, in time of peace as well as in time of armed conflict, to disseminate the present Convention and the Protocols by which it is bound as widely as possible in its country, in particular by including the study thereof in military training programs, so that the armed forces may be fully acquainted with these instruments.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条本公约生效时的条约关系1.当冲突的一方不受一项所附议定书的约束时,凡是受本公约和该项所附议定书约束的各方在其相互关系上仍受本公约和该项议定书的约束。
Translation:
Article 7 Treaty Relations at the Time of Entry into Force of This Convention

1. When one of the parties to the conflict is not bound by an annexed Protocol, the parties that are bound by both this Convention and the said Protocol shall remain bound by both this Convention and the Protocol in their mutual relations.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在第一条所设想的任何场合中,如果任何一个不是本公约的缔约国、或不受所附有关议定书约束的国家,接受并适用本公约或有关议定书,并就此通知保存者,则任何缔约国在其与该国的关系上,均受本公约反对其生效的任何所附议定书的约束。
Translation: 2. In any situation contemplated in Article 1, if any State which is not a Party to this Convention or is not bound by any relevant Protocol annexed hereto accepts and applies the provisions of this Convention or the relevant Protocol and notifies the Depositary accordingly, any Contracting Party shall, in its relations with that State, be bound by this Convention and by any Protocol annexed hereto which is in force for it.

Query_Text_cn: 3.保存者于收到本条第2款所述的任何通知时,应立即把它告知各有关缔约国。
Translation: Upon receipt of any notification referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article, the Depositary shall immediately inform all relevant Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 或(b)该缔约国不是第一号附加议定书的缔约国,也不是上文(a)项所指的当局,但接受日内瓦四公约和本公约及其所附有关议定书的各项义务并将之适用于该武装冲突。
Translation: or (b) the said Party is not a Party to Additional Protocol I, nor is it an authority referred to in subparagraph (a) above, but accepts and applies the obligations of the four Geneva Conventions, this Convention, and the relevant Protocols annexed thereto to the armed conflict in question.

Query_Text_cn: (三)日内瓦四公约、本公约及其所附有关议定书对冲突的所有当事各方具有同等约束力。
Translation: (3) The four Geneva Conventions, this Convention, and the relevant Protocols attached thereto are equally binding on all parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 该缔约国和该当局也可在对等基础上回意接受并适用日内瓦四公约第一号附加议定书所规定的义务。
Translation: The Contracting Party and the authority concerned may also, on a reciprocal basis, declare their willingness to accept and apply the obligations set forth in Additional Protocol I to the Geneva Conventions.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条审查和修正1.(a)本公约生效后的任何时候,任何缔约国可对本公约或其所附对该缔约国具有约束力的任何议定书提出修正。
Translation:
Article 8 Review and Amendment

1.(a) At any time after the entry into force of this Convention, any State Party may propose amendments to this Convention or to any protocol thereto by which it is bound.

Query_Text_cn: 任何有关修正的提案应送交保存者,保存者应将此提案分送所有缔约国并征询各缔约国关于应否召开一次会议以审议该提案的意见。
Translation: Any proposal for amendment shall be submitted to the Depositary, who shall circulate it to all Contracting Parties and solicit their views on whether a meeting should be convened to consider the proposal.

Query_Text_cn: 如经不少于十八个的多数缔约国同意,则保存者应立即召开一次会议,并邀请所有缔约国参加。
Translation: If agreed by a majority of no fewer than eighteen contracting parties, the depositary shall immediately convene a meeting and invite all contracting parties to attend.

Query_Text_cn: 不是本公约缔约国的国家应被邀请作为观察员参加会议。
Translation: States that are not parties to this Convention shall be invited to attend the meetings as observers.

Query_Text_cn: (b)此一会议可就修正案达成协议,该修正案将依本公约及其所附议定书相同的方式予以通过和生效,但对本公约的修正案只可由各缔约国予以通过,而对某一项所附议定书的修正案只可由受该议定书约束的各缔约国予以通过。
Translation: (b) The conference may reach agreement on an amendment, which shall be adopted and enter into force in the same manner as provided for this Convention and its attached Protocols; however, amendments to the Convention may only be adopted by the Contracting Parties to the Convention, and amendments to any attached Protocol may only be adopted by the Contracting Parties bound by that Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 2.(a)本公约生效后的任何时候,任何缔约国可提议增列关于未为现有所附议定书所包括的其他类型常规武器的议定书。
Translation: 2.(a) At any time after the entry into force of this Convention, any State Party may propose the addition of a protocol concerning types of conventional weapons not covered by the existing annexed protocols.

Query_Text_cn: 任何有关此种增列议定书的提案应送交保存者,保存者应依照本条第1款(a)项将此提案分送所有缔约国。
Translation: Any proposal concerning such an additional protocol shall be submitted to the depositary, who shall circulate the proposal to all Contracting Parties in accordance with paragraph 1(a) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 如经不少于十八个的多数缔约国同意,则保存者应立即召开一次会议,并邀请所有国家参加。
Translation: If agreed by a majority of no fewer than eighteen contracting parties, the depositary shall immediately convene a meeting and invite all countries to participate.

Query_Text_cn: (b)此一会议,在所有派有代表参加会议的国家充分出席的情况下,可就各增列议定书达成协议,各该增列议定书将依本公约相同的方式予以通过,附于本公约,并按本公约第五条第3和第4款的规定开始生效。
Translation: (b) This conference, with full attendance by representatives from all participating countries, may reach agreements on additional protocols. Each such additional protocol shall be adopted in the same manner as this Convention, attached to this Convention, and shall enter into force in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 3 and 4 of Article 5 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3.(a)如在本公约生效十年后未曾按照本条第1款(a)项或第2款(a)项规定召开会议是,任何缔约国可要求保存者召开一次会议,邀请所有缔约国参加,以便审查本公约和所附议定书的范围和执行情况,并审议任何修正本公约或现有议定书的提案。
Translation: 3.(a) If, ten years after the entry into force of this Convention, no meeting has been convened in accordance with paragraph 1(a) or paragraph 2(a) of this Article, any Contracting Party may request the Depositary to convene a meeting inviting all Contracting Parties to participate, in order to review the scope and implementation of this Convention and the attached Protocols, and to consider any proposals for amending this Convention or the existing Protocols.

Query_Text_cn: 不是本公约缔约国的国家应被邀请作为观察员参加会议。
Translation: States that are not parties to this Convention shall be invited to attend the meetings as observers.

Query_Text_cn: 会议可就各修正案达成协议,各该修正案将按照上文第1款(b)项的规定予以通过和生效。
Translation: The meeting may reach agreement on each amendment, and each amendment shall be adopted and come into effect in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1(b) above.

Query_Text_cn: (b)此一会议也可审议任何有关未为现有所附议定书所包括的其他类型常规武器的增列议定书的提案。
Translation: (b) The conference may also consider proposals for the addition of protocols concerning other types of conventional weapons not currently covered by the existing annexed protocols.

Query_Text_cn: 所有派有代表参加这个会议的国家均可充分参加审议。
Translation: All countries that have sent representatives to this meeting may fully participate in the deliberations.

Query_Text_cn: 任何增列议定书均将依本公约相同的方式予以通过,并按本公约第五条第3和第4钦的规定附于本公约并开始生效。
Translation: Any additional protocols shall be adopted in the same manner as this Convention, and shall be annexed to and enter into force in accordance with paragraphs 3 and 4 of Article 5 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (c)如在本条第3款(a)项所述同样长久的时期内未曾按照上文第1款(a)项或第2款(a)项规定召开会议时,此一会议可审议应否制定关于在任何缔约国提出要求时召开另一次会议的条款。
Translation: (c) If, during the same extended period referred to in paragraph 3(a) of this Article, no meeting has been convened in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1(a) or paragraph 2(a) above, such a meeting may consider whether to establish provisions regarding the convening of another meeting upon the request of any Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条退约1.任何缔约国可在通知保存者后退出本公约或其所附的任何议定书。
Translation:
Article 9 Withdrawal

1. Any contracting party may withdraw from this Convention or any protocol attached thereto by notifying the depositary.

Query_Text_cn: 2.任何此种退约只有在公约保存者收到退约通知一年后方可生效。
Translation: 2. Any such denunciation shall take effect only one year after the depositary of the convention has received the notice of denunciation.

Query_Text_cn: 但如果在一年期满时,退约国正卷入第一条所指各种场合中的一种场合,则该国在武装冲突或占领结束之前仍应受本公约各项义务及所附各项议定书的约束,无论如何,在与受适用于武装冲突的国际法各项条规保护的人最后释放、遣返或安置有关的行动终止以前,并如任何所附议定书载有关于联合国部队或特派团在有关地区执行维持和平、观察或类似任务的各种场合的条款时,则在这些任务结束以前,此项退约不应发生效力。
Translation: However, if at the expiration of one year, the withdrawing State is engaged in one of the situations referred to in Article 1, that State shall remain bound by all the obligations of this Convention and its annexed Protocols until the end of the armed conflict or occupation. In any case, until the completion of all actions related to the final release, repatriation, or resettlement of persons protected by the rules of international law applicable to armed conflict, the denunciation shall not take effect. Furthermore, if any annexed Protocol contains provisions regarding the presence of United Nations forces or missions carrying out peacekeeping, observation, or similar tasks in the relevant area, the denunciation shall not take effect until the completion of such tasks.

Query_Text_cn: 3.任何退出本公约的退约应视为同样适用于退约国受其约束的一切所附议定书。
Translation: 3. Any withdrawal from this Convention shall be deemed to apply equally to all protocols attached hereto by which the withdrawing State is bound.

Query_Text_cn: 4.任何退约只对退约国有效。
Translation: 4. Any withdrawal from the agreement shall only be effective with respect to the withdrawing party.

Query_Text_cn: 5.任何退约国在退约生效前的任何行动不得以武装冲突为理由而影响该国根据本公约及其所附议定书所已承担的义务。
Translation: 5. No actions taken by any withdrawing State prior to the effective date of withdrawal shall be used as grounds for armed conflict to affect the obligations that the State has undertaken under this Convention and its annexed protocols.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条保存者1.联合国秘书长应为本公约及其所附议定书的保存者。
Translation:
Article 10 Depositary

1. The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall be the depositary of this Convention and its attached Protocols.

Query_Text_cn: (e)接第九条的规定收到的退约通知及其有效日期。
Translation: (e) The notice of withdrawal received pursuant to the provisions of Article 9 and its effective date.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条有效文本本公约及其所附议定书的正本用阿拉伯文、中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文写成，各种文本具有同等效力，本公约及其所附议定书应由保存者保存，他应将经正式核证的副本递交所有国家。
Translation:
Article 11: Authentic Texts

The original texts of this Convention and its attached Protocol shall be drawn up in Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian, and Spanish, all texts being equally authentic. The Convention and its attached Protocol shall be deposited with the Depositary, who shall transmit certified copies to all States.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条本公约确定制造商和其他由第三条规定的人因产品造成损害，包括因对产品的错误说明或对其质量、特性或使用方法未提供适当说明而造成损害责任所适用的法律。在产品的所有权或使用权从被请求承担责任的一方移转到遭受损害一方的情况下，本公约不适用于他们之间的责任。不管诉讼性质如何，本公约均应予以适用。
Translation: Article 1: This Convention determines the law applicable to the liability of manufacturers and other persons specified in Article 3 for damage caused by products, including liability arising from incorrect descriptions of products or from failure to provide adequate information regarding their quality, characteristics, or methods of use. In cases where ownership or the right to use the product is transferred from the party against whom liability is sought to the party suffering the damage, this Convention does not apply to liability between them. This Convention shall apply regardless of the nature of the proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: （一）“产品”一词应包括天然产品和工业产品，无论是未加工还是加工的，是动产还是不动产。
Translation: The term "products" shall include both natural and industrial products, whether unprocessed or processed, and whether movable or immovable.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，除非与其他损害有关，产品本身的损害以及由此而引起的经济损失不应包括在内。
Translation: However, unless related to other damages, damage to the product itself and the resulting economic losses should not be included.

Query_Text_cn: （三）“人”一词系指法人及自然人。
Translation: (3) The term "person" refers to both legal persons and natural persons.

Query_Text_cn: （四）在产品准备或销售等整个商业环节中的其他人，包括修理人和仓库管理员。
Translation: (iv) Other individuals involved in various stages of the business process, such as product preparation or sales, including repair personnel and warehouse managers.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约对以上规定的人的代理人或雇员的责任亦应予以适用。
Translation: This Convention shall also apply to the liability of agents or employees of the persons referred to above.

Query_Text_cn: （三）直接遭受损害的人取得产品的地方。
Translation: (3) The place where the person directly suffering damage obtained the product.

Query_Text_cn: （二）直接遭受损害的人取得产品的地方。
Translation: (b) The place where the person directly suffering the damage obtained the product.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条如果第四条和第五条指定适用的法律都不适用，除非原告基于侵害地国家的国内法提出其请求，适用的法律应为被请求承担责任的人的主营业地国家的国内法。
Translation: Article 6: If the laws designated in Articles 4 and 5 are not applicable, unless the plaintiff bases their claim on the domestic law of the country where the infringement occurred, the applicable law shall be the domestic law of the country where the person requested to bear liability has their principal place of business.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条如果被请求承担责任的人证明他不能合理地预见产品或他自己的同类产品会经由商业渠道在该国出售，则第四条、第五条和第六条规定的侵害地国家和直接遭受损害的人的惯常所在地国法均不适用。
Translation: Article 7: If the person requested to assume liability proves that he could not reasonably have foreseen that the product or his own similar products would be sold in the country through commercial channels, then the laws of the country where the infringement occurred and the country of habitual residence of the person directly suffering damage, as stipulated in Articles 4, 5, and 6, shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: （九）时效规则，包括有关时效的开始、中断和中止的规则。
Translation: (9) Rules on limitation periods, including provisions regarding the commencement, interruption, and suspension of limitation periods.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条适用第四条、第五条、第六条时不应不考虑产品销售市场所在国家通行的有关行为规则和安全规则。
Translation: Article 9: When applying Articles 4, 5, and 6, due consideration should be given to the prevailing conduct and safety regulations in the country where the product is marketed.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条根据本公约宣示适用的法律只有在其适用会明显地与公共政策（“公共秩序”）相抵触时才可拒绝适用。
Translation: Article 10: The law declared applicable under this Convention may only be refused application if its application would manifestly be contrary to public policy ("ordre public").

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条上述各条的适用与任何互惠的要求无关。即使应适用的法律是非缔约国的法律，本公约亦应予适用。
Translation: Article 11 The application of the foregoing articles is not subject to any requirement of reciprocity. This Convention shall apply even if the applicable law is that of a non-contracting state.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条如一国由若干领土单位组成，而这些领土单位又各有其自己关于产品责任的法律规则时，为依本公约选择适用法律的目的，各领土单位应视为一个国家。
Translation: Article 12: If a country is composed of several territorial units, each of which has its own legal rules concerning product liability, these territorial units shall be regarded as one country for the purpose of selecting the applicable law under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条如果一个具有统一法律制度的国家根据本公约第四条、第五条规定不受适用另一国法律的约束时，则一个由若干各有其自己关于产品责任的法律规则的领土单位组成国家，也可不受适用本公约的约束。
Translation: Article 13: If a country with a unified legal system is not bound by the application of another country's law pursuant to Articles 4 and 5 of this Convention, then a country composed of several territorial units, each having its own rules of law regarding product liability, may also not be bound by the application of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条如一个缔约国由两个或两个以上各有其自己关于产品责任的法律规则的领土单位组成，则可在签字、批准、接受、认可或加入时，宣布本公约应适用于其所有领土单位或仅适用于其中一个或数个领土单位，并可在任何时候通过发表另一声明修改该声明。此类声明应通知荷兰外交部，并应明白说明公约适用的领土单位。
Translation: Article 14: If a Contracting State comprises two or more territorial units, each with its own rules of law relating to product liability, it may, at the time of signature, ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, declare that this Convention shall apply to all its territorial units or only to one or more of them, and may modify such declaration at any time by submitting another declaration. Such declarations shall be notified to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands and shall clearly specify the territorial units to which the Convention applies.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条对于缔约国参加的，或可能参加的其他专门方面公约中有关产品责任的规定，本公约不应优先适用。
Translation: Article 15: With regard to provisions on product liability in other specialized conventions to which a Contracting State is, or may become, a party, this Convention shall not take precedence.

Query_Text_cn: （二）本公约不适用于未经加工的产品。不允许有其他任何保留。任何缔约国根据第十九条通知扩展适用时，也可作出一项或数项此类保留，其效力限于扩展通知中提及的领土全部或一部。
Translation: (b) This Convention does not apply to unprocessed products. No other reservations are permitted. Any Contracting State, when notifying an extension under Article 19, may make one or more such reservations, the effect of which shall be limited to all or part of the territories mentioned in the extension notification.

Query_Text_cn: 该项保留自通知撤销后第三个月的第一天起终止效力。
Translation: This provision shall cease to be effective from the first day of the third month following the date of notification of revocation.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条本公约对派代表参加海牙国际私法会议第十二次会议的国家开放签字。本公约须经批准、接受或认可。批准书、接受书或认可书应交存荷兰外交部。
Translation:
Article 17

This Convention is open for signature by the States which sent representatives to the Twelfth Session of the Hague Conference on Private International Law. This Convention shall be subject to ratification, acceptance, or approval. Instruments of ratification, acceptance, or approval shall be deposited with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条任何于第十二次会议后成为海牙国际私法会议成员的国家、联合国会员国或联合国专门机构成员国或国际法院规约参加国均可在本公约根据第二十条生效后加入。加入书应交存荷兰外交部。
Translation:
Article 18  
Any State that becomes a member of the Hague Conference on Private International Law after the Twelfth Session, any member State of the United Nations or of a specialized agency of the United Nations, or any State party to the Statute of the International Court of Justice may accede to this Convention after it enters into force in accordance with Article 20. The instrument of accession shall be deposited with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条任何国家在签字、批准、接受、认可或加入时，得声明本公约的效力扩展适用于其在国际关系上负有责任的所有领土或仅及其中一处或数处，此项声明自该国加入本公约生效之日起发生效力。此后，这种扩展适用应通知荷兰外交部。
Translation:
Article 19  
Any State, at the time of signature, ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, may declare that the provisions of this Convention shall extend to all territories for whose international relations it is responsible, or only to one or more of them. Such a declaration shall take effect from the date on which the State becomes a party to this Convention. Thereafter, any such extension shall be notified to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条本公约应自第十七条第二款所述的批准书、接受书、认可书或加入书交存之日起，于第三个月的第一天开始生效。
Translation: Article 20: This Convention shall enter into force on the first day of the third month following the date of deposit of the instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 17.

Query_Text_cn: 对于嗣后批准、接受或认可的国家，本公约应自各该国交存其批准书、接受书或认可书后第三个月的第一天开始生效。
Translation: For any State that subsequently ratifies, accepts, or approves this Convention, it shall enter into force on the first day of the third month following the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification, acceptance, or approval.

Query_Text_cn: 对于根据第十九条规定，本公约扩展适用的领土，自该条所指的通知以后第三个月的第一天开始生效。
Translation: For any territory to which the application of this Convention is extended pursuant to Article 19, the Convention shall enter into force on the first day of the third month following the notification referred to in that Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条本公约自依第二十条第一款规定生效之日起，存续有效五年，对其后批准、接受、认可或加入的国家亦同。如未经废止，本公约每五年自动更新有效一次。任何废止，至迟应在五年期满六个月前，通知荷兰外交部。废止得限于本公约适用的某些领土。废止仅对该通知废止的国家生效，本公约对其他缔约国仍应存续有效。
Translation:
Article 21

This Convention shall remain in force for five years from the date of its entry into force in accordance with paragraph 1 of Article 20, and the same shall apply to States which subsequently ratify, accept, approve, or accede to it. Unless denounced, the Convention shall be automatically renewed for successive periods of five years. Any denunciation must be notified to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands at least six months before the expiry of the five-year period. Denunciation may be limited to certain territories to which the Convention applies. The denunciation shall take effect only in respect of the State which has notified it; the Convention shall remain in force for the other Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: （六）第二十一条所述的废止。下列签字人经正式授权签署本公约，以资证明。1973年10月2日订于海牙，用英法两种文字写成，两种文本具有同等效力，合成一个正本，存放于荷兰政府档案库，经核证无误的副本应通过外交途径分送召开第十二次会议时海牙国际私法会议各会员国。
Translation: (6) Abrogation as referred to in Article 21. The undersigned, being duly authorized, have signed this Convention as evidence thereof. Done at The Hague on 2 October 1973, in both the English and French languages, both texts being equally authentic, in a single original copy to be deposited in the archives of the Government of the Netherlands. Certified copies shall be transmitted through diplomatic channels to each Member State of the Hague Conference on Private International Law that participated in the Twelfth Session.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条本公约规定适用于信托的法律及其承认。
Translation: Article 1: This Convention applies to the law governing trusts and their recognition.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条在本公约中，当财产为受益人的利益或为了特定目的而置于受托人的控制之下时，“信托”这一术语系指财产授予人设定的在其生前或身后发生效力的法律关系。
Translation: Article 2: In this Convention, where property is placed under the control of a trustee for the benefit of beneficiaries or for a specific purpose, the term "trust" refers to the legal relationship established by the settlor, which takes effect either during their lifetime or after their death.

Query_Text_cn: （三）受托人有根据信托的条件和法律所加于他的特殊职责，管理、使用或处分财产的权力和应尽的义务。财产授予人保留某些权利和权力以及受托人本身得享有作为受益人的权利这一事实，并不一定与信托的存在相矛盾。
Translation: (3) Trustees have the authority and obligations to manage, use, or dispose of property in accordance with the terms of the trust and the special duties imposed by law. The fact that the settlor retains certain rights and powers, and that the trustee himself may enjoy rights as a beneficiary, does not necessarily conflict with the existence of the trust.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条本公约仅适用于自愿设定并以书面证明的信托。
Translation: Article 3: This Convention applies only to trusts that are voluntarily established and evidenced in writing.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条本公约不适用于与据以移转财产与受托人的遗嘱及其他行为的有效性有关的先决问题。
Translation: Article 4: This Convention does not apply to preliminary questions concerning the validity of wills or other acts by virtue of which property is transferred to a trustee.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条在第二章中规定的法律未对信托或对有关的信托所属的类别作出规定的范围内，本公约不应予以适用。
Translation: Article 5: To the extent that the law specified in Chapter II does not provide for trusts or for the category of trusts concerned, this Convention shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条信托应依财产授予人所选择的法律。该项选择必须是明示的或默示地规定在设定或书面证明信托的文件的条款中，必要时，须根据案件的情况予以解释。如果根据前款选择的法律未对信托或对有关的信托所属类别作出规定，该项选择不应为有效，第七条中指定的法律则应予适用。
Translation: Article 6: A trust shall be governed by the law chosen by the settlor. Such choice must be expressly stated or implied in the terms of the instrument creating or evidencing the trust, and, where necessary, shall be ascertained in light of the circumstances of the case. If the law chosen in accordance with the preceding paragraph does not provide for trusts or for the category of trust concerned, such choice shall not be effective, and the law specified in Article 7 shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条如适用的法律未经选择，信托应依与之有最密切联系的法律。
Translation: Article 7 If the applicable law has not been chosen, the trust shall be governed by the law with which it is most closely connected.

Query_Text_cn: （四）信托的目的及其目的实现地。
Translation: (iv) The purpose of the trust and the place where the purpose is to be fulfilled.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条第六条、第七条规定的法律应支配信托的有效性、解释、效力及其管理。
Translation: Article 8 The validity, interpretation, effect, and administration of the trust shall be governed by the laws specified in Articles 6 and 7.

Query_Text_cn: （十）受托人报告管理情况的义务。
Translation: (10) The trustee's obligation to report on management activities.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条适用本章时，信托的某一可分割事项，特别是管理事项，可依不同的法律。
Translation: When applying this Chapter to Article 9, a divisible matter of the trust, particularly matters of administration, may be governed by different laws.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条适用于信托有效性的法律应决定该项法律或支配信托某一可分割事项的法律能否为另一法律所替代。
Translation: Article 10: The law governing the validity of a trust shall determine whether that law, or the law governing a severable aspect of the trust, may be replaced by another law.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条根据前章规定的法律所设定的信托应作为信托而予承认。该项承认至少应意味着信托财产为独立的资金，受托人可以受托人身份起诉，以及他可以在公证人或任何其他履行官方职务的人面前以该身份出现或行事。
Translation: Article 11 Trusts created in accordance with the laws specified in the preceding chapter shall be recognized as trusts. Such recognition shall at least imply that the trust property constitutes a separate fund, that the trustee may sue in his capacity as trustee, and that he may appear or act in such capacity before a notary or any other person performing an official function.

Query_Text_cn: （四）如果受托人违反信托，将信托财产与其个人财产混合或让渡信托财产，则信托财产可予回复。但财产的第三方持有人的权利和义务仍应受法院地法律选择规则所确定的法律支配。
Translation: (4) If the trustee breaches the trust by commingling the trust property with their personal property or disposing of the trust property, the trust property may be restored. However, the rights and obligations of third-party holders of the property shall remain governed by the law determined under the choice of law rules of the forum court.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条如果受托人意欲为财产，不管是动产或不动产，或财产所有权文书登记注册，他有权在不为注册登记地法律所禁止或不与注册登记地法律相抵触的范围内，以受托人的身份这样做，或通过公布信托存在那样的其他方式行事。
Translation: Article 12: If the trustee intends to register property, whether movable or immovable, or documents of title to property, he is entitled to do so in his capacity as trustee, or to act in such other manner as may publicize the existence of the trust, provided that such actions are not prohibited by or inconsistent with the laws of the place of registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条除对适用法律作了选择外，没有国家有义务承认其信托，如重要因素，即管理地和受托人的惯常居所，与没有信托制度或有关的信托所属的类别的国家有更为密切的联系。
Translation: Article 13: Except where a choice of applicable law has been made, no country is obliged to recognize a trust if significant factors, such as the place of administration and the habitual residence of the trustee, are more closely connected with a country that does not have a trust system or with the category of trust concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条本公约不阻碍对承认信托更为有利的法律的适用。
Translation: Article 14: This Convention shall not prevent the application of laws that are more favorable to the recognition of trusts.

Query_Text_cn: （六）在其他方面对善意第三人的保护。如果前款的适用致使信托无法得到承认，则法院应试用其他方法使信托之目的得以实现。
Translation: (6) Protection of bona fide third parties in other respects. If the application of the preceding clause results in the trust not being recognized, the court should employ other methods to ensure the purpose of the trust is fulfilled.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条不管冲突法规则如何规定，本公约不妨碍法院地即使对国际性案件也必须适用的法律条款的适用；如果另一国家与案件有足够密切的联系，那么，在例外情况下，可以给予该国具有前款述及的性质的规则以效力。任何缔约国可通过保留方式，声明其将不适用本条第二款。
Translation:
Article 16
Regardless of the provisions of conflict of law rules, this Convention does not preclude the application of legal provisions that the court must apply, even in international cases. If another country has a sufficiently close connection with the case, then, in exceptional circumstances, rules of the nature referred to in the preceding paragraph may be given effect. Any Contracting State may, by way of reservation, declare that it will not apply the second paragraph of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条在本公约中，“法律”一词系指在一国有效的除其法律冲突法规则以外的法律规则。
Translation: Article 17: In this Convention, the term "law" refers to the legal rules in force in a country, excluding its rules of conflict of laws.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条本公约条款的适用如明显地与公共政策（公共秩序）不相一致时，则可不加考虑。
Translation: Article 18: If the application of the provisions of this Convention is manifestly incompatible with public policy (ordre public), such provisions may be disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条本公约不得损害各国在财政方面拥有的权力。
Translation: Article 19: This Convention shall not prejudice the fiscal powers of any country.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条任何缔约国可在任何时候声明本公约的条款将扩展适用于法院判决所宣布的信托。该项声明应通知荷兰王国外交部，并于该项声明收到日生效。
Translation: Article 20: Any Contracting State may at any time declare that the provisions of this Convention shall be extended to trusts declared by court judgments. Such a declaration shall be notified to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of the Netherlands and shall take effect on the date of receipt of the declaration.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条可适用于本公约的废止，也可同样适用于该项声明的撤销。
Translation: Article 31 shall apply to the termination of this Convention and equally to the withdrawal of such declarations.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条任何缔约国可保留权利，仅将第三章的规定适用于依缔约国法律支配其有效性的信托。
Translation: Article 21 Any Contracting State may reserve the right to apply the provisions of Chapter III only to trusts whose validity is governed by the law of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条不管信托设定于何日期，本公约均予适用。但缔约国可保留权利，不将公约适用于公约对该国生效日期之前设定的信托。
Translation:
Article 22

This Convention shall apply to trusts regardless of the date on which they are established. However, a Contracting State may reserve the right not to apply the Convention to trusts established before the date on which the Convention enters into force for that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条为确定根据本公约所可适用的法律，如果某一缔约国由若干各自有其有关信托的法律规则的领土单位组成，任何援用该国法律应解释为援用有关领土单位有效的法律。
Translation:
Article 23  
For the purpose of determining the law applicable under this Convention, if a Contracting State comprises two or more territorial units, each with its own rules of law relating to trusts, any reference to the law of that State shall be construed as referring to the law in force in the relevant territorial unit.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条由各自有其有关信托的法律规则的不同领土单位所组成的国家，没有义务将本公约适用于仅仅发生在这些领土单位之间的法律冲突。
Translation: Article 24: A State composed of territorial units, each of which has its own rules of law in respect of trusts, shall not be obliged to apply this Convention to conflicts of laws arising solely between such territorial units.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条本公约不影响一缔约国参加的并载有受本公约支配之事项的条款的任何其他国际文件。
Translation: Article 25: This Convention shall not affect any other international instrument to which a Contracting State is a party and which contains provisions relating to matters governed by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条任何国家可在签字、批准、接受、认可或加入时，或者在根据第二十九条规定作出声明时，作出第十六条、第二十一条和第二十二条规定的保留。其他任何保留均不得被准许。
Translation: Article 26: Any State may, at the time of signature, ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, or when making a declaration pursuant to Article 29, make reservations as provided for in Articles 16, 21, and 22. No other reservations shall be permitted.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条本公约应向海牙国际私法会议第十五次会议时的会员国开放签字。本公约须经批准、接受或认可，批准书、接受书或认可书应交存荷兰王国外交部。
Translation:
Article 27

This Convention shall be open for signature by the Member States of the Hague Conference on Private International Law at the time of its Fifteenth Session. This Convention is subject to ratification, acceptance, or approval, and the instruments of ratification, acceptance, or approval shall be deposited with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of the Netherlands.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条任何其他国家均可在本公约根据第三十条第一款生效后加入本公约。加入书应交存荷兰王国外交部。该项加入仅在加入国和接到第二十二条述及的通知后十二个月内未提出反对的那些缔约国之间生效。这样的反对亦得由会员国于加入后，在其批准、接受或认可本公约时提出。任何此类异议应通知荷兰王国外交部。
Translation: Article 28: Any other country may accede to this Convention after it has entered into force pursuant to paragraph 1 of Article 30. Instruments of accession shall be deposited with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. Such accession shall become effective only between the acceding country and those Contracting States which have not raised an objection within twelve months after receiving the notification referred to in Article 22. Such objection may also be raised by a Member State at the time of its accession, ratification, acceptance, or approval of this Convention. Any such objection shall be notified to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of the Netherlands.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条如果一国具有两个或两个以上领土单位，而在这些领土单位中适用不同的法律制度，该国家在签署、批准、接受、认可或加入时，得声明本公约应扩展适用于所有领土单位，或仅适用于其中的一个或一个以上领土单位，并得在任何时候提出另一项声明以修正该项声明。任何此类声明应通知荷兰王国外交部并应明确说明本公约适用的领土单位。如果国家未根据本条作出声明，则本公约应扩及适用于该国的所有领土。
Translation:
Article 29  
If a State comprises two or more territorial units in which different systems of law are applicable, it may, at the time of signature, ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, declare that this Convention shall extend to all its territorial units or only to one or more of them, and may at any time make another declaration amending its previous declaration. Any such declaration shall be notified to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of the Netherlands and shall expressly indicate the territorial units to which the Convention applies. If the State makes no declaration under this Article, the Convention shall extend to all territorial units of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条本公约应在第二十七条述及的第三份批准书、接受书、认可书或加入书交存后，第三个历月的第一天起生效。
Translation: Article 30 This Convention shall enter into force on the first day of the third month following the date of deposit of the third instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession referred to in Article 27.

Query_Text_cn: （三）对公约根据第二十九条扩及适用的领土单位，自该条中述及的通知作出后第三个历月的第一天起。
Translation: (3) For territorial units to which the Convention is extended pursuant to Article 29, the Convention shall enter into force on the first day of the third calendar month following the date of the notification referred to in that Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条任何缔约国可以正式书面通知本公约保存处，即荷兰王国外交部的方式废止本公约。该项废止于保存处收到该通知书之日或于通知书中规定的更晚的日期起六个月期满后的第一天起生效。
Translation: Article 31 Any Contracting State may denounce this Convention by means of a formal written notification addressed to the depositary of the Convention, namely the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. Such denunciation shall take effect on the first day following the expiration of a period of six months after the date on which the depositary has received the notification, or on such later date as may be specified in the notification.

Query_Text_cn: （七）第三十一条述及的废止。下列经各自政府正式授权的代表在本公约上签署，以资证明。1985年7月1日订于海牙，以英文和法文写成，两种文本同属原本，并成一册，应存放于荷兰王国政府外交部档案库，其经核证无误的副本，应通过外交途径分送海牙国际私法会议第十五次会议时的会员国各一份。
Translation: (7) Abrogation as referred to in Article 31. The undersigned, duly authorized by their respective governments, have signed this Convention as evidence thereof.
