Translation: The number of votes required for election must exceed half of the total.

Query_Text_cn: 在执行董事出缺期间，由副董事代行其职权，但不得再指派副董事。
Translation: During the vacancy of the Executive Director, the Deputy Director shall act on their behalf, but may not appoint another Deputy Director.

Query_Text_cn: (e)执行董事应常驻银行总办事处办公，并根据银行业务需要经常集会。
Translation: (e)The Executive Directors shall reside at the principal office of the Bank and shall meet as often as the business of the Bank may require.

Query_Text_cn: (f)执行董事每次会议的法定人数应为过半数董事，并持有不少于半数的总投票权。
Translation: (f) The quorum for each meeting of the Executive Directors shall be more than half of the directors, holding no less than half of the total voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: (g)每一被指派的董事应按本条第三节分配给指派该董事的会员国的票数投票。
Translation: (g) Each appointed director shall cast the votes allocated to the member country that appointed him or her, as provided in Section 3 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 每一被选任的董事应按其当选所得的票数投票。
Translation: Each elected director shall cast votes according to the number of votes received upon election.

Query_Text_cn: 各董事可投的全部票数应作为一个单位投票。
Translation: All votes that each director is entitled to cast shall be cast as a single unit.

Query_Text_cn: (h)理事会应制定规章，使按上述(b)款规定不能指派董事的会员国，在讨论该会员国提出的请求或与该会员国有特殊影响的事项时，得派遣一代表出席执行董事的会议、(i)执行董事得在其认为有必要时，酌情设立各种委员会。
Translation:
(h) The Board of Governors shall establish regulations to allow member countries that cannot appoint directors as stipulated in paragraph (b) above to send a representative to attend meetings of the Executive Directors when requests submitted by such member countries or matters that have a special impact on them are being discussed.

(i) The Executive Directors may, at their discretion, establish various committees whenever they deem it necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会的成员不必限于理事、董事或其副职。
Translation: Members of the committee are not required to be limited to directors, board members, or their deputies.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节行长和工作人员(a)执行董事应选行长一人。理事、执行董事或两者之副职皆不得兼任行长。
Translation:
Section 5: President and Staff

(a) The Executive Directors shall select a President. Neither Governors, Executive Directors, nor their deputies may serve as President.

Query_Text_cn: 行长应为执行董事会的主席，但除在双方票数相等时得投一决票外，无投票权。
Translation: The President shall serve as the Chairman of the Executive Board but shall have no voting rights except in the event of a tie, in which case the President may cast the deciding vote.

Query_Text_cn: 行长得参加理事会会议，但无投票权。
Translation: The president must attend board meetings but has no voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 行长职务的终止由执行董事决定。
Translation: The termination of the President's duties shall be decided by the Executive Directors.

Query_Text_cn: (b)行长为银行工作人员的主管，在执行董事的指导下处理银行日常业务，并在执行董事总的管理下负责官员和工作人员的组织、任命及辞退。
Translation: (b)The President shall be the chief of the Bank's staff, shall conduct the ordinary business of the Bank under the direction of the Executive Directors, and shall be responsible, under the general supervision of the Executive Directors, for the organization, appointment, and dismissal of officers and staff.

Query_Text_cn: (c)行长、官员和工作人员在执行其任务时，应完全对银行负责，而不对其他官方负责。
Translation: (c) The president, officials, and staff shall be fully accountable to the bank in the performance of their duties and shall not be accountable to any other authority.

Query_Text_cn: 各会员国应尊重此种职责的国际性，并应制止在他们执行职务时对他们任何人施加影响的企图。
Translation: Member States shall respect the international character of these duties and shall refrain from attempting to influence any of them in the discharge of their responsibilities.

Query_Text_cn: (d)行长任命职员和工作人员时，最重要的，应以其是否能达到最高的工作效率和技术能力为标准，并应尽可能注意按广泛的地区性录用人员的重要性。
Translation: (d) In appointing officers and staff, the President shall give primary consideration to securing the highest standards of efficiency and technical competence, and shall pay due regard to the importance of recruiting personnel on as wide a geographical basis as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 第六节顾问委员会(a)银行应设一不少于7人的顾问委员会，其人选由理事会选定，应包括银行业、商业、工业、劳工及农业各方面利益的代表，并尽可能照顾到广大国别。
Translation:
Section 6 Advisory Committee

(a) The Bank shall establish an Advisory Committee consisting of not fewer than seven persons, selected by the Board of Governors. The committee shall include representatives of the interests of banking, commerce, industry, labor, and agriculture, and shall, as far as possible, be broadly representative of the member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 在委员会成员所代表的领域内，如有专门的国际组织存在，则该成员的选定，应征得该组织的同意。
Translation: If a specialized international organization exists in the field represented by a committee member, the selection of that member shall be subject to the consent of the organization.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会应向银行提供有关总的政策方面的意见。
Translation: The committee should provide the bank with advice on overall policy matters.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会除应每年开会一次外，需应银行要求随时召集会议。
Translation: In addition to holding an annual meeting, the committee shall convene meetings at any time upon the request of the bank.

Query_Text_cn: (b)顾问任期为两年，可以连任。
Translation: (b)The term of office for consultants is two years and may be renewed.

Query_Text_cn: 其因银行事务而发生的合理费用应由银行支付。
Translation: Reasonable expenses incurred due to banking transactions shall be borne by the bank.

Query_Text_cn: 第七节贷款委员会按第三条第四节规定，负责贷款报告的委员会，应由银行指派。
Translation: Section 7 The Loan Committee, as stipulated in Section 4 of Article 3, which is responsible for loan reports, shall be appointed by the bank.

Query_Text_cn: 每一个这种委员会，应包括代表项目所在地会员国的理事所选的专家一人，以及银行技术人员一人或数人。
Translation: Each such committee shall include one expert selected by the Executive Director representing the member country where the project is located, as well as one or more technical staff members of the Bank.

Query_Text_cn: 第八节与其他国际组织的关系(a)银行应在本协定条文范围内，与任何一般的国际组织和在有关领域内负有专门责任的公共国际组织进行合作。
Translation:
Section 8: Relations with Other International Organizations  
(a) Within the scope of the provisions of this Agreement, the Bank shall cooperate with any general international organization and any public international organization with specialized responsibilities in relevant fields.

Query_Text_cn: 凡此项合作的办法，如涉及更改本协定的任何条款时，须按照第八条规定修改本协定后方能生效。
Translation: Any arrangements for such cooperation that involve changes to any provisions of this Agreement shall only become effective after the Agreement has been amended in accordance with Article 8.

Query_Text_cn: (b)在对申请贷款或担保作出决定时，如其有关事项直接属于上款所列各种国际组织职能范围之内，且这种国际组织之参加者主要为银行各会员国，银行应对此组织所提供的意见和建议加以考虑。
Translation: (b) When making decisions regarding loan or guarantee applications, if the relevant matters fall directly within the functions of the international organizations listed in the preceding paragraph, and the participants of such organizations are primarily member countries of the Bank, the Bank shall take into account the opinions and recommendations provided by these organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 第九节办事处所在地(a)银行总办事处应设于持有最大股份的会员国境内。
Translation:
Section 9: Location of Offices  
(a) The principal office of the Bank shall be located in the territory of the member holding the largest number of shares.

Query_Text_cn: (b)银行得在任何会员国境内设立办事处或分行。
Translation: (b) The Bank may establish offices or branches within the territory of any member country.

Query_Text_cn: 第十节地区办事处和地区委员会(a)银行得设立地区办事处，并决定各地区办事处的所在地及其所辖的地区。
Translation:
Section 10 Regional Offices and Regional Committees

(a) The Bank may establish regional offices and determine the locations of such offices as well as the regions under their jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: (b)每一地区办事处应设一区域委员会以资顾问，代表整个地区提供意见，其人选由银行决定之。
Translation: (b) Each regional office shall establish a regional committee to serve in an advisory capacity, representing the entire region in providing opinions, with its members appointed by the Bank.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一节存款机构(a)各会员国应指定其中央银行为存放世界银行所持有的全部该国货币的存款机构。如无中央银行，则应指定银行所同意的其它机构。
Translation:
Section 11: Depository Institutions

(a) Each member shall designate its central bank as the depository for all holdings of its currency by the World Bank. In the absence of a central bank, the member shall designate such other institution as may be acceptable to the Bank.

Query_Text_cn: (b)银行得将其它资产，包括黄金在内，存放在持有最大股份的5个会员国所指定的存款机构内，或银行选择的其它指定的存款机构内。
Translation: (b) The Bank shall deposit other assets, including gold, in depositories designated by the five member countries holding the largest shares, or in other designated depositories selected by the Bank.

Query_Text_cn: 最初成立时，银行的黄金储备至少应有一半存于总办事处所在地会员国所指定的存款机构内，并至少有40%存放在上述其余的4个会员国所指定的存款机构内。每一存款机构最初存入的黄金数量，不得少于指定存款地点之会员国认缴股份中已缴付的黄金数额。
Translation: At the time of its establishment, at least half of the bank's gold reserves shall be deposited in the designated depository institution of the member country where the headquarters is located, and at least 40% shall be deposited in the designated depository institutions of the other four member countries. The initial amount of gold deposited in each depository institution shall not be less than the amount of gold paid by the member country at the designated location as part of its subscribed shares.

Query_Text_cn: 但银行在转移黄金时应充分注意到运输费用，并预计到银行的需要。
Translation: However, banks should pay full attention to transportation costs when transferring gold and anticipate their own needs.

Query_Text_cn: 遇有紧急情况时，执行董事会得将全部或任何一部分黄金转移至任何能得到充分保护的地点。
Translation: In case of emergency, the Executive Board may transfer all or any part of the gold to any location where adequate protection can be ensured.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二节持有货币的形式凡按第二条第七节(i)项而付给银行的会员国货币，或者用以分期偿还贷款的该项货币，如银行业务上不需要时，应接受该会员国政府或其指定的存款机构开出的票据或类似证券以替代之。该项票据不得转让，也无利息，需要时按票面价值见票即付，在指定存款机构记入银行帐户贷方。
Translation:
Section 12: Forms of Holding Currency

Any member country currency paid to the Bank under Article II, Section 7(i), or used for the repayment of loans in installments, shall, when not required for the Bank's operations, be replaced by promissory notes or similar securities issued by the government of the member country or its designated depository. Such notes shall be non-negotiable, non-interest bearing, and payable at face value upon demand, and shall be credited to the Bank's account at the designated depository.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三节报告的公布和资料的提供(a)银行应出版一种年报，内容包括已经过审计的决算报告，并应每隔3个月或更短时期向会员国发布一份表明财务状况的简报和业务经营成果的损益计算书。
Translation:
Section 13: Publication of Reports and Provision of Information  
(a) The Bank shall publish an annual report containing audited financial statements and shall, at intervals of three months or less, issue to member countries a summary statement of its financial position and a profit and loss account showing the results of its operations.

Query_Text_cn: (b)银行认为对其执行其任务有利时，得发表其他报告。
Translation: (b) The bank may issue other reports when it deems them beneficial to the performance of its duties.

Query_Text_cn: (c)本节所述各种报告、报表和出版物，均应分发给会员国。
Translation: (c) All reports, statements, and publications referred to in this section shall be distributed to the Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四节净收入的分配(a)银行的净收入，在提出各项准备以后，哪些部分用于公积金，哪些部分(如果有的话)用于分配，应每年由理事会决定。
Translation:
Section 14: Allocation of Net Income

(a) After making provisions for reserves, the allocation of the net income of the Bank—specifically, what portion shall be assigned to the reserve fund and what portion (if any) shall be distributed—shall be determined annually by the Board of Governors.

Query_Text_cn: (b)如有任何净收入部分用于分配，第一次应根据当年按第四条第节(a)款(i)项贷出之款项的平均未偿还金额为基础，将至多2%作为第一批红利，用与各会员国认缴股款相同的货币分配给各会员国。红利如不分配时，不得积累至以后分配。
Translation: (b) If any portion of net income is to be distributed, the first distribution shall be based on the average outstanding amount of loans made during the year under Article IV, Section (a)(i), with up to 2% allocated as the first dividend, to be distributed to each member country in the same currency as their subscribed capital. Dividends not distributed shall not be accumulated for future distribution.

Query_Text_cn: 如第一次支付2%后尚有余款可供分配，应按会员国股份比例支付给全体会员国。
Translation: If there remains a balance available for distribution after the initial 2% payment, it shall be paid to all member countries in proportion to their respective shares.

Query_Text_cn: 付款给各会员国时应用各该国本国货币，如缺乏该项货币，应用该会员国可以接受的其他会员国货币。
Translation: Payments to each member country shall be made in the currency of that country; if such currency is unavailable, payments shall be made in the currency of another member country acceptable to the member concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 如果用其他会员国货币付款，接受该项货币的会员国转移和使用该项货币时应不受其他会员国的限制。
Translation: If payment is made in the currency of another member country, the member country accepting such currency shall not be subject to restrictions by other member countries when transferring and using that currency.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条会员国的退出及暂停会员国资格，营业的停止第一节会员国退出的权利任何会员国得随时以书面通知银行总办事处退出银行。
Translation:
Article 6: Withdrawal and Suspension of Membership, Cessation of Operations

Section 1: Right of Member Countries to Withdraw

Any member country may withdraw from the Bank at any time by delivering a written notice to the principal office of the Bank.

Query_Text_cn: 在银行接到该项通知之日起，退出即应生效。
Translation: The withdrawal shall take effect immediately upon the bank's receipt of such notice.

Query_Text_cn: 第二节暂停会员资格如果会员国不履行任何对银行的义务，银行经半数以上理事并持有过半数总投票权的表决，得暂停其会员国资格。
Translation:
Section 2 Suspension of Membership

If a member country fails to fulfill any of its obligations to the Bank, the Bank may suspend its membership by a decision of more than half of the Governors representing more than half of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: 该国自暂停会员国资格之日起1年后，除非以同样的多数表决恢复其资格外，即自动终止为会员国。
Translation: One year after the suspension of its membership, the country shall automatically cease to be a member unless its membership is restored by the same majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 在暂停资格期间，该会员国除有权退出外，不再享有本协定规定的任何权利，但仍应对全部债务负责。
Translation: During the suspension of its membership, the member country shall not enjoy any rights under this Agreement except the right to withdraw, but shall remain liable for all its obligations.

Query_Text_cn: 第三节在国际货币基金组织中停止会员国资格任何会员国在其丧失国际货币基金组织会员国资格3个月后，即自动丧失其为银行会员国的资格，除非经银行总投票权3/4的多数通过允许该国仍为会员国。
Translation:
Section 3: Suspension of Membership in the International Monetary Fund

Any member that loses its membership in the International Monetary Fund shall automatically cease to be a member of the Bank three months after such loss, unless the Bank, by a three-fourths majority of the total voting power, decides to allow the country to remain a member.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节与已停止为会员国之政府清理帐目的办法(a)一国政府停止为会员国时，它对该会员国在未退出前所欠银行的一切直接负债及所应分担的银行债务，在贷款或担保贷款的任何部分还未清偿以前，仍应继续负责。
Translation:
Section 4: Settlement of Accounts with Governments Ceasing to Be Members

(a) When a government ceases to be a member, it shall remain liable for all direct obligations to the Bank and for its share of the Bank's liabilities incurred prior to withdrawal, until such loans or guarantees, or any part thereof, have been fully discharged.

Query_Text_cn: 但在该国停止为会员国以后，对银行承做的贷款与担保贷款不再负有责任，也不再分摊银行的收益或费用。
Translation: However, after the country ceases to be a member, it will no longer be liable for loans and guaranteed loans undertaken by the bank, nor will it share in the bank's income or expenses.

Query_Text_cn: (b)在一国政府停止为会员国时，银行应按照下述(c)及(d)款的规定，安排购回其股份作为与该政府清算帐目的一部分。
Translation: (b) When a government ceases to be a member, the Bank shall arrange for the repurchase of its shares as part of the settlement of accounts with that government, in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs (c) and (d) below.

Query_Text_cn: 购回股份的价格，应以该政府停止为会员国当日的银行帐面价值为准。
Translation: The price for repurchasing shares shall be based on the book value of the bank as of the date the government ceases to be a member country.

Query_Text_cn: (i)如该政府或其中华银行或所属任何机构，作为借款人或担保人，对银行仍负有债务时，银行得扣留其应付给该政府的股款中的一定数额，并在该项债务到期时，用此项款项清偿该项债务。
Translation: (i) If the government, the Central Bank of China, or any of its affiliated institutions, as borrower or guarantor, still owes any debt to the bank, the bank may withhold a certain amount from the shares payable to the government and use such amount to settle the debt when it becomes due.

Query_Text_cn: 但不得因该政府在第二条第五节(ii)款下认购股份所产生的债务，而扣留任何数量之股款。
Translation: However, no amount of share money shall be withheld on account of any debt arising from the subscription of shares by that government under Article II, Section 5(ii).

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下，应付该政府的股款，应自该政府停止为会员国之日起6个月后方可付给。
Translation: Under no circumstances shall the payment of the shares due to the government be made until six months after the government ceases to be a member.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)如上述(b)款应付的购回价款超过上述(c)款(i)项下贷款及担保的债务总额，则其超过部分，银行得在该政府交出股票时随时支付，直至该前会员国收到全部购回价款为止。
Translation: (ii) If the repurchase price payable under paragraph (b) above exceeds the total amount of debt under the loan and guarantee referred to in subparagraph (i) of paragraph (c) above, the Bank may pay the excess at any time upon the surrender of the shares by the government, until the former member has received the full repurchase price.

Query_Text_cn: (iii)付款应用收款国家货币或由银行选择用黄金支付。
Translation: (iii) Payments shall be made in the currency of the receiving country or, at the option of the bank, in gold.

Query_Text_cn: (iv)如银行担保的贷款、参加的贷款、或贷款，在该政府停止为会员国之日尚未偿还而遭受损失，而该项损失的金额超过该政府停止为会员国之日，银行用以备抵损失的准备金数额，且在决定购回价格时已经计及该项损失，则该政府一经银行要求，应即交回按照股份购回价格所应予减少之金额。
Translation: (iv) If losses are incurred on loans guaranteed by the Bank, participated loans, or direct loans that remain outstanding on the date the government ceases to be a member, and the amount of such losses exceeds the reserves set aside by the Bank to cover losses as of that date, and such losses have been taken into account in determining the repurchase price, then upon the Bank's request, the government shall promptly return the amount by which the repurchase price of its shares should be reduced.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，如在决定购回价格时，银行资本已经发生亏损，并已进行催缴时，则该前会员国政府对于按第二条第五节(ii)款下任何催缴未缴股份，仍负有义务，必须补缴。
Translation: Furthermore, if, at the time the repurchase price is determined, the Bank has incurred a loss in its capital and a call for payment has been made, the government of the former member shall remain liable for payment of any unpaid shares subject to call under Article II, Section 5(ii), and must make such payments.

Query_Text_cn: (d)在任何会员国政府停止为会员国后6个月内，如银行按照本条第五节(b)款永远停止营业，则该政府所享有的一切权益应按本条第五节规定办理。
Translation: (d) If the Bank permanently ceases operations pursuant to Section 5(b) of this Article within six months after any member government ceases to be a member, all rights enjoyed by that government shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of Section 5 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节营业的停止及债务的清理(a)在紧急情况时，执行董事得暂时停止新的贷款和担保业务，以待理事会作进一步考虑和采取进一步行动。
Translation:
Section 5 Suspension of Operations and Settlement of Obligations

(a) In emergency situations, the Executive Directors may temporarily suspend new lending and guarantee operations pending further consideration and action by the Board of Governors.

Query_Text_cn: (b)经持有过半数总投票权的多数理事通过，银行得永远停止新的贷款和担保业务。
Translation: (b) With the approval of a majority of the Board of Directors holding more than half of the total voting power, the Bank may permanently cease new lending and guarantee operations.

Query_Text_cn: 在业务中止后，银行应即停止一切活动，但与有秩序地变卖、保存和保管银行资产以及清理债续有关的事项除外。
Translation: After the cessation of business, the bank shall immediately cease all activities, except for matters related to the orderly liquidation, preservation, and custody of the bank's assets, as well as the settlement of outstanding debts.

Query_Text_cn: (c)各会员国对银行总资本未催缴部分所应负的债务、以及因本国货币贬值而发生的债务责任，应持续至银行各债权人的所有债权，包括可能产生的债权全部清偿为止。
Translation: (c)Each member country's liability for the unpaid portion of the Bank's total capital, as well as for obligations arising from the depreciation of its currency, shall continue until all claims of the Bank's creditors, including any contingent claims, have been fully discharged.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条UCP的适用范围《跟单信用证统一惯例--2007年修订本，国际商会第600号出版物》(简称“UCP”)乃一套规则，适用于所有在其文本中明确表明受本惯例约束的跟单信用证(下称信用证)(在其可适用的范围内，包括备用信用证)。
Translation:
Article 1 Scope of Application of the UCP

The "Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits—2007 Revision, ICC Publication No. 600" (hereinafter referred to as "UCP") is a set of rules applicable to all documentary credits (hereinafter referred to as "credits") that expressly indicate in their text that they are subject to these rules (to the extent applicable, including standby letters of credit).

Query_Text_cn: 除非信用证明确修改或排除，本惯例各条文对信用证所有当事人均具有约束力。
Translation: Unless expressly amended or excluded by the credit, the provisions of these rules shall be binding on all parties to the credit.

Query_Text_cn: 通知行指应开证行的要求通知信用证的银行。
Translation: The advising bank notifies the credit to the beneficiary at the request of the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: 申请人指要求开立信用证的一方。
Translation: The applicant refers to the party requesting the issuance of a letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: 银行工作日指银行在其履行受本惯例约束的行为的地点通常开业的一天。
Translation: Banking day refers to a day on which banks are generally open at the location where they are performing actions subject to this practice.

Query_Text_cn: 受益人指接受信用证并享受其利益的一方。
Translation: The beneficiary refers to the party that receives and enjoys the benefits of the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: 相符交单指与信用证条款、本惯例的相关适用条款以及国际标准银行实务一致的交单。
Translation: Complying presentation refers to a presentation that is in accordance with the terms and conditions of the letter of credit, the relevant applicable provisions of these rules, and international standard banking practice.

Query_Text_cn: 保兑指保兑行在开证行承诺之外做出的承付或议付相符交单的确定承诺。
Translation: Confirmation refers to the definite undertaking by the confirming bank, in addition to the issuing bank's commitment, to honor or negotiate compliant documents.

Query_Text_cn: 保兑行指根据开证行的授权或要求对信用证加具保兑的银行。
Translation: The confirming bank refers to the bank that adds its confirmation to a letter of credit at the authorization or request of the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: 信用证指一项不可撤销的安排，无论其名称或描述如何，该项安排构成开证行对相符交单予以承付的确定承诺。
Translation: A letter of credit refers to an irrevocable arrangement, regardless of its name or description, which constitutes a definite undertaking by the issuing bank to honor a complying presentation.

Query_Text_cn: a．如果信用证为即期付款信用证，则即期付款。
Translation: a. If the letter of credit is a sight payment letter of credit, payment shall be made at sight.

Query_Text_cn: b．如果信用证为延期付款信用证，则承诺延期付款并在承诺到期日付款。
Translation: b. If the letter of credit is a deferred payment letter of credit, the commitment to deferred payment shall be made and payment shall be effected on the maturity date of the commitment.

Query_Text_cn: c．如果信用证为承兑信用证，则承兑受益人开出的汇票并在汇票到期日付款。
Translation: c. If the letter of credit is a usance letter of credit, the draft drawn by the beneficiary will be accepted and payment will be made on the maturity date of the draft.

Query_Text_cn: 开证行指应申请人要求或者代表自己开出信用证的银行。
Translation: The issuing bank refers to the bank that issues a letter of credit at the request of the applicant or on its own behalf.

Query_Text_cn: 议付指指定银行在相符交单下，在其应获偿付的银行工作日当天或之前向受益人预付或者同意预付款项，从而购买汇票(其付款人为指定银行以外的其他银行)及／或单据的行为。
Translation: Negotiation refers to the act whereby the nominated bank, under a complying presentation, advances or agrees to advance funds to the beneficiary on or before the banking day on which it is to be reimbursed, thereby purchasing drafts (drawn on a bank other than the nominated bank) and/or documents.

Query_Text_cn: 指定银行指信用证可在其处兑用的银行，如信用证可在任一银行兑用，则任何银行均为指定银行。
Translation: A designated bank refers to the bank at which a letter of credit can be negotiated. If the letter of credit can be negotiated at any bank, then any bank is considered a designated bank.

Query_Text_cn: 交单指向开证行或指定银行提交信用证项下单据的行为，或指按此方式提交的单据。
Translation: Presentation refers to the act of submitting documents under a letter of credit to the issuing bank or a designated bank, or to the documents submitted in this manner.

Query_Text_cn: 交单人指实施交单行为的受益人、银行或其他人。
Translation: The presenter refers to the beneficiary, bank, or any other person who performs the act of presentation.

Query_Text_cn: 如情形适用，单数词形包含复数含义，复数词形包含单数含义。
Translation: Where the context permits, words in the singular include the plural and words in the plural include the singular.

Query_Text_cn: 信用证是不可撤销的，即使未如此表明。
Translation: A letter of credit is irrevocable, even if not expressly stated as such.

Query_Text_cn: 单据签字可用手签、摹样签字、穿孔签字、印戳、符号或任何其他机械或电子的证实方法为之。
Translation: Signatures on documents may be executed by handwritten signature, facsimile signature, perforated signature, seal, symbol, or any other mechanical or electronic means of authentication.

Query_Text_cn: 诸如单据须履行法定手续、签证、证明等类似要求，可由单据上任何看似满足该要求的签字、标记、印戳或标签来满足。
Translation: Requirements such as the need for documents to undergo statutory procedures, endorsements, certifications, or similar formalities may be satisfied by any signature, mark, stamp, or label on the document that appears to fulfill such requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 一家银行在不同国家的分支机构被视为不同的银行。
Translation: A bank's branches in different countries are regarded as separate banks.

Query_Text_cn: 用诸如“第一流的”、“著名的”、“合格的”、“独立的”、“正式的”、“有资格的”或“本地的”等词语描述单据的出单人时，允许除受益人之外的任何人出具该单据。
Translation: When terms such as "first-class," "well-known," "qualified," "independent," "official," "competent," or "local" are used to describe the issuer of a document, the document may be issued by any party other than the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: 除非要求在单据中使用，否则诸如“迅速地”、“立刻地”或“尽快地”等词语将被不予理会。
Translation: Unless required for use in documents, terms such as "promptly," "immediately," or "as soon as possible" will be disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: “在或大概在(onorabout)”或类似用语将被视为规定事件发生在指定日期的前后五个日历日之间，起讫日期计算在内。
Translation: "‘On or about’ or similar terms shall be deemed to mean that the specified event occurs within five calendar days before or after the designated date, inclusive of the start and end dates."

Query_Text_cn: “至(to)”、“直至(until，till)”、“从……开始(from)”及“在……之间(between)”等词用于确定发运日期时包含提及的日期，使用“在……之前(before)”及“在……之后(after)”时则不包含提及的日期。
Translation: The terms "to," "until," "till," "from," and "between," when used to determine the shipment date, include the specified date. However, "before" and "after" do not include the specified date.

Query_Text_cn: “从……开始(from)”及“在……之后(after)”等词用于确定到期日时不包含提及的日期。
Translation: Terms such as "from..." and "after..." used to determine the maturity date do not include the referenced date.

Query_Text_cn: “前半月”及“后半月”分别指一个月的第一日到第十五日及第十六日到该月的最后一日，起讫日期计算在内。
Translation: "The first half of the month" and "the second half of the month" refer to the period from the first day to the fifteenth day of a month, and from the sixteenth day to the last day of the month, respectively, with both the starting and ending dates included in the calculation.

Query_Text_cn: 一个月的“开始(beginning)”、“中间(middle)”及“末尾(end)”分别指第一到第十日、第十一日到第二十日及第二十一日到该月的最后一日，起讫日期计算在内。
Translation: The "beginning," "middle," and "end" of a month refer to the 1st to the 10th, the 11th to the 20th, and the 21st to the last day of the month, respectively, with both the starting and ending dates included.

Query_Text_cn: a．就其性质而言，信用证与可能作为其开立基础的销售合同或其他合同是相互独立的交易，即使信用证中含有对此类合同的任何援引，银行也与该合同无关，且不受其约束。
Translation: a. By its nature, a letter of credit is an independent transaction from the sales contract or any other contract that may serve as its underlying basis. Even if the letter of credit contains any reference to such contracts, banks are not concerned with and are not bound by those contracts.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，银行关于承付、议付或履行信用证项下其他义务的承诺，不受申请人基于其与开证行或与受益人之间的关系而产生的任何请求或抗辩的影响。
Translation: Therefore, the bank's commitment to honor, negotiate, or fulfill other obligations under the letter of credit shall not be affected by any requests or defenses arising from the applicant's relationship with the issuing bank or the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: 受益人在任何情况下不得利用银行之间或申请人与开证行之间的合同关系。
Translation: Under no circumstances shall the beneficiary make use of the contractual relationship between banks or between the applicant and the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: b．开证行应劝阻申请人试图将基础合同、形式发票等文件作为信用证组成部分的做法。
Translation: b. The issuing bank should discourage the applicant from attempting to include documents such as the underlying contract or pro forma invoice as part of the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条单据与货物、服务或履约行为银行处理的是单据，而不是单据可能涉及的货物、服务或履约行为。
Translation: Article 5 Documents vs. Goods, Services or Performance Banks deal with documents and not with goods, services or performance to which the documents may relate.

Query_Text_cn: a．信用证必须规定可在其处兑用的银行，或是否可在任一银行兑用。
Translation: a. The letter of credit must specify the bank at which it is available for negotiation, or whether it is available at any bank.

Query_Text_cn: 规定在指定银行兑用的信用证同时也可以在开证行兑用。
Translation: A letter of credit designated for negotiation at a specified bank may also be negotiated at the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: b．信用证必须规定其是以即期付款、延期付款、承兑还是议付的方式兑用。
Translation: b. The letter of credit must specify whether it is to be utilized by sight payment, deferred payment, acceptance, or negotiation.

Query_Text_cn: c．信用证不得开成凭以申请人为付款人的汇票兑用。
Translation: c. The letter of credit shall not be issued in such a way that drafts drawn with the applicant as the payor are negotiable under it.

Query_Text_cn: d．ⅰ．信用证必须规定一个交单的截止日。
Translation: d. i. The letter of credit must specify a latest date for the presentation of documents.

Query_Text_cn: 规定的承付或议付的截止日将被视为交单的截止日。
Translation: The stipulated deadline for acceptance or negotiation shall be deemed as the latest date for presentation of documents.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．可在其处兑用信用证的银行所在地即为交单地点。
Translation: ii. The place where the bank authorized to negotiate the letter of credit is located shall be deemed as the place of document submission.

Query_Text_cn: 可在任一银行兑用的信用证其交单地点为任一银行所在地。
Translation: The place of presentation for a credit available at any bank is the location of any bank.

Query_Text_cn: 除规定的交单地点外，开证行所在地也是交单地点。
Translation: In addition to the designated place of document submission, the location of the issuing bank is also considered a place of document submission.

Query_Text_cn: e．除非如第二十九条a款规定的情形，否则受益人或者代表受益人的交单应在截止日当天或之前完成。
Translation: e. Unless otherwise provided in Article 29(a), presentation by or on behalf of the beneficiary must be made on or before the expiry date.

Query_Text_cn: ⅴ．信用证规定由指定银行议付但其未议付。
Translation: Ⅴ. The credit stipulates negotiation by the nominated bank, but the nominated bank has not negotiated.

Query_Text_cn: b．开证行自开立信用证之时起即不可撤销地承担承付责任。
Translation: b. From the moment of issuance, the issuing bank irrevocably undertakes the obligation to honor the credit.

Query_Text_cn: c．指定银行承付或议付相符交单并将单据转给开证行之后，开证行即承担偿付该指定银行的责任。
Translation: c. After the designated bank accepts or negotiates compliant documents and forwards them to the issuing bank, the issuing bank assumes the responsibility to reimburse the designated bank.

Query_Text_cn: 对承兑或延期付款信用证下相符交单金额的偿付应在到期日办理，无论指定银行是否在到期日之前预付或购买了单据。
Translation: Payment for a complying presentation under acceptance or deferred payment credits must be made at maturity, regardless of whether the nominated bank has prepaid or purchased the documents before the maturity date.

Query_Text_cn: 开证行偿付指定银行的责任独立于开证行对受益人的责任。
Translation: The issuing bank's obligation to pay the designated bank is independent of its obligation to the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: e)信用证规定由另一指定银行议付，但其未议付。
Translation: e) The letter of credit stipulates negotiation by another designated bank, but such negotiation has not taken place.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．无追索权地议付，如果信用证规定由保兑行议付。
Translation: ⅱ. Negotiation without recourse, if the credit stipulates that negotiation is to be effected by the confirming bank.

Query_Text_cn: b．保兑行自对信用证加具保兑之时起即不可撤销地承担承付或议付的责任。
Translation: b. From the moment the confirming bank adds its confirmation to the letter of credit, it irrevocably undertakes the responsibility to honor or negotiate.

Query_Text_cn: c．其他指定银行承付或议付相符交单并将单据转往保兑行之后，保兑行即承担偿付该指定银行的责任。
Translation: c. Once other designated banks have honored or negotiated compliant documents and forwarded the documents to the confirming bank, the confirming bank shall assume the responsibility to reimburse the designated banks.

Query_Text_cn: 对承兑或延期付款信用证下相符交单金额的偿付应在到期日办理，无论指定银行是否在到期日之前预付或购买了单据。
Translation: Payment for a complying presentation under acceptance or deferred payment credits must be made at maturity, regardless of whether the nominated bank has prepaid or purchased the documents before the maturity date.

Query_Text_cn: 保兑行偿付指定银行的责任独立于保兑行对受益人的责任。
Translation: The obligation of the confirming bank to pay the designated bank is independent of the confirming bank's obligation to the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: d．如果开证行授权或要求一银行对信用证加具保兑，而其并不准备照办，则其必须毫不延误地通知开证行，并可通知此信用证而不加保兑。
Translation: d. If the issuing bank authorizes or requests a bank to add its confirmation to the credit, but the bank is not prepared to do so, it must inform the issuing bank without delay and may advise the credit without adding its confirmation.

Query_Text_cn: a．信用证及其任何修改可以经由通知行通知给受益人。
Translation: a. The letter of credit and any amendments thereto may be notified to the beneficiary through the advising bank.

Query_Text_cn: 非保兑行的通知行通知信用证及修改时不承担承付或议付的责任。
Translation: The advising bank that is not a confirming bank assumes no responsibility for payment or negotiation when notifying the letter of credit or its amendments.

Query_Text_cn: b．通知行通知信用证或修改的行为表示其已确信信用证或修改的表面真实性，而且其通知准确地反映了其收到的信用证或修改的条款。
Translation: b. The act of the advising bank in advising a credit or amendment signifies that it has satisfied itself as to the apparent authenticity of the credit or amendment and that the advice accurately reflects the terms and conditions of the credit or amendment as received.

Query_Text_cn: c．通知行可以通过另一银行(“第二通知行”)向受益人通知信用证及修改。
Translation: c. The advising bank may notify the beneficiary of the credit and its amendments through another bank ("second advising bank").

Query_Text_cn: 第二通知行通知信用证或修改的行为表明其已确信收到的通知的表面真实性，并且其通知准确地反映了收到的信用证或修改的条款。
Translation: The act of the second advising bank notifying the credit or amendment indicates that it is satisfied with the apparent authenticity of the received notification and that its advice accurately reflects the terms of the credit or amendment received.

Query_Text_cn: d．经由通知行或第二通知行通知信用证的银行必须经由同一银行通知其后的任何修改。
Translation: d. The bank that notifies the credit, whether as the advising bank or the second advising bank, must notify any subsequent amendments through the same bank.

Query_Text_cn: e．如一银行被要求通知信用证或修改但其决定不予通知，则应毫不延误地告知自其处收到信用证、修改或通知的银行。
Translation: e. If a bank is requested to advise a credit or amendment but decides not to do so, it must, without delay, inform the bank from which it received the credit, amendment, or advice.

Query_Text_cn: f．如一银行被要求通知信用证或修改但其不能确信信用证、修改或通知的表面真实性，则应毫不延误地通知看似从其处收到指示的银行。
Translation: f. If a bank is requested to advise a credit or amendment but cannot be certain of the apparent authenticity of the credit, amendment, or advice, it must, without delay, inform the bank from which the instructions appear to have been received.

Query_Text_cn: 如果通知行或第二通知行决定仍然通知信用证或修改，则应告知受益人或第二通知行其不能确信信用证、修改或通知的表面真实性。
Translation: If the advising bank or second advising bank decides to continue advising the credit or amendment, it shall inform the beneficiary or second advising bank that it cannot vouch for the apparent authenticity of the credit, amendment, or advice.

Query_Text_cn: a．除第三十八条另有规定者外，未经开证行、保兑行(如有的话)及受益人同意，信用证既不得修改，也不得撤销。
Translation: a. Except as otherwise provided in Article 38, a credit cannot be amended or revoked without the consent of the issuing bank, the confirming bank (if any), and the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: b．开证行自发出修改之时起，即不可撤销地受其约束。
Translation: b. From the moment the issuing bank sends out the amendment, it is irrevocably bound by it.

Query_Text_cn: 保兑行可将其保兑扩展至修改，并自通知该修改之时，即不可撤销地受其约束。
Translation: The confirming bank may extend its confirmation to the amendment, and shall be irrevocably bound by such amendment as of the time it notifies the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，保兑行可以选择将修改通知受益人而不对其加具保兑。__UNDEF__若然如此，其必须毫不延误地将此告知开证行，并在其给受益人的通知中告知受益人。
Translation: However, the confirming bank may choose to advise the amendment to the beneficiary without adding its confirmation. If it does so, it must inform the issuing bank without delay and notify the beneficiary of this fact in its advice to the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: c．在受益人告知通知修改的银行其接受该修改之前，原信用证(或含有先前被接受的修改的信用证)的条款对受益人仍然有效。
Translation: c. Prior to the beneficiary notifying the advising bank of its acceptance of the amendment, the terms of the original credit (or the credit incorporating any previously accepted amendments) shall remain valid for the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: 受益人应提供接受或拒绝修改的通知。
Translation: The beneficiary shall provide a notice of acceptance or rejection of the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 如果受益人未能给予通知，当交单与信用证以及尚未表示接受的修改的要求一致时，即视为受益人已作出接受修改的通知，并且从此时起，该信用证被修改。
Translation: If the beneficiary fails to give notice, when the presentation complies with the credit and the requirements of the amendment that has not yet been accepted, the beneficiary shall be deemed to have given notice of acceptance of the amendment, and from that moment, the credit shall be considered amended.

Query_Text_cn: d．通知修改的银行应将任何接受或拒绝的通知转告发出修改的银行。
Translation: d. The bank requested to amend shall forward any acceptance or rejection notifications to the bank that initiated the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: e．对同一修改的内容不允许部分接受，部分接受将被视为拒绝修改的通知。
Translation: e. Partial acceptance of the same amendment is not permitted; any partial acceptance will be deemed as a notice of rejection of the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: f．修改中关于除非受益人在某一时间内拒绝修改否则修改生效的规定应被不予理会。
Translation: The provision in the amendment stating that the amendment shall take effect unless the beneficiary rejects it within a certain period should be disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: a．以经证实的电讯方式发出的信用证或信用证修改即被视为有效的信用证或修改文据，任何后续的邮寄确认书应被不予理会。
Translation: a. A credit letter or amendment issued by a proven telecommunication method shall be deemed as a valid credit letter or amendment document, and any subsequent mailed confirmation shall be disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: 如电讯声明“详情后告”(或类似用语)或声明以邮寄确认书为有效信用证或修改，则该电讯不被视为有效信用证或修改。
Translation: If a telecommunication statement includes "details to follow" (or similar wording) or states that a mailed confirmation will constitute a valid letter of credit or amendment, such telecommunication shall not be considered a valid letter of credit or amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 开证行必须随即不迟延地开立有效信用证或修改，其条款不得与该电讯矛盾。
Translation: The issuing bank must promptly and without delay issue a valid letter of credit or make amendments, and its terms must not contradict the contents of the telecommunication.

Query_Text_cn: b．开证行只有在准备开立有效信用证或作出有效修改时，才可以发出关于开立或修改信用证的初步通知(预先通知)。
Translation: b. The issuing bank may only send a preliminary notification (pre-advice) regarding the issuance or amendment of a letter of credit when it is prepared to issue a valid letter of credit or make a valid amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 开证行作出该预先通知，即不可撤销地保证不迟延地开立或修改信用证，且其条款不能与预先通知相矛盾。
Translation: The issuing bank, by giving such prior notice, irrevocably undertakes to promptly issue or amend the letter of credit, and its terms shall not contradict the prior notice.

Query_Text_cn: a．除非指定银行为保兑行，对于承付或议付的授权并不赋予指定银行承付或议付的义务，除非该指定银行明确表示同意并且告知受益人。
Translation: a. Unless the nominated bank is the confirming bank, authorization to honor or negotiate does not impose any obligation on the nominated bank to honor or negotiate, unless the nominated bank expressly agrees and informs the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: b．开证行指定一银行承兑汇票或做出延期付款承诺，即为授权该指定银行预付或购买其已承兑的汇票或已做出的延期付款承诺。
Translation: b. When the issuing bank designates a bank to accept a bill of exchange or makes a deferred payment undertaking, it thereby authorizes the designated bank to prepay or purchase the bill it has accepted or the deferred payment undertaking it has made.

Query_Text_cn: c．非保兑行的指定银行收到或审核并转递单据的行为并不使其承担承付或议付的责任，也不构成其承付或议付的行为。
Translation: c. The act of a nominated bank that is not a confirming bank in receiving, examining, and forwarding documents does not make it liable for payment or negotiation, nor does it constitute payment or negotiation by such bank.

Query_Text_cn: a．如果信用证规定指定银行(“索偿行”)向另一方(“偿付行”)获取偿付时，必须同时规定该偿付是否按信用证开立时有效的ICC银行间偿付规则进行。
Translation: a. If the credit requires the nominated bank ("claiming bank") to obtain reimbursement from another party ("reimbursing bank"), it must also specify whether such reimbursement is to be made in accordance with the ICC rules for bank-to-bank reimbursements in effect at the time the credit is issued.

Query_Text_cn: ⅰ．开证行必须给予偿付行有关偿付的授权，授权应符合信用证关于兑用方式的规定，且不应设定截止日。
Translation: The issuing bank must provide the paying bank with authorization for payment, which should comply with the terms of the credit regarding the method of utilization and should not specify an expiry date.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．开证行不应要求索偿行向偿付行提供与信用证条款相符的证明。
Translation: ⅱ. The issuing bank should not require the claiming bank to provide the paying bank with proof that complies with the terms of the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: ⅲ．如果偿付行未按信用证条款见索即偿，开证行将承担利息损失以及产生的任何其他费用。
Translation: iii. If the paying bank fails to make payment upon presentation in accordance with the terms of the letter of credit, the issuing bank shall bear the interest loss and any other expenses incurred.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．偿付行的费用应由开证行承担。
Translation: ⅳ. The expenses of the reimbursing bank shall be borne by the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果此项费用由受益人承担，开证行有责任在信用证及偿付授权中注明。
Translation: However, if this fee is to be borne by the beneficiary, the issuing bank is responsible for specifying it in the letter of credit and the reimbursement authorization.

Query_Text_cn: 如果偿付行的费用由受益人承担，该费用应在偿付时从付给索偿行的金额中扣取。
Translation: If the reimbursement bank's fees are borne by the beneficiary, such fees shall be deducted from the amount paid to the claiming bank at the time of reimbursement.

Query_Text_cn: 如果偿付未发生，偿付行的费用仍由开证行负担。
Translation: If reimbursement does not occur, the expenses of the reimbursing bank shall still be borne by the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: c．如果偿付行未能见索即偿，开证行不能免除偿付责任。
Translation: c. If the reimbursing bank fails to make payment upon request, the issuing bank cannot be relieved of its payment obligation.

Query_Text_cn: a．按指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如果有的话)及开证行须审核交单，并仅基于单据本身确定其是否在表面上构成相符交单。
Translation: a. The nominated bank, confirming bank (if any), and issuing bank must examine the documents presented and determine, on the basis of the documents alone, whether they appear on their face to constitute a complying presentation.

Query_Text_cn: b．按指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)及开证行各有从交单次日起的至多五个银行工作日用以确定交单是否相符。
Translation: b. The designated bank acting as instructed, the confirming bank (if any), and the issuing bank each have up to five banking days from the date of presentation to determine whether the documents comply.

Query_Text_cn: 这一期限不因在交单日当天或之后信用证截止日或最迟交单日届至而受到缩减或影响。
Translation: This period shall not be shortened or affected by the expiry date of the credit or the latest date for presentation, whether such expiry or latest date occurs on or after the date of presentation.

Query_Text_cn: c．如果单据中包含一份或多份受第十九、二十、二十一、二十二、二十三、二十四或二十五条规制的正本运输单据，则须由受益人或其代表在不迟于本惯例所指的发运日之后的二十一个日历日内交单，但是在任何情况下都不得迟于信用证的截止日。
Translation: c. If the documents include one or more original transport documents governed by Articles 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, or 25, the beneficiary or their representative must present the documents no later than twenty-one calendar days after the shipment date as specified in these rules, but in any case, not later than the expiry date of the credit.

Query_Text_cn: d．单据中的数据，在与信用证、单据本身以及国际标准银行实务参照解读时，无须与该单据本身中的数据、其他要求的单据或信用证中的数据等同一致，但不得矛盾。
Translation: d. The data contained in the documents, when interpreted in reference to the letter of credit, the documents themselves, and international standard banking practice, need not be identical to the data in the same document, other required documents, or the letter of credit, but must not be contradictory.

Query_Text_cn: e．除商业发票外，其他单据中的货物、服务或履约行为的描述，如果有的话，可使用与信用证中的描述不矛盾的概括性用语。
Translation: e. Except for the commercial invoice, descriptions of goods, services, or performance in other documents, if any, may use general terms that are not inconsistent with those in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: f．如果信用证要求提交运输单据、保险单据或者商业发票之外的单据，却未规定出单人或其数据内容，则只要提交的单据内容看似满足所要求单据的功能，且其他方面符合第十四条d款，银行将接受该单据。
Translation: f. If the credit requires the presentation of documents other than transport documents, insurance documents, or commercial invoices, but does not specify the issuer or the data content, the bank will accept any document that appears to fulfill the function of the required document and otherwise complies with sub-article 14(d).

Query_Text_cn: g．提交的非信用证所要求的单据将被不予理会，并可被退还给交单人。
Translation: g. Documents submitted that are not required by the letter of credit will be disregarded and may be returned to the presenter.

Query_Text_cn: h．如果信用证含有一项条件，但未规定用以表明该条件得到满足的单据，银行将视为未作规定并不予理会。
Translation: h. If a credit letter contains a condition but does not specify the document required to evidence compliance with that condition, banks will consider it as not stipulated and will disregard it.

Query_Text_cn: i．单据日期可以早于信用证的开立日期，但不得晚于交单日期。
Translation: i. The date of the documents may be earlier than the issuance date of the letter of credit, but must not be later than the date of presentation.

Query_Text_cn: j．当受益人和申请人的地址出现在任何规定的单据中时，无须与信用证或其他规定单据中所载相同，但必须与信用证中规定的相应地址同在一国。
Translation: j. When the addresses of the beneficiary and the applicant appear on any stipulated document, they do not need to be identical to those stated in the credit or in any other stipulated document, but must be in the same country as the respective address specified in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: 联络细节(传真、电话、电子邮件及类似细节)作为受益人和申请人地址的一部分时将被不予理会。
Translation: Contact details (such as fax, telephone, email, and similar information) will be disregarded when included as part of the beneficiary's and applicant's addresses.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果申请人的地址和联络细节为第十九、二十、二十一、二十二、二十三、二十四或二十五条规定的运输单据上的收货人或通知方细节的一部分时，应与信用证规定的相同。
Translation: However, if the applicant's address and contact details form part of the consignee or notify party details on the transport documents as stipulated in Articles 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, or 25, they must be identical to those specified in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: k．在任何单据中注明的托运人或发货人无须为信用证的受益人。
Translation: k. The shipper or consignor indicated on any document does not have to be the beneficiary of the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: l．运输单据可以由任何人出具，无须为承运人、船东、船长或租船人，只要其符合第十九、二十、二十一、二十二、二十三或二十四条的要求。
Translation: l. Transport documents may be issued by any party and do not need to be issued by the carrier, shipowner, master, or charterer, as long as they comply with the requirements of Articles 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, or 24.

Query_Text_cn: a．当开证行确定交单相符时，必须承付。
Translation: a. When the issuing bank determines that the documents presented are in compliance, it must honor the payment.

Query_Text_cn: b．当保兑行确定交单相符时，必须承付或者议付并将单据转递给开证行。
Translation: b. When the confirming bank determines that the documents presented are in compliance, it must honor or negotiate and forward the documents to the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: c．当指定银行确定交单相符并承付或议付时，必须将单据转递给保兑行或开证行。
Translation: c. When the nominated bank determines that the documents are in compliance and has honored or negotiated, it must forward the documents to the confirming bank or the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: a．当按照指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)或者开证行确定交单不符时，可以拒绝承付或议付。
Translation: a. When the nominated bank, confirming bank (if any), or issuing bank determines that the documents presented do not comply, they may refuse to honor or negotiate.

Query_Text_cn: b．当开证行确定交单不符时，可以自行决定联系申请人放弃不符点。
Translation: b. When the issuing bank determines that the documents presented are discrepant, it may, at its own discretion, contact the applicant to waive the discrepancies.

Query_Text_cn: 然而这并不能延长第十四条b款所指的期限。
Translation: However, this does not extend the period referred to in Article 14(b).

Query_Text_cn: c．当按照指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)或开证行决定拒绝承付或议付时，必须给予交单人一份单独的拒付通知。
Translation: c. When the nominated bank, confirming bank (if any), or issuing bank decides to refuse payment or negotiation in accordance with the stipulated instructions, a separate notice of refusal must be given to the presenter.

Query_Text_cn: d)银行将按之前从交单人处获得的指示处理。
Translation: d) The bank will act in accordance with the instructions previously received from the presenter.

Query_Text_cn: d．第十六条c款要求的通知必须以电讯方式，如不可能，则以其他快捷方式，在不迟于自交单之翌日起第五个银行工作日结束前发出。
Translation: d. The notice required under Article 16(c) must be sent by telecommunication; if this is not possible, it should be sent by another expeditious means, no later than the close of the fifth banking day following the day of presentation.

Query_Text_cn: e．按照指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)或开证行在按照第十六条c款ⅲ项a)或b)发出了通知之后，可以在任何时候将单据退还交单人。
Translation: e. The nominated bank, confirming bank (if any), or issuing bank acting on its instructions may, at any time after giving notice pursuant to Article 16(c)(iii)(a) or (b), return the documents to the presenter.

Query_Text_cn: f．如果开证行或保兑行未能按照本条行事，则无权宣称交单不符。
Translation: f. If the issuing bank or confirming bank fails to act in accordance with this article, it shall have no right to claim that the presentation is non-compliant.

Query_Text_cn: g．当开证行拒绝承付或保兑行拒绝承付或者议付，并且按照本条发出了拒付通知后，有权要求返还已偿付的款项及利息。
Translation: g. When the issuing bank refuses to honor payment or the confirming bank refuses to honor or negotiate, and a notice of refusal has been issued in accordance with this article, the bank has the right to demand the return of any amounts already paid, along with interest.

Query_Text_cn: a．信用证规定的每一种单据须至少提交一份正本。
Translation: a. At least one original of each document stipulated in the letter of credit must be submitted.

Query_Text_cn: b．银行应将任何带有看似出单人的原始签名、标记、印戳或标签的单据视为正本单据，除非单据本身表明其非正本。
Translation: b. Banks should regard any document bearing what appears to be an original signature, mark, stamp, or label of the apparent issuer as an original document, unless the document itself indicates that it is not an original.

Query_Text_cn: 或者ⅲ．单据声明其为正本单据，除非该声明看似不适用于提交的单据。
Translation: or (iii) the document states that it is an original, unless such a statement appears not to apply to the document presented.

Query_Text_cn: d．如果信用证要求提交单据的副本，提交正本或副本均可。
Translation: d. If the letter of credit requires the submission of copies of documents, either originals or copies may be presented.

Query_Text_cn: e．如果信用证使用诸如“一式两份(induplicate)”、“两份(intwofold)”、“两套(intwocopras)”等用语要求提交多份单据，则提交至少一份正本，其余使用副本即可满足要求，除非单据本身另有说明。
Translation: e. If the letter of credit requires the submission of multiple copies of documents using terms such as "in duplicate," "in twofold," or "in two copies," the requirement can be satisfied by submitting at least one original and the remaining as copies, unless otherwise specified in the documents themselves.

Query_Text_cn: 且ⅳ．无须签名。
Translation: And (iv) no signature is required.

Query_Text_cn: b．按指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)或开证行可以接受金额大于信用证允许金额的商业发票，其决定对有关各方均有约束力，只要该银行对超过信用证允许金额的部分未作承付或者议付。
Translation: b. The nominated bank acting on instructions, the confirming bank (if any), or the issuing bank may accept commercial invoices for amounts exceeding the credit amount, and their decision shall be binding on all parties concerned, provided that the bank does not honor or negotiate the portion exceeding the amount permitted by the credit.

Query_Text_cn: c．商业发票上的货物、服务或履约行为的描述应该与信用证中的描述一致。
Translation: c. The description of goods, services, or performance on the commercial invoice should be consistent with the description in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: *承运人或其具名代理人，或者*船长或其具名代理人。
Translation: *The carrier or its named agent, or* the master or its named agent.

Query_Text_cn: 承运人、船长或代理人的任何签字，必须标明其承运人、船长或代理人的身份。
Translation: Any signature by the carrier, master, or agent must indicate their capacity as carrier, master, or agent.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人的任何签字必须标明其系代表承运人还是船长签字。
Translation: Any signature by an agent must indicate whether it is made on behalf of the carrier or the master.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．通过以下方式表明货物已经在信用证规定的地点发送、接管或已装运。
Translation: ⅱ. Evidence that the goods have been dispatched, taken in charge, or shipped at the location specified in the letter of credit may be provided in the following ways.

Query_Text_cn: *事先印就的文字；__UNDEF__或者*表明货物已经被发送、接管或装运日期的印戳或批注。
Translation: *Pre-printed text; __UNDEF__ or * indicates a stamp or annotation showing that the goods have been dispatched, taken over, or the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: 运输单据的出具日期将被视为发送、接管或装运的日期，也即发运的日期。
Translation: The issuance date of the transport documents shall be regarded as the date of dispatch, taking over, or shipment, that is, the date of delivery.

Query_Text_cn: 然而如单据以印戳或批注的方式表明了发送、接管或装运日期，该日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: However, if the document indicates the date of dispatch, taking over, or shipment by means of a stamp or notation, that date shall be regarded as the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: b)该运输单据载有“预期的”或类似的关于船只、装货港或卸货港的限定语。
Translation: b) The transport document contains the term "intended" or similar qualifiers regarding the vessel, port of loading, or port of discharge.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．为唯一的正本运输单据，或者，如果出具为多份正本，则为运输单据中表明的全套单据。
Translation: ⅳ. As the sole original transport document, or, if issued in multiple originals, as the full set of documents indicated in the transport document.

Query_Text_cn: ⅴ．载有承运条款和条件，或提示承运条款和条件参见别处(简式／背面空白的运输单据)。
Translation: V. Contains the terms and conditions of carriage, or refers to the terms and conditions of carriage elsewhere (short form/blank back transport document).

Query_Text_cn: 银行将不审核承运条款和条件的内容。
Translation: The bank will not review the contents of the carrier's terms and conditions.

Query_Text_cn: ⅵ．未表明受租船合同约束。
Translation: ⅵ. Not indicated as being subject to the charter party.

Query_Text_cn: b．就本条而言，转运指在从信用证规定的发送、接管或者发运地点至最终目的地的运输过程中从某一运输工具上卸下货物并装上另一运输工具的行为(无论其是否为不同的运输方式)。
Translation: b. For the purposes of this article, transshipment refers to the act of unloading goods from one means of transport and loading them onto another during the course of transportation from the place of dispatch, taking charge, or shipment specified in the credit to the final destination, regardless of whether different modes of transport are involved.

Query_Text_cn: c．ⅰ．运输单据可以表明货物将要或可能被转运，只要全程运输由同一运输单据涵盖。
Translation: c.i. Transport documents may indicate that the goods will or may be transshipped, provided that the entire transportation is covered by the same transport document.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．即使信用证禁止转运，注明将要或者可能发生转运的运输单据仍可接受。
Translation: ii. Even if transshipment is prohibited by the letter of credit, transport documents indicating that transshipment will or may occur are still acceptable.

Query_Text_cn: *预先印就的文字，或者*已装船批注表明货物的装运日期。
Translation: *Pre-printed text or* a shipped-on-board notation indicates the date of shipment of the goods.

Query_Text_cn: 提单的出具日期将被视为发运日期，除非提单载有表明发运日期的已装船批注，此时已装船批注中显示的日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: The date of issuance of the bill of lading shall be regarded as the date of shipment, unless the bill of lading bears an on-board notation indicating the date of shipment, in which case the date shown in the on-board notation shall be regarded as the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: 如果提单载有“预期船只”或类似的关于船名的限定语，则需以已装船批注明确发运日期以及实际船名。
Translation: If the bill of lading contains the term "intended vessel" or similar qualifications regarding the vessel's name, it must bear an on-board notation specifying the actual date of shipment and the name of the vessel used.

Query_Text_cn: ⅲ．表明货物从信用证规定的装货港发运至卸货港。
Translation: iii. Indicate that the goods have been shipped from the port of loading specified in the letter of credit to the port of discharge.

Query_Text_cn: 如果提单没有表明信用证规定的装货港为装货港，或者其载有“预期的”或类似的关于装货港的限定语，则需以已装船批注表明信用证规定的装货港、发运日期以及实际船名。
Translation: If the bill of lading does not indicate the port of loading as stipulated in the letter of credit, or contains terms such as "intended" or similar qualifiers regarding the port of loading, an onboard notation must be added to specify the port of loading required by the letter of credit, the shipment date, and the actual vessel name.

Query_Text_cn: 即使提单以事先印就的文字表明了货物已装载或装运于具名船只，本规定仍适用。
Translation: This provision shall apply even if the bill of lading, by pre-printed wording, indicates that the goods have been loaded on board or shipped on a named vessel.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．为唯一的正本提单，或如果以多份正本出具，为提单中表明的全套正本。
Translation: (iv) For the sole original bill of lading, or, if issued in multiple originals, for the full set of originals as indicated in the bill of lading.

Query_Text_cn: ⅴ．载有承运条款和条件，或提示承运条款和条件参见别处(简式／背面空白的提单)。
Translation: ⅴ. Contains carrier terms and conditions, or refers to carrier terms and conditions elsewhere (short form/blank back bill of lading).

Query_Text_cn: b．就本条而言，转运系指在信用证规定的装货港到卸货港之间的运输过程中，将货物从一船卸下并再装上另一船的行为。
Translation: b. For the purposes of this article, transshipment refers to the act of unloading goods from one vessel and reloading them onto another vessel during the course of transportation between the port of loading and the port of discharge as specified in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: c．ⅰ．提单可以表明货物将要或可能被转运，只要全程运输由同一提单涵盖。
Translation: c.i. The bill of lading may indicate that the goods will or may be transshipped, provided that the entire transportation is covered by the same bill of lading.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ即使信用证禁止转运，注明将要或可能发生转运的提单仍可接受，只要其表明货物由集装箱、拖车或子船运输。
Translation: (ii) Even if transshipment is prohibited by the letter of credit, bills of lading indicating that transshipment will or may occur are still acceptable, provided they show that the goods are carried in containers, trailers, or LASH vessels.

Query_Text_cn: d．提单中声明承运人保留转运权利的条款将被不予理会。
Translation: d. Any clause in the bill of lading stating that the carrier reserves the right of transshipment shall be disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: 不可转让海运单的出具日期将被视为发运日期，除非其上带有已装船批注注明发运日期，此时已装船批注注明的日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: The issuance date of a non-transferable sea waybill shall be regarded as the date of shipment, unless it bears an onboard notation specifying the date of shipment, in which case the date indicated in the onboard notation shall be regarded as the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: 如果不可转让海运单载有“预期船只”或类似的关于船名的限定语，则需要以已装船批注表明发运日期和实际船名。
Translation: If a non-transferable sea waybill contains the term "intended vessel" or similar qualifications regarding the vessel's name, an onboard notation indicating the date of shipment and the actual vessel name is required.

Query_Text_cn: 如果不可转让海运单未以信用证规定的装货港为装货港，或者如果其载有“预期的”或类似的关于装货港的限定语，则需要以已装船批注表明信用证规定的装货港、发运日期和船名。
Translation: If a non-transferable sea waybill does not indicate the port of loading as stipulated in the letter of credit, or if it contains the term "intended" or similar qualifying language regarding the port of loading, an onboard notation stating the port of loading as specified in the letter of credit, the date of shipment, and the name of the vessel is required.

Query_Text_cn: 即使不可转让海运单以预先印就的文字表明货物已由具名船只装载或装运，本规定也适用。
Translation: This provision shall also apply even if a non-negotiable sea waybill, by means of pre-printed wording, indicates that the goods have been loaded on board or shipped by the named vessel.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．为唯一的正本不可转让海运单，或如果以多份正本出具，为海运单上注明的全套正本。
Translation: (iv) As the sole original non-transferable sea waybill, or, if issued in multiple originals, as the full set of originals as indicated on the sea waybill.

Query_Text_cn: ⅴ．载有承运条款和条件，或提示承运条款和条件参见别处(简式／背面空白的海运单)。
Translation: V. Contains carrier terms and conditions, or refers to carrier terms and conditions elsewhere (short form/blank back sea waybill).

Query_Text_cn: c．ⅰ．不可转让海运单可以注明货物将要或可能被转运，只要全程运输由同一海运单涵盖。
Translation: c.i. A non-transferable sea waybill may indicate that the goods will or may be transshipped, provided that the entire carriage is covered by the same sea waybill.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．即使信用证禁止转运，注明转运将要或可能发生的不可转让的海运单仍可接受，只要其表明货物装于集装箱、拖船或子船中运输。
Translation: ⅱ. Even if transshipment is prohibited by the credit, non-negotiable sea waybills indicating that transshipment will or may occur are still acceptable, provided they show that the goods are transported in containers, barges, or lighter vessels.

Query_Text_cn: d．不可转让的海运单中声明承运人保留转运权利的条款将被不予理会。
Translation: d. Any clause in a non-negotiable sea waybill stating that the carrier reserves the right of transshipment will be disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: *船长或其具名代理人，或*船东或其具名代理人，或*租船人或其具名代理人。
Translation: *The Master or their duly authorized agent, or *the Owner or their duly authorized agent, or *the Charterer or their duly authorized agent.

Query_Text_cn: 船长、船东、租船人或代理人的任何签字必须标明其船长、船东、租船人或代理人的身份。
Translation: Any signature by the master, owner, charterer, or agent must indicate their respective capacity as master, owner, charterer, or agent.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人签字必须表明其系代表船长、船东还是租船人签字。
Translation: The agent's signature must indicate whether they are signing on behalf of the master, the shipowner, or the charterer.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人代表船东或租船人签字时必须注明船东或租船人的名称。
Translation: When an agent signs on behalf of the shipowner or charterer, the name of the shipowner or charterer must be clearly indicated.

Query_Text_cn: 租船合同提单的出具日期将被视为发运日期，除非租船合同提单载有已装船批注注明发运日期，此时已装船批注上注明的日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: The date of issuance of the charter party bill of lading shall be regarded as the date of shipment, unless the charter party bill of lading bears an on-board notation indicating the date of shipment, in which case the date indicated in the on-board notation shall be regarded as the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: 卸货港也可显示为信用证规定的港口范围或地理区域。
Translation: The port of discharge may also be indicated as a range of ports or a geographical area as specified in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．为唯一的正本租船合同提单，或如以多份正本出具，为租船合同提单注明的全套正本。
Translation: ⅳ. The sole original charter party bill of lading, or, if issued in multiple originals, the full set of originals marked as charter party bills of lading.

Query_Text_cn: b．银行将不审核租船合同，即使信用证要求提交租船合同。
Translation: b. The bank will not examine the charter party, even if the letter of credit requires the presentation of a charter party.

Query_Text_cn: *承运人，或*承运人的具名代理人。
Translation: *Carrier, or *Carrier's named agent.

Query_Text_cn: 承运人或其代理人的任何签字必须标明其承运人或代理人的身份。
Translation: Any signature by the carrier or its agent must indicate the identity of the carrier or agent.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人签字必须表明其系代表承运人签字。
Translation: The agent's signature must indicate that it is signed on behalf of the carrier.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．表明货物已被收妥待运。
Translation: ii. Indicates that the goods have been received and are awaiting shipment.

Query_Text_cn: ⅲ．表明出具日期。
Translation: iii. Indicate the date of issuance.

Query_Text_cn: 该日期将被视为发运日期，除非空运单据载有专门批注注明实际发运日期，此时批注中的日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: This date shall be regarded as the date of shipment unless the air transport documents bear a specific notation indicating the actual date of shipment, in which case the date stated in the notation shall be regarded as the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: 空运单据中其他与航班号和航班日期相关的信息将不被用来确定发运日期。
Translation: Other information related to the flight number and flight date in the air transport documents will not be used to determine the shipment date.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．表明信用证规定的起飞机场和目的地机场。
Translation: ⅳ. Specify the airport of departure and the airport of destination as stipulated in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: ⅴ．为开给发货人或托运人的正本，即使信用证规定提交全套正本。
Translation: ⅴ. Issued to the shipper or consignor as originals, even if the letter of credit requires submission of a full set of originals.

Query_Text_cn: ⅵ．载有承运条款和条件，或提示条款和条件参见别处。
Translation: ⅵ. Contains the carrier's terms and conditions, or refers to terms and conditions available elsewhere.

Query_Text_cn: b．就本条而言，转运是指在信用证规定的起飞机场到目的地机场的运输过程中，将货物从一飞机卸下再装上另一飞机的行为。
Translation: b. For the purposes of this article, transshipment refers to the act of unloading goods from one aircraft and loading them onto another during the transportation from the airport of departure to the airport of destination as specified in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: c．ⅰ．空运单据可以注明货物将要或可能转运，只要全程运输由同一空运单据涵盖。
Translation: c.i. Air transport documents may indicate that the goods will be or may be transshipped, provided that the entire carriage is covered by the same air transport document.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．即使信用证禁止转运，注明将要或可能发生转运的空运单据仍可接受。
Translation: ⅱ. Even if transshipment is prohibited by the letter of credit, air transport documents indicating that transshipment will or may occur are still acceptable.

Query_Text_cn: ⅰ．表明承运人名称，并且*由承运人或其具名代理人签署，或者*由承运人或其具名代理人以签字、印戳或批注表明货物收讫。
Translation: (i) Indicate the name of the carrier and be signed by the carrier or its named agent, or indicate receipt of the goods by the carrier or its named agent by means of signature, stamp, or annotation.

Query_Text_cn: 承运人或其具名代理人的收货签字、印戳或批注必须标明其承运人或代理人的身份。
Translation: The carrier or its named agent's signature, stamp, or notation upon receipt must clearly indicate their identity as the carrier or agent.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人的收货签字、印戳或批注必须标明代理人系代表承运人签字或行事。
Translation: The agent's receipt signature, stamp, or endorsement must clearly indicate that the agent is signing or acting on behalf of the carrier.

Query_Text_cn: 如果铁路运输单据没有指明承运人，可以接受铁路运输公司的任何签字或印戳作为承运人签署单据的证据。
Translation: If the railway transport document does not specify the carrier, any signature or stamp from the railway transport company may be accepted as evidence of the carrier's endorsement of the document.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．表明货物在信用证规定地点的发运日期，或者收讫待运或待发送的日期。
Translation: ii. Indicate the date of shipment of the goods at the location specified in the letter of credit, or the date of receipt for dispatch or forwarding.

Query_Text_cn: 运输单据的出具日期将被视为发运日期，除非运输单据上盖有带日期的收货印戳，或注明了收货日期或发运日期。
Translation: The issuance date of the transport document shall be deemed as the shipment date, unless the transport document bears a dated receipt stamp or specifies the date of receipt or shipment.

Query_Text_cn: ⅲ．表明信用证规定的发运地及目的地。
Translation: iii. Indicate the shipment origin and destination as specified in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: b．ⅰ．公路运输单据必须看似为开给发货人或托运人的正本，或没有任何标记表明单据开给何人。
Translation: b.i. The road transport document must appear to be issued to the shipper or consignor as an original, or bear no indication as to whom it is issued.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．注明“第二联”的铁路运输单据将被作为正本接受。
Translation: ⅱ. Railway transport documents marked as "Second Copy" will be accepted as originals.

Query_Text_cn: ⅲ．无论是否注明正本字样，铁路或内陆水运单据都被作为正本接受。
Translation: iii. Whether or not marked as an original, railway or inland waterway documents are accepted as originals.

Query_Text_cn: c．如运输单据上未注明出具的正本数量，提交的份数即视为全套正本。
Translation: c. If the number of originals issued is not specified on the transport document, the number of copies submitted shall be deemed to constitute a full set of originals.

Query_Text_cn: d．就本条而言，转运是指在信用证规定的发运、发送或运送的地点到目的地之间的运输过程中，在同一运输方式中从一运输工具卸下再装上另一运输工具的行为。
Translation: d. For the purposes of this article, transshipment refers to the act of unloading goods from one means of transport and reloading them onto another means of transport within the same mode of transportation during the journey from the place of dispatch, shipment, or sending specified in the credit to the destination.

Query_Text_cn: e．ⅰ．只要全程运输由同一运输单据涵盖，公路、铁路或内陆水运单据可以注明货物将要或可能被转运。
Translation: e.i. As long as the entire transportation is covered by the same transport document, road, rail, or inland waterway transport documents may indicate that the goods will or may be transshipped.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．即使信用证禁止转运，注明将要或可能发生转运的公路、铁路或内陆水运单据仍可接受。
Translation: ⅱ. Even if transshipment is prohibited by the credit, road, rail, or inland waterway transport documents indicating that transshipment will or may occur are still acceptable.

Query_Text_cn: 并且ⅱ．表明取件或收件的日期或类似词语。
Translation: and (ii) indicate the date of collection or receipt, or similar terms.

Query_Text_cn: 该日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: This date shall be regarded as the shipment date.

Query_Text_cn: b．如果要求显示快递费用付讫或预付，快递机构出具的表明快递费由收货人以外的一方支付的运输单据可以满足该项要求。
Translation: b. If it is required to indicate that the courier charges have been paid or prepaid, a transport document issued by the courier company showing that the charges are to be paid by a party other than the consignee will satisfy this requirement.

Query_Text_cn: c．证明货物收讫待运的邮政收据或投邮证明，无论名称如何，必须看似在信用证规定的货物发运地点盖章或签署并注明日期。
Translation: c. Proof of posting receipts for goods received for dispatch or certificates of posting, regardless of their title, must appear to be stamped or signed and dated at the place of dispatch of the goods as specified in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: a．运输单据不得表明货物装于或者将装于舱面。
Translation: a. The transport documents must not indicate that the goods are or will be loaded on deck.

Query_Text_cn: 声明货物可能被装于舱面的运输单据条款可以接受。
Translation: Clauses in the transport document stating that the goods may be carried on deck are acceptable.

Query_Text_cn: b．载有诸如“托运人装载和计数”或“内容据托运人报称”条款的运输单据可以接受。
Translation: b. Transport documents containing clauses such as "Shipper's Load and Count" or "Contents as Declared by Shipper" are acceptable.

Query_Text_cn: c．运输单据上可以以印戳或其他方式提及运费之外的费用。
Translation: c. Charges other than freight may be indicated on the transport document by means of a stamp or other methods.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条清洁运输单据银行只接受清洁运输单据。
Translation:
Article 27 Clean Transport Documents

The bank will only accept clean transport documents.

Query_Text_cn: 清洁运输单据指未载有明确宣称货物或包装有缺陷的条款或批注的运输单据。
Translation: A clean transport document refers to a transport document that does not contain any clauses or notations explicitly declaring that the goods or packaging are defective.

Query_Text_cn: “清洁”一词并不需要在运输单据上出现，即使信用证要求运输单据为“清洁已装船”的。
Translation: The term "clean" does not need to appear on the transport documents, even if the letter of credit requires the transport documents to be "clean on board."

Query_Text_cn: a．保险单据，例如保险单或预约保险项下的保险证明书或者声明书，必须看似由保险公司或承保人或其代理人或代表出具并签署。
Translation: a. Insurance documents, such as insurance policies or certificates or declarations issued under cover notes, must appear to be issued and signed by the insurance company, insurer, or their agent or representative.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人或代表的签字必须表明其系代表保险公司或承保人签字。
Translation: The signature of the agent or representative must indicate that they are signing on behalf of the insurance company or the underwriter.

Query_Text_cn: b．如果保险单据表明其以多份正本出具，所有正本均须提交。
Translation: b. If the insurance documents indicate that they are issued in multiple originals, all originals must be submitted.

Query_Text_cn: c．暂保单将不被接受。
Translation: c. Temporary cover notes will not be accepted.

Query_Text_cn: d．可以接受保险单代替预约保险项下的保险证明书或声明书。
Translation: d. Insurance policies may be accepted in lieu of certificates or declarations of insurance under the insurance to be arranged.

Query_Text_cn: e．保险单据日期不得晚于发运日期，除非保险单据表明保险责任不迟于发运日生效。
Translation: e. The date of the insurance document must not be later than the date of shipment, unless the insurance document indicates that the insurance coverage takes effect no later than the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: f．ⅰ．保险单据必须表明投保金额并以与信用证相同的货币表示。
Translation: f.i. The insurance documents must indicate the insured amount and be denominated in the same currency as the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．信用证对于投保金额为货物价值、发票金额或类似金额的某一比例的要求，将被视为对最低保额的要求。
Translation: ⅱ. A requirement in the letter of credit for the insured amount to be a certain percentage of the value of the goods, invoice amount, or similar amount shall be deemed to be a requirement for a minimum insured amount.

Query_Text_cn: 如果信用证对投保金额未做规定，投保金额须至少为货物的CIF或CIP价格的百分之一百一十。
Translation: If the letter of credit does not specify the amount of insurance, the amount insured must be at least 110% of the CIF or CIP value of the goods.

Query_Text_cn: 如果从单据中不能确定CIF或者CIP价格，投保金额必须基于要求承付或议付的金额，或者基于发票上显示的货物总值来计算，两者之中取金额较高者。
Translation: If the CIF or CIP price cannot be determined from the documents, the insured amount must be calculated based on the amount required for payment or negotiation, or the total value of the goods shown on the invoice, whichever is higher.

Query_Text_cn: ⅲ．保险单据须表明承保的风险区间至少涵盖从信用证规定的货物接管地或发运地开始到卸货地或最终目的地为止。
Translation: iii. The insurance documents must indicate that the insured risk period covers at least from the place of taking charge or shipment specified in the letter of credit to the place of unloading or final destination.

Query_Text_cn: g．信用证应规定所需投保的险别及附加险(如有的话)。
Translation: g. The letter of credit should specify the required types of insurance coverage and any additional insurance (if applicable).

Query_Text_cn: 如果信用证使用诸如“通常风险”或“惯常风险”等含义不确切的用语，则无论是否有漏保之风险。__UNDEF__保险单据将被照样接受。
Translation: If the credit uses vague terms such as "usual risks" or "customary risks," the insurance document will be accepted as presented, regardless of whether there is any risk of under-insurance.

Query_Text_cn: h．当信用证规定投保“一切险”时，如保险单据载有任何“一切险”批注或条款，无论是否有“一切险”标题，均将被接受，即使其声明任何风险除外。
Translation: h. When the credit requires coverage for "All Risks," any insurance document containing any "All Risks" notation or clause, whether or not it bears an "All Risks" heading, will be accepted, even if it states that certain risks are excluded.

Query_Text_cn: i．保险单据可以援引任何除外条款。
Translation: Insurance documents may invoke any exclusion clauses.

Query_Text_cn: j．保险单据可以注明受免赔率或免赔额(减除额)约束。
Translation: j. Insurance policies may specify the application of deductibles or excess clauses.

Query_Text_cn: a．如果信用证的截止日或最迟交单日适逢接受交单的银行非因第三十六条所述原因而歇业，则截止日或最迟交单日，视何者适用，将顺延至其重新开业的第一个银行工作日。
Translation: a. If the expiry date of the letter of credit or the latest date for presentation falls on a day when the bank authorized to receive the documents is closed for reasons other than those specified in Article 36, the expiry date or the latest date for presentation, as applicable, shall be extended to the first banking day on which such bank reopens.

Query_Text_cn: b．如果在顺延后的第一个银行工作日交单，指定银行必须在其致开证行或保兑行的面函中声明交单是在根据第二十九条a款顺延的期限内提交的。
Translation: b. If the presentation is made on the first banking day following the extension, the nominated bank must state in its covering letter to the issuing bank or confirming bank that the documents were presented within the extended period in accordance with sub-article 29(a).

Query_Text_cn: c．最迟发运日不因第二十九条a款规定的原因而顺延。
Translation: c. The latest shipment date shall not be extended due to the reasons stipulated in Article 29(a).

Query_Text_cn: （1）本国际商会第522号出版物《托收统一规则》1995年修订本，应适用于第二条界定的、并在第四条"托收指示”中列明适用该项规则的所有托收项目，且除非另有明确的相反约定，或与无法规避的某一国家、政府或地方法律及/或法规相抵触，本规则对所有的当事人均具有约束力。
Translation: (1) The Uniform Rules for Collections, ICC Publication No. 522, 1995 Revision, shall apply to all collections as defined in Article 2 and as specified in the collection instructions under Article 4, provided that these rules are stated to be applicable. Unless otherwise expressly agreed or where they conflict with the mandatory laws and/or regulations of any country, government, or locality, these rules shall be binding on all parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: （2）银行没有义务必须办理某一托收或任何托收指示或以后的相关指示。
Translation: (2) The bank is not obligated to process any particular collection,

Query_Text_cn: （3）如果银行无论出于何种理由选择不办理它所收到的托收或任何相关的托收指示，应毫不延误地采用电讯，或者如果电讯不可能时，采用其它快捷的工具，通知向其发出托收或指示的当事人。
Translation: (3) If a bank, for any reason, chooses not to process a collection or any related collection instruction it has received, it shall, without delay, notify the party from whom it received the collection or instruction by telecommunication, or, if telecommunication is not possible, by any other expeditious means.

Query_Text_cn: 或c.按照其他条款和条件交付单据。
Translation: or c. deliver the documents in accordance with other terms and conditions.

Query_Text_cn: （2）单据是指金融单据及/或商业单据。
Translation: (2) Documents refer to financial documents and/or commercial documents.

Query_Text_cn: b.商业单据是指发票、运输单据、所有权单据或其他类似的单据，或者不属于金融单据的任何其他单据。
Translation: b. Commercial documents refer to invoices, transport documents, documents of title, or other similar documents, or any other documents that are not financial documents.

Query_Text_cn: （3）光票托收是指不附有商业单据的金融单据项下的托收。
Translation: (3) Clean collection refers to the collection of financial documents not accompanied by commercial documents.

Query_Text_cn: b.不附有金融单据的商业单据项下的托收。
Translation: b. Collections under commercial documents not accompanied by financial documents.

Query_Text_cn: d.提示行，即向付款人提示单据的代收行。
Translation: d. Presenting bank, which presents the documents to the payer as the collecting bank.

Query_Text_cn: （2）付款人，即根据托收指示向其提示单据的人。
Translation: (2) The payer, that is, the person to whom the documents are presented in accordance with the collection instructions.

Query_Text_cn: （1）a.所有送往托收的单据必须附有一项托收指示，注明该项托收将遵循《托收统一规则》第522号出版物，并列出完整和明确的指示。
Translation: a. All documents sent for collection must be accompanied by a collection instruction indicating that the collection will be subject to the Uniform Rules for Collections, Publication No. 522, and providing complete and precise instructions.

Query_Text_cn: c.除非托收指示中另有授权，银行将不理会向其发出托收的任何当事人/银行以外的任何当事人/银行的任何指示。
Translation: c. Unless otherwise authorized in the collection instructions, banks will disregard any instructions issued to them by any party/bank other than the party/bank presenting the collection.

Query_Text_cn: k.发生拒绝付款、拒绝承兑及/或与其他指示不相符的情况时应给出的指示。
Translation: k. Instructions to be provided in the event of non-payment, non-acceptance, and/or discrepancies with other instructions.

Query_Text_cn: （3）a.托收指示应载明付款人或将要办理提示的场所之完整地址。如果地址不全或有错误，代收银行可尽力查明适当的地址，但其本身不承担任何义务和责任。
Translation: (3) a. Collection instructions must specify the complete address of the payer or the location where presentation will be made. If the address is incomplete or incorrect, the collecting bank may make reasonable efforts to ascertain the correct address, but it assumes no obligation or liability in this regard.

Query_Text_cn: b.代收银行对因所提供地址不全或有误所造成的任何延误，将不承担任何责任。
Translation: b. The collecting bank shall not be held liable for any delays caused by incomplete or incorrect addresses provided.

Query_Text_cn: 提示（1）就本规则各项条款而言，提示是指银行按照指示将单据提供给付款人的程序。
Translation: For the purposes of these rules, "presentation" refers to the procedure by which the bank, in accordance with instructions, provides documents to the payer.

Query_Text_cn: （2）托收指示应列明付款人将要采取行动的确切期限。诸如"首先、迅速、立即”和类似的表述，不应用于指提示、或付款人赎单或采取任何其他行动的任何期限。如果采用了该类术语，银行将不予理会。
Translation: (2) The collection instructions should specify the exact time frame within which the drawee is to take action. Expressions such as "first," "prompt," "immediately," and similar terms should not be used to indicate any period for presentation, payment, release of documents to the drawee, or for any other action to be taken by the drawee. If such terms are used, banks will disregard them.

Query_Text_cn: （3）单据必须以银行收到时的形式向付款人提示，但经授权银行可以贴附任何必需的印章，并按照说明由向银行发出托收的当事人承担费用，而且银行可以经授权采取任何必要的背书或加盖橡皮戳记、或其他托收业务惯用的和必要的辨认记号或符号。
Translation: (3) Documents must be presented to the payer in the form in which they are received by the bank, but the authorized bank may affix any necessary stamps and, as instructed, the party sending the collection to the bank shall bear the costs. Furthermore, the bank may, if authorized, make any necessary endorsements or affix rubber stamps or other customary and necessary identification marks or symbols used in collection operations.

Query_Text_cn: （4）为了使委托人的指示得以实现，托收行将以委托人所指定的银行作为代收行。在未指定代收行时，托收行将使用自己的任何银行，或者在付款或承兑的国家中、或必须遵守其他条件的国家中选择另外的银行。
