Translation: Done at Rio de Janeiro on May 14, 1966, in a single original in English, French, and Spanish, each text being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条本公约给予之保护将不更动也决不影响文学和艺术作品的版权保护。
Translation: Article 1: The protection granted by this Convention shall neither alter nor affect the copyright protection of literary and artistic works.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，本公约的条款不得作妨碍此种保护的解释。
Translation: Therefore, the provisions of this Convention shall not be interpreted as impeding such protection.

Query_Text_cn: ()其广播节目从设在该国领土上的发射台发射的总部设在该国境内的广播组织的待遇。
Translation: The treatment of broadcasting organizations headquartered within the country whose broadcast programs are transmitted from transmitters located on its territory.

Query_Text_cn: (二)国民待遇应服从本公约具体给予的保护和具体规定的限制。
Translation: (2) National treatment shall be subject to the specific protections and restrictions provided under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (庚)"转播”是指一个广播组织的广播节目被另一个广播组织同时广播。
Translation: "Simulcasting" refers to a situation where a broadcast program of one broadcasting organization is simultaneously broadcast by another broadcasting organization.

Query_Text_cn: ()表演未被录制成录音制品，但在受本公约第六条保护的广播节目中播放。
Translation: The performance has not been fixed in a phonogram but is broadcast in a program protected under Article 6 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: ()录音制品是在另一个缔约国首次发行的(发行标准)。
Translation: The phonogram was first published in another contracting state (publication criterion).

Query_Text_cn: (二)如果某种录音制品是在某一非缔约国首次发行的，但在首次发行后三十天内也在某一缔约国发行(同时发行)，则该录音制品应当认为是在该缔约国首次发行。
Translation: (2) If a sound recording is first published in a non-contracting country, but is also published in a contracting country within thirty days of its initial publication (simultaneous publication), the sound recording shall be deemed to have been first published in that contracting country.

Query_Text_cn: (三)任何缔约国，通过向联合国秘书长递交通知书的办法，可以声明它将不执行发行标准，或者不执行录制标准。
Translation: (3) Any Contracting State may, by notifying the Secretary-General of the United Nations, declare that it will not apply the standards for publication or the standards for recording.

Query_Text_cn: 此类通知书可以在批准、接受或参加本公约的时候递交，也可以在此后任何时间递交。
Translation: Such notifications may be submitted at the time of approval, acceptance, or accession to this Convention, or at any time thereafter.

Query_Text_cn: 在后一种情况下，通知书应当于递交六个月之后生效。
Translation: In the latter case, the notice shall take effect six months after it has been submitted.

Query_Text_cn: ()广播节目是由设在另一缔约国的发射台播放的。
Translation: The broadcasting program is transmitted by a station located in the other contracting state.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何缔约国，通过向联合国秘书长递交通知书的办法，可以声明它只保护其总部设在另一个缔约国并从设在该同一缔约国的发射台播放的广播组织的广播节目。
Translation: (2) Any Contracting State may declare, by submitting a notification to the Secretary-General of the United Nations, that it will protect only the broadcast programs of broadcasting organizations whose headquarters are located in another Contracting State and whose broadcasts are transmitted from a transmitter situated in that same Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: ()未经他们同意，广播和向公众传播他们的表演。
Translation: Broadcasting and communicating their performances to the public without their consent.

Query_Text_cn: (3)如果录音、录像的原版是根据第十五条的规定录制的，而制作复制品的目的与此条规定的目的不同。
Translation: (3) If the original audio or video recording was made in accordance with the provisions of Article 15, but the purpose of producing copies differs from the purpose stipulated in this article.

Query_Text_cn: (二)(1)如果广播是经演员同意的，则防止转播，防止为广播目的的录音、录像，以及防止为广播目的的此类录音、录像的复制，应当由要求其保护的缔约国的国内法律规定。
Translation: (2)(1) If the broadcast is made with the consent of the performers, the prevention of rebroadcasting, the prevention of sound or visual recordings made for the purpose of broadcasting, as well as the prevention of reproduction of such recordings made for the purpose of broadcasting, shall be governed by the domestic laws of the Contracting Party requesting such protection.

Query_Text_cn: (2)广播组织使用为广播目的而制作的录音录像的期限和条件，应当根据要求其保护的缔约的国内法律确定。
Translation: The duration and conditions for broadcasting organizations to use audio and video recordings produced for broadcasting purposes shall be determined in accordance with the domestic laws of the contracting party requesting such protection.

Query_Text_cn: (3)但是，本款第(1)和(2)小款中提到的国内法律不得用来使表演者失去通过合同控制他们与广播组织之间的关系的能力。
Translation: (3) However, the domestic laws referred to in paragraphs (1) and (2) of this Article shall not be used to deprive performers of the ability to control their relationship with broadcasting organizations through contracts.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条如果若干表演者参加同一项表演，任何缔约国均可根据本国法律和规章，明确指出表演者在行使权利方面确定代表的方式。
Translation: Article 8 If several performers participate in the same performance, any Contracting Party may, in accordance with its own laws and regulations, specify the manner in which a representative is designated for the exercise of rights by the performers.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条任何缔约国均可根据国内法律和规章，将本公约提供的保护扩大到不是表演文学或艺术作品的艺人。
Translation: Article 9: Any Contracting State may, in accordance with its domestic laws and regulations, extend the protection provided by this Convention to performers who do not perform literary or artistic works.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条录音制品制作者应当有权授权或禁止直接或间接复制他们的录音制品。
Translation: Article 10 Producers of sound recordings shall have the right to authorize or prohibit the direct or indirect reproduction of their sound recordings.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，如果复制品或其包装物上没有注明主要表演者，则标记还应当包括在制作这些录音的国家内拥有此种表演者权利的人的姓名。
Translation: In addition, if the principal performer is not indicated on the copy or its packaging, the marking shall also include the name of the person who, within the country where these recordings are produced, holds the rights of such a performer.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条如果某种为商业目的发行的录音制品或此类唱片的复制品直接用于广播或任何向公众的传播，使用者则应当付一笔总的合理的报酬给表演者，或录音制品制作者，或给二者。
Translation: Article 12: If a sound recording or a copy thereof, issued for commercial purposes, is used directly for broadcasting or any other communication to the public, the user shall pay a single reasonable remuneration to the performers, the producer of the sound recording, or both.

Query_Text_cn: 如有关各方之间没有协议，国内法律可以提出分享这些报酬的条件。
Translation: If there is no agreement among the relevant parties, domestic law may stipulate the conditions for sharing these proceeds.

Query_Text_cn: (2)根据第十五条的规定而制作他们的广播节目的录音和录像，但复制的目的不符合该条规定的目的。
Translation: (2)To make sound and video recordings of their broadcasts in accordance with the provisions of Article 15, but the purpose of reproduction does not comply with the purposes stipulated in that Article.

Query_Text_cn: (丁)向公众传播电视节目，如果此类传播是在收门票的公共场所进行的。
Translation: (d) Broadcasting television programs to the public, if such broadcasting takes place in public venues where admission is charged.

Query_Text_cn: 行使这种权利的条件由被要求保护的缔约国的国内法律确定。
Translation: The conditions for exercising this right shall be determined by the domestic laws of the Contracting Party whose protection is sought.

Query_Text_cn: ()对广播节目——开始广播的年份的年底。
Translation: () refers to the end of the year in which the radio program began broadcasting.

Query_Text_cn: (丁)仅用于教学和科学研究之目的。
Translation: (d) Solely for the purposes of teaching and scientific research.

Query_Text_cn: (二)尽管有本条第一款，任何缔约国对于表演者、录音制品制作者和广播组织的保护，可以在其国内法律与规章中做出像它在国内法律和规章中做出的对文学和艺术作品的版权保护的同样的限制。
Translation: (2) Notwithstanding paragraph 1 of this Article, any Contracting Party may impose, in its domestic laws and regulations, the same limitations on the protection of performers, producers of phonograms, and broadcasting organizations as it imposes on copyright protection for literary and artistic works in its domestic laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，只有在不违背本公约的范围内才能颁发强迫许可证。
Translation: However, compulsory licenses may only be granted within the scope permitted by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条(一)任何国家一旦成为本公约的成员，就应当履行本公约的所有义务，同时享受本公约的所有权益。
Translation: Article 16(1) Once a country becomes a party to this Convention, it shall fulfill all obligations under the Convention and enjoy all rights conferred by the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，录音制品制作者为其国民的缔约国，对同一个或同一伙受益人不像发表声明的国家那样给予保护的事实，不能认为是保护范围的不同。
Translation: However, the fact that the country of the producer of sound recordings, as a contracting party for its nationals, does not provide the same protection to the same person or group of beneficiaries as the country making the declaration, cannot be regarded as a difference in the scope of protection.

Query_Text_cn: 如果某个缔约国发表此种声明，其他缔约国对其总部设在上述缔约国的广播组织则没有义务给予第十三条(丁)款提到的权利。
Translation: If a Contracting State makes such a declaration, the other Contracting States shall not be obliged to grant the rights referred to in Article 13(d) to broadcasting organizations whose headquarters are located in that State.

Query_Text_cn: (二)如果本条第一款提到的通知书是在批准、接受或参加证书递交之日以后发布。
Translation: (2) If the notice referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article is issued after the date of deposit of the instrument of ratification, acceptance, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条任何在1961年10月26日仅根据录制标准给予录音制品制作者以保护的国家，可以在批准、接受或参加本公约时通过向联合国秘书长递交通知书声明，为了第五条的目的，它仅执行录制标准；为了第十六条第一款()目第(3)和第(4)小节的目的，他将执行录制标准以代替国民标准。
Translation:
Article 17  
Any country which, on October 26, 1961, granted protection to producers of phonograms solely on the basis of the fixation criterion may, at the time of ratification, acceptance, or accession to this Convention, declare by notification addressed to the Secretary-General of the United Nations that, for the purposes of Article 5, it applies only the fixation criterion; and for the purposes of Article 16, paragraph 1, subparagraphs (3) and (4), it will apply the fixation criterion in place of the national treatment criterion.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条任何根据第五条第三款、第六条第二款、第十六条第一款或第十七条递交了通知书的国家，通过向联合国秘书长递交另外一份通知书，可以缩小第一次通知书的范围或撤回该通知书。
Translation: Article 18 Any State which has submitted a notification pursuant to paragraph 3 of Article 5, paragraph 2 of Article 6, paragraph 1 of Article 16, or Article 17 may, by submitting another notification to the Secretary-General of the United Nations, restrict the scope of its initial notification or withdraw it.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条不管本公约有什么规定，一旦表演者同意将其表演录像或录音录像，第七条就不再适用。
Translation: Article 19 Notwithstanding any provisions of this Convention, once a performer has consented to the fixation of his performance in a visual or audiovisual recording, Article 7 shall no longer apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条(一)本公约不得影响任何缔约国当本公约在该国生效之前已经获得的权利。
Translation: Article 20(1) Nothing in this Convention shall affect any rights acquired by any Contracting State prior to the entry into force of this Convention in that State.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何缔约国无须一定将本公约的条款运用于本公约在该国生效之前已经进行的表演和已经广播的节目，以及已经录制的录音制品。
Translation: (2) No Contracting State shall be required to apply the provisions of this Convention to performances, broadcasts, or sound recordings that took place, were broadcast, or were recorded before the Convention entered into force in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条本公约规定的保护不得影响表演者、录音制品制作者和广播组织另外取得的任何保护。
Translation: Article 21 The protection provided under this Convention shall not affect any other protection to which performers, producers of phonograms, and broadcasting organizations may be entitled.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条缔约各国保留互相之间签订特别协定的权利，只要此类协定给予表演者、录音制品制作者和广播组织的权利比本公约给予的权利更广泛，或包含其他不与本公约相反的条款。
Translation: Article 22: The Contracting States reserve the right to enter into special agreements with one another, provided that such agreements grant performers, producers of phonograms, and broadcasting organizations rights that are more extensive than those granted by this Convention, or contain other provisions not contrary to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条本公约应当送交联合国秘书长。凡被邀请参加国际保护表演者、录音制品制作者和广播组织外交会议的任何世界版权公约的成员国或保护文学艺术作品国际联盟的成员国，1962年6月30日前均可在本公约上签字。
Translation: Article 23: This Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations. Any member country of the Universal Copyright Convention or of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works that was invited to participate in the Diplomatic Conference on the International Protection of Performers, Producers of Phonograms, and Broadcasting Organizations may sign this Convention before June 30, 1962.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条(一)本公约须经签字国批准或接受。
Translation: Article 24(1) This Convention shall be subject to ratification or acceptance by the signatory States.

Query_Text_cn: (二)第二十三条提到的被邀请参加会议的任何国家和任何联合国成员国，只要它们参加了世界版权公约或保护文学艺术作品国际联盟，均可参加本公约。
Translation: (b) Any country and any Member State of the United Nations invited to participate in the meeting referred to in Article 23 may become a party to this Convention, provided that they are parties to the Universal Copyright Convention or members of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works.

Query_Text_cn: (三)批准、接受或参加本公约须向联合国秘书长递交有关证书后方能生效。
Translation: (3) Approval, acceptance, or accession to this Convention shall only become effective after the relevant instrument has been deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条(一)本公约应当于第六份批准、接受或参加证书递交三个月之后生效。
Translation: Article 25(1) This Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of the sixth instrument of ratification, acceptance, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: (二)此后，本公约应当于各个有关国家递交批准、接受或参加证书三个月之后在该国生效。
Translation: (2) Thereafter, this Convention shall enter into force in each relevant country three months after the deposit of its instrument of ratification, acceptance, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条(一)各缔约国保证根据本国宪法采取必要措施保障本公约的实施。
Translation: Article 26(1) Each State Party shall ensure, in accordance with its constitution, that the necessary measures are taken to guarantee the implementation of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (二)各国在递交批准、接受或参加证书时，它就必须处于根据其国内法律使本公约所有条款生效的地位。
Translation: (2) When submitting instruments of ratification, acceptance, or accession, each country must be in a position to ensure that all provisions of this Convention are effective under its domestic law.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条(一)任何国家在批准、接受或参加本公约时，或在此后任何时间，可以在致联合国秘书长的通知书中，声明本公约将适用于由它对其国际关系负责的所有或其中任何一个领地，只要世界版权公约或保护文学艺术作品国际公约适用于这个或这些领地。
Translation: Article 27(1) Any State, upon ratifying, accepting, or acceding to this Convention, or at any time thereafter, may declare, by notification addressed to the Secretary-General of the United Nations, that this Convention shall apply to all or any of the territories for whose international relations it is responsible, provided that the Universal Copyright Convention or the International Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works applies to such territory or territories.

Query_Text_cn: 此通知书应当从收到之日起三个月后生效。
Translation: This notice shall take effect three months after the date of receipt.

Query_Text_cn: (二)第五条第三款、第六条第二款、第十六条第二款和第十七、十八条所提到的通知书，可以适用于本条第一款提到的所有或其中任何一个领地。
Translation: (2) The notices referred to in Paragraph 3 of Article 5, Paragraph 2 of Article 6, Paragraph 2 of Article 16, and Articles 17 and 18 may apply to all or any of the territories mentioned in Paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条(一)任何缔约国可以用自己的名义或代表第二十七条中提到的所有或其中任何一个领地，通知退出本公约。
Translation: Article 28(1) Any Contracting State may, in its own name or on behalf of all or any of the territories referred to in Article 27, notify its withdrawal from this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (二)退出本公约必须通过向联合国秘书长递交通知书方能生效，而且应当于通知书收到之日后十二个月生效。
Translation: (b) Withdrawal from this Convention shall only become effective upon the submission of a notification to the Secretary-General of the United Nations, and shall take effect twelve months after the date on which the notification is received.

Query_Text_cn: (三)本公约在某缔约国生效未满五年，该缔约国不得行使通知退出的权利。
Translation: (3) A Contracting State may not exercise the right to notify its withdrawal from this Convention if the Convention has been in force in that State for less than five years.

Query_Text_cn: (四)当某缔约国既不是世界版权公约的成员也不是保护文学艺术作品国际联盟的成员时，它就不再是本公约的成员。
Translation: (4) When a Contracting State is neither a member of the Universal Copyright Convention nor a member of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works, it shall cease to be a member of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (五)当世界版权公约或保护文学艺术作品的国际公约不适用于第二十七条中提到的领地时，本公约就不再适用于该领地。
Translation: (5) When the Universal Copyright Convention or the International Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works does not apply to the territory referred to in Article 27, this Convention shall cease to apply to that territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条(一)本公约生效五年之后，任何缔约国可以通知联合国秘书长要求召开会议修改本公约。
Translation: Article 29(1) Five years after the entry into force of this Convention, any Contracting State may notify the Secretary-General of the United Nations of its request to convene a conference for the purpose of revising this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 联合国秘书长应当将此要求通知所有缔约国。
Translation: The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall notify all Contracting States of this requirement.

Query_Text_cn: 如果联合国秘书长发出通知后六个月之内，有不少于半数的缔约国通知他同意此种要求，则秘书长应当通知国际劳工组织总干事、联合国教育科学文化组织总干事和保护文学艺术作品国际联盟国际局主任，他们应当与第三十二条提到的政府间委员会合作召集修改公约的会议。
Translation: If, within six months after the Secretary-General of the United Nations issues the notification, not less than half of the Contracting States notify him of their agreement to such a request, the Secretary-General shall inform the Director-General of the International Labour Organization, the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, and the Director of the International Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works, who shall, in cooperation with the Intergovernmental Committee referred to in Article 32, convene a meeting to amend the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (二)本公约的任何修改需要参加修改会议的三分之二的国家投赞成票通过，但是这个多数要包括在召开修改会议时本公约的三分之二的成员国。
Translation: (2) Any amendment to this Convention shall require the approval of two-thirds of the States participating in the amendment conference; however, this majority must also include two-thirds of the States Parties to the Convention at the time the amendment conference is convened.

Query_Text_cn: ()对于尚未成为修订公约的缔约国的各国，涉及它们之间的关系或涉及本公约与它们之间的关系，本公约应当继续有效。
Translation: For States Parties that have not yet become parties to the revised Convention, this Convention shall remain in force with respect to relations among them or between this Convention and those States.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条如两个或数个缔约国对本公约的解释或实施发生争执而又不能通过谈判解决时，此争执应当根据争执诸方中任何一方的要求，提交国际法庭裁决，除非他们同意采取另外的办法解决。
Translation: Article 30: If a dispute arises between two or more Contracting Parties regarding the interpretation or implementation of this Convention and cannot be resolved through negotiation, the dispute shall, at the request of any party to the dispute, be submitted to the International Court of Justice for adjudication, unless the parties agree to settle it by other means.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条在不妨碍第五条第三款、第六条第二款、第十六条第一款和第十七条的规定的情况下，不得对本公约作保留。
Translation: Article 31: Subject to the provisions of Article 5, paragraph 3; Article 6, paragraph 2; Article 16, paragraph 1; and Article 17, no reservations may be made to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: ()为可能修订本公约收集建议和准备文件资料。
Translation: () to collect suggestions and prepare documentation for possible amendments to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会成员的数目，如果缔约国是十二个或少于十二个，则为六名，如果缔约国是十三个至十八个，则为九名，如缔约国超过十八个，则为十二名。
Translation: The number of committee members shall be six if there are twelve or fewer contracting parties; nine if there are thirteen to eighteen contracting parties; and twelve if there are more than eighteen contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: (三)委员会应当于公约生效后十二个月选举产生，选举由国际劳工组织总干事、联合国教育科学文化组织总干事和保护文学艺术作品国际联盟国际局主任根据大多数缔约国事先通过的规则来组织，每个缔约国均为一票。
Translation: (3) The Committee shall be elected twelve months after the entry into force of the Convention. The election shall be organized by the Director-General of the International Labour Organization, the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, and the Director of the International Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works, in accordance with rules previously adopted by a majority of the Contracting States, with each Contracting State having one vote.

Query_Text_cn: (四)委员会选举主席和官员，制订自己的议事程序规则。
Translation: (iv) The committee shall elect its chairperson and officers, and formulate its own rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 这些规则应当特别规定保证在各成员国之间用轮换的办法进行委员会未来的活动和对成员的选择。
Translation: These rules should specifically stipulate that the future activities of the committee and the selection of its members shall be conducted on a rotational basis among the member states.

Query_Text_cn: (五)由其总干事或主任指定的国际劳工组织、联合国教育科学文化组织和保护文学艺术作品国际联盟国际局的官员组成委员会的秘书处。
Translation: (v) The secretariat of the committee shall be composed of officials of the International Labour Organization, the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, and the International Bureau for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works, designated by their respective Directors-General or Directors.

Query_Text_cn: (六)只要委员会大多数成员认为有必要，委员会应随时召开，会议轮流在国际劳工组织总部、联合国教育科学文化组织总部和保护文学艺术作品国际联盟国际局总部举行。
Translation: (6) The Committee shall convene at any time deemed necessary by a majority of its members, with meetings held alternately at the headquarters of the International Labour Organization, the headquarters of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, and the headquarters of the International Bureau of the Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works.

Query_Text_cn: (七)委员会成员的费用应当由各自的政府负担。
Translation: The expenses of the committee members shall be borne by their respective governments.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条(一)本公约用英文、法文和西班牙文制订，三种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: Article 33(1) This Convention is drawn up in English, French, and Spanish, all three texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: (二)此外，本公约的正式文本还将用德文、意大利文和葡萄牙文制订。
Translation: (ii) In addition, the official texts of this Convention shall also be drawn up in German, Italian, and Portuguese.

Query_Text_cn: (丁)出现第二十八条第四、五款提到的任何情况。
Translation: (d) The occurrence of any situation mentioned in Clauses 4 or 5 of Article 28.

Query_Text_cn: (二)联合国秘书长还应当将根据第二十九条向他提出的要求以及从缔约国收到的任何涉及修改本公约的信件通知国际劳工组织总干事、联合国教育科学文化组织总干事和保护文学艺术作品国际联盟国际局主任。
Translation: (b) The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall also communicate to the Director-General of the International Labour Organization, the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, and the Director of the International Bureau of the Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works any requests submitted to him under Article 29, as well as any correspondence received from Contracting States concerning amendments to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 下列签字者，经授权在本公约上签字，以昭信守。
Translation: The undersigned, duly authorized, have signed this Convention as a testament to their commitment.

Query_Text_cn: 1961年10月26日于罗马，在一份英、法、西班牙三种文字的统一文本上签字。
Translation: Signed in Rome on 26 October 1961 in a single original in the English, French and Spanish languages.

Query_Text_cn: 联合国秘书长应当将核实无误的副本送给第二十三条提到的会议的所有应邀参加国家和所有联合国会员国，以及国际劳工组织总干事、联合国教育科学文化组织总干事和保护文学艺术作品国际联盟国际局主任。
Translation: The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall transmit certified copies to all States invited to the conference referred to in Article 23, to all Member States of the United Nations, as well as to the Director-General of the International Labour Organization, the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, and the Director of the International Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条公约的一般义务一、各缔约国政府承担义务实施本公约及其附则的各项规定，该附则应构成本公约的组成部分，凡引用本公约时，同时也就是引用该附则。
Translation:
General Obligations under Article 1 of the Convention

1. The governments of all Contracting Parties undertake the obligation to implement the provisions of this Convention and its Annex, which shall form an integral part of the Convention. Any reference to this Convention shall also be deemed to include a reference to the Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 二、各缔约国政府承担义务颁布一切必要的法律、法令、命令和规则并采取一切必要的其他措施，使本公约充分和完全生效，以便从人命安全的观点出发，保证船舶适合其预定的用途。
Translation: 2. The governments of the Contracting States undertake the obligation to enact all necessary laws, decrees, orders, and regulations, and to take all other necessary measures to give full and complete effect to this Convention, in order to ensure, from the perspective of safety of life, that ships are fit for their intended purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条适用范围本公约适用于经授权悬挂缔约国政府国旗的船舶。
Translation:
Article 2 Scope of Application

This Convention applies to ships that are duly authorized to fly the national flag of a Contracting Government.

Query_Text_cn: 三、根据本公约规定所颁发证书的足够数量的样本，以便分送各缔约国政府，供其官员参考。
Translation: 3. A sufficient number of samples of certificates issued in accordance with this Convention shall be provided for distribution to the governments of the Contracting States for reference by their officials.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条不可抗力情况一、在出航时不受本公约规定约束的船舶，并不因天气恶劣或任何其他不可抗力的原因偏离原定航线而受本公约规定的约束。
Translation:
Article 4 Force Majeure

1. A vessel not subject to the provisions of this Convention at the time of departure shall not become subject to the provisions of this Convention solely because it deviates from its intended route due to adverse weather conditions or any other force majeure event.

Query_Text_cn: 二、由于不可抗力或因船长负有搭载失事船舶人员或其他人员的义务而登上船的人员，在确定本公约的任何规定适用于该船时，都不应计算在内。
Translation: 2. Persons who are on board the ship due to force majeure or because the master is obliged to carry persons from a ship in distress or other persons shall not be counted when determining the application of any provision of this Convention to the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条紧急情况下载运人员一、为了避免对人命安全的威胁而撤离人员时，缔约国政府可准许它的船舶载运多于本公约其他规定所允许的人数。
Translation:
Article 5 Emergency Evacuation Personnel  
1. In order to avoid threats to human life during the evacuation of personnel, the government of a contracting state may permit its vessels to carry more persons than allowed under other provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述许可并不剥夺其他缔约国政府根据本公约享有的对到达其港口的这种船舶的任何监督权。
Translation: 2. The above-mentioned authorization does not deprive the government of any other Contracting State of any supervisory rights over such ships arriving at its ports to which it is entitled under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 三、给予此项许可的缔约国政府，应将任何这种许可的通知连同当时情况的说明送交海协组织秘书长。
Translation: 3. The government of the Contracting Party granting such authorization shall notify the Secretary-General of the Maritime Organization of any such authorization, together with an explanation of the circumstances at the time.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条以前的条约和公约一、在缔约国政府之间，本公约代替并废除1960年6月17日在伦敦签订的国际海上人命安全公约。
Translation:
Article 6: Previous Treaties and Conventions

1. Between the governments of the Contracting States, this Convention replaces and abrogates the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea signed in London on June 17, 1960.

Query_Text_cn: (二)适用本公约的船舶，但本公约未予明文规定的事项。
Translation: (ii) Matters concerning ships to which this Convention applies, but which are not expressly stipulated in this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 三、至于上述条约、公约或协定与本公约的规定有抵触时，应以本公约的规定为准。
Translation: 3. In the event of any conflict between the provisions of the aforementioned treaties, conventions, or agreements and those of this Convention, the provisions of this Convention shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本公约未予明文规定的一切事项，仍受缔约国政府的法律管辖。
Translation: 4. All matters not expressly stipulated in this Convention shall remain subject to the laws of the governments of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条经协议订立的特殊规则所有或某些缔约国政府之间，通过协议而按照本公约订立特殊规则时，应将这种规则通知海协组织秘书长，以便分发给所有缔约国政府。
Translation:
Article 7 Special Rules Established by Agreement

When special rules are established by agreement between all or some of the Contracting Governments in accordance with this Convention, such rules shall be communicated to the Secretary-General of the Organization for the purpose of circulation to all Contracting Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条修正一、本公约可按下列各款所述的任一程序进行修正。
Translation: Article 8 Amendment 1. This Convention may be amended in accordance with any of the procedures described below.

Query_Text_cn: (一)缔约国政府提议的任何修正案应提交给海协组织秘书长，随后由其将该修正案在海协组织审议前至少6个月分发给海协组织所有会员和所有缔约国政府。
Translation: Any amendment proposed by the government of a Contracting Party shall be submitted to the Secretary-General of the Organization, who shall circulate it to all Members of the Organization and to all governments of Contracting Parties at least six months prior to its consideration by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: (二)按上述所提议的和分发的任何修正案，应交付海协组织海上安全委员会审议。
Translation: (ii) Any proposed and distributed amendments as mentioned above shall be submitted to the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization for consideration.

Query_Text_cn: (三)缔约国政府不论是否是海协组织的会员，均有权参加海上安全委员会对修正案进行审议和通过的会议。
Translation: (3) Governments of Contracting States, whether or not they are members of the Maritime Organization, have the right to participate in meetings of the Maritime Safety Committee for the consideration and adoption of amendments.

Query_Text_cn: (四)修正案应在按照本款(三)项所规定的扩大的海上安全委员会(以下称海上安全委员会扩大会议)上，经到会并投票的缔约国政府的2/3多数通过，但在表决时至少应有1/3的缔约国政府出席。
Translation: (iv) Amendments shall be adopted at an enlarged meeting of the Maritime Safety Committee (hereinafter referred to as the Enlarged Maritime Safety Committee Meeting) convened in accordance with paragraph (iii) of this Article, by a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Governments present and voting, provided that at least one-third of the Contracting Governments are present at the time of voting.

Query_Text_cn: (五)经按照本款(四)项通过的修正案应由海协组织秘书长通知所有缔约国政府，以供接受。
Translation: (5) Amendments adopted in accordance with paragraph (4) of this Article shall be communicated by the Secretary-General of the Organization to the governments of all Contracting Parties for their acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: (2)在海上安全委员会扩大会议上，由到会并投票的缔约国政府的2/3多数通过时所确定的不短于一年的不同期限届满时。
Translation: (2) Upon the expiration of different periods, not less than one year, as determined by a two-thirds majority of the governments of the Contracting States present and voting at an expanded meeting of the Maritime Safety Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 但如果在上述期间内，1/3以上的缔约国政府或商船合计吨数不少于世界商船总吨数50%的缔约国政府，通知海协组织秘书长反对该修正案，那么应认为该修正案未被接受。
Translation: However, if within the aforementioned period, one-third or more of the Contracting Governments, or Contracting Governments whose combined merchant fleets constitute not less than 50% of the world's total gross tonnage of merchant ships, notify the Secretary-General of the Organization of their objection to the amendment, the amendment shall be deemed not to have been accepted.

Query_Text_cn: (七)1.关于对公约条款或附则第一章的修正案，就那些业已接受该修正案的缔约国政府而言，应在其被认为接受之日后经过六个月生效；就该修正案被认为接受之日以后接受的各个缔约国政府而言，应在其被接受之日后经过六个月生效。
Translation: (7)1. With regard to amendments to the provisions of the Convention or Chapter I of the Annex, for the governments of Contracting Parties that have already accepted the amendment, it shall enter into force six months after the date on which it is deemed to have been accepted; for the governments of Contracting Parties that accept the amendment after the date on which it is deemed to have been accepted, it shall enter into force six months after the date of acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: 2.关于对附则的修正案，除第一章外，就所有缔约国政府而言，应在其被认为接受之日后经过六个月生效，但按照本款(六)项2目的规定对该修正案表示过反对，并且未曾撤销这种反对的缔约国政府除外，然而，在该修正案生效日之前，任何缔约国政府可通知海协组织秘书长，在该修正案生效之日算起不长于一年的期间内，或者在海上安全委员会扩大会议通过修正案时，经到会并投票的缔约国政府的2/3多数可能确定的更为长的期间内，免于实行该修正案。
Translation: 2. With regard to amendments to the Annex, except for Chapter I, such amendments shall enter into force for all Contracting Governments six months after the date on which they are deemed to have been accepted, except for any Contracting Government which, in accordance with subparagraph (vi)(2) of this paragraph, has objected to the amendment and has not withdrawn such objection. However, prior to the date of entry into force of the amendment, any Contracting Government may notify the Secretary-General of the Organization that, for a period not exceeding one year from the date of entry into force of the amendment, or for such longer period as may be determined by a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Governments present and voting at the expanded session of the Maritime Safety Committee at which the amendment was adopted, it will not apply the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 三、会议修正(一)应缔约国政府的请求，并经至少有1/3缔约国政府的同意，海协组织应召开缔约国政府会议，审议对本公约的修正案。
Translation:
III. Amendments to the Convention  
(1) At the request of the government of a Contracting Party, and with the consent of at least one-third of the governments of the Contracting Parties, the Organization shall convene a meeting of the governments of the Contracting Parties to consider amendments to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (二)经此种会议由到会并投票的缔约国政府的2/3多数通过的每一项修正案，应由海协组织秘书长通知所有缔约国政府，以供接受。
Translation: (ii) Each amendment adopted by a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Governments present and voting at such a meeting shall be communicated by the Secretary-General of the Organization to all Contracting Governments for their acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: (三)除会议另有决定外，该修正案分别根据本条二款(六)项和(七)项所规定的程序应认为已被接受和应予生效：但在这些条款中凡提到海上安全委员会扩大会议这一名称时，应认为就是指缔约国政府会议。
Translation: (3) Unless otherwise decided by the meeting, the amendment shall be deemed to have been accepted and to enter into force in accordance with the procedures specified in paragraphs (6) and (7) of this Article. However, whenever the term "expanded session of the Maritime Safety Committee" is mentioned in these paragraphs, it shall be understood to refer to the meeting of the Contracting Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 四、(一)业经接受一项已生效的附则修正案的缔约国政府没有义务将本公约在所签发证书方面的利益给予经授权悬挂某一缔约国政府国旗的船舶，这一政府系按本条二款(六)项2目的规定对该修正案表示过反对，并且未曾撤销这种反对者；但这仅限于该修正案所涉及的与证书有关的事项。
Translation: 4.(1) A Government of a Contracting Party which has accepted an amendment to an annex that has entered into force shall not be obliged to extend the benefits of the Convention relating to certificates to ships flying the flag of a State Party which, pursuant to paragraph 2(6)2 of this Article, has objected to the amendment and has not withdrawn such objection; provided, however, that this shall apply only to matters relating to certificates covered by the amendment in question.

Query_Text_cn: (二)业经接受一项已生效的附则修正案的缔约国政府应将本公约在所签发证书方面的利益给予经授权悬挂某一缔约国政府国旗的船舶，这一政府系按本条二款(七)项2目的规定，已通知海协组织秘书长，免于实行该修正案者。
Translation: (2) A government of a Contracting State that has accepted an amendment to the Annex which has entered into force shall extend the benefits of this Convention, in respect of certificates issued, to ships entitled to fly the flag of a Contracting State whose government, pursuant to paragraph (7) subparagraph 2 of this Article, has notified the Secretary-General of the Maritime Organization that it is exempt from implementing the said amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 五、除另有明文规定外，按本条规定对本公约所作的任何修正案，涉及到船舶结构者，应仅适用于在该修正案生效之日或以后安放龙骨或处于相应建造阶段的船舶。
Translation: 5. Unless otherwise expressly provided, any amendment to this Convention relating to the structure of ships, adopted in accordance with this article, shall apply only to ships the keels of which are laid or which are at a similar stage of construction on or after the date on which the amendment enters into force.

Query_Text_cn: 六、按照本条二款(七)项2目的规定对某项修正案的接受或反对的任何声明，或任何通知，应以书面提交给海协组织秘书长，并由其将此种文件和收到日期通知所有缔约国政府。
Translation: 6. Any declaration of acceptance or rejection of an amendment, or any notification made in accordance with paragraph 2(7)(b) of this Article, shall be submitted in writing to the Secretary-General of the Organization, who shall inform all Contracting Governments of the contents of such documents and the date of their receipt.

Query_Text_cn: 七、海协组织秘书长应将按照本条规定生效的任何修正案，连同每项这种修正案的生效日期，通知所有缔约国政府。
Translation: 7. The Secretary-General of the Organization for Maritime Cooperation shall notify the government of each Contracting Party of any amendment that enters into force in accordance with this Article, together with the date of entry into force of each such amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条签字、批准、接受、认可和加入一、本公约自1974年11月1日起至1975年7月1日止在海协组织总部开放签字，以后仍可加入。
Translation:
Article 9: Signature, Ratification, Acceptance, Approval, and Accession

1. This Convention shall be open for signature at the headquarters of the International Maritime Organization from November 1, 1974, to July 1, 1975, and thereafter shall remain open for accession.

Query_Text_cn: (三)加入。
Translation: (3) Accession.

Query_Text_cn: 二、批准、接受、核准或加入应向海协组织秘书长交存一份相应的文件。
Translation: 2. Instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the Maritime Cooperation Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 三、海协组织秘书长应将任何签字，或者关于批准、接受、认可或加入的任何文件的交存以及交存日期，通知本公约所有签字国政府或加入本公约的各国政府。
Translation: 3. The Secretary-General of the Maritime Cooperation Organization shall notify the governments of all signatory states to this Convention, as well as the governments of states acceding to this Convention, of any signature, the deposit of any instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, and the date of such deposit.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条生效一、本公约应在至少有25个国家，其商船合计吨数不少于世界商船总吨数50%，按第九条规定参加本公约之日后经过12个月生效。
Translation:
Article 10 Entry into Force

1. This Convention shall enter into force 12 months after the date on which at least 25 countries, whose combined merchant fleets constitute not less than 50% of the world's total merchant tonnage, have become parties to this Convention in accordance with the provisions of Article 9.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在本公约生效日以后交存的关于批准、接受、认可或加入的任何文件，应自交存文件之日后经过三个月生效。
Translation: 2. Any instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession deposited after the entry into force of this Convention shall take effect three months after the date of its deposit.

Query_Text_cn: 三、对本公约的修正案在其按第八条规定被认为接受之日以后，交存的关于批准、接受、认可或加入的任何文件应适用于修正后的公约。
Translation: 3. Any instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession deposited after the date on which an amendment to this Convention is deemed to have been accepted in accordance with Article 8 shall apply to the Convention as amended.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条退出一、任何缔约国政府，在本公约对该政府生效满五年后，可随时退出本公约。
Translation:
Article 11: Withdrawal

1. Any Contracting Government may withdraw from this Convention at any time after the Convention has been in force for five years with respect to that Government.

Query_Text_cn: 二、退出本公约应向海协组织秘书长交存一份退出文件，秘书长应将收到的退出本公约的任何文件和收到日期以及退出生效日期通知所有其他缔约国政府。
Translation: 2. Any party wishing to withdraw from this Convention shall deposit an instrument of withdrawal with the Secretary-General of the Maritime Cooperation Organization. The Secretary-General shall notify the governments of all other Contracting Parties of the receipt of any such instrument of withdrawal, the date of receipt, and the date on which the withdrawal takes effect.

Query_Text_cn: 三、退出本公约，应在海协组织秘书长收到退出文件一年后，或在该文件中所载较此为长的期限届满后生效。
Translation: 3. Withdrawal from this Convention shall take effect one year after the Secretary-General of the Organization receives the withdrawal document, or upon the expiration of any longer period specified in that document.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条保存和登记一、本公约应由海协组织秘书长保存，海协组织秘书长应将本公约核证无误的副本分发给本公约所有签字国政府或加入本公约的各国政府。
Translation:
Article 12 Preservation and Registration

1. This Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the Maritime Cooperation Organization, who shall distribute certified true copies of this Convention to the governments of all signatory states and to the governments of all states acceding to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本公约一经生效，海协组织秘书长应按照联合国宪章一百零二条的规定将本公约文本送交联合国秘书长，以供登记和公布。
Translation: 2. Upon the entry into force of this Convention, the Secretary-General of the Maritime Cooperation Organization shall transmit the text of this Convention to the Secretary-General of the United Nations for registration and publication in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条文字本公约正本一份用中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文写成，各种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: Article 13 The original text of this Convention shall be drawn up in Chinese, English, French, Russian, and Spanish, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 阿拉伯文、德文和意大利文的官方译本应译就，并与签署的原本一起保存。
Translation: Official translations in Arabic, German, and Italian shall be prepared and kept together with the signed original.

Query_Text_cn: 具名于下的经各自政府正式授权的代表特签署本公约，以昭信守。
Translation: The undersigned, duly authorized by their respective governments, have signed this Convention to attest their commitment to its observance.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约于1974年11月1日订于伦敦。
Translation: This Convention was concluded in London on November 1, 1974.

Query_Text_cn: （xi）"联盟成员”系指1961/1972法规或1978年的法规的缔约国家或缔约方。
Translation: (xi) "Union member" refers to a Contracting State or Contracting Party to the 1961/1972 Convention or the 1978 Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第2条缔约方的基本义务每个缔约方应授予和保护育种家的权利。
Translation:
Article 2 Basic Obligations of the Contracting Parties

Each Contracting Party shall grant and protect the rights of breeders.

Query_Text_cn: 第3条需要保护的属和种(1)[已是联盟成员的国家]受1961/1972年的法规或1978年的法规约束的各缔约方应遵守本公约条款规定。(i)从受本公约约束之日起，适用于1961/1972年的法规或1978年的法规规定的所有植物属和种，也都于上述之日起适用于本公约；(ii)自上述之日起，至迟五年内，适用于所有植物属和种。
Translation:
Article 3: Genera and Species to be Protected

(1) [States already members of the Union] Each Contracting Party bound by the 1961/1972 Act or the 1978 Act shall comply with the provisions of this Convention.

(i) From the date on which it becomes bound by this Convention, all genera and species of plants to which the provisions of the 1961/1972 Act or the 1978 Act apply shall, from that date, also be subject to this Convention;

(ii) From the aforementioned date, and at the latest within five years, this Convention shall apply to all genera and species of plants.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[联盟的新成员]不受1961/1972年的法规或1978年的法规约束的各缔约方应遵守本公约条款规定。(i)自受本公约约束之日起，至少适用于15个植物属或种；(ii)自上述日期起，至迟10年内，适用于所有植物属和种。
Translation: (2) [New members of the Union] Any Contracting Party not bound by the 1961/1972 Acts or the 1978 Act shall comply with the provisions of this Convention: (i) from the date on which it becomes bound by this Convention, with respect to at least 15 genera or species; (ii) from that date, within a maximum of 10 years, with respect to all plant genera and species.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条国民的待遇（1）[待遇]在不损害本公约规定的权利的前提下，缔约方的国民以及永久居留的自然人和在缔约方的领土内有其注册办事处的合法实体，就其育种家权利的授予和保护而言，在每个缔约方的领土内，将享有每个其他缔约方根据法律所给予或今后将给予其自己的国民相同的待遇，只要所说的国民、自然人或合法实体遵守所说的其他缔约方对国民的规定和手续。
Translation: Article 4: National Treatment (1) [Treatment] Without prejudice to the rights provided by this Convention, nationals of the Contracting Parties, permanent residents, and legal entities with a registered office within the territory of a Contracting Party shall, with respect to the granting and protection of breeders' rights, enjoy in the territory of each Contracting Party the same treatment as that accorded or hereafter accorded by law to its own nationals, provided that such nationals, natural persons, or legal entities comply with the requirements and procedures applicable to nationals of the said Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （2）["国民”]在前面一段，"国民”的概念是，如果缔约方是一个国家，那么就指那个国家的国民，如果缔约方是一个政府间组织，则指那个组织各成员国的国民。
Translation: (2) ["Nationals"] In the preceding paragraph, the concept of "nationals" refers to the nationals of the country if the contracting party is a country, or to the nationals of the member countries of the organization if the contracting party is an intergovernmental organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第5条保护的条件(1)[需满足的标准]当品种符合下列条件时应授予育种家权利：(i)新颖性；(ii)奇异性；(iii)均一性；(iv)稳定性。
Translation: Article 5 Conditions of Protection (1) [Requirements to be Met] Breeder's rights shall be granted where the variety meets the following conditions: (i) novelty; (ii) distinctness; (iii) uniformity; (iv) stability.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[其他条件]凡育种家育出的品种是按照第20款的规定的名称命名的，申请者履行缔约方法律规定的手续，向当局申请备案，申请者交纳必要的手续费，则对育种家权利的授予就不应附带任何其他的条件。
Translation: (2) [Other Conditions] For any variety bred by a breeder that is named in accordance with the provisions of Article 20, if the applicant fulfills the procedures prescribed by the contracting party's laws, submits an application for registration to the authorities, and pays the necessary fees, the grant of breeders' rights shall not be subject to any other conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条新颖性(1)[标准]该品种应被认为具有新颖性，如果在育种家的权利申请书备案之日，该品种繁育或收获的材料尚未售出，或虽转让给他人，但业经育种家同意，旨在开发。(i)在缔约一方的领土上，于该日期一年前申请书已备案者；(ii)在缔约方以外的领土、申请书于该日期前四年已备案者，对于树木或藤木植物，早于该日期前六年已备案者。
Translation:
Article 6 Novelty

(1) [Standard] A variety shall be deemed to be novel if, at the date of filing of the breeder’s right application, the propagating or harvested material of that variety has not been sold or otherwise disposed of to others, or has only been transferred to others with the breeder’s consent for the purpose of development.

(i) In the territory of a Contracting Party, if the application has been filed not more than one year prior to that date;
(ii) In the territory outside the Contracting Party, if the application has been filed not more than four years prior to that date, or, in the case of trees or vines, not more than six years prior to that date.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[新培育的品种]凡缔约方实施本公约的属或种，以前未实施本公约或早期法规者可以认为自实施这种保护之日起已存在的培育的一个品种，以符合(1)节规定的新品种的条件，即使早于按该段所述的出售或转让给其他人的时间，也应是新培育的品种。
Translation: (2) [Newly Bred Varieties] For any genus or species to which a Contracting Party applies this Convention, but for which the Convention or earlier regulations were not previously applied, a variety that already existed at the date of the introduction of such protection may be considered to meet the requirements for a new variety as specified in paragraph (1), even if the sale or disposal to others referred to in that paragraph occurred earlier; such a variety shall be deemed a newly bred variety.

Query_Text_cn: (3)[某些情况下的"领土”]为实施(1)节，在所有缔约方为同样一个政府间组织的成员国的情况下，当该组织的规章有此要求时，可以联合行动，在该组织的成员国家领土上共同行动，在其各自领土上活动，如果要这样做，应相应地报告秘书长。
Translation: (3) [“Territory” in Certain Circumstances] For the purposes of paragraph (1), in cases where all the Contracting Parties are member states of the same intergovernmental organization, and where the rules of that organization so require, joint action may be taken on the territories of the member states of that organization, and activities may be carried out on their respective territories. If such action is to be taken, it shall be reported accordingly to the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条奇异性如果一个品种在申请书备案之时显然有别于人所共知的任何品种，则这个品种就可以认为是奇异的。
Translation:
Article 7 Distinctness  
If a variety is clearly distinguishable from any commonly known variety at the time of application filing, it shall be considered distinct.

Query_Text_cn: 特别是，育种家权利申请书备案或其他品种在任何国家法定的品种登记处登记的情况下，假如已申请获得了育种家的权利或者在法定的品种登记处对其它品种作了登记，则可认为从申请之日起，该其它品种就是人所共知的。
Translation: In particular, if a breeder's right application has been filed or another variety has been registered in the official variety register of any country, it may be considered that, from the date of application, such other variety is deemed to be a matter of common knowledge.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条均一性一个品种从其繁殖的特殊性能可预期其变异，如果其有关的特性完全一致，则该品种应认为是均一的。
Translation: Article 8 Uniformity: A variety shall be deemed uniform if, subject to the variation that may be expected from the particular features of its propagation, its relevant characteristics are entirely consistent.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条稳定性如果一个品种经过反复繁殖有关特性保持不变，或者是在一特殊繁殖周期情况下，在每个周期末尾其有关特性保持不变，这个品种就被认为是稳定的。
Translation: Article 9 Stability: A variety is considered stable if, after repeated propagation, its relevant characteristics remain unchanged, or, in the case of a particular cycle of propagation, its relevant characteristics remain unchanged at the end of each cycle.

Query_Text_cn: 第10条提交申请(1)[首次申请地]申请品种权的育种家可按自己的意愿选择提交首次申请的缔约方机构。
Translation: Article 10 Submission of Application (1) [First Application Location] Breeders applying for variety rights for the first time may, at their own discretion, choose the authority of the Contracting Party to which they submit their initial application.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[二次申请时间]在受理首次申请的缔约方尚未批准授予品种权之前，育种家有权向其他缔约方机构提交二次申请。
Translation: (2) [Timeframe for Subsequent Applications] Before the Contracting Party processing the initial application has granted the breeder's right, the breeder is entitled to submit subsequent applications to the authorities of other Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: (3)[保护的互不依赖性]任何缔约方均不得以未向其他国家或政府间机构提交保护同一品种的申请，或这种申请已被拒绝或保护期满为由，拒授品种权或限制其期限。
Translation: (3) [Independence of Protection] No Contracting Party shall refuse to grant a breeder's right or limit its duration on the grounds that an application for the protection of the same variety has not been submitted to other countries or intergovernmental organizations, or that such an application has been refused or the protection period has expired.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条优先权(1)[优先权及其期限]凡已正式向缔约方之一提交保护某一品种的申请("首次申请”)的育种家，出于为获得同一品种权而向其他缔约方提交申请("二次申请”)时，均享有为期12个月的优先权。
Translation: Article 11 Priority (1) [Priority and its Duration] A breeder who has duly filed an application for the protection of a variety (“first application”) in one of the Contracting Parties shall, for the purpose of filing an application for the same variety (“subsequent application”) with other Contracting Parties, enjoy a right of priority for a period of twelve months.

Query_Text_cn: 这个期限从提交首次申请之日算起，二次申请的当日不计在内。
Translation: This period is calculated from the date of submission of the initial application, excluding the date of the second application.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[要求享受优先权]育种家为从优先权获益，在提交二次申请时有权要求享有首次申请后的优先权。
Translation: (2) [Claiming Priority] In order to benefit from priority rights, breeders are entitled to claim priority from the date of the first application when submitting a subsequent application.

Query_Text_cn: 受理二次申请的机构可以要求育种家在一定时间内(从提交二次申请之日起不少于3个月)提供有关文件和样品或其他证据，证明两次申请的真实文本，和同一品种。
Translation: The authority handling the second application may require the breeder to provide, within a specified period (not less than three months from the date of submission of the second application), relevant documents, samples, or other evidence to prove the authenticity of the texts of both applications and that they pertain to the same variety.

Query_Text_cn: (3)[文件和材料]允许育种家在优先权期满后两年之内，或在首次申请被拒或撤销后的一定时间内，向二次申请受理方提供依法需要的信息、文件或材料，以满足第十二条所指的审查要求。
Translation: (3) [Documents and Materials] Breeders are permitted to provide the information, documents, or materials required by law to the authority handling the subsequent application within two years after the expiration of the priority period, or within a specified period following the rejection or withdrawal of the initial application, in order to meet the examination requirements referred to in Article 12.

Query_Text_cn: (4)[本期限内发生的事件](1)款中所规定的期限内发生的事件，例如另提申请或首次申请主体品种的公开或利用，不能成为拒受二次申请的理由。
Translation: Events occurring within the period specified in paragraph (1) of [Events Occurring Within This Period]—such as the filing of another application or the disclosure or use of the main variety by the initial applicant—cannot serve as grounds for rejecting a subsequent application.

Query_Text_cn: 这类事件也不应产生第三方之权利。
Translation: Such incidents should not give rise to the rights of third parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条申请的审查决定授予品种权之前，应就其是否符合第五至九条规定进行审查。
Translation: Before granting variety rights for an application under Article 12, an examination shall be conducted to determine whether it complies with the provisions of Articles 5 to 9.

Query_Text_cn: 审查过程中，受理方可自行种植该品种或进行其它必要试验，委托他人进行种植或其它必要试验，或考察业已完成的种植或其它试验的结果。
Translation: During the examination process, the receiving party may independently cultivate the variety or conduct other necessary tests, entrust others to carry out cultivation or other necessary tests, or review the results of cultivation or other tests that have already been completed.

Query_Text_cn: 为进行审查，受理方可以要求育种家提供一切必要的信息、文件或材料。
Translation: For the purpose of examination, the receiving party may require the breeder to provide all necessary information, documents, or materials.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条临时性保护各缔约方应采取措施，在提交或公开申报品种权的申请至正式批准之前的期限内，保护育种家的权益。
Translation:
Article 13 Temporary Protection  
Each Contracting Party shall take measures to protect the breeder's rights during the period between the filing or publication of an application for variety rights and the formal grant of such rights.

Query_Text_cn: 这类措施应有如下效力，凡在此期间从事根据第十四条规定待申请批准后应由育种家本人授权的有关活动的当事人，至少应给予品种权持有人公平的报偿。
Translation: Such measures should have the following effect: any party engaging in activities during this period that, according to Article 14, require the breeder's authorization after an application for approval, should at least provide the holder of the variety right with fair remuneration.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约方可规定这类措施只适用于育种家已告知其申请的有关人员。
Translation: The Contracting Party may stipulate that such measures apply only to persons whom the breeder has informed in connection with their application.

Query_Text_cn: (i)生产或繁殖；(ii)为繁殖而进行的调整；(iii)提供销售；(iv)销售或其它交易；(v)出口；(vi)进口；(vii)出于上述(i)至(vi)的目的而提供存货。
Translation: (i) Production or breeding; (ii) Adjustment for breeding purposes; (iii) Offering for sale; (iv) Sale or other transactions; (v) Export; (vi) Import; (vii) Stockpiling for the purposes mentioned in (i) to (vi) above.

Query_Text_cn: (b)育种家可有权附加条件或限制。
Translation: (b) Breeders may have the right to impose conditions or restrictions.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[有关收获材料的活动]依照第15和16条，从事(1)款(a)中(i)至(vii)各项活动，涉及由未经授权使用受保护品种的繁殖材料获得的收获材料(包括整株和部分植株)时，应得到育种家授权，但育种家有正当机会能行使其权力的繁殖材料则例外。
Translation: (2) [Acts in respect of harvested material] Subject to Articles 15 and 16, the authorization of the breeder shall be required for the acts referred to in items (i) to (vii) of paragraph (1)(a) in respect of harvested material, including entire plants and parts of plants, obtained through the unauthorized use of propagating material of the protected variety, unless the breeder has had a reasonable opportunity to exercise his right in relation to the said propagating material.

Query_Text_cn: (3)[与某些产品有关的活动]依照第15和16条，各缔约方可作出规定，从事(1)款(a)中(i)至(vii)各项活动，在涉及用(2)款中所指由未经授权使用的受保护品种的收获材料直接制作的产品时，应得到育种家授权，育种家能控制该收获材料的情况例外。
Translation: (3) [Activities Related to Certain Products] In accordance with Articles 15 and 16, each Contracting Party may provide that, for the activities referred to in items (i) to (vii) of paragraph (1)(a), authorization from the breeder shall be required in respect of products made directly from harvested material of the protected variety obtained through unauthorized use as referred to in paragraph (2), except where the breeder has had a reasonable opportunity to exercise control over the harvested material.

Query_Text_cn: (4)[其它活动]依照第15和16条，各缔约方可作出规定，除(1)款(a)中(i)至(vii)各项外，从事其它活动也应得到育种家授权。
Translation: (4) [Other Activities] In accordance with Articles 15 and 16, each Contracting Party may stipulate that, in addition to the activities listed in items (i) to (vii) of paragraph (1)(a), authorization from the breeder is also required for engaging in other activities.

Query_Text_cn: (5)[派生品种和某些其它品种](a)上述(1)至(4)款规定也适用下列各项：(i)受保护品种的派生品种，但受保护品种本身不是派生品种；(ii)根据第七条规定，与受保护品种没有明显区别的品种；(viii)需要反复利用受保护品种进行繁育的品种。
(b)满足下列条件时，一品种即为另一品种("原始品种”)的派生系，即(a)(i)中所指派生品种：(i)直接从原始品种选出或从该原始品种的派生品种中选出的品种，能够表达由原始品种基因型或基因型组合控制的基本种特性；(ii)与原始品种有明显区别；(iii)除派生型状有差异外，由原始品种基因型或基因型组合控制的基本种特性的表达与原始品种相同。
(c)通过选择天然或诱变株、体细胞无性变异味，从原始品种中选变异单株、回交或经遗传工程转化等途径获得派生品种。
Translation: (c) Derived varieties can be obtained from the original variety through the selection of natural or induced mutants, somaclonal variation, selection of variant single plants, backcrossing, or genetic engineering transformation.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条品种权的例外(1)[强制性例外]品种权不适用于下列各项：(i)私人的非商业性活动；(ii)试验性活动；(iii)培育其他新品种活动，依照第14条(5)款实施的除外，第14条(1)至(4)款所指与该新品种有关的活动。
(2)[非强制性例外]尽管有第14条款规定，但各缔约方仍可在不影响育种家合法权益的情况下，在适当的范围内，对任何品种的品种权予以限制，允许农民用自种自收形式，繁殖受保护品种或第14条(5)款(a)，(i)或(ii)所指品种，以供自用。
Translation: (2) [Non-mandatory Exceptions] Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 14, each Contracting Party may, within reasonable limits and subject to the safeguarding of the legitimate interests of the breeder, restrict the breeder’s right with respect to any variety in order to permit farmers to use for propagating purposes, on their own holdings, the product of the harvest which they have obtained by planting, on their own holdings, the protected variety or a variety covered by Article 14(5)(a)(i) or (ii), for their own use.

Query_Text_cn: 第16条品种权的终止(1)[权利终止]受保护品种的材料或第14条(5)款所指品种的材料，或任何从该材料衍生的材料，已由育种家本人或经其同意在有关缔约方领土内出售之后，不受品种权制约，除非这类活动：(i)涉及该品种的进一步繁殖，或(ii)涉及品种材料出口，使其繁殖，而进口国并不保护该品种所在的植物属或种。出口材料用于最终消费的情况例外。
Translation: Article 16 Termination of Breeder's Rights (1) [Termination of Rights] After the sale of the material of a protected variety or the material of a variety referred to in Article 14(5), or any material derived from such material, by the breeder himself or with his consent within the territory of the relevant Contracting Party, such material shall no longer be subject to breeder's rights, unless such activities: (i) involve further propagation of the variety, or (ii) involve the export of variety material for propagation purposes to a country that does not protect the plant genus or species to which the variety belongs. Exceptions are made for cases where the exported material is intended for final consumption.

Query_Text_cn: (2)["材料”的含义]以(1)款的宗旨的品种"材料”的含义如下：(i)任何种类的繁殖材料；(ii)收获材料，包括整株和部分植株；(iii)直接由收获材料制成的产品。
Translation: (2) [Meaning of "Material"] The meaning of "Material" as referred to in the purpose of paragraph (1) is as follows: (i) any type of propagating material; (ii) harvested material, including entire plants and parts of plants; (iii) products directly made from harvested material.

Query_Text_cn: 第17条行使品种权的限制条件(1)[公共利益]除公共利益及本公约明文规定外，任何缔约方不得以其它理由限制自由行使品种权。
Translation: Article 17 Restrictions on the Exercise of Breeder's Rights (1) [Public Interest] Except for reasons of public interest and as expressly provided in this Convention, no Contracting Party shall restrict the free exercise of breeder's rights for any other reason.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[公平报偿]如果这类限制具有授权第三方从事需经育种家认可的活动的效力，有关缔约方应采取一切必需措施，确保育种家得到公平报偿。
Translation: (2) [Fair Remuneration] If such restrictions empower third parties to engage in activities that require the breeder's authorization, the relevant Contracting Party shall take all necessary measures to ensure that the breeder receives fair remuneration.

Query_Text_cn: 第18条管理商业性活动的措施任何缔约方在其领土内实行的管理品种材料的生产、检验和销售或进出口活动的措施，不应对品种权构成干扰。
Translation:
Measures for the management of commercial activities

Any measures implemented by a Contracting Party within its territory to regulate the production, inspection, and sale or import and export activities of propagating material shall not interfere with the exercise of breeders' rights.

Query_Text_cn: 任何情况下这类措施均不应妨碍本公约条款的实施。
Translation: In no circumstances shall such measures impede the implementation of the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第19条品种权期限（1）[保护期限]品种权有一定期限。
Translation: Article 19 Term of Plant Variety Rights (1) [Term of Protection] Plant variety rights are granted for a limited period.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[最短期限]自批准之日起不少于20年，对于树木和藤本植物，这个期限不少于25年。
Translation: (2) [Minimum Term] Not less than 20 years from the date of approval, and not less than 25 years for trees and woody vines.

Query_Text_cn: 名称的使用]（a）品种名称应按属命名。
Translation: [Use of Names] (a) Variety names shall be designated according to the genus.

Query_Text_cn: （b）除（4）款另有规定外，各缔约方应确保注册的品种名称，用于该品种时不受干扰，即使是在该品种权期满之后。
Translation: (b) Except as otherwise provided in paragraph (4), each Contracting Party shall ensure that the registered variety denomination is not subject to interference when used in relation to that variety, even after the expiration of the variety protection period.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[名称特性]名称应具有验明品种的能力。
Translation: (2) [Name Characteristics] The name should have the ability to identify the variety.

Query_Text_cn: 名称不应仅用数字表示，已成为惯例的情况除外。
Translation: Names should not be represented solely by numbers, except in cases where it has become customary.

Query_Text_cn: 要力戒名称引起误解，或在品种特性、价值或种别或育种家身分方面造成混淆。
Translation: It is essential to avoid names that may cause misunderstanding or confusion regarding the characteristics, value, category, or breeder identity of the variety.

Query_Text_cn: 尤其是名称必须异于各缔约方领土内相同物种或亲缘种现存品种的名称。
Translation: In particular, the name must differ from the names of existing varieties of the same species or related species within the territories of each contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[名称注册]育种家须将品种名称提交注册机构，如提交的名称不符合（2）款规定，注册机构有权拒受并要求育种家在规定时限内提出一个新名。
Translation: (3) [Name Registration] Breeders must submit the variety name to the registration authority. If the submitted name does not comply with the provisions of paragraph (2), the registration authority has the right to refuse acceptance and require the breeder to propose a new name within the specified time limit.

Query_Text_cn: 品种名称的注册起始日期与品种权的批准日期相同。
Translation: The registration start date for the variety name is the same as the approval date of the variety rights.

Query_Text_cn: （4）[第三方居先权]第三方居先权受保护。
Translation: (4) [Priority Rights of Third Parties] The priority rights of third parties are protected.

Query_Text_cn: 符合（7）款规定的一方，因居先权而被禁止使用一个品种的名称，但又有义务必须使用时，注册机构将要求育种家为其品种取一个新的名称。
Translation: If a party covered by paragraph (7) is prohibited from using a variety denomination due to prior rights but is nevertheless obliged to use a denomination, the registration authority shall require the breeder to propose a new denomination for the variety.

Query_Text_cn: （5）[名称相同要求]向所有缔约方提交的同一品种的名称必须相同。
Translation: (5) [Requirement for Consistent Naming] The name of the same variety submitted to all contracting parties must be identical.

Query_Text_cn: 除在其领土不适用者外，各缔约方将按提交的名称注册。
Translation: Except where not applicable within their territories, each contracting party shall register under the submitted name.

Query_Text_cn: 出现不适用情况时，有关缔约方将要求育种家另外提交新名称。
Translation: In cases where the proposed name is deemed unsuitable, the relevant contracting party will require the breeder to submit a new name.

Query_Text_cn: （6）[缔约方当局之间的信息交流]缔约一方当局应保证向所有其他缔约方当局通报有关品种命名，尤其是命名的提交、注册和取消等有关事宜。
Translation: (6) [Exchange of Information Between Contracting Party Authorities] The authority of a contracting party shall ensure that all other contracting party authorities are informed of matters related to variety denomination, particularly the submission, registration, and cancellation of denominations.

Query_Text_cn: 收到通报的任何一方，可用信函把对注册名称的意见告知对方。
Translation: Either party receiving the notification may communicate its views on the registered name to the other party in writing.

Query_Text_cn: （7）[使用品种名称的义务]凡在一个缔约方境内从事销售受保护品种的繁育材料者，均有义务使用该品种名称，即使是在该品种保护期满之后也应如此。符合（4）款规定，受居先权限制者例外。
Translation: (7) [Obligation to Use the Variety Denomination] Any person who sells propagating material of a protected variety within the territory of a Contracting Party is obliged to use the denomination of that variety, even after the expiration of the protection period. Exceptions apply to those restricted by prior rights in accordance with paragraph (4).

Query_Text_cn: （8）[品种名称标识]品种在销售时，除使用注册名称外，允许带有商标、商品名或其它类似标识，但品种名称必须易于识别。
Translation: (8) [Variety Name Identification] When a variety is sold, in addition to using its registered name, trademarks, trade names, or other similar identifiers are permitted. However, the variety name must be easily identifiable.

Query_Text_cn: 第21条品种权的无效(1)[无效的原因]遇有下列情况，缔约方将宣布其授予的品种权无效。(i)批准时不符合第6或7条规定；(ii)主要根据育种家本人提供的信息和有关文件进行审批，但在批准时不符合第8或9条规定，或(iii)把品种权错授他人，但移交给被授予的有资格者除外。
Translation:
Article 21: Nullity of the Breeder’s Right

(1) [Grounds for Nullity] A Contracting Party shall declare a breeder’s right granted by it null and void in the following cases:
(i) if it was granted in contravention of the provisions of Article 6 or 7 at the time of the grant;
(ii) if the grant was essentially based upon information and documents furnished by the breeder, but the variety was not eligible for protection under the provisions of Article 8 or 9 at the time of the grant; or
(iii) if the breeder’s right has been granted to a person who is not entitled to it, except where it is transferred to the person who is so entitled.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[排除其它原因](除)(1)款所述理由外，不得以其它理由宣布品种权无效。
Translation: (2) [Exclusion of Other Reasons] Except for the reasons specified in Item (1), no other grounds may be used to declare the invalidity of variety rights.

Query_Text_cn: 第22条品种权的取消（1）[取消的理由]（a）不再符合第8或9条规定时，各缔约方可取消其授予的品种权。
Translation:
Article 22 Cancellation of Breeder's Rights

(1) [Grounds for Cancellation]
(a) Each Contracting Party may cancel the breeder's rights it has granted if they no longer comply with the provisions of Article 8 or Article 9.

Query_Text_cn: （b）此外，在规定期限内发生下列情况，缔约方可取消其授予的品种权。（i）育种家未能提供用以证明保存该品种的必要资料、文件或材料；（ii）育种家未能交付使其品种权维持有效的必要费用，或（iii）授予品种权之后，品种名称被取消，而育种家未能提交合适的新名称。
Translation: (b) Furthermore, within the prescribed period, the Contracting Party may revoke the granted variety rights in the following circumstances: (i) the breeder fails to provide the necessary information, documents, or materials required to demonstrate the preservation of the variety; (ii) the breeder fails to pay the fees necessary to maintain the validity of the variety rights; or (iii) after the grant of the variety rights, the denomination of the variety is cancelled and the breeder fails to submit an appropriate new denomination.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[排除其它理由]除（1）款所述理由外，不得以其它理由取消品种权。
Translation: (2) [Exclusion of Other Grounds] Except for the reasons specified in Paragraph (1), no other grounds may be used to revoke plant variety rights.

Query_Text_cn: 第23条成员所有缔约方均为本联盟成员。
Translation: Article 23: All contracting parties are members of the Alliance.

Query_Text_cn: 第24条法律地位和办公地点(1)[法人资格]本联盟具法人资格。
Translation:
Article 24 Legal Status and Office Location  
(1) [Legal Entity] The Alliance possesses legal entity status.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[法律行为能力]在不违背各方法律的前提下，本联盟在各缔约方境内享有实现本会目标和发挥自身作用的法律行为能力。
Translation: (2) [Legal Capacity] Provided that it does not contravene the laws of any party, the Alliance shall possess the legal capacity within the territories of each contracting party to achieve its objectives and fulfill its functions.

Query_Text_cn: (3)[地点]本联盟及常设机构设在日内瓦。
Translation: (3) [Location] The Alliance and its permanent institutions are based in Geneva.

Query_Text_cn: (4)[总部协定]本联盟与瑞士联邦签有总部协定。
Translation: (4) [Headquarters Agreement] The Alliance has signed a headquarters agreement with the Swiss Confederation.

Query_Text_cn: 第25条机构本协会的常设机构为理事会和联盟办公室。
Translation: Article 25: The standing bodies of the association are the Council and the Alliance Office.

Query_Text_cn: 第26条理事会（1）[组成]理事会由会员代表组成，每个联盟会员指派一名代表和一名候补代表参加理事会。
Translation: Article 26 Council (1) [Composition] The Council shall be composed of representatives of the members. Each member of the Union shall appoint one representative and one alternate representative to the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 代表或候补代表可携助手或顾问。
Translation: Representatives or alternate representatives may be accompanied by assistants or advisers.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[官员]理事会设一名理事长和一名第一副理事长，还可设若干名副理事长。
Translation: (2) [Officials] The Council shall appoint a Chairperson and a First Vice Chairperson, and may also appoint several Vice Chairpersons.

Query_Text_cn: 理事长因故不能主持工作时，其职责由第一副理事长接替。
Translation: When the Chairman is unable to preside over the work due to certain reasons, the First Vice Chairman shall assume his duties.

Query_Text_cn: 理事长任期三年。
Translation: The term of office for the chairman is three years.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[理事会议]理事会议由理事长召集，例行会议每年一次。
Translation: (3) [Board Meeting] The board meeting is convened by the chairman and is held once a year as a regular meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 三个月内有三分之一会员提出要求，理事长将召开理事会议。
Translation: If one-third of the members submit a request within three months, the chairman shall convene a board meeting.

Query_Text_cn: （4）[观察员]非本联盟成员国可以观察员每份应邀参加理事会议，其他观察员和有关专家也可应邀参加这类会议。
Translation: (4) [Observers] Non-member states of the Alliance may be invited to attend Council meetings as observers. Other observers and relevant experts may also be invited to participate in such meetings.

Query_Text_cn: （x）作出有关决议，确保本联盟充分发挥作用。
Translation: (x) Adopt relevant resolutions to ensure that the Alliance fully fulfills its role.

Query_Text_cn: （6）[表决权]（a）本联盟每一成员为主权国，在理事会中各有一票表决权。
Translation: (6) [Voting Rights] (a) Each member of the League is a sovereign nation and shall have one vote in the Council.

Query_Text_cn: （b）如果缔约方是一个政府间组织，在讨论与其有关的事项时，该缔约方可代作为其成员的本联盟成员国行使表决权。
Translation: (b) If a Contracting Party is an intergovernmental organization, it may exercise the voting rights on behalf of its member States that are members of the Union when matters concerning it are under discussion.

Query_Text_cn: 当这类组织的成员国自行行使其表决权时，这类组织将不再行使其成员国的表决权，反之亦然。
Translation: When the member states of such organizations exercise their voting rights individually, the organizations shall no longer exercise the voting rights of their member states, and vice versa.

Query_Text_cn: （7）[多数]理事会决议一般只需简单多数票通过即为有效，涉及本条（5）款（ii），（vi）和（vii）以及第28条（3）款，29条（5）款（b）和（38）条（1）款的理事会决议，需经四分之三票数通过方为有效。
Translation: (7) [Majority] Council resolutions are generally valid upon passage by a simple majority vote. However, resolutions concerning paragraph (5)(ii), (vi), and (vii) of this Article, as well as paragraph (3) of Article 28, paragraph (5)(b) of Article 29, and paragraph (1) of Article 38, shall require a three-fourths majority vote to be valid.

Query_Text_cn: 缺席者不占票数席位。
Translation: Absentees do not count towards the number of voting seats.

Query_Text_cn: 第27条办公室（1）[办公室的任务和方向]联盟办公室应执行理事会委托的全部责任和任务，并在秘书长的指导下进行工作。
Translation: Article 27 Office (1) [Duties and Direction of the Office] The Office of the Union shall perform all responsibilities and tasks entrusted by the Council and shall operate under the guidance of the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 他负有执行理事会决定的责任。
Translation: He is responsible for implementing the decisions of the Executive Council.

Query_Text_cn: 他把联盟预算提交理事会审批，并负责执行。
Translation: He submits the alliance budget to the council for approval and is responsible for its implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 他向理事会汇报联盟的行政管理、开展的活动及财务状况。
Translation: He reports to the council on the alliance's administrative management, activities undertaken, and financial status.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[职员]根据第26条（5）（iii）中的条款，为了有效地完成联盟办公室任务，所需任命和雇用的职员，其条件应符合行政管理和财务制度的规定。
Translation: (3) [Staff] In accordance with the provisions of Article 26(5)(iii), staff required to be appointed and employed for the effective performance of the tasks of the Union Office shall be subject to the conditions stipulated by the administrative and financial regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第28条语言（1）[办公室使用语言]联盟办公室将用英语、法语、德语和西班牙语履行其职责。
Translation: Article 28 Language (1) [Languages Used in the Office] The Union Office shall perform its duties in English, French, German, and Spanish.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[某些会议中使用的语言]理事会和修定会开会时间用上述四种语言。
Translation: (2) [Languages Used in Certain Meetings] The meetings of the Council and the Revision Conference shall be conducted in the four aforementioned languages.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[增添使用的语言]理事会可以决定增用语种。
Translation: (3) [Addition of Languages Used] The Council may decide to add languages for use.

Query_Text_cn: 第29条财务（1）[收入]联盟开支将来自以下几项：（i）每年各联盟成员国的捐助；（ii）服务所收报酬；（iii）各项杂收。
Translation: Article 29 Finance (1) [Revenue] The expenditures of the Union shall be met from the following sources: (i) annual contributions from each member country of the Union; (ii) fees received for services rendered; (iii) miscellaneous receipts.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[捐助单位]（a）每个联盟成员国在每年捐资总额中所分摊的份额将由从联盟成员国捐资中花费的总额和适合于（3）节中情况的捐助单位数目来决定。
Translation: (2) [Contributing Units] (a) The share of each member country of the Union in the total annual contributions shall be determined by the total amount expended from the contributions of the member countries of the Union and the number of contributing units applicable to the circumstances described in Section (3).

Query_Text_cn: 份额将按（4）节计算。
Translation: The share will be calculated in accordance with Section (4).

Query_Text_cn: 每一成员所分摊的份额]（a）任何1961/1972年法规或1978年法规缔约方的联盟成员国，自受本公约约束之日起，其捐助的单位数即与其上述日期以前的数相同。
Translation: The share apportioned to each member: (a) For any member country of the Union that is a contracting party to the 1961/1972 Act or the 1978 Act, the number of units it contributes shall, from the date on which it becomes bound by this Convention, remain the same as the number prior to that date.

Query_Text_cn: （b）任何其它联盟成员国在加入联盟时应向秘书长说明适合于它的捐资单位数。
Translation: (b) Any other member state joining the Union shall indicate to the Secretary-General the number of contribution units appropriate to it.

Query_Text_cn: （c）任何联盟成员国任何时候都可向秘书长声明与（a）或者（b）节数目不同的捐资单位。
Translation: (c) Any member state of the alliance may, at any time, declare to the Secretary-General a number of contribution units different from those specified in paragraphs (a) or (b).

Query_Text_cn: 如果是在公历年的前6个月做的声明，该声明将从该公历年年初生效，否则将推迟到下一公历年的年初生效。
Translation: If the declaration is made within the first six months of the calendar year, it will take effect from the beginning of that calendar year; otherwise, it will be postponed to take effect from the beginning of the following calendar year.

Query_Text_cn: 份额的计算]（a）在每一预算期间，按以上期各联盟成员国捐资中花费的总和除以这些联盟成员国应捐资单位数目的总和而得到每一捐助单位相应承担的份额。
Translation: [Calculation of Shares] (a) In each budget period, the share to be borne by each contributing unit shall be determined by dividing the total amount expended from the contributions of all Member States of the Union during the preceding period by the total number of contribution units that these Member States are required to provide.

Query_Text_cn: （b）每个联盟成员国捐助的数额应为每一捐助单位承担的份额乘以那个联盟成员国应捐资单位数。
Translation: (b) The amount contributed by each member state of the alliance shall be calculated by multiplying the share borne by each contributing unit by the number of contributing units that the member state is required to provide.

Query_Text_cn: （5）[拖欠捐资][a]如果拖欠捐款的任何联盟成员国，所欠款数等于或超过了前一整年应捐助的数额，该成员国不能享有在理事会中的投票决定权，（b）节情况除外。
Translation: (5) [Arrears in Contributions] (a) If any member country of the alliance is in arrears to an extent equal to or greater than the amount of contributions due for the preceding full year, that member country shall not enjoy the right to vote in the Council, except as provided in paragraph (b).

Query_Text_cn: 停止投票决定权并不等于免除了这个联盟成员国对该公约承担的责任，也不等于剥夺其它任何权力。
Translation: The suspension of voting rights does not exempt the member state of the alliance from its obligations under the convention, nor does it deprive it of any other rights.

Query_Text_cn: （b）欠资的联盟成员国只要向理事会证实拖欠的款项是由于额外的和不可避免的原因，理事会可允许该成员国继续行使其投票表决权。
Translation: (b) If a Member State in arrears can demonstrate to the Council that the failure to pay is due to extraordinary and unavoidable circumstances, the Council may permit that Member State to continue to exercise its voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: （6）[审计帐目]审计帐目应按行政和财务规定由某个联盟成员国进行，该联盟成员国应由理事会指派，并得到该成员国的同意。
Translation: (6) [Audit of Accounts] The audit of accounts shall be conducted by a member country of the Union in accordance with administrative and financial regulations. This member country shall be designated by the Council and must consent to the appointment.

Query_Text_cn: （7）[政府间机构的捐助]任何政府间组织缔约方，可不履行捐资的义务。
Translation: (7) [Contributions from Intergovernmental Organizations] Any intergovernmental organization that is a Party may be exempted from the obligation to make contributions.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果其愿意捐资，将按1至4节中的条款实施。
Translation: However, if it is willing to make a donation, the provisions in Sections 1 to 4 shall be implemented accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: （iii）保证通过定期出版物将以下有关的信息告知公众：——申请和授予育种家的权益，以及——名称的提议与核准。
Translation: (iii) Ensure that the following information is made available to the public through regular publications: — applications for and grants of breeders' rights, and — proposals and approvals of denominations.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[依照法律]每个国家或政府间机构，在按实际情况交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时，必须依照自己的法律，站在使本公约的条款生效的位置上，这点务必给予充分理解。
Translation: (2) [In accordance with the law] Each country or intergovernmental organization, when depositing its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession according to actual circumstances, must do so in accordance with its own laws, from the position of ensuring the provisions of this Convention take effect. This point must be fully understood.

Query_Text_cn: 第31条本公约缔约国与受早期条例约束的缔约方之间的关系（1）[受本公约约束的国家之间的关系]受本公约和任何早期条例约束的联盟成员国之间，唯有本公约适用。
Translation:
Article 31 Relations Between Contracting States to This Convention and Parties Bound by Earlier Regulations

(1) [Relations Between States Bound by This Convention] Among member states of the Union that are bound by both this Convention and any earlier regulations, only this Convention shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[与不受本公约约束国家的可能关系]任何不受本公约约束的联盟成员国，可以通知秘书长，表明它与只受本公约约束的每个联盟成员国之间的关系，按其受约束的最新条例处理。
Translation: (2) [Possible Relations with States Not Bound by This Convention] Any Union member state not bound by this Convention may notify the Secretary-General, indicating the nature of its relations with each Union member state that is only bound by this Convention, and such relations shall be governed by the most recent provisions by which it is bound.

Query_Text_cn: 从该通知书的日期满一个月起，和直到发通知书的该成员国受本公约约束之日止，上述成员国按其受约束的最新条例建立它与只受本公约约束的每个联盟成员国之间的关系，而对前者来说，后者仍按本公约。
Translation: Starting from one month after the date of the said notification and until the day when the notifying Member State becomes bound by this Convention, the said Member State shall establish its relations with each Union Member State that is bound only by this Convention in accordance with the latest provisions by which it is bound, while for the latter, the former shall still be governed by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第32条特殊协定联盟各成员国有保留在它们之间缔结品种保护特殊协定的权力，但这种协定与本公约条款不相冲突。
Translation:
Article 32 Special Agreements

The member states of the Union retain the right to conclude special agreements on the protection of varieties among themselves, provided that such agreements are not in conflict with the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第33条签字本公约进行公开签字，任何国家从它签字之日起，就成为一个联盟成员。
Translation: Article 33: The convention shall be open for public signature, and any country shall become a member of the alliance from the date it signs the convention.

Query_Text_cn: 签字日期持续到1992年3月31日。
Translation: The signing period lasted until March 31, 1992.

Query_Text_cn: 加入（1）[国家和一些政府间的机构]（a）任何国家，正如本条款规定，可以成为本公约的缔约方。
Translation: (1) [States and certain intergovernmental organizations] (a) Any State, as provided in this Article, may become a party to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （b）任何政府间的机构，只要按本条款规定，又具备下列条件，可以成为本公约的缔约方：（i）具有按本公约处理问题的能力；（ii）在授予和保护育种家权益方面有自己的法规约束其成员国，以及（iii）依照自己内部的程序，有加入本公约的充分权威。
Translation: (b) Any intergovernmental organization may become a party to this Convention, provided that it meets the requirements set forth in this Article and fulfills the following conditions: (i) it has the capacity to address matters governed by this Convention; (ii) it has its own legislation binding on its member States with respect to the granting and protection of breeders' rights; and (iii) it has the authority, in accordance with its internal procedures, to accede to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[同意加入书]在本公约上签字的国家，在交存本公约的批准书、接受书或核准书之后将成为本公约的缔约方。
