Translation: (2) [Consent to Accession] A State that has signed this Convention shall become a Party to the Convention upon the deposit of its instrument of ratification, acceptance, or approval.

Query_Text_cn: 尚未在本公约上签字的国家和政府间机构通过交存本公约的接受书而成为本公约的一方。
Translation: States and intergovernmental organizations that have not yet signed this Convention may become parties to it by depositing an instrument of acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书、接受方、核准书或接受书应交存秘书长。
Translation: Instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[理事会的意见]尚未成为本联盟成员的国家和政府间机构，在交存接受书之前，应就其法律与该公约的条款是否一致，征询理事会的意见。
Translation: (3) [Opinion of the Council] Any State or intergovernmental organization that is not yet a member of the Union shall, before depositing its instrument of acceptance, seek the opinion of the Council as to whether its laws are in conformity with the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如果其结果是正面意见，可以交存加入书。
Translation: If the result is a favorable opinion, it may be submitted for inclusion in the accession documents.

Query_Text_cn: 第35条保留权（1）[原则]不允许对本公约有保留权，根据（2）节者除外。
Translation:
Article 35 Reservations  
(1) [Principle] No reservations may be made to this Convention, except as provided in paragraph (2).

Query_Text_cn: （2）[可能的例外]（a）尽管有第3条（1）的条款，在成为本公约的缔约方时，已是1978年条例缔约方，以及通过工业产权而不是育种家权益将无性繁育的品种加以保护的国家，将有权继续其原有保护而无需采用本公约对这些品种的保护。
Translation: (2) [Possible Exceptions] (a) Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3(1), a country that, at the time of becoming a party to this Convention, is already a party to the 1978 Act and protects vegetatively propagated varieties through industrial property rights rather than breeders' rights, shall have the right to continue its existing protection without being required to adopt the protection provided by this Convention for such varieties.

Query_Text_cn: （b）在具有运用上述权利的国家，在交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时，应通知秘书长。
Translation: (b) In countries where the exercise of the aforementioned rights is applicable, notification shall be given to the Secretary-General at the time of depositing the instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 该国在任何时候都可以撤销上述通知。
Translation: The country may revoke the above notification at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 需出版的资料（1）[最初的通知]当按实际情况交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时，任何国家或政府间机构应通知秘书长：（i）保障育种家权益的法规；以及（ii）受保护目录表上的植物属和种，自受本公约约束之日起将按本公约的条款进行保护。
Translation: Materials to be published (1) [Initial Notification] When depositing instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession in accordance with actual circumstances, any country or intergovernmental organization shall notify the Secretary-General of: (i) the regulations safeguarding breeders' rights; and (ii) the list of genera and species subject to protection, which, from the date this Convention becomes binding, shall be protected in accordance with its provisions.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[改变的通告]每一缔约方应立即向秘书长通告：（i）保障育种家权益法规的任何变更情况；以及（ii）将适用本公约的范围扩大至另外一些植物属和种。
Translation: (2) [Notification of Changes] Each Contracting Party shall immediately notify the Secretary-General of: (i) any changes in the regulations safeguarding breeders' rights; and (ii) any extension of the scope of this Convention to additional genera and species of plants.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[信息出版]秘书长将根据来自每一缔约方的信息，出版下列信息资料：（i）保障育种家权益的法规及其改变情况，和（ii）在（1）节（ii）中提及的植物属和种目录表和在（2）节（ii）中提及的扩大应用范围。
Translation: (3) [Information Publication] The Secretary-General shall publish the following information based on data provided by each Contracting Party: (i) regulations safeguarding breeders' rights and any changes thereto, and (ii) lists of plant genera and species referred to in Section (1)(ii), as well as the expanded scope of application mentioned in Section (2)(ii).

Query_Text_cn: 早期条例的终止（1）[开始生效]本公约在有五个国家存交批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书后一个月即开始生效，但至少要有三个所说的文件是由1961/1972年条例或1978年条例缔约国存交的。
Translation:
Termination of Earlier Regulations

(1) [Entry into Force] This Convention shall enter into force one month after five countries have deposited their instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, provided that at least three of these instruments have been deposited by States that are parties to the 1961/1972 Act or the 1978 Act.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[继后生效]（1）节中未包括的任何国家或政府间机构，在它按实际情况交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书之日一个月后，即将受本公约的约束。
Translation: (2) Any country or intergovernmental organization not included in paragraph (1) shall be bound by this Convention one month after the date on which it deposits its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession, as the case may be.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[1978年条例的终止]根据（1）节在本公约生效后，就不再按1978年的条例交存加入书，除了按联合国大会的惯例作为发展中国家者，至1995年12月31日前还可交存此类文件，其它国家可至1993年12月31日，即使本公约在该日期之前已生效，仍可交存此类文件。
Translation: (3) [Termination of the 1978 Regulations] Pursuant to Section (1), after the entry into force of this Convention, instruments of accession under the 1978 Regulations shall no longer be deposited, except that, in accordance with United Nations General Assembly practice, developing countries may continue to deposit such instruments until December 31, 1995, and other countries may do so until December 31, 1993. Even if this Convention enters into force before those dates, such instruments may still be deposited.

Query_Text_cn: 第38条本公约的修正（1）[大会]本公约可由联盟成员国大会修正。
Translation: Article 38 Amendments to this Convention (1) [Assembly] This Convention may be amended by the Assembly of the member countries of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 召集这样的会议由理事会决定。
Translation: The convening of such meetings shall be decided by the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[法定数与多数]只有在至少有半数成员国出席的情况下，大会议程才有效。
Translation: (2) [Quorum and Majority] The agenda of the General Assembly is valid only when at least half of the member states are present.

Query_Text_cn: 对所作的任何修改，要有3/4的多数联盟成员国出席并投票的情况下才能作出决定。
Translation: Any decision on any amendment shall be made only with the presence and vote of three-fourths of the member states of the alliance.

Query_Text_cn: 第39条退约（1）[通告]任何缔约方都可通告秘书长退出本公约。
Translation: Article 39 Withdrawal (1) [Notification] Any contracting party may notify the Secretary-General of its withdrawal from this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长将立即把收到的通告告知联盟的各个成员。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall immediately inform all members of the League of any notification received.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[早期条约]退出本公约的通告被认为也是构成退出该缔约方受约束的任何早期条约的通告。
Translation: (2) A notification of withdrawal from this Convention shall also be deemed to constitute a notification of withdrawal from any earlier treaty by which the withdrawing party is bound.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[有效日期]秘书长收到通告当年的下一公历年度末退约即生效。
Translation: (3) [Effective Date] Withdrawal shall take effect at the end of the next calendar year following the year in which the Secretary-General receives the notification.

Query_Text_cn: （4）[获有的权力]在退约开始生效之日之前，将不影响某一品种从本公约或者任何早期条例获得的任何权益。
Translation: (4) [Acquired rights] prior to the effective date of withdrawal shall not affect any benefits obtained for a particular variety under this Convention or any earlier regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第40条保护现有的权益本公约将不限制根据缔约方之法律或早期条约，或除本公约以外联盟成员之间缔结的任何条约而获得的现有育种家的权利。
Translation:
Article 40 Protection of Existing Rights

This Convention shall not restrict the breeder's rights already acquired under the laws of the Contracting Parties, earlier treaties, or any treaties concluded between members of the Union other than this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第41条本公约的原始文本和官方文本（1）[原始文本]本公约将以英语、法语和德语各签署一份原始文本，在各文本中如有差异，以法语文本为准。
Translation:
Article 41: Original and Official Texts of This Convention

(1) [Original Text] This Convention shall be signed in three original texts in English, French, and German. In the event of any divergence between the texts, the French text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 原始文本将由秘书长存档。
Translation: The original text will be archived by the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[官方文本]在与有关政府协商之后，秘书长将用阿拉伯文、荷兰文、意大利文、日文和西班牙文以及由理事会指定的其它文种制成官方文本。
Translation: (2) [Official Texts] After consultation with the governments concerned, the Secretary-General shall prepare official texts in Arabic, Dutch, Italian, Japanese, and Spanish, as well as in such other languages as may be designated by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 第42条保存人的作用（1）[传送副本]秘书长将把本公约的真实副本传送给所有的采纳本公约参加外交会议的国家和政府间的机构，或根据要求，传送给其它的国家和政府间的机构。
Translation: Article 42 Role of the Depositary (1) [Transmission of Copies] The Secretary-General shall transmit authentic copies of this Convention to all States and intergovernmental organizations that adopted the Convention at the diplomatic conference, or, upon request, to other States and intergovernmental organizations.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[登记]秘书长将向联合国秘书处登记本公约。
Translation: (2) [Registration] The Secretary-General shall register this Convention with the Secretariat of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 为了以有效的电信业务促进各国人民之间的和平关系、国际合作和经济、社会的发展，各缔约国政府的全权代表在充分承认每个国家均有主权管制其电信和注意到电信对维护各国的和平和社会、经济发展起着越来越重要作用的同时，同意制订本公约，作为国际电信联盟的基本法规。
Translation: In order to promote peaceful relations, international cooperation, and economic and social development among peoples of all countries through effective telecommunications services, the plenipotentiary representatives of the governments of the Contracting States, fully recognizing each country's sovereign right to regulate its telecommunications and noting the increasingly important role of telecommunications in maintaining peace and fostering social and economic development, agree to establish this Convention as the fundamental statute of the International Telecommunication Union.

Query_Text_cn: 5.c)既未列入附件一，又非联合国会员的主权国家而申请为电联会员并在取得三分之二电联会员同意后按第四十六条规定加入本公约者。
Translation: 5.c) Sovereign states that are neither listed in Annex I nor members of the United Nations, but apply for membership in the Union and, upon obtaining the consent of two-thirds of the Union members, accede to this Convention in accordance with the provisions of Article 46.

Query_Text_cn: 6.2.对于第5款的规定，如在两届全权代表大会之间有通过外交途径并经由电联所在国提出入会申请者时，秘书长应征询各电联会员的意见。
Translation: 6.2. With regard to the provisions of paragraph 5, if an application for membership is submitted through diplomatic channels and by the country where the Union is located between two plenipotentiary conferences, the Secretary-General shall consult the opinions of all members of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 如会员在征询提出后四个月内未予答复，应作弃权论。
Translation: If a member fails to respond within four months after being consulted, it shall be deemed as an abstention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条会员的权利和义务7.1.电联会员应享有公约所规定的权利，并应履行公约所规定的义务。
Translation:
Article 2 Rights and Obligations of Members

7.1. Members of the association shall enjoy the rights stipulated in the Charter and fulfill the obligations prescribed therein.

Query_Text_cn: 11.c)根据第117和179款的规定，每一会员在所有以通信方式进行的征询中，也享有一个表决权。
Translation: 11.c) In accordance with paragraphs 117 and 179, each member shall also have one vote in all consultations conducted by means of communication.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条电联的会址12.电联的会址设在日内瓦。
Translation:
Article 3: Headquarters of the Union  
12. The headquarters of the Union shall be located in Geneva.

Query_Text_cn: 14.a)维护和扩大所有电联会员之间的国际合作，以改进和合理使用各种电信，以及在电信领域内促进并提供对发展中国家的技术援助。
Translation: 14.a) Maintain and expand international cooperation among all ITU members to improve and rationalize the use of various telecommunications, and to promote and provide technical assistance to developing countries in the field of telecommunications.

Query_Text_cn: 16.c)协调各国的行动，以达上述目的。
Translation: 16.c) Coordinate the actions of countries in pursuit of the above objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 24.g)对各种电信问题进行研究，制订规则，通过决议，编拟建议和意见，以及收集、出版与电信有关的资料。
Translation: 24.g) To conduct studies on various telecommunication issues, formulate rules, adopt resolutions, draft recommendations and opinions, as well as collect and publish information related to telecommunications.

Query_Text_cn: 33.d)国际电报电话咨询委员会(报话咨委会)。
Translation: 33.d) International Telegraph and Telephone Consultative Committee (CCITT).

Query_Text_cn: 第六条全权代表大会34.1.全权代表大会由代表会员国的代表团组成。
Translation: Article 6 Plenipotentiary Conference 34.1. The Plenipotentiary Conference shall be composed of delegations representing the Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 该大会通常五年召开一次，在任何情况下，两届连续的全权代表大会的间隔不得超过六年。
Translation: The conference is usually held every five years, and under no circumstances shall the interval between two consecutive plenipotentiary conferences exceed six years.

Query_Text_cn: 47.l)处理必需处理的任何其他电信问题。
Translation: 47.l) Address any other telecommunications issues that must be addressed.

Query_Text_cn: 51.2.行政大会通常应为审议特种电信问题而召开，只可讨论列入议程的问题，其决定必须在所有情况下符合公约的规定。
Translation: 51.2. The Administrative Conference shall normally be convened to deliberate on special telecommunication issues and may only discuss matters included in the agenda. Its decisions must, under all circumstances, comply with the provisions of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 行政大会在通过决议和决定时应考虑到可以预知的财务影响，并应设法避免通过那些可能引起开支超过全权代表大会规定的经费最高限额的决议和决定。
Translation: When adopting resolutions and decisions, the Executive Council shall take into account foreseeable financial implications and shall endeavor to avoid adopting resolutions and decisions that may result in expenditures exceeding the maximum budgetary limits established by the plenipotentiary conference.

Query_Text_cn: 55.c)大会权限内任何其他世界性问题。
Translation: 55.c) Any other global issues within the competence of the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 56.(2)区域性行政大会的议程仅限于区域性的特种电信问题，包括向国际频率登记委员会颁发的关于其在该区域活动而与其他区域的利益不相抵触的指示在内。
Translation: 56.(2) The agenda of a regional administrative conference shall be limited to regional special telecommunication issues, including instructions issued to the International Frequency Registration Board concerning activities within the region that do not conflict with the interests of other regions.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，这种大会的决定必须在所有情况下符合各种行政规则的规定。
Translation: Moreover, the decisions of such a conference must comply with the provisions of various administrative regulations in all circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条行政理事会57.1.(1)行政理事会由全权代表大会选出的四十一个电联会员组成，选举时需适当注意世界所有区域公平分配理事会的席位。
Translation: Article 8 Administrative Council 57.1.(1) The Administrative Council shall be composed of forty-one members of the Union elected by the Plenipotentiary Conference, with due regard being paid, in the election, to the equitable distribution of Council seats among all regions of the world.

Query_Text_cn: 除遇有一般规则所述的出缺外，选入行政理事会的电联会员应任职到全权代表大会选出新的行政理事会之日为止，并有连选连任的资格。
Translation: Except in cases of vacancies as described by the general rules, members of the Administrative Council elected from among the ITU members shall serve until the day a new Administrative Council is elected by the Plenipotentiary Conference, and shall be eligible for re-election.

Query_Text_cn: 58.(2)理事会的每一理事国应指派一人出席理事会，此人可由一名或几名顾问协助。
Translation: Each member of the Council shall designate one representative to attend the Council, who may be assisted by one or more advisers.

Query_Text_cn: 59.2.行政理事会应采用自行制订的议事规则。
Translation: 59.2. The Executive Council shall adopt its own rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 60.3.在两届全权代表大会之间，行政理事会在全权代表大会所授予的权限内代行其职权。
Translation: Between two plenipotentiary conferences, the Administrative Council shall exercise the powers of the conference within the scope of authority granted by the conference.

Query_Text_cn: 61.4.(1)行政理事会应采取一切步骤，促进各会员履行公约和各种行政规则的规定以及全权代表大会的决定，并在必要时，促进其履行电联其他大会和会议的决定；行政理事会应执行全权代表大会所指派的任务。
Translation: 61.4.(1) The Administrative Council shall take all necessary steps to promote the fulfillment by Members of the provisions of the Convention, the various administrative regulations, and the decisions of the Plenipotentiary Conference, and, when necessary, to promote their fulfillment of the decisions of other conferences and meetings of the Union; the Administrative Council shall carry out the tasks assigned by the Plenipotentiary Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 62.(2)行政理事会应根据电联的宗旨每年确定技术援助政策。
Translation: 62.(2) The Administrative Council shall, in accordance with the purposes of the Union, determine the technical assistance policy each year.

Query_Text_cn: 63.(3)行政理事会应确保对电联的工作进行有效的协调，并对电联各常设机构进行有效的财政监督。
Translation: 63.(3) The Administrative Council shall ensure effective coordination of the work of the Union and exercise effective financial supervision over the Union's permanent organs.

Query_Text_cn: 64.(4)行政理事会应借助其掌握的一切手段，特别是通过电联参加联合国的有关计划，并根据电联的宗旨(其中一条宗旨是以一切可能的手段促进电信的发展)，促进旨在向发展中国家提供技术合作的国际合作。
Translation: 64.(4) The Administrative Council shall utilize all available means, particularly by participating in relevant United Nations programs through the Union, and, in accordance with the purposes of the Union (one of which is to promote the development of telecommunications by all possible means), promote international cooperation aimed at providing technical assistance to developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条总秘书处65.1.(1)总秘书处由秘书长领导，秘书长由一名副秘书长协助。
Translation: Article 9 Secretariat 65.1.(1) The Secretariat is headed by the Secretary-General, who is assisted by a Deputy Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 66.(2)秘书长和副秘书长在当选时所确定的日期就职，通常任职到下届全权代表大会所确定的日期为止。
Translation: 66.(2) The Secretary-General and Deputy Secretary-General shall assume office on the date determined at the time of their election and shall normally serve until the date specified by the next plenipotentiary conference.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长和副秘书长只有一次连选连任的资格。
Translation: The Secretary-General and Deputy Secretary-General are eligible for re-election and consecutive terms only once.

Query_Text_cn: 67.(3)秘书长应采取一切必要措施，以确保电联资金的节省使用。他应对行政理事会负责电联在行政和财务方面的全部活动。
Translation: 67.(3) The Secretary-General shall take all necessary measures to ensure the economical use of ITU funds. He shall be responsible to the Administrative Council for all administrative and financial activities of the ITU.

Query_Text_cn: 副秘书长应对秘书长负责。
Translation: The Deputy Secretary-General shall be accountable to the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 68.2.(1)如果秘书长的职位出缺，应由副秘书长接替并任职到下届全权代表大会所确定的日期为止。
Translation: 68.2.(1) If the position of Secretary-General becomes vacant, the Deputy Secretary-General shall assume the role and serve until the date determined by the next plenipotentiary conference.

Query_Text_cn: 根据第66款规定，该副秘书长有当选秘书长的资格。
Translation: According to Article 66, the Deputy Secretary-General is eligible for election as Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 在副秘书长接替秘书长的情况下，副秘书长的职位应从接替之日起视为出缺并应按第69款的规定办理。
Translation: In the event that the Deputy Secretary-General succeeds the Secretary-General, the position of Deputy Secretary-General shall be deemed vacant from the date of succession and shall be filled in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 69.

Query_Text_cn: 69.(2)如果在距下届全权代表大会召开日期的一百八十天以前遇有副秘书长的职位出缺，行政理事会应任命一名接替人在剩余的任期内任职。
Translation: 69.(2) If a vacancy occurs in the position of Deputy Secretary-General more than one hundred and eighty days before the date of the next plenipotentiary conference, the Administrative Council shall appoint a replacement to serve for the remainder of the term.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会应任命一名秘书长。
Translation: The Council shall appoint a Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 如果这一出缺是距下届全权代表大会召开日期的一百八十天以前发生的，则还应任命一名副秘书长。
Translation: If the vacancy occurs more than 180 days before the opening date of the next plenipotentiary conference, a Deputy Secretary-General shall also be appointed.

Query_Text_cn: 由行政理事会任命的官员在其前任官员的剩余任期内任职，他们在全权代表大会上有当选为秘书长和(或)副秘书长的资格。
Translation: Officials appointed by the Executive Council shall serve for the remainder of their predecessors’ terms and shall be eligible for election as Secretary-General and/or Deputy Secretary-General at the Plenary Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 71.3.秘书长是电联的合法代表。
Translation: 71.3. The Secretary-General is the legal representative of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 72.4.副秘书长应协助秘书长履行职责并执行秘书长交办的特别任务。
Translation: 72.4. The Deputy Secretary-General shall assist the Secretary-General in performing his or her duties and carry out special tasks assigned by the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 在秘书长缺席时，副秘书长履行秘书长的职责。
Translation: In the absence of the Secretary-General, the Deputy Secretary-General shall perform the duties of the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条国际频率登记委员会73.1.国际频率登记委员会(频登会)由全权代表大会选举的五名具有独立性的委员组成。
Translation:
Article 10 International Frequency Registration Board

73.1. The International Frequency Registration Board (IFRB) shall be composed of five independent members elected by the Plenipotentiary Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 这些委员应从电联会员国提名的候选人中选出，选举的方式须保证全世界各区域公平分配名额。
Translation: These members shall be elected from candidates nominated by ITU Member States, and the election process must ensure equitable geographical distribution of seats across all regions of the world.

Query_Text_cn: 每一电联会员只能提名本国国民一人作为候选人。
Translation: Each ITU member may nominate only one national as a candidate.

Query_Text_cn: 74.2.国际频率登记委员会委员应在当选时所确定的日期就职并任职到下届全权代表大会所确定的日期为止。
Translation: Members of the International Frequency Registration Board shall assume office on the date determined at the time of their election and shall serve until the date determined by the next Plenipotentiary Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 75.3.国际频率登记委员会委员不应代表各自国家或某一区域，而应以国际公共托管物的管理人身份进行工作。
Translation: Members of the International Frequency Registration Board shall not represent their respective countries or any particular region, but shall act in their capacity as custodians of an international public trust.

Query_Text_cn: 在筹备无线电大会时应考虑行政理事会的有关指示。
Translation: The relevant directives of the Administrative Council should be taken into account when preparing for the Radiocommunication Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 82.f)保持与其履行职责有关的重要记录。
Translation: 82.f) Maintain important records related to the performance of its duties.

Query_Text_cn: 一般而言，此种研究不应涉及经济问题，但在比较各种技术方案时，可以考虑经济因素。
Translation: Generally speaking, such research should not involve economic issues; however, economic factors may be considered when comparing various technical solutions.

Query_Text_cn: 但根据第83款属无线电咨委会职权范围的有关无线电通信的技术或操作问题除外。
Translation: Except for technical or operational issues related to radiocommunication that fall within the competence of the Radio Advisory Committee as specified in Article 83.

Query_Text_cn: 85.(3)每一咨委会在进行研究时，应适当注意研究与发展中国家在区域及国际范围内建立、发展和促进电信直接有关的问题和编写这方面的建议。
Translation: 85.(3) In conducting research, each advisory committee shall pay appropriate attention to issues directly related to the establishment, development, and promotion of telecommunications by developing countries at regional and international levels, and shall prepare recommendations on these matters.

Query_Text_cn: 88.b)经认可的私营电信机构而表示愿意参加这些委员会的工作并经认可它的会员核准者。
Translation: 88.b) Those who express their willingness to participate in the work of these committees through recognized private telecommunications entities and whose participation has been approved by the members of such entities.

Query_Text_cn: 92.c)由全权代表大会选举并根据第323款的规定任命的主任。
Translation: 92(c) The director elected by the plenipotentiary conference and appointed in accordance with the provisions of Article 323.

Query_Text_cn: 93.4.应设立一个世界性计划委员会及若干个由各国际咨询委员会的全体会议联合批准的区域性计划委员会。
Translation: A World Planning Board and several regional planning boards, jointly approved by plenary sessions of the various international consultative committees, should be established.

Query_Text_cn: 这些计划委员会应拟订一项国际电信网路总计划，以利国际电信业务的协调发展，并应将各项与发展中国家有特殊关系且属各咨询委员会研究范围内的问题提交各国际咨询委员会研究。
Translation: These planning committees shall formulate a master plan for the international telecommunication network to facilitate the coordinated development of international telecommunication services, and shall refer to the relevant international consultative committees for study any issues that fall within their scope of research and are of particular relevance to developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 94.5.区域性计划委员会可与希望合作的区域性组织进行密切合作。
Translation: 94.5. Regional planning committees may work closely with regional organizations that wish to cooperate.

Query_Text_cn: 95.6.国际咨询委员会的工作细则载明在一般规则内。
Translation: The working procedures of the International Advisory Committee are specified within the general rules.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条协调委员会96.1.协调委员会由秘书长、副秘书长、国际咨询委员会主任和国际频率登记委员会主席、副主席组成。
Translation:
Article 12 Coordination Committee

96.1. The Coordination Committee is composed of the Secretary-General, Deputy Secretary-General, Chair of the International Advisory Committee, and the Chair and Vice-Chair of the International Frequency Registration Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 协调委员会由秘书长主持，在秘书长缺席时，由副秘书长主持。
Translation: The Coordination Committee is chaired by the Secretary-General, and in the absence of the Secretary-General, it is chaired by the Deputy Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 97.2.协调委员会在涉及一个以上常设机构的行政、财务、技术合作事宜和对外关系及新闻宣传方面向秘书长提出咨询意见并给予实际协助。
Translation: 97.2. The Coordination Committee provides advisory opinions and practical assistance to the Secretary-General on matters involving more than one permanent organ, including administrative, financial, technical cooperation issues, external relations, and public information.

Query_Text_cn: 协调委员会在审议时须时时充分考虑到公约的规定、行政理事会的决定和电联的整体利益。
Translation: The Coordination Committee must fully take into account the provisions of the Convention, the decisions of the Administrative Council, and the overall interests of the Union during its deliberations.

Query_Text_cn: 98.3.协调委员会还应审议根据公约委托审议的其他事项和行政理事会向其提出的任何事项，并在审议后通过秘书长向行政理事会提出报告。
Translation: 98.3. The Coordination Committee shall also review other matters entrusted to it under the Convention, as well as any matters submitted to it by the Administrative Council, and, after its review, submit a report to the Administrative Council through the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条电联的选任官员和职员99.1.(1)电联的选任官员和职员在履行职责时，不得寻求或接受任何政府或电联以外任何其他当局的指示，并应杜绝与其国际官员身份不符的任何行为。
Translation:
Article 13: Election of Officials and Staff of the Union

99.1.(1) The elected officials and staff of the Union, in the performance of their duties, shall neither seek nor accept instructions from any government or any authority outside the Union, and shall refrain from any conduct incompatible with their status as international officials.

Query_Text_cn: 100.(2)每一会员应尊重电联选任官员和职员的绝对国际性，不得设法影响其工作的执行。
Translation: 100.(2) Each Member shall respect the exclusively international character of the duties of the elected officials and staff of the Union and shall refrain from attempting to influence them in the discharge of their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 101.(3)电联的选任官员或任何职员，除作为其职责外，不得以任何方式参加与电信有关的企业，或享有其他任何财务权益。
Translation: 101.(3)No elected official or employee of the Telecommunication Union shall, except in the performance of their duties, in any way participate in any enterprise related to telecommunications or have any other financial interest therein.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，"财务权益”一词不得解释为继续享受由先前的受雇或服务所产生的离职后的福利。
Translation: However, the term "financial interest" shall not be construed as the continued enjoyment of post-employment benefits arising from previous employment or service.

Query_Text_cn: 102.(4)为保证电联有效的工作，任何有本国国民当选为秘书长、副秘书长、频率登记委员会的委员或某一国际咨询委员会的主任的会员国应尽可能避免在两届全权代表大会之间召回该人员。
Translation: 102.(4) To ensure the effective functioning of the International Telecommunication Union, any Member State whose national has been elected as Secretary-General, Deputy Secretary-General, a member of the Radio Regulations Board, or the Chairman of an International Consultative Committee should, as far as possible, refrain from recalling such personnel between two Plenipotentiary Conferences.

Query_Text_cn: 103.2.秘书长、副秘书长、国际咨询委员会的主任和国际频率登记委员会的委员都应是电联各不同会员国的国民。
Translation: The Secretary-General, the Deputy Secretary-General, the Chairman of the International Advisory Committee, and the members of the International Frequency Registration Board shall all be nationals of different Member States of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 在选举时应适当考虑第104款所述的原则和世界各区域的按地域公平分配。
Translation: During elections, appropriate consideration should be given to the principles set out in Article 104 and to the equitable geographical distribution among the various regions of the world.

Query_Text_cn: 104.3.在招聘职员和确定服务条件时，应首先考虑使电联在工作效率、能力、道德诸方面获得具有最高标准的人员，并应适当注意在尽可能广泛的地域内招聘职员的重要性。
Translation: 104.3. In recruiting staff and determining the conditions of service, first consideration shall be given to securing employees for the Union who possess the highest standards of efficiency, competence, and integrity. Due regard shall also be paid to the importance of recruiting staff on as wide a geographical basis as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条大会和其他会议工作的安排和讨论的进行105.1.大会以及国际咨询委员会的全体会议和一般会议在涉及其工作的安排和讨论的进行时应采用一般规则内所载的议事规则。
Translation:
Article 14: Arrangements for the Work and Conduct of Discussions at the Assembly and Other Meetings

105.1. The Assembly, as well as plenary and general meetings of the International Advisory Committee, shall apply the rules of procedure set forth in the General Rules when arranging their work and conducting discussions on matters within their competence.

Query_Text_cn: 106.2.大会、行政理事会和国际咨询委员会的全体会议及一般会议可以采用其认为必需的议事规则以外的规则。
Translation: 106.2. The plenary sessions and general meetings of the General Assembly, the Administrative Council, and the International Advisory Committee may adopt rules of procedure other than those they deem necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这种附加议事规则必须与公约相一致，全体会议和研究组所通过的附加议事规则应以决议的形式刊布在全体会议的文件内。
Translation: However, such supplementary rules of procedure must be consistent with the Convention, and any supplementary rules of procedure adopted by the plenary session and research groups shall be published in the plenary session documents in the form of resolutions.

Query_Text_cn: 110.c)向发展中国家提供的技术合作和援助的费用。
Translation: 110.c) Costs of technical cooperation and assistance provided to developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 111.2.电联的经费开支应由其会员所缴纳的会费支付。
Translation: The expenses of the Electrical Union shall be covered by the membership fees paid by its members.

Query_Text_cn: 40单位等级4单位等级35单位等级3单位等级30单位等级2单位等级25单位等级11/2单位等级20单位等级1单位等级18单位等级1/2单位等级15单位等级1/4单位等级13单位等级1/8单位等级(只适用于联合国所列10单位等级的最不发达国家和行政理事会所8单位等级确定的其他国家)5单位等级112.3.除第111款所列的会费等级以外，任何会员可以选择高于40的会费单位数。
Translation:
40 unit level  
4 unit level  
35 unit level  
3 unit level  
30 unit level  
2 unit level  
25 unit level  
1 1/2 unit level  
20 unit level  
1 unit level

112.3. In addition to the assessment levels listed in paragraph 111, any member may choose a number of assessment units higher than 40.

Query_Text_cn: 113.4.会员可以自由选择其摊付电联经费开支的会费等级。
Translation: 113.4. Members are free to choose the membership fee tier for covering their share of the Telecommunication Union's expenses.

Query_Text_cn: 114.5.在本公约有效期内，按照公约选择的会费等级不得降低。
Translation: 114.5. During the validity period of this Convention, the chosen level of membership dues may not be reduced.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如遇发生自然灾害而必须实施国际援助计划这类特殊情况时，行政理事会在某一会员提出申请并证明不能保持其原来选择等级的会费时，可以核准该会员降低会费单位等级。
Translation: However, in exceptional circumstances such as the need to implement international aid programs due to natural disasters, the Administrative Council may approve a reduction in the unit level of membership dues for a member who submits an application and demonstrates that it is unable to maintain its originally selected level.

Query_Text_cn: 115.6.第50款所述区域性行政大会的费用应由有关区域所有会员，以及必要时由参加大会的其他区域的会员，根据各自认担的会费单位等级摊付。
Translation: The expenses of the regional administrative conferences referred to in Article 50 shall be borne by all members of the relevant region, as well as, when necessary, by members from other regions participating in the conference, in proportion to the number of contributory units they are assessed.

Query_Text_cn: 116.7.会员应预付根据行政理事会所核准的预算算出的每年应摊会费。
Translation: 116.7. Members shall pay in advance their annual contributions as calculated based on the budget approved by the Administrative Council.

Query_Text_cn: 117.8.对电联欠款的会员在其欠款额等于或大于其两个年度应付会费的总额时，应丧失其按第10、11两款所规定的表决权。
Translation: 117.8. A member in arrears to the Union shall lose its voting rights as stipulated in paragraphs 10 and 11 when its arrears are equal to or greater than the total amount of its contributions due for two years.

Query_Text_cn: 118.9.关于经认可的私营电信机构、科学或工业组织和国际组织认担会费的规定，载明在一般规则内。
Translation: 118.9. Provisions regarding the payment of contributions by recognized private telecommunication entities, scientific or industrial organizations, and international organizations are specified in the general rules.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条语言119.1.(1)电联的正式语言是中文、西班牙文、阿拉伯文、英文、法文和俄文。
Translation: Article 16 Language 119.1.(1) The official languages of the Union shall be Chinese, Spanish, Arabic, English, French, and Russian.

Query_Text_cn: 120.(2)电联的工作语言是西班牙文、英文和法文。
Translation: 120.(2) The working languages of the Telecommunication Union are Spanish, English, and French.

Query_Text_cn: 121.(3)如遇争议，应以法文本为准。
Translation: 121.(3) In the event of any dispute, the legal text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 122.2.(1)全权代表大会和行政大会的各种最后定稿的文件、最后法规、议定书、决议、建议和意见应以电联的各种正式语言拟具，各语种文本的形式和内容应当相同。
Translation: 122.2.(1) All final documents, final regulations, protocols, resolutions, recommendations, and opinions of the Plenipotentiary Conference and the Administrative Conference shall be drawn up in all the official languages of the Union, and the form and content of the texts in each language shall be identical.

Query_Text_cn: 123.(2)上述大会的所有其他文件应以电联的工作语言印发。
Translation: 123.(2) All other documents of the aforementioned conference shall be published in the working languages of the telecommunication union.

Query_Text_cn: 124.3.(1)行政规则所规定的电联正式公务文件应以六种正式语言印发。
Translation: 124.3.(1) Official telecommunication documents stipulated by administrative regulations shall be issued in six official languages.

Query_Text_cn: 125.(2)以任何正式语言书写的向大会和国际咨询委员会会议提交的提案和文稿应用电联的工作语言转达给各会员。
Translation: 125.(2) Proposals and documents submitted to the Plenary Assembly and meetings of the International Consultative Committees in any official language shall be communicated to all Members in the working languages of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 126.(3)秘书长在履行职责过程中所编制的供普遍分发的所有其他文件应以三种工作语言拟具。
Translation: 126.(3) All other documents prepared by the Secretary-General in the course of performing his or her duties for general distribution shall be drafted in the three working languages.

Query_Text_cn: 127.4.(1)在电联大会、国际咨询委员会全体会议、由全体会议核准并列入工作计划的所有研究组会议和行政理事会会议上，应使用六种正式语言之间互相传译的有效系统。
Translation: 127.4.(1)At the Plenipotentiary Conference, the full meetings of the International Consultative Committees, all study group meetings approved by the plenary and included in the work plan, and the meetings of the Administrative Council, an effective system of interpretation among the six official languages shall be used.

Query_Text_cn: 128.(2)在国际咨询委员会的其他会议上，应用工作语言进行讨论，但要求将某一种工作语言传译的会员应至少在九十天前通知他们将参加会议。
Translation: At other meetings of the International Advisory Committee, discussions shall be conducted in the working languages. However, any member requiring interpretation into a particular working language must notify their intention to attend the meeting at least ninety days in advance.

Query_Text_cn: 129.(3)如果大会或会议的全体与会者一致同意，则可用少于上文所提到的语言进行讨论。
Translation: 129.(3) If all participants at the assembly or meeting unanimously agree, discussions may be conducted in fewer languages than those mentioned above.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条电联的法律权能130.电联在其每一会员的领土上享有为行使其职责和实现其宗旨所必需的法律权能。
Translation:
Article 17 Legal Capacity of the Union

130. The Union shall enjoy, within the territory of each of its Members, such legal capacity as may be necessary for the exercise of its functions and the fulfillment of its purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条公众使用国际电信业务的权利131.各会员承认公众有使用国际公众通信业务进行通信的权利。
Translation:
Article 18: The Right of the Public to Use International Telecommunications Services

131. Each Member recognizes the right of the public to use international public communication services for communication.

Query_Text_cn: 各类通信的服务、资费和保障对于所有用户均应相同，不得有任何优先或优待。
Translation: The services, tariffs, and guarantees for all types of communications must be the same for all users, with no priority or preferential treatment allowed.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条电信的停止传递132.1.各会员对于可能危及国家安全、违反国家法律、妨害公共治安或有伤风化的私务电报保留停止传递的权利，但须立即将停止传递这类电报或这类电报一部分的情况通知原发报局。如这种通知可能危及国家安全，则不在此限。
Translation:
Article 19 Suspension of Telegraph Transmission

132.1. Each Member reserves the right to suspend the transmission of private telegrams that may endanger national security, violate national laws, disrupt public order, or offend public morals. However, the Member must immediately notify the originating office of the suspension of such telegrams or any part thereof. This requirement does not apply if such notification could endanger national security.

Query_Text_cn: 133.2.各会员对于可能危及国家安全、违反国家法律、妨害公共治安或有伤风化的任何其他私务电信，也保留予以截断的权利。
Translation: 133.2. Each Member reserves the right to interrupt any other private telecommunications that may endanger national security, violate national laws, disrupt public order, or offend public morals.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条业务的中止134.每一会员保留无限期地中止国际电信业务的权利，或则中止其全部业务，或则仅中止某些通信联络和(或)某几种通信的发送，接收或经转；但必须立即将这类行动通过秘书长通知每一其他会员。
Translation:
Article 20 Suspension of Services

134. Each Member reserves the right to suspend international telecommunication services indefinitely, either by suspending all services or only certain communications links and/or the sending, receiving, or transit of certain types of communications; however, such actions must be immediately notified to all other Members through the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条责任135.各会员对国际电信业务的用户，尤其在赔偿损失的要求方面，不承担任何责任。
Translation: Article 21 Responsibility 135. Members shall not bear any responsibility towards users of international telecommunication services, particularly with regard to claims for compensation for damages.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条电信的保密136.1.各会员同意采取与其所使用的电信系统相适应的一切可能措施，以确保国际通信的机密。
Translation: Article 22 Confidentiality of Telecommunications 136.1. Each Member agrees to take all possible measures compatible with the telecommunications systems it uses to ensure the confidentiality of international communications.

Query_Text_cn: 137.2.但是，各会员保留将这种国际间的通信通知有关当局的权利，以保证其国内法律的实施或其所缔结的国际公约的履行。
Translation: 137.2. However, each member reserves the right to notify the relevant authorities of such international communications in order to ensure the enforcement of its domestic laws or the fulfillment of international conventions to which it is a party.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条电信设备和电路的建立、操作和保护138.1.各会员应采取必要步骤，保证在最优良的技术条件下建立为迅速和不间断地交换国际电信所必需的电路和设备。
Translation:
Article 23 Establishment, Operation, and Protection of Telecommunication Equipment and Circuits

138.1. Each Member shall take the necessary steps to ensure that circuits and equipment essential for the rapid and uninterrupted exchange of international telecommunications are established under the best possible technical conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 139.2.对于这些电路和设备，必须尽可能用经实际操作经验证明属于最好的方法和程序进行操作，必须经常保持其正常的工作状态并使之随着科学技术的进展而得到改进。
Translation: For these circuits and devices, the best proven methods and procedures, as verified through practical operation, must be employed whenever possible. They must be kept in proper working condition at all times and improved in line with advances in science and technology.

Query_Text_cn: 140.3.各会员应在其管辖权限内保护这些电路和设备。
Translation: 140.3. Each Member shall protect such circuits and equipment within its jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: 141.4.除另有专门协议制定其他规定外，每一会员应采取必要步骤，以保证维护其所控制的那部分国际电信电路。
Translation: 141.4. Unless otherwise provided by a specific agreement, each Member shall take the necessary steps to ensure the maintenance of that part of the international telecommunication circuits under its control.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条违反规定的通知142.为便于实施本公约第四十四条的规定，各会员应保证互相通知违反本公约和行政规则及其各种附属规则规定的事例。
Translation:
Article 24 Notification of Violations

142. In order to facilitate the implementation of Article 44 of this Convention, each member shall ensure mutual notification of cases of violations of the provisions of this Convention, the administrative regulations, and their various subsidiary rules.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条有关生命安全电信的优先权143.国际电信业务对于有关海上、陆上、空中或外层空间生命安全的一切电信以及世界卫生组织非常紧急的疫情电信，必须给予绝对优先权。
Translation:
Article 25: Priority of Telecommunications Related to Life Safety

143. International telecommunications must be given absolute priority for all communications concerning the safety of life at sea, on land, in the air, or in outer space, as well as for extremely urgent epidemic communications from the World Health Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条政务电报和政务电话的优先权144.如发报人要求优先权时，政务电报可在不违反本公约第二十五和三十六条规定的情况下，享有先于其他电报的优先权。
Translation:
Article 26 Priority of Government Telegrams and Government Telephone Calls

144. When the sender requests priority, government telegrams may be given precedence over other telegrams, provided that this does not contravene the provisions of Articles 25 and 36 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 政务电话如经特别要求时，也可在可行范围内给予先于其他电话的优先权。
Translation: Government calls may also be given priority over other calls within feasible limits when specially requested.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条密语145.1.政务电报和公务公电在所有通信联络中均可用密语书写。
Translation: Article 27 Cipher 145.1. Official telegrams and government public telegrams may be written in cipher in all communications.

Query_Text_cn: 146.2.在所有国家之间均可受理密语私务电报；但是，预先经由秘书长通知不受理密语私务电报的国家不在此例。
Translation: 146.2. Ciphered private telegrams may be accepted between all countries; however, countries that have notified the Secretary General in advance that they do not accept ciphered private telegrams are exempt from this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 147.3.凡不受理发自或发往其本国境内的密语私务电报的会员必须准许密语私务电报过境，但遇有第二十条所规定的业务中止情况时除外。
Translation: 147.3. Any member that does not accept private cipher telegrams sent from or destined for its own territory must permit the transit of private cipher telegrams, except in cases of service suspension as stipulated in Article 20.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条资费和免费业务148.有关电信资费和准用免费业务的各种情况的规定载明在本公约各种附属行政规则内。
Translation:
Article 28 Tariffs and Free Services  
148. Provisions regarding various situations related to telecommunications tariffs and authorized free services are set forth in the various annexed administrative regulations of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如未缔结这种协议且未按第三十一条规定订立特别协定时，则按照行政规则进行结算。
Translation: If no such agreement has been concluded and no special arrangement has been made in accordance with Article 31, the settlement shall be conducted in accordance with administrative regulations.

Query_Text_cn: ——国际货币基金组织的货币单位，或——金法郎，这两种货币单位在行政规则内已有说明，其适用规定载明在电报电话规则附件一内。
Translation: —The International Monetary Fund's unit of account, or —the gold franc, both of which are defined in the Administrative Regulations, with their applicable provisions set forth in Annex 1 of the Telegraph and Telephone Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条特别协议151.各会员为本身、为经其认可的私营电信机构以及其他经正式核准的电信机构保留可以订立不涉及一般会员的电信事务的特别协议的权利。
Translation: Article 31 Special Agreements 151. Each Member reserves the right, for itself, for recognized private telecommunication agencies, and for other duly authorized telecommunication agencies, to enter into special agreements concerning telecommunication matters that do not affect the general interests of the Members.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这种协议在涉及因它的实施而可能对其他国家无线电业务造成有害干扰时，不得与本公约或其各种附属行政规则的条款相抵触。
Translation: However, such agreements shall not conflict with the provisions of this Convention or its associated administrative regulations in cases where their implementation may cause harmful interference to the radio services of other countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条区域性大会、协议和组织152.为解决可在区域范围内处理的电信问题，各会员保留可以召开区域性大会、订立区域性协议和成立区域性组织的权利。
Translation:
Article 32 Regional Conferences, Agreements, and Organizations

152. In order to address telecommunication issues that can be resolved at the regional level, each Member reserves the right to convene regional conferences, conclude regional agreements, and establish regional organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这种协议不得与本公约相抵触。
Translation: However, such agreements shall not be inconsistent with this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，须尽早采用最新的技术发展成果。
Translation: To this end, it is necessary to adopt the latest technological advancements as early as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 154.在使用空间无线电业务的频带时，各会员应注意，无线电频率和地球同步卫星轨道是有限的自然资源，必须有效而节省地予以使用，以使各国或国家集团可以依照无线电规则的规定并考虑到发展中国家和个别国家的地理位置的特殊需要，公平地使用无线电频率和地球同步卫星轨道。
Translation: 154. When using frequency bands allocated to the space radiocommunication services, Members shall bear in mind that radio frequencies and the geostationary-satellite orbit are limited natural resources and must be used efficiently and economically so that countries or groups of countries may have equitable access to these resources, in accordance with the provisions of the Radio Regulations and taking into account the special needs of developing countries and the particular geographical situation of individual countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条相互间的通信155.1.在移动业务中开放无线电通信的电台，在其正常工作范围内，不论其采用何种无线电系统，均应负有互相交换无线电通信的义务。
Translation: Article 34: Mutual Communication 155.1. Radio stations opened for mobile services are obligated to exchange radio communications with each other within their normal operating range, regardless of the radio system employed.

Query_Text_cn: 156.2.然而，为不致阻碍科学进展起见，第155款的规定不应阻止使用不能同其他系统进行通信的无线电系统，但是这种系统之所以不能同其他系统进行通信必须是由于其特性所致，而不是因为采用了专用于阻碍相互间通信的装置的结果。
Translation: 156.2. However, in order not to hinder scientific progress, the provisions of Article 155 should not prevent the use of radio systems that are incapable of communicating with other systems, provided that such incapability is due to their inherent characteristics and not the result of employing devices specifically designed to obstruct intercommunication.

Query_Text_cn: 157.3.虽有第155款的规定，但仍可根据这种业务的用途或与所采用的系统无关的其他情况，指定某一电台开放有限制的国际电信业务。
Translation: 157.3. Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 155, a station may still be designated to provide restricted international telecommunication services based on the purpose of such services or other circumstances unrelated to the system employed.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条有害干扰158.1.所有电台，不论其用途如何，在建立和使用时均不得对其他会员，或对经认可的私营电信机构，或对其他经正式核准开办无线电业务并按照无线电规则经营的电信机构的无线电业务或通信造成有害干扰。
Translation: Article 35 Harmful Interference 158.1. All radio stations, regardless of their purpose, shall be established and operated in such a manner as not to cause harmful interference to the radio operations or communications of other Members, recognized private telecommunications entities, or other telecommunications entities that have been officially authorized to operate radio services in accordance with the Radio Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 159.2.每一会员应负责要求经其认可的私营电信机构和其他经正式核准开办无线电业务的电信机构遵守第158款的规定。
Translation: 159.2. Each Member shall be responsible for requiring private telecommunications entities it has approved and other telecommunications entities formally authorized to operate radio services to comply with the provisions of Article 158.

Query_Text_cn: 160.3.此外，各会员公认，宜应采取一切实际可行的步骤使各种电气装置和设备的运转不致对第158款所述的无线电业务或通信造成有害干扰。
Translation: 160.3. Furthermore, all Members recognize that it is advisable to take all practicable steps to ensure that the operation of various electrical installations and equipment does not cause harmful interference to the radio services or communications referred to in Article 158.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条遇险呼叫和通信161.无线电台对于遇险呼叫和通信，不论其发自何处，均有义务绝对优先地予以接收和答复，并立即采取必要的行动。
Translation:
Article 36: Distress Calls and Communications  
161. Radio stations are obligated to give absolute priority to the reception and response of distress calls and communications, regardless of their origin, and must immediately take necessary action.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条虚假的或欺骗性的遇险信号、紧急信号、安全信号或识别信号162.各会员同意采取必要的步骤，以阻止发送或转发虚假的或欺骗性的遇险信号、紧急信号、安全信号或识别信号，并共同协作从各自国家寻找和查明发送这种信号的电台。
Translation:
Article 37 False or Deceptive Distress, Emergency, Safety, or Identification Signals

162. Each Member agrees to take the necessary steps to prevent the transmission or retransmission of false or deceptive distress, emergency, safety, or identification signals, and to cooperate in locating and identifying the stations in their respective countries that transmit such signals.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条国防业务使用的设备163.1.各会员对于本国陆、海、空军的军用无线电设备保留其完全的自由权。
Translation: Article 38 Equipment Used for National Defense Operations 163.1. Each member retains complete freedom regarding the military radio equipment used by its national land, sea, and air forces.

Query_Text_cn: 164.2.但是，这种设备必须按照其业务性质，尽可能遵守有关遇险时给予援助和采取防止有害干扰的措施的法定条款以及行政规则内关于应使用的发射方式和频率的条款。
Translation: However, such equipment must, in accordance with its operational nature, comply as far as possible with the statutory provisions concerning assistance in distress situations and the measures to prevent harmful interference, as well as the administrative regulations regarding the emission modes and frequencies to be used.

Query_Text_cn: 165.3.此外，如果这种军用设备参加公众通信业务或本公约各种附属行政规则所规定的其他业务，则通常必须遵守这类业务所适用的管制性条款。
Translation: 165.3. Furthermore, if such military equipment is involved in public correspondence services or other services specified in the various annexed administrative regulations of this Convention, it shall generally be subject to the regulatory provisions applicable to such services.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条与联合国的关系166.1.联合国与国际电信联盟之间的关系在这两个组织缔结的协定中有明文规定，该协定的文本载于本公约附件三内。
Translation:
Article 39: Relations with the United Nations

166.1. The relationship between the United Nations and the International Telecommunication Union is explicitly stipulated in the agreement concluded between the two organizations, the text of which is contained in Annex 3 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 167.2.根据上述协定第十六条规定，联合国办理电信业务的部门享有本公约及其各种附属行政规则所规定的权利并承担其所规定的义务。
Translation: 167.2. In accordance with Article 16 of the aforementioned agreement, the department of the United Nations responsible for telecommunications shall enjoy the rights and assume the obligations stipulated in this Convention and its various ancillary administrative regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 因而，上述部门有权以顾问身份参加电联的一切大会，包括国际咨询委员会的会议。
Translation: Therefore, the aforementioned departments are entitled to participate in all conferences of the telecommunication union, including meetings of the International Advisory Committee, in an advisory capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条与各国际组织的关系168.为促进国际间电信事务的全面协调，电联应与在利益上、活动上有联系的各国际组织进行合作。
Translation:
Article 40: Relations with International Organizations

168. In order to promote comprehensive coordination of international telecommunications affairs, the Union shall cooperate with international organizations whose interests and activities are related to those of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十一条基本条款和一般规则169.如公约第一部分(基本条款，第1至194款)与公约第二部分(一般规则，第201至643款)的条款有矛盾之处时，应以前者为准。
Translation:
Article 41 Basic Provisions and General Rules

169. In the event of any conflict between the provisions of Part I of the Convention (Basic Provisions, Clauses 1 to 194) and those of Part II of the Convention (General Rules, Clauses 201 to 643), the former shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条行政规则170.1.公约的条款系由管制电信的使用并对全体会员均有约束力的各种行政规则加以补充。
Translation: Article 42 Administrative Regulations 170.1. The provisions of the Convention are supplemented by various administrative regulations governing the use of telecommunications, which are binding on all members.

Query_Text_cn: 171.2.按照第四十五条规定批准本公约或按照第四十六条规定加入本公约意味着必然接受在批准或加入时有效的各种行政规则。
Translation: 171.2. Approval of this Convention in accordance with Article 45 or accession to this Convention in accordance with Article 46 necessarily entails acceptance of all administrative regulations in force at the time of approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 172.3.各会员应将其核准相关行政大会对这类规则所作的修订通知秘书长，再由秘书长将收到此种核准通知书的情况立即转告各会员。
Translation: Each Member shall notify the Secretary-General of its approval of amendments to such rules made by the relevant Administrative Conference, and the Secretary-General shall immediately inform all Members of the receipt of such notifications of approval.

Query_Text_cn: 173.4.如公约与行政规则的条款有矛盾之处时，应以公约为准。
Translation: 173.4. In the event of any inconsistency between the provisions of the Convention and the administrative regulations, the provisions of the Convention shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十三条现行行政规则的有效性174.第170款所述的行政规则系在本公约签署时有效的各种行政规则。
Translation:
Article 43 Validity of Existing Administrative Regulations

174. The administrative regulations referred to in paragraph 170 are those administrative regulations that were in effect at the time of the signing of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 这类行政规则应视为附属于本公约的，即使按照第53款规定对之进行部分修订，仍应继续有效，直到相关的世界性行政大会制订的新规则生效并作为本公约附件予以取代时为止。
Translation: Such administrative regulations shall be deemed to be annexed to this Convention and, even if partially revised in accordance with Article 53, shall remain in force until new regulations adopted by the relevant world administrative conference enter into effect and replace them as annexes to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条公约和规则的执行175.1.各会员在其所建立或经营的、参与国际业务或可能对其他国家无线电业务造成有害干扰的所有电信局和电台内，均有义务遵守本公约和各种行政规则的规定，但是，根据第三十八条规定免除这项义务的业务除外。
Translation: Article 44 Implementation of the Convention and Regulations 175.1. Each Member is obligated to comply with the provisions of this Convention and the various Administrative Regulations in all telecommunications stations and radio stations established, operated, or engaged in international operations, or which may cause harmful interference to the radio operations of other countries, except for those operations exempted from this obligation under the provisions of Article 38.

Query_Text_cn: 176.2.各会员还有义务采取必要的步骤，责令所有经其批准而建立和经营电信、并参与国际业务或经营可能对其他国家无线电业务造成有害干扰的电台的私营电信机构遵守本公约和各种行政规则的规定。
Translation: 176.2. Each Member shall also be obliged to take the necessary steps to require all private telecommunication agencies operating telecommunication services, established and operated with its approval and participating in international services, or operating radio stations that may cause harmful interference to the radio services of other countries, to comply with the provisions of this Convention and the various Administrative Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条公约的批准177.1.本公约应由各签字国政府根据各该国家的现行宪法条例予以批准。
Translation:
Article 45: Ratification of the Convention

177.1. This Convention shall be ratified by the governments of the signatory States in accordance with their respective constitutional procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书应当尽快地通过外交途径并经由电联所在国政府转交秘书长收存。
Translation: The instrument of ratification shall be transmitted as soon as possible through diplomatic channels and by the government of the country where the telecommunication union is located to the Secretary-General for deposit.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长须将每份批准书的交存通知各会员。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall notify all members of the deposit of each instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 178.2.(1)自本公约生效之日起两年内，签字国政府即使没有按照第177款规定交存批准书，仍可享有第8至11款所赋予电联会员的权力。
Translation: 178.2.(1) Within two years from the date of the entry into force of this Convention, the government of a signatory, even if it has not deposited its instrument of ratification in accordance with the provisions of Article 177, may nevertheless enjoy the rights conferred upon Members of the Union under paragraphs 8 to 11.

Query_Text_cn: 但表决权以外的其他权利不受影响。
Translation: However, rights other than voting rights remain unaffected.

Query_Text_cn: 180.3.在本公约按照第五十二条规定生效后，每份批准书自交存秘书长之日起生效。
Translation: 180.3. After the entry into force of this Convention in accordance with Article 52, each instrument of ratification shall take effect from the date it is deposited with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 181.4.本公约并不因为一个或几个签字国政府不予批准而对业已批准的各国政府减少效力。
Translation: 181.4. The effectiveness of this Convention for the governments that have ratified it shall not be diminished by the failure of one or more signatory governments to ratify it.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条公约的加入182.1.非本公约签字国的政府可以随时按照第一条规定加入本公约。
Translation: Article 46 Accession to the Convention 182.1. The government of a State that is not a signatory to this Convention may accede to the Convention at any time in accordance with the provisions of Article 1.

Query_Text_cn: 183.2.加入证书应当通过外交途径并经由电联所在国政府转交秘书长收存。
Translation: 183.2. Instruments of accession shall be transmitted to the Secretary-General for deposit through diplomatic channels and through the government of the country where the International Telecommunication Union is located.

Query_Text_cn: 除在证书内另有说明外，证书应自交存之日起生效。
Translation: Unless otherwise specified in the certificate, the certificate shall become effective from the date of deposit.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长须在收到每份加入证书后通知各会员，并将该加入证书的证明无误的副本送交每一会员一份。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall notify each member upon receipt of every instrument of accession and shall provide each member with a certified true copy of such instrument.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十七条公约的宣告废除184.1.每一业已批准或加入本公约的会员有权宣告废除本公约。废除公约的通知书应当通过外交途径并经由电联所在国政府转交秘书长。
Translation:
Article 47: Declaration of Denunciation of the Convention  
184.1. Any Member that has ratified or acceded to this Convention has the right to declare its denunciation of the Convention. The notice of denunciation shall be transmitted to the Secretary-General through diplomatic channels and via the government of the country where the International Telecommunication Union is located.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长须将这种情况通知其他会员。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall notify the other members of this situation.

Query_Text_cn: 185.2.废除公约应自秘书长收到废除公约通知书之日起届满一年后生效。
Translation: 185.2. The denunciation of the Convention shall take effect one year after the date on which the Secretary-General receives the notification of denunciation.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十八条国际电信公约(1973年，马拉加—托雷莫里诺斯)的废止186.在各缔约国政府之间的关系方面，本公约废止并取代国际电信公约(1973年，马拉加—托雷莫里诺斯)。
Translation:
Article 48: Abrogation of the International Telecommunication Convention (Malaga-Torremolinos, 1973)

186. In relations between the governments of the Contracting States, this Convention abrogates and replaces the International Telecommunication Convention (Malaga-Torremolinos, 1973).

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条与非缔约国的关系187.每一会员为其本身和为经认可的私营电信机构保留其可以与非本公约缔约国订定关于受理来往电信业务的条件的权利。
Translation:
Article 49 Relations with Non-Contracting States

187. Each Member reserves, for itself and for recognized private operating agencies, the right to establish conditions for the acceptance of telecommunications exchanged with non-Contracting States to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如果从非缔约国领土发出的电信业务为某一会员所接受，该会员必须予以传递；并且只要该电信业务在某一会员的电信电路上传递，则应适用本公约和各种行政规则内必须遵行的条款以及通常的资费。
Translation: If telecommunications originating from the territory of a non-contracting country are received by a Member, that Member must transmit them; furthermore, as long as such telecommunications are transmitted over the telecommunication circuits of a Member, the provisions of this Convention and the mandatory administrative regulations, as well as the usual charges, shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十条争议的解决188.1.各会员可以通过外交途径，或按照它们之间为解决国际争端所订立的双边或多边条约内规定的程序，或用相互商定的任何其他方法解决它们之间关于本公约或第四十二条所述各种规则的解释和执行问题的争议。
Translation:
Article 50: Settlement of Disputes

188.1. Members may resolve disputes concerning the interpretation and implementation of this Convention or the various rules referred to in Article 42 through diplomatic channels, in accordance with procedures stipulated in bilateral or multilateral treaties concluded between them for the settlement of international disputes, or by any other mutually agreed method.

Query_Text_cn: 189.2.如果不采用上述解决方法中的任何一种，则作为争端一方的任何会员可以根据情况将该项争议按照一般规则或任选附加议定书所规定的程序提付仲裁。
Translation: 189.2. If none of the aforementioned solutions is adopted, any Member that is a party to the dispute may, as appropriate, submit the dispute to arbitration in accordance with the procedures set out in the general rules or any optional protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 192.b）第四十二条所述各种规则内所解释的其他名词具有各该规则所指定的意义。
Translation: Other terms interpreted within the various rules referred to in Article 42 shall have the meanings assigned to them in those rules.

Query_Text_cn: 国际劳工组织大会，经国际劳工局理事会召集，于1999年6月1日在日内瓦举行其第87届会议，并考虑到需要通过新的文书，把禁止和消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动作为包括国际合作和援助在内的国家和国际行动的主要优先目标，以便补充依然是童工劳动方面基本文书的1973年准予就业最低年龄公约和建议书，并考虑到立即采取全面行动切实消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动，既要关注免费基础教育的重要性，又要关注需要使有关儿童脱离所有此类工作以及为其康复和社会融合提供援助，还要同时解决其家庭需要问题，并忆及1996年第83届国际劳工大会上通过的关于消除童工劳动的决议，并认识到童工劳动在很大程度上是由于贫困造成的，长期的解决办法有赖于经济的持续增长带来的社会进步，特别是在消除贫困和普及教育方面，并忆及联合国大会于1989年11月20日通过的《儿童权利公约》，并忆及1998年第86届国际劳工大会上通过的《国际劳工组织关于工作中基本原则和权利的宣言及其后续措施》，并忆及某些最恶劣形式的童工劳动已涵盖在其他国际文书中，特别是1930年《强迫劳动公约》和联合国1956年《废止奴隶制、奴隶贩卖及类似奴隶制的制度与习俗补充公约》，并经决定采纳本届会议议程第四项关于童工劳动的若干提议，并经确定这些提议应采取一项国际公约的形式，于1999年6月17日通过以下公约，引用时得称之为1999年《禁止和立即行动消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动公约》。
Translation: The International Labour Conference, convened by the Governing Body of the International Labour Office, held its 87th session in Geneva on 1 June 1999, and, considering the need to adopt a new instrument making the prohibition and elimination of the worst forms of child labour a primary objective of national and international action, including international cooperation and assistance, in order to supplement the Minimum Age Convention and Recommendation of 1973, which remain the fundamental instruments on child labour, and considering the urgent need for immediate and comprehensive action to effectively eliminate the worst forms of child labour, with due regard to the importance of free basic education, the necessity of removing children from all such work and providing assistance for their rehabilitation and social integration, as well as addressing the needs of their families, and recalling the resolution concerning the elimination of child labour adopted by the 83rd session of the International Labour Conference in 1996, and recognizing that child labour is largely caused by poverty and that its long-term solution depends on sustained economic growth leading to social progress, particularly in the eradication of poverty and the provision of universal education, and recalling the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child adopted by the General Assembly on 20 November 1989, and recalling the Declaration on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work and its Follow-up adopted by the 86th session of the International Labour Conference in 1998, and recalling that certain worst forms of child labour are covered by other international instruments, in particular the Forced Labour Convention of 1930 and the United Nations Supplementary Convention on the Abolition of Slavery, the Slave Trade and Institutions and Practices Similar to Slavery of 1956, and having decided to adopt proposals concerning child labour as the fourth item on the agenda of the session, and having determined that these proposals should take the form of an international Convention, hereby adopts, on 17 June 1999, the following Convention, which may be cited as the Worst Forms of Child Labour Convention, 1999.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条凡批准本公约的会员国应立即采取有效的措施，以保证将禁止和消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动作为一项紧迫事务。
Translation: Article 1: Any Member State that ratifies this Convention shall immediately take effective measures to ensure that the prohibition and elimination of the worst forms of child labor are treated as a matter of urgent priority.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条就本公约而言，“儿童”一词适用于18岁以下的所有人员。
Translation: For the purposes of this Convention, the term "child" applies to all persons under the age of 18.

Query_Text_cn: (d)在可能对儿童健康、安全或道德有伤害性的环境中工作。
Translation: (d) Working in environments that may be harmful to children's health, safety, or morals.

Query_Text_cn: 1、第三条(d)项所指的工作类型应由国家法律或条例，或是主管当局，在同有关雇主组织和工人组织磋商之后，考虑有关国际标准，特别是1999年《禁止和立即行动消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动建议书》第3款、第4款的情况，然后确定。
Translation: The types of work referred to in Article 3(d) shall be determined by national laws or regulations, or by the competent authority, after consultation with the relevant employers' and workers' organizations, taking into account relevant international standards, particularly the provisions of Paragraphs 3 and 4 of the 1999 Recommendation concerning the Prohibition and Immediate Action for the Elimination of the Worst Forms of Child Labour.

Query_Text_cn: 2、主管当局在同有关雇主组织和工人组织磋商之后，应查明所确定的工作类型存在场所。
Translation: 2. The competent authorities, after consulting with the relevant employers' and workers' organizations, shall identify the workplaces where the specified types of work exist.

Query_Text_cn: 3、根据本条第1款确定的工作类型一览表，应同有关雇主组织和工人组织磋商，进行定期审查并视需要予以修订。
Translation: 3. The list of types of work determined in accordance with paragraph 1 of this Article shall be subject to regular review and, if necessary, revision, in consultation with the relevant employers' and workers' organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条凡批准本公约的会员国在同雇主组织和工人组织磋商之后，应建立或指定适当机构，监督实施使本公约发生效力的各项条款。
Translation: Article 5: Each Member State that ratifies this Convention shall, after consultation with employers' and workers' organizations, establish or designate appropriate bodies to supervise the implementation of the provisions giving effect to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 1、凡批准本公约的会员国应将制定和实施行动计划，作为优先目标，以消除最恶劣形式的童工劳动。
Translation: 1. Each member country that ratifies this Convention shall make the formulation and implementation of action plans a priority objective in order to eliminate the worst forms of child labor.

Query_Text_cn: 2、制定和实施此类行动计划，应同有关政府机构以及雇主组织和工人组织进行磋商，凡适宜时，考虑其他有关群体的意见。
Translation: The formulation and implementation of such action plans should be carried out in consultation with relevant government agencies, employers' organizations, and workers' organizations, and, where appropriate, take into account the views of other concerned groups.

Query_Text_cn: 1、凡批准本公约的会员国应采取一切必要措施，包括规定和执行刑事制裁或其他必要制裁，以保证有效实施和强制执行使本公约发生效力的各项条款。
Translation: 1. Each Member State that ratifies this Convention shall take all necessary measures, including the establishment and enforcement of criminal sanctions or other necessary penalties, to ensure the effective implementation and enforcement of all provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (e)考虑女童的特殊情况。
Translation: (e) Take into account the specific circumstances of girls.

Query_Text_cn: 3、凡批准本公约的会员国应指定主管当局，负责实施使本公约发生效力的各项条款。
Translation: 3. Each member country that ratifies this Convention shall designate a competent authority responsible for implementing the provisions necessary to give effect to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条凡批准本公约的会员国应采取适宜步骤，通过加强国际合作和／或援助，包括支持社会与经济发展、消除贫困计划与普及教育，以相互帮助，落实本公约的条款。
Translation: Article 8: Any Member State that ratifies this Convention shall take appropriate measures, through enhanced international cooperation and/or assistance—including support for social and economic development, poverty eradication programs, and universal education—to mutually assist in the implementation of the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条本公约的正式批准书应送请国际劳工局长登记。
Translation: Article 9: The formal instruments of ratification of this Convention shall be communicated to the Director-General of the International Labour Office for registration.

Query_Text_cn: 1、本公约应仅对其批准书已经国际劳工局长登记的国际劳工组织会员国有约束力。
Translation: 1. This Convention shall be binding only upon those Members of the International Labour Organization whose instruments of ratification have been registered with the Director-General of the International Labour Office.

Query_Text_cn: 2、本公约自两个会员国的批准书已经国际劳工局长登记之日起12个月后生效。
Translation: 2. This Convention shall come into force twelve months after the date on which the ratifications of two Member States have been registered with the Director-General of the International Labour Office.

Query_Text_cn: 3、此后，对于任何会员国，本公约应自其批准书已经登记之日起12个月后生效。
Translation: Thereafter, for any member state, this Convention shall enter into force 12 months after the date on which its instrument of ratification has been registered.

Query_Text_cn: 1、凡批准本公约的会员国，自本公约初次生效之日起满10年后得向国际劳工局长通知解约，并请其登记。
Translation: Any member state that has ratified this Convention may, after the expiration of ten years from the date on which the Convention first enters into force, notify the Director-General of the International Labour Office of its denunciation, requesting registration thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 1、国际劳工局长应将国际劳工组织各会员国所送达的一切批准书和解约通知书的登记情况，通知本组织的全体会员国。
Translation: The Director-General of the International Labour Office shall notify all member states of the Organization of the registration of all instruments of ratification and denunciation received from member states of the International Labour Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2、国际劳工局长在将所送达的第二份批准书的登记情况通知本组织全体会员国时，应提请本组织务会员国注意本公约开始生效的日期。
Translation: 2. When notifying all Member States of the Organization of the registration of the second instrument of ratification received, the Director-General of the International Labour Office shall draw the attention of the Member States of the Organization to the date on which this Convention shall enter into force.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条国际劳工局长应将他按照以上各条规定所登记的一切批准书和解约通知书的详细情况，按照《联合国宪章》第102条的规定，送请联合国秘书长进行登记。
Translation: Article 13 The Director-General of the International Labour Office shall communicate to the Secretary-General of the United Nations for registration, in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations, full particulars of all ratifications and denunciations registered by him in accordance with the provisions of the preceding articles.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条国际劳工局理事会在必要时，应将本公约的实施情况向大会提出报告，并审查应否将本公约的全部或部分修订问题列入大会议程。
Translation: Article 14: The Governing Body of the International Labour Office shall, when necessary, submit a report to the Conference on the implementation of this Convention and shall examine whether the question of the revision, in whole or in part, of this Convention should be included in the agenda of the Conference.

Query_Text_cn: (b)自新修订公约生效之日起，本公约应即停止接受会员国的批准。
Translation: (b) From the date the newly revised Convention enters into force, this Convention shall cease to be open for ratification by Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条本公约的英文本和法文本同等作准。
Translation: Article 16 The English and French texts of this Convention shall be equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 中国和澳大利亚高度重视气候变化问题,愿加强合作共同应对气候变化挑战。
Translation: China and Australia attach great importance to the issue of climate change and are willing to strengthen cooperation to jointly address the challenges posed by climate change.

Query_Text_cn: 双方重申对于《联合国气候变化框架公约》(简称《公约》)和《京都议定书》的承诺,再次强调发达国家应根据“共同但有区别的责任”原则和各自能力以及“巴厘路线图”,在2012年后继续率先减少温室气体排放,并协助发展中国家提高应对气候变化的能力。
Translation: Both parties reaffirm their commitment to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) and the Kyoto Protocol, and reiterate that developed countries should continue to take the lead in reducing greenhouse gas emissions after 2012 in accordance with the principle of "common but differentiated responsibilities," their respective capabilities, and the Bali Roadmap, as well as assist developing countries in enhancing their capacity to address climate change.

Query_Text_cn: 中澳双方认识到应加强谈判以实现“巴厘路线图”规定的时间表,双方将在即将举行的相关双边和多边论坛中密切合作,支持《公约》下的谈判。
Translation: Both China and Australia recognize the need to intensify negotiations to meet the timeline set out in the Bali Roadmap. The two sides will work closely together in upcoming relevant bilateral and multilateral forums to support negotiations under the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 中澳双方在气候变化方面有许多共同点。
Translation: China and Australia share many commonalities in addressing climate change.

Query_Text_cn: 双方的伙伴关系和合作将集中于比较优势和共同利益,从而为全球应对气候变化的努力做出贡献。
Translation: The partnership and cooperation between both parties will focus on comparative advantages and shared interests, thereby contributing to global efforts to address climate change.

Query_Text_cn: 双方同意通过加强部长级政策对话,以及开发执行协助双方应对气候变化的互惠互利的实质性项目强化务实合作,促进更紧密气候变化合作。
Translation: Both sides agreed to strengthen practical cooperation and promote closer collaboration on climate change by enhancing ministerial-level policy dialogue and developing and implementing mutually beneficial substantive projects to assist both parties in addressing climate change.

Query_Text_cn: 基于两国开展更紧密气候变化合作的精神,双方重申对中澳洁净煤技术联合协调小组工作的支持。
Translation: In the spirit of fostering closer cooperation on climate change between the two countries, both sides reaffirm their support for the work of the China-Australia Joint Coordination Group on Clean Coal Technology.

Query_Text_cn: 两国认为减少毁林排放应作为未来应对气候变化行动的一个方面,重申对中国于2007年9月在悉尼亚太经合组织会议上倡议发起的亚太森林恢复和可持续管理网络的支持。
Translation: The two countries believe that reducing emissions from deforestation should be considered as one aspect of future actions to address climate change, and reaffirm their support for the Asia-Pacific Network for Forest Restoration and Sustainable Management, which was initiated by China at the APEC meeting in Sydney in September 2007.

Query_Text_cn: 中澳双方与其他各方在《公约》第13次缔约方会议上共同努力,达成了关于未来应对气候变化国际框架的“巴厘路线图”。
Translation: China, Australia, and other parties worked together at the 13th Conference of the Parties to the Convention to reach the "Bali Roadmap" regarding the future international framework for addressing climate change.

Query_Text_cn: 双方将在《公约》和《京都议定书》的指导下,继续共同努力推动气候变化谈判和相关国际合作。
Translation: Both parties will continue to work together to advance climate change negotiations and related international cooperation under the guidance of the Convention and the Kyoto Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 为此,双方同意在现有气候变化机制基础上,举行年度部长级会议,加强双方在气候变化方面的经常性政策对话、合作和协调。
Translation: To this end, both parties agreed to hold annual ministerial meetings based on existing climate change mechanisms to strengthen regular policy dialogue, cooperation, and coordination on climate change.

Query_Text_cn: 第一次部长级会议将由澳方于2008年下半年举办。
Translation: The first ministerial meeting will be hosted by Australia in the second half of 2008.

Query_Text_cn: 中澳拥有成功的双边气候变化伙伴关系,这一伙伴关系汇聚了双方工业、科学和相关政府部门的资源和专家。
Translation: China and Australia have a successful bilateral partnership on climate change, which brings together resources and experts from both countries' industries, scientific communities, and relevant government departments.

Query_Text_cn: 双方重申对已达成的合作项目的承诺,同意进一步扩展务实项目活动,尤其是在能力建设、可再生能源技术、能效、甲烷回收利用、气候变化和农业、土地利用、土地利用变化和林业、适应气候变化和气候变化科学等方面。
Translation: Both parties reaffirm their commitment to the cooperation projects already agreed upon and agree to further expand practical project activities, particularly in the areas of capacity building, renewable energy technologies, energy efficiency, methane recovery and utilization, climate change and agriculture, land use, land use change and forestry, climate change adaptation, and climate change science.

Query_Text_cn: 中澳将合作开发低排放技术,协助两国在发展经济的同时尽可能减少温室气体排放,并满足两国对清洁发电技术不断增长的需要。
Translation: China and Australia will cooperate in developing low-emission technologies to help both countries minimize greenhouse gas emissions while growing their economies, and to meet the increasing demand for clean power generation technologies in both nations.

Query_Text_cn: 两国对目前双方在亚太清洁发展和气候伙伴计划、中澳洁净煤技术联合协调小组和双边气候变化伙伴关系有关领域内开展的合作表示欢迎。
Translation: The two countries welcomed the ongoing cooperation between them in relevant areas under the Asia-Pacific Partnership on Clean Development and Climate, the Australia-China Joint Coordination Group on Clean Coal Technology, and the bilateral Climate Change Partnership.

Query_Text_cn: 中方欢迎澳方再次重申将向中澳洁净煤技术联合协调小组投入2000万澳元的承诺。
Translation: China welcomes Australia's renewed commitment to invest AUD 20 million in the China-Australia Joint Coordination Group on Clean Coal

Query_Text_cn: 应中华人民共和国国务院总理温家宝的邀请,丹麦王国首相安诺斯·福格·拉斯穆森阁下于2008年10月20至25日来华出席第七届亚欧首脑会议并对中国进行正式访问。
Translation: At the invitation of Premier Wen Jiabao of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, His Excellency Anders Fogh Rasmussen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Denmark, visited China from October 20 to 25, 2008, to attend the Seventh Asia-Europe Summit and pay an official visit to China.

Query_Text_cn: 访问期间,胡锦涛主席会见了拉斯穆森首相,温家宝总理同拉斯穆森首相举行了会谈。
Translation: During the visit, President Hu Jintao met with Prime Minister Rasmussen, and Premier Wen Jiabao held talks with Prime Minister Rasmussen.

Query_Text_cn: 双方领导人回顾了两国自1950年建交以来双边关系的长足发展及在政治、经济、文化、教育、科技等领域富有成果的合作,认为双边关系得到稳步提升,政治互信和相互尊重日益增强,经贸合作不断拓展。
Translation: The leaders of both sides reviewed the significant progress in bilateral relations since the establishment of diplomatic ties in 1950, as well as the fruitful cooperation in political, economic, cultural, educational, and scientific fields. They agreed that bilateral relations have been steadily enhanced, with growing political mutual trust and respect, and expanding economic and trade cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 双方一致认为,在双边、多边和全球事务上开展合作符合两国共同利益。
Translation: Both sides agreed that cooperation in bilateral, multilateral, and global affairs serves the common interests of both countries.

Query_Text_cn: 一、双方同意加强双边政治和经济对话。
Translation: 1. Both parties agree to strengthen bilateral political and economic dialogue.

Query_Text_cn: 保持高层互访势头,加强两国政府、立法机构和地方政府间不同形式、不同级别的友好往来,增进相互了解,建立实质性合作。
Translation: Maintain the momentum of high-level exchanges, strengthen friendly interactions between the governments, legislative bodies, and local governments of both countries in various forms and at different levels, enhance mutual understanding, and establish substantive cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 促进两国外交部间加强政治对话,开展更为密切的磋商与合作,继续保持副部级政治磋商机制,力争在北京和哥本哈根轮流举行年度会晤。
Translation: Promote strengthened political dialogue between the foreign ministries of the two countries, conduct closer consultations and cooperation, continue to maintain the vice-ministerial political consultation mechanism, and strive to hold annual meetings alternately in Beijing and Copenhagen.

Query_Text_cn: 在有关交往、双边磋商和会见中,双方可探讨加强合作的新途径,包括政府领导人或外交部长在双边或多边场合进行会晤。
Translation: In their interactions, bilateral consultations, and meetings, both sides may explore new ways to strengthen cooperation, including meetings between government leaders or foreign ministers on bilateral or multilateral occasions.

Query_Text_cn: 双方将共同努力,推动在2010年通过适当的高层互访等方式庆祝两国建交60周年。
Translation: The two sides will work together to celebrate the 60th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries in 2010 through appropriate high-level exchanges and other means.

Query_Text_cn: 丹麦重申坚定奉行一个中国政策,不支持台湾加入仅限主权国家参加的国际组织,不与台湾进行官方往来。
Translation: Denmark reiterates its firm adherence to the one-China policy, does not support Taiwan's participation in international organizations limited to sovereign states, and does not engage in official exchanges with Taiwan.

Query_Text_cn: 中方对丹方这一原则立场表示赞赏。
Translation: China appreciates Denmark's principled position.

Query_Text_cn: 丹方表达了希望通过建设性对话和平解决台湾问题的愿望。
Translation: Denmark has expressed its hope to resolve the Taiwan issue peacefully through constructive dialogue.

Query_Text_cn: 中方重申了在台湾问题上的原则立场。
Translation: The Chinese side reiterated its principled position on the Taiwan issue.

Query_Text_cn: 双方均对中欧关系的良好发展感到高兴,愿继续为深化中欧全面战略伙伴关系做出贡献。
Translation: Both sides are pleased with the positive development of China-EU relations and are willing to continue contributing to the deepening of the China-EU comprehensive strategic partnership.

Query_Text_cn: 丹麦确认,愿基于2004年中欧领导人会晤发表的联合声明和欧洲理事会随后的结论,继续朝着促成欧盟解除对华军售禁令的方向前进。
Translation: Denmark has confirmed its willingness to continue advancing toward the lifting of the EU arms embargo against China, based on the Joint Statement issued at the 2004 China-EU leaders' meeting and the subsequent conclusions of the European Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、中丹两国均完全支持公平、公正、建立在规则基础之上的多边国际体系,支持联合国在处理全球事务,以及通过协商与谈判寻求政治解决国际争端中发挥核心作用。
Translation: 2. Both China and Denmark fully support a fair, just, and rules-based multilateral international system, and support the United Nations in playing a central role in addressing global affairs and seeking political solutions to international disputes through consultation and negotiation.

Query_Text_cn: 双方支持联合国进行合理、必要的改革。
Translation: Both sides support reasonable and necessary reforms of the United Nations.
