Translation: Article 18 Identification 1. Each party to the conflict shall endeavor to ensure that medical and religious personnel, as well as medical units and means of transport, can be properly identified.

Query_Text_cn: 二、冲突每一方还应努力采取和实行使使用特殊标志和特殊信号的医疗队和运输工具有可能被认出的方法和程序。
Translation: 2. Each party to the conflict should also endeavor to adopt and implement methods and procedures that enable medical teams and transportation vehicles using special emblems and signals to be recognized.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在被占领领土内或在正在进行战斗或可能进行战斗的地区内，平民医务人员和平民宗教人员应使用特殊标志和证明其身份的身份证，使其可能被认出。
Translation: 3. In occupied territories or areas where fighting is taking place or may take place, civilian medical personnel and civilian religious personnel shall use special emblems and carry identification documents proving their identity, so that they may be recognized.

Query_Text_cn: 四、经主管当局同意，医疗队和医务运输工具应用特殊标志标明。
Translation: 4. With the approval of the competent authorities, medical teams and medical transport vehicles shall be marked with special signs.

Query_Text_cn: 本议定书第二十二条所指的船艇，应按照第二公约的规定予以标明。
Translation: Vessels referred to in Article 22 of this Protocol shall be marked in accordance with the provisions of the Second Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 五、除特殊标志外，冲突一方得按本议定书附件一第三章所规定，核准使用特殊信号，以识别医疗队和医务运输工具。
Translation: 5. Except for special signs, parties to the conflict may authorize the use of distinctive signals as specified in Chapter III of Annex I to this Protocol to identify medical units and medical transports.

Query_Text_cn: 作为例外，在该章所包括的特别情形下，医务运输工具得使用特殊信号而不展示特殊标志。
Translation: As an exception, in the special circumstances covered by this chapter, medical transport vehicles may use special signals without displaying special markings.

Query_Text_cn: 六、本条第一款到第五款的规定的适用受本议定书附件一第一章到第三章的支配。
Translation: VI. The application of paragraphs 1 to 5 of this Article is governed by Chapters I to III of Annex I to this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 该附件第三章为专门用于医疗队和医务运输工具所指定的信号，除该章所规定外，不应用于识别该章所规定的医疗队和医务运输工具以外的任何其他目的。
Translation: Chapter III of this annex specifies signals designated exclusively for medical teams and medical transport units. Except as stipulated in this chapter, these signals shall not be used for any purpose other than the identification of the medical teams and medical transport units specified herein.

Query_Text_cn: 七、本条并不核准超出第一公约第四十四条的规定外在平时更广泛地使用特殊标志。
Translation: 7. This article does not authorize the use of special emblems in peacetime beyond the provisions of Article 44 of the First Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 八、各公约和本议定书关于监督特殊标志的使用和关于防止和取缔其任何滥用的规定，应适用于特殊信号。
Translation: 8. The provisions of the Conventions and this Protocol concerning the supervision of the use of special emblems and the prevention and suppression of any misuse thereof shall apply to special signals.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条中立国家和其他非冲突各方的国家中立国家和其他非冲突各方的国家应对在其领土内收留或拘禁的受本部规定保护的人，或对其所发现的冲突各方的任何死者，适用本议定书的有关规定。
Translation:
Article 19 Neutral States and Other Non-Party States

Neutral states and other non-party states shall apply the relevant provisions of this Protocol to persons protected under these regulations who are received or detained on their territory, as well as to any deceased persons of the parties to the conflict found by them.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条对报复的禁止对本部所保护的人和物体的报复，是禁止的。
Translation:
Article 20: Prohibition of Retaliation

Retaliation against persons and objects protected by this Headquarters is prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条医务车辆医务车辆应受流动医疗队依据各公约和本议定书所受的同样尊重和保护。
Translation:
Article 21 Medical Vehicles

Medical vehicles shall be respected and protected in the same manner as mobile medical units under the relevant Conventions and this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: (一)第二公约第二十二条、第二十四条、第二十五条和第二十七条所述的船舶，(二)其救生艇和小艇，(三)其人员和船员，和(四)船上伤者、病者和遇船难者的规定，在这些船舶运载不属于第二公约第十三条所载任何一类的平民伤者、病者和遇船难者的情形下，也应适用。
Translation: The provisions concerning (1) the ships referred to in Articles 22, 24, 25, and 27 of the Second Convention, (2) their lifeboats and small boats, (3) their personnel and crew, and (4) the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked on board, shall also apply in cases where these ships are carrying civilian wounded, sick, and shipwrecked persons who do not belong to any of the categories listed in Article 13 of the Second Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 但这类平民不应将其交给非其所属的任何一方或在海上将其拿捕。
Translation: However, such civilians should not be handed over to any party other than their own, nor should they be captured at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 这类平民如果在其所属以外的冲突一方权力下，应包括在第四公约和本议定书的规定范围内。
Translation: Such civilians, if under the authority of a party to the conflict other than their own, should be covered by the provisions of the Fourth Convention and this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 二、各公约对第二公约第二十五条所述船舶所提供的保护，应扩展于(一)中立国家或其他非该冲突一方的国家，或(二)公正的国际人道主义组织，为了人道主义目的向冲突一方提供的医院船，但在上述任何一种情形下，均须符合该条所列的要求。
Translation: 2. The protection afforded by Article 25 of the Second Convention to the vessels referred to therein shall be extended to: (a) hospital ships belonging to neutral States or other States not party to the conflict, or (b) hospital ships operated by impartial international humanitarian organizations for humanitarian purposes for the benefit of a party to the conflict, provided that in either case the requirements set forth in that Article are met.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第二公约第二十七条所述的小艇，即使未发出该条所规定的通知，也应受保护。
Translation: 3. The small boats referred to in Article 27 of the Second Convention shall be protected even if the notification prescribed in that Article has not been given.

Query_Text_cn: 而关于任何其他足以便利识别和认出这类小艇的有关细节，请冲突各方彼此通知。
Translation: As for any other details sufficient to facilitate the identification and recognition of such small craft, the parties to the conflict shall notify each other accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条其他医务船艇一、本议定书第二十二条和第二公约第三十八条所指以外的医务船艇，不论在海上或在其他水域内，均应受流动医疗队依据各公约和本议定书所受的同样尊重和保护。
Translation:
Article 23 Other Medical Vessels

1. Medical vessels other than those referred to in Article 22 of this Protocol and Article 38 of the Second Convention, whether at sea or in other waters, shall be accorded the same respect and protection as mobile medical units under the Conventions and this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 由于这种保护只有在这类船艇能被识别和认出的条件下才能有效，因而这类船艇应以特殊标志标明，并尽可能遵从第二公约第四十三条第二款的规定。
Translation: Since such protection is effective only when these vessels can be identified and recognized, they should be marked with distinctive signs and, as far as possible, comply with the provisions of Article 43, paragraph 2, of the Second Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第一款所指的船艇应仍受战争法规的拘束。
Translation: 2. The vessels referred to in the first paragraph shall remain subject to the laws of war.

Query_Text_cn: 任何有可能立即强制执行其命令的水面战舰，得命令这类船艇停航，或命令其驶离，或使其航驶一定航线，而这类船艇应服从每一项这类命令。
Translation: Any surface warship capable of immediately enforcing its orders shall have the authority to order such vessels to stop, to leave, or to follow a specified course, and such vessels shall comply with each of these orders.

Query_Text_cn: 这类船艇，只要为船上伤者、病者和遇船难者所需，即不得以任何其他方式改变其医务使命。
Translation: Such vessels shall be used exclusively for medical purposes required by the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked on board, and their medical mission shall not be diverted for any other purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第一款所规定的保护，仅应在第二公约第三十四条和第三十五条所列的条件下停止。
Translation: 3. The protection stipulated in Paragraph 1 shall only cease under the conditions specified in Articles 34 and 35 of the Second Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 明显地拒绝服从按照第二款所发出的命令，应是第二公约第三十四条所规定的害敌行为。
Translation: A clear refusal to comply with an order issued under paragraph 2 shall constitute an act harmful to the enemy as defined in Article 34 of the Second Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 四、冲突一方得尽可能在医务船艇，特别是超过2000总吨的船舶出航前，将其名称、形状、预定出航时间、航线和估计的速度通知任何敌方，并得提供任何其他便于识别和认出的情报。
Translation: 4. The parties to the conflict shall, as far as possible, notify any adverse party, particularly before the departure of hospital ships and craft exceeding 2,000 gross tons, of their names, descriptions, intended time of departure, routes, and estimated speeds, and may provide any other information that would facilitate their identification and recognition.

Query_Text_cn: 敌方应表明收到这项情报。
Translation: The opposing party should acknowledge receipt of this information.

Query_Text_cn: 五、第二公约第三十七条的规定应适用于这类船艇上的医务和宗教人员。
Translation: 5. The provisions of Article 37 of the Second Convention shall apply to medical and religious personnel on such vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 六、第二公约的规定应适用于这类船艇上属于第二公约第十三条和本议定书第四十四条所指各类的伤者、病者和遇船难者。
Translation: 6. The provisions of the Second Convention shall apply to the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked persons of the categories referred to in Article 13 of the Second Convention and Article 44 of this Protocol who are on such vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 这类平民如果在其所属一方以外的冲突一方权力下，应包括在第四公约和本议定书的规定的范围内。
Translation: Such civilians, if under the authority of a party to the conflict other than their own, should be covered by the provisions of the Fourth Convention and this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条对医务飞机的保护在本部规定的拘束下，医务飞机应受尊重和保护。
Translation:
Article 24 Protection of Medical Aircraft

Subject to the restrictions set forth in this Section, medical aircraft shall be respected and protected.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条敌方未控制的地区内医务飞机在友方部队所实际控制的陆地地区内或其上空，或在敌方所未实际控制的海域内或其上空，对冲突一方医务飞机的尊重和保护，不依赖于与敌方订立的任何协定。
Translation: Article 25 The respect and protection of medical aircraft of a Party to the conflict operating within or over land areas actually controlled by friendly forces, or within or over sea areas not actually controlled by the enemy, in territories not under enemy control, shall not be dependent on any agreement with the enemy.

Query_Text_cn: 但为更安全起见，在这些地区内操纵医务飞机的冲突一方，得按第二十九条所规定，通知敌方，特别是在该飞机飞行进入敌方地对空武器系统射程时，更须通知。
Translation: For greater safety, however, the party to the conflict operating medical aircraft within these areas must, in accordance with Article 29, notify the enemy, and such notification is especially required when the aircraft enters the range of the enemy's ground-to-air weapon systems.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条接触或类似地带内医务飞机一、在友方部队所实际控制的接触地带的一些部分内和其上空，以及在实际控制权未明显确立的地区内或其上空，只有按第二十九条所规定，冲突各方主管军事当局之间事先取得协议，医务飞机才能得到充分有效的保护。
Translation:
Article 26: Medical Aircraft in Contact or Similar Zones

1. In certain parts of the contact zone actually controlled by friendly forces and in the airspace above, as well as in areas or airspace where effective control has not been clearly established, medical aircraft shall only be fully and effectively protected if prior agreement has been reached between the competent military authorities of the parties to the conflict, as stipulated in Article 29.

Query_Text_cn: 在没有这种协议的情形下，医务飞机虽其操纵须自冒风险，但在其已被认出是医务飞机后，仍应受尊重。
Translation: In the absence of such an agreement, although medical aircraft must operate at their own risk, they should still be respected once they have been identified as medical aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 二、"接触地带”是指敌对部队的先头部分彼此接触，特别是该部分已直接暴露于地面火力下的任何陆地地区。
Translation: 2. "Contact zone" refers to any land area where the leading elements of opposing forces are in contact with each other, especially where these elements are directly exposed to ground fire.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条敌方控制的地区内医务飞机一、冲突一方的医务飞机在敌方所实际控制的陆地地区或海域上空飞行时，应继续受保护，但须事先取得该敌方的主管当局对这项飞行的同意。
Translation:
Article 27 Medical Aircraft in Areas Controlled by the Adverse Party

1. Medical aircraft of one party to the conflict flying over land areas or sea areas actually controlled by the adverse party shall continue to be protected, but must obtain prior consent for such flights from the competent authorities of the adverse party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、由于航行错误或因影响飞行安全的紧急状态而在未取得第一款所规定的同意或违反该项同意的情形下飞行于敌方所实际控制的地区上空的医务飞机，应尽力使其能被识别，并应将情况通知敌方。
Translation: 2. In the event that a medical aircraft flies over areas actually controlled by the enemy due to navigational errors or because of an emergency affecting flight safety, without obtaining the consent specified in the preceding paragraph or in violation of such consent, every effort shall be made to ensure that the aircraft can be identified, and the situation shall be notified to the enemy.

Query_Text_cn: 一旦这类医务飞机为敌方所认出，该方应尽一切合理努力，立即发出第三十条第一款所指的着陆或降落水面的命令，或采取保障其本身利益的其他措施，并在上述任何一种情形下，应在对该飞机进行攻击前，允许该飞机有遵从命令的时间。
Translation: Once such medical aircraft are recognized by the opposing party, that party shall make every reasonable effort to immediately issue the order to land or alight on water as referred to in paragraph 1 of Article 30, or take other measures to safeguard its own interests. In any of these situations, the aircraft must be given sufficient time to comply with the order before any attack is carried out against it.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条对医务飞机运用的限制一、禁止冲突各方利用其医务飞机，以图从敌方取得任何军事利益。
Translation:
Article 28 Restrictions on the Use of Medical Aircraft

1. It is prohibited for parties to a conflict to use their medical aircraft in order to obtain any military advantage over the enemy.

Query_Text_cn: 医务飞机的存在不应被利用，以图使军事目标不受攻击。
Translation: The existence of medical aircraft should not be exploited to shield military targets from attack.

Query_Text_cn: 二、医务飞机不应被利用，以收集或传送情报资料，并不应携带旨在用于这项目的的任何器材。
Translation: 2. Medical aircraft shall not be used to collect or transmit intelligence information, nor shall they carry any equipment intended for such purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 禁止医务飞机运载任何不包括在第八条第六款的定义内的任何人或货物。
Translation: Medical aircraft are prohibited from carrying any persons or goods not included in the definition provided in Article 8, Paragraph 6.

Query_Text_cn: 飞机运载机上人员的个人物品或目的仅在便利航行、通讯或识别的装备，不应视为属于禁止之列。
Translation: Personal belongings of individuals on board an aircraft carrier, or equipment intended solely for facilitating navigation, communication, or identification, should not be considered as prohibited items.

Query_Text_cn: 三、医务飞机不应携带任何武器，但取自飞机上伤者、病者和遇船难者而尚未送交主管部门的轻兵器及弹药，以及使船上医务人员能自卫和保卫在其照顾下的伤者、病者和遇船难者所需的个人轻武器除外。
Translation: 3. Medical aircraft shall not carry any weapons, except for light personal arms and ammunition taken from the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked persons on board the aircraft and not yet handed over to the competent authorities, as well as such light personal weapons as may be necessary for the medical personnel on board to defend themselves and to protect the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked persons under their care.

Query_Text_cn: 四、在进行第二十六条和第二十七条所指的飞行时，医务飞机除与敌方事先达成协议外，不应用以搜寻伤者、病者和遇船难者。
Translation: 4. When conducting flights referred to in Articles 26 and 27, medical aircraft shall not be used to search for the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked, except by prior agreement with the enemy.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条关于医务飞机的通知和协议一、第二十五条所规定的通知或为取得第二十六条、第二十七条、第二十八条第四款或第三十一条所规定的事先协议而提出的请求，应说明医务飞机的计划数目、其飞行计划和识别方法，并应被理解为含有每次飞行均将遵照第二十八条的规定的意思。
Translation:
Article 29 Notification and Agreement Concerning Medical Aircraft

1. Notifications as stipulated in Article 25, or requests made to obtain prior agreements as provided in Articles 26, 27, paragraph 4 of Article 28, or Article 31, shall specify the planned number of medical aircraft, their flight plans, and methods of identification, and shall be understood to imply that each flight will comply with the provisions of Article 28.

Query_Text_cn: 二、收到第二十五条所规定的通知的一方，应立即表明收到该通知。
Translation: 2. The party receiving the notice stipulated in Article 25 shall immediately acknowledge receipt of such notice.

Query_Text_cn: 或(三)提出对该请求的合理的替代建议。
Translation: or (iii) propose a reasonable alternative to the request.

Query_Text_cn: 该方还得提议，在所涉时间内禁止或限制在该地区内的其他飞行。
Translation: The party must also propose to prohibit or restrict other flights within the area during the specified period.

Query_Text_cn: 提出请求的一方，如果接受替代建议，应将其接受通知他方。
Translation: If the requesting party accepts the alternative proposal, it shall notify the other party of its acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: 四、各方应采取必要措施，以保证能迅速地发出通知和取得协议。
Translation: 4. All parties shall take necessary measures to ensure that notifications can be promptly issued and agreements can be promptly reached.

Query_Text_cn: 五、各方还应采取必要措施，迅速向有关军事单位传播任何该通知和协议的内容，并将有关医务飞机所使用的识别方法指示该军事单位。
Translation: 5. All parties shall also take necessary measures to promptly communicate the contents of this notification and agreement to the relevant military units, and instruct these units on the methods of identification used by medical aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条医务飞机的降落和检查一、对在敌方所实际控制的地区上空或在实际控制权未明显确立的地区上空飞行的医务飞机，得按适当情况命令其着陆或降落水面，以便按照下列各款进行检查。
Translation:
Article 30 Landing and Inspection of Medical Aircraft

1. Medical aircraft flying over areas actually controlled by the enemy, or over areas where effective control has not been clearly established, may be ordered to land or alight on water as appropriate, in order to be inspected in accordance with the following provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 医务飞机应服从任何这类命令。
Translation: Medical aircraft shall comply with any such orders.

Query_Text_cn: 二、这类飞机，不论因被命令或基于其他原因而着陆或降落水面，仅得因确定第三款和第四款所指的事项而受检查。
Translation: 2. Such aircraft, whether landing or alighting on water due to orders or for other reasons, may only be inspected for the purpose of determining the matters referred to in paragraphs 3 and 4.

Query_Text_cn: 任何这种检查应立即开始，并应从速进行。
Translation: Any such inspection should commence immediately and be conducted expeditiously.

Query_Text_cn: 检查一方对于伤者和病者，除为检查所需外，不应要求将其移离飞机。
Translation: The inspecting party should not require the injured or ill to be removed from the aircraft except as necessary for inspection.

Query_Text_cn: 该方无论如何应保证伤者和病者的状况不因检查或移离而受不利的影响。
Translation: In any case, the party concerned shall ensure that the condition of the wounded and sick is not adversely affected by inspection or removal.

Query_Text_cn: (一)是第八条第十款的意义内的医务飞机，(二)不违反第二十八条所规定的条件，而且(三)在需要事先协议的情形下，其飞行并非事先没有协议或并不破坏事先协议的规定，该飞机和属于敌方或属于中立国家或其他非冲突一方的其他国家的机上人员，应准其立即继续飞行。
Translation: (a) It is a medical aircraft within the meaning of Article 8, paragraph 10; (b) it does not violate the conditions stipulated in Article 28; and (c) in cases where prior agreement is required, its flight is not conducted without such agreement nor does it contravene the provisions of any prior agreement. The aircraft, as well as personnel on board belonging to the enemy, neutral states, or other states not party to the conflict, shall be permitted to continue their flight immediately.

Query_Text_cn: (一)不是第八条第十款的意义内的医务飞机，(二)违反第二十八条所规定的条件，或(三)在需要事先协议的情形下，其飞行并无事先协议或破坏事先协议的规定；对该飞机得予拿捕。
Translation: (a) If the aircraft is not a medical aircraft within the meaning of Article 8, paragraph 10, (b) violates the conditions stipulated in Article 28, or (c) in cases where prior agreement is required, operates without such agreement or contravenes the provisions of the prior agreement, the aircraft may be seized.

Query_Text_cn: 对机上人员应按照各公约和本议定书的有关规定给予待遇。
Translation: The treatment of persons on board shall be in accordance with the relevant provisions of the conventions and this protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 曾被派为常设医务飞机的任何飞机，被拿捕后仅得用为医务飞机。
Translation: Any aircraft that has been designated as a permanent medical aircraft may, after being captured, be used only as a medical aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条中立国家或其他非冲突各方的国家一、除有事先协议外，医务飞机不应在中立国家或其他非冲突一方的国家的领土上空飞行，或在该领土内降落。
Translation:
Article 31 Neutral States or Other Non-Conflicting Parties

1. Except by prior agreement, medical aircraft shall not fly over or land on the territory of neutral States or other States not party to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 但在有事先协议的情形下，医务飞机在其全部飞行中以及在该领土内任何停留期间，则均应受尊重。
Translation: However, in cases where prior agreement has been reached, medical aircraft shall be respected throughout their entire flight and during any stopovers within that territory.

Query_Text_cn: 然而该医务飞机仍应服从着陆或在适当情况下降落水面的任何命令。
Translation: However, the medical aircraft shall still comply with any order to land or, when appropriate, to alight on water.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果医务飞机由于航行错误或因影响飞行安全的紧急状态而在没有协议或背离协议规定的情形下飞行于中立国家或其他非冲突一方的国家的领土上空，该飞机应尽力发出飞行的通知，并使自己能被识别。
Translation: 2. If a medical aircraft flies over the territory of a neutral country or another non-conflicting party without an agreement or in deviation from the terms of an agreement due to navigational errors or an emergency affecting flight safety, the aircraft shall make every effort to give notice of its flight and ensure it can be identified.

Query_Text_cn: 一旦这类医务飞机被认出，该国应尽一切合理努力，立即发出第三十条第一款所指的着陆或降落水面的命令，或采取保障其本身的利益的其他措施，并在上述任何一种情形下，应在对该飞机进行攻击前，允许该飞行有遵从命令的时间。
Translation: Once such medical aircraft have been identified, the State shall make every reasonable effort to immediately issue the order to land or alight on water as referred to in Article 30, paragraph 1, or take other measures to safeguard its own interests. In any of the above circumstances, before attacking the aircraft, the State shall allow sufficient time for the aircraft to comply with the order.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如果医务飞机依据协议或在第二款所载的情况下，不论因被命令着陆或降落水面或基于其他原因，而在中立国家或其他非冲突一方的国家的领土内着陆或降落水面，该飞机应受检查，以确定其在事实上是否医务飞机。
Translation: 3. If a medical aircraft, pursuant to an agreement or under the circumstances described in paragraph 2, lands or alights on water within the territory of a neutral State or any other State not party to the conflict, whether by order or for any other reason, the aircraft shall be subject to inspection to determine whether it is in fact a medical aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 检查应立即开始，并应从速进行。
Translation: The inspection should commence immediately and be carried out without delay.

Query_Text_cn: 对属于操纵飞机的一方的伤者和病者，除其移离飞机为检查所需外，检查一方不应要求其移离飞机。
Translation: For injured or ill persons belonging to the party operating the aircraft, except when removal from the aircraft is necessary for inspection, the inspecting party shall not require their removal from the aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 检查一方无论如何应保证伤者和病者的状况不因检查或移离而受不利的影响。
Translation: The inspecting party must ensure that, under all circumstances, the condition of the wounded and sick is not adversely affected by inspection or removal.

Query_Text_cn: 如果检查表明，该飞机在事实上是医务飞机，则该飞机及其机上人员，除按照适用于武装冲突的国际法规则必须予以拘留外，应准其恢复飞行，并应给予继续飞行的合理便利。
Translation: If the inspection shows that the aircraft is indeed a medical aircraft, the aircraft and its personnel shall be permitted to resume flight and be provided with reasonable facilities for continuing their journey, except where detention is required under the rules of international law applicable to armed conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 如果检查表明，飞机不是医务飞机，对该飞机应予拿捕，机上人员应按照第四款的规定享受待遇。
Translation: If an inspection reveals that the aircraft is not a medical aircraft, the aircraft shall be subject to capture, and the personnel on board shall be treated in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 4.

Query_Text_cn: 四、经地方当局同意，在中立国家或其他非冲突一方的国家领土内，并非临时地从医务飞机下来的伤者、病者和遇船难者，除该国和冲突各方之间另有协议外，如果适用于武装冲突的国际法规则有此要求，则应由该国予以拘留，使其不能再从事敌对行动。
Translation: 4. With the consent of local authorities, wounded, sick, and shipwrecked persons who disembark from medical aircraft in the territory of a neutral country or any other state not party to the conflict, and who are not merely temporarily present, shall, unless otherwise agreed between that country and the parties to the conflict, be detained by that country if required by the rules of international law applicable to armed conflict, so as to prevent them from taking part in hostilities again.

Query_Text_cn: 医院治疗和拘禁的费用应由这类人所属的国家负担。
Translation: The costs of medical treatment and detention for such individuals should be borne by their respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 五、中立国家或其他非冲突各方的国家，应对冲突所有各方同样适用关于医务飞机在其领土上空通过或在其领土内着陆的任何条件和限制。
Translation: 5. Neutral countries or other states not party to the conflict shall apply any conditions and restrictions regarding the passage or landing of medical aircraft over or within their territory equally to all parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条一般原则在执行本段的规定时，缔约各方、冲突各方和各公约和本议定书所载的国际人道主义组织的活动，主要应受家庭了解其亲属命运的权利的推动。
Translation: Article 32 General Principle: In implementing the provisions of this section, the activities of the Parties to the conflict, the Parties to the Convention, and the international humanitarian organizations mentioned in the Convention and this Protocol shall be primarily motivated by the right of families to know the fate of their relatives.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条失踪的人一、一旦情况许可，并至迟从实际战斗结束时开始，冲突各方应即搜寻经敌方报告为失踪的人。
Translation:
Article 33 Missing Persons

1. As soon as circumstances permit, and at the latest from the end of active hostilities, each party to the conflict shall search for persons reported missing by the opposing party.

Query_Text_cn: 该敌方应发送有关这类人的一切情报，以便利搜寻。
Translation: The opposing party shall transmit all information concerning such individuals to facilitate their search.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在最大可能范围内便利、并于需要时进行搜寻这类人的工作，以及如果这类人由于敌对行动或占领而在其他情况下死亡，将其有关情报记录下来的工作。
Translation: (b) To facilitate, to the greatest extent possible, and when necessary, to conduct searches for such persons, as well as to record relevant information if such persons die as a result of hostile actions or occupation, or under other circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 三、按照第一款已报告为失踪的人的有关情报以及获得这种情报的请求，应直接或通过保护国或红十字国际委员会中央查访局或各国红十字会(红新月会、红狮与太阳会)发送。
Translation: 3. Information concerning persons reported missing under the first paragraph, as well as requests for such information, shall be transmitted directly or through the Protecting Power, the Central Tracing Agency of the International Committee of the Red Cross, or the National Red Cross (Red Crescent, Red Lion and Sun) Societies.

Query_Text_cn: 在未通过红十字国际委员会及其中央查访局发送情报的情形下，冲突一方也应保证向中央查访局提供该项情报。
Translation: In cases where information is not transmitted through the International Committee of the Red Cross and its Central Tracing Agency, the party to the conflict shall nevertheless ensure that such information is provided to the Central Tracing Agency.

Query_Text_cn: 四、冲突各方应努力商定关于搜寻、识别和收回战地上死者的工作组的安排，并于适当时，包括关于在敌方控制地区内执行这项任务时由敌方人员伴随工作组的安排。
Translation: IV. All parties to the conflict should endeavor to agree on arrangements for a working group responsible for the search, identification, and retrieval of the deceased on the battlefield, and, when appropriate, include provisions for the accompaniment of the working group by personnel from the opposing side when carrying out such tasks in areas under enemy control.

Query_Text_cn: 这类工作组在专门履行这项职责时，应受尊重和保护。
Translation: Such working groups should be respected and protected when performing this specific duty.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条死者尸体一、基于与占领有关的原因死亡或因占领或敌对行动而在拘留中死亡的人的尸体，以及不是基于敌对行动的原因而死亡的所在地国家的国民的人的尸体，均应受尊重，所有这类人的墓地，如果依据各公约和本议定书不受更优惠的考虑，应按照第四公约第一百三十条的规定，受尊重、维护并予以标明。
Translation:
Article 34: The Bodies of the Deceased

1. The bodies of persons who have died for reasons related to occupation or who have died in detention due to occupation or hostilities, as well as the bodies of persons who are nationals of the country of residence and have died for reasons not related to hostilities, shall be respected. All graves of such persons, unless they receive more favorable treatment under the Conventions and this Protocol, shall be respected, maintained, and properly marked in accordance with Article 130 of the Fourth Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （三）便利在本国请求下，或除该国反对外，在最近亲属请求下，送还死者的尸体和个人用品。
Translation: (3) Facilitate, upon the request of the home country or, unless the country objects, at the request of the next of kin, the repatriation of the deceased's remains and personal belongings.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在未订立第二款第二项或第三项所规定的协定的情形下，如果死者本国不愿自己支付费用以安排这类墓地的维护，墓地所在地的缔约一方得建议将死者尸体送还其本国。
Translation: 3. In the absence of an agreement as stipulated in Item 2 or 3 of Paragraph 2, if the deceased's home country is unwilling to bear the costs of maintaining such graves, the Contracting Party in whose territory the cemetery is located may propose that the remains of the deceased be returned to their home country.

Query_Text_cn: 如果这项建议未被接受，缔约一方得在提出建议满五年后，并在向死者本国发出适当通知后，采取其本国关于坟墓的法律所规定的安排。
Translation: If this proposal is not accepted, the Contracting Party may, after five years from the date the proposal was made and upon giving appropriate notice to the deceased's country, make arrangements in accordance with its own national laws concerning graves.

Query_Text_cn: “五、缔约国一方居民转让其在缔约国另一方居民公司资本中的股份、参股或其他权利取得的收益，如果取得该收益的人在该转让行为前12个月内，曾经直接或间接参与拥有该公司至少25%的资本，可以在缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: 5. Gains derived by a resident of one Contracting State from the alienation of shares, interests, or other rights in the capital of a company that is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State if, at any time during the 12 months preceding such alienation, the person deriving the gains directly or indirectly held at least 25% of the capital of that company.

Query_Text_cn: “六、转让第一款至第五款所述财产以外的其他财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国征税。
Translation: 6. Income derived from the transfer of property other than those referred to in paragraphs 1 to 5 shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the transferor is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方主管当局应交换可以预见与执行本协定的规定相关的情报，或与执行缔约国双方或其地方当局征收的各种税收的国内法律相关的情报，以根据这些法律征税与本协定不相抵触为限。
Translation: 1. The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall exchange information that is foreseeably relevant to the implementation and enforcement of the provisions of this Agreement, or to the domestic laws concerning the imposition of various taxes by either Contracting State or their local authorities, to the extent that taxation under such laws is not contrary to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国双方政府应通过外交换函，确认已履行为本议定书生效所必需的国内法律程序。
Translation: The governments of both contracting parties shall confirm, through an exchange of diplomatic notes, that the necessary domestic legal procedures for the entry into force of this Protocol have been completed.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在毛里求斯，本议定书生效之日后7月1日或以后开始的所得年度中取得的所得。
Translation: (b) In Mauritius, income derived in any year of assessment beginning on or after July 1 following the date of entry into force of this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 本议定书应随协定长期有效。
Translation: This Protocol shall remain in effect alongside the Agreement for the long term.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表，经正式授权，已在本议定书上签字为证。
Translation: The undersigned representatives, duly authorized, have signed this Protocol as evidence thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本议定书于二零零六年九月五日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文和英文写成。
Translation: This Protocol was signed in Beijing on September 5, 2006, in duplicate, each copy being written in both Chinese and English.

Query_Text_cn: 如在文本解释上有分歧，应以英文本为准。
Translation: In case of discrepancies in textual interpretation, the English version shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: (22)“1994年《商标法条约》”指1994年10月27日于日内瓦签订的《商标法条约》。
Translation: "(22) 'Trademark Law Treaty of 1994' refers to the Trademark Law Treaty signed in Geneva on October 27, 1994."

Query_Text_cn: 第二条本条约适用的商标一、[商标的性质]任何缔约方法律规定可以作为商标注册的标志所构成的商标均应适用本条约。
Translation:
Article 2: Trademarks to Which This Treaty Applies

1. [Nature of Marks] This Treaty shall apply to any trademark consisting of signs that, under the law of a Contracting Party, are eligible for registration as trademarks.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[商标的种类](一)本条约应适用于与商品有关的商标(商品商标)或与服务有关的商标(服务商标),或与商品和服务均有关的商标。
Translation:
II. Types of Trademarks  
(1) This Treaty shall apply to trademarks related to goods (goods trademarks), trademarks related to services (service trademarks), or trademarks related to both goods and services.

Query_Text_cn: (二)本条约不应适用于集体商标、证明商标和保证商标。
Translation: (b) This Treaty shall not apply to collective marks, certification marks, or guarantee marks.

Query_Text_cn: (16)缔约方法律要求提交的有意使用该商标的声明。
Translation: A declaration of intent to use the trademark as required by the laws of the contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: (二)按照缔约方法律的要求,申请人可以提交实际使用商标的声明和相关证据,作为对本款第(一)项(16)目所指有意使用商标的声明的替代或补充。
Translation: (2) In accordance with the requirements of the law of the contracting party, the applicant may submit a declaration of actual use of the trademark and relevant evidence as a substitute for or supplement to the declaration of intent to use the trademark referred to in item (16) of subparagraph (1) of this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: (三)任何缔约方均可以要求,提交注册申请须向商标主管机关缴纳费用。
Translation: (3) Any contracting party may require that fees be paid to the trademark authority for the submission of a registration application.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[一件申请多类注册]同一申请可以涉及多项商品或服务,无论其在《尼斯分类》中同属一个类别还是分属多个类别。
Translation: 2. [Multiple Class Registration in a Single Application] A single application may cover multiple goods or services, regardless of whether they fall under the same class or different classes in the Nice Classification.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[实际使用]任何缔约方均可以要求,已经按照本条第一款第(一)项第(16)目的规定提交有意使用商标声明的,申请人须在法律规定的期限(应不少于本条约《实施细则》规定的最短期限)内,按该法律的要求向商标主管机关提交商标实际使用的证据。
Translation: 3. [Actual Use] Any Contracting Party may require that an applicant who has submitted a declaration of intent to use a trademark pursuant to Article 1(1)(xvi) of this Article must, within the period prescribed by law (which shall not be less than the minimum period specified in the Regulations under this Treaty), submit evidence of actual use of the trademark to the competent trademark authority in accordance with the requirements of such law.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[禁止其他要求]除本条第一款、第三款及本条约第八条所提及的要求外,任何缔约方不得就申请另行规定其他要求。
Translation: 4. [Prohibition of Other Requirements] Except for the requirements specified in Paragraphs 1 and 3 of this Article and Article 8 of this Treaty, no Contracting Party shall impose any additional requirements on applications.

Query_Text_cn: (4)提交该商标已在其他缔约方获得注册,或已在非缔约方的《巴黎公约》成员国获得注册的证据。__UNDEF__申请人要求适用《巴黎公约》第六条之五规定的除外。
Translation: (4) Submit evidence that the trademark has already been registered in another contracting party, or has been registered in a non-contracting party that is a member of the Paris Convention. __UNDEF__ The applicant requests the exception provided for in Article 6quinquies of the Paris Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关在审查过程中对申请中的任何说明或项目的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: 5. [Evidence] Any Contracting Party may require that, if the trademark authority has reasonable doubts about the authenticity of any statement or item in the application during the examination process, relevant evidence must be provided to the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: (2)应提供其在缔约方规定的领土内的一个地址作为其地址。
Translation: (2) It shall provide an address within the territory specified by the Contracting Party as its registered address.

Query_Text_cn: (二)符合缔约方根据本款第(一)项所适用的要求的代理人,向商标主管机关采取的或与之相关的任何代理行为,应具有与委托该代理人的申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人所采取的或与之相关的行为同样的效力。
Translation: (b) Any act undertaken by an agent who meets the requirements applied by the Contracting Party under subparagraph (a) of this paragraph, before or in relation to the trademark authority, shall have the same effect as if it had been undertaken by the applicant, the holder of the registration, or any other interested party who appointed the agent.

Query_Text_cn: 送达地址](一)任何缔约方均可以要求,在其境内既无住所又无真实有效的工商营业所的申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人,向商标主管机关办理任何业务,必须委托代理人办理。
Translation: Delivery Address: (1) Any contracting party may require that applicants, registered holders, or other interested parties who have neither a domicile nor a genuine and effective commercial establishment within its territory must appoint an agent to handle any business with the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: (二)如果缔约方未要求按照本款第(一)项规定指定代理人,则该缔约方可以要求,在其境内既无住所又无真实有效的工商营业所的申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人,向商标主管机关办理任何业务,必须在其境内有送达地址。
Translation: (2) If a Contracting Party does not require the appointment of a representative as stipulated in item (1) of this paragraph, it may require that any applicant, registered holder, or other interested party who has neither a domicile nor a genuine and effective place of business within its territory must provide an address for service within its territory when conducting any business with the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[委托书](一)如果缔约方允许或要求申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人通过代理人向商标主管机关办理有关业务,则该缔约方可以要求须以专函的形式(以下称为“委托书”)委托代理人,并视情况注明申请人、注册持有人或其他相关人的名称。
Translation:
III. Power of Attorney

(1) If a Contracting Party permits or requires an applicant, registered holder, or other interested party to conduct relevant business with the trademark authority through an agent, that Contracting Party may require the appointment of the agent by means of a specific written document (hereinafter referred to as the "Power of Attorney"), and, as appropriate, indicate the name of the applicant, registered holder, or other relevant party.

Query_Text_cn: (二)委托书可以涉及委托人指定的一件或多件申请或注册,也可以涉及委托人现有的和将来的全部申请或注册,但委托人声明的例外情况除外。
Translation: (2) The power of attorney may pertain to one or more applications or registrations designated by the principal, or it may cover all existing and future applications or registrations of the principal, except for any exceptions expressly stated by the principal.

Query_Text_cn: (三)委托书可以将代理人的权力限制在一定范围。
Translation: (3) The power of attorney may limit the agent's authority to a certain scope.

Query_Text_cn: 任何缔约方均可以要求,赋予代理人撤回申请或放弃注册的权力,必须在委托书中明确规定。
Translation: Any contracting party may require that the power to withdraw an application or abandon a registration be expressly stipulated in the power of attorney if it is to be granted to an agent.

Query_Text_cn: (四)缔约方商标主管机关可以规定,如果某人在向商标主管机关递交的文函中自称为代理人,但商标主管机关在收到文函时没有收到所要求提供的委托书的,可以要求其在规定期限(应不少于本条约《实施细则》规定的最短期限)内将委托书递交商标主管机关。
Translation: (4) The trademark authority of a Contracting Party may stipulate that if a person claims to be an agent in a written communication submitted to the trademark authority, but the required power of attorney has not been received by the authority at the time of receipt of the communication, the authority may require that the power of attorney be submitted within a prescribed period (which shall not be shorter than the minimum period specified in the Regulations under this Treaty).

Query_Text_cn: 任何缔约方均可以规定,未能在规定期限内将委托书递交商标主管机关的,该人递交的该文函无效。
Translation: Any contracting party may stipulate that if a power of attorney is not submitted to the trademark authority within the prescribed period, the document submitted by that person shall be deemed invalid.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[委托书的提及]任何缔约方均可以要求,代理人就所代理的业务向商标主管机关递交的任何文函,均须提及其据以代理该业务的委托书。
Translation: 4. [Reference to Power of Attorney] Any contracting party may require that the agent, in any correspondence submitted to the trademark authority regarding the business they represent, must refer to the power of attorney authorizing them to act in such business.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[禁止其他要求]除本条第三款、第四款及本条约第八条所提及的要求外,任何缔约方不得就上述条款所指事项另行规定其他要求。
Translation: 5. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] Except as provided in Paragraphs 3 and 4 of this Article and Article 8 of this Treaty, no Contracting Party shall impose any additional requirements concerning the matters referred to in the above provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 六、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对本条第三款、第四款所指任何文函内容的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: 6. [Evidence] Any contracting party may request that, if the trademark authority has reasonable doubts about the authenticity of any written content referred to in paragraphs 3 and 4 of this Article, relevant evidence must be provided to the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: (6)在适用本条约第三条第一款第(一)项第(16)目或第(二)项时,缔约方法律要求提交的本条约第三条第一款第(一)项第(16)目所指的声明,或本条约第三条第一款第(二)项所指的声明和证据。
Translation: (6) When applying subparagraph (16) of Article 3, paragraph 1(a), or paragraph 1(b) of Article 3 of this Treaty, the declaration referred to in subparagraph (16) of Article 3, paragraph 1(a), or the declaration and evidence referred to in Article 3, paragraph 1(b), as required by the laws of the Contracting Parties, shall be submitted.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何缔约方均可以规定,以商标主管机关收到本款第(一)项所提及的部分而非全部说明和项目的日期,或以收到不符合本条约第八条第二款的语言要求的说明和项目的日期为申请日期。
Translation: (b) Any Contracting Party may provide that the date of receipt by the trademark office of the description and items referred to in item (i) of this paragraph, if not all are received, or the date of receipt of the description and items not complying with the language requirements of Article 8(2) of this Treaty, shall be regarded as the filing date.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[准许的附加要求](一)缔约方可以规定,在缴纳费用之前不得确定申请日期。
Translation: II. [Permitted Additional Requirements] (1) A Contracting Party may stipulate that the filing date of an application shall not be determined until the payment of fees has been made.

Query_Text_cn: (二)缔约方只有在加入本条约时就适用本款第(一)项要求的,才可以适用这一要求。
Translation: (ii) A Contracting Party may apply the requirement set forth in paragraph (i) of this Article only if it has declared its intention to do so at the time of accession to this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[更正和期限]本条第一款和第二款下的更正方式和期限应在本条约《实施细则》中予以确定。
Translation: III. [Correction and Time Limit] The methods and time limits for correction under Paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall be specified in the Implementation Rules of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[禁止其他要求]除本条第一款和第二款规定的要求外,任何缔约方不得就申请日期另行规定其他要求。
Translation: IV. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] Except for the requirements stipulated in Paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, no Contracting Party shall impose any other requirements regarding the date of application.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一件申请多类注册同一件申请中含有《尼斯分类》中多个类别的商品或服务的,该申请应按同一注册办理。
Translation:
Article 6: Multiple Classes in One Application

If an application for registration covers goods or services in multiple classes as defined by the Nice Classification, the application shall be processed as a single registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条申请和注册的分解一、[申请的分解](一)涉及多项商品或服务的任何申请(以下称为“原申请”),可以(1)至少在商标主管机关对该商标能否注册作出决定之前,(2)在对商标主管机关作出的注册决定进行任何异议程序期间,(3)在对商标主管机关作出的注册决定进行任何上诉程序期间,由申请人或经申请人请求将其分为两件或多件申请(以下称为“分申请”),分别就“原申请”中所涉及的商品或服务提出申请。
Translation:
Article 7: Division of Application and Registration

I. Division of Application

(1) Any application involving multiple goods or services (hereinafter referred to as the “original application”) may, at the request of the applicant or upon the applicant’s request, be divided into two or more applications (hereinafter referred to as “divisional applications”) with respect to the goods or services covered by the original application, under the following circumstances: (1) at least before the trademark authority makes a decision on whether the trademark can be registered; (2) during any opposition proceedings against the registration decision made by the trademark authority; or (3) during any appeal proceedings against the registration decision made by the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: “分申请”应保留“原申请”的申请日期及优先权(如果有)。
Translation: The divisional application should retain the filing date and priority (if any) of the original application.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何缔约方在不违反本款第(一)项规定的前提下,均可以就申请的分解作出规定,包括费用的缴纳等。
Translation: (2) Provided that the provisions of paragraph (1) of this Article are not violated, any Contracting Party may establish regulations regarding the division of applications, including the payment of fees.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[注册的分解]本条第一款在细节上作必要修改后,应适用于注册的分解事宜。
Translation: II. [Division of Registration] After making necessary modifications to the details, the first paragraph of this article shall apply to matters concerning the division of registration.

Query_Text_cn: 此种分解无论是(1)在第三方就注册的有效性向商标主管机关提出任何争议的程序期间,还是(2)在对商标主管机关就争议作出的决定进行任何上诉的程序期间,均应允许进行。__UNDEF__但是,如果缔约方法律允许第三方在商标获得注册之前对商标的注册提出异议,则缔约方可以排除注册分解的可能性。
Translation: Such division shall be permitted both (1) during any proceedings in which a third party disputes the validity of the registration before the trademark authority, and (2) during any appeal proceedings against a decision made by the trademark authority regarding such a dispute. However, if the law of a contracting party allows third parties to oppose the registration of a trademark before it is registered, the contracting party may exclude the possibility of division of the registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条文函一、[传送方式和文函形式]任何缔约方均可以选定文函的传送方式,并确定是否接受书面形式、电子形式或其他形式的文函。
Translation: Article 8, Letter 1: [Means of Transmission and Form of Correspondence] Any contracting party may select the means of transmitting correspondence and determine whether to accept correspondence in written form, electronic form, or other forms.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[文函语言](一)任何缔约方均可以要求,任何文函必须使用商标主管机关所接受的语言。
Translation: II. [Written Communication] (1) Any Contracting Party may require that any written communication be in a language accepted by the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: 商标主管机关允许使用多种语言的,可以要求申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人选择使用该商标主管机关规定的任何一种语言,但不得要求同一文函的说明或项目使用多种语言。
Translation: Where the trademark authority permits the use of multiple languages, it may require applicants, registrants, or other interested parties to choose any one of the languages designated by the authority. However, it shall not require the description or items within the same document to be presented in multiple languages.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何缔约方不得要求,对文函的任何译文出具证明、公证、鉴定、法律认证或其他证明材料,本条约另有规定的除外。
Translation: (b) No Contracting Party may require certification, notarization, authentication, legalization, or any other proof for any translation of documents or correspondence, except as otherwise provided in this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: (三)缔约方未要求文函使用商标主管机关所接受的语言的,商标主管机关可以要求该文函须由官方译员或代理人译成该商标主管机关接受的语言,并在合理期限内提交。
Translation: (3) If the Contracting Party does not require the communication to be in a language accepted by the trademark office, the trademark office may require that the communication be translated into a language accepted by the office by an official translator or agent and submitted within a reasonable period.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[书面文函的签字](一)任何缔约方均可以要求,书面文函应由申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人签字。
Translation:
III. [Signature on Written Documents]  
(1) Any contracting party may require that written documents be signed by the applicant, the registrant, or other interested parties.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约方对书面文函有签字要求的,应接受符合本条约《实施细则》有关规定的任何签字。
Translation: If a contracting party requires signatures on written documents, it shall accept any signature that complies with the relevant provisions of the Implementation Rules of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何缔约方不得要求,对任何签字出具证明、公证、鉴定、法律认证或其他证明材料,缔约方法律对放弃注册时的签字有此规定的除外。
Translation: (ii) No contracting party shall require certification, notarization, appraisal, legal authentication, or other supporting documents for any signature, except where the laws of the contracting party stipulate such requirements for signatures when waiving registration.

Query_Text_cn: (三)尽管有本款第(二)项的规定,任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对任何书面文函的签字的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: (3) Notwithstanding the provisions of item (2) of this paragraph, any Contracting Party may require that, where the trademark authority has reasonable doubts about the authenticity of a signature on any written document, relevant evidence must be provided to the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[以电子方式提交或以电子手段传送的文函]缔约方允许以电子形式提交或以电子方式传送文函的,可以要求任何此种文函均应符合本条约《实施细则》的有关规定。
Translation: 4. [Submission or Transmission of Documents by Electronic Means] Where a Contracting Party permits documents to be submitted or transmitted electronically, it may require that any such documents comply with the relevant provisions of the Regulations under this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[文函的递交]递交文函时,凡内容符合本条约《实施细则》规定的相关国际书式范本(如果有)的,任何缔约方均应予以接受。
Translation: 5. [Submission of Documents] When submitting documents, any Contracting Party shall accept them if their content conforms to the relevant international format templates specified in the Implementation Rules of this Treaty (if available).

Query_Text_cn: 六、[禁止其他要求]除本条规定的要求外,任何缔约方不得就本条第一款至第五款内容另行规定其他要求。
Translation: 6. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] Except as provided in this Article, no Contracting Party shall impose any additional requirements with respect to the provisions of paragraphs 1 to 5 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 七、[与代理人之间的通信手段]本条中的任何规定均不适用于申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人与其代理人之间的通信手段。
Translation: 7. [Means of Communication with Agents] None of the provisions in this Article shall apply to the means of communication between the applicant, the registrant, or other interested parties and their agents.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条商品或服务的分类一、[注明商品或服务]商标主管机关核准的每件注册和发布的公告,凡涉及申请或注册并注明商品或服务的,均应注明商品或服务的名称,应按《尼斯分类》中的类别分组,并在每组前标明所属类别的编号,按类别顺序排列。
Translation:
Article 9 Classification of Goods or Services

1. [Specification of Goods or Services] For each registration and published announcement approved by the trademark authority, if the application or registration specifies goods or services, the names of the goods or services shall be indicated. They shall be grouped according to the classes in the "Nice Classification," with the class number indicated before each group, and arranged in the order of the classes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[同一类别或不同类别的商品或服务](一)商品或服务,不得因为商标主管机关在任何注册或公告中将其列入《尼斯分类》的同一类别,而被认为互相类似。
Translation: II. [Goods or services of the same or different classes] (1) Goods or services shall not be deemed similar to each other solely because the trademark authority has classified them under the same class in the Nice Classification in any registration or publication.

Query_Text_cn: (二)商品或服务,不得因为商标主管机关在任何注册或公告中将其列入《尼斯分类》的不同类别,而被认为互相不类似。
Translation: (2) Goods or services shall not be deemed dissimilar to each other solely because the trademark authority has classified them under different categories in the Nice Classification in any registration or publication.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条变更名称或地址一、[变更注册持有人名称或地址](一)任何缔约方均应准许,注册持有人未变而其名称或地址发生变更的,该注册持有人可以以文函形式向商标主管机关提交变更商标注册簿登记的申请,申请中应注明相关商标的注册号及申请变更登记的内容。
Translation:
Article 10 Change of Name or Address

I. [Change of Name or Address of the Registered Holder]
(1) Each Contracting Party shall permit that, where the registered holder remains unchanged but there is a change in the name or address, the registered holder may submit a written application to the trademark authority to request a change in the registration details recorded in the trademark register. The application shall specify the registration number of the relevant trademark and the details of the requested change.

Query_Text_cn: (三)任何缔约方均可以要求,提交变更登记申请须向商标主管机关缴纳费用。
Translation: (3) Any contracting party may require that an application for registration of changes be subject to the payment of fees to the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: (四)变更涉及多件注册的,如果注明所有相关商标的注册号,则只须提交一件申请。
Translation: (4) If the change involves multiple registered trademarks, only one application needs to be submitted, provided that the registration numbers of all relevant trademarks are indicated.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[变更申请人名称或地址]变更涉及一件或多件申请的,或同时涉及一件或多件申请和一件或多件注册的,本条第一款在细节上作必要修改后,应予适用。__UNDEF__但是,如果相关申请号尚未公布或尚不为申请人或其代理人知晓,变更申请则应按本条约《实施细则》的有关规定注明该相关申请。
Translation: 2. [Change of Applicant’s Name or Address] Where the change concerns one or more applications, or concerns both one or more applications and one or more registrations, the first paragraph of this Article shall apply with the necessary modifications in detail. However, if the relevant application number has not yet been published or is not yet known to the applicant or their representative, the request for change shall indicate the relevant application in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Regulations under this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[变更代理人名称、地址或送达地址]本条第一款在细节上作必要修改后,应适用于代理人(如果有)名称或地址以及送达地址(如果有)的任何变更。
Translation: Article 3: [Change of Agent's Name, Address, or Service Address] After making necessary modifications to the details in the first paragraph of this article, it shall apply to any changes in the name or address of the agent (if any) as well as the service address (if any).

Query_Text_cn: 四、[禁止其他要求]除本条第一款至第三款及本条约第八条规定的要求外,任何缔约方不得就本条所指的申请另行规定其他要求,尤其不得要求提交任何有关变更的证明。
Translation: 4. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] Except for the requirements set forth in Paragraphs 1 to 3 of this Article and Article 8 of this Treaty, no Contracting Party shall impose any other requirements with respect to the applications referred to in this Article, in particular, no proof of any change shall be required.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对变更申请中的任何说明的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: 5. [Evidence] Any contracting party may request that, if the trademark authority has reasonable doubts about the authenticity of any statement in the change application, relevant evidence must be provided to the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条变更所有权一、[变更注册所有权](一)任何缔约方均应准许,注册持有人发生变更的,该持有人或新获得所有权的人(以下称为“新所有人”)可以以文函形式向商标主管机关提交变更商标注册簿登记的申请,申请中应注明相关商标的注册号及申请变更登记的内容。
Translation:
Article 11 Change of Ownership

I. [Change of Registered Ownership]

(1) Any Contracting Party shall permit that, in the event of a change in the registered holder, the said holder or the person acquiring ownership (hereinafter referred to as the "new owner") may submit a written application to the trademark authority for the change of registration in the trademark register. The application shall specify the registration number of the relevant trademark and the details of the requested change.

Query_Text_cn: (三)任何缔约方均可以要求,因企业合并而发生所有权变更的,变更申请中须对此予以说明,并附送一份由主管部门签发的证明该项合并的文件的复印件,例如商业登记簿摘录的复印件,还可以要求提供由文件签发部门、公证机构或任何其他政府主管部门出具的有关该复印件真实性的证明。
Translation: (3) Any contracting party may require that, in the case of a change of ownership resulting from a corporate merger, the application for change must provide an explanation of this circumstance and be accompanied by a copy of the document certifying the merger issued by the competent authority, such as an excerpt from the commercial register. It may also require the submission of a certificate attesting to the authenticity of the copy, issued by the authority that issued the document, a notary public, or any other competent government authority.

Query_Text_cn: (四)任何缔约方均可以要求,因合同或企业合并而发生所有权变更的,如果共同注册持有人中有一人或多人发生变更但非全部都发生变更的,所有权未发生变更的任何共同注册持有人,均须以签字文件的形式就该所有权变更明确表示同意。
Translation: (iv) Any contracting party may require that, in the event of a change of ownership due to contract or corporate merger, if one or more, but not all, of the joint registered holders undergo a change, any joint registered holder whose ownership remains unchanged must explicitly consent to such change of ownership in the form of a signed document.

Query_Text_cn: (五)任何缔约方均可以要求,对于并非因合同或企业合并引起,而是因实施法律或法院判决等其他原因引起的所有权变更,变更申请中须对此予以说明,并附送一份证明该项变更的文件的复印件,还可以要求提供由文件签发部门、公证机构或任何其他政府主管部门出具的证明该文件真实性的证明。
Translation: Any contracting party may request that, for ownership changes not arising from contracts or corporate mergers but resulting from the implementation of laws, court judgments, or other reasons, the application for change must provide an explanation and be accompanied by a copy of the document evidencing such change. The contracting party may also request the submission of a certificate issued by the issuing authority, a notary public, or any other competent government authority attesting to the authenticity of the document.

Query_Text_cn: (七)任何缔约方均可以要求,提交变更申请须向商标主管机关缴纳费用。
Translation: (7) Any Contracting Party may require that a fee be paid to the trademark authority when submitting a request for amendment.

Query_Text_cn: (八)变更涉及多件注册的,如果每件注册的注册持有人和新所有人均相同,并且申请中注明所有相关商标的注册号,则只须提交一件申请。
Translation: (viii) If the change involves multiple registrations, and the registrant and the new owner for each registration are identical, and the application specifies the registration numbers of all relevant trademarks, only one application needs to be submitted.

Query_Text_cn: (九)所有权变更不涉及注册的所有商品或服务,且可适用的法律允许对此种变更予以登记的,商标主管机关应就所有权变更所涉及的商品或服务单独设立一件注册。
Translation: (9) Where a change of ownership does not involve all the goods or services covered by the registration, and applicable law permits the recording of such a change, the trademark office shall establish a separate registration for the goods or services affected by the change of ownership.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[申请的所有权变更]变更涉及一件或多件申请的,或同时涉及一件或多件申请和一件或多件注册的,本条第一款在细节上作必要修改后,应予适用。__UNDEF__但是,如果相关申请号尚未公布或尚不为申请人及其代理人知晓,变更申请则应按本条约《实施细则》的有关规定注明该相关申请。
Translation: 2. [Change of Ownership of Applications] Where the change concerns one or more applications, or concerns both one or more applications and one or more registrations, the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall apply with the necessary modifications in detail. However, if the relevant application number has not yet been published or is not yet known to the applicant or their representative, the request for change shall indicate the relevant application in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Regulations under this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: (4)说明原注册持有人已将其企业或有关商誉全部或部分转让给新所有人并提供相关证据。
Translation: (4) State that the original registered holder has transferred all or part of their business or related goodwill to the new owner and provide relevant evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对变更申请中或本条所指的任何文件中的任何说明的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据,或在适用本条第一款第(三)项或第(五)项时,须按该项规定进一步提供相关证据。
Translation: 4. [Evidence] Any Contracting Party may require that, where the trademark office has reasonable doubts as to the authenticity of any statement contained in a request for change or in any document referred to in this Article, relevant evidence must be provided to the trademark office, or, when applying subparagraph (iii) or (v) of paragraph 1 of this Article, further relevant evidence must be provided in accordance with the provisions of that subparagraph.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条更正错误一、[更正注册方面的错误](一)任何缔约方均应准许,对于向商标主管机关提交的申请或其他申请中所出现的并反映在商标主管机关的商标注册簿或任何公告中的错误,注册持有人可以以文函方式申请更正,申请中应注明相关商标的注册号、须更正的错误以及须登记的更正。
Translation:
Article 12 Correction of Errors

1. [Correction of Errors in Registration]

(a) Each Contracting Party shall permit the holder of a registration to request, in writing, the correction of any error appearing in an application or other request submitted to the trademark office, which is reflected in the trademark register or in any publication by the trademark office. The request shall specify the registration number of the relevant trademark, the error to be corrected, and the correction to be recorded.

Query_Text_cn: (3)注册持有人有送达地址的,该送达地址。
Translation: (3) If the registered holder has a service address, that service address.

Query_Text_cn: (四)更正涉及同一人的多件注册的,如果各件注册的错误和须更正的内容均相同,而且在申请中注明所有相关注册的注册号,则只须提交一件申请。
Translation: (4) If the correction involves multiple registrations of the same person, and the errors and the content to be corrected in each registration are identical, and all relevant registration numbers are indicated in the application, only one application needs to be submitted.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[更正申请方面的错误]更正涉及一件或多件申请的,或同时涉及一件或多件申请和一件或多件注册的,本条第一款在细节上作必要修改后,应予适用。__UNDEF__但是,如果相关申请号尚未公布或尚不为申请人或其代理人知晓,更正申请则应按本条约《实施细则》的有关规定注明该相关申请。
Translation: 2. [Correction of Errors Relating to Applications] Where the correction concerns one or more applications, or concerns both one or more applications and one or more registrations, the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall apply with the necessary modifications in detail. However, if the relevant application number has not yet been published or is not yet known to the applicant or his agent, the request for correction shall indicate the relevant application in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Regulations under this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[禁止其他要求]除本条第一款、第二款及本条约第八条规定的要求外,任何缔约方不得就本条所指的申请另行规定其他要求。
Translation: 3. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] Except for the requirements set forth in Paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article and those stipulated in Article 8 of this Treaty, no Contracting Party shall impose any additional requirements with respect to the applications referred to in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对申请更正的错误是否确系错误产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: 4. [Evidence] Any contracting party may request that, where there is reasonable doubt as to whether an error for which correction is sought is indeed an error, the trademark authority shall be provided with relevant evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[商标主管机关造成的错误]缔约方商标主管机关应依职权或根据请求,更正其自身造成的错误,不收取任何费用。
Translation: V. [Errors Caused by Trademark Authorities] The trademark authority of a contracting party shall, ex officio or upon request, correct any errors caused by itself without charging any fees.

Query_Text_cn: 六、[无法更正的错误]任何缔约方,对于其法律规定无法更正的错误,均无义务适用本条第一款、第二款及第五款的规定。
Translation: 6. [Irremediable Errors] Any Contracting Party shall not be obliged to apply the provisions of paragraphs 1, 2, and 5 of this Article to errors that cannot be remedied under its laws.

Query_Text_cn: (8)缔约方允许除注册持有人或其代理人之外的第三人提出续展申请且该人已提交申请的,该第三人的名称和地址。
Translation: If a Contracting Party permits a third party, other than the holder of registration or their representative, to file a renewal application and such application has been submitted, the name and address of that third party shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何缔约方均可以要求,提交续展申请须向商标主管机关缴纳费用。
Translation: (ii) Any contracting party may require that a renewal application be accompanied by the payment of fees to the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: 已经缴纳首期注册费用或任一续展期费用的,商标主管机关不得再收取该期限内的注册维持费用。
Translation: For those who have already paid the initial registration fee or any renewal fee, the trademark authority shall not charge any additional registration maintenance fees for that period.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本项的规定,与提交商标使用声明或证据有关的费用,不应被视为注册维持费用,不受本项规定的影响。
Translation: According to the provisions of this section, fees related to the submission of statements or evidence of trademark use shall not be regarded as registration maintenance fees and shall not be affected by the provisions of this section.

Query_Text_cn: (三)任何缔约方均可以要求,续展申请须在其法律规定的期限(应不少于本条约《实施细则》所规定的最短期限)内提交商标主管机关,并缴纳本条第(二)项所指的相关费用。
Translation: (3) Any Contracting Party may require that a request for renewal be submitted to the trademark office within the time limit prescribed by its laws (which shall not be less than the minimum period specified in the Regulations under this Treaty), and that the relevant fees referred to in paragraph (2) of this Article be paid.

Query_Text_cn: (3)有关该商标使用的声明或证据。
Translation: (3) Statement or evidence regarding the use of the trademark.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对续展申请中的说明或项目的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须在该续展申请的审查过程中向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: 3. [Evidence] Any contracting party may request that, if the trademark authority has reasonable doubts about the authenticity of the statements or items in a renewal application, relevant evidence must be provided to the trademark authority during the examination of such renewal application.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[禁止实质审查]任何缔约方的商标主管机关均不得因为续展而对注册进行实质审查。
Translation: 4. [Prohibition of Substantive Examination] The trademark authorities of any contracting party shall not conduct substantive examination of the registration due to renewal.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[有效期]首次注册和每次续展的有效期均为十年。
Translation: V. [Validity Period] The validity period for both initial registration and each renewal is ten years.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条未遵守期限时的救济措施一、[期限届满前的救济措施]缔约方可以规定,向商标主管机关办理有关申请或注册的某一业务期限,凡在期限届满前向商标主管机关提出申请要求延长该期限的,均可予以延长。
Translation:
Article 14 Remedies for Failure to Comply with Time Limits

1. [Remedies Before Expiry of Time Limits] The Contracting Parties may stipulate that, for any time limit relating to an application or registration handled by the trademark authority, if an application for extension of such time limit is submitted to the trademark authority before the expiry of the original time limit, the extension shall be granted.

Query_Text_cn: (3)商标主管机关认为未能遵守期限,但已作出在具体情况下应作的努力的,或根据缔约方的规定,未能遵守期限并非出于故意的,恢复申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人对申请或注册的权利。
Translation: (3) Where the trademark authority considers that the failure to comply with a time limit was despite all due efforts made in the specific circumstances, or, in accordance with the provisions of the contracting party, the failure to comply was not intentional, the rights of the applicant, the holder of the registration, or other interested parties in respect of the application or registration shall be reinstated.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[例外]对于《实施细则》中规定的例外情况,不得要求任何缔约方提供本条第二款提及的任何救济措施。
Translation: 3. [Exceptions] In the case of exceptions specified in the Implementation Rules, no Party shall be required to provide any of the remedies referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[费用]任何缔约方均可以要求,申请本条第一款和第二款所提及的任何救济措施均须缴纳费用。
Translation: 4. [Costs] Any contracting party may require that any application for the remedies referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article be subject to the payment of costs.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[禁止其他要求]除本条和本条约第八条规定的要求外,任何缔约方不得就本条第二款所提及的任何救济措施另行规定其他要求。
Translation: 5. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] Except for the requirements specified in this Article and Article 8 of this Treaty, no Contracting Party shall impose any additional requirements with respect to any remedies referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条遵守《巴黎公约》的义务任何缔约方均应遵守《巴黎公约》中有关商标的规定。
Translation:
Article 15: Obligation to Comply with the Paris Convention

Each contracting party shall comply with the provisions of the Paris Convention concerning trademarks.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条服务商标任何缔约方均应允许注册服务商标并对服务商标适用《巴黎公约》中有关商标的规定。
Translation:
Article 16: Service Marks

Each contracting party shall permit the registration of service marks and shall apply to service marks the provisions of the Paris Convention that are applicable to trademarks.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条使用许可备案的申请一、[有关备案申请的要求]缔约方法律规定商标使用许可须报其商标主管机关备案的,该缔约方可以要求备案申请须：__UNDEF__(1)按照《实施细则》规定的要求提交；__UNDEF__(2)附送《实施细则》规定的补充文件。
Translation:
Article 17 Application for Recordal of License

I. [Requirements for Application for Recordal] Where the law of a Contracting Party requires that a trademark license be recorded with its competent authority for trademarks, that Contracting Party may require that the application for recordal shall:

(1) be submitted in accordance with the requirements prescribed in the Regulations;
(2) be accompanied by the supplementary documents prescribed in the Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[费用]任何缔约方均可以规定,申请使用许可备案须向商标主管机关缴纳费用。
Translation: 2. [Fees] Any contracting party may stipulate that an application for recordal of a license must be accompanied by the payment of fees to the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[涉及多件注册的一件申请]使用许可涉及多件注册的,如果所有注册的持有人和被许可人均相同,申请中注明所有相关注册的注册号,并且按照《实施细则》的规定注明所有注册的许可范围,则只须提交一件申请。
Translation: III. [Single Application Involving Multiple Registrations] If a license involves multiple registrations and all the registrants and licensees are the same, it is sufficient to submit a single application, provided that the application specifies the registration numbers of all relevant registrations and, in accordance with the Implementing Regulations, indicates the scope of the license for each registration.

Query_Text_cn: (3)关于使用许可合同中财务条款的说明。
Translation: (3) Explanation of the financial terms in the licensing agreement.

Query_Text_cn: (二)除在商标注册簿中进行使用许可备案外,本款第(一)项,对于缔约方法律规定的任何信息公开义务,均不构成影响。
Translation: (b) Except for the recordal of trademark license in the trademark register, subparagraph (a) of this paragraph shall not affect any information disclosure obligations imposed by the laws of the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[证据]任何缔约方均可以要求,商标主管机关对使用许可备案申请中或《实施细则》提及的任何文件中的任何说明的真实性产生合理怀疑的,须向商标主管机关提供相关证据。
Translation: V. [Evidence] Any contracting party may request that, if the trademark authority has reasonable doubts about the authenticity of any statement in the application for recordal of trademark license or in any document referred to in the Implementing Rules, relevant evidence must be provided to the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: 六、[与注册申请有关的使用许可备案申请]缔约方法律允许对注册申请进行使用许可备案的,本条第一款至第五款在细节上作必要修改后,应适用于此种使用许可备案的申请。
Translation: VI. [Filing of License Agreements Related to Registration Applications] Where the law permits the filing of license agreements for registration applications, paragraphs 1 to 5 of this Article shall apply, with necessary modifications to the details, to applications for the filing of such license agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条变更或撤销使用许可备案的申请一、[有关申请的要求]缔约方法律规定使用许可须报其商标主管机关备案的,该缔约方可以要求,变更或撤销使用许可备案的申请须：__UNDEF__(1)按照《实施细则》规定的要求提交；__UNDEF__(2)附送《实施细则》规定的补充文件。
Translation:
Article 18 Application for Change or Cancellation of Recordal of License

1. [Requirements for the Application] Where the law of a contracting party requires that the license for use be recorded with its trademark authority, that contracting party may require that an application for change or cancellation of the recordal of the license must:

(1) be submitted in accordance with the requirements stipulated in the Implementing Regulations;
(2) be accompanied by supplementary documents as specified in the Implementing Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[其他要求]第十七条第二款至第六款在细节上作必要修改后,应适用于变更或撤销使用许可备案的申请。
Translation: II. [Other Requirements] After making necessary adjustments to the details, Paragraphs 2 to 6 of Article 17 shall apply to applications for the modification or cancellation of the record of use license.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条未就使用许可备案的影响一、[注册和保护的有效性]未就使用许可向缔约方的商标主管机关或任何其他机构备案的,不得影响被许可商标注册的有效性或该商标应受的保护。
Translation:
Article 19: Effects of Non-Recordal of a License

1. [Validity of Registration and Protection] Failure to record a license with the trademark authority or any other agency of a contracting party shall not affect the validity of the registration of the licensed trademark or the protection to which that trademark is entitled.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[被许可人的某些权利]凡缔约方法律规定被许可人享有参与注册持有人提起的商标侵权诉讼,或通过此种诉讼从对被许可商标的侵权中获得损害赔偿的权利的,不得再将使用许可备案作为被许可人享有该权利的条件。
Translation: II. [Certain Rights of the Licensee] Where the laws of the contracting party grant the licensee the right to participate in trademark infringement litigation initiated by the registrant, or to obtain damages from infringement of the licensed trademark through such litigation, the recordation of the license for use shall not be made a condition for the licensee to enjoy such rights.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[对未备案使用许可商标的使用]凡缔约方法律规定在涉及商标确权、维持或执法的诉讼程序中,被许可人对商标的使用可以视同为注册持有人对该商标的使用的,不得再将使用许可备案作为视同使用的条件。
Translation: III. [Use of Licensed Trademarks Without Recordation] Where the laws of the contracting parties stipulate that, in litigation procedures involving trademark confirmation, maintenance, or enforcement, the use of the trademark by the licensee may be deemed as use by the registered holder, the recordation of the license shall not be required as a condition for such deemed use.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条对使用许可的说明缔约方法律要求对商标被许可使用这一情况予以说明的,如果全部或者部分不符合该要求,不得影响被许可商标注册的有效性或该商标应受的保护,也不得影响本条约第十九条第三款的适用。
Translation:
Article 20 Explanation of Use License

If the law of the Contracting Party requires an explanation regarding the licensed use of a trademark, the failure to fully or partially comply with such requirement shall neither affect the validity of the registration of the licensed trademark or the protection to which the trademark is entitled, nor affect the application of Article 19(3) of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条对拟驳回的意见陈述对于依据本条约第三条提出的申请以及依据本条约第七条、第十条至第十四条、第十七条和第十八条提出的申请,商标主管机关拟驳回时未给予申请人或提出各项申请者(视具体情况而定)在合理期限内陈述意见的机会的,不得完全或部分驳回。
Translation:
Article 21: Statement of Objections to Proposed Rejection

With respect to applications filed under Article 3 of this Treaty, as well as applications filed under Articles 7, 10 to 14, 17, and 18 of this Treaty, the trademark authority shall not wholly or partially reject such applications if the applicant or the person submitting the respective application (as the case may be) has not been given an opportunity to present their arguments within a reasonable period of time regarding the proposed rejection.

Query_Text_cn: 就第十四条而言,申请救济措施的人已有机会对相关决定所依据的事实陈述意见的,不得再次要求商标主管机关给予其陈述意见的机会。
Translation: With respect to Article 14, if the applicant for relief has already had the opportunity to present their views on the facts upon which the relevant decision is based, they shall not be entitled to request another opportunity to present their views to the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: (3)任何行政要求、事项或程序。
Translation: (3) Any administrative requirements, matters, or procedures.

Query_Text_cn: (二)《实施细则》也应包括《国际书式范本》。
Translation: (2) The Implementation Guidelines should also include the International Standard Format.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[《实施细则》的修改]除本条第三款规定以外,对《实施细则》的任何修正均须获得所投票数的四分之三。
Translation: II. [Amendments to the Implementation Rules] Except as provided in Paragraph 3 of this Article, any amendment to the Implementation Rules must be approved by three-fourths of the votes cast.

Query_Text_cn: (三)确定是否达成一致同意时,应只考虑实际投票数。
Translation: (3) When determining whether unanimous consent has been reached, only the actual number of votes cast should be considered.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[本《条约》与《实施细则》之间相抵触的]本《条约》的规定与《实施细则》的规定发生抵触时,应以前者为准。
Translation: 4. In the event of any conflict between the provisions of this Treaty and the Implementation Rules, the provisions of this Treaty shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条大会一、[组成](一)缔约方应设立大会。
Translation:
Article 23 Conference

1. [Composition] (a) The Parties shall establish a Conference of the Parties.

Query_Text_cn: (二)每一缔约方应在大会中有一名代表,该代表可以由副代表、顾问和专家辅助。
Translation: (b) Each Contracting Party shall have one representative in the Conference, who may be assisted by alternate representatives, advisers, and experts.

Query_Text_cn: 每一代表只能代表一个缔约方。
Translation: Each representative may represent only one contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: (4)为执行本条约的规定履行其他适当职责。
Translation: (4) To perform other appropriate duties necessary for the implementation of the provisions of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[法定人数](一)大会成员国的半数构成法定人数。
Translation: III. [Quorum] (1) A quorum shall consist of half of the member states of the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: (二)尽管有本款第(一)项的规定,如果在任何一次大会会议上,出席会议的大会成员国的数目不足大会成员国的半数,但达到或超过三分之一,大会可以作出决定。
Translation: (b) Notwithstanding the provisions of subparagraph (a) of this paragraph, if at any meeting of the General Assembly the number of Member States present is less than half but at least one-third of the total number of Member States, the Assembly may make decisions.

Query_Text_cn: （五）“非独占使用许可”指不禁止注册持有人使用商标，也不禁止注册持有人许可其他人使用的使用许可。
Translation: (v) "Non-exclusive license" refers to a license that does not prohibit the registrant from using the trademark, nor does it prohibit the registrant from granting licenses to others for its use.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[《条约》中定义的缩略语]条约第一条所定义的缩略语，其含义与本《实施细则》中的相同。
Translation: 2. [Abbreviations Defined in the Treaty] The abbreviations defined in Article 1 of the Treaty shall have the same meanings in these Implementation Rules.

Query_Text_cn: （1）该人为自然人的，须注明的名称应为该人的姓或主姓和一个或几个名或副名，或根据该人的选择，注明该人惯用的一个或几个姓名。
Translation: (1) If the person is a natural person, the name to be indicated shall be the person's surname or principal surname and one or more given names or secondary names, or, at the person's discretion, one or more names customarily used by the person.

Query_Text_cn: （2）该人为法人的，须注明的名称应为该法人的正式全称。
Translation: (2) If the entity is a legal person, the name provided must be the official full name of the legal entity.

Query_Text_cn: （二）任何缔约方均应接受，须注明名称的代理人为公司或合伙企业时，注明该公司或合伙企业的惯用名称，即为已注明名称。
Translation: (2) Any contracting party shall accept that when an agent whose name must be specified is a company or partnership, the commonly used name of such company or partnership shall be deemed as the specified name.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[地址]（一）任何缔约方均可以要求，须注明某人地址时，注明的地址须满足快速邮寄的习惯要求，并且一定要包括所有相关的行政单位名称，直至（并包括）房屋或建筑物编号（如果有）。
Translation: II. [Address] (1) Any contracting party may require that, when specifying a person's address, the address provided must meet the customary requirements for expedited mail delivery and must include all relevant administrative unit names, up to and including the house or building number (if applicable).

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约方可以要求，以地址不同的两人或多人的名义向缔约方商标主管机关提交文函的，文函中须注明一个单一地址作为通信地址。
Translation: (b) A Contracting Party may require that, where a communication is submitted to the trademark office of the Contracting Party in the name of two or more persons with different addresses, a single address must be specified in the communication as the address for correspondence.

Query_Text_cn: （三）注明的地址可以包括电话号码、传真号码、电子邮件地址以及用于通信的不同于本款第（一）项所注明的地址。
Translation: (3) The specified address may include a telephone number, fax number, email address, and an address for correspondence that is different from the address specified in item (1) of this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: （四）本款第（一）项和第（三）项在细节上作必要修改后应适用于送达地址。
Translation: (4) After making necessary adjustments to the details, subparagraphs (1) and (3) of this paragraph shall also apply to the service address.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[其他确认方式]任何缔约方均可以要求，在向商标主管机关提交的文函中，须注明申请人、注册持有人、代理人或利害关系人在该商标主管机关的登记号或其他确认方式（如果有）。
Translation: III. [Other Means of Identification] Any contracting party may require that, in documents submitted to the trademark authority, the applicant, registrant, agent, or interested party indicate their registration number or other means of identification (if any) with the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: 但除以电子形式提交申请的外，任何缔约方均不得以不符合此种要求为由拒收文函。
Translation: Except for applications submitted in electronic form, no Contracting Party may refuse to accept documents on the grounds of non-compliance with such requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[使用的字体]任何缔约方均可以要求，第一款至第三款所注明的任何内容须以商标主管机关使用的字体表示。
Translation: 4. [Font Used] Any Contracting Party may require that any information specified in paragraphs 1 to 3 be presented in the font used by the trademark authority.

Query_Text_cn: 细则三关于申请的细则一、[标准字符]如果缔约方商标主管机关以某种字符（字母和数字）作为标准字符使用，而申请人在申请书中声明希望以商标主管机关所使用的标准字符注册和公告商标的，则该商标主管机关应以该种标准字符对商标进行注册和公告。
Translation:
Rule 3: Details Regarding Applications

1. [Standard Characters] If the trademark office of a Contracting Party uses certain characters (letters and numbers) as standard characters, and the applicant declares in the application that they wish the trademark to be registered and published in the standard characters used by the trademark office, then the trademark office shall register and publish the trademark in those standard characters.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[指定颜色的商标]商标主管机关可以要求，申请人在申请书中声明希望指定颜色作为商标的显著特点的，申请书中须注明所指定的一种或多种颜色的名称或代码，并注明每种颜色所占商标的主要部分。
Translation: II. [Trademarks with Specified Colors] The trademark authority may require that, if an applicant wishes to designate a specific color as a distinctive feature of the trademark in the application, the application must specify the name or code of the designated color(s) and indicate the main part of the trademark occupied by each color.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如果申请书中声明希望以该缔约方商标主管机关所使用的标准字符对商标进行注册和公告的，所要求提交的黑白商标图样不得多于一份。
Translation: (2) If the application declares a desire for the trademark to be registered and published in the standard characters used by the trademark authority of that Contracting Party, no more than one black-and-white representation of the trademark shall be required to be submitted.

Query_Text_cn: （二）任何缔约方，对于申请人在申请书中声明希望指定颜色作为商标的显著特点的，所要求提交的黑白商标图样不得多于五份，彩色商标图样亦不得多于五份。
Translation: (b) Any Contracting Party may require that no more than five copies of the black-and-white representation of the trademark be submitted, and no more than five copies of the color representation, in cases where the applicant declares in the application that they wish to designate color as a distinctive feature of the trademark.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[立体商标]（一）在申请书中声明商标为立体商标的，商标图样中应当包括一份平面的绘制图样或摄制图样。
Translation: IV. [Three-Dimensional Trademarks] (1) If the application declares the trademark as a three-dimensional trademark, the trademark specimen must include a two-dimensional drawing or photographic representation.

Query_Text_cn: （二）按本款第（一）项规定提交的图样，根据申请人的选择，可以包括该商标的一个视图，也可以包括该商标的多个不同视图。
Translation: (ii) The drawings submitted in accordance with item (i) of this clause may, at the applicant's discretion, include a single view of the trademark or multiple different views of the trademark.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如果商标主管机关认为申请人按本款第（一）项规定提交的图样不足以体现该立体商标的特点，可以通知申请人在通知书所规定的合理期限内提交该商标的六个以下（含六个）不同的视图或对该商标的文字说明。
