Translation: (3) If the trademark authority deems that the specimen submitted by the applicant in accordance with item (1) of this paragraph is insufficient to reflect the characteristics of the three-dimensional trademark, it may notify the applicant to submit, within a reasonable period specified in the notice, no more than six different views of the trademark (including six), or a textual description of the trademark.

Query_Text_cn: （四）如果商标主管机关认为本款第（三）项所指的不同视图或文字说明仍不足以体现该立体商标的特点，可以通知申请人在通知书所规定的合理期限内提交该商标的一份样本。
Translation: (4) If the trademark authority considers that the different views or written descriptions referred to in item (3) of this paragraph are still insufficient to reflect the characteristics of the three-dimensional trademark, it may notify the applicant to submit a sample of the trademark within a reasonable period specified in the notification.

Query_Text_cn: （五）第三款第（一）项第（1）目和第（二）项在细节上作必要修改后应予适用。
Translation: (5) Item (1) of Subparagraph (i) and Item (2) of Subparagraph (ii) of Paragraph 3 shall apply after necessary modifications are made to the details.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[全息图商标、动作商标、颜色商标、位置商标]任何缔约方均可以要求，申请书中声明商标为全息图商标、动作商标、颜色商标或位置商标的，须按其法律规定提交该商标的一份或多份图样，以及有关该商标的细节。
Translation: V. [Hologram trademarks, motion trademarks, color trademarks, position trademarks] Any Contracting Party may require that, where an application declares the trademark to be a hologram trademark, motion trademark, color trademark, or position trademark, one or more representations of the trademark, as well as details concerning the trademark, must be submitted in accordance with its laws.

Query_Text_cn: 六、[含有非可视性标志的商标]任何缔约方均可以要求，申请书中声明商标含有非可视性标志的，须按其法律规定提交该商标的一份或多份表现物、关于该商标类型的说明，以及有关该商标的细节。
Translation: VI. [Trademarks Containing Non-Visible Signs] Any Contracting Party may require that, where an application declares the trademark contains non-visible signs, the applicant must submit one or more representations of the trademark, a description of the type of trademark in accordance with its laws, and details concerning the trademark.

Query_Text_cn: 七、[商标的音译]根据条约第三条第一款第（一）项第（13）目的规定，凡构成商标的内容或商标所含有的内容不是以商标主管机关所使用的字体表示的，或表示数目的数字也非商标主管机关所使用的数字的，可以要求提交按商标主管机关所使用的字体和数字的音译。
Translation: VII. [Transliteration of Trademarks] Pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1, Item (13) of the Treaty, where the content constituting a trademark or contained within a trademark is not represented in the typeface used by the trademark authority, or where numerals are not represented in the form used by the trademark authority, a transliteration in the typeface and numerals used by the trademark authority may be required to be submitted.

Query_Text_cn: 八、[商标的意译]根据条约第三条第一款第（一）项第（14）目的规定，凡构成商标的或商标含有的一个或多个字不是以商标主管机关所接受的语言或所接受的多种语言之一表示的，可以要求将该字译为该商标主管机关所接受的语言或所接受的多种语言之一。
Translation: VIII. [Transliteration of Trademarks] Pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1, Item (14) of the Treaty, where one or more words constituting or included in a trademark are not expressed in a language accepted by the trademark authority or in one of the accepted languages, a request may be made to translate such words into a language accepted by the trademark authority or into one of the accepted languages.

Query_Text_cn: 九、[商标实际使用证据的提交期限]条约第三条第三款所指的期限，应自缔约方商标主管机关受理申请之日起计算，不少于六个月。
Translation: 9. [Deadline for Submission of Evidence of Actual Use of Trademarks] The period referred to in Article 3, Paragraph 3 of the Treaty shall be calculated from the date on which the trademark authority of the Contracting Party accepts the application and shall not be less than six months.

Query_Text_cn: 如果符合缔约方法律规定的条件，申请人或注册持有人有权要求延长该期限，每次至少可以延长六个月，总共至少可以延长两年半。
Translation: If the applicant or the registered holder meets the conditions stipulated by the contracting state's laws, they are entitled to request an extension of the period, with each extension lasting at least six months and the total extension period being at least two and a half years.

Query_Text_cn: 细则四关于代理和送达地址的细则一、[委托代理人时的地址]委托代理人的，缔约方应将该代理人的地址视为送达地址。
Translation:
Rule 4 on Agents and Service Addresses

1. [Address When Appointing an Agent] Where an agent is appointed, the contracting party shall regard the address of such agent as the address for service.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[未委托代理人时的地址]申请人、注册持有人或其他利害关系人未委托代理人但已经提供一个缔约方境内地址作为其地址的，该缔约方应将该地址视为送达地址。
Translation: II. [Address When No Agent Is Appointed] Where the applicant, registered holder, or other interested party has not appointed an agent but has provided an address within the territory of a contracting party as their address, that contracting party shall regard such address as the address for service.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[期限]条约第四条第三款第（四）项所指的期限，应自相关缔约方商标主管机关收到该条所指的文函之日起计算。__UNDEF__文函当事人地址在缔约方境内的，该期限应不少于一个月；__UNDEF__当事人地址在缔约方境外的，该期限应不少于两个月。
Translation: 3. [Time Limit] The time limit referred to in Article 4, paragraph 3, item (iv) of the Treaty shall be calculated from the date on which the competent trademark authority of the relevant Contracting Party receives the written communication referred to in that Article. If the address of the party to the written communication is within the territory of the Contracting Party, the time limit shall be not less than one month; if the address of the party is outside the territory of the Contracting Party, the time limit shall be not less than two months.

Query_Text_cn: 细则五关于申请日期的细则一、[不符合申请要求时的程序]如果商标主管机关收到的申请不符合条约第五条第一款第（一）项或第二款第（一）项可适用的任何要求，商标主管机关应迅速通知申请人在通知书所规定的期限内使申请符合相关要求，并可以要求为此缴纳专门费用。__UNDEF__该期限应自通知之日起计算，申请人地址在缔约方境内的，应至少为一个月；__UNDEF__申请人地址在缔约方境外的，应至少为两个月。__UNDEF__即使商标主管机关没有发出所述通知，上述要求亦不受影响。
Translation:
Rule 5: Details Concerning the Filing Date

1. [Procedure When Requirements Are Not Met] If the trademark authority receives an application that does not meet any of the applicable requirements under Article 5(1)(a) or Article 5(2)(a) of the Treaty, the trademark authority shall promptly notify the applicant to bring the application into compliance within the period specified in the notification, and may require the payment of a special fee for this purpose. This period shall be calculated from the date of the notification and shall be at least one month if the applicant’s address is within the territory of the Contracting Party, and at least two months if the applicant’s address is outside the territory of the Contracting Party. These requirements shall apply even if the trademark authority does not issue the aforementioned notification.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[更正情况下的申请日期]如果申请人在通知书所规定的期限内满足第一款所述通知的要求并缴纳所规定的专门费用，则申请日期应以商标主管机关收到条约第五条第一款第（一）项所要求的所有说明和项目以及条约第五条第二款第（一）项所要求的费用（如果适用）之日为准。
Translation: 2. [Application Date in Case of Correction] If the applicant complies with the requirements set forth in the notification within the prescribed time limit and pays the specified special fee, the application date shall be the date on which the trademark authority receives all the indications and items required under Article 5(1)(a) of the Treaty and the fees required under Article 5(2)(a) of the Treaty (if applicable).

Query_Text_cn: 否则，该申请应被视为未提交。
Translation: Otherwise, the application shall be deemed not submitted.

Query_Text_cn: （2）签字人身份在文函中不明显的，须注明本人的身份。
Translation: (2) If the signatory's identity is not clearly indicated in the document, it must be specified.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[签字日期]任何缔约方均可以要求，签字时须注明签字日期。
Translation: 2. [Date of Signature] Any contracting party may request that the date of signature be specified at the time of signing.

Query_Text_cn: 要求注明日期而未注明的，应以商标主管机关收到带有签字的文函的日期，或如果缔约方允许，以早于此日期的某一日期作为签字日期。
Translation: If a date is required to be indicated but is not, the date on which the signed written communication is received by the trademark authority shall be considered as the date of signature, or, if permitted by the Contracting Party, an earlier date may be used as the date of signature.

Query_Text_cn: （3）如果在文函上签字的自然人为缔约方国民，并且该人的地址在该缔约方境内，或如果文函上的签字所代表的法人是依该缔约方的法律组建并在该缔约方境内拥有住所或真实有效的工商营业所的，可以要求使用印章替代手写签字。
Translation: (3) If the natural person signing the document is a national of the contracting party and their address is within the territory of that contracting party, or if the legal entity represented by the signature on the document is established under the laws of that contracting party and has its domicile or a genuine and effective place of business within the territory of that contracting party, the use of a seal may be required in lieu of a handwritten signature.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[通过电子传送手段提交的书面文函的签字]缔约方规定可以通过电子传送手段提交文函的，如果所收到的文函上有该缔约方根据第三款可以接受的签字的图形，应视为该文函已经签字。
Translation: 4. [Signatures on Written Documents Submitted by Electronic Transmission] If a Contracting Party stipulates that documents may be submitted by electronic transmission, any document received bearing a graphic representation of a signature acceptable to that Contracting Party in accordance with Paragraph 3 shall be deemed to have been signed.

Query_Text_cn: 五、[通过电子传送手段提交的书面文函的原件]缔约方规定可以通过电子传送手段提交书面文函的，均可以要求任何此种书面文函原件：__UNDEF__（1）均须提交商标主管机关，并附函确认该在先电子传送的文函；__UNDEF__并（2）均须在规定期限内提交，该期限应自商标主管机关收到以电子传送手段提交的文函之日起至少一个月。
Translation: 5. [Originals of Written Communications Submitted by Electronic Means] Where a Contracting Party provides that written communications may be submitted by electronic means, it may require that the original of any such written communication: __UNDEF__ (1) must be submitted to the trademark office, accompanied by a letter confirming the prior electronic transmission of the communication; __UNDEF__ and (2) must be submitted within a prescribed time limit, which shall be at least one month from the date on which the trademark office receives the communication submitted by electronic means.

Query_Text_cn: 六、[电子文函的验证]凡允许以电子方式提交文函的缔约方均可以要求，任何此种文函均须通过该缔约方规定的电子验证系统加以验证。
Translation: VI. [Verification of Electronic Communications] Any Contracting Party that permits the submission of communications electronically may require that any such communication be verified through an electronic verification system specified by that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 七、[收到或收讫日期]每一缔约方均可以自行决定，对于向下列机构或下列地址实际送交的文件或实际缴纳的费用，在何种情况下应视为已由其商标主管机关收到或收讫：__UNDEF__（1）商标主管机关的一个分支机构或分局；__UNDEF__（2）缔约方为条约第二十六条第一款第（2）项所指的政府间机构的，代表该缔约方的某国商标主管机关；__UNDEF__（3）某官方邮政机构；__UNDEF__（4）缔约方指定的某邮递服务机构或代理机构；__UNDEF__（5）商标主管机关指定地址外的某地址。
八、[电子提交]缔约方规定可以以电子方式或通过电子传送手段提交文函的，在不违反第七款规定的情况下，凡以此种方式或通过此种手段提交的，缔约方商标主管机关收到此种文函的日期应视为收到日期。
Translation: 8. [Electronic Submission] Where a Contracting Party stipulates that documents may be submitted electronically or by means of electronic transmission, and provided this does not contravene the provisions of paragraph 7, the date on which such documents are received by the trademark office of the Contracting Party shall be deemed the date of receipt.

Query_Text_cn: （1）商标主管机关给予的临时申请号（如果有），或（2）申请的复印件，或（3）商标的表现物，连同申请人或代理人对其所知的商标主管机关收到申请的日期的说明，以及申请人或代理人自己给予申请的编号。
Translation: (1) The provisional application number assigned by the trademark authority (if any), or (2) a copy of the application, or (3) a representation of the trademark, together with a statement by the applicant or agent regarding the date on which, to the best of their knowledge, the trademark authority received the application, as well as the application number assigned by the applicant or agent.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[禁止其他要求]任何缔约方，对于申请号尚未公布或尚不为申请人或其代理人知晓的情况，除第一款规定的要求外，不得就申请的注明另行规定其他要求。
Translation: 2. [Prohibition of Additional Requirements] Except for the requirements stipulated in Paragraph 1, no Contracting Party shall impose any additional requirements regarding the indication of an application in cases where the application number has not yet been published or is not yet known to the applicant or their representative.

Query_Text_cn: 细则八关于有效期及续展的细则根据条约第十三条第一款第（三）项的规定，提交续展申请和缴纳续展费用的期限，应自注册到期之日前至少六个月起，至注册到期之日后至少六个月止。
Translation:
Rule 8: Details Regarding Validity Period and Renewal

According to Article 13, paragraph 1(c) of the Treaty, the period for submitting a renewal application and paying the renewal fee shall begin at least six months before the expiry date of the registration and shall end at least six months after the expiry date of the registration.

Query_Text_cn: 任何缔约方均可以规定，对于在注册到期之日后提交续展申请或缴纳续展费用的，须缴纳附加费用才受理续展申请。
Translation: Any Contracting Party may provide that a renewal application submitted or a renewal fee paid after the date of expiry of the registration shall be accepted only upon payment of an additional fee.

Query_Text_cn: 细则九未遵守期限时的救济措施一、[有关条约第十四条第二款第（1）项规定的延长期限的要求]根据条约第十四条第二款第（1）项规定可以延长期限的缔约方，应自提交延长期限申请之日起将期限合理延长，并可以要求该申请：__UNDEF__（1）须含有申请延长期限者的身份、有关的申请号或注册号及相关期限的说明，并（2）须在规定期限内提交，该期限自相关期限届满之日起应不少于两个月。
Translation:
Remedies for Failure to Comply with Time Limits under Rule 9

1. [Request for Extension of Time Limit under Article 14(2)(i) of the Relevant Treaty]  
A Contracting Party that may extend a time limit under Article 14(2)(i) of the Treaty shall, from the date of submission of the request for extension, reasonably extend the time limit, and may require that such request:  
__UNDEF__  
(1) contains the identity of the person requesting the extension, the relevant application or registration number, and an explanation of the relevant time limit; and  
(2) is submitted within a prescribed period, which shall be not less than two months from the date of expiration of the relevant time limit.

Query_Text_cn: 二、[有关条约第十四条第二款第（2）项规定的继续处理的要求]缔约方可以要求，根据条约第十四条第二款第（2）项规定提交的继续处理的申请：__UNDEF__（1）须含有申请继续处理者的身份、有关的申请号或注册号及相关期限的说明，并（2）须在规定期限内提交，该期限应自相关期限届满之日起不少于两个月。__UNDEF__疏失行为应在该期限内完成，缔约方规定在提交申请时完成的，则应在提交申请时完成。
Translation:
II. [Requirements for Continued Processing under Article 14(2)(2) of the Treaty]  
A Contracting Party may require that a request for continued processing submitted under Article 14(2)(2) of the Treaty:  
(1) must contain an identification of the person requesting continued processing, the relevant application or registration number, and an indication of the relevant time limit; and  
(2) must be submitted within a prescribed period, which shall be not less than two months from the date of expiration of the relevant time limit.  
Any omitted act shall be completed within that period or, if the Contracting Party requires it to be completed at the time of submitting the request, it shall be completed at the time of submission.

Query_Text_cn: 三、[有关条约第十四条第二款第（3）项规定的恢复权利的要求]（一）缔约方可以要求，根据条约第十四条第二款第（3）项提交的恢复权利的申请：__UNDEF__（1）须含有申请恢复权利者的身份、有关的申请号或注册号及相关期限的说明，并（2）须提供事实和证据，说明未能遵守相关期限的原因。
Translation: III. [Requirements for the restoration of rights under Article 14(2)(3) of the Treaty] (1) A Contracting Party may require that an application for restoration of rights submitted under Article 14(2)(3) of the Treaty: __UNDEF__ (1) shall contain the identity of the person requesting restoration, the relevant application or registration number, and an indication of the relevant time limit, and (2) shall provide facts and evidence explaining the reasons for the failure to comply with the relevant time limit.

Query_Text_cn: （二）恢复权利的申请应在合理期限内提交商标主管机关，该期限的长短应由缔约方自未遵守有关期限的原因消除之日起确定。
Translation: (b) Applications for the restoration of rights shall be submitted to the trademark authority within a reasonable period, the length of which shall be determined by the Contracting Party from the date on which the reason for failing to comply with the relevant time limit has been eliminated.

Query_Text_cn: 疏失行为应在该期限内完成，缔约方规定在提交申请时完成的，则应在提交申请时完成。
Translation: Negligent acts shall be completed within the specified period; if the contracting party requires completion at the time of application submission, they shall be completed at the time of application submission.

Query_Text_cn: （三）缔约方可以为符合本款第（一）项和第（二）项的要求规定一个最长期限，该期限应自相关期限到期之日起不少于六个月。
Translation: (c) A Contracting Party may establish a maximum period for meeting the requirements set out in subparagraphs (a) and (b) of this paragraph, which shall not be less than six months from the date of expiry of the relevant period.

Query_Text_cn: 四、[条约第十四条第三款规定的例外]条约第十四条第三款规定的例外是指未遵守下列期限的情形：__UNDEF__（1）已根据条约第十四条第二款给予救济措施的期限；__UNDEF__（2）根据条约第十四条提交救济措施申请的期限；__UNDEF__（3）缴纳续展费用的期限；__UNDEF__（4）向上诉委员会或商标主管机关内的其他复审机构采取行动的期限；__UNDEF__（5）当事人之间程序中有关行动的期限；__UNDEF__（6）提交条约第三条第一款第（一）项第（7）目所述声明或条约第三条第一款第（一）项第（8）目所述声明的期限；__UNDEF__（7）提交按缔约方法律可以为待审申请确定新申请日的声明的期限；__UNDEF__以及（8）对优先权要求作出修改或增加的期限。
（13）使用许可的期限。
Translation: (13) Term of License.

Query_Text_cn: （2）变更或撤销涉及本款第（一）项规定的说明或项目的，应注明须登记的变更或撤销的性质和范围。
Translation: (2) Any changes or cancellations involving the explanations or items specified in subparagraph (1) of this clause shall indicate the nature and scope of the changes or cancellations that require registration.

Query_Text_cn: （1）使用许可备案合同摘要，注明使用许可合同当事各方以及所许可的权利，公证机构或任何其他政府主管部门对其真实性出具的证明，或（2）未经证明的使用许可声明，其内容应与《实施细则》规定的使用许可声明书式内容相符，并由注册持有人和被许可人共同签字。
Translation: (1) A summary of the record-filing of the license agreement, specifying the parties to the license agreement and the licensed rights, along with a certificate of authenticity issued by a notary public or any other competent government authority, or (2) an unverified license declaration, the content of which shall be consistent with the format prescribed for license declarations in the Implementing Rules and jointly signed by the registrant and the licensee.

Query_Text_cn: （二）任何缔约方均可以要求，非使用许可合同当事人的任何其他共同注册持有人，均须以签字文件的形式对使用许可明确表示同意。
Translation: (b) Any contracting party may require that any other joint registrant who is not a party to the license agreement expressly consent to the license in writing.

Query_Text_cn: （1）证明使用许可备案变更的文件，或（2）未经证明的使用许可变更声明，其内容应与本《实施细则》规定的使用许可变更声明书式内容相符，并由注册持有人和被许可人共同签字。
Translation: (1) The document certifying the change of license for use, or (2) an uncertified statement of change of license for use, must be consistent in content with the format of the statement of change of license for use as stipulated in these Implementation Rules, and must be jointly signed by the registrant and the licensee.

Query_Text_cn: （二）任何缔约方均可以要求，非使用许可合同当事人的任何其他共同注册持有人，均须以签字文件的形式对使用许可变更明确表示同意。
Translation: (b) Any contracting party may require that any other joint registrant who is not a party to the license agreement must expressly consent to the modification of the license in writing.

Query_Text_cn: （1）证明使用许可备案撤销的文件，或（2）未经证明的撤销使用许可的声明，其内容应与本《实施细则》规定的撤销使用许可声明书式内容相符，并由注册持有人和被许可人共同签字。
Translation: (1) Documentation proving the revocation of the license for use, or (2) an unverified statement of revocation of the license for use, must conform to the format and content requirements for the statement of revocation of the license for use as stipulated in these Implementation Rules, and must be jointly signed by the registrant and the licensee.

Query_Text_cn: 《生物多样性公约》卡塔赫纳生物安全议定书（2000年1月29日签订，本议定书于2003年9月11日生效。__UNDEF__中华人民共和国于2000年8月8日签署本议定书。
Translation: Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety to the Convention on Biological Diversity (signed on January 29, 2000; entered into force on September 11, 2003. The People's Republic of China signed this Protocol on August 8, 2000.)

Query_Text_cn: 第1条目标本议定书的目标是依循《关于环境与发展的里约宣言》原则15所订立的预先防范办法，协助确保在安全转移、处理和使用凭借现代生物技术获得的、可能对生物多样性的保护和可持续使用产生不利影响的改性活生物体领域内采取充分的保护措施，同时顾及对人类健康所构成的风险并特别侧重越境转移问题。
Translation:
Article 1 Objective

The objective of this Protocol is to contribute to ensuring adequate protection in the field of the safe transfer, handling, and use of living modified organisms obtained through modern biotechnology that may have adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity, taking into account risks to human health and focusing particularly on transboundary movements, in accordance with the precautionary approach contained in Principle 15 of the Rio Declaration on Environment and Development.

Query_Text_cn: 1．每一缔约方应为履行本议定书为之规定的各项义务采取必要和适当的法律、行政和其他措施。
Translation: 1. Each Party shall take the necessary and appropriate legal, administrative, and other measures to fulfill the obligations stipulated in this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 2．各缔约方应确保在从事任何改性活生物体的研制、处理、运输、使用、转移和释放时，防止或减少其对生物多样性构成的风险，同时亦应顾及对人类健康所构成的风险。
Translation: 2. Each Contracting Party shall ensure that, in the development, handling, transport, use, transfer, and release of any living modified organism, risks to biological diversity are prevented or minimized, while also taking into account risks to human health.

Query_Text_cn: 3．本议定书的任何规定不得以任何方式妨碍依照国际法所确立的各国对其领海所拥有的主权以及国际法所规定的各国对其专属经济区及其大陆架所拥有的主权和管辖权，亦不得妨碍所有国家的船只和航空器依照国际法和有关国际文书所享有的航行权和航行自由。
Translation: 3. Nothing in this Protocol shall in any way affect the sovereignty of States over their territorial seas as established under international law, nor the sovereign rights and jurisdiction of States over their exclusive economic zones and continental shelves as provided for by international law, nor shall it prejudice the rights and freedoms of navigation enjoyed by all ships and aircraft in accordance with international law and relevant international instruments.

Query_Text_cn: 4．不得将本议定书中的任何条款解释为限制缔约方为确保对生物多样性的保护和可持续使用采取比本议定书所规定的更为有力的保护行动的权利，但条件是此种行动须符合本议定书的各项目标和条款并符合国际法为缔约方规定的各项其他义务。
Translation: 4. Nothing in this Protocol shall be interpreted as restricting the right of any Party to take measures that are more protective than those set out in this Protocol for the conservation and sustainable use of biodiversity, provided that such measures are consistent with the objectives and provisions of this Protocol and with other obligations of the Party under international law.

Query_Text_cn: 5．鼓励各缔约方酌情考虑到具有在人类健康风险领域内开展活动权限的各国际机构所掌握的现有专门知识、所订立的文书和所开展的工作。
Translation: 5. Parties are encouraged, as appropriate, to take into account the existing expertise, instruments, and activities of relevant international organizations with mandates in the area of human health risk.

Query_Text_cn: b．超出生物分类学科的细胞融合，此类技术可克服自然生理繁殖或重新组合障碍，且并非传统育种和选种中所使用的技术。
Translation: b. Cell fusion beyond the boundaries of biological taxonomy, a technology that can overcome barriers to natural physiological reproduction or recombination and is not used in traditional breeding and selection.

Query_Text_cn: （k）“越境转移”是指从一缔约方向另一缔约方转移改性活生物体，但就第17条和第24条的目的而言，越境转移所涉范围当予扩大到缔约方与非缔约方之间的转移。
Translation: (k) "Transboundary movement" refers to the transfer of modified living organisms from one Party to another Party; however, for the purposes of Articles 17 and 24, the scope of transboundary movement shall be extended to include transfers between Parties and non-Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条范围本议定书应适用于可能对生物多样性的保护和可持续使用产生不利影响的所有改性活生物体的越境转移、过境、处理和使用，同时亦顾及对人类健康构成的风险。
Translation:
Article 4 Scope

This Protocol shall apply to the transboundary movement, transit, handling, and use of all living modified organisms that may have adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity, taking also into account risks to human health.

Query_Text_cn: 第5条药物尽管有第4条的规定，在不损害缔约方在其就进口问题作出决定之前对所有改性活生物体进行风险评估的权利的情况下，本议定书不应适用于由其他有关国际协定或组织予以处理的、用作供人类使用的药物的改性活生物体的越境转移。
Translation: Article 5 Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 4, and without prejudice to the right of a Party to conduct a risk assessment on all living modified organisms prior to making decisions regarding import, this Protocol shall not apply to the transboundary movement of living modified organisms intended for use as pharmaceuticals for humans that are addressed by other relevant international agreements or organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 1．尽管有第4条的规定，在不损害过境缔约方对作穿越其领土运输的改性活生物体实行管制以及根据第2条第3款把该缔约方针对穿越其领土运输某种改性活生物体作出的任何决定通知生物安全资料交换所的任何权利的情况下，本议定书中有关提前知情同意程序的规定不应适用于过境的改性活生物体。
Translation: 1. Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 4, and without prejudice to the right of a transit Party to regulate the transport of living modified organisms through its territory and to notify the Biosafety Clearing-House of any decision it makes regarding the transport of a particular living modified organism through its territory pursuant to paragraph 3 of Article 2, the provisions of this Protocol concerning the advance informed agreement procedure shall not apply to living modified organisms in transit.

Query_Text_cn: 2．尽管有第4条的规定，在不损害缔约方在其就进口问题作出决定之前对所有改性活生物体进行风险评估的任何权利以及针对属其管辖范围之内的封闭使用订立标准的任何权利的情况下，本议定书中有关提前知情同意程序的规定不应适用于那些拟按照进口缔约方的标准用于封闭使用的改性活生物体的越境转移。
Translation: 2. Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 4, and without prejudice to the right of a Party to conduct a risk assessment on all living modified organisms prior to making a decision regarding import, as well as the right to establish standards for contained use within its jurisdiction, the provisions of this Protocol concerning the advance informed agreement procedure shall not apply to the transboundary movement of living modified organisms intended for contained use in accordance with the standards of the importing Party.

Query_Text_cn: 1．在不违反第5条和第6条的情况下，第8至第10条和第12条中所列提前知情同意程序应在拟有意向进口缔约方的环境中引入改性活生物体的首次有意越境转移之前予以适用。
Translation: 1. Without prejudice to Articles 5 and 6, the advance informed agreement procedure set out in Articles 8 to 10 and Article 12 shall apply prior to the first intentional transboundary movement of a living modified organism intended for introduction into the environment of the Party of import.

Query_Text_cn: 2．以上第1款中所述“有意向环境中引入”并非指拟直接用作食物或饲料或用于加工的改性活生物体。
Translation: 2. The "intentional introduction into the environment" referred to in Paragraph 1 above does not mean the introduction of modified living organisms intended to be used directly as food or feed, or for processing.

Query_Text_cn: 3．第11条应在拟直接用作食物或饲料或用于加工的改性活生物体首次越境转移之前予以适用。
Translation: 3. Article 11 shall apply prior to the first transboundary movement of a modified living organism intended for direct use as food or feed, or for processing.

Query_Text_cn: 4．提前知情同意程序不应适用于经作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会的一项决定认定在亦顾及对人类健康构成的风险的情况下不太可能对生物多样性的保护和可持续使用产生不利影响的改性活生物体的有意越境转移。
Translation: 4. The advance informed consent procedure shall not apply to the intentional transboundary movement of living modified organisms that, by a decision of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol, have been determined as unlikely to have adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity, taking also into account risks to human health.

Query_Text_cn: 1．出口缔约方应在首次有意越境转移属于第7条第1款范围内的改性活生物体之前，通知或要求出口者确保以书面形式通知进口缔约方的国家主管部门。
Translation: 1. The exporting Party shall, prior to the first intentional transboundary movement of a modified living organism falling within the scope of Article 7, paragraph 1, notify or require the exporter to ensure that written notification is provided to the national competent authority of the importing Party.

Query_Text_cn: 通知中至少应列有附件一所列明的资料。
Translation: The notice shall include at least the information specified in Annex I.

Query_Text_cn: 2．出口缔约方应确保订有法律条文，规定出口者所提供的资料必须准确无误。
Translation: 2. The exporting Contracting Party shall ensure that legal provisions are in place requiring that the information provided by the exporter must be accurate and correct.

Query_Text_cn: 1．进口缔约方应于收到通知后九十天内以书面形式向发出通知者确认已收到通知。
Translation: The importing contracting party shall, within ninety days of receiving the notification, confirm in writing to the notifying party that the notification has been received.

Query_Text_cn: （c）可否根据进口缔约方的国内规章制度或根据第10条中列明的程序采取下一步行动。
Translation: (c) Whether further actions can be taken in accordance with the domestic regulations of the importing Party or the procedures specified in Article 10.

Query_Text_cn: 3．以上第2（c）款所述国内规章制度应与本议定书相一致。
Translation: 3. The domestic regulations referred to in Article 2(c) above shall be consistent with this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 4．即使进口缔约方未能对通知作出确认，亦不应意味着其对越境转移表示同意。
Translation: 4. Even if the importing Party fails to acknowledge the notification, this shall not be construed as consent to the transboundary movement.

Query_Text_cn: 1．进口缔约方所作决定应符合第15条的规定。
Translation: Decisions made by the importing Contracting Party shall comply with the provisions of Article 15.

Query_Text_cn: （b）于至少九十天后未收到后续书面同意。
Translation: (b) No subsequent written consent has been received after at least ninety days.

Query_Text_cn: （d）通知发出通知者已将本款所列明的期限适当延长。
Translation: (d) The notifying party has duly extended the period specified in this clause.

Query_Text_cn: 4．除非已予以无条件核准，否则根据以上第3款所作的决定应列出作出这一决定的理由。
Translation: 4. Unless unconditionally approved, any decision made pursuant to paragraph 3 above shall set out the reasons for such decision.

Query_Text_cn: 5．即使进口缔约方未能在收到通知后二百七十天内通报其决定，亦不应意味着该缔约方对有意越境转移表示同意。
Translation: 5. Even if the importing Party fails to communicate its decision within 270 days after receiving the notification, this shall not be construed as consent by that Party to the intended transboundary movement.

Query_Text_cn: 6．在亦顾及对人类健康构成的风险的情况下，即使由于在改性活生物体对进口缔约方的生物多样性的保护和可持续使用所产生的潜在不利影响的程度方面未掌握充分的相关科学资料和知识，因而缺乏科学定论，亦不应妨碍该缔约方酌情就以上第3款所指的改性活生物体的进口问题作出决定，以避免或尽最大限度减少此类潜在的不利影响。
Translation: 6. In consideration of risks to human health, even in cases where there is insufficient relevant scientific information and knowledge regarding the extent of potential adverse effects of living modified organisms on the protection and sustainable use of biological diversity in the importing Party, and thus a lack of scientific consensus, this should not prevent the Party from making decisions, as appropriate, concerning the import of living modified organisms referred to in paragraph 3 above, in order to avoid or minimize such potential adverse effects to the greatest extent possible.

Query_Text_cn: 7．作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会应在其第一次会议上就旨在便利进口缔约方决策的适当程序和机制作出决定。
Translation: 7. At its first meeting, the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol shall decide on appropriate procedures and mechanisms aimed at facilitating decision-making by importing Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 1．一缔约方如已针对为供直接作食物或饲料或加工之用而拟予以越境转移的改性活生物体的国内用途、包括投放市场作出最终决定，则应在作出决定后十五天之内通过生物安全资料交换所将之通报各缔约方。
Translation: If a Party has made a final decision regarding the domestic use, including placing on the market, of a living modified organism intended for direct use as food or feed, or for processing, which is to be transboundary moved, it shall, within fifteen days of making that decision, inform all Parties through the Biosafety Clearing-House.

Query_Text_cn: 此种通知应至少列有附件二所规定的信息资料。
Translation: Such notification shall include at least the information specified in Annex II.

Query_Text_cn: 该缔约方应将上述信息资料的书面副本提供给事先已告知秘书处它无法通过生物安全资料交换所交流信息资料的每一缔约方的国家联络点。
Translation: The Party shall provide a written copy of the above-mentioned information to the national focal point of each Party that has previously informed the Secretariat of its inability to access information through the Biosafety Clearing-House.

Query_Text_cn: 此项规定不应适用于关于实地测试的决定。
Translation: This provision should not apply to decisions regarding on-site testing.

Query_Text_cn: 2．根据以上第1款作出决定的缔约方应确保订有法律条文，规定申请者所提供的资料必须准确无误。
Translation: 2. The Contracting Party making a decision pursuant to paragraph 1 above shall ensure that legal provisions are in place requiring that the information provided by the applicant must be accurate and correct.

Query_Text_cn: 3．任何缔约方均可从附件二第（b）段中指明的主管部门索要其他资料。
Translation: 3. Any Contracting Party may request additional information from the competent authorities specified in paragraph (b) of Annex II.

Query_Text_cn: 4．缔约方可根据符合本议定书目标的国内规章条例，就拟直接作食物或饲料或加工之用的改性活生物体的进口作出决定。
Translation: 4. Parties may make decisions regarding the import of living modified organisms intended for direct use as food, feed, or for processing in accordance with domestic regulations that are consistent with the objectives of this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 5．每一缔约方如订有适用于拟直接作食物或饲料或加工之用的改性活生物体的进口的任何国家法律、规章条例和准则，应向生物安全资料交换所提供此种资料的副本。
Translation: 5. Each Party that has national laws, regulations, and guidelines applicable to the import of modified living organisms intended for direct use as food or feed, or for processing, shall provide copies of such information to the Biosafety Clearing-House.

Query_Text_cn: （b）在不超过二百七十天的可预测的时间范围内作出决定。
Translation: (b) Make a decision within a foreseeable timeframe not exceeding 270 days.

Query_Text_cn: 7．缔约方未能依照以上第6款发出通知不应意味着该缔约方同意或拒绝进口某种拟直接作食物或饲料或加工之用的改性活生物体，除非该缔约方另有明确说明。
Translation: 7. Failure by a Party to provide notification in accordance with paragraph 6 above shall not imply that the Party consents to or refuses the import of a living modified organism intended for direct use as food or feed, or for processing, unless the Party has otherwise clearly indicated its decision.

Query_Text_cn: 8．在亦顾及对人类健康构成的风险的情况下，即使由于在改性活生物体对进口缔约方生物多样性的保护和可持续使用产生的潜在不利影响的程度方面未掌握充分的相关科学资料和知识，因而缺乏科学定论，亦不应妨碍进口缔约方酌情就拟直接作食物、饲料或加工之用的该改性活生物体的进口作出决定，以避免或尽最大限度减少此类潜在的不利影响。
Translation: 8. While also taking into account risks to human health, the lack of sufficient relevant scientific information and knowledge regarding the extent of potential adverse effects of the modified living organism on the protection and sustainable use of biodiversity in the importing Party, and thus the absence of a scientific consensus, shall not prevent the importing Party from making a decision, as appropriate, regarding the import of such modified living organism intended for direct use as food, feed, or for processing, in order to avoid or minimize such potential adverse effects to the greatest extent possible.

Query_Text_cn: 9．缔约方可表明它在拟直接作食物或饲料或加工之用的改性活生物体方面需要得到的财务和技术援助及其在相关的能力建设方面的需要。
Translation: 9. A Party may indicate its need for financial and technical assistance, as well as its requirements for capacity building, with respect to modified living organisms intended for direct use as food or feed, or for processing.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约方应相互合作，以根据第22和第28条满足这些需要。
Translation: The Parties shall cooperate with each other to meet these needs in accordance with Articles 22 and 28.

Query_Text_cn: 1．进口缔约方可随时根据对生物多样性的保护和可持续使用的潜在不利影响方面的新的科学资料，并顾及对人类健康构成的风险，审查并更改其已就改性活生物体的有意越境转移作出的决定。
Translation: 1. The importing Party may, at any time, review and amend its decision regarding the intentional transboundary movement of living modified organisms in light of new scientific information regarding potential adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity, taking into account risks to human health.

Query_Text_cn: 在此种情形中，该缔约方应于三十天之内就此通知先前曾向其通报此种决定中所述改性活生物体的转移活动的任何发出通知者以及生物安全资料交换所，并应说明作出这一决定的理由。
Translation: In such cases, the Party shall, within thirty days, notify any notifier who previously informed it of the transfer activities involving the modified living organism described in the decision, as well as the Biosafety Clearing-House, and shall state the reasons for making this decision.

Query_Text_cn: 3．进口缔约方应于九十天内对此种要求作出书面回复并说明其所作决定的依据。
Translation: The importing contracting party shall respond in writing within ninety days to such a request and state the grounds for its decision.

Query_Text_cn: 4．进口缔约方可自行斟酌决定是否要求对后续进口进行风险评估。
Translation: 4. The importing Party may, at its own discretion, decide whether to require a risk assessment for subsequent imports.

Query_Text_cn: （b）拟免除对向该缔约方进口的改性活生物体采用提前知情同意程序。
Translation: (b) It is proposed to exempt the application of the advance informed consent procedure for imports of modified living organisms from that Party.

Query_Text_cn: 以上第（a）项中所述通知可适用于其后向同一缔约方进行的类似转移。
Translation: The notice referred to in item (a) above may apply to similar subsequent transfers to the same contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 2．应在以上第1（a）款所述通知中予以提供的有意越境转移资料应为附件一中具体列明的资料。
Translation: 2. The information regarding the intended cross-border transfer to be provided in the notice referred to in Clause 1(a) above shall be the specific information listed in Annex I.

Query_Text_cn: 1．缔约方可在符合本议定书目标的前提下，与其他缔约方或非缔约方就有意越境转移改性活生物体问题订立双边、区域及多边协定和安排，但条件是此种协定和安排所规定的保护程度不得低于本议定书所规定的保护程度。
Translation: 1. Parties may, provided that the objective of this Protocol is met, enter into bilateral, regional, and multilateral agreements and arrangements regarding the intentional transboundary movement of living modified organisms with other Parties or non-Parties, provided that such agreements and arrangements offer a level of protection that is not lower than that provided for by this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 2．各缔约方应通过生物安全资料交换所相互通报各自在本议定书生效日期之前或之后订立的任何此种双边、区域及多边协定和安排。
Translation: 2. Each Party shall notify other Parties, through the Biosafety Clearing-House, of any such bilateral, regional, and multilateral agreements and arrangements entered into before or after the date of entry into force of this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 3．本议定书的各项条款不得妨碍此类协定或安排的缔约方之间根据此种协定和安排进行的有意越境转移。
Translation: 3. The provisions of this Protocol shall not prevent intentional transboundary movements conducted between Parties to such agreements or arrangements in accordance with those agreements and arrangements.

Query_Text_cn: 4．任何缔约方均可决定其国内的规章条例适用于对它的某些特定进口，并应向生物安全资料交换所通报其所作决定。
Translation: 4. Any Party may decide that its domestic regulations apply to certain specific imports, and shall notify the Biosafety Clearing-House of its decision.

Query_Text_cn: 1．依照本议定书进行的风险评估应按附件三的规定并以在科学上合理的方式做出，同时应考虑采用已得到公认的风险评估技术。
Translation: 1. Risk assessments conducted under this Protocol shall be carried out in accordance with the provisions of Annex III and in a scientifically sound manner, while taking into account recognized risk assessment techniques.

Query_Text_cn: 此种风险评估应以根据第8条所提供的资料和其他现有科学证据作为评估所依据的最低限度资料，以期确定和评价改性活生物体可能对生物多样性的保护和可持续使用产生的不利影响，同时亦顾及对人类健康构成的风险。
Translation: Such risk assessment should, as a minimum, be based on the information provided in accordance with Article 8 and other available scientific evidence, with the aim of identifying and evaluating the potential adverse effects of living modified organisms on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity, while also taking into account risks to human health.

Query_Text_cn: 2．进口缔约方应确保为依照第10条作出决定而进行风险评估。
Translation: 2. The importing Party shall ensure that a risk assessment is conducted for the purpose of making decisions in accordance with Article 10.

Query_Text_cn: 它可要求出口者进行此种风险评估。
Translation: It may require exporters to conduct such risk assessments.

Query_Text_cn: 3．如果进口缔约方要求由发出通知者承担进行风险评估的费用，则发出通知者应承担此种费用。
Translation: 3. If the importing Party requires the notifier to bear the costs of conducting the risk assessment, the notifier shall be responsible for such costs.

Query_Text_cn: 1．缔约方应参照《公约》第8（g）条的规定，制定并保持适宜的机制、措施和战略，用以制约、管理和控制在本议定书风险评估条款中指明的、因改性活生物体的使用、处理和越境转移而构成的各种风险。
Translation: 1. The Parties shall, in accordance with Article 8(g) of the Convention, establish and maintain appropriate mechanisms, measures, and strategies to regulate, manage, and control the various risks arising from the use, handling, and transboundary movement of living modified organisms as specified in the risk assessment provisions of this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 2．应在必要范围内规定必须采取以风险评估结果为依据的措施，以防止改性活生物体在进口缔约方领土内对生物多样性的保护和可持续使用产生不利影响，同时亦顾及对人类健康构成的风险。
Translation: 2. It is necessary to stipulate, within an appropriate scope, that measures based on risk assessment results must be taken to prevent adverse effects of living modified organisms on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity within the territory of the importing Party, while also taking into account risks to human health.

Query_Text_cn: 3．每一缔约方均应采取适当措施，防止于无意之中造成改性活生物体的越境转移，其中包括要求于某一改性活生物体的首次释放之前进行风险评估等措施。
Translation: 3. Each Party shall take appropriate measures to prevent the unintentional transboundary movement of living modified organisms, including measures such as requiring a risk assessment to be conducted prior to the first release of a particular living modified organism.

Query_Text_cn: 4．在不妨碍以上第2款的情况下，每一缔约方均应做出努力，确保在把无论是进口的还是于当地研制的任何改性活生物体投入预定使用之前，对其进行与其生命周期或生殖期相当的一段时间的观察。
Translation: 4. Without prejudice to paragraph 2 above, each Contracting Party shall endeavor to ensure that any modified living organism, whether imported or locally developed, is observed for a period equivalent to its lifecycle or reproductive cycle before being put to intended use.

Query_Text_cn: （b）为处理此种改性活生物体或其具体特性采取适当措施。
Translation: (b) To take appropriate measures for handling such modified living organisms or their specific traits.

Query_Text_cn: 1．每一缔约方均应在获悉已发生下列情况时采取适当措施，向受到影响或可能会受到影响的国家、生物安全资料交换所并酌情向有关的国际组织发出通报：__UNDEF__因在其管辖范围内发生的某一事件造成的释放导致了或可能会导致改性活生物体的无意越境转移，从而可能对上述国家内生物多样性的保护和可持续使用产生重大不利影响，同时亦可能对这些国家的人类健康构成风险。
Translation: 1. Each Party shall take appropriate measures and notify affected or potentially affected States, the Biosafety Clearing-House, and, where appropriate, relevant international organizations, as soon as it becomes aware of the following: the release resulting from an incident within its jurisdiction has led to, or may lead to, the unintentional transboundary movement of living modified organisms, which is likely to have significant adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity in such States, and may also pose risks to human health in those States.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约方应在知悉上述情况时立即发出此种通知。
Translation: The contracting party shall immediately issue such notice upon becoming aware of the above-mentioned circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 2．每一缔约方应最迟在本议定书对其生效之日，向生物安全资料交换所提供有关其负责接收根据本条所发通知的联络点的详细情况。
Translation: 2. Each Party shall, no later than the date on which this Protocol enters into force for it, provide the Biosafety Clearing-House with detailed information regarding the contact point responsible for receiving notifications pursuant to this Article.

Query_Text_cn: （e）可供索取进一步资料的联络点。
Translation: (e) Contact point for requesting further information.

Query_Text_cn: 4．为尽可能减少其对生物多样性的保护和可持续使用的任何重大不利影响，同时亦顾及对人类健康所构成的风险，每一缔约方，如已在其管辖范围内发生以上第1款所述改性活生物体的释放，应立即与受到影响或可能会受到影响的国家进行协商，使它们得以确定适当的应对办法并主动采取必要行动，包括采取各种应急措施。
Translation: 4. In order to minimize any significant adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity, while also taking into account risks to human health, each Party, if a release of living modified organisms as referred to in paragraph 1 above has occurred within its jurisdiction, shall immediately consult with any States affected or likely to be affected, enabling them to determine appropriate response measures and to take necessary action proactively, including the implementation of various emergency measures.

Query_Text_cn: 1．为了避免对生物多样性的保护和可持续使用产生不利影响，同时亦顾及对人类健康构成的风险，每一缔约方应采取必要措施，要求对凡拟作属于本议定书范围内的有意越境转移的改性活生物体，均参照有关的国际规则和标准，在安全条件下予以处理、包装和运输。
Translation: 1. In order to avoid adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biodiversity, while also taking into account risks to human health, each Party shall take necessary measures to require that all modified living organisms intended for intentional transboundary movement within the scope of this Protocol are handled, packaged, and transported under safe conditions, in accordance with relevant international rules and standards.

Query_Text_cn: （a）拟直接作食物或饲料或加工之用的改性活生物体应附有单据，明确说明其中“可能含有”改性活生物体且不打算有意将其引入环境之中；__UNDEF__并附上供进一步索取信息资料的联络点。
Translation: (a) Modified living organisms intended for direct use as food, feed, or for processing shall be accompanied by documentation clearly stating that they “may contain” modified living organisms and are not intended for intentional introduction into the environment; __UNDEF__ and shall include a contact point for further information requests.

Query_Text_cn: 以及列出关于所涉转移符合本议定书中适用于出口者的规定的声明。
Translation: And provide a statement listing compliance with the provisions applicable to exporters under this Protocol regarding the transfer in question.

Query_Text_cn: 3．作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会应与其他相关的国际机构协商，考虑是否有必要以及以何种方式针对标识、处理、包装和运输诸方面的习惯做法制定标准。
Translation: 3. As the Conference of the Parties to this Protocol, the Meeting of the Parties shall consult with other relevant international organizations to consider whether it is necessary, and in what manner, to establish standards regarding customary practices for identification, handling, packaging, and transportation.

Query_Text_cn: 1．每一缔约方应指定一个国家联络点，负责代表缔约方与秘书处进行联系。
Translation: Each Party shall designate a national focal point responsible for representing the Party in communications with the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 每一缔约方还应指定一个或数个国家主管部门，负责行使本议定书所规定的行政职能和按照授权代表缔约方行使此类职能。
Translation: Each Party shall also designate one or more national authorities responsible for carrying out the administrative functions specified in this Protocol and for exercising such functions on behalf of the Party, as authorized.

Query_Text_cn: 每一缔约方可指定一个单一的实体同时负责履行联络点和国家主管部门这两项职能。
Translation: Each contracting party may designate a single entity to be responsible for both the functions of the contact point and the national competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 2．每一缔约方最迟应于本议定书对其生效之日将其联络点和国家主管部门的名称和地址通报秘书处。
Translation: 2. Each Party shall, no later than the date on which this Protocol enters into force for it, communicate to the Secretariat the name and address of its contact point and national competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约方如果指定了一个以上的国家主管部门，则应将有关这些主管部门各自职责的资料随通知一并送交秘书处。
Translation: If a Party designates more than one national competent authority, it shall provide the Secretariat with information regarding the respective responsibilities of each authority along with the notification.

Query_Text_cn: 如果属于此种情况，则此种资料至少应明确说明由哪一主管部门负责何种类别的改性活生物体。
Translation: If this is the case, such information should at least clearly specify which competent authority is responsible for which category of modified living organisms.

Query_Text_cn: 如在其国家联络点的指定方面或在其国家主管部门的名称和地址或职责方面出现任何变更，缔约方应立即就此通知秘书处。
Translation: If there are any changes regarding the designation of its national contact point or in the name, address, or responsibilities of its national competent authority, the Contracting Party shall immediately notify the Secretariat thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 3．秘书处应立即向各缔约方通报其根据以上第2款收到的通知，并应通过生物安全资料交换所提供此类信息资料。
Translation: 3. The Secretariat shall immediately inform all Parties of any notifications it receives pursuant to paragraph 2 above, and shall make such information available through the Biosafety Clearing-House.

Query_Text_cn: （b）协助缔约方履行本议定书，同时顾及各发展中国家缔约方、特别是其中最不发达国家和小岛屿发展中国、经济转型国家以及属于起源中心和遗传多样性中心的国家的特殊需要。
Translation: (b) Assist Parties in implementing this Protocol, while taking into account the special needs of developing country Parties, particularly the least developed countries and small island developing States among them, countries with economies in transition, as well as countries that are centers of origin and centers of genetic diversity.

Query_Text_cn: 2．生物安全资料交换所应作为为以上第1款的目的相互交流信息资料的一种手段。
Translation: 2. The Biosafety Clearing-House shall serve as a means for the exchange of information for the purposes referred to in paragraph 1 above.

Query_Text_cn: 它应作为连接渠道，提供各缔约方所提交的有关本议定书履行情况的信息资料。
Translation: It should serve as a communication channel, providing information submitted by each contracting party regarding the implementation of this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 它还应在可能情况下作为连接渠道，接通其他国际生物安全资料交流机制。
Translation: It should also serve, where possible, as a channel to connect with other international biosafety information exchange mechanisms.

Query_Text_cn: （e）它依照第33条提交的报告，包括有关提前知情同意程序实施情况的报告。
Translation: (e) It submits reports in accordance with Article 33, including reports on the implementation of the prior informed consent procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 4．作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会应在其第一次会议上审议并决定生物安全资料交换所的运作方式，包括关于其各项活动的报告，并于其后不断予以审查。
Translation: 4. At its first meeting, the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol shall review and decide on the modalities of operation of the Biosafety Clearing-House, including reports on its activities, and shall thereafter continuously review them.

Query_Text_cn: 1．进口缔约方应准许发出通知者指明，在按照本议定书的程序所提交的或进口缔约方作为本议定书提前知情同意程序的一部分而要求提交的资料中，应将哪些资料视为机密性资料。
Translation: 1. The importing Party shall permit the notifier to specify which information submitted in accordance with the procedures of this Protocol, or required by the importing Party as part of the advance informed consent procedure under this Protocol, should be treated as confidential.

Query_Text_cn: 在指明机密性资料时，应根据要求说明理由。
Translation: When indicating confidential materials, reasons should be provided as required.

Query_Text_cn: 2．进口缔约方如果决定，经发出通知者指明为机密性资料的资料不符合机密资料条件，则应就此与发出通知者进行协商，并应在公开有关资料之前将其决定通报发出通知者，同时根据要求说明理由，且在资料予以公开之前提供进行协商和对该决定进行内部审查的机会。
Translation: If the importing contracting party determines that information designated as confidential by the notifying party does not meet the criteria for confidential information, it shall consult with the notifying party on this matter. The importing contracting party shall inform the notifying party of its decision before disclosing the information, provide reasons upon request, and offer an opportunity for consultation and internal review of the decision prior to the disclosure of the information.

Query_Text_cn: 3．缔约方应对其根据本议定书收到的机密性资料保密，包括对其在本议定书提前知情同意程序范畴内收到的任何机密资料保密。
Translation: 3. The Parties shall maintain the confidentiality of any information received under this Protocol, including any confidential information received within the scope of the prior informed consent procedure under this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 每一缔约方均应确保建立关于对此种资料实行保密的程序，而且对此种资料的保密程度不应低于其对国内制造的改性活生物体的有关机密资料的保密程度。
Translation: Each Party shall ensure that procedures are established to maintain the confidentiality of such information, and that the level of confidentiality afforded to such information is no less than that accorded to similar confidential information concerning domestically produced living modified organisms.

Query_Text_cn: 4．除非发出通知者以书面形式表示同意，否则进口缔约方不得将此种资料用于商业目的。
Translation: 4. Unless the notifying party gives written consent, the importing contracting party shall not use such information for commercial purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 5．如果发出通知者撤回或已经撤回通知，进口缔约方仍应为商业和工业资料保密，其中包括关于研究和研制工作的资料以及该缔约方与发出通知者之间未能对其机密性取得一致看法的那些资料。
Translation: 5. If the notifying party withdraws or has already withdrawn the notification, the importing contracting party shall still maintain the confidentiality of commercial and industrial information, including information related to research and development activities, as well as information for which the contracting party and the notifying party have not reached a consensus regarding its confidentiality.

Query_Text_cn: （d）任何应急方法和计划。
Translation: (d) Any emergency measures and plans.

Query_Text_cn: 1．各缔约方应开展合作，以有效履行本议定书为目的，通过诸如现有的全球、区域、分区域和国家机构和组织和酌情通过促进私人部门的参与等方式，协助发展中国家和经济转型国家缔约方、特别是其中最不发达国家和小岛屿发展中国家逐步建立和／或加强生物安全方面的人力资源和体制能力，包括生物安全所需的生物技术。
Translation: 1. The Parties shall cooperate to effectively implement this Protocol by assisting developing country Parties and Parties with economies in transition, particularly the least developed countries and small island developing States among them, to gradually establish and/or strengthen human resources and institutional capacities in biosafety, including biotechnology necessary for biosafety. Such cooperation may take place through existing global, regional, subregional, and national institutions and organizations, and, as appropriate, by promoting the participation of the private sector.

Query_Text_cn: 2．为执行以上第1款的规定，应依照《公约》中的相关条款，在生物安全的能力建设方面充分考虑到各发展中国家缔约方、特别是其中最不发达国家和小岛屿发展中国家对资金以及对获得和转让技术和专门知识的需求。
Translation: 2. In implementing the provisions of paragraph 1 above, due consideration shall be given, in accordance with the relevant articles of the Convention, to the needs of developing country Parties, particularly the least developed countries and small island developing States, for funding as well as access to and transfer of technology and expertise in capacity-building for biosafety.

Query_Text_cn: 在能力建设方面开展的合作应根据每一缔约方的不同情况、能力和需要进行，包括在对生物技术进行妥善、安全管理方面和为促进生物安全而进行风险评估和风险管理方面提供科学技术培训，并提高生物安全方面的技术和体制能力。
Translation: Cooperation on capacity building should be carried out according to the specific circumstances, capabilities, and needs of each Party, including providing scientific and technical training in the proper and safe management of biotechnology, conducting risk assessment and risk management to promote biosafety, and enhancing technical and institutional capacities in the field of biosafety.

Query_Text_cn: 在此种生物安全能力建设中还应充分考虑到经济转型国家缔约方的需要。
Translation: The needs of contracting parties from economies in transition should also be fully taken into account in such biosafety capacity-building efforts.

Query_Text_cn: （a）促进和便利开展关于安全转移、处理和使用改性活生物体的公众意识及教育活动和参与，同时顾及对人类健康构成的风险，以利于生物多样性的保护和可持续使用。
Translation: (a) Promote and facilitate public awareness, education, and participation regarding the safe transfer, handling, and use of modified living organisms, while taking into account the risks to human health, in order to support the conservation and sustainable use of biodiversity.

Query_Text_cn: （b）力求确保公众意识和教育活动的内容包括使公众能够获得关于可能进口的、根据本议定书确定的改性活生物体的资料。
Translation: (b) Strive to ensure that the content of public awareness and education activities enables the public to access information about living modified organisms that may be imported and are identified in accordance with this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 2．各缔约方应按照其各自的法律和规章，在关于改性活生物体的决策过程中征求公众的意见，并在不违反关于机密资料的第21条的情况下，向公众通报此种决定的结果。
Translation: 2. Each Party shall, in accordance with its respective laws and regulations, consult the public in the decision-making process regarding living modified organisms and, without prejudice to Article 21 concerning confidential information, inform the public of the results of such decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 3．每一缔约方应力求使公众知悉可通过何种方式公开获得生物安全资料交换所的信息和资料。
Translation: 3. Each Party shall endeavor to inform the public of the means by which information and data from the Biosafety Clearing-House can be accessed.

Query_Text_cn: 1．缔约方与非缔约方之间进行的改性活生物体的越境转移应符合本议定书的目标。
Translation: The transboundary movement of modified living organisms between Parties and non-Parties shall be consistent with the objectives of this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约方可与非缔约方订立关于此种越境转移的双边、区域和多边协定及安排。
Translation: Each Party may enter into bilateral, regional, and multilateral agreements and arrangements with non-Parties regarding such transboundary movements.

Query_Text_cn: 2．各缔约方应鼓励非缔约方遵守本议定书并向生物安全资料交换所提供改性活生物体在属其国家管辖的地区内释放及其出人情况的相关信息和资料。
Translation: 2. Each Party shall encourage non-Parties to comply with this Protocol and to provide relevant information and data on the release and movement of living modified organisms within areas under their national jurisdiction to the Biosafety Clearing-House.

Query_Text_cn: 1．每一缔约方应在其国内采取适当措施，防止和酌情惩处违反其履行本议定书的国内措施的改性活生物体越境转移。
Translation: Each Party shall take appropriate measures within its territory to prevent and, as appropriate, penalize the transboundary movement of living modified organisms in violation of its domestic measures implementing this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 此种转移应视为非法越境转移。
Translation: Such transfers should be regarded as illegal cross-border transfers.

Query_Text_cn: 2．在发生非法越境转移事件时，受到影响的缔约方可要求起源缔约方酌情以运回本国或以销毁方式处置有关的改性活生物体，所涉费用自理。
Translation: 2. In the event of an incident involving illegal transboundary movement, the affected Party may request the Party of origin to, at its discretion, either repatriate or destroy the relevant modified living organisms, with all associated costs to be borne by the Party of origin.

Query_Text_cn: 3．每一缔约方应向生物安全资料交换所提供涉及到本国的非法越境转移案件的信息和资料。
Translation: 3. Each Party shall provide the Biosafety Clearing-House with information and data regarding cases of illegal transboundary movements involving its own country.

Query_Text_cn: 1．缔约方在按照本议定书或按照其履行本议定书的国内措施作出进口决定时，可根据国际义务，考虑到因改性活生物体对生物多样性的保护和可持续使用的影响而产生的社会一经济因素，特别是涉及到生物多样性对土著和地方社区所具有的价值方面的社会一经济因素。
Translation: When making import decisions under this Protocol or pursuant to domestic measures implementing this Protocol, Parties may, in accordance with their international obligations, take into account socio-economic considerations arising from the impact of living modified organisms on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity, especially those socio-economic considerations related to the value of biological diversity to indigenous and local communities.

Query_Text_cn: 2．鼓励各缔约方开展合作，针对改性活生物体所产生的任何社会一经济影响、特别是对土著和当地社区的影响进行研究和交流信息。
Translation: 2. Encourage all Parties to engage in cooperation to study and exchange information on any socio-economic impacts arising from living modified organisms, with particular attention to the impacts on indigenous and local communities.

Query_Text_cn: 第27条赔偿责任和补救作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会应在其第一次会议上发起一个旨在详细拟定适用于因改性活生物体的越境转移而造成损害的赔偿责任和补救方法的国际规则和程序的进程，同时分析和参照目前在国际法领域内就此类事项开展的工作，并争取在四年时间内完成这一进程。
Translation:
Article 27: Liability and Redress

The Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol shall, at its first meeting, initiate a process to elaborate in detail international rules and procedures applicable to liability and redress for damage resulting from the transboundary movement of modified living organisms. This process shall be conducted with analysis and reference to ongoing work in the field of international law on such matters, and efforts shall be made to complete this process within four years.

Query_Text_cn: 1．在考虑履行本议定书所需财政资源时，缔约方应考虑到《公约》第20条的规定。
Translation: 1. When considering the financial resources required to implement this Protocol, the Parties shall take into account the provisions of Article 20 of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2．应由受委托负责按照《公约》第21条设立的财务机制的运作的机构充任本议定书的财务机制。
Translation: 2. The entity entrusted with operating the financial mechanism established under Article 21 of the Convention shall serve as the financial mechanism for this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 3．对于本议定书第22条中所述及的能力建设，作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会在就以上第2款中提及的财务机制提出指导意见供缔约方大会审议时，应考虑到各发展中国家缔约方、特别是其中最不发达国家和小岛屿发展中国家的对财政资源的需求。
Translation: 3. With regard to capacity-building as referred to in Article 22 of this Protocol, when providing guidance on the financial mechanism mentioned in paragraph 2 above for consideration by the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol, due consideration shall be given to the needs of developing country Parties, in particular the least developed countries and small island developing States among them, for financial resources.

Query_Text_cn: 4．在以上第1款所涉范畴内，各缔约方亦应考虑到各发展中国家缔约方和经济转型国家缔约方、特别是其中最不发达国家和小岛屿发展中国家在为履行本议定书而努力确定和开展能力建设活动方面的各种需要。
Translation: 4. Within the scope referred to in paragraph 1 above, each Party shall also take into account the various needs of developing country Parties and Parties with economies in transition, particularly the least developed countries and small island developing States among them, in their efforts to identify and implement capacity-building activities for the purpose of fulfilling this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 5．缔约方大会在其各项相关决定、包括在本议定书获得通过之前作出的决定中向《公约》财务机制提供的指导，应在细节上作必要修改后适用于本条的规定。
Translation: 5. The guidance provided by the Conference of the Parties to the financial mechanism of the Convention in its relevant decisions, including those made prior to the adoption of this Protocol, shall apply to the provisions of this Article, subject to necessary modifications in detail.

Query_Text_cn: 6．为履行本议定书的条款，发达国家缔约方亦可通过双边、区域和多边渠道提供财政和技术资源，而发展中国家缔约方和经济转型国家缔约方则可利用这些渠道获得财政和技术资源。
Translation: 6. In order to fulfill the provisions of this Protocol, developed country Parties may also provide financial and technological resources through bilateral, regional, and multilateral channels, while developing country Parties and Parties with economies in transition may access financial and technological resources through these channels.

Query_Text_cn: 1．缔约方大会应作为本议定书的缔约方会议。
Translation: 1. The Conference of the Parties shall serve as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 2．非本议定书缔约方的《公约》缔约方可作为观察员出席作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会的任何一次会议。
Translation: 2. Parties to the Convention that are not Parties to this Protocol may participate as observers in any session of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 在缔约方大会作为本议定书的缔约方会议时，涉及本议定书的决定仅应由本议定书各缔约方作出。
Translation: When the Conference of the Parties serves as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol, decisions relating to this Protocol shall be taken only by the Parties to this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 3．在缔约方大会作为本议定书缔约方会议时，主席团中代表届时尚不是本议定书缔约方的《公约》缔约方的任何成员应由本议定书缔约方从议定书各缔约方中另行选举出一名成员予以替代。
Translation: 3. When the Conference of the Parties serves as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol, any member of the Bureau representing a Party to the Convention that is not, at that time, a Party to this Protocol shall be replaced by a member to be elected by and from among the Parties to this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 4．作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会应定期审查本议定书的履行情况，并应在其任务范围内作出促进其有效履行的必要决定。
Translation: 4. As the Conference of the Parties to this Protocol, the Meeting of the Parties shall regularly review the implementation of this Protocol and, within its mandate, make the necessary decisions to promote its effective implementation.

Query_Text_cn: （f）行使履行本议定书所需的其他职能。
Translation: (f) To perform other functions necessary for the implementation of this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 5．除非作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会以协商一致方式另外作出决定，缔约方大会的议事规则和《公约》的财务细则应在细节上作必要修改后适用于本议定书。
Translation: 5. Unless the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol decides otherwise by consensus, the rules of procedure of the Conference of the Parties and the financial rules of the Convention shall apply to this Protocol, subject to such modifications as may be necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 6．作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会第一次会议应由秘书处结合缔约方大会预定于本议定书生效之日后召开的第一次会议召集举行。
Translation: 6. The first meeting of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol shall be convened by the Secretariat in conjunction with the first meeting of the Conference of the Parties scheduled to be held after the entry into force of this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会的其后各次常会应每年结合缔约方大会的常会举行，除非作为本议定缔约方会议的缔约方大会另有决定。
Translation: The subsequent regular sessions of the Conference of the Parties to this Protocol shall be held annually in conjunction with the regular sessions of the Conference of the Parties, unless the Conference of the Parties to this Protocol decides otherwise.

Query_Text_cn: 7．作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会的非常会议应于作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会认为必要的其他时间举行，或根据任何缔约方的书面请求举行，但这一请求须在秘书处向各缔约方作出通报后六个月内获得至少三分之一缔约方的支持。
Translation: 7. Extraordinary sessions of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol shall be held at such other times as deemed necessary by the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol, or upon the written request of any Party, provided that, within six months of the Secretariat notifying all Parties of such a request, it is supported by at least one third of the Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 8．联合国、其各专门机构和国际原子能机构以及它们的非《公约》缔约方的任何会员国、成员国或观察员皆可作为观察员出席作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会。
Translation: 8. The United Nations, its specialized agencies, the International Atomic Energy Agency, and any member state or observer of these organizations that is not a Party to the Convention may participate as observers in the meetings of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 任何组织或机构，无论是国家或国际、政府或非政府性质的组织或机构，只要在本议定书所涉事项方面具有资格、且已通知秘书处它愿意作为观察员出席作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会，均可被接纳参加会议，除非至少有三分之一的出席缔约方表示反对。
Translation: Any organization or institution, whether national or international, governmental or non-governmental, that is qualified in matters covered by this Protocol and has notified the Secretariat of its willingness to participate as an observer at meetings of the Conference of the Parties to this Protocol, may be admitted to attend such meetings unless at least one-third of the Parties present object.

Query_Text_cn: 除非本条中另有规定，观察员的接纳和参加应遵守以上第5款中述及的议事规则。
Translation: Unless otherwise provided in this article, the admission and participation of observers shall be governed by the rules of procedure referred to in paragraph 5 above.

Query_Text_cn: 1．根据《公约》或在《公约》下设立的任何附属机构可依照作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会作出的决定为本议定书提供服务。__UNDEF__在此种情形中，缔约方会议应明确规定该机构应行使哪些职能。
Translation: 1. Any subsidiary body established under the Convention or in accordance with the Convention may, pursuant to a decision of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol, provide services to this Protocol. In such cases, the Conference of the Parties shall specify which functions the body shall exercise.

Query_Text_cn: 2．非本议定书缔约方的《公约》缔约方可作为观察员出席议定书附属机构的任何会议。
Translation: 2. Parties to the Convention that are not Parties to this Protocol may attend any meeting of the subsidiary bodies of the Protocol as observers.

Query_Text_cn: 当《公约》的附属机构作为本议定书的附属机构时，涉及本议定书的决定仅应由本议定书的缔约方作出。
Translation: When a subsidiary body of the Convention serves as a subsidiary body of this Protocol, decisions relating to this Protocol shall be taken only by the Parties to this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 3．当《公约》的附属机构就涉及本议定书的事项行使其职能时，该附属机构主席团中代表届时尚不是本议定书缔约方的《公约》缔约方的任何成员应由本议定书缔约方从议定书各缔约方中另行选举出一名成员予以替代。
Translation: 3. When a subsidiary body of the Convention exercises its functions concerning matters related to this Protocol, any member of the bureau of that subsidiary body representing a Party to the Convention that is not yet a Party to this Protocol shall be replaced by a member elected by the Parties to this Protocol from among the Parties to the Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 1．依照《公约》第24条设立的秘书处应作为本议定书的秘书处。
Translation: 1. The Secretariat established under Article 24 of the Convention shall serve as the secretariat for this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 2．《公约》中有关秘书处职能的第24条第1款应在细节上作必要修改后适用于本议定书。
Translation: 2. Article 24, paragraph 1 of the Convention concerning the functions of the Secretariat shall apply to this Protocol, subject to necessary modifications in detail.

Query_Text_cn: 3．为本议定书提供的秘书处服务所涉费用可分开支付时，此种费用应由本议定书各缔约方予以支付。
Translation: When the costs of secretariat services provided for this Protocol can be separated, such costs shall be borne by the Parties to this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约各国政府，认为在处理它们的贸易和经济事业的关系方面，应以提高生活水平、保证充分就业、保证实际收入和有效需求的巨大持续增长、扩大世界资源的充分利用以及发展商品的生产与交换为目的。切望达成互惠互利协议，导致大幅度地削减关税和其它贸易障碍，取消国际贸易中的歧视待遇，以对上述目的作出贡献。
Translation: The governments of the contracting parties, considering that their relations in the field of trade and economic affairs should be conducted with the aim of raising living standards, ensuring full employment, guaranteeing a substantial and sustained growth of real income and effective demand, expanding the full utilization of world resources, and developing the production and exchange of goods, earnestly desire to reach mutually beneficial agreements that will lead to significant reductions in tariffs and other trade barriers, the elimination of discriminatory treatment in international commerce, and thereby contribute to the achievement of the aforementioned objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条一般最惠国待遇1.在对输出或输入、有关输出或输入及输出入货物的国际支付转帐所征收的关税和费用方面，在征收上述关税和费用的方法方面，在输出和输入的规章手续方面，以及在本协定第三条第2款及第4款所述事项方面，一缔约国对来自或运往其它国家的产品所给予的利益、优待、特权或豁免，应当立即无条件地给予来自或运往所有其它缔约国的相同产品。注指有注释和补充规定，见附件九。以下同。
Translation:
Article 1: General Most-Favored-Nation Treatment

1. With respect to customs duties and charges of any kind imposed on or in connection with importation or exportation, or imposed on the international transfer of payments for imports or exports, and with respect to the method of levying such duties and charges, as well as with respect to all rules and formalities in connection with importation and exportation, and with respect to the matters referred to in paragraphs 2 and 4 of Article III of this Agreement, any advantage, favor, privilege, or immunity granted by any contracting party to any product originating in or destined for any other country shall be accorded immediately and unconditionally to the like product originating in or destined for the territories of all other contracting parties.

Note: For annotations and supplementary provisions, see Annex IX. The same applies hereinafter.

Query_Text_cn: (丁)本协定附件五和附件六所列的毗邻国家之间专享的现行优惠待遇。
Translation: Exclusive preferential treatment currently enjoyed between neighboring countries as listed in Annex V and Annex VI of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 3.原属于奥托曼帝国后于1923年7月24日分离出来的国家之间实施的优惠待遇，如能按本协定第二十五条第5款的规定予以批准，应不受本条第1款规定的约束。对这个问题运用本协定第二十五条第5款，应参考本协定第二十九条第1款。
Translation: 3. Preferential treatment implemented among countries that originally belonged to the Ottoman Empire and separated on July 24, 1923, may, if approved in accordance with paragraph 5 of Article 25 of this Agreement, be exempt from the restrictions stipulated in paragraph 1 of this Article. The application of paragraph 5 of Article 25 of this Agreement to this issue shall be made with reference to paragraph 1 of Article 29 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: (b)对有关减让表内未列明的任何产品的关税和费用，这一产品的优惠差额应不超过1947年4月10日所实施的最惠国税率与优惠税率的差额。
Translation: (b) For any products not specified in the schedule of concessions, the preferential margin for such products shall not exceed the difference between the most-favored-nation rate and the preferential rate as applied on April 10, 1947.

Query_Text_cn: 对于本协定附件七所列的各缔约国、本款(a)项及(b)项所称1947年4月10日的日期，应分别以这个附件所列的日期代替。
Translation: For each contracting party listed in Annex VII to this Agreement, the date of April 10, 1947, referred to in subparagraphs (a) and (b) of this paragraph, shall be replaced by the respective date specified for that party in the said Annex.

Query_Text_cn: ）一缔约国对其它缔约国贸易所给的待遇，不得低于本协定所附这一缔约国的有关减让表中有关部分所列的待遇。
Translation: The treatment accorded by any contracting party to the trade of other contracting parties shall not be less favorable than that provided for in the relevant parts of the schedule of concessions relating to that contracting party annexed to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （）一缔约国领土的产品如在另一缔约国减让表的第一部分内列名，当这种产品输入到这一减让表所适用的领土时，应依照减让表的规定、条件或限制，对它免征超过减让表所列的普通关税。
Translation: When the products of the territory of one contracting party are listed in Part I of the schedule of concessions of another contracting party, such products, when imported into the territory to which the schedule applies, shall be exempt from ordinary customs duties in excess of those specified in the schedule, in accordance with the provisions, conditions, or limitations set forth therein.

Query_Text_cn: 对这种产品，也应免征超过于本协定签订之日对输入或有关输入所征收的任何其它税费，或免征超过于本协定签订之日进口领土内现行法律规定以后要直接或授权征收的任何其它税费。
Translation: Such products should also be exempt from any other taxes or charges imposed on imports or related to imports in excess of those levied on the date of the signing of this Agreement, or from any other taxes or charges imposed directly or by authorization under the laws in force in the importing territory on the date of the signing of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （）一缔约国领土的产品如在另一缔约国减让表的第二部分内列名，当这种产品输入到这一减让表所适用的领土，按照本协定第一条可以享受优惠待遇时，应依照减让表的规定、条件或限制，对它免征超过减让表所列的普通关税。
Translation: When a product of the territory of one contracting party is specified in Part II of the Schedule of another contracting party, and such product, upon importation into the territory to which the Schedule applies, is entitled to preferential treatment in accordance with Article I of this Agreement, it shall, in accordance with the provisions, conditions, or limitations set forth in the Schedule, be exempt from the imposition of ordinary customs duties in excess of those specified in the Schedule.

Query_Text_cn: 对这种产品，也应免征超过于本协定签订之日对输入或有关输入所征收的任何其它税费，或免征超过于本协定签订之日进口领土内现行法律规定以后要直接或授权征收的任何其它税费。
Translation: Such products shall also be exempt from any other taxes or charges in excess of those imposed on imports or in connection with imports as of the date of the signing of this Agreement, or from any other taxes or charges in excess of those that, under the laws in force in the importing territory on the date of the signing of this Agreement, are to be imposed directly or by authorization in the future.

Query_Text_cn: 但本条的规定并不妨碍缔约国维持在本协定签订的关于何种货物可按优惠税率进口的已有规定。
Translation: However, the provisions of this Article shall not preclude any Contracting Party from maintaining existing regulations, as of the date of this Agreement, regarding which goods may be imported at preferential tariff rates.

Query_Text_cn: （）相当于提供服务成本的规费或其它费用。
Translation: () is equivalent to fees or other charges for the cost of providing services.

Query_Text_cn: 3.缔约国不得变更完税价格的审定或货币的折合方法，以损害本协定所附这一缔约国的有关减让表所列的任何减让的价值。
Translation: 3. No contracting party shall alter the method of determining the customs value or the method of currency conversion in such a way as to impair the value of any concession listed in the schedule of concessions annexed to this Agreement for that contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 4.当缔约国在形式上或事实上对本协定有关减让表列名的某种产品的进口建立、维持或授权实施某种垄断时，这种垄断平均提供的保护，除减让表内有规定或经原谈判减让的各缔约国另有议定的以外，不得超过有关减让表所列的保护水平。
Translation: 4. When a contracting party formally or in practice establishes, maintains, or authorizes a monopoly on the importation of a product listed in the schedule of concessions under this Agreement, the average level of protection provided by such monopoly shall not exceed the level of protection specified in the relevant schedule of concessions, except as otherwise provided in the schedule or as otherwise agreed by the contracting parties originally involved in the negotiation of the concession.

Query_Text_cn: 但本条的规定，并不限制缔约国根据本协定的其它规定，向本国生产者提供任何形式的援助。
Translation: However, the provisions of this Article do not restrict any Party from providing any form of assistance to its domestic producers in accordance with other provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 5.如果一缔约国相信某一产品应享受的待遇在本协定所附另一缔约国的减让表所订的减让中已有规定，并认为另一缔约国未给予此种待遇时，这一缔约国可以直接提请另一缔约国注意这一问题。
Translation: 5. If a contracting party believes that the treatment to be accorded to a certain product is already provided for in the concessions set forth in the Schedule of another contracting party annexed to this Agreement, and considers that such treatment has not been accorded by the other contracting party, the former may directly bring the matter to the attention of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 后一缔约国如同意减让表所规定的待遇确系对方所要求的待遇，但声明：由于本国法院或其它有关当局的决定，按照本国税法有关产品不能归入可以享受减让表的应有待遇的一类，因而不能给予这项待遇时，则这两个缔约国，连同其它有实质利害关系的缔约国，应立即进一步进行协商，以便对这一问题达成补偿性的调整办法。
Translation: If a contracting party agrees to the treatment specified in the schedule of concessions, which is indeed the treatment requested by the other party, but declares that, due to decisions by its courts or other relevant authorities, certain products cannot be classified under its tax laws as eligible for the treatment provided in the schedule of concessions and therefore cannot be granted such treatment, then the two contracting parties, together with any other contracting parties with substantial interests, shall immediately enter into further consultations in order to reach a compensatory adjustment regarding this issue.

Query_Text_cn: 6.（）缔约国若是国际货币基金的成员国，其减让表所列的从量关税和费用以及其维持的从量关税和费用的优惠差额，系以这一国家的货币按照国际货币基金在本协定签订之日所接受或临时认可的平价表示。
Translation: 6. If a contracting party is a member of the International Monetary Fund, the specific duties and charges listed in its schedule of concessions, as well as the preferential margins of the specific duties and charges it maintains, shall be expressed in terms of the par value of that country's currency as accepted or provisionally recognized by the International Monetary Fund on the date of the signing of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 但须经缔约国全体（指按本协定第二十五条采取联合行动的缔约各国）同意这种调整不致损害本协定有关减让表及本协定其它部分所列减让的价值，而对于与调整的必要性和紧迫性有关的一切因素，都应予以适当考虑。
Translation: However, such adjustments must be approved by all contracting parties (referring to those acting jointly under Article XXV of this Agreement), ensuring that the value of concessions specified in the schedules of concessions and other parts of this Agreement is not impaired. All factors relevant to the necessity and urgency of the adjustment shall be duly taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: （）对于不是国际货币基金成员国的缔约国，自其成为国际货币基金的成员国或按照本协定第十五条签订特别汇兑协定之日起，上述规定也应适用。
Translation: The above provisions shall also apply to any Contracting Party that is not a member of the International Monetary Fund, as from the date on which it becomes a member of the International Monetary Fund or enters into a special exchange agreement in accordance with Article XV of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 7.本协定所附的各减让表，应视为本协定第一部分的组成部分。
Translation: 7. The schedules of concessions annexed to this Agreement shall be considered an integral part of Part I of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条国内税与国内规章的国民待遇1.缔约各国认为，国内税和其它国内费用，影响产品的国内销售、推销、购买、运输、分配或使用的法令、条例和规定，以及对产品的混合、加工或使用须符合特定数量或比例要求的国内数量限制条例，在对进口产品或国产品实施时，不应用来对国内生产提供保护。
Translation:
Article 3: National Treatment on Domestic Taxes and Domestic Regulations

1. The contracting parties recognize that domestic taxes and other internal charges, laws, regulations, and requirements affecting the internal sale, offering for sale, purchase, transportation, distribution, or use of products, as well as domestic quantitative regulations requiring products to be mixed, processed, or used in specified amounts or proportions, shall not be applied to imported or domestic products so as to afford protection to domestic production.

Query_Text_cn: 2.一缔约国领土的产品输入到另一缔约国领土时，不应对它直接或间接征收高于对相同的国产品所直接或间接征收的国内税或其它国内费用。
Translation: 2. When products of the territory of one contracting party are imported into the territory of another contracting party, they shall not be subject, directly or indirectly, to internal taxes or other internal charges of any kind in excess of those applied, directly or indirectly, to like domestic products.

Query_Text_cn: 同时，缔约国不应对进口产品或国产品采用其它与本条第1款规定的原则有抵触的办法来实施国内税或其它国内费用。
Translation: At the same time, contracting parties shall not apply domestic taxes or other internal charges to imported or domestic products in any manner contrary to the principles set forth in paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 3.与本条第2款有抵触的现行实施的国内税，如果是1947年4月10日有效的贸易协定中所特别规定允许征收的，而且在有关贸易协定中还规定了凡已征收这种国内税的产品，它的进口关税即不能任意增加，则征收这种国内税的缔约国，可以推迟实施本条第2款的规定，直到在贸易协定中所承担的义务得到解除，它能够增加进口关税以补偿国内税保护因素的取消之时为止。
Translation: 3. If any existing domestic tax that conflicts with paragraph 2 of this Article is specifically permitted to be levied under a trade agreement in force on April 10, 1947, and if such trade agreement further provides that, for products on which such domestic tax has been imposed, the import duties thereon may not be increased arbitrarily, then the contracting party imposing such domestic tax may postpone the application of the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article until the obligations undertaken in the trade agreement have been released and it is able to increase the import duties to compensate for the removal of the protective element of the domestic tax.

Query_Text_cn: 4.一缔约国领土的产品输入到另一缔约国领土时，在关于产品的国内销售、推销、购买、运输、分配或使用的全部法令、条例和规定方面，所享受的待遇应不低于相同的国产品所享受的待遇。
Translation: 4. When products from the territory of one contracting party are imported into the territory of another contracting party, they shall be accorded treatment no less favorable than that accorded to like domestic products in respect of all laws, regulations, and requirements affecting their internal sale, offering for sale, purchase, transportation, distribution, or use.

Query_Text_cn: 但本款的规定不应妨碍国内差别运输费用的实施，如果实施这种差别运输费用纯系基于运输工具的经济使用而与产品的国别无关。
Translation: However, the provisions of this paragraph shall not preclude the application of domestic differential transportation charges, provided that such charges are based solely on the economic utilization of transportation facilities and are not related to the country of origin of the products.

Query_Text_cn: 5.缔约国不得建立或维持某种对产品的混合、加工或使用须符合特定数量或比例的国内数量限制条例，直接或间接要求某一特定数量或比例的条例对象产品必须由国内来源供应。
Translation: 5.
