Translation: (b) The national law of any elected State may provide that, if the applicant chooses to restrict his claims in accordance with the provisions of item (a), those parts of the international application which, as a consequence of such restriction, are no longer the subject of the international preliminary examination shall, with respect to their effect in that State, be considered withdrawn unless the applicant pays the prescribed fee to the national patent office of that State.

Query_Text_cn: （ｃ）如果申请人不在规定的时间期限内遵守第（ａ）项所载的提请，则国际初步审查单位应就国际申请中所涉看来是主要发明的那些部分写成国际初步审查报告，并在上述报告中列举有关的情节。__UNDEF__任何选定国家的国内法可规定：__UNDEF__如果其国家局认为国际初步审查单位的提请是正确的，则该国际申请中与主要发明无关的那些部分，就其在该国的效力来说，应视为已经撤回，除非申请人向该局交付相应费用。
Translation: (c) If the applicant does not comply with the invitation referred to in paragraph (a) within the prescribed time limit, the International Preliminary Examining Authority shall establish the international preliminary examination report on those parts of the international application which appear to relate to the main invention, and shall indicate the relevant circumstances in the said report. The national law of any elected State may provide that, if its national Office considers the invitation by the International Preliminary Examining Authority to be justified, those parts of the international application which do not relate to the main invention shall, as far as that State is concerned, be considered withdrawn unless the applicant pays the prescribed fee to that Office.

Query_Text_cn: （ｉ）国际申请涉及一项国际初步审查单位按附属规则规定并不需要进行国际初步审查的主题，并且在特定情况下决定不进行这种审查，或者（ｉｉ）说明书、权项或附图不清楚，或者说明书对权项的解说不充分，因而不可能对申请专利的发明的新颖性、创造性步骤（不是显而易见的）或工业上的应用的可能性，形成有意义的见解时。__UNDEF__则上述单位，将不就第三十三条第（１）款规定的各项问题进行探究，并应将这种意见及其理由通知申请人。
Translation: (i) Where the international application relates to a subject matter for which the International Preliminary Examining Authority, pursuant to the applicable regulations, is not required to carry out an international preliminary examination and, in certain cases, decides not to carry out such examination, or (ii) where the description, claims, or drawings are unclear, or the description is insufficient to support the claims, making it impossible to form a meaningful opinion on the novelty, inventive step (non-obviousness), or industrial applicability of the invention claimed, the said Authority shall not examine the matters specified in Article 33(1) and shall notify the applicant of such opinion and the reasons therefor.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条凡本公约对其生效的会员国,承诺执行一项国家政策,以保证有效地废除童工并将准予就业或工作的最低年龄逐步提高到符合年轻人身心最充分发展的水平。
Translation: Article 1: Each Member for which this Convention is in force undertakes to pursue a national policy designed to ensure the effective abolition of child labour and to progressively raise the minimum age for admission to employment or work to a level consistent with the fullest physical and mental development of young persons.

Query_Text_cn: 除了符合本公约第四至第八条规定外,未满该年龄者不得允许其受雇于或从事任何职业。
Translation: Except in compliance with the provisions of Articles 4 to 8 of this Convention, no person under the specified minimum age shall be permitted to be employed or to engage in any occupation.

Query_Text_cn: 2.凡批准本公约的会员国得随后再以声明书通知国际劳工局长,告知其规定了高于以前规定的最低年龄。
Translation: 2. Any Member which has ratified this Convention may subsequently notify the Director-General of the International Labour Office, by a declaration, that it has prescribed a minimum age higher than that previously specified.

Query_Text_cn: 3.根据本条第1款规定的最低年龄应不低于完成义务教育的年龄,并在任何情况下不得低于十五岁。
Translation: 3. The minimum age specified in paragraph 1 of this Article shall not be lower than the age at which compulsory education is completed and, in any case, shall not be less than fifteen years.

Query_Text_cn: 4.尽管有本条第3款的规定,如会员国的经济和教育设施不够发达,得在与有关的雇主组织和工人组织(如存在此种组织)协商后,初步规定最低年龄为十四岁。
Translation: 4. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 3 of this Article, where the economic and educational facilities of a Member are insufficiently developed, the Member may, after consultation with the relevant employers' and workers' organizations where such organizations exist, initially specify a minimum age of fourteen years.

Query_Text_cn: (a)如此做的理由(b)自某日起放弃其援用有关规定的权利。
Translation:
(a) The reasons for doing so  
(b) Waives its right to invoke the relevant provisions as of a certain date.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条1.准予从事按其性质或其工作环境很可能有害年轻人健康、安全或道德的任何职业或工作类别,其最低年龄不得少于十八岁。
Translation: Article 3(1): Authorization to engage in any occupation or category of work which, by its nature or the circumstances in which it is carried out, is likely to harm the health, safety, or morals of young persons shall not be granted to anyone under the age of eighteen.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本条第1款适用的职业类别应由国家法律或条例,或由主管当局在与有关的雇主组织和工人组织(如存在此种组织)协商后确定。
Translation: The occupational categories to which paragraph 1 of this Article applies shall be determined by national laws or regulations, or by the competent authority after consultation with the relevant employers' and workers' organizations, where such organizations exist.

Query_Text_cn: 3.尽管有本条第1款的规定,国家法律或条例,或主管当局在与有关的雇主组织和工人组织(如存在此种组织)协商后可准予从十六岁起就业或工作,条件是必须充分保护有关年轻人的健康、安全和道德,这些年轻人并须在有关的活动部门受过适当的专门指导或职业训练。
Translation: 3. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article, national laws or regulations, or the competent authority after consultation with the relevant employers' and workers' organizations (where such organizations exist), may authorize employment or work from the age of sixteen, provided that the health, safety, and morals of the young persons concerned are fully protected and that those young persons have received adequate specific instruction or vocational training in the relevant branch of activity.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条1.如属必要,主管当局在与有关的雇主组织和工人组织(如存在此种组织)协商后,对运用本公约将产生特殊和重大问题的有限几种职业或工作得豁免其应用本公约。
Translation: Article 4(1): Where necessary, and after consultation with the relevant employers' and workers' organizations (where such organizations exist), the competent authorities may exempt a limited number of occupations or jobs from the application of this Convention if its implementation would give rise to specific and significant problems.

Query_Text_cn: 2.凡批准本公约的会员国应在其按照国际劳工组织章程第22条的规定提交的关于实施本公约的第一次报告中,列举按照本条第1款的规定得豁免予应用本公约的任何职业或工作类别,陈述豁免的理由,并应在以后的报告中说明该国法律和实践对豁免此类职业或工作所作规定的状况,并说明在何种程度上已经或建议对此类职业或工作实施本公约。
Translation: Any Member State that ratifies this Convention shall, in its first report on the implementation of the Convention submitted under Article 22 of the Constitution of the International Labour Organization, list any occupations or categories of work that are exempted from the application of the Convention pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article, state the reasons for such exemptions, and in subsequent reports, describe the status of national laws and practices regarding the exemption of such occupations or categories of work, and indicate to what extent the Convention has been or is proposed to be applied to such occupations or categories of work.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本公约第三条所规定的职业或工作,不得按照本条规定而免于应用本公约。
Translation: 3. The occupations or jobs specified in Article 3 of this Convention shall not be exempted from the application of this Convention under the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条1.经济和行政设施不够发达的会员国在与有关的雇主组织和工人组织(如存在此种组织)协商后,得在开始时限制本公约的应用范围。
Translation: Article 5(1). Member States whose economic and administrative facilities are insufficiently developed may, after consultation with the relevant employers' and workers' organizations where such organizations exist, initially limit the scope of application of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2.凡援用本条第1款规定的会员国,应在附于其批准书的声明中,详细说明哪些经济活动部门或企业类别将应用本公约的规定。
Translation: Any Member State invoking the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall specify in a declaration attached to its instrument of ratification which sectors of economic activity or categories of undertakings will be subject to the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 以及种植园和其他主要为商业目的而生产的农业企业,但不包括为当地消费而生产又不正式雇工的家庭企业和小型企业。
Translation: as well as plantations and other agricultural enterprises primarily engaged in commercial production, but excluding household and small-scale enterprises that produce for local consumption and do not formally employ labor.

Query_Text_cn: (b)得在任何时候通过向国际劳工局长提交声明书,正式扩大应用范围。
Translation: (b) The scope of application may be formally extended at any time by submitting a declaration to the Director-General of the International Labour Office.

Query_Text_cn: (c)为便于选择一种职业或行业的培训指导或引导计划。
Translation: (c) To facilitate the selection of a training, guidance, or orientation program for a particular occupation or industry.

Query_Text_cn: (b)不会妨碍他们上学、参加经主管当局批准的职业指导或培训计划或从所受教育中获益的能力。
Translation: (b) It shall not hinder their ability to attend school, participate in vocational guidance or training programs approved by the competent authorities, or benefit from the education they receive.

Query_Text_cn: 2.国家法律或条例还得允许年龄至少为十五岁但还未完成其义务教育的人从事符合本条第1款(a)和(b)项所要求的工作。
Translation: 2. National laws or regulations may also permit the employment of persons who are at least fifteen years old but have not yet completed their compulsory education in work that meets the requirements set out in subparagraphs (a) and (b) of paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 3.主管当局应确定按照本条第1和第2款的规定得被允许就业或工作的活动,并应规定从事此种就业或工作的工作小时数和工作条件。
Translation: 3. The competent authorities shall determine the activities that may be permitted for employment or work in accordance with paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, and shall stipulate the working hours and conditions for such employment or work.

Query_Text_cn: 4.尽管有本条第1和第2款的规定,已援用第二条第4款的会员国,只要其继续这样做,得以十二岁和十四岁取代本条第1款的十三岁和十五岁,并以十四岁取代本条第2款的十五岁。
Translation: 4. Notwithstanding paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, any Member which has availed itself of the provisions of paragraph 4 of Article 2 may, so long as it continues to do so, substitute twelve and fourteen years for thirteen and fifteen years specified in paragraph 1 of this Article, and fourteen years for fifteen years specified in paragraph 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条1.主管当局在与有关的雇主组织和工人组织(如存在此种组织)协商后,得在个别情况下,例如参加艺术表演,准许除外于本公约第二条关于禁止就业或工作的规定。
Translation: Article 8(1): The competent authorities, after consulting with the relevant employers' and workers' organizations where such organizations exist, may, in individual cases such as participation in artistic performances, grant exceptions to the prohibition of employment or work stipulated in Article 2 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如此作出的准许应对准予就业或工作的小时数加以限制,并规定其条件。
Translation: 2. Such permission shall be subject to limitations on the number of hours of employment or work authorized and shall specify the conditions thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条1.主管当局应采取一切必要措施,包括规定适当惩罚,以保证本公约诸条款的有效实施。
Translation: Article 9(1). The competent authorities shall take all necessary measures, including the imposition of appropriate penalties, to ensure the effective implementation of the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2.国家法律或条例或主管当局应规定何种人员有责任遵守实施公约的条款。
Translation: 2. National laws, regulations, or competent authorities should specify which personnel are responsible for complying with and implementing the provisions of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 这种登记册或文件应包括他所雇用或为他工作的不足十八岁的人的姓名、年龄或出生日期,尽可能有正式证明。
Translation: Such register or document shall include the names, ages or dates of birth of all persons under the age of eighteen employed by or working for him, with formal proof thereof wherever possible.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条1.本公约按照本条条款修正一九一九年(工业)最低年龄公约,一九二O年(海上)最低年龄公约,一九二一年(农业)最低年龄公约,一九二一年(扒炭工和司炉工)最低年龄公约,一九三二年(非工业就业)最低年龄公约,一九三六年(海上)最低年龄公约(修订),一九三七年(工业)最低年龄公约(修订),一九三七年(非工业就业)最低年龄公约(修订),一九五九年(渔民)最低年龄公约,以及一九六五年(井下工作)最低年龄公约。
Translation:
Article 10

1. This Convention, in accordance with the provisions of this Article, revises the Minimum Age (Industry) Convention, 1919; the Minimum Age (Sea) Convention, 1920; the Minimum Age (Agriculture) Convention, 1921; the Minimum Age (Trimmers and Stokers) Convention, 1921; the Minimum Age (Non-Industrial Employment) Convention, 1932; the Minimum Age (Sea) Convention (Revised), 1936; the Minimum Age (Industry) Convention (Revised), 1937; the Minimum Age (Non-Industrial Employment) Convention (Revised), 1937; the Minimum Age (Fishermen) Convention, 1959; and the Minimum Age (Underground Work) Convention, 1965.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本公约生效不应停止接受下列公约的批准：__UNDEF__一九三六年(海上)最低年龄公约(修订),一九三七年(工业)最低年龄公约(修订),一九三七年(非工业就业)最低年龄公约(修订),一九五九年(渔民)最低年龄公约,或一九六五年(井下工作)最低年龄公约。
Translation: 2. The entry into force of this Convention shall not preclude the acceptance of the following Conventions: the Minimum Age (Sea) Convention (Revised), 1936; the Minimum Age (Industry) Convention (Revised), 1937; the Minimum Age (Non-Industrial Employment) Convention (Revised), 1937; the Minimum Age (Fishermen) Convention, 1959; or the Minimum Age (Underground Work) Convention, 1965.

Query_Text_cn: 3.如有关各方都以批准本公约或向国际劳工局长送达声明书表示同意停止对一九一九年(工业)最低年龄公约,一九二O年(海上)最低年龄公约,一九二一年(农业)最低年龄公约和一九二一年(执炭工和司炉工)最低年龄公约的继续批准,则应停止其继续批准。
Translation: 3. If all parties concerned express their consent to cease the continued ratification of the Minimum Age (Industry) Convention, 1919, the Minimum Age (Sea) Convention, 1920, the Minimum Age (Agriculture) Convention, 1921, and the Minimum Age (Trimmers and Stokers) Convention, 1921, either by ratifying this Convention or by submitting a declaration to the Director-General of the International Labour Office, then the continued ratification of these Conventions shall cease.

Query_Text_cn: 4.如本公约生效或当其生效之时：__UNDEF__(a)一个已批准了一九三七年(工业)最低年龄公约(修订)的会员国承担本公约的义务且已遵照本公约第二条规定了最低年龄不低于十五岁,则依法应为对该公约的立即解约,(b)关于一九三二年(非工业就业)最低年龄公约所规定的非工业就业,如一个批准了该公约的会员国承担本公约的义务,则依法应为对该公约的立即解约,(c)关于一九三七年(非工业就业)最低年龄公约(修订)所规定的非工业就业,如一个批准了该公约的会员国承担本公约的义务,并遵照本公约第二条规定了最低年龄不低于十五岁,则依法应为对该公约的立即解约,(d)关于海事就业,如一个批准了一九三六年(海上)最低年龄公约的会员国承担本公约的义务,并遵照本公约第二条规定了最低年龄不低于十五岁或该会员国规定本公约第三条适用于海事就业,则依法应为对该公约的立即解约,(e)关于海上捕鱼就业,如一个批准了一九五九年(渔民)最低年龄公约的会员国承担本公约的义务,并遵照本公约第二条规定了最低年龄不低于十五岁或该会员国规定本公约第三条适用于海上捕鱼就业,则依法应为对该公约的立即解约,(f)一个批准了一九六五年(井下工作)最低年龄公约的会员国承担本公约的义务,并遵照本公约第二条规定了不低于该公约规定的最低年龄或该会员国因本公约第三条而规定此年龄适用于井下就业时,则依法应为对该公约的立即解约。
5.如本公约生效或当其生效之时：__UNDEF__(a)关于一九一九年(工业)最低年龄公约,承担本公约的义务应涉及根据该公约第十二条对该公约解约,(b)关于农业,承担本公约的义务应涉及根据一九二一年(农业)最低年龄公约第九条对该公约解约,(c)关于海事就业,承担本公约的义务应涉及根据一九二O年(海上)最低年龄公约第十条和一九二一年(扒炭工和司炉工)公约第十二条对该公约解约。
第十一条本公约的正式批准书应送请国际劳工局长登记。
Translation: Article 11: The formal instruments of ratification of this Convention shall be communicated to the Director-General of the International Labour Office for registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条l.本公约应仅对其批准书已经国际劳工局长登记的会员国有约束力。
Translation: Article 12.1 This Convention shall be binding only upon those Member States whose instruments of ratification have been registered with the Director-General of the International Labour Office.

Query_Text_cn: 3.此后对于任何会员国,本公约应自其批准书已经登记之日起十二个月后生效。
Translation: 3. Thereafter, for any Member State, this Convention shall enter into force twelve months after the date on which its instrument of ratification has been registered.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条1.凡批准本公约的会员国,自本公约初次生效之日起满十年后,得向国际劳工局长通知解约,并请其登记。
Translation: Article 13(1). Any Member State that has ratified this Convention may, after the expiration of ten years from the date on which the Convention first comes into force, notify the Director-General of the International Labour Office of its denunciation of the Convention, and request its registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条1.国际劳工局长应将国际劳工组织各会员国所送达的一切批准书和解约通知书的登记情况,通知本组织的全体会员国。
Translation: Article 14(1). The Director-General of the International Labour Office shall notify all Members of the Organization of the registration of all ratifications and denunciations communicated by the Members of the International Labour Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条国际劳工局长应将他按照以上各条款规定所登记的一切批准书和解约通知书的详细情况,按照联合国宪章第102条的规定,送请联合国秘书长进行登记。
Translation: Article 15: The Director-General of the International Labour Office shall transmit to the Secretary-General of the United Nations, for registration in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations, full particulars of all ratifications and denunciations registered in accordance with the provisions of the preceding articles.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条国际劳工局理事会在必要时,应将本公约的实施情况向大会提出报告,并审查应否将本公约的全部或部分修订问题列入大会议程。
Translation: Article 16: The Governing Body of the International Labour Office shall, when necessary, submit a report to the Conference on the implementation of this Convention and shall examine whether the question of revising this Convention in whole or in part should be included in the agenda of the Conference.

Query_Text_cn: (a)如新修订公约生效和当其生效之时,会员国对于新修订公约的批准,不须按照上述第十三条的规定,依法应为对本公约的立即解约。
Translation: (a) When the newly revised Convention enters into force and at the time of its entry into force, the ratification of the newly revised Convention by a Member State shall not, in accordance with Article 13 above, be deemed as an immediate denunciation of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (b)自新修订公约生效之日起,本公约应即停止接受会员国的批准。
Translation: (b) From the date of entry into force of the newly revised Convention, this Convention shall cease to be open for ratification by Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条本公约的英文本和法文本同等为准。
Translation: Article 18 The English and French texts of this Convention shall be equally authentic.
